grammar_rules:
Present Simple — odatda bo‘ladigan ishlar.
Present Continuous — hozir bo‘layotgan ishlar.
Past Simple — oldin bo‘lib tugagan ishlar.

1. Present Simple — odat, tartib, doimiy holat

Present Simple bizning kundalik hayotimiz, odatlarimiz, doimiy ishlarimiz haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

Masalan, talaba o‘z hayoti haqida gapirsa:

I study English every day.
Men har kuni ingliz tili o‘qiyman.

Bu yerda ish aynan hozir bo‘layotgani shart emas. Bu uning odatiy hayoti.

Real vaziyatlar

1. Kundalik tartib

I wake up at 7 o’clock.
Men soat 7 da uyg‘onaman.

I go to school every day.
Men har kuni maktabga boraman.

I do my homework in the evening.
Men kechqurun uy vazifamni qilaman.

Bu gaplar har kuni yoki doimiy takrorlanadigan ishlar haqida.

2. Odatlar

She drinks tea in the morning.
U ertalab choy ichadi.

He plays football on Sundays.
U yakshanba kunlari futbol o‘ynaydi.

They watch TV in the evening.
Ular kechqurun televizor ko‘rishadi.

Bu ishlar hozir bo‘layotgani emas, odatda shunday bo‘lishi haqida.

3. Doimiy holat

I live in Urgench.
Men Urganchda yashayman.

My father works at school.
Dadam maktabda ishlaydi.

She likes English.
U ingliz tilini yoqtiradi.

Bu gaplar doimiy yoki uzoq davom etadigan holat haqida.

4. Umumiy haqiqatlar

Water boils at 100°C.
Suv 100°C da qaynaydi.

The sun rises in the east.
Quyosh sharqdan chiqadi.

Cats like milk.
Mushuklar sutni yoqtiradi.

Bu gaplar umumiy haqiqat yoki fakt.

2. Present Continuous — hozir bo‘layotgan ish

Present Continuous aynan hozir, shu paytda, ko‘z oldimizda bo‘layotgan ishlar uchun ishlatiladi.

Masalan, dars paytida:

The students are writing.
O‘quvchilar yozishyapti.

Bu ish hozir, shu onda davom etyapti.

Real vaziyatlar

1. Dars paytida

The teacher is explaining the lesson.
Ustoz darsni tushuntiryapti.

The students are listening.
O‘quvchilar tinglashyapti.

One student is answering the question.
Bir o‘quvchi savolga javob beryapti.

Bu gaplar aynan dars davomida hozir bo‘layotgan ishlar haqida.

2. Uyda hozirgi holat

My mother is cooking dinner.
Onam ovqat pishiryapti.

My brother is watching TV.
Ukam televizor ko‘ryapti.

I am doing my homework.
Men uy vazifamni qilyapman.

Bu ishlar hozir uyda sodir bo‘lyapti.

3. Telefon orqali gaplashganda

Do‘sting telefon qiladi va so‘raydi: “Nima qilyapsan?”

I am studying.
Men o‘qiyapman.

I am watching a film.
Men film ko‘ryapman.

I am going home.
Men uyga ketyapman.

Bu yerda odam ayni paytda nima qilayotganini aytyapti.

4. Vaqtinchalik holat

I am staying with my uncle this week.
Men bu hafta amakimnikida turibman.

He is working in Tashkent this month.
U bu oy Toshkentda ishlayapti.

We are learning online these days.
Biz shu kunlarda online o‘qiyapmiz.

Bu holatlar doimiy emas, vaqtincha.

3. Past Simple — oldin bo‘lib tugagan ish

Past Simple — o‘tgan zamonda bo‘lgan va tugagan ishlar uchun ishlatiladi.

Masalan:

I watched a film yesterday.
Men kecha film ko‘rdim.

Bu ish hozir davom etmayapti. Kecha bo‘lgan va tugagan.

Real vaziyatlar

1. Kechagi kun haqida

I played football yesterday.
Men kecha futbol o‘ynadim.

She visited her grandmother yesterday.
U kecha buvisinikiga bordi.

We studied English yesterday.
Biz kecha ingliz tili o‘qidik.

Bu gaplar kecha bo‘lgan ishlar haqida.

2. O‘tgan hafta yoki oy haqida

They travelled to Tashkent last week.
Ular o‘tgan hafta Toshkentga sayohat qilishdi.

He bought a new phone last month.
U o‘tgan oy yangi telefon sotib oldi.

We finished the course last year.
Biz o‘tgan yili kursni tugatdik.

Bu ishlar aniq o‘tgan vaqtda tugagan.

3. Hikoya aytganda

Yesterday I woke up early. I had breakfast. Then I went to school. After school, I played football.

Kecha men erta turdim. Nonushta qildim. Keyin maktabga bordim. Maktabdan keyin futbol o‘ynadim.

Hikoya qilishda Past Simple juda ko‘p ishlatiladi, chunki voqealar ketma-ket o‘tgan zamonda bo‘ladi.
grammar_rules_en:
Present Simple — things that usually happen.
Present Continuous — things happening now.
Past Simple — things that happened and finished earlier.

1. Present Simple — habits, routines, permanent states

We use the Present Simple to talk about our daily life, our habits and the things we always do.

For example, when a student talks about their life:

I study English every day.

This sentence is about their daily life.

Real situations

1. Daily routine

I wake up at 7 o’clock.

I go to school every day.

I do my homework in the evening.

These sentences are about actions that happen every day or are repeated regularly.

2. Habits

She drinks tea in the morning.

He plays football on Sundays.

They watch TV in the evening.

These actions are not happening now, but usually occur like this.

3. Permanent states

I live in Urgench.

My father works at school.

She likes English.

These sentences are about permanent or long-lasting states.

4. General truths

Water boils at 100°C.

The sun rises in the east.

Cats like milk.

These sentences express general truths or facts.

2. Present Continuous — actions happening now

Present Continuous is used for actions that are happening right now, at this moment, in front of us.

For example, during the lesson:

The students are writing.

This action is currently ongoing at this moment.

Real situations

1. During the lesson

The teacher is explaining the lesson.

The students are listening.

One student is answering the question.

These sentences are about actions happening right now during the lesson.

2. Current situation at home

My mother is cooking dinner.

My brother is watching TV.

I am doing my homework.

These actions are happening at home right now.

3. When talking on the phone

Your friend calls and asks: “What are you doing?”

I am studying.

I am watching a film.

I am going home.

Here, the person is saying what they are doing at that moment.

4. Temporary situations

I am staying with my uncle this week.

He is working in Tashkent this month.

We are learning online these days.

These situations are not permanent, they are temporary.

3. Past Simple — actions that happened and finished earlier

Past Simple is used for actions that occurred and finished in the past.

For example:

I watched a film yesterday.

This action is not ongoing now. It happened and finished yesterday.

Real situations

1. About yesterday

I played football yesterday.

She visited her grandmother yesterday.

We studied English yesterday.

These sentences are about actions that happened yesterday.

2. About last week or month

They travelled to Tashkent last week.

He bought a new phone last month.

We finished the course last year.

These actions were completed at a specific time in the past.

3. When telling a story

Yesterday I woke up early. I had breakfast. Then I went to school. After school, I played football.

Yesterday, I woke up early. I had breakfast. Then I went to school. After school, I played football.

Past Simple is often used in storytelling because events occur in a sequence in the past.
grammar_rules_ru:
Present Simple — то, что происходит обычно.
Present Continuous — то, что происходит сейчас.
Past Simple — то, что произошло и закончилось раньше.

1. Present Simple — привычка, распорядок, постоянное состояние

Present Simple используется, когда мы говорим о нашей повседневной жизни, привычках и постоянных делах.

Например, если студент рассказывает о своей жизни:

I study English every day.
Я каждый день занимаюсь английским.

Здесь не обязательно, чтобы действие происходило именно сейчас. Это его обычная жизнь.

Реальные ситуации

1. Распорядок дня

I wake up at 7 o’clock.
Я встаю в 7 часов.

I go to school every day.
Я хожу в школу каждый день.

I do my homework in the evening.
Я делаю домашнее задание вечером.

Эти предложения о действиях, которые происходят каждый день или регулярно.

2. Привычки

She drinks tea in the morning.
Она пьет чай утром.

He plays football on Sundays.
Он играет в футбол по воскресеньям.

They watch TV in the evening.
Они смотрят телевизор вечером.

Эти действия не происходят сейчас, а обычно так и бывает.

3. Постоянное состояние

I live in Urgench.
Я живу в Ургенче.

My father works at school.
Мой отец работает в школе.

She likes English.
Она любит английский.

Эти предложения о постоянных или длительных состояниях.

4. Общие факты

Water boils at 100°C.
Вода кипит при 100°C.

The sun rises in the east.
Солнце встает на востоке.

Cats like milk.
Кошки любят молоко.

Эти предложения о общих истинах или фактах.

2. Present Continuous — действия, происходящие сейчас

Present Continuous используется для действий, которые происходят именно сейчас, в данный момент, перед нашими глазами.

Например, во время урока:

The students are writing.
Студенты пишут.

Это действие происходит сейчас, в данный момент.

Реальные ситуации

1. Во время урока

The teacher is explaining the lesson.
Учитель объясняет урок.

The students are listening.
Студенты слушают.

One student is answering the question.
Один студент отвечает на вопрос.

Эти предложения о действиях, которые происходят именно во время урока.

2. Текущая ситуация дома

My mother is cooking dinner.
Моя мама готовит ужин.

My brother is watching TV.
Мой брат смотрит телевизор.

I am doing my homework.
Я делаю домашнее задание.

Эти действия происходят сейчас дома.

3. Когда говоришь по телефону

Друг звонит и спрашивает: “Что ты делаешь?”

I am studying.
Я учусь.

I am watching a film.
Я смотрю фильм.

I am going home.
Я иду домой.

Здесь человек говорит, что он делает в данный момент.

4. Временное состояние

I am staying with my uncle this week.
Я на этой неделе остаюсь у дяди.

He is working in Tashkent this month.
Он работает в Ташкенте в этом месяце.

We are learning online these days.
Мы учимся онлайн в эти дни.

Эти состояния не постоянные, временные.

3. Past Simple — действия, которые произошли и закончились

Past Simple используется для действий, которые произошли и закончились в прошлом.

Например:

I watched a film yesterday.
Я посмотрел фильм вчера.

Это действие не продолжается сейчас. Оно произошло и закончилось вчера.

Реальные ситуации

1. О вчерашнем дне

I played football yesterday.
Я играл в футбол вчера.

She visited her grandmother yesterday.
Она навестила бабушку вчера.

We studied English yesterday.
Мы изучали английский вчера.

Эти предложения о действиях, которые произошли вчера.

2. О прошлой неделе или месяце

They travelled to Tashkent last week.
Они путешествовали в Ташкент на прошлой неделе.

He bought a new phone last month.
Он купил новый телефон в прошлом месяце.

We finished the course last year.
Мы закончили курс в прошлом году.

Эти действия закончились в определенное время в прошлом.

3. Когда рассказываешь историю

Yesterday I woke up early. I had breakfast. Then I went to school. After school, I played football.

Вчера я встал рано. Я позавтракал. Затем я пошел в школу. После школы я играл в футбол.

При рассказе истории Past Simple используется очень часто, так как события происходят последовательно в прошлом.
grammar_rules_kk:
Present Simple — ádette bolatuǵın isler.
Present Continuous — házir bolıp atırǵan isler.
Past Simple — burın bolıp tamamlanǵan isler.

1. Present Simple — ádet, tártip, doimiy jaǵday

Present Simple biziń kúndelikli turmısımız, ádetlerimiz, doimiy islerimiz haqqında aytqanda qollanıladı.

Mısalı, student óz hayatı haqqında aytsa:

I study English every day.
Men hár kúni inglis tilin oqıyman.

Bul jerde is dál házir bolıp atırıwı shárt emes. Bul onıń ádettegi turmısı.

Real jaǵdaylar

1. Kúndelikli tártip

I wake up at 7 o’clock.
Men soat 7 de uyg‘onaman.

I go to school every day.
Men hár kúni mektepke boraman.

I do my homework in the evening.
Men kechqurun uy vazifamni qilaman.

Bul gáplar hár kúni yaki doimiy takrorlanǵan isler haqqında.

2. Ádetler

She drinks tea in the morning.
U ertalab choy ichadi.

He plays football on Sundays.
U yakshanba kúnlérinde futbol o‘ynaydi.

They watch TV in the evening.
Ular kechqurun televizor ko‘rishadi.

Bul isler házir bolıp atırǵan emes, ádette shunday bolıwı haqqında.

3. Doimiy jaǵday

I live in Urgench.
Men Urganchda yashayman.

My father works at school.
Dadam mektepte ishlaydi.

She likes English.
U inglis tilin yoqtiradi.

Bul gáplar doimiy yaki uzoq davom etip atırǵan jaǵday haqqında.

4. Umumiy haqiqatlar

Water boils at 100°C.
Suv 100°C da qaynaydi.

The sun rises in the east.
Quyosh sharqdan chiqadı.

Cats like milk.
Mushuklar sutni yoqtiradi.

Bul gáplar umumiy haqiqat yaki fakt.

2. Present Continuous — házir bolıp atırǵan is

Present Continuous házir, shu paytda, kóz aldıńızǵa keltiriw bolıp atırǵan isler ushın qollanıladı.

Mısalı, dars paytında:

The students are writing.
O‘quvshılar yozıp atır.

Bul is házir, shu onda davom etip atır.

Real jaǵdaylar

1. Dars paytında

The teacher is explaining the lesson.
Ustoz darsnı túsindiriw atır.

The students are listening.
O‘quvshılar tinglip atır.

One student is answering the question.
Bir o‘quvshi savolğa juwap beryip atır.

Bul gáplar házir dars davomında bolıp atırǵan isler haqqında.

2. Uyda házirgi jaǵday

My mother is cooking dinner.
Onam ovqat pishirip atır.

My brother is watching TV.
Ukam televizor ko‘rıp atır.

I am doing my homework.
Men uy vazifamni qılıp atırmın.

Bul isler házir uyda sodir bolıp atır.

3. Telefon arqılıq gaplaşıwda

Do‘sting telefon qiladi hám so‘raydı: “Ne qılıp atırsıñ?”

I am studying.
Men o‘qıp atırmın.

I am watching a film.
Men film ko‘rıp atırmın.

I am going home.
Men uyğa ketip atırmın.

Bul jerde adam áni paytda nima qılıp atırǵanın aytıp atır.

4. Vaqtinchalik jaǵday

I am staying with my uncle this week.
Men bul hafta amakimnikide turıp atırmın.

He is working in Tashkent this month.
U bul oy Toshkentte ishlip atır.

We are learning online these days.
Biz shu kunlarda online o‘qıp atırmız.

Bul jaǵdaylar doimiy emes, vaqtincha.

3. Past Simple — burın bolıp tamamlanǵan is

Past Simple — o‘tken zamanda bolıp tamamlanǵan isler ushın qollanıladı.

Mısalı:

I watched a film yesterday.
Men keshe film ko‘rdim.

Bul is házir davom etip atır emes. Keshe bolıp tamamlanǵan.

Real jaǵdaylar

1. Keshegi kun haqqında

I played football yesterday.
Men keshe futbol o‘ynadım.

She visited her grandmother yesterday.
U keshe buvisinikige bordı.

We studied English yesterday.
Biz keshe inglis tilin oqıdıq.

Bul gáplar keshe bolıp atırǵan isler haqqında.

2. O‘tken hafta yaki oy haqqında

They travelled to Tashkent last week.
Ular o‘tken hafta Toshkentke sayahat qıldı.

He bought a new phone last month.
U o‘tken oy jańa telefon sotıp aldı.

We finished the course last year.
Biz o‘tken jılı kursnı tamamladıq.

Bul isler anıq o‘tken waqıtta tamamlanǵan.

3. Hikoya aytganda

Yesterday I woke up early. I had breakfast. Then I went to school. After school, I played football.

Keshe men erta turdim. Nonushta qıldım. Keyin mektepke bordım. Mektepten keyin futbol o‘ynadım.

Hikoya qilishda Past Simple juda kób ishlitiladı, çünki voqealar ketma-ket o‘tken zamanda boladı.
reading_passage:
The student magazine has a new feature on producing a multimedia student magazine. It begins with a situation from a media laboratory.

The team normally publishes a digital magazine at the end of each month. This week students are editing photographs, checking audio and preparing page layouts.

Yesterday they interviewed two lecturers and recorded a short campus video. The editor uses present and past tenses to describe routines, current work and completed tasks.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Yesterday Lena opened the file, noticed the mistake and corrected it.” The mixed-media issue is ready for publication after a final review.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Lena and Sam compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

The final task asks readers to connect the topic with their own experience. They should explain one idea in their own words and then use the lesson grammar in a new sentence about producing a multimedia student magazine.

reading_vocabulary.definition: the arrangement of text and images on a page

reading_vocabulary.definition: a person who prepares content for publication
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “editor” in the context of producing a multimedia student magazine.

reading_vocabulary.definition: to make content available to the public
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “publish” in the context of producing a multimedia student magazine.

reading_vocabulary.definition: to capture sound or video
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “record” in the context of producing a multimedia student magazine.

reading_vocabulary.definition: one edition of a magazine

reading_questions.question: What is the text mainly about?

planning a journey inspired by Marco Polo
a classroom lost-and-found table
producing a multimedia student magazine

the campus sports centre
a media laboratory
an old countryside hotel

options: the team is going to visit a farm to learn how water use is measured
her host family had been inviting her to local events, which slowly made social situations easier
the team normally publishes a digital magazine at the end of each month
students from several countries shared food and described how they celebrated New Year at home

reading_questions.question: What additional information does the text give?

discussion of the book focuses on influence, interpretation and the transformation of private experience into public art

reading_questions.question: Which statement belongs to the later part of the text?

not only was the soup carefully prepared, but the staff also explained where the main ingredients came from

reading_questions.question: What happens or is explained after that?

conservation teams have repaired damaged sections while trying to preserve original materials
the editor uses present and past tenses to describe routines, current work and completed tasks

reading_questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the grammar focus of this lesson?

Lena is studying while Sam is talking on the phone.

content that combines text, images, audio or video

The class creates a short digital-study guide for first-year students.
The mixed-media issue is ready for publication after a final review.

reading_questions.question: Why is this text included in the lesson?
options: to copy a model answer without reading
to understand the topic and notice the target grammar in meaningful context
to memorise an unrelated word list
to translate every sentence word for word
reading_questions.hint: The lesson combines comprehension with grammar-in-context rather than isolated rules.

listening_transcript:
Lena: This is a short Learnist report from a media laboratory. The topic is producing a multimedia student magazine.
Sam: The students are working on how to report the progress of a multimedia project.
Lena: Here is the first key detail.
Sam: Adam says the team usually meets on Thursday.
Lena: The report also notes a second point.
Sam: Today they are finishing the cover design.
Lena: A third detail changes how the situation is understood.
Sam: Yesterday Nina recorded an interview for the science page.
Lena: One final fact completes the report.
Sam: They still need to check two audio clips before uploading the issue.
Lena: The lesson also includes this grammar example.
Sam: For example: Yesterday Lena opened the file, noticed the mistake and corrected it.
Lena: The report ends with this result.
Sam: The team expects to publish the magazine in the evening.

listening_questions.question: What are the speakers trying to do?
options: make long-term predictions using future perfect continuous
introduce ourselves before the first English class
report the progress of a multimedia project
describe parts of a historic house using relative clauses
listening_questions.hint: Listen to the purpose stated in the opening exchange.

listening_questions.question: What first detail does the second speaker mention?
options: Daniel believes AI assistants will help students organise information
emergency numbers are saved on every participant’s phone
Adam says the team usually meets on Thursday

he also describes why regular updates reduce security risks
today they are finishing the cover design
Nina says she has already completed two internships

listening_questions.question: Which detail changes or supports the decision?

listening_questions.question: Which sentence uses today’s target grammar?

listening_questions.question: What is the final result of the conversation?

instead of listening to the audio
to copy answers without checking evidence
after the first attempt, to compare what was heard with the exact wording

Past Simple: Irregular Verbs

Irregular verbs — o‘tgan zamonda -ed qo‘shilmaydigan fe’llar.

Ya’ni ular oddiy qoida bilan yasalmaydi, alohida yod olinadi.

Masalan:

1. Irregular verbs qachon ishlatiladi?

Irregular verbs ham Past Simple zamonida ishlatiladi. Ya’ni ish-harakat o‘tgan zamonda bo‘lgan va tugagan bo‘lsa ishlatiladi.

Masalan:

Men kecha maktabga bordim.

Bu ishlar hozir davom etmayapti. Ular o‘tgan zamonda bo‘lgan va tugagan.

Regular verbs

Regular verbs o‘tgan zamonda -ed oladi.

Irregular verbs

Inkor gapda didn’t ishlatiladi.

grammar_rules_en:
Past Simple: Irregular Verbs

Irregular verbs are verbs that don’t add -ed in the past.

That means they don’t follow the normal rule and have to be learned by heart.

For example:

go → went
come → came
eat → ate
see → saw
buy → bought

1. When are irregular verbs used?

Irregular verbs are also used in the Past Simple, that is, when an action happened and finished in the past.

For example:

I went to school yesterday.
I went to school yesterday.

She ate an apple.
She ate an apple.

They bought a new car last month.
They bought a new car last month.

These actions are not continuing now. They happened and finished in the past.

2. The difference between Regular and Irregular verbs

Regular verbs

Regular verbs add -ed in the past.

play → played
watch → watched
clean → cleaned

Irregular verbs

Irregular verbs change to a different form in the past.

go → went
see → saw
drink → drank
write → wrote

3. About school and lessons

I read a text yesterday.

She wrote an essay.

The teacher said the answer.

He understood the lesson.

4. About travel and shopping

We went to Tashkent last week.

5. Important rule in negative sentences

In negative sentences, didn’t is used.
After didn’t, the verb is in the base form, not in the past form.

Correct:

I didn’t go to school.

She didn’t eat breakfast.
She didn’t eat breakfast.

They didn’t buy a car.
They didn’t buy a car.

Incorrect:

I didn’t went to school.
I didn’t ate breakfast.
I didn’t bought a car.

6. Important rule in question sentences

In questions, Did is used.
After Did, the verb is in the base form.

Correct:

Did you go to school yesterday?

Did she eat breakfast?
Did she eat breakfast?

Did they buy a car?
Did they buy a car?

Incorrect:

Did she ate breakfast?
Did they bought a car?

7. Short answers

grammar_rules_ru:
Past Simple: Irregular Verbs

Неправильные глаголы — глаголы, к которым в прошедшем времени не добавляется -ed.

То есть они не образуются по обычному правилу, их нужно выучить отдельно.

Например:

go → went
come → came
eat → ate
see → saw
buy → bought

1. Когда используются неправильные глаголы?

Неправильные глаголы тоже используются в Past Simple. То есть когда действие произошло и закончилось в прошлом.

Например:

I went to school yesterday.
Я вчера пошёл в школу.

She ate an apple.
Она съела яблоко.

They bought a new car last month.
Они купили новую машину в прошлом месяце.

Эти действия сейчас не продолжаются. Они произошли и закончились в прошлом.

2. Разница между правильными и неправильными глаголами

Правильные глаголы

Правильные глаголы в прошедшем времени получают -ed.

play → played
watch → watched
clean → cleaned

Неправильные глаголы

Неправильные глаголы в прошедшем времени изменяются по-другому.

go → went
see → saw
drink → drank
write → wrote

5. Важное правило в отрицательных предложениях

В отрицательных предложениях используется didn’t.
После didn’t глагол не стоит в прошедшем времени, а в простой форме.

Правильно:

She didn’t ate breakfast.
They didn’t bought a car.

6. Важное правило в вопросительных предложениях

В вопросах используется Did.

Did she ate breakfast?
Did they bought a car?

reading_passage:
Maya is taking part in a lesson about a New Year celebration with friends. The activity is set in a student cultural club.

Students from several countries shared food and described how they celebrated New Year at home. Maya brought a traditional dessert, Daniel made a playlist and Sara wrote wishes on small cards.

After midnight the group sang, took photographs and gave each other small gifts. Some students went home early while others stayed and helped clean the room.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Last night Maya went to a celebration, saw friends and ate traditional food.” The event gave everyone a chance to use irregular past-tense verbs in a real story.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Maya and Daniel compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

listening_transcript:
Maya: Hi Daniel. Today we are talking about a New Year celebration with friends.
Daniel: Good. The main task is to tell a friend what happened at the New Year party.
Maya: What should we notice first?
Daniel: Daniel says he went to the cultural club at nine.
Maya: That helps. What is the second important point?
Daniel: He met students from five countries and ate several traditional dishes.
Maya: Is there anything else that affects the situation?
Daniel: Maya gave him a small card with a New Year wish.
Maya: Give me one final detail before we decide.
Daniel: After midnight they took a group photograph and went outside for a few minutes.
Maya: Can you connect the idea with today’s grammar?
Daniel: For example: Last night Maya went to a celebration, saw friends and ate traditional food.
Maya: So what is the final result?
Daniel: Daniel says the evening was simple but memorable.

listening_questions.question: What are the speakers trying to do?

grammar_rules:
Past Continuous — o‘tgan zamonda ma’lum bir vaqtda davom etayotgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Ya’ni ish o‘tmishda boshlangan, ma’lum bir paytda davom etayotgan bo‘lgan.

Masalan:

I was watching TV at 8 o’clock yesterday.
Men kecha soat 8 da televizor ko‘rayotgan edim.

She was cooking when I came home.
Men uyga kelganimda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

They were playing football at 5 o’clock yesterday.
Ular kecha soat 5 da futbol o‘ynayotgan edi.

1. Past Continuous qachon ishlatiladi?

1. O‘tgan zamonda aniq bir vaqtda davom etayotgan ish

Masalan, kecha soat 8 da nima qilayotgan edingiz?

I was doing my homework at 8 o’clock yesterday.
Men kecha soat 8 da uy vazifamni qilayotgan edim.

He was sleeping at 10 o’clock last night.
U kecha kechasi soat 10 da uxlayotgan edi.

We were studying English at this time yesterday.
Biz kecha shu paytda ingliz tili o‘qiyotgan edik.

2. Bir ish bo‘layotganda, ikkinchi ish sodir bo‘lsa

Bu holatda uzoqroq davom etayotgan ish Past Continuous, qisqa sodir bo‘lgan ish esa Past Simple bo‘ladi.

I was watching TV when my friend called me.
Do‘stim menga telefon qilganida men televizor ko‘rayotgan edim.

She was cooking when I came home.
Men uyga kelganimda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

They were playing football when it started to rain.
Yomg‘ir yog‘a boshlaganida ular futbol o‘ynayotgan edi.

3. Ikki ish bir vaqtda davom etayotgan bo‘lsa

Agar o‘tgan zamonda ikki ish bir vaqtning o‘zida davom etgan bo‘lsa, ikkalasida ham Past Continuous ishlatiladi.

I was reading while my brother was watching TV.
Ukam televizor ko‘rayotgan paytda men kitob o‘qiyotgan edim.

She was cooking while her children were playing.
Bolalari o‘ynayotgan paytda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

They were studying while we were cleaning the room.
Biz xonani tozalayotgan paytda ular o‘qiyotgan edi.

2. Past Continuous yasalishi

Darak gap

Subject + was / were + Verb-ing

Subject | To be past | Example
I | was | I was reading.
He / She / It | was | She was cooking.
You / We / They | were | They were playing.

Misollar:

I was reading a book.
Men kitob o‘qiyotgan edim.

She was watching TV.
U televizor ko‘rayotgan edi.

They were playing football.
Ular futbol o‘ynayotgan edi.

3. Was yoki Were?

Was

I / He / She / It bilan ishlatiladi.

I was studying.
Men o‘qiyotgan edim.

He was sleeping.
U uxlayotgan edi.

She was cooking.
U ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

It was raining.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi.

Were

You / We / They bilan ishlatiladi.

You were listening.
Sen tinglayotgan eding.

We were working.
Biz ishlayotgan edik.

They were running.
Ular yugurayotgan edi.

4. Inkor shakli

Was not = wasn’t
Were not = weren’t

I wasn’t sleeping.
Men uxlayotgan emas edim.

She wasn’t cooking.
U ovqat pishirayotgan emas edi.

They weren’t playing football.
Ular futbol o‘ynayotgan emas edi.

We weren’t watching TV.
Biz televizor ko‘rayotgan emas edik.

5. Savol shakli

Savol yasash uchun was / were gap boshiga chiqadi.

Was he sleeping?
U uxlayotgan edimi?

Was she cooking?
U ovqat pishirayotgan edimi?

Were you studying?
Sen o‘qiyotgan edingmi?

Were they playing football?
Ular futbol o‘ynayotgan edimi?

6. Qisqa javoblar

Question | Positive | Negative
Were you studying? | Yes, I was. | No, I wasn’t.
Was she cooking? | Yes, she was. | No, she wasn’t.
Was he sleeping? | Yes, he was. | No, he wasn’t.
Were they playing? | Yes, they were. | No, they weren’t.

7. Past Continuous signal words

Signal word | Ma’nosi
at 7 o’clock yesterday | kecha soat 7 da
at this time yesterday | kecha shu paytda
when | -ganida
while | paytda
all evening | butun kechqurun
all day yesterday | kecha kun bo‘yi

Misollar:

I was studying at 8 o’clock yesterday.
Men kecha soat 8 da o‘qiyotgan edim.

She was cooking when I came home.
Men uyga kelganimda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

They were playing while we were studying.
Biz o‘qiyotgan paytda ular o‘ynayotgan edi.

8. Present Continuous va Past Continuous farqi

Present Continuous

Hozir davom etayotgan ish.

I am reading now.
Men hozir o‘qiyapman.

She is cooking now.
U hozir ovqat pishiryapti.

Past Continuous

O‘tgan zamonda davom etayotgan ish.

I was reading at 8 yesterday.
Men kecha soat 8 da o‘qiyotgan edim.

She was cooking when I came home.
Men uyga kelganimda u ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

9. Past Simple va Past Continuous farqi

Past Simple

Ish o‘tgan zamonda bo‘lgan va tugagan.

I watched TV yesterday.
Men kecha televizor ko‘rdim.

Past Continuous

O‘tgan zamonda ish davom etayotgan bo‘lgan.

I was watching TV at 8 o’clock yesterday.
Men kecha soat 8 da televizor ko‘rayotgan edim.

Taqqoslang:

I cooked dinner yesterday.
Men kecha ovqat pishirdim.

I was cooking dinner when my friend called.
Do‘stim telefon qilganida men ovqat pishirayotgan edim.
grammar_rules_en:
Past Continuous — indicates an action that was in progress at a specific time in the past.

That means the action started in the past and was still ongoing at a certain moment.

For example:

I was watching TV at 8 o’clock yesterday.

She was cooking when I came home.

They were playing football at 5 o’clock yesterday.

1. When is the Past Continuous used?

1. An action in progress at a specific time in the past

For example, what were you doing at 8 o’clock yesterday?

I was doing my homework at 8 o’clock yesterday.

He was sleeping at 10 o’clock last night.

We were studying English at this time yesterday.

2. When one action is happening and a second action occurs

In this case, the longer action is in the Past Continuous, while the shorter action is in the Past Simple.

I was watching TV when my friend called me.

She was cooking when I came home.

They were playing football when it started to rain.

3. When two actions are happening at the same time

If two actions were happening at the same time in the past, both use the Past Continuous.

I was reading while my brother was watching TV.

She was cooking while her children were playing.

They were studying while we were cleaning the room.

2. Formation of the Past Continuous

Affirmative sentence

Subject + was / were + Verb-ing

Subject | To be past | Example
I | was | I was reading.
He / She / It | was | She was cooking.
You / We / They | were | They were playing.

Examples:

I was reading a book.

She was watching TV.

They were playing football.

3. Was or Were?

Was

Used with I / He / She / It.

I was studying.

He was sleeping.

She was cooking.

It was raining.

Were

Used with You / We / They.

You were listening.

We were working.

They were running.

4. Negative form

Was not = wasn’t
Were not = weren’t

I wasn’t sleeping.

She wasn’t cooking.

They weren’t playing football.

We weren’t watching TV.

5. Question form

To form a question, was / were comes to the beginning of the sentence.

Was he sleeping?

Was she cooking?

Were you studying?

Were they playing football?

6. Short answers

Question | Positive | Negative
Were you studying? | Yes, I was. | No, I wasn’t.
Was she cooking? | Yes, she was. | No, she wasn’t.
Was he sleeping? | Yes, he was. | No, he wasn’t.
Were they playing? | Yes, they were. | No, they weren’t.

7. Past Continuous signal words

Signal word | Meaning
at 7 o’clock yesterday | at 7 o’clock yesterday
at this time yesterday | at this time yesterday
when | when
while | while
all evening | all evening
all day yesterday | all day yesterday

Examples:

I was studying at 8 o’clock yesterday.

She was cooking when I came home.

They were playing while we were studying.

8. Difference between Present Continuous and Past Continuous

Present Continuous

An action that is currently in progress.

I am reading now.

She is cooking now.

Past Continuous

An action that was in progress in the past.

I was reading at 8 yesterday.

She was cooking when I came home.

9. Difference between Past Simple and Past Continuous

Past Simple

An action that happened and finished in the past.

I watched TV yesterday.

Past Continuous

An action that was ongoing in the past.

I was watching TV at 8 o’clock yesterday.

Compare:

I cooked dinner yesterday.

I was cooking dinner when my friend called.
grammar_rules_ru:
Past Continuous обозначает действие, которое длилось в определённый момент в прошлом.

То есть действие началось в прошлом и в определённый момент продолжалось.

Например:

I was watching TV at 8 o’clock yesterday.
Я смотрел телевизор в 8 часов вчера.

She was cooking when I came home.
Когда я пришёл домой, она готовила.

They were playing football at 5 o’clock yesterday.
Вчера в 5 часов они играли в футбол.

1. Когда используется Past Continuous?

1. Действие, которое длилось в определённый момент в прошлом

Например, что вы делали вчера в 8 часов?

I was doing my homework at 8 o’clock yesterday.
Я делал домашнее задание в 8 часов вчера.

He was sleeping at 10 o’clock last night.
Он спал в 10 часов прошлой ночью.

We were studying English at this time yesterday.
Мы изучали английский язык в это время вчера.

2. Когда одно действие происходит, а другое происходит

В этом случае длительное действие будет в Past Continuous, а краткое действие в Past Simple.

I was watching TV when my friend called me.
Я смотрел телевизор, когда мой друг позвонил мне.

She was cooking when I came home.
Когда я пришёл домой, она готовила.

They were playing football when it started to rain.
Они играли в футбол, когда начался дождь.

3. Когда два действия происходят одновременно

Если два действия происходят одновременно в прошлом, оба будут в Past Continuous.

I was reading while my brother was watching TV.
Я читал, пока мой брат смотрел телевизор.

She was cooking while her children were playing.
Она готовила, пока её дети играли.

They were studying while we were cleaning the room.
Они учились, пока мы убирали комнату.

2. Образование Past Continuous

Утвердительное предложение

Subject + was / were + Verb-ing

Subject | To be past | Example
I | was | I was reading.
He / She / It | was | She was cooking.
You / We / They | were | They were playing.

Примеры:

I was reading a book.
Я читал книгу.

She was watching TV.
Она смотрела телевизор.

They were playing football.
Они играли в футбол.

3. Was или Were?

Was

Используется с I / He / She / It.

I was studying.
Я учился.

He was sleeping.
Он спал.

She was cooking.
Она готовила.

It was raining.
Шёл дождь.

Were

Используется с You / We / They.

You were listening.
Ты слушал.

We were working.
Мы работали.

They were running.
Они бегали.

4. Отрицательная форма

Was not = wasn’t
Were not = weren’t

I wasn’t sleeping.
Я не спал.

She wasn’t cooking.
Она не готовила.

They weren’t playing football.
Они не играли в футбол.

We weren’t watching TV.
Мы не смотрели телевизор.

5. Вопросительная форма

Чтобы задать вопрос, was / were ставится в начало предложения.

Was he sleeping?
Он спал?

Was she cooking?
Она готовила?

Were you studying?
Ты учился?

Were they playing football?
Они играли в футбол?

6. Краткие ответы

Question | Positive | Negative
Were you studying? | Yes, I was. | No, I wasn’t.
Was she cooking? | Yes, she was. | No, she wasn’t.
Was he sleeping? | Yes, he was. | No, he wasn’t.
Were they playing? | Yes, they were. | No, they weren’t.

7. Сигнальные слова Past Continuous

Signal word | Значение
at 7 o’clock yesterday | вчера в 7 часов
at this time yesterday | вчера в это время
when | когда
while | пока
all evening | весь вечер
all day yesterday | весь день вчера

Примеры:

I was studying at 8 o’clock yesterday.
Я учился в 8 часов вчера.

She was cooking when I came home.
Когда я пришёл домой, она готовила.

They were playing while we were studying.
Они играли, пока мы учились.

8. Разница между Present Continuous и Past Continuous

Present Continuous

Действие, которое происходит сейчас.

I am reading now.
Я сейчас читаю.

She is cooking now.
Она сейчас готовит.

Past Continuous

Действие, которое происходило в прошлом.

I was reading at 8 yesterday.
Я читал в 8 часов вчера.

She was cooking when I came home.
Когда я пришёл домой, она готовила.

9. Разница между Past Simple и Past Continuous

Past Simple

Действие, которое произошло и завершилось в прошлом.

I watched TV yesterday.
Я смотрел телевизор вчера.

Past Continuous

Действие, которое происходило в прошлом.

I was watching TV at 8 o’clock yesterday.
Я смотрел телевизор в 8 часов вчера.

Сравните:

I cooked dinner yesterday.
Я готовил ужин вчера.

I was cooking dinner when my friend called.
Я готовил ужин, когда мой друг позвонил.

reading_passage:
A university English class is exploring a family mystery and possible alibis through a short article set in a fictional detective story.

A valuable ring disappeared during a family dinner at a large house. At eight o’clock the grandmother was talking to a neighbour while two cousins were washing dishes.

One uncle was reading in the study when he heard a door close upstairs. The youngest cousin was feeding the dog in the garden and did not see anyone leave.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Sara was reading when Leo heard a strange noise downstairs.” The detective compares what everyone was doing when the ring disappeared.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Sara and Leo compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

grammar_rules:
Present Perfect — o‘tgan zamonda boshlangan yoki bo‘lgan ishning hozir bilan aloqasi borligini bildiradi.

Bu zamonda asosiy e’tibor ish qachon bo‘lganida emas, balki uning natijasi hozir muhimligida bo‘ladi.

Masalan:

I have finished my homework.
Men uy vazifamni tugatdim.
Ya’ni hozir natija bor: uy vazifam tayyor.

She has lost her phone.
U telefonini yo‘qotib qo‘ydi.
Ya’ni hozir natija bor: telefoni yo‘q.

They have visited Samarkand.
Ular Samarqandga borishgan.
Ya’ni ular hayotida bu tajriba bor.

1. Present Perfect qachon ishlatiladi?

1. Natijasi hozir muhim bo‘lgan ishlar

I have cleaned my room.
Men xonamni tozaladim.

Bu gapda muhim narsa: xona hozir toza.

She has cooked dinner.
U ovqat pishirib bo‘ldi.

Bu gapda muhim narsa: ovqat hozir tayyor.

We have finished the test.
Biz testni tugatdik.

Bu gapda muhim narsa: test hozir tugagan.

2. Hayotiy tajriba haqida

Hayotimizda biror ishni qilganmiz yoki qilmaganmiz — shuni aytganda Present Perfect ishlatiladi.

I have been to Tashkent.
Men Toshkentda bo‘lganman.

She has seen this film.
U bu filmni ko‘rgan.

They have tried sushi.
Ular sushi yeb ko‘rishgan.

We have visited Bukhara.
Biz Buxoroga borganmiz.

Bu yerda aniq vaqt muhim emas. Muhim narsa — tajriba bor yoki yo‘q.

3. Yaqinda bo‘lgan ishlar

Just bilan juda ko‘p ishlatiladi.

I have just finished my homework.
Men hozirgina uy vazifamni tugatdim.

She has just arrived.
U hozirgina yetib keldi.

They have just started the lesson.
Ular hozirgina darsni boshlashdi.

4. Hali bo‘lmagan ishlar

Yet odatda inkor va savol gaplarda ishlatiladi.

I haven’t finished my homework yet.
Men hali uy vazifamni tugatmadim.

She hasn’t called me yet.
U hali menga telefon qilmadi.

Have you done your homework yet?
Uy vazifangni qilib bo‘ldingmi?

5. Allaqachon bo‘lgan ishlar

Already darak gaplarda ishlatiladi.

I have already eaten.
Men allaqachon ovqatlanib bo‘ldim.

She has already finished the task.
U topshiriqni allaqachon tugatdi.

They have already left.
Ular allaqachon ketishdi.

6. Boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat

For va since bilan ishlatiladi.

I have lived in Urgench for five years.
Men Urganchda 5 yildan beri yashayman.

She has studied English since 2022.
U 2022-yildan beri ingliz tili o‘rganadi.

We have known each other for two years.
Biz bir-birimizni 2 yildan beri bilamiz.

2. Present Perfect yasalishi

Darak gap

Subject + have / has + Verb 3

I have finished.
Men tugatdim.

She has finished.
U tugatdi.

They have finished.
Ular tugatishdi.

Have yoki Has?

Subject | Have / Has
I | have
You | have
We | have
They | have
He | has
She | has
It | has

Misollar:

I have done my homework.
Men uy vazifamni qildim.

She has done her homework.
U uy vazifasini qildi.

We have seen this film.
Biz bu filmni ko‘rganmiz.

He has lost his key.
U kalitini yo‘qotdi.

3. Verb 3 nima?

Present Perfectda fe’lning uchinchi shakli ishlatiladi.

Regular verbs

Regular fe’llarda Verb 3 odatda -ed bilan bo‘ladi.

Verb 1 | Verb 3
play | played
watch | watched
clean | cleaned
finish | finished
visit | visited

Misollar:

I have watched this film.
Men bu filmni ko‘rganman.

She has cleaned the room.
U xonani tozaladi.

Irregular verbs

Irregular fe’llarning Verb 3 shakli yod olinadi.

Verb 1 | Verb 2 | Verb 3
go | went | gone
come | came | come
see | saw | seen
eat | ate | eaten
drink | drank | drunk
do | did | done
write | wrote | written
read | read | read
buy | bought | bought
make | made | made
take | took | taken
give | gave | given
speak | spoke | spoken
be | was/were | been
have | had | had

Misollar:

I have gone home.
Men uyga ketganman.

She has eaten breakfast.
U nonushta qilib bo‘ldi.

They have seen this film.
Ular bu filmni ko‘rishgan.

4. Inkor gap

Have not = haven’t
Has not = hasn’t

I haven’t finished my homework.
Men uy vazifamni tugatmadim.

She hasn’t eaten breakfast.
U nonushta qilmadi.

They haven’t seen this film.
Ular bu filmni ko‘rishmagan.

5. Savol gap

Savolda have / has gap boshiga chiqadi.

Have you finished your homework?
Uy vazifangni tugatdingmi?

Has she eaten breakfast?
U nonushta qildimi?

Have they visited Tashkent?
Ular Toshkentga borishganmi?

6. Qisqa javoblar

| Question | Positive | Negative |
| Have you finished? | Yes, I have. | No, I haven’t. |
| Has she eaten? | Yes, she has. | No, she hasn’t. |
| Have they gone? | Yes, they have. | No, they haven’t. |

7. Present Perfect signal words

Signal word | Ma’nosi
already | allaqachon
just | hozirgina
yet | hali / hali ham
ever | hech qachon? / hayotingizda
never | hech qachon
for | davomida / beri
since | -dan beri
recently | yaqinda
so far | hozirgacha

8. Ever va Never

Ever

Ever savollarda ishlatiladi. Hayotda biror ishni qilib ko‘rganmisiz deb so‘raydi.

Have you ever been to Samarkand?
Samarqandda hech bo‘lganmisiz?

Have you ever eaten sushi?
Sushi yeb ko‘rganmisiz?

Have you ever met a famous person?
Mashhur odamni uchratganmisiz?

Never

Never “hech qachon” degani.

I have never been to London.
Men Londonda hech bo‘lmaganman.

She has never eaten sushi.
U hech qachon sushi yemagan.

They have never seen snow.
Ular hech qachon qor ko‘rmagan.

9. For va Since farqi

For

For — qancha vaqt davomida?

for two days
ikki kundan beri

for three years
uch yildan beri

for a long time
uzoq vaqtdan beri

Misollar:

I have lived here for five years.
Men bu yerda 5 yildan beri yashayman.

She has studied English for two years.
U 2 yildan beri ingliz tili o‘rganadi.

Since

Since — qachondan beri?

since 2020
2020-yildan beri

since Monday
dushanbadan beri

since morning
ertalabdan beri

Misollar:

I have lived here since 2020.
Men bu yerda 2020-yildan beri yashayman.

She has studied English since September.
U sentabrdan beri ingliz tili o‘rganadi.

10. Past Simple va Present Perfect farqi

Past Simple

Aniq o‘tgan vaqt bor:

I watched this film yesterday.
Men bu filmni kecha ko‘rdim.

She went to Tashkent last week.
U o‘tgan hafta Toshkentga bordi.

Present Perfect

Aniq vaqt muhim emas, natija yoki tajriba muhim:

I have watched this film.
Men bu filmni ko‘rganman.

She has gone to Tashkent.
U Toshkentga ketgan.

Farq:

I lost my key yesterday.
Men kecha kalitimni yo‘qotdim.
Bu yerda vaqt muhim: kecha.

I have lost my key.
Men kalitimni yo‘qotib qo‘ydim.
Bu yerda natija muhim: hozir kalit yo‘q.

11. Talabalar uchun eng kerakli gaplar

I have done my homework.
Men uy vazifamni qilib bo‘ldim.

I haven’t done my homework yet.
Men hali uy vazifamni qilib bo‘lmadim.

Have you finished the exercise?
Mashqni tugatdingmi?

She has already learned new words.
U yangi so‘zlarni allaqachon o‘rgandi.

We have just started the lesson.
Biz hozirgina darsni boshladik.

I have never been to London.
Men Londonda hech bo‘lmaganman.

Have you ever spoken English with a foreigner?
Hech chet ellik bilan inglizcha gaplashganmisiz?

I have studied English for two years.
Men ikki yildan beri ingliz tili o‘rganaman.

He has lived in Urgench since 2020.
U 2020-yildan beri Urganchda yashaydi.
grammar_rules_en:
The Present Perfect shows that something that started or happened in the past is connected to the present.

In this tense the focus is not on when the action happened, but on its result mattering now.

For example:

I have finished my homework.
So there is a result now: my homework is done.

She has lost her phone.
So there is a result now: she has no phone.

They have visited Samarkand.
So they have this experience in their lives.

1. When is the Present Perfect used?

1. Actions whose result matters now

I have cleaned my room.
So there is a result now: my room is clean.

This sentence emphasizes: the room is clean now.

She has cooked dinner.
So there is a result now: the dinner is ready.

This sentence emphasizes: the dinner is ready now.

We have finished the test.
So there is a result now: the test is finished.

This sentence emphasizes: the test is finished now.

2. About life experiences

The Present Perfect is used to say whether we have done something in our lives or not.

I have been to Tashkent.
So I have this experience: I have been to Tashkent.

She has seen this film.
So she has this experience: she has seen this film.

They have tried sushi.
So they have this experience: they have tried sushi.

We have visited Bukhara.
So we have this experience: we have visited Bukhara.

Here, the exact time is not important. What matters is whether the experience exists or not.

3. Recent actions

Just is used very often.

I have just finished my homework.

She has just arrived.

They have just started the lesson.

4. Actions that have not happened yet

Yet is usually used in negative and interrogative sentences.

I haven’t finished my homework yet.

She hasn’t called me yet.

Have you done your homework yet?

5. Actions that have already happened

Already is used in affirmative sentences.

I have already eaten.

She has already finished the task.

They have already left.

6. Situations that started and continue until now

Used with for and since.

I have lived in Urgench for five years.

She has studied English since 2022.

We have known each other for two years.

2. Formation of the Present Perfect

Affirmative sentence

Subject + have / has + Verb 3

I have finished.

She has finished.

They have finished.

Have or Has?

Subject | Have / Has
I | have
You | have
We | have
They | have
He | has
She | has
It | has

Examples:

I have done my homework.

She has done her homework.

We have seen this film.

He has lost his key.

3. What is Verb 3?

In the Present Perfect, the third form of the verb is used.

Regular verbs

In regular verbs, Verb 3 usually ends with -ed.

Verb 1 | Verb 3
play | played
watch | watched
clean | cleaned
finish | finished
visit | visited

Examples:

I have watched this film.

She has cleaned the room.

Irregular verbs

The third form of irregular verbs is memorized.

Verb 1 | Verb 2 | Verb 3
go | went | gone
come | came | come
see | saw | seen
eat | ate | eaten
drink | drank | drunk
do | did | done
write | wrote | written
read | read | read
buy | bought | bought
make | made | made
take | took | taken
give | gave | given
speak | spoke | spoken
be | was/were | been
have | had | had

Examples:

I have gone home.

She has eaten breakfast.

They have seen this film.

4. Negative sentences

Have not = haven’t
Has not = hasn’t

I haven’t finished my homework.

She hasn’t eaten breakfast.

They haven’t seen this film.

5. Question sentences

In questions, have / has comes to the beginning of the sentence.

Have you finished your homework?

Has she eaten breakfast?

Have they visited Tashkent?

6. Short answers

| Question | Positive | Negative |
| Have you finished? | Yes, I have. | No, I haven’t. |
| Has she eaten? | Yes, she has. | No, she hasn’t. |
| Have they gone? | Yes, they have. | No, they haven’t. |

7. Present Perfect signal words

Signal word | Meaning
already | already
just | just
yet | yet / still
ever | ever?
never | never
for | for / since
since | since
recently | recently
so far | so far

8. Ever and Never

Ever

Ever is used in questions. It asks if you have ever done something in your life.

Have you ever been to Samarkand?

Have you ever eaten sushi?

Have you ever met a famous person?

Never

Never means 'never'.

I have never been to London.

I have never eaten sushi.

They have never seen snow.

9. The difference between For and Since

For

For — how long?

for two days

for three years

for a long time

Examples:

I have lived here for five years.

She has studied English for two years.

Since

Since — since when?

since 2020

since Monday

since morning

Examples:

I have lived here since 2020.

She has studied English since September.

10. The difference between Past Simple and Present Perfect

Past Simple

There is a specific past time:

I watched this film yesterday.

She went to Tashkent last week.

Present Perfect

The specific time is not important; the result or experience is important:

I have watched this film.

She has gone to Tashkent.

Difference:

I lost my key yesterday.

I have lost my key.

11. Most necessary sentences for students

I have done my homework.

I haven’t done my homework yet.

Have you finished the exercise?

She has already learned new words.

We have just started the lesson.

I have never been to London.

Have you ever spoken English with a foreigner?

I have studied English for two years.

He has lived in Urgench since 2020.
grammar_rules_ru:
Present Perfect — показывает, что действие, которое началось или произошло в прошлом, связано с настоящим.

В этом времени главное внимание не на том, когда произошло действие, а на том, что его результат важен сейчас.

Например:

I have finished my homework.
Я закончил домашнее задание.
То есть сейчас есть результат: задание готово.

She has lost her phone.
Она потеряла телефон.
То есть сейчас есть результат: телефона нет.

They have visited Samarkand.
Они бывали в Самарканде.
То есть у них в жизни есть такой опыт.

1. Когда используется Present Perfect?

1. Действия, результат которых важен сейчас

I have cleaned my room.
Я убрал свою комнату.

В этом предложении важно: комната сейчас чистая.

She has cooked dinner.
Она приготовила ужин.

В этом предложении важно: еда сейчас готова.

We have finished the test.
Мы закончили тест.

В этом предложении важно: тест сейчас завершен.

2. О жизненном опыте

Present Perfect используется, когда мы говорим о том, что сделали или не сделали в жизни.

I have been to Tashkent.
Я был в Ташкенте.

She has seen this film.
Она видела этот фильм.

They have tried sushi.
Они пробовали суши.

We have visited Bukhara.
Мы посетили Бухару.

Здесь конкретное время не важно. Важно — есть ли опыт или нет.

3. Недавние действия

Часто используется с just.

I have just finished my homework.
Я только что закончил домашнее задание.

She has just arrived.
Она только что приехала.

They have just started the lesson.
Они только что начали урок.

4. Действия, которые еще не произошли

Yet обычно используется в отрицательных и вопросительных предложениях.

I haven’t finished my homework yet.
Я еще не закончил домашнее задание.

She hasn’t called me yet.
Она еще не позвонила мне.

Have you done your homework yet?
Ты уже сделал домашнее задание?

5. Действия, которые уже произошли

Already используется в утвердительных предложениях.

I have already eaten.
Я уже поел.

She has already finished the task.
Она уже закончила задание.

They have already left.
Они уже ушли.

6. Состояние, начавшееся в прошлом и продолжающееся до настоящего

Используется с for и since.

I have lived in Urgench for five years.
Я живу в Ургенче уже пять лет.

She has studied English since 2022.
Она изучает английский с 2022 года.

We have known each other for two years.
Мы знаем друг друга уже два года.

2. Образование Present Perfect

Утвердительное предложение

Subject + have / has + Verb 3

I have finished.
Я закончил.

She has finished.
Она закончила.

They have finished.
Они закончили.

Have или Has?

Subject | Have / Has
I | have
You | have
We | have
They | have
He | has
She | has
It | has

Примеры:

I have done my homework.
Я сделал домашнее задание.

She has done her homework.
Она сделала домашнее задание.

We have seen this film.
Мы видели этот фильм.

He has lost his key.
Он потерял свой ключ.

3. Что такое Verb 3?

В Present Perfect используется третья форма глагола.

Правильные глаголы

У правильных глаголов третья форма обычно образуется с помощью -ed.

Verb 1 | Verb 3
play | played
watch | watched
clean | cleaned
finish | finished
visit | visited

Примеры:

I have watched this film.
Я смотрел этот фильм.

She has cleaned the room.
Она убрала комнату.

Неправильные глаголы

Третья форма неправильных глаголов запоминается.

Verb 1 | Verb 2 | Verb 3
go | went | gone
come | came | come
see | saw | seen
eat | ate | eaten
drink | drank | drunk
do | did | done
write | wrote | written
read | read | read
buy | bought | bought
make | made | made
take | took | taken
give | gave | given
speak | spoke | spoken
be | was/were | been
have | had | had

Примеры:

I have gone home.
Я ушел домой.

She has eaten breakfast.
Она позавтракала.

They have seen this film.
Они видели этот фильм.

4. Отрицательное предложение

Have not = haven’t
Has not = hasn’t

I haven’t finished my homework.
Я не закончил домашнее задание.

She hasn’t eaten breakfast.
Она не позавтракала.

They haven’t seen this film.
Они не видели этот фильм.

5. Вопросительное предложение

В вопросах have / has ставится в начало предложения.

Have you finished your homework?
Ты закончил домашнее задание?

Has she eaten breakfast?
Она позавтракала?

Have they visited Tashkent?
Они посетили Ташкент?

6. Краткие ответы

| Вопрос | Утвердительный | Отрицательный |
| Have you finished? | Да, я закончил. | Нет, я не закончил. |
| Has she eaten? | Да, она позавтракала. | Нет, она не позавтракала. |
| Have they gone? | Да, они ушли. | Нет, они не ушли. |

7. Сигнальные слова Present Perfect

Сигнальное слово | Значение
already | уже
just | только что
yet | еще / пока
ever | когда-либо?
never | никогда
for | в течение / с
since | с
recently | недавно
so far | до сих пор

8. Ever и Never

Ever

Ever используется в вопросах. Спрашивает, делали ли вы что-то в жизни.

Have you ever been to Samarkand?
Вы когда-либо были в Самарканде?

Have you ever eaten sushi?
Вы когда-либо пробовали суши?

Have you ever met a famous person?
Вы когда-либо встречали знаменитого человека?

Never

Never означает «никогда».

I have never been to London.
Я никогда не был в Лондоне.

She has never eaten sushi.
Она никогда не ела суши.

They have never seen snow.
Они никогда не видели снег.

9. Разница между For и Since

For

For — сколько времени?

for two days
в течение двух дней

for three years
в течение трех лет

for a long time
в течение долгого времени

Примеры:

I have lived here for five years.
Я живу здесь уже пять лет.

She has studied English for two years.
Она учит английский язык уже два года.

Since

Since — с какого времени?

since 2020
с 2020 года

since Monday
с понедельника

since morning
с утра

Примеры:

I have lived here since 2020.
Я живу здесь с 2020 года.

She has studied English since September.
Она учит английский язык с сентября.

10. Разница между Past Simple и Present Perfect

Past Simple

Есть конкретное прошедшее время:

I watched this film yesterday.
Я смотрел этот фильм вчера.

She went to Tashkent last week.
Она поехала в Ташкент на прошлой неделе.

Present Perfect

Конкретное время не важно, важен результат или опыт:

I have watched this film.
Я смотрел этот фильм.

She has gone to Tashkent.
Она уехала в Ташкент.

Разница:

I lost my key yesterday.
Я потерял свой ключ вчера.
Здесь время важно: вчера.

I have lost my key.
Я потерял свой ключ.
Здесь важен результат: сейчас ключа нет.

11. Самые необходимые фразы для студентов

I have done my homework.
Я сделал свою домашнюю работу.

I haven’t done my homework yet.
Я еще не сделал свою домашнюю работу.

Have you finished the exercise?
Ты закончил упражнение?

She has already learned new words.
Она уже выучила новые слова.

We have just started the lesson.
Мы только что начали урок.

I have never been to London.
Я никогда не был в Лондоне.

Have you ever spoken English with a foreigner?
Ты когда-нибудь говорил по-английски с иностранцем?

I have studied English for two years.
Я изучаю английский язык уже два года.

He has lived in Urgench since 2020.
Он живет в Ургенче с 2020 года.
grammar_rules_kk:
Present Perfect — ótken zamanda boshlanǵan yamasa bolǵan istiń házir menen baylanısı bar ekenin bildiredi.

Bul zamanda asasıy e’tibar istiń qashan bolǵanında emes, al onıń nátiyjesi házir áhmiyetli ekeninde boladı.

Mısalı:

I have finished my homework.
Men úy tapsırmamdı pitkerdim.
Yaǵnıy házir nátiyje bar: úy tapsırmam tayar.

She has lost her phone.
Ol telefonın joǵaltıp qoydı.
Yaǵnıy házir nátiyje bar: telefonı joq.

They have visited Samarkand.
Olar Samarqandqa barǵan.
Yaǵnıy olardıń ómirinde bunday tájiriybe bar.

1. Present Perfect qashan qollanıladı?

1. Nátiyjesi házir áhmiyetli bolǵan isler

I have cleaned my room.
Men xonamni tozaladım.

Bul gápda muhim narsa: xona házir toza.

She has cooked dinner.
Ol ovqat pishirib boǵdı.

Bul gápda muhim narsa: ovqat házir tayar.

We have finished the test.
Biz testni tugatdıq.

Bul gápda muhim narsa: test házir tugadı.

2. Hayotiy tájiriybe háqında

Hayotımızda biror isni qilǵanımız yamasa qilmaǵanımız — shuni aytqanda Present Perfect qollanıladı.

I have been to Tashkent.
Men Toshkentda bolǵanman.

She has seen this film.
Ol bu filmni ko‘rǵan.

They have tried sushi.
Olar sushi yeb ko‘rǵan.

We have visited Bukhara.
Biz Buxoroga borganmız.

Bul yerda anıq waqıt muhim emes. Muhim narsa — tájiriybe bar yamasa yoq.

3. Yaqında bolǵan isler

Just bilen juda kóbinese qollanıladı.

I have just finished my homework.
Men hozirgina úy tapsırmamdı pitkerdim.

She has just arrived.
Ol hozirgina yetip keldi.

They have just started the lesson.
Olar hozirgina darsnı bastadı.

4. Hali bolmaǵan isler

Yet odatda inkor hám soraw gáplarında qollanıladı.

I haven’t finished my homework yet.
Men hali úy tapsırmamdı tugatmadım.

She hasn’t called me yet.
Ol hali menga telefon qilmadı.

Have you done your homework yet?
Úy tapsırǵıñnı qılıp bolǵan mı?

5. Allaqachon bolǵan isler

Already darak gáplarında qollanıladı.

I have already eaten.
Men allaqachon ovqatlanıp boǵdım.

She has already finished the task.
Ol topshiriqnı allaqachon tugatdı.

They have already left.
Olar allaqachon ketti.

6. Boshlanǵan hám házirge deyingi davrda bolǵan holat

For hám since bilen qollanıladı.

I have lived in Urgench for five years.
Men Urganchda 5 jıldan beri yashayman.

She has studied English since 2022.
Ol 2022-jıldan beri inglis tilin úyrenip keldi.

We have known each other for two years.
Biz bir-birimizni 2 jıldan beri bilimiz.

2. Present Perfect yasalışı

Darak gáp

Subject + have / has + Verb 3

I have finished.
Men tugatdım.

She has finished.
Ol tugatdı.

They have finished.
Olar tugatdı.

Have yamasa Has?

Subject | Have / Has
I | have
You | have
We | have
They | have
He | has
She | has
It | has

Mısallar:

I have done my homework.
Men úy tapsırmamdı qıldım.

She has done her homework.
Ol úy tapsırmasın qıldı.

We have seen this film.
Biz bu filmni ko‘rǵanmız.

He has lost his key.
Ol kalitini joǵaltıp qoydı.

3. Verb 3 nima?

Present Perfectda feyilniń üchünci şekli qollanıladı.

Regular verbs

Regular feyıllarda Verb 3 odatda -ed bilen boladı.

Verb 1 | Verb 3
play | played
watch | watched
clean | cleaned
finish | finished
visit | visited

Mısallar:

I have watched this film.
Men bu filmni ko‘rǵanman.

She has cleaned the room.
Ol xonani tozaladı.

Irregular verbs

Irregular feyıllardıń Verb 3 şekli yod alınıp boladı.

Verb 1 | Verb 2 | Verb 3
go | went | gone
come | came | come
see | saw | seen
eat | ate | eaten
drink | drank | drunk
do | did | done
write | wrote | written
read | read | read
buy | bought | bought
make | made | made
take | took | taken
give | gave | given
speak | spoke | spoken
be | was/were | been
have | had | had

Mısallar:

I have gone home.
Men uyǵa ketǵenman.

She has eaten breakfast.
Ol nonushta qılıp boǵdı.

They have seen this film.
Olar bu filmni ko‘rǵan.

4. Inkor gáp

Have not = haven’t
Has not = hasn’t

I haven’t finished my homework.
Men úy tapsırmamdı tugatmadım.

She hasn’t eaten breakfast.
Ol nonushta qilmadı.

They haven’t seen this film.
Olar bu filmni ko‘rǵan emes.

5. Soraw gáp

Sorawda have / has gáp boshına şıǵadı.

Have you finished your homework?
Úy tapsırǵıñnı tugatdıñ mı?

Has she eaten breakfast?
Ol nonushta qıldımı?

Have they visited Tashkent?
Olar Toshkentqa barǵan mı?

6. Qısqa juwaplar

| Soraw | Pozitiv | Negativ |
| Have you finished? | Yes, I have. | No, I haven’t. |
| Has she eaten? | Yes, she has. | No, she hasn’t. |
| Have they gone? | Yes, they have. | No, they haven’t. |

7. Present Perfect signal sözler

Signal söz | Ma’nosi
already | allaqachon
just | hozirgina
yet | hali / hali ham
ever | hech qachon? / hayotingizda
never | hech qachon
for | davomında / beri
since | -dan beri
recently | yaqında
so far | hozirgacha

8. Ever hám Never

Ever

Ever sorawda qollanıladı. Hayotda biror isni qilǵan mısyz dep soraydı.

Have you ever been to Samarkand?
Samarqandda hech bolǵan mısyz?

Have you ever eaten sushi?
Sushi yeb ko‘rǵan mısyz?

Have you ever met a famous person?
Mashhur odamni uchratǵan mısyz?

Never

Never “hech qachon” degani.

I have never been to London.
Men Londonda hech bolǵanım joq.

She has never eaten sushi.
Ol hech qachon sushi yemedi.

They have never seen snow.
Olar hech qachon qor kórmedi.

9. For hám Since farqı

For

For — qancha waqıt davomında?

for two days
ikki kundan beri

for three years
üch jıldan beri

for a long time
uzoq waqıttan beri

Mısallar:

I have lived here for five years.
Men bu yerda 5 jıldan beri yashayman.

She has studied English for two years.
Ol 2 jıldan beri inglis tili úyrenedi.

Since

Since — qachondan beri?

since 2020
2020-jıldan beri

since Monday
duşanbadan beri

since morning
ertalabdan beri

Mısallar:

I have lived here since 2020.
Men bu yerda 2020-jıldan beri yashayman.

She has studied English since September.
Ol sentabrdan beri inglis tili úyrenedi.

10. Past Simple hám Present Perfect farqı

Past Simple

Aniq ótǵan waqıt bar:

I watched this film yesterday.
Men bu filmni kecha kórdim.

She went to Tashkent last week.
Ol ótǵan hafta Toshkentke bordı.

Present Perfect

Aniq waqıt muhim emes, natija yaki tajriba muhim:

I have watched this film.
Men bu filmni kórǵanım joq.

She has gone to Tashkent.
Ol Toshkentke ketti.

Farq:

I lost my key yesterday.
Men kecha kalitimni yóqotdim.
Bu yerda waqıt muhim: kecha.

I have lost my key.
Men kalitimni yóqotıp qoydım.
Bu yerda natija muhim: hozir kalit yóq.

11. Talabalar üşin eng kerekli gáplar

I have done my homework.
Men uy tapsırmamni qıldım.

I haven’t done my homework yet.
Men hali uy tapsırmamni qılmadım.

Have you finished the exercise?
Mashqni tugatǵan mısız?

She has already learned new words.
Ol jańa sózlarni allaqachon úyrenip boldı.

We have just started the lesson.
Biz hozirgina darsni bastadıq.

I have never been to London.
Men Londonda hech bolǵanım joq.

Have you ever spoken English with a foreigner?
Hech chet ellik bilen inglisçe gapláşǵan mısız?

I have studied English for two years.
Men ikki jıldan beri inglis tili úyrenip keldim.

He has lived in Urgench since 2020.
Ol 2020-jıldan beri Urganchda yashaydı.
reading_passage:
Hi Adam,

Today our English class worked on careers and experience in ICT. The example came from a graduate careers fair.

Companies are looking for graduates who have completed practical projects as well as university courses. Nina has built three small websites and has worked on a cybersecurity team.

Adam has learned Python and has recently completed a cloud-computing internship. Recruiters also ask whether students have collaborated with others and presented technical ideas clearly.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Nina has completed three internships and has learned two programming languages.” Both students realise that their completed experiences are important evidence for employers.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Nina and Adam compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

The final task asks readers to connect the topic with their own experience. They should explain one idea in their own words and then use the lesson grammar in a new sentence about careers and experience in ICT.
