grammar_rules:
Relative Clauses va Linking Words

Bu ikki mavzu gaplarni boyroq, uzunroq va mantiqliroq qilish uchun kerak.

Relative clauses — odam, narsa yoki joy haqida qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradi.
Linking words — gaplar va fikrlarni bog‘laydi.

1. Relative Clauses

Relative clause — biror odam, narsa yoki joy haqida qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradigan qism.

Masalan:

This is the boy who won the competition.
Bu musobaqada yutgan bola.

I have a book which is very interesting.
Menda juda qiziqarli kitob bor.

This is the school where I study.
Bu men o‘qiydigan maktab.

2. Relative pronouns

Relative clauses ko‘pincha quyidagi so‘zlar bilan boshlanadi:

Relative pronoun | Qachon ishlatiladi? | Misol
who | odamlar uchun | The girl who is speaking is my sister.
which | narsa / hayvon uchun | The book which is on the table is mine.
that | odam / narsa uchun | The film that I watched was interesting.
where | joy uchun | This is the house where I live.
when | vaqt uchun | Sunday is the day when I relax.
whose | egalik uchun | This is the boy whose father is a doctor.

3. Who

Who odamlar haqida qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradi.

The man who teaches English is my uncle.
Ingliz tili o‘qitadigan erkak mening amakim.

The student who answered the question is very clever.
Savolga javob bergan o‘quvchi juda aqlli.

I know the girl who lives next door.
Men qo‘shni uyda yashaydigan qizni taniyman.

4. Which

Which narsa yoki hayvon haqida qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradi.

The book which is on the table is mine.
Stol ustida turgan kitob meniki.

The phone which I bought yesterday is very good.
Kecha sotib olgan telefonim juda yaxshi.

The dog which is sleeping is very cute.
Uxlayotgan kuchuk juda yoqimtoy.

5. That

That odamlar va narsalar uchun ishlatilishi mumkin. Oddiy nutqda juda ko‘p ishlatiladi.

The boy that sits next to me is my friend.
Yonimda o‘tiradigan bola mening do‘stim.

The film that we watched yesterday was funny.
Kecha ko‘rgan filmimiz kulgili edi.

The car that he bought is expensive.
U sotib olgan mashina qimmat.

6. Where

Where joy haqida qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradi.

This is the school where I study.
Bu men o‘qiydigan maktab.

That is the restaurant where we had dinner.
Ana u biz kechki ovqat qilgan restoran.

Urgench is the city where I live.
Urganch men yashaydigan shahar.

7. When

When vaqt haqida qo‘shimcha ma’lumot beradi.

Saturday is the day when I visit my grandmother.
Shanba — men buvimnikiga boradigan kun.

Summer is the season when students relax.
Yoz — o‘quvchilar dam oladigan fasl.

2020 was the year when we moved to Tashkent.
2020-yil biz Toshkentga ko‘chgan yil edi.

8. Whose

Whose “kimning” degani. Egalikni bildiradi.

This is the boy whose father is a doctor.
Bu otasi shifokor bo‘lgan bola.

I know the girl whose brother studies with me.
Men akasi men bilan o‘qiydigan qizni taniyman.

That is the teacher whose lessons are very interesting.
Ana u darslari juda qiziqarli bo‘lgan ustoz.

9. Relative clause nima uchun kerak?

Relative clause gapni qisqaroq va chiroyliroq qiladi.

Oddiy gaplar:

I know a boy. He speaks English very well.

Relative clause bilan:

I know a boy who speaks English very well.
Men ingliz tilida juda yaxshi gapiradigan bolani taniyman.

Oddiy gaplar:

This is a book. I bought it yesterday.

Relative clause bilan:

This is the book that I bought yesterday.
Bu men kecha sotib olgan kitob.

10. Linking Words

Linking words — fikrlarni bog‘laydigan so‘zlar. Ular gapni mantiqli va tartibli qiladi.

Masalan:

I was tired, but I finished my homework.
Men charchagan edim, lekin uy vazifamni tugatdim.

I studied hard, so I passed the exam.
Men qattiq o‘qidim, shuning uchun imtihondan o‘tdim.

She likes English because it is interesting.
U ingliz tilini yoqtiradi, chunki u qiziqarli.

11. Eng kerakli linking words

Linking word | Ma’nosi | Ishlatilishi
and | va | ikki fikrni qo‘shadi
but | lekin | qarama-qarshi fikr
because | chunki | sabab
so | shuning uchun | natija
or | yoki | tanlov
also | ham / shuningdek | qo‘shimcha fikr
however | biroq | kuchliroq qarama-qarshilik
therefore | shuning uchun | rasmiyroq natija
although | garchi | kutilmagan qarama-qarshilik
first / then / finally | avval / keyin / oxiri | tartib bilan aytish

12. And

And ikki fikrni qo‘shadi.

I like English and Biology.
Men ingliz tili va biologiyani yoqtiraman.

She cooked dinner and cleaned the room.
U ovqat pishirdi va xonani tozaladi.

We studied grammar and did exercises.
Biz grammatikani o‘rgandik va mashqlar bajardik.

13. But

But qarama-qarshi fikrni bildiradi.

I like football, but I don’t play it well.
Men futbolni yoqtiraman, lekin yaxshi o‘ynay olmayman.

She is tired, but she is studying.
U charchagan, lekin o‘qiyapti.

The test was difficult, but I passed it.
Test qiyin edi, lekin men undan o‘tdim.

14. Because

Because sababni bildiradi.

I am happy because I passed the exam.
Men xursandman, chunki imtihondan o‘tdim.

She studies hard because she wants to enter university.
U qattiq o‘qiydi, chunki universitetga kirmoqchi.

I like this teacher because his lessons are interesting.
Men bu ustozni yoqtiraman, chunki uning darslari qiziqarli.

15. So

So natijani bildiradi.

I was ill, so I stayed at home.
Men kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim.

She studied hard, so she got a good mark.
U qattiq o‘qidi, shuning uchun yaxshi baho oldi.

It was raining, so we didn’t go out.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi, shuning uchun tashqariga chiqmadik.

16. Because va So farqi

Because sababni aytadi.
So natijani aytadi.

I stayed at home because I was ill.
Men uyda qoldim, chunki kasal edim.

I was ill, so I stayed at home.
Men kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim.

Ma’no bir xil, lekin gapning yo‘nalishi boshqacha.

17. Although

Although “garchi” degani. Qarama-qarshi vaziyatni ko‘rsatadi.

Although it was cold, we went outside.
Garchi sovuq bo‘lsa ham, biz tashqariga chiqdik.

Although the test was difficult, I passed it.
Garchi test qiyin bo‘lsa ham, men undan o‘tdim.

Although she was tired, she finished her homework.
Garchi u charchagan bo‘lsa ham, uy vazifasini tugatdi.

18. However

However “biroq” degani. Ko‘proq yozma va rasmiy uslubda ishlatiladi.

The test was difficult. However, I passed it.
Test qiyin edi. Biroq, men undan o‘tdim.

He is very clever. However, he doesn’t study regularly.
U juda aqlli. Biroq, muntazam o‘qimaydi.

19. Talabalar uchun eng kerakli gaplar

I like teachers who explain clearly.
Men tushunarli tushuntiradigan ustozlarni yoqtiraman.

This is the book that helped me.
Bu menga yordam bergan kitob.

I want to study at a university where students learn medicine.
Men talabalar tibbiyot o‘rganadigan universitetda o‘qishni xohlayman.

I study English because I want to travel.
Men sayohat qilishni xohlaganim uchun ingliz tili o‘qiyman.

I was tired, but I did my homework.
Men charchagan edim, lekin uy vazifamni qildim.

I studied hard, so I got a good result.
Men qattiq o‘qidim, shuning uchun yaxshi natija oldim.

Although grammar is difficult, I like learning English.
Garchi grammatika qiyin bo‘lsa ham, men ingliz tili o‘rganishni yoqtiraman.
grammar_rules_en:
Relative Clauses and Linking Words

These two topics are necessary to make sentences richer, longer, and more logical.

Relative clauses give extra information about a person, thing, or place.
Linking words connect sentences and ideas.

1. Relative Clauses

A relative clause is the part of a sentence that gives extra information about a person, thing, or place.

For example:

This is the boy who won the competition.

I have a book which is very interesting.

This is the school where I study.

2. Relative pronouns

Relative clauses often begin with the following words:

Relative pronoun | When is it used? | Example
who | for people | The girl who is speaking is my sister.
which | for things/animals | The book which is on the table is mine.
that | for people/things | The film that I watched was interesting.
where | for places | This is the house where I live.
when | for time | Sunday is the day when I relax.
whose | for possession | This is the boy whose father is a doctor.

3. Who

Who gives extra information about people.

The man who teaches English is my uncle.

The student who answered the question is very clever.

I know the girl who lives next door.

4. Which

Which gives extra information about things or animals.

The book which is on the table is mine.

The phone which I bought yesterday is very good.

The dog which is sleeping is very cute.

5. That

That can be used for people and things. It is used very often in everyday speech.

The boy that sits next to me is my friend.

The film that we watched yesterday was funny.

The car that he bought is expensive.

6. Where

Where gives extra information about places.

This is the school where I study.

That is the restaurant where we had dinner.

Urgench is the city where I live.

7. When

When gives extra information about time.

Saturday is the day when I visit my grandmother.

Summer is the season when students relax.

2020 was the year when we moved to Tashkent.

8. Whose

Whose means 'whose'. It indicates possession.

This is the boy whose father is a doctor.

I know the girl whose brother studies with me.

That is the teacher whose lessons are very interesting.

9. Why is a relative clause necessary?

A relative clause makes the sentence shorter and more beautiful.

Simple sentences:

I know a boy. He speaks English very well.

With a relative clause:

I know a boy who speaks English very well.

Simple sentences:

This is a book. I bought it yesterday.

With a relative clause:

This is the book that I bought yesterday.

10. Linking Words

Linking words are words that connect ideas. They make the sentence logical and orderly.

For example:

I was tired, but I finished my homework.

I studied hard, so I passed the exam.

She likes English because it is interesting.

11. The most necessary linking words

Linking word | Meaning | Usage
and | and | connects two ideas
but | but | indicates a contrasting idea
because | because | reason
so | so | result
or | or | choice
also | also | additional idea
however | however | stronger contrast
therefore | therefore | more formal result
although | although | unexpected contrast
first / then / finally | first / then / finally | to indicate order

12. And

And connects two ideas.

I like English and Biology.

She cooked dinner and cleaned the room.

We studied grammar and did exercises.

13. But

But indicates a contrasting idea.

I like football, but I don’t play it well.

She is tired, but she is studying.

The test was difficult, but I passed it.

14. Because

Because indicates a reason.

I am happy because I passed the exam.

She studies hard because she wants to enter university.

I like this teacher because his lessons are interesting.

15. So

So indicates a result.

I was ill, so I stayed at home.

She studied hard, so she got a good mark.

It was raining, so we didn’t go out.

16. The difference between Because and So

Because indicates a reason.
So indicates a result.

I stayed at home because I was ill.

I was ill, so I stayed at home.

The meaning is the same, but the direction of the sentences is different.

17. Although

Although means 'even though'. It shows a contrasting situation.

Although it was cold, we went outside.

Although the test was difficult, I passed it.

Although she was tired, she finished her homework.

18. However

However means 'but'. It is used more in written and formal style.

The test was difficult. However, I passed it.

He is very clever. However, he doesn’t study regularly.

19. Most important sentences for students

I like teachers who explain clearly.

This is the book that helped me.

I want to study at a university where students learn medicine.

I study English because I want to travel.

I was tired, but I did my homework.

I studied hard, so I got a good result.

Although grammar is difficult, I like learning English.
grammar_rules_ru:
Relative Clauses и Linking Words

Эти две темы нужны, чтобы делать предложения богаче, длиннее и логичнее.

Relative clauses — дают дополнительную информацию о человеке, предмете или месте.
Linking words — связывают предложения и мысли.

1. Relative Clauses

Relative clause — часть предложения, которая даёт дополнительную информацию о каком-то человеке, предмете или месте.

Например:

This is the boy who won the competition.
Это мальчик, который победил в соревновании.

I have a book which is very interesting.
У меня есть очень интересная книга.

This is the school where I study.
Это школа, в которой я учусь.

2. Relative pronouns

Relative clauses ко‘пинча quyidagi so‘zlar bilan boshlanadi:

Relative pronoun | Когда используется? | Пример
who | для людей | The girl who is speaking is my sister.
which | для предметов / животных | The book which is on the table is mine.
that | для людей / предметов | The film that I watched was interesting.
where | для мест | This is the house where I live.
when | для времени | Sunday is the day when I relax.
whose | для принадлежности | This is the boy whose father is a doctor.

3. Who

Who даёт дополнительную информацию о людях.

The man who teaches English is my uncle.
Мужчина, который преподаёт английский, — мой дядя.

The student who answered the question is very clever.
Студент, который ответил на вопрос, очень умный.

I know the girl who lives next door.
Я знаю девочку, которая живёт по соседству.

4. Which

Which даёт дополнительную информацию о предметах или животных.

The book which is on the table is mine.
Книга, которая на столе, — моя.

The phone which I bought yesterday is very good.
Телефон, который я купил вчера, очень хороший.

The dog which is sleeping is very cute.
Собака, которая спит, очень милая.

5. That

That может использоваться для людей и предметов. В разговорной речи используется очень часто.

The boy that sits next to me is my friend.
Мальчик, который сидит рядом со мной, — мой друг.

The film that we watched yesterday was funny.
Фильм, который мы смотрели вчера, был смешным.

The car that he bought is expensive.
Машина, которую он купил, дорогая.

6. Where

Where даёт дополнительную информацию о месте.

This is the school where I study.
Это школа, в которой я учусь.

That is the restaurant where we had dinner.
Это ресторан, в котором мы ужинали.

Urgench is the city where I live.
Ургенч — это город, в котором я живу.

7. When

When даёт дополнительную информацию о времени.

Saturday is the day when I visit my grandmother.
Суббота — это день, когда я навещаю бабушку.

Summer is the season when students relax.
Лето — это время, когда студенты отдыхают.

2020 was the year when we moved to Tashkent.
2020 год — это год, когда мы переехали в Ташкент.

8. Whose

Whose означает «чей». Обозначает принадлежность.

This is the boy whose father is a doctor.
Это мальчик, чей отец — врач.

I know the girl whose brother studies with me.
Я знаю девочку, чей брат учится со мной.

That is the teacher whose lessons are very interesting.
Это учитель, чьи уроки очень интересные.

9. Зачем нужны relative clauses?

Relative clause делает предложение короче и красивее.

Простые предложения:

I know a boy. He speaks English very well.

С relative clause:

I know a boy who speaks English very well.
Я знаю мальчика, который очень хорошо говорит по-английски.

Простые предложения:

This is a book. I bought it yesterday.

С relative clause:

This is the book that I bought yesterday.
Это книга, которую я купил вчера.

10. Linking Words

Linking words — это слова, которые связывают мысли. Они делают предложение логичным и упорядоченным.

Например:

I was tired, but I finished my homework.
Я был уставшим, но я закончил домашнее задание.

I studied hard, so I passed the exam.
Я усердно учился, поэтому я сдал экзамен.

She likes English because it is interesting.
Она любит английский, потому что он интересный.

11. Самые необходимые linking words

Linking word | Значение | Использование
and | и | соединяет две мысли
but | но | противоположная мысль
because | потому что | причина
so | поэтому | результат
or | или | выбор
also | также | дополнительная мысль
however | однако | сильное противопоставление
therefore | поэтому | более формальный результат
although | хотя | неожиданный контраст
first / then / finally | сначала / затем / наконец | последовательное изложение

12. And

And соединяет две мысли.

I like English and Biology.
Мне нравятся английский и биология.

She cooked dinner and cleaned the room.
Она приготовила ужин и убрала в комнате.

We studied grammar and did exercises.
Мы изучали грамматику и делали упражнения.

13. But

But обозначает противоположную мысль.

I like football, but I don’t play it well.
Мне нравится футбол, но я не играю в него хорошо.

She is tired, but she is studying.
Она устала, но она учится.

The test was difficult, but I passed it.
Тест был сложным, но я его сдал.

14. Because

Because обозначает причину.

I am happy because I passed the exam.
Я счастлив, потому что я сдал экзамен.

Она усердно учится, потому что хочет поступить в университет.
U qattiq o‘qiydi, chunki universitetga kirmoqchi.

Мне нравится этот учитель, потому что его уроки интересные.
Men bu ustozni yoqtiraman, chunki uning darslari qiziqarli.

15. So

So обозначает результат.

Я был болен, поэтому остался дома.
Men kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim.

Она усердно училась, поэтому получила хорошую оценку.
U qattiq o‘qidi, shuning uchun yaxshi baho oldi.

Шел дождь, поэтому мы не вышли на улицу.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi, shuning uchun tashqariga chiqmadik.

16. Разница между Because и So

Because указывает на причину.
So указывает на результат.

Я остался дома, потому что был болен.
Men uyda qoldim, chunki kasal edim.

Я был болен, поэтому остался дома.
Men kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim.

Смысл одинаковый, но направление предложения разное.

17. Although

Although означает “хотя”. Показывает противоположную ситуацию.

Хотя было холодно, мы вышли на улицу.
Garchi sovuq bo‘lsa ham, biz tashqariga chiqdik.

Хотя тест был трудным, я его сдал.
Garchi test qiyin bo‘lsa ham, men undan o‘tdim.

Хотя она была уставшей, она закончила домашнее задание.
Garchi u charchagan bo‘lsa ham, uy vazifasini tugatdi.

18. However

However означает “однако”. Используется чаще в письменном и формальном стиле.

Тест был трудным. Однако, я его сдал.
Test qiyin edi. Biroq, men undan o‘tdim.

Он очень умный. Однако, он не учится регулярно.
U juda aqlli. Biroq, muntazam o‘qimaydi.

19. Самые необходимые фразы для студентов

Мне нравятся учителя, которые объясняют ясно.
Men tushunarli tushuntiradigan ustozlarni yoqtiraman.

Это книга, которая мне помогла.
Bu menga yordam bergan kitob.

Я хочу учиться в университете, где студенты изучают медицину.
Men talabalar tibbiyot o‘rganadigan universitetda o‘qishni xohlayman.

Я изучаю английский, потому что хочу путешествовать.
Men sayohat qilishni xohlaganim uchun ingliz tili o‘qiyman.

Я был уставшим, но сделал домашнее задание.
Men charchagan edim, lekin uy vazifamni qildim.

Я усердно учился, поэтому получил хороший результат.
Men qattiq o‘qidim, shuning uchun yaxshi natija oldim.

Хотя грамматика трудная, мне нравится учить английский.
Garchi grammatika qiyin bo‘lsa ham, men ingliz tili o‘rganishni yoqtiraman.
grammar_rules_kk:
Relative Clauses hám Linking Words

Bul eki tema gápterdi bayıraq, uzınıraq hám mantiqlıraq etiw ushın kerek.

Relative clauses — adam, zat yamasa orın haqqında qosımsha maǵlıwmat beredi.
Linking words — gápter hám pikirlerdi baylanıstıradı.

1. Relative Clauses

Relative clause — qanday da bir adam, zat yamasa orın haqqında qosımsha maǵlıwmat beretuǵın bólim.

Mısalı:

This is the boy who won the competition.
Bul musobaqada jeńgen bala.

I have a book which is very interesting.
Mende júdá qızıqlı kitap bar.

This is the school where I study.
Bul men oqıydıǵan mektep.

2. Relative pronouns

Relative clauses kóbinese quyıdıqı so‘zlermen bastaladı:

Relative pronoun | Qay jerde qollanıladı? | Mısal
who | adamlar ushın | The girl who is speaking is my sister.
which | zat / hayvan ushın | The book which is on the table is mine.
that | adam / zat ushın | The film that I watched was interesting.
where | orın ushın | This is the house where I live.
when | waqıt ushın | Sunday is the day when I relax.
whose | egalik ushın | This is the boy whose father is a doctor.

3. Who

Who adamlar haqqında qosımsha maǵlıwmat beredi.

The man who teaches English is my uncle.
Ingliz tili oqıtıwshısı er adam mening amakım.

The student who answered the question is very clever.
Savolğa juwap bergan oqıwshı júdá aqıllı.

I know the girl who lives next door.
Men qoşni uyda yashaydıǵan qızdı taniyman.

4. Which

Which zat yamasa hayvan haqqında qosımsha maǵlıwmat beredi.

The book which is on the table is mine.
Stol ustında turgan kitap meniki.

The phone which I bought yesterday is very good.
Kecha sotıp alğan telefonım júdá jaqsı.

The dog which is sleeping is very cute.
Uxlayotqan kuchuk júdá yoqımtoy.

5. That

That adamlar hám zatlar ushın qollanıla aladı. Oddı nutqda júdá kób qollanıladı.

The boy that sits next to me is my friend.
Yonımda otırğan bala mening dostım.

The film that we watched yesterday was funny.
Kecha körgen filmimiz kulgili edi.

The car that he bought is expensive.
U sotıp alğan mashina qımmat.

6. Where

Where orın haqqında qosımsha maǵlıwmat beredi.

This is the school where I study.
Bul men oqıydıǵan mektep.

That is the restaurant where we had dinner.
Ana u biz kechki ovqat qilğan restoran.

Urgench is the city where I live.
Urganch men yashaydıǵan qala.

7. When

When waqıt haqqında qosımsha maǵlıwmat beredi.

Saturday is the day when I visit my grandmother.
Shanba — men buvimnikige boradıǵan kun.

Summer is the season when students relax.
Yoz — oqıwshılar dam aladıǵan fasıl.

2020 was the year when we moved to Tashkent.
2020-jıl biz Toshkentke köşken jıl edi.

8. Whose

Whose “kimniń” deganı. Egalikni bildiradi.

This is the boy whose father is a doctor.
Bul otası shifokor bolǵan bala.

I know the girl whose brother studies with me.
Men akası menen oqıydıǵan qızdı taniyman.

That is the teacher whose lessons are very interesting.
Ana u darsları júdá qızıqlı bolǵan ustoz.

9. Relative clause nima ushın kerek?

Relative clause gápni qisqaroq hám chiroyliroq etedi.

Oddı gáplar:

I know a boy. He speaks English very well.

Relative clause bilen:

I know a boy who speaks English very well.
Men ingliz tilinde júdá jaqsı gapıradıǵan bolanı taniyman.

Oddı gáplar:

This is a book. I bought it yesterday.

Relative clause bilen:

This is the book that I bought yesterday.
Bul men kecha sotıp alǵan kitap.

10. Linking Words

Linking words — pikirlerdi baylanıstıradıǵan so‘zler. Ular gápni mantiqlı hám tartıblı etedi.

reading_passage:
This week I learned about the history of an old riverside house. Our class used a realistic situation from a local heritage article.

The house, which stands near a narrow river, was built in 1892. The family that first owned it operated a small textile business.

A wooden staircase that was added in 1920 is still used today. Neighbours have preserved letters which describe how the area changed during the twentieth century.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “First connect the keyboard, then install the driver, and finally test the device.” The building is now a small museum where visitors can explore local history.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Amina and Tom compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

The final task asks readers to connect the topic with their own experience. They should explain one idea in their own words and then use the lesson grammar in a new sentence about the history of an old riverside house.

grammar_rules:
FIRST CONDITIONAL va SECOND CONDITIONAL

1. Conditional nima?

Conditional — bu “agar … bo‘lsa, … bo‘ladi / bo‘lardi” degan gaplar.

Ya’ni biror shart va uning natijasi bo‘ladi.

Masalan:

If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
Agar sen qattiq o‘qisang, imtihondan o‘tasan.

Bu gapda:

If you study hard — shart
you will pass the exam — natija

2. FIRST CONDITIONAL

First Conditional qachon ishlatiladi?

First Conditional real hayotda bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan vaziyatlar haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

Ya’ni vaziyat haqiqiy, mumkin, kelajakda bo‘lish ehtimoli bor.

Tuzilishi

If + Present Simple, will + Verb

Masalan:

If it rains, I will stay at home.
Agar yomg‘ir yog‘sa, men uyda qolaman.

Bu yerda yomg‘ir yog‘ishi mumkin. Shuning uchun First Conditional ishlatiladi.

First Conditional real vaziyatlarda

1. O‘qish va imtihon

If you prepare well, you will get a good result.
Agar yaxshi tayyorlansang, yaxshi natija olasan.

If students do the homework, they will understand the topic better.
Agar o‘quvchilar uy vazifasini bajarsa, mavzuni yaxshiroq tushunadi.

If he doesn’t study chemistry, he will fail the test.
Agar u kimyoni o‘qimasa, testdan yiqiladi.

2. Kundalik hayot

If I have time, I will call you.
Agar vaqtim bo‘lsa, senga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

If we leave early, we will arrive on time.
Agar erta chiqsak, vaqtida yetib boramiz.

If you eat too much, you will feel bad.
Agar juda ko‘p yesang, o‘zingni yomon his qilasan.

3. Ogohlantirish

If you touch that wire, you will get an electric shock.
Agar u simga tegsang, tok uradi.

If you don’t listen carefully, you will make a mistake.
Agar diqqat bilan eshitmasang, xato qilasan.

If you drive too fast, you will have an accident.
Agar juda tez haydasang, avariya qilasan.

4. Taklif va maslahat

If you feel tired, you should rest.
Agar charchagan bo‘lsang, dam olishing kerak.

If you want to improve your English, you should practise every day.
Agar ingliz tilingni yaxshilamoqchi bo‘lsang, har kuni mashq qilishing kerak.

Bu yerda natija qismida faqat will emas, can / should / must / may ham kelishi mumkin.

Masalan:

If you study every day, you can improve quickly.
Agar har kuni o‘qisang, tez rivojlana olasan.

Muhim qoida

If qismida odatda will ishlatilmaydi.

Noto‘g‘ri:
If I will have time, I will call you.

To‘g‘ri:
If I have time, I will call you.

First Conditional qisqacha mazmuni

First Conditional — kelajakda bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan real vaziyat.

Masalan:

If I study, I will pass.
O‘qisam, o‘taman.

Bu real. O‘qisa, o‘tishi mumkin.

3. SECOND CONDITIONAL

Second Conditional qachon ishlatiladi?

Second Conditional hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy, kam ehtimolli, haqiqatga yaqin bo‘lmagan vaziyatlar haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

Ya’ni “agar shunday bo‘lganida, unday qilardim” degan ma’noda.

Tuzilishi

If + Past Simple, would + Verb

Masalan:

If I had a car, I would travel more.
Agar mashinam bo‘lganida, ko‘proq sayohat qilardim.

Bu yerda hozir menda mashina yo‘q. Shuning uchun bu xayoliy vaziyat.

Second Conditional real vaziyatlarda

1. Xayoliy holat

If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
Agar boy bo‘lganimda, katta uy sotib olardim.

If I had more free time, I would learn another language.
Agar ko‘proq bo‘sh vaqtim bo‘lganida, yana bitta til o‘rganardim.

If she knew English well, she would work abroad.
Agar u ingliz tilini yaxshi bilganida, chet elda ishlardi.

2. Maslahat berish

Second Conditional ko‘pincha maslahat berishda ishlatiladi:

If I were you, I would study harder.
Sening o‘rningda bo‘lganimda, ko‘proq o‘qirdim.

If I were you, I wouldn’t buy that phone.
Sening o‘rningda bo‘lganimda, u telefonni olmasdim.

If I were you, I would speak to the teacher.
Sening o‘rningda bo‘lganimda, ustoz bilan gaplashardim.

Bu juda ko‘p ishlatiladigan ibora:

If I were you, I would …
Sening o‘rningda bo‘lganimda, men …

3. Hozirgi holatdan norozilik yoki orzu

If I lived near the school, I wouldn’t be late.
Agar maktabga yaqin yashaganimda, kech qolmasdim.

If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
Agar javobni bilganimda, senga aytardim.

If he studied harder, he would get better marks.
Agar u ko‘proq o‘qiganida, yaxshiroq baholar olardi.

“Were” ishlatilishi

Second Conditionalda I / he / she / it bilan ham ko‘pincha were ishlatiladi.

If I were you, I would not do it.
Sening o‘rningda bo‘lganimda, buni qilmasdim.

If she were here, she would help us.
Agar u shu yerda bo‘lganida, bizga yordam berardi.

Oddiy gapda “I was” bo‘ladi, lekin Second Conditionalda rasmiy va to‘g‘ri shakl ko‘pincha If I were.

4. First Conditional va Second Conditional farqi

First Conditional

Vaziyat real. Bo‘lish ehtimoli bor.

If I study, I will pass the exam.
Agar o‘qisam, imtihondan o‘taman.

Bu real: o‘qishi mumkin, o‘tishi mumkin.

Second Conditional

Vaziyat xayoliy yoki ehtimoli past.

If I studied, I would pass the exam.
Agar o‘qiganimda, imtihondan o‘tardim.

Bu gapda hozir u o‘qimayapti yoki o‘qish ehtimoli kamroq. Gap xayoliyroq eshitiladi.
grammar_rules_en:
FIRST CONDITIONAL and SECOND CONDITIONAL

1. What is a conditional?

A conditional is a sentence of the type “if …, then … will / would happen”.

That means there is a condition and its result.

For example:

If you study hard, you will pass the exam.

In this sentence:

If you study hard — the condition.
you will pass the exam — the result.

2. FIRST CONDITIONAL

When is the First Conditional used?

First Conditional is used when talking about situations that can happen in real life.

That means the situation is real, possible, and has a chance of happening in the future.

Structure

If + Present Simple, will + Verb

For example:

If it rains, I will stay at home.

This sentence means that it might rain. Therefore, First Conditional is used.

First Conditional in real situations

1. Studying and exams

If you prepare well, you will get a good result.

If students do the homework, they will understand the topic better.

If he doesn’t study chemistry, he will fail the test.
If he doesn’t study chemistry — the condition. he will fail the test — the result.

2. Daily Life

If I have time, I will call you.
If I have time — the condition. I will call you — the result.

If we leave early, we will arrive on time.
If we leave early — the condition. we will arrive on time — the result.

If you eat too much, you will feel bad.
If you eat too much — the condition. you will feel bad — the result.

3. Warning

If you touch that wire, you will get an electric shock.
If you touch that wire — the condition. you will get an electric shock — the result.

If you don’t listen carefully, you will make a mistake.
If you don’t listen carefully — the condition. you will make a mistake — the result.

If you drive too fast, you will have an accident.
If you drive too fast — the condition. you will have an accident — the result.

4. Suggestions and Advice

If you feel tired, you should rest.
If you feel tired — the condition. you should rest — the advice.

If you want to improve your English, you should practise every day.
If you want to improve your English — the condition. you should practise every day — the advice.

In this case, not only will can / should / must / may be used in the result part.

For example:

If you study every day, you can improve quickly.
If you study every day — the condition. you can improve quickly — the result.

Important Rule

In the if part, will is usually not used.

Incorrect:
If I will have time, I will call you.

Correct:
If I have time, I will call you.

Summary of the First Conditional

First Conditional — a real situation that may happen in the future.

For example:

If I study, I will pass.
If I study, I will pass.

This is real. If he studies, he might pass.

3. SECOND CONDITIONAL

When is the Second Conditional used?

The Second Conditional is used when talking about hypothetical, unlikely, or unreal situations in the present or future.

That is, in the sense of 'if it were like this, I would do that.'

Structure

If + Past Simple, would + Verb

For example:

If I had a car, I would travel more.
If I had a car, I would travel more.

Here, I do not have a car now. Therefore, this is a hypothetical situation.

Second Conditional in real situations

1. Hypothetical situation

If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
If I were rich, I would buy a big house.

If I had more free time, I would learn another language.
If I had more free time, I would learn another language.

If she knew English well, she would work abroad.
If she knew English well, she would work abroad.

2. Giving advice

The Second Conditional is often used for giving advice:

If I were you, I would study harder.
If I were you, I would study harder.

If I were you, I wouldn’t buy that phone.
If I were you, I wouldn’t buy that phone.

If I were you, I would speak to the teacher.
If I were you, I would speak to the teacher.

This is a very commonly used phrase:

If I were you, I would …
If I were you, I would …

3. Discontent or wish about the present situation

If I lived near the school, I wouldn’t be late.
If I lived near the school, I wouldn’t be late.

If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
If I knew the answer, I would tell you.

If he studied harder, he would get better marks.
If he studied harder, he would get better marks.

Use of 'were'

In the Second Conditional, 'were' is often used with I / he / she / it.

If I were you, I would not do it.
If I were you, I would not do it.

If she were here, she would help us.
If she were here, she would help us.

In a simple sentence, it would be 'I was', but in the Second Conditional, the formal and correct form is often 'If I were'.

4. Difference between First Conditional and Second Conditional

First Conditional

The situation is real. There is a possibility of occurrence.

If I study, I will pass the exam.
If I study, I will pass the exam.

This is real: it is possible to study, it is possible to pass.

Second Conditional

The situation is hypothetical or unlikely.

If I studied, I would pass the exam.
If I studied, I would pass the exam.

In this sentence, he is not studying now or the likelihood of studying is low. The sentence sounds more hypothetical.
grammar_rules_ru:
FIRST CONDITIONAL и SECOND CONDITIONAL

1. Что такое conditional?

Conditional — это предложения вида «если …, то … будет / было бы».

То есть есть условие и его результат.

Например:

If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
Если ты будешь усердно учиться, ты сдашь экзамен.

В этом предложении:

If you study hard — условие
you will pass the exam — результат.

2. FIRST CONDITIONAL

Когда используется First Conditional?

First Conditional используется, когда речь идет о ситуациях, которые могут произойти в реальной жизни.

То есть ситуация реальная, возможная, есть вероятность, что она произойдет в будущем.

Структура

If + Present Simple, will + Verb

Например:

If it rains, I will stay at home.
Если пойдет дождь, я останусь дома.

Здесь дождь может пойти. Поэтому используется First Conditional.

First Conditional в реальных ситуациях

1. Учёба и экзамен

If you prepare well, you will get a good result.
Если ты хорошо подготовишься, ты получишь хороший результат.

If students do the homework, they will understand the topic better.
Если студенты сделают домашнее задание, они лучше поймут тему.

If he doesn’t study chemistry, he will fail the test.
Если он не будет учить химию, он провалит тест.

2. Повседневная жизнь

If I have time, I will call you.
Если у меня будет время, я тебе позвоню.

If we leave early, we will arrive on time.
Если мы выйдем рано, мы приедем вовремя.

If you eat too much, you will feel bad.
Если ты будешь слишком много есть, ты будешь чувствовать себя плохо.

3. Предупреждение

If you touch that wire, you will get an electric shock.
Если ты коснешься этого провода, тебя ударит ток.

If you don’t listen carefully, you will make a mistake.
Если ты не будешь слушать внимательно, ты сделаешь ошибку.

If you drive too fast, you will have an accident.
Если ты будешь ехать слишком быстро, у тебя будет авария.

4. Предложение и совет

If you feel tired, you should rest.
Если ты чувствуешь усталость, тебе нужно отдохнуть.

If you want to improve your English, you should practise every day.
Если ты хочешь улучшить свой английский, тебе нужно практиковаться каждый день.

Здесь в части результата может быть не только will, но и can / should / must / may.

Например:

If you study every day, you can improve quickly.
Если ты будешь учиться каждый день, ты сможешь быстро развиваться.

Важное правило

В части If обычно не используется will.

Неправильно:
If I will have time, I will call you.

Правильно:
If I have time, I will call you.

Краткое содержание First Conditional

First Conditional — это реальная ситуация, которая может произойти в будущем.

Например:

If I study, I will pass.
Если я буду учиться, я сдам.

Это реально. Если он будет учиться, он может сдать.

3. SECOND CONDITIONAL

Когда используется Second Conditional?

Second Conditional используется, когда речь идет о гипотетических, маловероятных, не очень реальных ситуациях в настоящем или будущем.

То есть в значении «если бы так было, я бы сделал так».

Структура

If + Past Simple, would + Verb

Например:

If I had a car, I would travel more.
Если бы у меня была машина, я бы путешествовал больше.

Здесь у меня сейчас нет машины. Поэтому это гипотетическая ситуация.

Second Conditional в реальных ситуациях

1. Гипотетическое состояние

If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
Если бы я был богат, я бы купил большой дом.

If I had more free time, I would learn another language.
Если бы у меня было больше свободного времени, я бы выучил еще один язык.

If she knew English well, she would work abroad.
Если бы она хорошо знала английский, она бы работала за границей.

2. Дать совет

Second Conditional часто используется для дачи советов:

If I were you, I would study harder.
Если бы я был на твоем месте, я бы учился усерднее.

If I were you, I wouldn’t buy that phone.
Если бы я был на твоем месте, я бы не покупал этот телефон.

If I were you, I would speak to the teacher.
Если бы я был на твоем месте, я бы поговорил с учителем.

Это очень часто используемая фраза:

If I were you, I would …
Если бы я был на твоем месте, я бы …

3. Неприятие или мечта о настоящем состоянии

If I lived near the school, I wouldn’t be late.
Если бы я жил рядом со школой, я бы не опаздывал.

If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
Если бы я знал ответ, я бы сказал тебе.

If he studied harder, he would get better marks.
Если бы он учился усерднее, он бы получал лучшие оценки.

Использование “were”

В Second Conditional часто используется were с I / he / she / it.

If I were you, I would not do it.
Если бы я был на твоем месте, я бы этого не делал.

If she were here, she would help us.
Если бы она была здесь, она бы нам помогла.

В простом предложении используется “I was”, но в Second Conditional формальный и правильный вариант часто — If I were.

4. Различие между First Conditional и Second Conditional

First Conditional

Ситуация реальная. Есть вероятность, что она произойдет.

If I study, I will pass the exam.
Если я буду учиться, я сдам экзамен.

Это реально: он может учиться, он может сдать.

Second Conditional

Ситуация гипотетическая или маловероятная.

If I studied, I would pass the exam.
Если бы я учился, я бы сдал экзамен.

В этом предложении сейчас он не учится или вероятность учёбы мала. Предложение звучит более гипотетически.
grammar_rules_kk:
FIRST CONDITIONAL hám SECOND CONDITIONAL

1. Conditional nima?

Conditional — bul “agar … bolsa, … boladı / bolar edi” degen gápler.

Yaǵnıy biror shárt hám onıń nátiyjesi boladı.

Mısalı:

If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
Agar sen qattiq oqısań, imtihandan óteseń.

Bul gápte:

If you study hard — shárt
you will pass the exam — nátiyje

2. FIRST CONDITIONAL

First Conditional qachon ishlatiladi?

First Conditional real hayotda bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan vaziyatlar haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

Ya’ni vaziyat haqiqiy, mumkin, kelajakta bo‘lish ehtimoli bar.

Tuzilishi

If + Present Simple, will + Verb

Mısalı:

If it rains, I will stay at home.
Agar yomg‘ir yog‘sa, men uyda qolaman.

Bu yerda yomg‘ir yog‘ishi mumkin. Sonlıqtan First Conditional ishlatiladı.

First Conditional real vaziyatlarda

1. O‘qıw hám imtihon

If you prepare well, you will get a good result.
Agar yaxshi tayyorlansañ, yaxshi natija alasıñ.

If students do the homework, they will understand the topic better.
Agar o‘quvshılar uy vazifasın bajarsa, mavzuni yaxshıraq túsinadı.

If he doesn’t study chemistry, he will fail the test.
Agar u kimyoni o‘qımasa, testden yiqıladı.

2. Kundalık hayot

If I have time, I will call you.
Agar vaqtım bolsa, senga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

If we leave early, we will arrive on time.
Agar erta chiqsak, vaqtında yetip boramız.

If you eat too much, you will feel bad.
Agar juda kóp yesañ, o‘zingni yomon his qilasıñ.

3. Ogohlantıru

If you touch that wire, you will get an electric shock.
Agar u simga tegsañ, tok uradı.

If you don’t listen carefully, you will make a mistake.
Agar diqqat menen eshitmesañ, xato qilasıñ.

If you drive too fast, you will have an accident.
Agar juda tez haydasañ, avariya qilasıñ.

4. Taklıf hám maslahat

If you feel tired, you should rest.
Agar charchagan bolsañ, dam alıwıñ kerek.

If you want to improve your English, you should practise every day.
Agar inglis tilingni yaxshılaqwıñ kerek bolsa, hár kúni mashq qilıwıñ kerek.

Bu yerda natija qismında faqat will emes, can / should / must / may ham kelishi mumkin.

Mısalı:

If you study every day, you can improve quickly.
Agar hár kúni o‘qısañ, tez rivojlana alasıñ.

Muhim qoida

If qismında odatda will ishlatilmaydı.

Noto‘g‘ri:
If I will have time, I will call you.

To‘g‘ri:
If I have time, I will call you.

First Conditional qisqacha mazmunı

First Conditional — kelajakta bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan real vaziyat.

Mısalı:

If I study, I will pass.
O‘qısań, o‘taman.

Bu real. O‘qısa, o‘tuwı mumkin.

3. SECOND CONDITIONAL

Second Conditional qachon ishlatiladı?

Second Conditional hozirgi yáki kelajaktağı xayoliy, kam ehtimolli, haqiqatta yaqin bo‘lmagan vaziyatlar haqida gapirganda ishlatiladı.

Ya’ni “agar shunday bolğanında, unday qilardım” degen ma’noda.

Tuzilishi

If + Past Simple, would + Verb

Mısalı:

If I had a car, I would travel more.
Agar mashinam bolğanında, kópraq sayohat qilardım.

Bu yerda hozir menda mashina yoq. Sonlıqtan bu xayoliy vaziyat.

Second Conditional real vaziyatlarda

1. Xayoliy holat

If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
Agar boy bolğanımda, katta uy sotıp alardım.

If I had more free time, I would learn another language.
Agar kópraq bo‘sh vaqtım bolğanında, yana bitta til o‘rganardım.

If she knew English well, she would work abroad.
Agar u inglis tilin yaxshi bilğanında, chet elde ishlardı.

2. Maslahat beriw

Second Conditional kópínça maslahat beriwde ishlatiladı:

If I were you, I would study harder.
Sening orningda bolğanımda, kópraq o‘qırdım.

If I were you, I wouldn’t buy that phone.
Sening orningda bolğanımda, u telefonni almasdım.

If I were you, I would speak to the teacher.
Sening orningda bolğanımda, ustoz menen gaplaşardım.

Bu juda kóp ishlatiladıgan ibora:

If I were you, I would …
Sening orningda bolğanımda, men …

3. Hozirgi holatdan norozılıq yaki orzu

If I lived near the school, I wouldn’t be late.
Agar mektepke yaqin yashaganimda, kech qolmasdım.

If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
Agar javobni bilğanımda, senga aytardım.

If he studied harder, he would get better marks.
Agar u kópraq o‘qısa, yaxshıraq baholar alardı.

“Were” ishlatilışı

Second Conditionalda I / he / she / it menen ham kópínça were ishlatiladı.

If I were you, I would not do it.
Sening orningda bolğanımda, buni qilmasdım.

If she were here, she would help us.
Agar u shu yerda bolğanında, bizge yardım bererdi.

Oddiy gápte “I was” boladı, lekin Second Conditionalda rasmiy hám to‘g‘ri şekil kópínça If I were.

4. First Conditional hám Second Conditional farqı

First Conditional

Vaziyat real. Bolıw ehtimoli bar.

If I study, I will pass the exam.
Agar o‘qısań, imtihondan o‘tasıñ.

Bu real: o‘qıwı mumkin, o‘tuwı mumkin.

Second Conditional

Vaziyat xayoliy yaki ehtimoli past.

If I studied, I would pass the exam.
Agar o‘qıg‘animda, imtihondan o‘tardım.

Bu gápte hozir u o‘qımayapti yaki o‘qıw ehtimoli kámroq. Gáp xayoliyroq eshitiladı.
reading_passage:
In a short student interview, Eva explains what the class learned about beliefs about ghosts and unexplained sounds in an old countryside hotel.

Guests sometimes report footsteps in a corridor that is empty at night. The manager says old heating pipes can create unusual sounds when the temperature changes.

One visitor says she would leave immediately if she saw a ghost. Another guest says he will investigate if he hears the footsteps again.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “If we hear another noise, we will check the hall; if I were braver, I would go alone.” The article leaves readers to decide whether the hotel is haunted or simply old and noisy.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Eva and Noah compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “haunted” in the context of beliefs about ghosts and unexplained sounds.

reading_vocabulary.definition: the sound of someone walking
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “footstep” in the context of beliefs about ghosts and unexplained sounds.

reading_vocabulary.definition: a long passage inside a building
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “corridor” in the context of beliefs about ghosts and unexplained sounds.

reading_vocabulary.definition: to examine something carefully to discover the truth
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “investigate” in the context of beliefs about ghosts and unexplained sounds.

reading_vocabulary.definition: not yet understood
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “unexplained” in the context of beliefs about ghosts and unexplained sounds.

reading_vocabulary.definition: a system that warms a building
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “heating” in the context of beliefs about ghosts and unexplained sounds.

the work of a computer security specialist

a crowded lecture hall

to understand the topic and notice the target grammar in meaningful context
to memorise an unrelated word list
to translate every sentence word for word

listening_transcript:
Eva: Hi Noah. I’m calling about the lesson on beliefs about ghosts and unexplained sounds.
Noah: Perfect timing. I’m reviewing how to discuss what they would do if they heard a strange sound.
Eva: Can you remind me of the first detail?
Noah: Maya says she will call the manager if the noise returns.
Eva: Thanks. What comes after that?
Noah: Daniel says he would check the corridor if he were not alone.
Eva: Was there another important point?
Noah: They agree that they will not enter locked rooms.
Eva: I need one last detail for my notes.
Noah: Maya jokes that she would run outside if she actually saw a ghost.
Eva: Before we hang up, give me one target-grammar sentence.
Noah: For example: If we hear another noise, we will check the hall; if I were braver, I would go alone.
Eva: And the final outcome?
Noah: They choose practical actions but keep their sense of humour.

title: Networking and communications
grammar_focus: Opinion language: I think / I believe / In my opinion
topic: opinions about social networks and communication
task_meta: Speaking: The benefits of new technology
grammar_rules:
I think, I believe, In my opinion

1. Umumiy ma’nosi

Bu iboralar o‘z fikrini aytishda ishlatiladi.

Uzbekchada:

I think — menimcha / men o‘ylaymanki
I believe — men ishonamanki / menimcha
In my opinion — mening fikrimcha

Masalan:

I think English is important.
Menimcha, ingliz tili muhim.

I believe hard work brings success.
Men ishonamanki, mehnat muvaffaqiyat olib keladi.

In my opinion, students should read more books.
Mening fikrimcha, o‘quvchilar ko‘proq kitob o‘qishi kerak.

2. I think

Qachon ishlatiladi?

I think eng oddiy va eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan ibora. Kundalik suhbatda juda tabiiy eshitiladi.

Ma’nosi: menimcha

Tuzilishi

I think + gap

Masalan:

I think this lesson is easy.
Menimcha, bu dars oson.

I think he is a good student.
Menimcha, u yaxshi o‘quvchi.

I think we should start now.
Menimcha, biz hozir boshlashimiz kerak.

Inkor shakli

Odatda ingliz tilida:

I don’t think + positive sentence

deyiladi.

Masalan:

I don’t think this answer is correct.
Menimcha, bu javob to‘g‘ri emas.

So‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilsak:
“Men bu javob to‘g‘ri deb o‘ylamayman.”

Lekin o‘zbekchada tabiiyroq tarjima:
Menimcha, bu javob noto‘g‘ri.

Yana misollar:

I don’t think he is ready.
Menimcha, u tayyor emas.

I don’t think it will rain today.
Menimcha, bugun yomg‘ir yog‘maydi.

I don’t think this is a good idea.
Menimcha, bu yaxshi fikr emas.

3. I believe

Qachon ishlatiladi?

I believe “I think”ga o‘xshaydi, lekin biroz kuchliroq va jiddiyroq eshitiladi.

Ma’nosi:

Men ishonamanki…
Men qat’iyroq o‘ylaymanki…

Masalan:

I believe education can change a person’s life.
Men ishonamanki, ta’lim inson hayotini o‘zgartira oladi.

I believe students need motivation.
Menimcha, o‘quvchilarga motivatsiya kerak.

I believe this method is effective.
Men ishonamanki, bu metod samarali.

I think va I believe farqi

I think — oddiy fikr.
I believe — kuchliroq fikr, ishonch bor.

Masalan:

I think he is right.
Menimcha, u haq.

I believe he is right.
Men ishonamanki, u haq.

Ikkinchisi kuchliroq eshitiladi.

4. In my opinion

Qachon ishlatiladi?

In my opinion ko‘proq writing, essay, speaking exam, rasmiyroq nutqda ishlatiladi.

Ma’nosi: mening fikrimcha

Masalan:

In my opinion, learning English is necessary for every student.
Mening fikrimcha, ingliz tilini o‘rganish har bir o‘quvchi uchun zarur.

In my opinion, exams are useful, but they should not be too difficult.
Mening fikrimcha, imtihonlar foydali, lekin ular juda qiyin bo‘lmasligi kerak.

In my opinion, children should spend less time on phones.
Mening fikrimcha, bolalar telefonda kamroq vaqt o‘tkazishi kerak.

Vergul ishlatilishi

In my opinion gap boshida kelsa, undan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi.

To‘g‘ri:

In my opinion, this book is useful.

Noto‘g‘ri:

In my opinion this book is useful.

Lekin oddiy suhbatda vergul eshitilmaydi, writingda esa kerak.

5. Uchtasining farqi

Ibora | Ma’nosi | Qayerda ko‘p ishlatiladi?
I think | Menimcha | Oddiy suhbatda
I believe | Men ishonamanki | Kuchliroq fikrda

grammar_rules_en:
I think, I believe, In my opinion

1. General meaning

These phrases are used to give your own opinion.

In Uzbek:

I think — menimcha / men o‘ylaymanki
I believe — men ishonamanki / menimcha
In my opinion — mening fikrimcha

For example:

I think English is important.
In my opinion, English is important.

I believe hard work brings success.
I believe hard work brings success.

In my opinion, students should read more books.
In my opinion, students should read more books.

2. I think

When is it used?

I think is the simplest and most commonly used phrase. It sounds very natural in everyday conversation.

Meaning: I think

Structure

I think + sentence

For example:

I think this lesson is easy.
I think this lesson is easy.

I think he is a good student.
I think he is a good student.

I think we should start now.
I think we should start now.

Negative form

Usually in English:

I don’t think + positive sentence

is used.

For example:

I don’t think this answer is correct.
I don’t think this answer is correct.

If we translate literally:
“I don’t think this answer is correct.”

But a more natural translation in Uzbek:
I think this answer is incorrect.

More examples:

I don’t think he is ready.
I don’t think he is ready.

I don’t think it will rain today.
I don’t think it will rain today.

I don’t think this is a good idea.
I don’t think this is a good idea.

3. I believe

When is it used?

I believe is similar to I think, but it sounds a bit stronger and more serious.

Meaning:

I believe...
I firmly think...

For example:

I believe education can change a person’s life.
I believe education can change a person’s life.

I believe students need motivation.
I believe students need motivation.

I believe this method is effective.
I believe this method is effective.

Difference between I think and I believe

I think — a simple opinion.
I believe — a stronger opinion, there is confidence.

For example:

I think he is right.
I think he is right.

I believe he is right.
I believe he is right.

The second one sounds stronger.

4. In my opinion

When is it used?

In my opinion is used more in writing, essays, speaking exams, and in more formal speech.

Meaning: in my opinion

For example:

In my opinion, learning English is necessary for every student.
In my opinion, learning English is necessary for every student.

In my opinion, exams are useful, but they should not be too difficult.
In my opinion, exams are useful, but they should not be too difficult.

In my opinion, children should spend less time on phones.
In my opinion, children should spend less time on phones.

Use of comma

If In my opinion comes at the beginning of a sentence, a comma is placed after it.

Correct:

In my opinion, this book is useful.

Incorrect:

In my opinion this book is useful.

But in casual conversation, the comma is not heard, while in writing it is necessary.

5. The difference between the three

Phrase | Meaning | Where is it commonly used?
I think | I think | In casual conversation
I believe | I believe | In stronger opinions
In my opinion | In my opinion | In writing and more formal speaking
grammar_rules_ru:
I think, I believe, In my opinion

1. Общее значение

Эти выражения используются, чтобы высказать своё мнение.

По-русски:

I think — я думаю / мне кажется
I believe — я уверен / я считаю
In my opinion — по моему мнению

Например:

I think English is important.
Я думаю, английский язык важен.

I believe hard work brings success.
Я уверен, что упорный труд приносит успех.

In my opinion, students should read more books.
По моему мнению, студенты должны читать больше книг.

2. I think

Когда используется?

I think — это самое простое и наиболее часто используемое выражение. В повседневной беседе оно звучит очень естественно.

Значение: я думаю

Структура

I think + предложение

Например:

I think this lesson is easy.
Я думаю, этот урок легкий.

I think he is a good student.
Я думаю, он хороший студент.

I think we should start now.
Я думаю, нам следует начать сейчас.

Отрицательная форма

Обычно в английском языке:

I don’t think + положительное предложение

говорится.

Например:

I don’t think this answer is correct.
Я думаю, этот ответ неверный.

Если перевести дословно:
“Я не думаю, что этот ответ правильный.”

Но на узбекском языке более естественный перевод:
Я думаю, этот ответ неправильный.

Еще примеры:

I don’t think he is ready.
Я думаю, он не готов.

I don’t think it will rain today.
Я думаю, сегодня дождя не будет.

I don’t think this is a good idea.
Я думаю, это не хорошая идея.

3. I believe

Когда используется?

I believe похоже на I think, но звучит немного сильнее и серьезнее.

Значение:

Я верю, что…
Я более уверенно думаю, что…

Например:

I believe education can change a person’s life.
Я верю, что образование может изменить жизнь человека.

I believe students need motivation.
Я верю, что студентам нужна мотивация.

I believe this method is effective.
Я верю, что этот метод эффективен.

Разница между I think и I believe

I think — простое мнение.
I believe — более сильное мнение, есть уверенность.

Например:

I think he is right.
Я думаю, он прав.

I believe he is right.
Я верю, что он прав.

Второе звучит сильнее.

4. In my opinion

Когда используется?

In my opinion чаще используется в письменной речи, эссе, устном экзамене, в более официальной речи.

Значение: по моему мнению

Например:

In my opinion, learning English is necessary for every student.
По моему мнению, изучение английского языка необходимо для каждого студента.

In my opinion, exams are useful, but they should not be too difficult.
По моему мнению, экзамены полезны, но они не должны быть слишком сложными.

In my opinion, children should spend less time on phones.
По моему мнению, детям следует проводить меньше времени за телефонами.

Использование запятой

Если In my opinion стоит в начале предложения, то после него ставится запятая.

Правильно:

In my opinion, this book is useful.

Неправильно:

In my opinion this book is useful.

Но в обычной беседе запятая не слышна, а в письменной она необходима.

5. Разница между тремя выражениями

Выражение | Значение | Где чаще используется?
I think | Я думаю | В повседневной беседе
I believe | Я верю, что | В более сильном мнении
In my opinion | По моему мнению | В письменной и более официальной речи

reading_passage:
The student magazine has a new feature on opinions about social networks and communication. It begins with a situation from a digital citizenship debate.

Some students believe social networks make it easier to maintain friendships across long distances. Others think constant notifications reduce concentration and encourage shallow conversations.

One group argues that private messages are useful for teamwork while public posts require more care. The class agrees that users should understand privacy settings before sharing personal information.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “In my opinion, secure networks are essential; I believe students should learn basic privacy rules.” The debate shows that technology itself is neither completely good nor completely bad.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Lena and Sam compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

grammar_rules:
1. Third Conditional nima?

Third Conditional o‘tgan zamonda bo‘lib o‘tgan yoki bo‘lmagan vaziyatlar haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

Asosiy ma’nosi:

Agar o‘shanda shunday bo‘lganida, natija boshqacha bo‘lardi.

Ya’ni gap o‘tmishdagi xayoliy vaziyat haqida bo‘ladi. Endi uni o‘zgartirib bo‘lmaydi.

2. Third Conditional tuzilishi

If + Past Perfect, would have + V3

Masalan:

If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
Agar men qattiqroq o‘qiganimda, imtihondan o‘tgan bo‘lardim.

Bu gapda:

If I had studied harder — agar qattiqroq o‘qiganimda
I would have passed the exam — imtihondan o‘tgan bo‘lardim

Lekin haqiqatda:
Men yetarlicha o‘qimaganman va imtihondan o‘tmaganman.

3. Third Conditional qachon ishlatiladi?

1. Afsuslanish

If I had listened to my teacher, I would have got a better result.
Agar ustozimga quloq solganimda, yaxshiroq natija olgan bo‘lardim.

If he had come earlier, he would not have missed the lesson.
Agar u ertaroq kelganida, darsni o‘tkazib yubormagan bo‘lardi.

If we had left home earlier, we would have arrived on time.
Agar uydan ertaroq chiqqanimizda, vaqtida yetib borgan bo‘lardik.

2. O‘tmishdagi sabab va natija

If it had rained yesterday, we would have stayed at home.
Agar kecha yomg‘ir yog‘ganida, biz uyda qolgan bo‘lardik.

If she had prepared well, she would have passed the test.
Agar u yaxshi tayyorlanganida, testdan o‘tgan bo‘lardi.

If they had invited me, I would have gone to the party.
Agar ular meni taklif qilganida, ziyofatga borgan bo‘lardim.

3. Tanqid yoki pushaymon

If you had told me the truth, I would have helped you.
Agar menga rostini aytganingda, men senga yordam bergan bo‘lardim.

If he had not wasted time, he would have finished the project.
Agar u vaqtini bekor sarflamaganida, loyihani tugatgan bo‘lardi.

If I had known about the exam, I would have prepared better.
Agar imtihon haqida bilganimda, yaxshiroq tayyorlangan bo‘lardim.

4. Third Conditionalda inkor shakl

If qismida inkor

If + had not + V3, would have + V3

If I had not been late, I would have met him.
Agar kech qolmaganimda, u bilan uchrashgan bo‘lardim.

Qisqartma shakli:

had not = hadn’t

If I hadn’t been late, I would have met him.

Natija qismida inkor

If + had + V3, would not have + V3

If he had studied, he would not have failed.
Agar u o‘qiganida, yiqilmagan bo‘lardi.

Qisqartma shakli:

would not have = wouldn’t have

If he had studied, he wouldn’t have failed.

5. Would have o‘rniga could have / might have

Third Conditionalda faqat would have emas, could have va might have ham ishlatiladi.

Would have

Aniqroq natija.

If I had studied, I would have passed.
Agar o‘qiganimda, o‘tgan bo‘lardim.

Could have

Imkoniyat bo‘lganini bildiradi.

If I had studied, I could have passed.
Agar o‘qiganimda, o‘tishim mumkin edi.

Might have

Ehtimol bo‘lganini bildiradi.

If I had studied, I might have passed.
Agar o‘qiganimda, ehtimol o‘tgan bo‘lardim.

6. Third Conditional qisqa xulosa

Third Conditional — o‘tmishdagi xayoliy vaziyat.

If I had known, I would have helped you.
Agar bilganimda, senga yordam bergan bo‘lardim.

Haqiqatda:
Men bilmaganman va yordam bermaganman.

7. Mixed Conditionals nima?

Mixed Conditional — bu ikki xil conditional aralashib kelgan holat.

Ya’ni shart bir zamonda, natija boshqa zamonda bo‘ladi.

Ko‘p ishlatiladigan 2 ta turi bor:

1. O‘tmishdagi shart → hozirgi natija

2. Hozirgi holat → o‘tmishdagi natija

8. Mixed Conditional 1-turi

O‘tmishdagi shart → hozirgi natija

Bu turda o‘tmishda nimadir boshqacha bo‘lganida, hozir natija boshqacha bo‘lardi.

Tuzilishi

If + Past Perfect, would + Verb

Formula:

If + had + V3, would + V1

Masalan:

If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
Agar men tibbiyotda o‘qiganimda, hozir shifokor bo‘lardim.

Bu yerda:

If I had studied medicine — o‘tmishdagi shart
I would be a doctor now — hozirgi natija

Haqiqatda:
Men tibbiyotda o‘qimaganman. Shuning uchun hozir shifokor emasman.

Yana misollar

If I had learned English earlier, I would speak English better now.
Agar ingliz tilini ertaroq o‘rganganimda, hozir yaxshiroq gapirardim.

If he had saved money, he would have a car now.
Agar u pul yig‘ganida, hozir mashinasi bo‘lardi.

If she had listened to her parents, she would be happier now.
Agar u ota-onasiga quloq solganida, hozir baxtliroq bo‘lardi.

If we had left earlier, we would be at home now.
Agar ertaroq chiqqanimizda, hozir uyda bo‘lardik.

9. Mixed Conditional 2-turi

Hozirgi holat → o‘tmishdagi natija

Bu turda hozirgi umumiy holat yoki xarakter sababli o‘tmishda nimadir boshqacha bo‘lgan bo‘lardi.

Tuzilishi

If + Past Simple, would have + V3

Formula:

If + V2, would have + V3

Masalan:

If I were more careful, I would not have made that mistake.
Agar men ehtiyotkorroq odam bo‘lganimda, o‘sha xatoni qilmagan bo‘lardim.

Bu yerda:

If I were more careful — hozirgi yoki umumiy xarakter
I would not have made that mistake — o‘tmishdagi natija

Haqiqatda:
Men ehtiyotkor emasman, shu sabab o‘tmishda xato qilganman.

Yana misollar

If he were more responsible, he would have finished the work yesterday.
Agar u mas’uliyatliroq bo‘lganida, kecha ishni tugatgan bo‘lardi.

If she knew English well, she would have answered the question.
Agar u ingliz tilini yaxshi bilganida, savolga javob bergan bo‘lardi.

If I were rich, I would have bought that house last year.
Agar boy bo‘lganimda, o‘tgan yili uyni sotib olgan bo‘lardim.

If they were more organized, they would not have missed the meeting.
Agar ular tartibliroq bo‘lganida, uchrashuvni o‘tkazib yubormagan bo‘lardi.

10. Third Conditional va Mixed Conditional farqi

Third Conditional

O‘tmishdagi shart va o‘tmishdagi natija.

If I had studied, I would have passed the exam.
Agar o‘qiganimda, imtihondan o‘tgan bo‘lardim.

Shart ham o‘tmishda, natija ham o‘tmishda.

Mixed Conditional 1

O‘tmishdagi shart, hozirgi natija.

If I had studied, I would know the answer now.
Agar o‘qiganimda, hozir javobni bilardim.

Shart o‘tmishda, natija hozir.

Mixed Conditional 2

Hozirgi holat, o‘tmishdagi natija.

If I knew English well, I would have answered the question yesterday.
Agar ingliz tilini yaxshi bilganimda, kecha savolga javob bergan bo‘lardim.

Shart hozirgi umumiy holat, natija o‘tmishda.

11. Taqqoslash jadvali

Conditional | Formula | Ma’nosi | Misol
Third Conditional | If + had + V3, would have + V3 | O‘tmishdagi xayoliy vaziyat | If I had studied, I would have passed.
Mixed Conditional 1 | If + had + V3, would + V1 | O‘tmishdagi shart → hozirgi natija | If I had studied, I would know now.
Mixed Conditional 2 | If + V2, would have + V3 | Hozirgi holat → o‘tmishdagi natija | If I knew English, I would have answered.
grammar_rules_en:
1. What is the Third Conditional?

The Third Conditional is used to talk about situations that did or didn’t happen in the past.

Its main meaning:

If things had been different then, the result would have been different.

So the sentence is about an imaginary situation in the past. It can no longer be changed.

2. Structure of the Third Conditional

If + Past Perfect, would have + V3

For example:

If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

This sentence indicates:

If I had studied harder
I would have passed the exam

But in reality:
I didn’t study enough and I didn’t pass the exam.

3. When is the Third Conditional used?

1. Regret

If I had listened to my teacher, I would have got a better result.
If I had listened to my teacher, I would have got a better result.

If he had come earlier, he would not have missed the lesson.
If he had come earlier, he would not have missed the lesson.

If we had left home earlier, we would have arrived on time.
If we had left home earlier, we would have arrived on time.

2. Cause and effect in the past

If it had rained yesterday, we would have stayed at home.
If it had rained yesterday, we would have stayed at home.

If she had prepared well, she would have passed the test.
If she had prepared well, she would have passed the test.

If they had invited me, I would have gone to the party.
If they had invited me, I would have gone to the party.

3. Criticism or Regret

If you had told me the truth, I would have helped you.

If he had not wasted time, he would have finished the project.

If I had known about the exam, I would have prepared better.

4. Negative Form in the Third Conditional

Negation in the if clause

If + had not + V3, would have + V3

If I had not been late, I would have met him.

Short form:

had not = hadn’t

If I hadn’t been late, I would have met him.

Negation in the result clause

If + had + V3, would not have + V3

If he had studied, he would not have failed.

Short form:

would not have = wouldn’t have

If he had studied, he wouldn’t have failed.

5. Using could have / might have instead of would have

In the Third Conditional, not only would have is used, but could have and might have as well.

Would have

More definite result.

If I had studied, I would have passed.

Could have

Indicates a possibility.

If I had studied, I could have passed.
If I had studied, I could have passed.

Might have

Indicates a possibility.

If I had studied, I might have passed.
If I had studied, I might have passed.

6. A brief summary of the Third Conditional

Third Conditional — an imaginary situation in the past.

If I had known, I would have helped you.
If I had known, I would have helped you.

In reality:
I didn’t know and didn’t help.

7. What are Mixed Conditionals?

Mixed Conditional — a situation where two different conditionals are mixed.

That is, the condition is in one tense, the result is in another tense.

There are 2 commonly used types:

1. Past condition → present result

2. Present situation → past result

8. Type 1 of Mixed Conditional

Past condition → present result

In this type, if something had been different in the past, the present result would be different.

Structure

If + Past Perfect, would + Verb

Formula:

If + had + V3, would + V1

For example:

If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.

Here:

If I had studied medicine — past condition
I would be a doctor now — present result

In reality:
I didn’t study medicine. That’s why I’m not a doctor now.

More examples

If I had learned English earlier, I would speak English better now.
If I had learned English earlier, I would speak English better now.

If he had saved money, he would have a car now.
If he had saved money, he would have a car now.

If she had listened to her parents, she would be happier now.
If she had listened to her parents, she would be happier now.

If we had left earlier, we would be at home now.
If we had left earlier, we would be at home now.

9. Type 2 of Mixed Conditional

Present situation → past result

In this type, something would have been different in the past due to the current general situation or character.

Structure

If + Past Simple, would have + V3

Formula:

If + V2, would have + V3

For example:

If I were more careful, I would not have made that mistake.
If I were more careful, I would not have made that mistake.

Here:

If I were more careful — present or general character
I would not have made that mistake — past result

In reality:
I am not careful, which is why I made a mistake in the past.

More examples

If he were more responsible, he would have finished the work yesterday.
If he were more responsible, he would have finished the work yesterday.

If she knew English well, she would have answered the question.
If she knew English well, she would have answered the question.

If I were rich, I would have bought that house last year.
If I were rich, I would have bought that house last year.

If they were more organized, they would not have missed the meeting.
If they were more organized, they would not have missed the meeting.

10. Difference between Third Conditional and Mixed Conditional

Third Conditional

Past condition and past result.

If I had studied, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied, I would have passed the exam.

Condition is in the past, result is also in the past.

Mixed Conditional 1

Past condition, present result.

If I had studied, I would know the answer now.
If I had studied, I would know the answer now.

Condition is in the past, result is present.

Mixed Conditional 2

Present situation, past result.

If I knew English well, I would have answered the question yesterday.
If I knew English well, I would have answered the question yesterday.

Condition is a current general situation, result is in the past.

11. Comparison table

Conditional | Formula | Meaning | Example
Third Conditional | If + had + V3, would have + V3 | Imaginary situation in the past | If I had studied, I would have passed.
Mixed Conditional 1 | If + had + V3, would + V1 | Past condition → present result | If I had studied, I would know now.
Mixed Conditional 2 | If + V2, would have + V3 | Present situation → past result | If I knew English, I would have answered.
grammar_rules_ru:
1. Что такое Third Conditional?

Third Conditional используется, когда говорят о ситуациях в прошлом, которые произошли или не произошли.

Основное значение:

Если бы тогда всё было иначе, результат был бы другим.

То есть речь идёт о воображаемой ситуации в прошлом. Изменить её уже нельзя.

2. Структура Third Conditional

If + Past Perfect, would have + V3

Например:

If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
Если бы я учился усерднее, я бы сдал экзамен.

В этом предложении:

If I had studied harder — если бы я учился усерднее
I would have passed the exam — я бы сдал экзамен

Но на самом деле:
Я недостаточно учился и не сдал экзамен.

3. Когда используется Third Conditional?

1. Сожаление

If I had listened to my teacher, I would have got a better result.
Если бы я слушал своего учителя, я бы получил лучший результат.

If he had come earlier, he would not have missed the lesson.
Если бы он пришёл раньше, он бы не пропустил урок.

If we had left home earlier, we would have arrived on time.
Если бы мы вышли из дома раньше, мы бы прибыли вовремя.

2. Причина и следствие в прошлом

If it had rained yesterday, we would have stayed at home.
Если бы вчера шёл дождь, мы бы остались дома.

If she had prepared well, she would have passed the test.
Если бы она хорошо подготовилась, она бы сдала тест.

If they had invited me, I would have gone to the party.
Если бы они пригласили меня, я бы пошёл на вечеринку.

3. Критика или сожаление

If you had told me the truth, I would have helped you.
Если бы ты сказал мне правду, я бы тебе помог.

If he had not wasted time, he would have finished the project.
Если бы он не тратил время зря, он бы закончил проект.

If I had known about the exam, I would have prepared better.
Если бы я знал о экзамене, я бы подготовился лучше.

4. Отрицательная форма в Third Conditional

Отрицание в части If

If + had not + V3, would have + V3

If I had not been late, I would have met him.
Если бы я не опоздал, я бы встретил его.

Сокращённая форма:

had not = hadn’t

If I hadn’t been late, I would have met him.

Отрицание в части результата

If + had + V3, would not have + V3

If he had studied, he would not have failed.
Если бы он учился, он бы не провалился.

Сокращённая форма:

would not have = wouldn’t have

If he had studied, he wouldn’t have failed.

5. Вместо would have можно использовать could have / might have

В Third Conditional используются не только would have, но и could have и might have.

Would have

Более определённый результат.

If I had studied, I would have passed.
Если бы я учился, я бы сдал.

Could have

Указывает на возможность.

If I had studied, I could have passed.
Если бы я учился, я мог бы сдать.

Might have

Указывает на вероятность.

If I had studied, I might have passed.
Если бы я учился, возможно, я бы сдал.

6. Краткое резюме Third Conditional

Third Conditional — это воображаемая ситуация в прошлом.

If I had known, I would have helped you.
Если бы я знал, я бы тебе помог.

На самом деле:
Я не знал и не помог.

7. Что такое Mixed Conditionals?

Mixed Conditional — это ситуация, в которой смешиваются два типа условных предложений.

То есть условие в одном времени, а результат в другом времени.

Существует два наиболее часто используемых типа:

1. Условие в прошлом → результат в настоящем

2. Настоящее состояние → результат в прошлом

8. Первый тип Mixed Conditional

Условие в прошлом → результат в настоящем

В этом типе, если бы в прошлом что-то было иначе, результат в настоящем был бы другим.

Структура

If + Past Perfect, would + Verb

Формула:

If + had + V3, would + V1

Например:

If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
Если бы я учился на медика, я бы сейчас был врачом.

Здесь:

If I had studied medicine — условие в прошлом
I would be a doctor now — результат в настоящем

На самом деле:
Я не учился на медика. Поэтому я не врач сейчас.

Другие примеры

If I had learned English earlier, I would speak English better now.
Если бы я учил английский раньше, я бы сейчас лучше говорил на английском.

If he had saved money, he would have a car now.
Если бы он копил деньги, у него была бы машина сейчас.

If she had listened to her parents, she would be happier now.
Если бы она слушала своих родителей, она была бы сейчас счастливее.

If we had left earlier, we would be at home now.
Если бы мы вышли раньше, мы бы сейчас были дома.

9. Второй тип Mixed Conditional

Настоящее состояние → результат в прошлом

В этом типе из-за текущего общего состояния или характера в прошлом что-то было бы иначе.

Структура

If + Past Simple, would have + V3

Формула:

If + V2, would have + V3

Например:

If I were more careful, I would not have made that mistake.
Если бы я был более осторожным, я бы не сделал эту ошибку.

Здесь:

If I were more careful — текущее или общее состояние
I would not have made that mistake — результат в прошлом.

На самом деле:
Я не осторожен, поэтому в прошлом я совершал ошибки.

Еще примеры

If he were more responsible, he would have finished the work yesterday.
Если бы он был более ответственным, он бы закончил работу вчера.

If she knew English well, she would have answered the question.
Если бы она хорошо знала английский, она бы ответила на вопрос.

If I were rich, I would have bought that house last year.
Если бы я был богат, я бы купил тот дом в прошлом году.

If they were more organized, they would not have missed the meeting.
Если бы они были более организованными, они бы не пропустили встречу.

10. Разница между Third Conditional и Mixed Conditional

Third Conditional

Условие в прошлом и результат в прошлом.

If I had studied, I would have passed the exam.
Если бы я учился, я бы сдал экзамен.

Условие также в прошлом, результат также в прошлом.

Mixed Conditional 1

Условие в прошлом, результат в настоящем.

If I had studied, I would know the answer now.
Если бы я учился, я бы знал ответ сейчас.

Условие в прошлом, результат сейчас.

Mixed Conditional 2

Настоящее состояние, результат в прошлом.

If I knew English well, I would have answered the question yesterday.
Если бы я хорошо знал английский, я бы ответил на вопрос вчера.

Условие в настоящем общем состоянии, результат в прошлом.

11. Таблица сравнения

Условное | Формула | Значение | Пример
Third Conditional | If + had + V3, would have + V3 | Воображаемая ситуация в прошлом | If I had studied, I would have passed.
Mixed Conditional 1 | If + had + V3, would + V1 | Условие в прошлом → результат в настоящем | If I had studied, I would know now.
Mixed Conditional 2 | If + V2, would have + V3 | Настоящее состояние → результат в прошлом | If I knew English, I would have answered.

2. Third Conditional dúzilisi

3. Third Conditional qachon ishlatiladi?

Agar u o‘qıǵanında, yiqılmaǵan bolardı.

would not have = wouldn’t have

If he had studied, he wouldn’t have failed.

5. Would have o‘rnına could have / might have

Third Conditionalda faqat would have emas, could have hám might have ham qollanıladı.

Agar o‘qıǵanımda, o‘tqan bolardım.

Agar o‘qıǵanımda, o‘tışım mümkin edi.

If I had studied, I might have passed.
Agar o‘qıǵanımda, ehtimol o‘tqan bolardım.

7. Mixed Conditionals nima?

Yaǵnıy shart bir zamanda, natija basqa zamanda boladı.

Kóbinese qollanılǵan 2 ta türı bar:

1. Ótmıştaki shart → hozirgi natija

2. Hozirgi holat → ótmıştaki natija

8. Mixed Conditional 1-türü

Ótmıştaki shart → hozirgi natija

Bu türde ótmışta nimadir basqa bolǵanda, hozir natija basqa bolardı.

Tuzılışı

If + Past Perfect, would + Verb

Formula:

If + had + V3, would + V1

Agar men tibbiyotda o‘qıǵanımda, hozir shifokor bolardım.

If I had studied medicine — ótmıştaki shart
I would be a doctor now — hozirgi natija

Men tibbiyotda o‘qıǵanım yoq. Sonlıqtan hozir shifokor emesmin.

Yana mısallar

Agar ingliz tilinı ertaroq o‘rganganımda, hozir yaxshıraq gapırardım.

If we had left earlier, we would be at home now.
Agar ertaroq chiqqanımızda, hozir uyda bolardık.

9. Mixed Conditional 2-türü

Hozirgi holat → ótmıştaki natija

Bu türde hozirgi umumı holat yaki xarakter sabablı ótmışta nimadir basqa bolǵan bolardı.

Tuzılışı

If + Past Simple, would have + V3

Formula:

If + V2, would have + V3

Mısalı:
