Agar men ehtiyotkorroq adam bolǵanımda, o‘sha xatoni qilmaǵan bolardım.

Bu yerda:

If I were more careful — hozirgi yaki umumı xarakter
I would not have made that mistake — ótmıştaki natija

Haqiqatda:
Men ehtiyotkor emesmin, shu sabab o‘tken de bolǵan xato qıldım.

Yana mısallar

If he were more responsible, he would have finished the work yesterday.
Agar u mas’uliyatlıroq bolǵanda, kecha ishni tugatqan bolardı.

If she knew English well, she would have answered the question.
Agar u ingliz tilin jaqsı bilǵanda, savolğa juwap bergan bolardı.

If I were rich, I would have bought that house last year.
Agar boy bolǵanımda, o‘tken jılda uyni satıp alǵan bolardı.

If they were more organized, they would not have missed the meeting.
Agar ular tartıblıroq bolǵanda, uchraşuvni ötkizip yuborǵan bolardı.

10. Third Conditional hám Mixed Conditional farqı

Third Conditional

O‘tken degi şart hám o‘tken degi natija.

If I had studied, I would have passed the exam.
Agar o‘qıǵanımda, imtihondan o‘tǵan bolardı.

Şart hám o‘tken de, natija hám o‘tken de.

Mixed Conditional 1

O‘tken degi şart, hozirgi natija.

If I had studied, I would know the answer now.
Agar o‘qıǵanımda, hozir juwapnı bilǵan bolardım.

Şart o‘tken de, natija hozir.

Mixed Conditional 2

Hozirgi holat, o‘tken degi natija.

If I knew English well, I would have answered the question yesterday.
Agar ingliz tilin jaqsı bilǵanımda, kecha savolğa juwap bergan bolardı.

Şart hozirgi umumı holat, natija o‘tken de.

11. Taqqoslaw jadvalı

Conditional | Formula | Ma’nisi | Mısal
Third Conditional | If + had + V3, would have + V3 | O‘tken degi xayoliy vaziyat | If I had studied, I would have passed.
Mixed Conditional 1 | If + had + V3, would + V1 | O‘tken degi şart → hozirgi natija | If I had studied, I would know now.
Mixed Conditional 2 | If + V2, would have + V3 | Hozirgi holat → o‘tken degi natija | If I knew English, I would have answered.

grammar_rules: Future form ma’noga qarab tanlanadi: will — prediction/decision, going to — plan yoki evidence, present continuous — fixed arrangement. Future perfect kelajakdagi nuqtadan oldingi natijaga qaraydi.
grammar_rules_en: The future form is chosen by meaning: will — prediction/decision, going to — plan or evidence, present continuous — fixed arrangement. The future perfect looks back at a result completed before a point in the future.
grammar_rules_ru: Форма будущего времени выбирается по смыслу: will — прогноз/решение, going to — план или очевидные признаки, present continuous — твёрдая договорённость. Future perfect смотрит на результат, достигнутый к определённому моменту в будущем.
grammar_rules_kk: Keleshek forması mánisine qarap tańlanadı: will — boljaw/sheshim, going to — joba yamasa anıq belgiler, present continuous — aldınnan kelisilgen is. Future perfect keleshektegi bir waqıtqa shekem tamamlanǵan nátiyjege qaraydı.

grammar_rules:
Future Simple nima?

Future Simple kelajakda bo‘ladigan ish-harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

Future Simple ko‘pincha will yordamida yasaladi.

Tuzilishi

Subject + will + Verb

Masalan:

I will help you.
Men senga yordam beraman.

She will come tomorrow.
U ertaga keladi.

They will study English.
Ular ingliz tilini o‘rganadi.

Bu yerda will hamma shaxslar bilan bir xil ishlatiladi:

I will
You will
He will
She will
It will
We will
They will

2. Future Simple qachon ishlatiladi?

1. Tez qaror qilinganda

Gapirayotgan paytda qaror qilinsa, will ishlatiladi.

Masalan:

I am tired. I will take a rest.
Men charchadim. Dam olaman.

This bag is heavy. I will help you.
Bu sumka og‘ir ekan. Men yordam beraman.

The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
Telefon jiringlayapti. Men javob beraman.

Bu gaplarda qaror oldindan rejalashtirilmagan. Qaror shu paytning o‘zida qilinyapti.

2. Va’da berilganda

I will call you tomorrow.
Men senga ertaga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

I will never forget you.
Men seni hech qachon unutmayman.

I will help you with your homework.
Men senga uy vazifangda yordam beraman.

3. Taxmin qilishda

Agar kelajak haqida taxmin qilsak, will ishlatiladi.

I think he will pass the exam.
Menimcha, u imtihondan o‘tadi.

I believe it will rain tomorrow.
Menimcha, ertaga yomg‘ir yog‘adi.

Maybe they will come late.
Balki ular kech kelishadi.

Future Simple bilan ko‘p ishlatiladigan so‘zlar:

I think — menimcha
I believe — men ishonamanki
Maybe — balki
Probably — ehtimol
I hope — umid qilamanki

Masalan:

I hope you will succeed.
Umid qilamanki, sen muvaffaqiyatga erishasan.

4. Taklif qilishda

I will open the window.
Men derazani ochaman.

I will carry your bag.
Men sumkangizni ko‘tarib beraman.

I will explain this topic again.
Men bu mavzuni yana tushuntirib beraman.

5. Kelajakdagi oddiy faktlar

The lesson will start at 8 o’clock.
Dars soat 8 da boshlanadi.

The exam will be difficult.
Imtihon qiyin bo‘ladi.

Winter will come soon.
Qish tez orada keladi.

3. Future Simple inkor shakli

Tuzilishi

Subject + will not + Verb

Qisqartma shakli:

will not = won’t

Masalan:

I will not go.
Men bormayman.

I won’t go.
Men bormayman.

She won’t come tomorrow.
U ertaga kelmaydi.

They won’t pass the exam if they don’t study.
Agar ular o‘qimasa, imtihondan o‘tmaydi.

4. Future Simple so‘roq shakli

Tuzilishi

Will + subject + Verb?

Masalan:

Will you help me?
Menga yordam berasanmi?

Will she come tomorrow?
U ertaga keladimi?

Will they study English?
Ular ingliz tilini o‘rganadimi?

Javoblar:

Yes, I will.
Ha.

No, I won’t.
Yo‘q.

5. Be going to nima?

Be going to ham kelajakni bildiradi. Lekin u odatda oldindan reja qilingan ishlar yoki belgisi ko‘rinib turgan natijalar uchun ishlatiladi.

Tuzilishi

Subject + am / is / are + going to + Verb

Masalan:

I am going to study English.
Men ingliz tilini o‘rganmoqchiman.

She is going to visit her grandmother.
U buvisinikiga bormoqchi.

They are going to play football.
Ular futbol o‘ynamoqchi.

6. Am / is / are ishlatilishi

Subject | Be going to
I | am going to
He | is going to
She | is going to
It | is going to
You | are going to
We | are going to
They | are going to

Misollar:

I am going to read a book.
Men kitob o‘qimoqchiman.

He is going to buy a phone.
U telefon sotib olmoqchi.

We are going to watch a film.
Biz film ko‘rmoqchimiz.

7. Be going to qachon ishlatiladi?

1. Oldindan reja qilingan ishlar

Agar ish oldindan rejalashtirilgan bo‘lsa, be going to ishlatiladi.

I am going to visit Tashkent next week.
Men kelasi hafta Toshkentga bormoqchiman.

She is going to start a new course.
U yangi kurs boshlamoqchi.

We are going to have an exam tomorrow.
Biz ertaga imtihon topshirmoqchimiz.

Bu gaplarda qaror oldindan qilingan.

2. Niyat va maqsad

I am going to learn English this year.
Men bu yil ingliz tilini o‘rganmoqchiman.

He is going to become a doctor.
U shifokor bo‘lmoqchi.

They are going to open a new school.
Ular yangi maktab ochmoqchi.

3. Belgisi hozir ko‘rinib turgan natija

Agar hozirgi vaziyatdan kelajakda nima bo‘lishi aniq ko‘rinib tursa, be going to ishlatiladi.

Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
Bulutlarga qara. Yomg‘ir yog‘adiganga o‘xshaydi.

Be careful! You are going to fall.
Ehtiyot bo‘l! Yiqilib tushasan.

The glass is on the edge of the table. It is going to fall.
Stakan stol chetida turibdi. U tushib ketadi.

Bu yerda taxmin shunchaki fikr emas, balki belgi bor.

8. Be going to inkor shakli

Tuzilishi

Subject + am / is / are + not + going to + Verb

Masalan:

I am not going to go.
Men bormoqchi emasman.

She is not going to study tonight.
U bugun kechqurun o‘qimoqchi emas.

They are not going to play football.
Ular futbol o‘ynamoqchi emas.

Qisqartmalar:

is not = isn’t
are not = aren’t

He isn’t going to come.
U kelmoqchi emas.

We aren’t going to buy a car.
Biz mashina sotib olmoqchi emasmiz.

9. Be going to so‘roq shakli

Tuzilishi

Am / Is / Are + subject + going to + Verb?

Masalan:

Are you going to study tonight?
Bugun kechqurun o‘qimoqchimisan?

Is she going to come tomorrow?
U ertaga kelmoqchimi?

Are they going to play football?
Ular futbol o‘ynamoqchimi?

Javoblar:

Yes, I am.
Ha.

No, I am not.
Yo‘q.

Yes, she is.
Ha.

No, she isn’t.
Yo‘q.

Yes, they are.
Ha.

No, they aren’t.
Yo‘q.

10. Will va Be going to farqi

1. Will — tez qaror

I am thirsty. I will drink some water.
Chanqadim. Suv ichaman.

Qaror shu paytda qilindi.

2. Be going to — oldindan reja

I am going to drink more water every day.
Men har kuni ko‘proq suv ichmoqchiman.

Bu oldindan o‘ylangan niyat yoki reja.

3. Will — oddiy taxmin

I think it will rain tomorrow.
Menimcha, ertaga yomg‘ir yog‘adi.

Bu shaxsiy fikr.

4. Be going to — dalil bor

Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
Bulutlarga qara. Yomg‘ir yog‘adi.

Bu yerda belgi bor: bulutlar ko‘rinib turibdi.
grammar_rules_en:
What is the Future Simple?

The Future Simple is used to express actions that will happen in the future.

The Future Simple is usually made with will.

Structure

Subject + will + Verb

For example:

I will help you.

She will come tomorrow.

They will study English.

Here, will is used the same for all subjects:

I will
You will
He will
She will
It will
We will
They will

2. When is the Future Simple used?

1. When making quick decisions

If a decision is made while speaking, will is used.

For example:

I am tired. I will take a rest.

This bag is heavy. I will help you.

The phone is ringing. I will answer it.

In these sentences, the decision is not planned in advance. The decision is being made at that moment.

2. When making promises

I will call you tomorrow.

I will never forget you.

I will help you with your homework.

3. When making predictions

If we make predictions about the future, will is used.

I think he will pass the exam.

I believe it will rain tomorrow.

Maybe they will come late.

Words commonly used with the Future Simple:

I think — I believe — Maybe — Probably — I hope

For example:

I hope you will succeed.

4. When making offers

I will open the window.

I will carry your bag.

I will explain this topic again.

5. Simple facts about the future

The lesson will start at 8 o’clock.

The exam will be difficult.

Winter will come soon.

3. The negative form of the Future Simple

Structure

Subject + will not + Verb

The contracted form:

will not = won’t

For example:

I will not go.

I won’t go.

She won’t come tomorrow.

They won’t pass the exam if they don’t study.

4. The interrogative form of the Future Simple

Structure

Will + subject + Verb?

For example:

Will you help me?

Will she come tomorrow?

Will they study English?

Answers:

Yes, I will.

No, I won’t.

5. What is be going to?

Be going to also indicates the future. However, it is usually used for actions that are planned in advance or for results that are clearly visible.

Structure

Subject + am / is / are + going to + Verb

For example:

I am going to study English.

She is going to visit her grandmother.

They are going to play football.

6. The use of am / is / are

Subject | Be going to
I | am going to
He | is going to
She | is going to
It | is going to
You | are going to
We | are going to
They | are going to

Examples:

I am going to read a book.

He is going to buy a phone.

We are going to watch a film.

7. When is be going to used?

1. For planned actions

If an action is planned in advance, be going to is used.

I am going to visit Tashkent next week.

She is going to start a new course.

We are going to have an exam tomorrow.

In these sentences, the decision has been made in advance.

2. Intentions and goals

I am going to learn English this year.

He is going to become a doctor.

They are going to open a new school.

3. When there is a clear indication of a future result

If it is clear what will happen in the future from the current situation, be going to is used.

Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.

Be careful! You are going to fall.

The glass is on the edge of the table. It is going to fall.

Here, the prediction is not just an opinion, but there is an indication.

8. The negative form of be going to

Structure

Subject + am / is / are + not + going to + Verb

For example:

I am not going to go.

She is not going to study tonight.

They are not going to play football.

Contractions:

is not = isn’t
are not = aren’t

He isn’t going to come.

We aren’t going to buy a car.

9. The interrogative form of be going to

Structure

Am / Is / Are + subject + going to + Verb?

For example:

Are you going to study tonight?
Are you going to study tonight?

Is she going to come tomorrow?
Is she going to come tomorrow?

Are they going to play football?
Are they going to play football?

Answers:

Yes, I am.
Yes, I am.

No, I am not.
No, I am not.

Yes, she is.
Yes, she is.

No, she isn’t.
No, she isn’t.

Yes, they are.
Yes, they are.

No, they aren’t.
No, they aren’t.

10. The difference between Will and Be going to

1. Will — quick decision

I am thirsty. I will drink some water.
I am thirsty. I will drink some water.

The decision is made at that moment.

2. Be going to — pre-planned intention

I am going to drink more water every day.
I am going to drink more water every day.

This is a premeditated intention or plan.

3. Will — simple assumption

I think it will rain tomorrow.
I think it will rain tomorrow.

This is a personal opinion.

4. Be going to — there is evidence

Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.

There is a sign here: the clouds are visible.
grammar_rules_ru:
Что такое Future Simple?

Future Simple используется для выражения действий, которые произойдут в будущем.

Future Simple чаще всего образуется с помощью will.

Структура

Subject + will + Verb

Например:

I will help you.
Я тебе помогу.

She will come tomorrow.
Она придёт завтра.

They will study English.
Они будут изучать английский.

Здесь will используется одинаково для всех лиц:

I will
Я буду
You will
Ты будешь
He will
Он будет
She will
Она будет
It will
Оно будет
We will
Мы будем
They will
Они будут

2. Когда используется Future Simple?

1. Когда принимается быстрое решение

Если решение принимается в момент разговора, используется will.

Например:

I am tired. I will take a rest.
Я устал. Я отдохну.

This bag is heavy. I will help you.
Эта сумка тяжёлая. Я помогу тебе.

The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
Телефон звонит. Я отвечу на него.

В этих предложениях решение не было запланировано заранее. Решение принимается в данный момент.

2. Когда даётся обещание

I will call you tomorrow.
Я позвоню тебе завтра.

I will never forget you.
Я никогда тебя не забуду.

I will help you with your homework.
Я помогу тебе с домашним заданием.

3. При предположениях

Если мы делаем предположение о будущем, используется will.

I think he will pass the exam.
Я думаю, он сдаст экзамен.

I believe it will rain tomorrow.
Я верю, что завтра будет дождь.

Maybe they will come late.
Может быть, они придут поздно.

Слова, часто используемые с Future Simple:

I think — я думаю
I believe — я верю
Maybe — может быть
Probably — вероятно
I hope — я надеюсь

Например:

I hope you will succeed.
Я надеюсь, что ты добьёшься успеха.

4. При предложениях

I will open the window.
Я открою окно.

I will carry your bag.
Я понесу твою сумку.

I will explain this topic again.
Я объясню эту тему снова.

5. Простые факты о будущем

The lesson will start at 8 o’clock.
Урок начнётся в 8 часов.

The exam will be difficult.
Экзамен будет трудным.

Winter will come soon.
Зима скоро наступит.

3. Отрицательная форма Future Simple

Структура

Subject + will not + Verb

Сокращённая форма:

will not = won’t

Например:

I will not go.
Я не пойду.

I won’t go.
Я не пойду.

She won’t come tomorrow.
Она не придёт завтра.

They won’t pass the exam if they don’t study.
Они не сдадут экзамен, если не будут учиться.

4. Вопросительная форма Future Simple

Структура

Will + subject + Verb?

Например:

Will you help me?
Ты мне поможешь?

Will she come tomorrow?
Она придёт завтра?

Will they study English?
Они будут изучать английский?

Ответы:

Yes, I will.
Да, я буду.

No, I won’t.
Нет, я не буду.

5. Что такое be going to?

Be going to также указывает на будущее. Но обычно он используется для заранее запланированных действий или когда результат очевиден.

Структура

Subject + am / is / are + going to + Verb

Например:

I am going to study English.
Я собираюсь изучать английский.

She is going to visit her grandmother.
Она собирается навестить свою бабушку.

They are going to play football.
Они собираются играть в футбол.

6. Использование am / is / are

Subject | Be going to
I | am going to
He | is going to
She | is going to
It | is going to
You | are going to
We | are going to
They | are going to

Примеры:

I am going to read a book.
Я собираюсь прочитать книгу.

He is going to buy a phone.
Он собирается купить телефон.

We are going to watch a film.
Мы собираемся посмотреть фильм.

7. Когда используется be going to?

1. Для заранее запланированных действий

Если действие запланировано заранее, используется be going to.

I am going to visit Tashkent next week.
Я собираюсь посетить Ташкент на следующей неделе.

She is going to start a new course.
Она собирается начать новый курс.

We are going to have an exam tomorrow.
Мы собираемся сдавать экзамен завтра.

В этих предложениях решение было принято заранее.

2. Намерение и цель

I am going to learn English this year.
Я собираюсь изучать английский в этом году.

He is going to become a doctor.
Он собирается стать врачом.

They are going to open a new school.
Они собираются открыть новую школу.

3. Когда результат очевиден

Если из текущей ситуации видно, что произойдёт в будущем, используется be going to.

Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
Смотри на облака. Похоже, будет дождь.

Be careful! You are going to fall.
Будь осторожен! Ты упадёшь.

The glass is on the edge of the table. It is going to fall.
Стакан стоит на краю стола. Он упадёт.

Здесь предположение не просто мнение, а признак.

8. Отрицательная форма be going to

Структура

Subject + am / is / are + not + going to + Verb

Например:

I am not going to go.
Я не собираюсь идти.

She is not going to study tonight.
Она не собирается учиться сегодня вечером.

They are not going to play football.
Они не собираются играть в футбол.

Сокращения:

is not = isn’t
are not = aren’t

He isn’t going to come.
Он не собирается приходить.

We aren’t going to buy a car.
Мы не собираемся покупать машину.

9. Вопросительная форма be going to

Структура

Am / Is / Are + subject + going to + Verb?

Например:

Ты собираешься учиться сегодня вечером?
Ты собираешься учиться сегодня вечером?

Она собирается прийти завтра?
Она собирается прийти завтра?

Они собираются играть в футбол?
Они собираются играть в футбол?

Ответы:

Да, я собираюсь.
Да.

Нет, я не собираюсь.
Нет.

Да, она собирается.
Да.

Нет, она не собирается.
Нет.

Да, они собираются.
Да.

Нет, они не собираются.
Нет.

10. Разница между Will и Be going to

1. Will — быстрое решение

Я хочу пить. Я выпью немного воды.
Я хочу пить. Я выпью немного воды.

Решение принято в этот момент.

2. Be going to — заранее запланировано

Я собираюсь пить больше воды каждый день.
Я собираюсь пить больше воды каждый день.

Это заранее обдуманное намерение или план.

3. Will — простое предположение

Я думаю, что завтра будет дождь.
Я думаю, что завтра будет дождь.

Это личное мнение.

4. Be going to — есть доказательства

Посмотри на облака. Будет дождь.
Посмотри на облака. Будет дождь.

Здесь есть признак: облака видны.

Future Simple degen ne?

Future Simple keljekte bolatın is-háreketlerdi bildiriw ushın qollanıladı.

Future Simple kóbinese will járdeminde jasaladı.

Dúzilisi

Subject + will + Verb

Mısalı:

I will help you.
Men saǵan járdem beremen.

She will come tomorrow.
Ol erteń keledi.

They will study English.
Olar inglis tilin óırenedi.

Bul jerde will hamma shaxslar menen bir qıyl ishlitiledi:

I will
You will
He will
She will
It will
We will
They will

2. Future Simple qachon ishlitiledi?

1. Tez qaror qılğanda

Gapirıp turğanda qaror qılınsa, will ishlitiledi.

Mısalı:

I am tired. I will take a rest.
Men charchadım. Dam alaman.

This bag is heavy. I will help you.
Bul sumka og‘ır eken. Men saǵa járdem beremen.

The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
Telefon jiringlayapti. Men juwap beremen.

Bul gaplarda qaror aldınan rejalashtırılmağan. Qaror shu paytning özinde qılınıp jatır.

2. Va’da berilgende

I will call you tomorrow.
Men saǵa erteń qońğıraq qılaman.

I will never forget you.
Men seni hech qachon unutmıymın.

I will help you with your homework.
Men saǵa uy vazifasında járdem beremen.

3. Taxmin qılğanda

Eger keljektegi toğrıda taxmin qılsaq, will ishlitiledi.

I think he will pass the exam.
Menimşe, ol imtihondan ótedi.

I believe it will rain tomorrow.
Menimşe, erteń yomğır yaǵadı.

Maybe they will come late.
Balki olar kech kelip qalar.

Future Simple menen kób ishlitiledi so'zlar:

I think — menimşe
I believe — men ishonamın
Maybe — balki
Probably — ehtimol
I hope — umid qilamın

Mısalı:

I hope you will succeed.
Umid qilamın, sen muvaffaqiyatqa erishesin.

4. Taklif qılğanda

I will open the window.
Men derazanı açaman.

I will carry your bag.
Men sumkasıñızdı köterip beremen.

I will explain this topic again.
Men bul mavzuni jańa túsindiremen.

5. Keljektegi oddiy faktlar

The lesson will start at 8 o’clock.
Dars soat 8 de bastaladı.

The exam will be difficult.
Imtihon qiyin boladı.

Winter will come soon.
Qış tez orada kelip qalar.

3. Future Simple inkor şekli

Dúzilisi

Subject + will not + Verb

Qısqartma şekli:

will not = won’t

Mısalı:

I will not go.
Men bormayman.

I won’t go.
Men bormayman.

She won’t come tomorrow.
Ol erteń kelmeydi.

They won’t pass the exam if they don’t study.
Eger olar óqımasa, imtihondan ótpeydi.

4. Future Simple so‘roq şekli

Dúzilisi

Will + subject + Verb?

Mısalı:

Will you help me?
Menga járdem beresiz be?

Will she come tomorrow?
Ol erteń kelip qalar ma?

Will they study English?
Olar inglis tilin óırenedi be?

Juwaplar:

Yes, I will.
Ha.

No, I won’t.
Yoq.

5. Be going to nima?

Be going to da keljekti bildirip, lekin odatda aldınan reja qılınğan is-háreketler nemese belgisini körinip turğan natijalar ushın ishlitiledi.

Dúzilisi

Subject + am / is / are + going to + Verb

Mısalı:

I am going to study English.
Men inglis tilin óıreniwim kerek.

She is going to visit her grandmother.
Ol buvisinikige bormaqçı.

They are going to play football.
Olar futbol oynamıqçı.

6. Am / is / are ishlitilwi

Subject | Be going to
I | am going to
He | is going to
She | is going to
It | is going to
You | are going to
We | are going to
They | are going to

Mısallar:

I am going to read a book.
Men kitap óqımaqçı.

He is going to buy a phone.
Ol telefon sotıp alımaqçı.

We are going to watch a film.
Biz film körımaqçı.

7. Be going to qachon ishlitiledi?

1. Aldınan reja qılınğan is-háreketler

Eger is aldınan rejalashtırılğan bolsa, be going to ishlitiledi.

I am going to visit Tashkent next week.
Men kelasi hafta Toshkentke bormaqçı.

She is going to start a new course.
Ol jańa kurs başlamaqçı.

We are going to have an exam tomorrow.
Biz erteń imtihon topsırmaqçı.

Bul gaplarda qaror aldınan qılınğan.

2. Niyat hám maqsat

Men bul jıl inglis tilin óıreniwim kerek.

He is going to become a doctor.
Ol shifokor bolmaqçı.

They are going to open a new school.
Olar jańa mektep açmaqçı.

3. Belgisi hozir körinip turğan natija

Eger hozirgi waqıttan keljekte ne bolatını anıq körinip tursa, be going to ishlitiledi.

Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
Bulutlarga qara. Yomğır yaǵadı.

Be careful! You are going to fall.
Ehtiyot bol! Yiqılıp tüşesiz.

The glass is on the edge of the table. It is going to fall.
Stakan stol chetinde turıp. U tüşip ketedi.

Bul jerde taxmin shunchalıq fikr emes, balki belgi bar.

8. Be going to inkor şekli

Dúzilisi

Subject + am / is / are + not + going to + Verb

Mısalı:

I am not going to go.
Men bormaqçı emesmin.

She is not going to study tonight.
Ol bugün kechqurun óqımaqçı emes.

They are not going to play football.
Olar futbol oynamıqçı emes.

Qısqartmalar:

is not = isn’t
are not = aren’t

Ol kelmeydi.

We aren’t going to buy a car.
Biz mashina sotıp alımaqçı emesmiz.

9. Be going to so‘roq şekli

Dúzilisi

Am / Is / Are + subject + going to + Verb?

Mısalı:

Siz bügün kechqurun oqıwshı bolıwıñız mı?
Bugun kechqurun o‘qimoqchimisan?

Ol ertenge kelıwı mı?
U ertaga kelmoqchimi?

Ular futbol oýnaıwı mı?
Ular futbol o‘ynamoqchimi?

Júwaplar:

Iya, men. 
Ha.

Yoq, men emes. 
Yo‘q.

Iya, ol. 
Ha.

Yoq, ol emes. 
Yo‘q.

Iya, olar. 
Ha.

Yoq, olar emes. 
Yo‘q.

10. Will hám Be going to farqı

1. Will — tez qaror

Men chanqadım. Men suv içemen.
I am thirsty. I will drink some water.

Qaror shu paytta qılındı.

2. Be going to — oldınqı reja

Men har kúni kóproq suv içiwim kerek.
I am going to drink more water every day.

Bu oldınqı oýlanğan niyat yáki reja.

3. Will — oddı taxmın

Menimşe, ertenge yomğır yaǵadı.
I think it will rain tomorrow.

Bu şahsı fikr.

4. Be going to — dalil bar

Bulutlarğa qara. Yomğır yaǵadı.

Bu jerde belgi bar: bulutlar kórinip turadı.
reading_passage:
Hi Adam,

Today our English class worked on predictions about life beyond the digital era. The example came from a future technology forum.

Researchers predict that small AI systems will work directly on personal devices instead of sending every task to distant servers. Health sensors will probably give people earlier warnings about some problems.

Smart transport systems may reduce traffic by changing routes automatically. Experts also say future technology will create new ethical questions about privacy and responsibility.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “In the future, smart systems will help people work faster and more safely.” The forum stresses that human decisions will remain important even as machines become more capable.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Nina and Adam compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

reading_vocabulary.definition: connected with ideas of right and wrong

reading_vocabulary.definition: to say what you think will happen
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “predict” in the context of predictions about life beyond the digital era.

reading_vocabulary.definition: able to do something
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “capable” in the context of predictions about life beyond the digital era.

reading_vocabulary.definition: the right to keep personal information protected
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “privacy” in the context of predictions about life beyond the digital era.

reading_vocabulary.definition: without needing a person to control every step
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “automatically” in the context of predictions about life beyond the digital era.

grammar_rules:
Past Perfect nima?

Past Perfect o‘tgan zamonda bir ish boshqa bir ishdan oldin sodir bo‘lganini ko‘rsatadi.

Ya’ni ikkita o‘tgan zamondagi voqea bo‘lsa, ulardan birinchisi Past Perfectda beriladi.

Masalan:

When I arrived, the lesson had started.
Men kelganimda, dars allaqachon boshlangan edi.

Bu gapda 2 ta ish bor:

1. The lesson had started — dars boshlangan edi.

2. I arrived — men keldim.

Dars avval boshlangan, men keyin kelganman.

Shuning uchun:

The lesson had started — Past Perfect
I arrived — Past Simple

2. Past Perfect tuzilishi

Darak gap

Subject + had + V3

Masalan:

I had finished my homework.
Men uy vazifamni tugatgan edim.

She had gone home.
U uyga ketgan edi.

They had eaten dinner.
Ular kechki ovqatni yeb bo‘lgan edi.

Bu yerda had hamma shaxslar bilan bir xil ishlatiladi:

I had
You had
He had
She had
It had
We had
They had

3. V3 nima?

Past Perfectda fe’lning 3-shakli ishlatiladi.

Masalan:

V1 | V2 | V3
go | went | gone
see | saw | seen
do | did | done
eat | ate | eaten
write | wrote | written
speak | spoke | spoken
come | came | come
buy | bought | bought
make | made | made
take | took | taken
finish | finished | finished
start | started | started
watch | watched | watched
play | played | played

Regular verbs uchun V2 va V3 bir xil bo‘ladi:

finish — finished — finished
play — played — played
watch — watched — watched

Irregular verbsni yodlash kerak:

go — went — gone
see — saw — seen
eat — ate — eaten

4. Past Perfect qachon ishlatiladi?

1. Bir ish boshqa ishdan oldin bo‘lganida

When we arrived at the cinema, the film had started.
Biz kinoteatrga kelganimizda, film boshlangan edi.

Bu yerda:

Film avval boshlangan.
Biz keyin kelganmiz.

When I came home, my mother had cooked dinner.
Men uyga kelganimda, onam ovqat pishirib bo‘lgan edi.

Ovqat avval pishirilgan.
Men keyin uyga kelganman.

When the teacher entered the classroom, the students had opened their books.
Ustoz sinfga kirganida, o‘quvchilar kitoblarini ochib bo‘lgan edi.

2. “Allaqachon” ma’nosida

Past Perfect ko‘pincha already bilan ishlatiladi.

I had already finished my homework when my friend called me.
Do‘stim qo‘ng‘iroq qilganida, men uy vazifamni allaqachon tugatgan edim.

She had already left when we arrived.
Biz kelganimizda, u allaqachon ketgan edi.

They had already eaten when I came.
Men kelganimda, ular allaqachon ovqatlanib bo‘lgan edi.

3. Sababni tushuntirishda

O‘tgan zamondagi bir holatning sababini ko‘rsatishda Past Perfect ishlatiladi.

He was tired because he had worked all day.
U charchagan edi, chunki u kun bo‘yi ishlagan edi.

She was happy because she had passed the exam.
U xursand edi, chunki u imtihondan o‘tgan edi.

I was angry because they had forgotten my birthday.
Men jahlim chiqqan edi, chunki ular tug‘ilgan kunimni unutgan edi.

4. Third Conditionalda

Third Conditionalda Past Perfect ishlatiladi.

If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
Agar qattiqroq o‘qiganimda, imtihondan o‘tgan bo‘lardim.

If she had come earlier, she would have met him.
Agar u ertaroq kelganida, u bilan uchrashgan bo‘lardi.

5. Past Perfect inkor shakli

Tuzilishi

Subject + had not + V3

Qisqartma shakli:

had not = hadn’t

Masalan:

I had not finished my homework.
Men uy vazifamni tugatmagan edim.

I hadn’t finished my homework.
Men uy vazifamni tugatmagan edim.

She hadn’t seen this film before.
U bu filmni oldin ko‘rmagan edi.

They hadn’t eaten before they came.
Ular kelishidan oldin ovqatlanmagan edi.

6. Past Perfect so‘roq shakli

Tuzilishi

Had + subject + V3?

Masalan:

Had you finished your homework?
Sen uy vazifangni tugatgan edingmi?

Had she gone home?
U uyga ketgan edimi?

Had they eaten dinner?
Ular kechki ovqatni yegan edimi?

Javoblar:

Yes, I had.
Ha.

No, I hadn’t.
Yo‘q.

Yes, she had.
Ha.

No, she hadn’t.
Yo‘q.

7. Past Simple va Past Perfect farqi

Past Simple

O‘tgan zamondagi oddiy ish-harakat.

I finished my homework.
Men uy vazifamni tugatdim.

Bu yerda faqat bitta o‘tgan ish aytilgan.

Past Perfect

O‘tgan zamonda boshqa bir ishdan oldin bo‘lgan ish.

I had finished my homework before my friend called me.
Do‘stim qo‘ng‘iroq qilishidan oldin men uy vazifamni tugatgan edim.

Bu yerda 2 ta ish bor:

1. Men uy vazifamni tugatdim.

2. Do‘stim qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.

Birinchi ish Past Perfectda:
had finished

Ikkinchi ish Past Simpleda:
called

8. Before va after bilan Past Perfect

Before

Before — “-dan oldin”

I had finished my homework before I went out.
Tashqariga chiqishimdan oldin uy vazifamni tugatgan edim.

She had cooked dinner before her husband came home.
Eri uyga kelishidan oldin u ovqat pishirib bo‘lgan edi.

After

After — “-dan keyin”

After I had finished my homework, I went out.
Uy vazifamni tugatganimdan keyin tashqariga chiqdim.

After she had cooked dinner, she watched TV.
U ovqat pishirib bo‘lgandan keyin televizor ko‘rdi.

9. When bilan Past Perfect

When — “qachonki / -ganida”

When I arrived, they had left.
Men kelganimda, ular ketib bo‘lgan edi.

When she came to the station, the train had gone.
U vokzalga kelganida, poyezd ketib bo‘lgan edi.

When the teacher asked the question, I had already written the answer.
Ustoz savol berganida, men javobni allaqachon yozgan edim.

10. Already, just, never, before

Past Perfect bilan quyidagi so‘zlar ko‘p ishlatiladi:

Already — allaqachon

I had already eaten when he came.
U kelganida, men allaqachon ovqatlanib bo‘lgan edim.

Just — endigina

She had just left when I arrived.
Men kelganimda, u endigina ketgan edi.

Never — hech qachon

I had never seen such a beautiful place before.
Men oldin hech qachon bunday chiroyli joyni ko‘rmagan edim.

Before — oldin

He had met her before.
U uni oldin uchratgan edi.

Past Perfect formulalari

Gap turi | Formula | Misol
Darak | Subject + had + V3 | I had finished.
Inkor | Subject + had not + V3 | I had not finished.
So‘roq | Had + subject + V3? | Had you finished?
grammar_rules_en:
What is the Past Perfect?

The Past Perfect shows that one past action happened before another past action.

So if there are two past events, the earlier one is in the Past Perfect.

For example:

When I arrived, the lesson had started.

This sentence has 2 actions:

1. The lesson had started — this happened first.

2. I arrived — this happened second.

The lesson started first, I arrived second.

Therefore:

The lesson had started — Past Perfect
I arrived — Past Simple

2. Structure of the Past Perfect

Affirmative sentence

Subject + had + V3

For example:

I had finished my homework.

She had gone home.

They had eaten dinner.

Here, 'had' is used the same way for all subjects:

I had
You had
He had
She had
It had
We had
They had

3. What is V3?

The third form of the verb is used in the Past Perfect.

For example:

V1 | V2 | V3
go | went | gone
see | saw | seen
do | did | done
eat | ate | eaten
write | wrote | written
speak | spoke | spoken
come | came | come
buy | bought | bought
make | made | made
take | took | taken
finish | finished | finished
start | started | started
watch | watched | watched
play | played | played

For regular verbs, V2 and V3 are the same:

finish — finished — finished
play — played — played
watch — watched — watched

Irregular verbs must be memorized:

go — went — gone
see — saw — seen
eat — ate — eaten

4. When is the Past Perfect used?

1. When one action happened before another action

When we arrived at the cinema, the film had started.

Here:

The film had started first.
We arrived second.

When I came home, my mother had cooked dinner.

The food had been cooked first.
I arrived home second.

When the teacher entered the classroom, the students had opened their books.

2. In the meaning of 'already'

The Past Perfect is often used with 'already'.

I had already finished my homework when my friend called me.

She had already left when we arrived.

They had already eaten when I came.

3. To explain a reason

The Past Perfect is used to show the reason for a situation in the past.

He was tired because he had worked all day.

She was happy because she had passed the exam.

I was angry because they had forgotten my birthday.

4. In the Third Conditional

The Past Perfect is used in the Third Conditional.

If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.

If she had come earlier, she would have met him.
If she had come earlier, she would have met him.

5. Past Perfect negative form

Structure

Subject + had not + V3

Contraction:

had not = hadn’t

For example:

I had not finished my homework.
I had not finished my homework.

I hadn’t finished my homework.
I hadn’t finished my homework.

She hadn’t seen this film before.
She hadn’t seen this film before.

They hadn’t eaten before they came.
They hadn’t eaten before they came.

6. Past Perfect interrogative form

Structure

Had + subject + V3?

For example:

Had you finished your homework?
Had you finished your homework?

Had she gone home?
Had she gone home?

Had they eaten dinner?
Had they eaten dinner?

Answers:

Yes, I had.
Yes, I had.

No, I hadn’t.
No, I hadn’t.

Yes, she had.
Yes, she had.

No, she hadn’t.
No, she hadn’t.

7. Difference between Past Simple and Past Perfect

Past Simple

Simple action in the past.

I finished my homework.
I finished my homework.

Here only one past action is mentioned.

Past Perfect

An action that happened before another action in the past.

I had finished my homework before my friend called me.
I had finished my homework before my friend called me.

Here there are 2 actions:

1. I finished my homework.

2. My friend called.

The first action is in Past Perfect:
had finished

The second action is in Past Simple:
called

8. Past Perfect with before and after

Before

Before means “before”

I had finished my homework before I went out.
I had finished my homework before I went out.

She had cooked dinner before her husband came home.
She had cooked dinner before her husband came home.

After

After means “after”

After I had finished my homework, I went out.
After I had finished my homework, I went out.

After she had cooked dinner, she watched TV.
After she had cooked dinner, she watched TV.

9. Past Perfect with when

When means “when”

When I arrived, they had left.
When I arrived, they had left.

When she came to the station, the train had gone.
This sentence shows that the train left before she arrived.

When the teacher asked the question, I had already written the answer.
This indicates that I completed my answer prior to the teacher's question.

10. Already, just, never, before

The following words are often used with the Past Perfect:

Already — allaqachon

I had already eaten when he came.
This means I finished eating before he arrived.

Just — endigina

She had just left when I arrived.
This indicates she left right before I got there.

Never — hech qachon

I had never seen such a beautiful place before.
This means I had no prior experience of seeing such a place.

Before — oldin

He had met her before.
This indicates he had prior acquaintance with her.

Past Perfect formulas

Sentence type | Formula | Example
Affirmative | Subject + had + V3 | I had finished.
Negative | Subject + had not + V3 | I had not finished.
Interrogative | Had + subject + V3? | Had you finished?
grammar_rules_ru:
Что такое Past Perfect?

Past Perfect показывает, что в прошлом одно действие произошло раньше другого.

То есть если есть два события в прошлом, то более раннее из них передаётся в Past Perfect.

Например:

When I arrived, the lesson had started.
Когда я пришёл, урок уже начался.

В этом предложении 2 действия:

1. The lesson had started — урок уже начался.

2. I arrived — я пришёл.

Урок аввал босhlangan, я пришёл позже.

Поэтому:

The lesson had started — Past Perfect
I arrived — Past Simple

2. Структура Past Perfect

Утвердительное предложение

Subject + had + V3

Например:

I had finished my homework.
Я закончил домашнее задание.

She had gone home.
Она ушла домой.

They had eaten dinner.
Они поужинали.

Здесь had используется для всех лиц одинаково:

I had
You had
He had
She had
It had
We had
They had

3. Что такое V3?

В Past Perfect используется третья форма глагола.

Например:

V1 | V2 | V3
go | went | gone
see | saw | seen
do | did | done
eat | ate | eaten
write | wrote | written
speak | spoke | spoken
come | came | come
buy | bought | bought
make | made | made
take | took | taken
finish | finished | finished
start | started | started
watch | watched | watched
play | played | played

Для правильных глаголов V2 и V3 совпадают:

finish — finished — finished
play — played — played
watch — watched — watched

Неправильные глаголы нужно запомнить:

go — went — gone
see — saw — seen
eat — ate — eaten

4. Когда используется Past Perfect?

1. Когда одно действие произошло раньше другого

When we arrived at the cinema, the film had started.
Когда мы пришли в кинотеатр, фильм уже начался.

Здесь:

Фильм уже начался.
Мы пришли позже.

When I came home, my mother had cooked dinner.
Когда я пришёл домой, мама уже приготовила ужин.

Ужин был приготовлен раньше.
Я пришёл позже.

When the teacher entered the classroom, the students had opened their books.
Когда учитель вошёл в класс, студенты уже открыли свои книги.

2. В значении “уже”

Past Perfect часто используется с already.

I had already finished my homework when my friend called me.
Когда мой друг позвонил, я уже закончил домашнее задание.

She had already left when we arrived.
Когда мы пришли, она уже ушла.

They had already eaten when I came.
Когда я пришёл, они уже поужинали.

3. Для объяснения причины

Past Perfect используется для указания причины состояния в прошлом.

He was tired because he had worked all day.
Он был уставшим, потому что работал весь день.

She was happy because she had passed the exam.
Она была счастлива, потому что сдала экзамен.

I was angry because they had forgotten my birthday.
Я был сердит, потому что они забыли мой день рождения.

4. В третьем условном предложении

В третьем условном предложении используется Past Perfect.

If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
Если бы я учился усерднее, я бы сдал экзамен.

If she had come earlier, she would have met him.
Если бы она пришла раньше, она бы встретила его.

5. Отрицательная форма Past Perfect

Структура

Subject + had not + V3

Сокращённая форма:

had not = hadn’t

Например:

I had not finished my homework.
Я не закончил домашнее задание.

I hadn’t finished my homework.
Я не закончил домашнее задание.

She hadn’t seen this film before.
Она не видела этот фильм раньше.

They hadn’t eaten before they came.
Они не поели до того, как пришли.

6. Вопросительная форма Past Perfect

Структура

Had + subject + V3?

Например:

Had you finished your homework?
Ты закончил домашнее задание?

Had she gone home?
Она ушла домой?

Had they eaten dinner?
Они поужинали?

Ответы:

Yes, I had.
Да.

No, I hadn’t.
Нет.

Yes, she had.
Да.

No, she hadn’t.
Нет.

7. Разница между Past Simple и Past Perfect

Past Simple

Простое действие в прошлом.

I finished my homework.
Я закончил домашнее задание.

Здесь указано только одно действие в прошлом.

Past Perfect

Действие, которое произошло раньше другого действия в прошлом.

I had finished my homework before my friend called me.
Я закончил домашнее задание до того, как мой друг позвонил мне.

Здесь 2 действия:

1. Я закончил домашнее задание.

2. Мой друг позвонил.

Первое действие в Past Perfect:
had finished

Второе действие в Past Simple:
called

8. Past Perfect с before и after

Before

Before — “до”

I had finished my homework before I went out.
Я закончил домашнее задание до того, как вышел на улицу.

She had cooked dinner before her husband came home.
Она приготовила ужин до того, как её муж пришёл домой.

After

After — “после”

After I had finished my homework, I went out.
После того, как я закончил домашнее задание, я вышел на улицу.

After she had cooked dinner, she watched TV.
После того, как она приготовила ужин, она смотрела телевизор.

9. Past Perfect с when

When — “когда”

When I arrived, they had left.
Когда я пришёл, они уже ушли.

Когда она пришла на станцию, поезд уже ушёл.
U vokzalga kelganida, poyezd ketib bo‘lgan edi.

Когда учитель задал вопрос, я уже написал ответ.
Ustoz savol berganida, men javobni allaqachon yozgan edim.

10. Уже, только, никогда, до

С Past Perfect часто используются следующие слова:

Уже — allaqachon

Я уже поел, когда он пришёл.
U kelganida, men allaqachon ovqatlanib bo‘lgan edim.

Только — endigina

Она только что ушла, когда я пришёл.
Men kelganimda, u endigina ketgan edi.

Никогда — hech qachon

Я никогда не видел такого красивого места раньше.
Men oldin hech qachon bunday chiroyli joyni ko‘rmagan edim.

До — oldin

Он встретил её раньше.
U uni oldin uchratgan edi.

Формулы Past Perfect

Тип предложения | Формула | Пример
Утверждение | Subject + had + V3 | I had finished.
Отрицание | Subject + had not + V3 | I had not finished.
Вопрос | Had + subject + V3? | Had you finished?
grammar_rules_kk:
Past Perfect degen ne?

Past Perfect ótken zamanda bir ishtin basqa bir ishdan aldın bolǵanın kórsetedi.

Yaǵnıy ikkita ótken zamondagi voqıa bolsa, ulardan birinshisi Past Perfectte beriledi.

Mısalı:

When I arrived, the lesson had started.
Men kelgenimde, sabaq álleqashan baslanǵan edi.

Bul gápte 2 is bar:

1. The lesson had started — sabaq baslanǵan edi.

2. I arrived — men keldim.

Sabaq avval baslanǵan, men keyin kelgenim.

Sonlıqtan:

The lesson had started — Past Perfect
I arrived — Past Simple

2. Past Perfect tuzilışı

Darak gáp

Subject + had + V3

Mısalı:

I had finished my homework.
Men uy vazifamni tugatǵan edim.

She had gone home.
U uyǵa ketǵan edi.

They had eaten dinner.
Ular kechki ovqatni yeb bolǵan edi.

Bul yerda had hamma shaxslar menen bir xil qollanıladı:

I had
You had
He had
She had
It had
We had
They had

3. V3 nima?

Past Perfectte feyilning 3-shaklı qollanıladı.

Mısalı:

V1 | V2 | V3
go | went | gone
see | saw | seen
do | did | done
eat | ate | eaten
write | wrote | written
speak | spoke | spoken
come | came | come
buy | bought | bought
make | made | made
take | took | taken
finish | finished | finished
start | started | started
watch | watched | watched
play | played | played

Regular verbs üşin V2 hám V3 bir xil boladı:

finish — finished — finished
play — played — played
watch — watched — watched

Irregular verbsni yodlaw kerek:

go — went — gone
see — saw — seen
eat — ate — eaten

4. Past Perfect qachon qollanıladı?

1. Bir ishtin basqa ishdan aldın bolǵanda

When we arrived at the cinema, the film had started.
Biz kinoteatrǵa kelgenimizde, film baslanǵan edi.

Bul yerda:

Film avval baslanǵan.
Biz keyin kelgenmiz.

When I came home, my mother had cooked dinner.
Men uyǵa kelgenimde, onam ovqat pishırıp bolǵan edi.

Ovqat avval pishirilǵan.
Men keyin uyǵa kelgenim.

When the teacher entered the classroom, the students had opened their books.
Ustoz sinfǵa kirǵanında, o‘quvshılar kitoblarını ochıp bolǵan edi.

2. “Álleqashan” ma’nosında

Past Perfect kóbinese already menen qollanıladı.

I had already finished my homework when my friend called me.
Do‘stim qo‘ng‘iroq qilǵanında, men uy vazifamni álleqashan tugatǵan edim.

She had already left when we arrived.
Biz kelgenimizde, u álleqashan ketǵan edi.

They had already eaten when I came.
Men kelgenimde, ular álleqashan ovqatlanıp bolǵan edi.

3. Sababnı túsindiriwde

Ótken zamandagi bir holatnıñ sababın kórsetiwde Past Perfect qollanıladı.

He was tired because he had worked all day.
U charchaǵan edi, chunki u kúnboyı jumıs isteǵan edi.

She was happy because she had passed the exam.
U xursand edi, chunki u imtihondan ótǵan edi.

I was angry because they had forgotten my birthday.
Men jahlim chiqqan edi, chunki olar tug‘ılǵan kúnimni unıtaǵan edi.

4. Third Conditionalda

Third Conditionalda Past Perfect qollanıladı.

If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
Agar qattiqroq óqıǵanımda, imtihondan ótǵan bolardım.

If she had come earlier, she would have met him.
Agar u ertaroq kelǵanında, u menen uchraşǵan bolardı.

5. Past Perfect inkor shaklı

Tuzılışı

Subject + had not + V3

Qısqartma shaklı:

had not = hadn’t

Mısalı:

I had not finished my homework.
Men uy vazifamni tugatmaǵan edim.

I hadn’t finished my homework.
Men uy vazifamni tugatmaǵan edim.

She hadn’t seen this film before.
U bu filmni oldın kórmaǵan edi.

They hadn’t eaten before they came.
Ular kelishidin oldın ovqatlanmaǵan edi.

6. Past Perfect so‘roq shaklı

Tuzılışı

Had + subject + V3?

Mısalı:

Had you finished your homework?
Sen uy vazifangni tugatǵan edingmi?

Had she gone home?
U uyǵa ketǵan edimi?

Had they eaten dinner?
Ular kechki ovqatni yegan edimi?

Javaplar:

Yes, I had.
Ha.

No, I hadn’t.
Yoq.

Yes, she had.
Ha.

No, she hadn’t.
Yoq.

7. Past Simple hám Past Perfect farqı

Past Simple

Ótken zamandagi ádette ishtin-háraket.

I finished my homework.
Men uy vazifamni tugatdım.

Bul yerda faqat bitta ótken ishtin aytilǵan.

Past Perfect

Ótken zamanda basqa bir ishtin aldın bolǵan ishtin.

I had finished my homework before my friend called me.
Do‘stim qo‘ng‘iroq qılışınan aldın men uy vazifamni tugatǵan edim.

Bul yerda 2 ta is bar:

1. Men uy vazifamni tugatdım.

2. Do‘stim qo‘ng‘iroq qıldı.

Birinshi is Past Perfectte:
had finished

Ikkinshi is Past Simplede:
called

8. Before hám after menen Past Perfect

Before

Before — “-dan aldın”

I had finished my homework before I went out.
Tashqarıǵa chiqıwımnan aldın uy vazifamni tugatǵan edim.

She had cooked dinner before her husband came home.
Eri uyǵa kelǵanında, u ovqat pishırıp bolǵan edi.

After

After — “-dan keyin”

After I had finished my homework, I went out.
Uy vazifamni tugatǵanımdan keyin tashqarıǵa chiqdim.

After she had cooked dinner, she watched TV.
U ovqat pishırıp bolǵandan keyin televizor kórdi.

9. When menen Past Perfect

When — “qachonki / -ǵanında”

When I arrived, they had left.
Men kelǵenimde, ular ketip bolǵan edi.

When she came to the station, the train had gone.
U vokzalga kelgeninde, poyezd ketip bolǵan edi.

When the teacher asked the question, I had already written the answer.
Ustoz savol bergende, men javobnı allaqachon yozǵan edim.

10. Already, just, never, before

Past Perfect bilen quyıdǵı so‘zlar kóp qollanıladı:

Already — allaqachon

I had already eaten when he came.
U kelgeninde, men allaqachon ovqatlanıp bolǵan edim.

Just — endigina

She had just left when I arrived.
Men kelgenimde, u endigina ketken edi.

Never — hech qachon

I had never seen such a beautiful place before.
Men oldın hech qachon bunday chiroyli joynı kórmegen edim.

Before — oldın

He had met her before.
U uni oldın uchratǵan edi.

Past Perfect formulaları

Gap türı | Formula | Mısal
Darak | Subject + had + V3 | I had finished.
Inkor | Subject + had not + V3 | I had not finished.
So‘roq | Had + subject + V3? | Had you finished?
reading_passage:
This week I learned about a university quiz competition. Our class used a realistic situation from a crowded lecture hall.

Four teams entered the final round after they had won smaller competitions in their departments. Before the event began, the organisers had tested every buzzer and checked all answer cards.

One team answered quickly because its members had already divided topics among themselves. The final question was difficult, but the winning team had studied that subject the previous week.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “By the time the quiz began, Amina had already reviewed the key terms.” The competition ended with a one-point difference between the top two teams.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Amina and Tom compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

listening_transcript:
Amina: Tom, I was thinking about our lesson on a university quiz competition.
Tom: Me too. We have to explain why one quiz team performed well, so the details matter.
Amina: I wrote down the first point. Tell me if this is right.
Tom: Nina says the team had reviewed science terms before the final.
Amina: What did you write for the next point?
Tom: Adam had prepared geography questions for the group.
Amina: I nearly missed another detail.
Tom: By the time the last round started, they had already agreed who would answer each topic.
Amina: Yes, and there is one more fact we should not forget.
Tom: They stayed calm because they had practised with the buzzer system.
Amina: Let’s check the grammar before we finish.
Tom: For example: By the time the quiz began, Amina had already reviewed the key terms.
Amina: Great. What happened in the end?
Tom: Their preparation helped them win the final question.

decide which sports group to join
