grammar_rules:
1. Future Perfect nima?

Future Perfect — kelajakda ma’lum bir vaqtgacha biror ish tugab bo‘lganini bildiruvchi zamon.

Eng asosiy ma’nosi:

Kelajakdagi bir vaqtgacha ish tugab bo‘ladi.

Masalan:

I will have finished my homework by 8 o’clock.
Men soat 8 gacha uy vazifamni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Bu gapda ish hozir emas, kelajakda tugaydi. Lekin u soat 8 dan oldin yoki soat 8 ga kelib tugagan bo‘ladi.

Oddiy tushuntirish

Agar siz kelajakdagi bir vaqtni tasavvur qilsangiz va o‘sha vaqtga kelib biror ish allaqachon tugagan bo‘lsa, Future Perfect ishlatiladi.

Masalan:

By tomorrow, I will have learned 20 new words.
Ertagacha men 20 ta yangi so‘zni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Bu degani:

Hozir hali 20 ta so‘zni o‘rganmagan bo‘lishingiz mumkin.
Lekin ertagacha ularni o‘rganib tugatgan bo‘lasiz.

Future Perfect qachon ishlatiladi?

Future Perfect quyidagi holatlarda ishlatiladi:

1. Kelajakdagi ma’lum vaqtgacha ish tugab bo‘lganda.

2. Kelajakda biror voqea boshlanishidan oldin boshqa ish tugaganda.

3. Reja, deadline, imtihon, loyiha, o‘qish, ish, ilmiy faoliyat haqida gapirganda.

4. “By...” ya’ni “...gacha” ma’nosi bilan ko‘p ishlatilganda.

Masalan:

By next month, we will have completed this project.
Kelasi oygacha biz bu loyihani tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘lamiz.

By the time the teacher arrives, the students will have opened their books.
Ustoz kelguniga qadar o‘quvchilar kitoblarini ochib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

2. Formula

A) Darak gap

Formula:

Subject + will have + V3

Bu yerda:

Subject — ega
will have — Future Perfect yordamchi qismi
V3 — fe’lning uchinchi shakli

Masalan:

I will have finished.
Men tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Darak gapga misollar

1. I will have finished my homework by 9 o’clock.
Men soat 9 gacha uy vazifamni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

2. She will have read the book by tomorrow.
U ertagacha kitobni o‘qib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. They will have completed the course by next month.
Ular kelasi oygacha kursni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

4. We will have learned this topic by the end of the lesson.
Biz dars oxirigacha bu mavzuni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘lamiz.

5. He will have written the essay by Friday.
U juma kunigacha inshoni yozib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

6. The students will have passed the exam by summer.
O‘quvchilar yozgacha imtihondan o‘tib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

7. The researchers will have collected enough data by 2030.
Tadqiqotchilar 2030-yilgacha yetarli ma’lumot to‘plab bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

B) Inkor gap

Formula:

Subject + will not have + V3

Qisqartma shakli:

will not = won’t

Demak:

Subject + won’t have + V3

Masalan:

I will not have finished.
Men tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘lmayman.

I won’t have finished.
Men tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘lmayman.

Inkor gapga misollar

1. I will not have finished the report by tomorrow.
Men ertagacha hisobotni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘lmayman.

2. She won’t have read the article by Monday.
U dushanbagacha maqolani o‘qib bo‘lgan bo‘lmaydi.

3. They will not have completed the project by next week.
Ular kelasi haftagacha loyihani tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘lmaydi.

4. We won’t have learned all the grammar rules by the end of today.
Biz bugun oxirigacha barcha grammatika qoidalarini o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘lmaymiz.

5. He will not have submitted his application by the deadline.
U muddatgacha arizasini topshirib bo‘lgan bo‘lmaydi.

6. The students won’t have prepared for the test by tomorrow morning.
O‘quvchilar ertaga ertalabgacha testga tayyorlanib bo‘lgan bo‘lmaydi.

7. The university will not have opened the new laboratory by September.
Universitet sentabrgacha yangi laboratoriyani ochib bo‘lgan bo‘lmaydi.

C) So‘roq gap

Formula:

Will + subject + have + V3?

Masalan:

Will you have finished?
Sen tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘lasanmi?

So‘roq gapga misollar

1. Will you have finished your homework by 8 o’clock?
Sen soat 8 gacha uy vazifangni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘lasanmi?

2. Will she have read the book by tomorrow?
U ertagacha kitobni o‘qib bo‘lgan bo‘ladimi?

3. Will they have completed the project by next week?
Ular kelasi haftagacha loyihani tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘ladimi?

4. Will we have learned this topic by the end of the lesson?
Biz dars oxirigacha bu mavzuni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘lamizmi?

5. Will he have written the essay by Friday?
U juma kunigacha inshoni yozib bo‘lgan bo‘ladimi?

6. Will the students have passed the exam by summer?
O‘quvchilar yozgacha imtihondan o‘tib bo‘lgan bo‘ladimi?

7. Will the researchers have finished the experiment by 2030?
Tadqiqotchilar 2030-yilgacha tajribani tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘ladimi?

3. Future Perfect ishlatiladigan asosiy vaqt ko‘rsatkichlari

Future Perfect ko‘pincha aniq vaqt chegarasi bilan ishlatiladi. Ya’ni “qachongacha?” degan savolga javob beradi.

1. By tomorrow

By tomorrow — ertagacha

Bu ibora ertangi kungacha ish tugab bo‘lishini bildiradi.

1. By tomorrow, I will have finished this book.
Ertagacha men bu kitobni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

2. By tomorrow, she will have learned all the new words.
Ertagacha u barcha yangi so‘zlarni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. By tomorrow, we will have prepared for the test.
Ertagacha biz testga tayyorlanib bo‘lgan bo‘lamiz.

2. By next week

By next week — kelasi haftagacha

Bu ibora kelasi haftaga kelib ish tugashini bildiradi.

1. By next week, they will have completed the project.
Kelasi haftagacha ular loyihani tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

2. By next week, I will have written my essay.
Kelasi haftagacha men inshomni yozib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

3. By next week, our class will have studied three new topics.
Kelasi haftagacha sinfimiz uchta yangi mavzuni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. By 2030

By 2030 — 2030-yilgacha

Bu uzoq kelajakdagi vaqt chegarasini bildiradi. Ko‘pincha rejalar, rivojlanish, ilm-fan, texnologiya va jamiyat haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

1. By 2030, many students will have learned to use artificial intelligence in education.
2030-yilgacha ko‘plab talabalar ta’limda sun’iy intellektdan foydalanishni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

2. By 2030, our university will have opened new research centers.
2030-yilgacha universitetimiz yangi tadqiqot markazlarini ochib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. By 2030, scientists will have developed more effective learning technologies.
2030-yilgacha olimlar yanada samarali ta’lim texnologiyalarini ishlab chiqqan bo‘ladi.

4. By the time

By the time — “...guniga qadar”, “...vaqtga kelib”

Bu ibora Future Perfect bilan juda ko‘p ishlatiladi.

Muhim qoida:

By the time + Present Simple, Future Perfect

Masalan:

By the time you arrive, I will have finished my work.
Sen kelguningcha men ishimni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Bu yerda “you arrive” kelajak ma’nosida bo‘lsa ham, Present Simple ishlatiladi. “Will arrive” emas.

Yana misollar:

1. By the time the lesson starts, the students will have opened their books.
Dars boshlanguniga qadar o‘quvchilar kitoblarini ochib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

2. By the time my parents come home, I will have cleaned my room.
Ota-onam uyga kelguniga qadar men xonamni tozalab bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

3. By the time we graduate, we will have learned many useful skills.
Biz bitirgunimizga qadar ko‘plab foydali ko‘nikmalarni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘lamiz.

5. Before

Before — “...dan oldin”

Future Perfectda before kelajakdagi bir voqeadan oldin boshqa ish tugashini bildiradi.

1. I will have finished the report before the meeting starts.
Majlis boshlanishidan oldin men hisobotni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

2. She will have prepared dinner before the guests arrive.
Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin u kechki ovqatni tayyorlab bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. They will have reviewed the topic before the exam begins.
Imtihon boshlanishidan oldin ular mavzuni takrorlab bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

E’tibor bering:

before the meeting starts — to‘g‘ri
before the meeting will start — noto‘g‘ri

6. In two years

In two years — ikki yildan keyin / ikki yil ichida

Future Perfectda bu ibora ikki yil o‘tgach, ish tugab bo‘lishini bildiradi.

1. In two years, I will have finished my master’s degree.
Ikki yildan keyin men magistraturani tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

2. In two years, she will have learned English well.
Ikki yildan keyin u ingliz tilini yaxshi o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. In two years, they will have built a new school.
Ikki yildan keyin ular yangi maktab qurib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

7. By then

By then — o‘sha vaqtgacha

Bu ibora oldin aytilgan kelajakdagi vaqtga ishora qiladi.

Masalan:

The exam is in June. By then, we will have revised all the topics.
Imtihon iyunda. O‘sha vaqtgacha biz barcha mavzularni takrorlab bo‘lgan bo‘lamiz.

Yana misollar:

1. The conference starts next month. By then, I will have prepared my presentation.
Konferensiya kelasi oy boshlanadi. O‘sha vaqtgacha men taqdimotimni tayyorlab bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

2. Our course ends in May. By then, students will have learned all basic grammar topics.
Kursimiz may oyida tugaydi. O‘sha vaqtgacha o‘quvchilar barcha asosiy grammatika mavzularini o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. The new semester begins in September. By then, the university will have updated the curriculum.
Yangi semestr sentabrda boshlanadi. O‘sha vaqtgacha universitet o‘quv dasturini yangilab bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

4. Future Perfect va boshqa zamonlar farqi

A) Future Simple bilan farqi

Zamon | Formula | Asosiy ma’no | Misol
Future Simple | Subject + will + V1 | Kelajakda ish bo‘ladi | I will finish my homework tomorrow. — Men ertaga uy vazifamni tugataman.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | Kelajakdagi vaqtgacha ish tugab bo‘ladi | I will have finished my homework by tomorrow. — Men ertagacha uy vazifamni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Farq:

Future Simple faqat kelajakdagi ishni aytadi.
Future Perfect esa ish kelajakdagi ma’lum vaqtgacha tugashini bildiradi.

Yana misollar:

She will read the book next week.
U kelasi hafta kitobni o‘qiydi.

She will have read the book by next week.
U kelasi haftagacha kitobni o‘qib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

B) Future Continuous bilan farqi

Zamon | Formula | Asosiy ma’no | Misol
Future Continuous | Subject + will be + V-ing | Kelajakdagi ma’lum vaqtda ish davom etayotgan bo‘ladi | At 8 o’clock, I will be studying. — Soat 8 da men o‘qiyotgan bo‘laman.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | Kelajakdagi ma’lum vaqtgacha ish tugab bo‘ladi | By 8 o’clock, I will have studied the topic. — Soat 8 gacha men mavzuni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Farq:

Future Continuous — ish davom etayotgan bo‘ladi.
Future Perfect — ish tugagan bo‘ladi.

Yana misollar:

At 10 o’clock, they will be writing the test.
Soat 10 da ular test yozayotgan bo‘ladi.

By 10 o’clock, they will have written the test.
Soat 10 gacha ular testni yozib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

C) Present Perfect bilan farqi

Zamon | Formula | Asosiy ma’no | Misol
Present Perfect | Subject + have/has + V3 | Hozirgacha tugagan ish | I have finished my homework. — Men uy vazifamni tugatdim.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | Kelajakdagi vaqtgacha tugab bo‘ladigan ish | I will have finished my homework by 8 o’clock. — Men soat 8 gacha uy vazifamni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Farq:

Present Perfect — hozirgacha natija bor.
Future Perfect — kelajakdagi vaqtgacha natija bo‘ladi.

Yana misollar:

They have completed the course.
Ular kursni tugatishdi.

They will have completed the course by next month.
Ular kelasi oygacha kursni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

5. O‘quvchi va talabalar ko‘p qiladigan xatolar

1-xato: Will have + V3 o‘rniga will + V1 ishlatish

Noto‘g‘ri:

By tomorrow, I will finish my homework.
Ertagacha men uy vazifamni tugataman.

Bu gap ba’zan tushunarli bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin Future Perfect ma’nosi kuchli chiqmaydi.

To‘g‘ri:

By tomorrow, I will have finished my homework.
Ertagacha men uy vazifamni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Sabab:

By tomorrow vaqt chegarasini bildiradi. Shuning uchun “tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman” ma’nosi kerak.

2-xato: By va until ni adashtirish

By — “...gacha ish tugab bo‘ladi”
Until — “...gacha davom etadi”

Noto‘g‘ri:

I will have waited for you by 5 o’clock.
Men soat 5 gacha seni kutib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Bu gap tabiiy emas, chunki “kutish” davom etadigan ish.

To‘g‘ri:

I will wait for you until 5 o’clock.
Men seni soat 5 gacha kutaman.

Yana bir to‘g‘ri misol:

I will have finished the work by 5 o’clock.
Men soat 5 gacha ishni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

3-xato: By the time bilan noto‘g‘ri zamon ishlatish

Noto‘g‘ri:

By the time you will arrive, I will have finished the work.
Sen kelgan bo‘ladigan vaqtda men ishni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

To‘g‘ri:

By the time you arrive, I will have finished the work.
Sen kelguningcha men ishni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Sabab:

By the timedan keyingi kelajak ma’nosidagi gapda odatda Present Simple ishlatiladi.

4-xato: V3 shaklini unutish

Noto‘g‘ri:

She will have write the essay by Friday.
U juma kunigacha inshoni yozib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

To‘g‘ri:

She will have written the essay by Friday.
U juma kunigacha inshoni yozib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

Sabab:

Future Perfectda will have + V3 ishlatiladi.

5-xato: Have o‘rniga has ishlatish

Noto‘g‘ri:

He will has finished the work by evening.
U kechgacha ishni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

To‘g‘ri:

He will have finished the work by evening.
U kechgacha ishni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

Sabab:

Willdan keyin har doim fe’lning oddiy shakli keladi. Shuning uchun will have, will has emas.

6. Qisqa grammatik qoida

Future Perfectni eslab qolish uchun 4 ta sodda qoida:

1. Future Perfect = kelajakdagi vaqtgacha ish tugab bo‘ladi.

2. Formula:
Subject + will have + V3

3. Future Perfect ko‘pincha by, by the time, before, by then bilan ishlatiladi.

4. By the time va beforedan keyin kelajak ma’nosi bo‘lsa ham, odatda Present Simple ishlatiladi:
By the time you arrive, I will have finished.
Sen kelguningcha men tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.
grammar_rules_en:
1. What is the Future Perfect?

The Future Perfect is a tense that shows an action will be finished by a certain time in the future.

Its main meaning:

By a certain time in the future, the action will be complete.

For example:

I will have finished my homework by 8 o’clock.
I will have finished my homework by 8 o’clock.

In this sentence the action doesn’t finish now but in the future. And it will be finished before or by 8 o’clock.

A simple explanation

If you imagine a certain time in the future and by that time an action has already been completed, the Future Perfect is used.

For example:

By tomorrow, I will have learned 20 new words.
By tomorrow, I will have learned 20 new words.

This means:

You may not have learned 20 words yet.
But by tomorrow, you will have finished learning them.

When is the Future Perfect used?

The Future Perfect is used in the following situations:

1. When an action will be completed by a certain time in the future.

2. When another action will be completed before an event starts in the future.

3. When talking about plans, deadlines, exams, projects, studies, work, or scientific activities.

4. When used frequently with 'By...' meaning 'until...'.

For example:

By next month, we will have completed this project.
By next month, we will have completed this project.

By the time the teacher arrives, the students will have opened their books.
By the time the teacher arrives, the students will have opened their books.

2. Formula

A) Affirmative sentence

Formula:

Subject + will have + V3

Here:

Subject
will have — auxiliary part of Future Perfect
V3 — third form of the verb

For example:

I will have finished.
I will have finished.

Examples of affirmative sentences

1. I will have finished my homework by 9 o’clock.
I will have finished my homework by 9 o’clock.

2. She will have read the book by tomorrow.
She will have read the book by tomorrow.

3. They will have completed the course by next month.
They will have completed the course by next month.

4. We will have learned this topic by the end of the lesson.
We will have learned this topic by the end of the lesson.

5. He will have written the essay by Friday.
He will have written the essay by Friday.

6. The students will have passed the exam by summer.
The students will have passed the exam by summer.

7. The researchers will have collected enough data by 2030.
The researchers will have collected enough data by 2030.

B) Negative sentence

Formula:

Subject + will not have + V3

Short form:

will not = won’t

So:

Subject + won’t have + V3

For example:

I will not have finished.
I will not have finished.

I won’t have finished.
I won’t have finished.

Examples of negative sentences

1. I will not have finished the report by tomorrow.
I will not have finished the report by tomorrow.

2. She won’t have read the article by Monday.
She won’t have read the article by Monday.

3. They will not have completed the project by next week.
They will not have completed the project by next week.

4. We won’t have learned all the grammar rules by the end of today.
We won’t have learned all the grammar rules by the end of today.

5. He will not have submitted his application by the deadline.
He will not have submitted his application by the deadline.

6. The students won’t have prepared for the test by tomorrow morning.
The students won’t have prepared for the test by tomorrow morning.

7. The university will not have opened the new laboratory by September.
The university will not have opened the new laboratory by September.

C) Interrogative sentence

Formula:

Will + subject + have + V3?

For example:

Will you have finished?
Will you have finished?

Examples of interrogative sentences

1. Will you have finished your homework by 8 o’clock?
Will you have finished your homework by 8 o’clock?

2. Will she have read the book by tomorrow?
Will she have read the book by tomorrow?

3. Will they have completed the project by next week?
Will they have completed the project by next week?

4. Will we have learned this topic by the end of the lesson?
Will we have learned this topic by the end of the lesson?

5. Will he have written the essay by Friday?
Will he have written the essay by Friday?

6. Will the students have passed the exam by summer?
Will the students have passed the exam by summer?

7. Will the researchers have finished the experiment by 2030?
Will the researchers have finished the experiment by 2030?

3. Main time indicators used with Future Perfect

The Future Perfect is often used with a specific time limit. That is, it answers the question 'by when?'.

1. By tomorrow

By tomorrow

This phrase indicates that the work will be completed by tomorrow.

1. By tomorrow, I will have finished this book.
By tomorrow, I will have finished this book.

2. By tomorrow, she will have learned all the new words.
By tomorrow, she will have learned all the new words.

3. By tomorrow, we will have prepared for the test.
By tomorrow, we will have finished preparing for the test.

2. By next week

By next week

This phrase indicates that the work will be completed by next week.

1. By next week, they will have completed the project.
By next week, they will have finished the project.

2. By next week, I will have written my essay.
By next week, I will have finished writing my essay.

3. By next week, our class will have studied three new topics.
By next week, our class will have finished studying three new topics.

3. By 2030

By 2030

This indicates a time limit in the distant future. It is often used when talking about plans, developments, science, technology, and society.

1. By 2030, many students will have learned to use artificial intelligence in education.
By 2030, many students will have learned to use artificial intelligence in education.

2. By 2030, our university will have opened new research centers.
By 2030, our university will have opened new research centers.

3. By 2030, scientists will have developed more effective learning technologies.
By 2030, scientists will have developed more effective learning technologies.

4. By the time

By the time — “by the time...”

This phrase is often used with the Future Perfect tense.

Important rule:

By the time + Present Simple, Future Perfect

For example:

By the time you arrive, I will have finished my work.
By the time you arrive, I will have finished my work.

Here, even though 'you arrive' has a future meaning, Present Simple is used. Not 'will arrive'.

More examples:

1. By the time the lesson starts, the students will have opened their books.
By the time the lesson starts, the students will have opened their books.

2. By the time my parents come home, I will have cleaned my room.
By the time my parents come home, I will have cleaned my room.

3. By the time we graduate, we will have learned many useful skills.
By the time we graduate, we will have learned many useful skills.

5. Before

Before — “before...”

In the Future Perfect, 'before' indicates that one action will be completed before another event in the future.

1. I will have finished the report before the meeting starts.
I will have finished the report before the meeting starts.

2. She will have prepared dinner before the guests arrive.
She will have prepared dinner before the guests arrive.

3. They will have reviewed the topic before the exam begins.
They will have reviewed the topic before the exam begins.

Note:

before the meeting starts — correct
before the meeting will start — incorrect

6. In two years

In two years — in two years / within two years

In the Future Perfect, this phrase indicates that the work will be completed after two years.

1. In two years, I will have finished my master’s degree.
In two years, I will have finished my master’s degree.

2. In two years, she will have learned English well.
In two years, she will have learned English well.

3. In two years, they will have built a new school.
In two years, they will have built a new school.

7. By then

By then — by that time

This phrase refers to a future time mentioned earlier.

For example:

The exam is in June. By then, we will have revised all the topics.
The exam is in June. By then, we will have revised all the topics.

More examples:

1. The conference starts next month. By then, I will have prepared my presentation.
The conference starts next month. By then, I will have prepared my presentation.

2. Our course ends in May. By then, students will have learned all basic grammar topics.
Our course ends in May. By then, students will have learned all basic grammar topics.

3. The new semester begins in September. By then, the university will have updated the curriculum.
The new semester begins in September. By then, the university will have updated the curriculum.

4. Difference between Future Perfect and other tenses

A) Difference with Future Simple

Tense | Formula | Main meaning | Example
Future Simple | Subject + will + V1 | An action will happen in the future | I will finish my homework tomorrow. — I will finish my homework tomorrow.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | An action will be completed by a certain time in the future | I will have finished my homework by tomorrow. — I will have finished my homework by tomorrow.

Difference:

Future Simple only states that an action will happen in the future.
Future Perfect indicates that the action will be completed by a certain time in the future.

More examples:

She will read the book next week.
She will read the book next week.

She will have read the book by next week.
She will have finished reading the book by next week.

B) Difference with Future Continuous

Time | Formula | Main meaning | Example
Future Continuous | Subject + will be + V-ing | An action will be continuing at a specific time in the future | At 8 o’clock, I will be studying.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | An action will be completed by a specific time in the future | By 8 o’clock, I will have studied the topic.

Difference:

Future Continuous — an action will be continuing.
Future Perfect — an action will be completed.

More examples:

At 10 o’clock, they will be writing the test.

By 10 o’clock, they will have written the test.

C) Difference with Present Perfect

Time | Formula | Main Meaning | Example
Present Perfect | Subject + have/has + V3 | An action that has finished up to now | I have finished my homework.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | An action that will be finished by a certain time in the future | I will have finished my homework by 8 o’clock.

Difference:

Present Perfect — there is a result up to now.
Future Perfect — there will be a result by a certain time in the future.

More examples:

They have completed the course.

They will have completed the course by next month.

5. Common mistakes made by students.

1. Mistake: Using will + V1 instead of will have + V3

Incorrect:

By tomorrow, I will finish my homework.
By tomorrow, I will finish my homework.

This sentence may sometimes be understandable, but the meaning of Future Perfect is not strong.

Correct:

By tomorrow, I will have finished my homework.
By tomorrow, I will have finished my homework.

Reason:

By tomorrow indicates a time limit. Therefore, the meaning of “I will have finished” is necessary.

2. Mistake: Confusing by and until

By — “the work will be finished by...”
Until — “it will continue until...”

Incorrect:

I will have waited for you by 5 o’clock.
I will have waited for you by 5 o’clock.

This sentence is not natural because “waiting” is an ongoing action.

Correct:

I will wait for you until 5 o’clock.
I will wait for you until 5 o’clock.

Another correct example:

I will have finished the work by 5 o’clock.

3rd mistake: Using the wrong tense with by the time

Incorrect:

By the time you will arrive, I will have finished the work.

Correct:

By the time you arrive, I will have finished the work.

Reason:

In sentences with a future meaning after by the time, Present Simple is usually used.

4th mistake: Forgetting the V3 form

Incorrect:

She will have write the essay by Friday.

Correct:

She will have written the essay by Friday.

Reason:

In Future Perfect, will have + V3 is used.

5th mistake: Using has instead of have

Incorrect:

He will has finished the work by evening.

Correct:

He will have finished the work by evening.

Reason:

After will, the base form of the verb always comes. Therefore, it is will have, not will has.

6. A short grammar rule

Four simple rules to remember Future Perfect:

1. Future Perfect = the work will be finished by a future time.

2. Formula:
Subject + will have + V3

3. Future Perfect is often used with by, by the time, before, by then.

4. Even though by the time and before have a future meaning, Present Simple is usually used after them:
By the time you arrive, I will have finished.
grammar_rules_ru:
1. Что такое Future Perfect?

Future Perfect — время, которое показывает, что действие будет завершено к определённому моменту в будущем.

Основное значение:

К определённому моменту в будущем действие будет закончено.

Например:

I will have finished my homework by 8 o’clock.
К 8 часам я уже закончу домашнее задание.

В этом предложении действие заканчивается не сейчас, а в будущем. Но оно будет завершено до 8 часов или к 8 часам.

Простое объяснение

Если вы представляете себе какой-то момент в будущем, и к этому моменту какое-то действие уже завершено, используется Future Perfect.

Например:

By tomorrow, I will have learned 20 new words.
К завтрашнему дню я уже выучу 20 новых слов.

Это значит:

Возможно, вы ещё не выучили 20 слов.
Но к завтрашнему дню вы их выучите.

Когда используется Future Perfect?

Future Perfect используется в следующих случаях:

1. Когда действие будет завершено к определённому моменту в будущем.

2. Когда одно действие завершится до начала другого события в будущем.

3. Когда речь идёт о планах, сроках, экзаменах, проектах, учёбе, работе, научной деятельности.

4. Когда часто используется выражение “By...” то есть “...к”.

Например:

By next month, we will have completed this project.
К следующему месяцу мы уже завершим этот проект.

By the time the teacher arrives, the students will have opened their books.
К моменту прихода учителя студенты уже откроют свои книги.

2. Формула

A) Утвердительное предложение

Формула:

Subject + will have + V3

Здесь:

Subject — подлежащее
will have — вспомогательная часть Future Perfect
V3 — третья форма глагола

Например:

I will have finished.
Я уже закончу.

Примеры утвердительных предложений

1. I will have finished my homework by 9 o’clock.
К 9 часам я уже закончу домашнее задание.

2. She will have read the book by tomorrow.
Она к завтрашнему дню уже прочитает книгу.

3. They will have completed the course by next month.
Они к следующему месяцу уже завершат курс.

4. We will have learned this topic by the end of the lesson.
Мы к концу урока уже изучим эту тему.

5. He will have written the essay by Friday.
Он к пятнице уже напишет эссе.

6. The students will have passed the exam by summer.
Студенты к лету уже сдадут экзамен.

7. The researchers will have collected enough data by 2030.
Исследователи к 2030 году уже соберут достаточно данных.

B) Отрицательное предложение

Формула:

Subject + will not have + V3

Сокращённая форма:

will not = won’t

Таким образом:

Subject + won’t have + V3

Например:

I will not have finished.
Я не закончу.

I won’t have finished.
Я не закончу.

Примеры отрицательных предложений

1. I will not have finished the report by tomorrow.
Я не закончу отчёт к завтрашнему дню.

2. She won’t have read the article by Monday.
Она не прочитает статью к понедельнику.

3. They will not have completed the project by next week.
Они не завершат проект к следующей неделе.

4. We won’t have learned all the grammar rules by the end of today.
Мы не изучим все грамматические правила к концу сегодняшнего дня.

5. He will not have submitted his application by the deadline.
Он не подаст своё заявление к сроку.

6. The students won’t have prepared for the test by tomorrow morning.
Студенты не подготовятся к тесту к завтрашнему утру.

7. The university will not have opened the new laboratory by September.
Университет не откроет новую лабораторию к сентябрю.

C) Вопросительное предложение

Формула:

Will + subject + have + V3?

Например:

Will you have finished?
Ты уже закончишь?

Примеры вопросительных предложений

1. Will you have finished your homework by 8 o’clock?
Ты уже закончишь домашнее задание к 8 часам?

2. Will she have read the book by tomorrow?
Она уже прочитает книгу к завтрашнему дню?

3. Will they have completed the project by next week?
Они уже завершат проект к следующей неделе?

4. Will we have learned this topic by the end of the lesson?
Мы уже изучим эту тему к концу урока?

5. Will he have written the essay by Friday?
Он уже напишет эссе к пятнице?

6. Will the students have passed the exam by summer?
Студенты уже сдадут экзамен к лету?

7. Will the researchers have finished the experiment by 2030?
Исследователи уже завершат эксперимент к 2030 году?

3. Основные временные указатели, когда используется Future Perfect

Future Perfect часто используется с чёткими временными рамками. То есть отвечает на вопрос “когда?”

1. By tomorrow

By tomorrow — к завтрашнему дню

Это выражение указывает на то, что действие будет завершено к завтрашнему дню.

1. By tomorrow, I will have finished this book.
К завтрашнему дню я уже закончу эту книгу.

2. By tomorrow, she will have learned all the new words.
К завтрашнему дню она уже выучит все новые слова.

3. К завтрашнему дню мы подготовимся к тесту.
Ertagacha biz testga tayyorlanib bo‘lgan bo‘lamiz.

2. К следующей неделе

By next week — kelasi haftagacha

Эта фраза указывает на завершение работы к следующей неделе.

1. К следующей неделе они завершат проект.
Kelasi haftagacha ular loyihani tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

2. К следующей неделе я напишу эссе.
Kelasi haftagacha men inshomni yozib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

3. К следующей неделе наш класс изучит три новых темы.
Kelasi haftagacha sinfimiz uchta yangi mavzuni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. К 2030 году

By 2030 — 2030-yilgacha

Эта фраза указывает на временной предел в далеком будущем. Обычно используется, когда речь идет о планах, развитии, науке, технологиях и обществе.

1. К 2030 году многие студенты научатся использовать искусственный интеллект в образовании.
2030-yilgacha ko‘plab talabalar ta’limda sun’iy intellektdan foydalanishni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

2. К 2030 году наш университет откроет новые исследовательские центры.
2030-yilgacha universitetimiz yangi tadqiqot markazlarini ochib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. К 2030 году ученые разработают более эффективные технологии обучения.
2030-yilgacha olimlar yanada samarali ta’lim texnologiyalarini ishlab chiqqan bo‘ladi.

4. К тому времени

By the time — “...guniga qadar”, “...vaqtga kelib”

Эта фраза часто используется с Future Perfect.

Важное правило:

By the time + Present Simple, Future Perfect

Например:

К тому времени, как ты приедешь, я закончу свою работу.
Sen kelguningcha men ishimni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Здесь “you arrive” используется в Present Simple, хотя и имеет будущее значение. Не “will arrive”.

Еще примеры:

1. К тому времени, как начнется урок, студенты откроют свои книги.
Dars boshlanguniga qadar o‘quvchilar kitoblarini ochib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

2. К тому времени, как мои родители придут домой, я уберу свою комнату.
Ota-onam uyga kelguniga qadar men xonamni tozalab bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

3. К тому времени, как мы выпустимся, мы изучим много полезных навыков.
Biz bitirgunimizga qadar ko‘plab foydali ko‘nikmalarni o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘lamiz.

5. До

Before — “...dan oldin”

В Future Perfect before указывает на завершение одного действия до другого события в будущем.

1. Я закончу отчет до начала собрания.
Majlis boshlanishidan oldin men hisobotni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

2. Она приготовит ужин до прихода гостей.
Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin u kechki ovqatni tayyorlab bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. Они повторят тему до начала экзамена.
Imtihon boshlanishidan oldin ular mavzuni takrorlab bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

Обратите внимание:

before the meeting starts — to‘g‘ri
before the meeting will start — noto‘g‘ri

6. Через два года

In two years — ikki yildan keyin / ikki yil ichida

В Future Perfect эта фраза указывает на завершение работы через два года.

1. Через два года я закончу свою магистратуру.
Ikki yildan keyin men magistraturani tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

2. Через два года она хорошо выучит английский.
Ikki yildan keyin u ingliz tilini yaxshi o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. Через два года они построят новую школу.
Ikki yildan keyin ular yangi maktab qurib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

7. К тому времени

By then — o‘sha vaqtgacha

Эта фраза указывает на ранее упомянутый временной предел в будущем.

Например:

Экзамен в июне. К тому времени мы повторим все темы.
Imtihon iyunda. O‘sha vaqtgacha biz barcha mavzularni takrorlab bo‘lgan bo‘lamiz.

Еще примеры:

1. Конференция начинается в следующем месяце. К тому времени я подготовлю свою презентацию.
Konferensiya kelasi oy boshlanadi. O‘sha vaqtgacha men taqdimotimni tayyorlab bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

2. Наш курс заканчивается в мае. К тому времени студенты изучат все основные грамматические темы.
Kursimiz may oyida tugaydi. O‘sha vaqtgacha o‘quvchilar barcha asosiy grammatika mavzularini o‘rganib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

3. Новый семестр начинается в сентябре. К тому времени университет обновит учебный план.
Yangi semestr sentabrda boshlanadi. O‘sha vaqtgacha universitet o‘quv dasturini yangilab bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

4. Разница между Future Perfect и другими временами

A) Разница с Future Simple

Время | Формула | Основное значение | Пример
Future Simple | Subject + will + V1 | Действие произойдет в будущем | I will finish my homework tomorrow. — Мен ertaga uy vazifamni tugataman.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | Действие завершится к определенному моменту в будущем | I will have finished my homework by tomorrow. — Мен ertagacha uy vazifamni tugatib bo‘lgan bo‘laman.

Разница:

Future Simple просто говорит о действии в будущем.
Future Perfect указывает на завершение действия к определенному времени в будущем.

Еще примеры:

She will read the book next week.
U kelasi hafta kitobni o‘qiydi.

She will have read the book by next week.
U kelasi haftagacha kitobni o‘qib bo‘lgan bo‘ladi.

B) Разница с Future Continuous

Время | Формула | Основное значение | Пример
Future Continuous | Subject + will be + V-ing | Действие будет продолжаться в определённый момент в будущем | At 8 o’clock, I will be studying. — В 8 часов я буду учиться.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | Действие будет завершено к определённому времени в будущем | By 8 o’clock, I will have studied the topic. — К 8 часам я закончу изучение темы.

Разница:

Future Continuous — действие будет продолжаться.
Future Perfect — действие будет завершено.

Еще примеры:

At 10 o’clock, they will be writing the test.
В 10 часов они будут писать тест.

By 10 o’clock, they will have written the test.
К 10 часам они закончат тест.

C) Разница с Present Perfect

Время | Формула | Основное значение | Пример
Present Perfect | Subject + have/has + V3 | Действие завершено на данный момент | I have finished my homework. — Я закончил домашнее задание.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | Действие будет завершено к будущему времени | I will have finished my homework by 8 o’clock. — К 8 часам я закончу домашнее задание.

Разница:

Present Perfect — результат на данный момент существует.
Future Perfect — результат будет в будущем.

Еще примеры:

They have completed the course.
Они завершили курс.

They will have completed the course by next month.
Они закончат курс к следующему месяцу.

5. Ошибки, которые часто делают студенты

1-я ошибка: Использование will + V1 вместо will have + V3

Неправильно:

By tomorrow, I will finish my homework.
К завтрашнему дню я закончу домашнее задание.

Это предложение может быть понятным, но смысл Future Perfect не будет сильным.

Правильно:

By tomorrow, I will have finished my homework.
К завтрашнему дню я закончу домашнее задание.

Причина:

By tomorrow указывает на временной предел. Поэтому необходимо использовать смысл “закончу”.

2-я ошибка: Путать by и until

By — “...к этому времени действие завершится”
Until — “...до этого времени действие будет продолжаться”

Неправильно:

I will have waited for you by 5 o’clock.
Я буду ждать тебя к 5 часам.

Это предложение неестественно, потому что “ждать” — это продолжающееся действие.

Правильно:

I will wait for you until 5 o’clock.
Я буду ждать тебя до 5 часов.

Еще один правильный пример:

I will have finished the work by 5 o’clock.
Я закончу работу к 5 часам.

3-я ошибка: Использование неправильного времени с by the time

Неправильно:

By the time you will arrive, I will have finished the work.
Когда ты приедешь, я закончу работу.

Правильно:

By the time you arrive, I will have finished the work.
Когда ты приедешь, я закончу работу.

Причина:

После by the time в предложениях с будущим значением обычно используется Present Simple.

4-я ошибка: Забыть форму V3

Неправильно:

She will have write the essay by Friday.
Она напишет эссе к пятнице.

Правильно:

She will have written the essay by Friday.
Она напишет эссе к пятнице.

Причина:

В Future Perfect используется will have + V3.

5-я ошибка: Использование has вместо have

Неправильно:

He will has finished the work by evening.
Он закончит работу к вечеру.

Правильно:

He will have finished the work by evening.
Он закончит работу к вечеру.

Причина:

После will всегда используется простая форма глагола. Поэтому будет will have, а не will has.

6. Краткое грамматическое правило

Чтобы запомнить Future Perfect, 4 простых правила:

1. Future Perfect = действие будет завершено к будущему времени.

2. Формула:
Subject + will have + V3

3. Future Perfect часто используется с by, by the time, before, by then.

4. После by the time и before, даже если есть будущее значение, обычно используется Present Simple:
By the time you arrive, I will have finished.
Когда ты приедешь, я закончу.
grammar_rules_kk:
1. Future Perfect degen ne?

Future Perfect — kelajakda ma’lum bir vaqtgacha biror ish tugap bolǵanın bildiretuǵın zamon.

Eń tiykarǵı mánisi:

Keljektegi bir waqıtqa shekem is tugap boladı.

Mısalı:

I will have finished my homework by 8 o’clock.
Men saat 8 ge shekem úy tapsırmamdı pitkerip bolǵan bolaman.

Bul gápte is házir emes, keljekte tugaydı. Biraq ol saat 8 den aldın yamasa saat 8 ge kelip tugap bolǵan boladı.

Ápiwayı túsindiriw

Agar siz keljektegi bir waqıt kóz aldıńızǵa keltiriń hám o‘sha waqıtqa kelip biror is allaqachon tugap bolǵan bolǵanda, Future Perfect qollanıladı.

Mısalı:

By tomorrow, I will have learned 20 new words.
Ertagacha men 20 ta jańa so‘zni o‘rganıp bolǵan bolaman.

Bul degani:

Hozir hali 20 ta so‘zni o‘rganmagan bolıwıñız mumkin.
Biraq ertagacha ularni o‘rganıp tugatqan bolıwıñız kerek.

Future Perfect qachon ishlatiladi?

Future Perfect quyidagi holatlarda ishlatiladi:

1. Keljektegi ma’lum waqıtqa shekem is tugap bolǵanda.

2. Keljekte biror voqea bastalınǵan aldın başka is tugap bolǵanda.

3. Reja, deadline, imtihon, loyiha, o‘qıw, jumıs, ilmiy faoliyat hakkında gápirganda.

4. “By...” ya’ni “...gacha” mánisi menen kóp ishlatilǵanda.

Mısalı:

By next month, we will have completed this project.
Kelasi oygacha biz bu loyihani tugatıp bolǵan bolamız.

By the time the teacher arrives, the students will have opened their books.
Ustoz kelgunıǵa qadar o‘quwshılar kitoblarını ochıp bolǵan boladı.

2. Formula

A) Darak gáp

Formula:

Subject + will have + V3

Bu yerda:

Subject — ega
will have — Future Perfect yordamçı qismi
V3 — feyilning úshınshı şekli

Mısalı:

I will have finished.
Men tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.

Darak gápke mısallar

1. I will have finished my homework by 9 o’clock.
Men saat 9 gacha úy tapsırmamdı tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.

2. She will have read the book by tomorrow.
U ertagacha kitobnı o‘qıp bolǵan boladı.

3. They will have completed the course by next month.
Ular kelasi oygacha kursnı tugatıp bolǵan boladı.

4. We will have learned this topic by the end of the lesson.
Biz dars oxırigacha bu mavzuni o‘rganıp bolǵan bolamız.

5. He will have written the essay by Friday.
U juma kunigacha inshoni yozıp bolǵan boladı.

6. The students will have passed the exam by summer.
O‘quwshılar yozgacha imtihondan o‘tıp bolǵan boladı.

7. The researchers will have collected enough data by 2030.
Tadqiqotchılar 2030-yilgacha yetarli ma’lumot to‘plap bolǵan boladı.

B) Inkor gáp

Formula:

Subject + will not have + V3

Qisqartma şekli:

will not = won’t

Demak:

Subject + won’t have + V3

Mısalı:

I will not have finished.
Men tugatıp bolǵan bolmayman.

I won’t have finished.
Men tugatıp bolǵan bolmayman.

Inkor gápke mısallar

1. I will not have finished the report by tomorrow.
Men ertagacha hisobotnı tugatıp bolǵan bolmayman.

2. She won’t have read the article by Monday.
U dushanbagacha maqolanı o‘qıp bolǵan bolmaydı.

3. They will not have completed the project by next week.
Ular kelasi haftagacha loyihanı tugatıp bolǵan bolmaydı.

4. We won’t have learned all the grammar rules by the end of today.
Biz búgin oxırigacha barlıq grammatika qaǵıdaların o‘rganıp bolǵan bolmaymiz.

5. He will not have submitted his application by the deadline.
U muddatgacha arizasını topshirıp bolǵan bolmaydı.

6. The students won’t have prepared for the test by tomorrow morning.
O‘quwshılar ertaga ertalabgacha testke tayyorlanıp bolǵan bolmaydı.

7. The university will not have opened the new laboratory by September.
Universitet sentabrgacha jańa laboratoriyanı ochıp bolǵan bolmaydı.

C) So‘roq gáp

Formula:

Will + subject + have + V3?

Mısalı:

Will you have finished?
Sen tugatıp bolǵan bolıwıñ mı?

So‘roq gápke mısallar

1. Will you have finished your homework by 8 o’clock?
Sen saat 8 gacha úy vazifañı tugatıp bolǵan bolıwıñ mı?

2. Will she have read the book by tomorrow?
U ertagacha kitobnı o‘qıp bolǵan bolıwı mı?

3. Will they have completed the project by next week?
Ular kelasi haftagacha loyihanı tugatıp bolǵan bolıwı mı?

4. Will we have learned this topic by the end of the lesson?
Biz dars oxırigacha bu mavzuni o‘rganıp bolǵan bolıwı mı?

5. Will he have written the essay by Friday?
U juma kunigacha inshoni yozıp bolǵan bolıwı mı?

6. Will the students have passed the exam by summer?
O‘quwshılar yozgacha imtihondan o‘tıp bolǵan bolıwı mı?

7. Will the researchers have finished the experiment by 2030?
Tadqiqotchılar 2030-yilgacha tajribani tugatıp bolǵan bolıwı mı?

3. Future Perfect ishlatilǵan asası waqıt kórsatqıshları

Future Perfect kóbinese anıq waqıt şeǵeresi menen ishlitiladi. Yaǵnıy “qachongacha?” deǵan sorawga juwap beredi.

1. By tomorrow

By tomorrow — ertagacha

Bu ibora ertangi kungacha is tugap bolǵan boladı.

1. By tomorrow, I will have finished this book.
Ertagacha men bu kitapnı tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.

2. By tomorrow, she will have learned all the new words.
Ertagacha u barlıq jańa so‘zlarni o‘rganıp bolǵan boladı.

3. Erteńge qadar biz testke tayyorlanıp bolǵan bolamız.
By tomorrow, we will have prepared for the test.

2. Kelasi haftagacha

By next week — kelasi haftagacha

Bul ibora kelasi haftaga kelip is tugap bolǵanın bildiradı.

1. Kelasi haftagacha ular loyihani tugatıp bolǵan boladı.
By next week, they will have completed the project.

2. Kelasi haftagacha men inshomni yozıp bolǵan bolaman.
By next week, I will have written my essay.

3. Kelasi haftagacha sinfimiz uchta jańa mavzuni óyranıp bolǵan boladı.
By next week, our class will have studied three new topics.

3. 2030-yilgacha

By 2030 — 2030-yilgacha

Bul uzoq kelǵektegi waqıt şeǵerlesin bildiradı. Kóbinese rejeler, rivojlanıw, ilm-fan, texnologiya hám jamiyat toǵrısında gápırǵanda qollanıladı.

1. 2030-yilgacha kóp talabalar ta’limde sun’iy intellektı qollanıp óyranıp bolǵan boladı.
By 2030, many students will have learned to use artificial intelligence in education.

2. 2030-yilgacha universitetimiz jańa tadqiqat markazların açıp bolǵan boladı.
By 2030, our university will have opened new research centers.

3. 2030-yilgacha olimlar yanada samaralı ta’lim texnologiyaların islep şıqqan boladı.
By 2030, scientists will have developed more effective learning technologies.

4. ...gunıǵa qadar

By the time — “...gunıǵa qadar”, “...waqtqa kelip”

Bul ibora Future Perfectpen juda kóp qollanıladı.

Múhim qaǵıda:

By the time + Present Simple, Future Perfect

Mısalı:

Sen kelgıńde men ishimni tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.
By the time you arrive, I will have finished my work.

Bul yerde “you arrive” kelǵektegi ma’nosında bolǵanına qaramastan, Present Simple qollanıladı. “Will arrive” emes.

Yana mısallar:

1. Dars bastalǵanda oquwshılar kitobların açıp bolǵan boladı.
By the time the lesson starts, the students will have opened their books.

2. Ota-onam uyga kelgıńde men xonamni tozalap bolǵan bolaman.
By the time my parents come home, I will have cleaned my room.

3. Biz bitirǵende kóp foydali kónikmaların óyranıp bolǵan bolamız.
By the time we graduate, we will have learned many useful skills.

5. ...dan oldın

Before — “...dan oldın”

Future Perfectda before kelǵektegi bir voqeadan oldın basqa iş tugap bolǵanın bildiradı.

1. Majlis bastalǵanda men hisabotnı tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.
I will have finished the report before the meeting starts.

2. Mehmonlar kelgıńde u kechki ovqatnı tayyorlap bolǵan boladı.
She will have prepared dinner before the guests arrive.

3. Imtihon bastalǵanda ular mavzunı takrorlap bolǵan boladı.
They will have reviewed the topic before the exam begins.

E’tibor bering:

before the meeting starts — toǵrı
before the meeting will start — notoǵrı

6. Ikki yıldan keyin

In two years — ikki yıldan keyin / ikki yıl içinde

Future Perfectda bul ibora ikki yıl ötgende iş tugap bolǵanın bildiradı.

1. Ikki yıldan keyin men magistraturanı tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.
In two years, I will have finished my master’s degree.

2. Ikki yıldan keyin u ingliz tilin jaqsı óyranıp bolǵan boladı.
In two years, she will have learned English well.

3. Ikki yıldan keyin ular jańa mektep qurıp bolǵan boladı.
In two years, they will have built a new school.

7. O‘sha waqtgacha

By then — o‘sha vaqtgacha

Bul ibora oldın aytılǵan kelǵektegi waqıtqa isharalaydı.

Mısalı:

Imtihon iyunda. O‘sha waqtgacha biz barlıq mavzularnı takrorlap bolǵan bolamız.
The exam is in June. By then, we will have revised all the topics.

Yana mısallar:

1. Konferensiya kelasi oy bastaladı. O‘sha waqtgacha men taqdimotımnı tayyorlap bolǵan bolaman.
The conference starts next month. By then, I will have prepared my presentation.

2. Kursımız may oyında tugaydı. O‘sha waqtgacha oquwshılar barlıq asası grammatika mavzuların óyranıp bolǵan boladı.
Our course ends in May. By then, students will have learned all basic grammar topics.

3. Jańa semestr sentabrda bastaladı. O‘sha waqtgacha universitet oquw dasturını jańılap bolǵan boladı.
The new semester begins in September. By then, the university will have updated the curriculum.

4. Future Perfect hám basqa zamandar farqı

A) Future Simple bilan farqı

Zaman | Formula | Asosı ma’nı | Mısal
Future Simple | Subject + will + V1 | Kelǵekte iş boladı | I will finish my homework tomorrow. — Men ertenge uy vazifamnı tugataman.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | Kelǵektegi waqıtqa iş tugap boladı | I will have finished my homework by tomorrow. — Men ertagacha uy vazifamnı tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.

Farq:

Future Simple faqat kelǵektegi işni aytadı.
Future Perfect esa iş kelǵektegi má’lum waqıtqa tugap bolǵanın bildiradı.

Yana mısallar:

U kelasi hafta kitobnı o‘qıydu.
She will read the book next week.

U kelasi haftagacha kitobnı o‘qıp bolǵan boladı.
She will have read the book by next week.

B) Future Continuous bilan farqı

Zamon | Formula | Asosiy ma’no | Misol
Future Continuous | Subject + will be + V-ing | Keljektegi málum waqıtta is dawam etip jatqan boladı | At 8 o’clock, I will be studying. — Soat 8 de men oqıw játıp jatqan bolaman.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | Keljektegi málum waqıttan alda is tugap boladı | By 8 o’clock, I will have studied the topic. — Soat 8 ge jete men mavzuni oqıp bolǵan bolaman.

Farq:

Future Continuous — is dawam etip jatqan boladı.
Future Perfect — is tugap boladı.

Yana misollar:

At 10 o’clock, they will be writing the test.
Soat 10 da olar test jazıp jatqan boladı.

By 10 o’clock, they will have written the test.
Soat 10 ge jete olar testni jazıp bolǵan boladı.

C) Present Perfect bilan farqi

Zamon | Formula | Asosiy ma’no | Misol
Present Perfect | Subject + have/has + V3 | Hozırǵa alǵan is | I have finished my homework. — Men uy vazifamni tugatıp boldım.
Future Perfect | Subject + will have + V3 | Keljektegi waqıtta tugap bolǵan is | I will have finished my homework by 8 o’clock. — Men soat 8 ge jete uy vazifamni tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.

Farq:

Present Perfect — hozırǵa natija bar.
Future Perfect — keljektegi waqıtta natija boladı.

Yana misollar:

They have completed the course.
Olar kursni tugatıp boldı.

They will have completed the course by next month.
Olar kelasi ayǵa kursni tugatıp bolǵan boladı.

5. O‘quvchi va talabalar ko‘p qiladigan xatolar

1-xato: Will have + V3 orınına will + V1 qollanw

Noto‘g‘ri:

By tomorrow, I will finish my homework.
Ertáǵa men uy vazifamni tugatamın.

Bu gáp baǵzan túsinarlı bolwı mümkin, biraq Future Perfect ma’nısı küşli şıqqan bolmaydı.

To‘g‘ri:

By tomorrow, I will have finished my homework.
Ertáǵa men uy vazifamni tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.

Sabab:

By tomorrow waqıt şeğerisin bildirip turadı. Sonlıqtan “tugatıp bolǵan bolaman” ma’nısı kerek.

2-xato: By hám until ni adashtırw

By — “...geçä is tugap boladı”
Until — “...geçä dawam etip jatadı”

Noto‘g‘ri:

I will have waited for you by 5 o’clock.
Men soat 5 ge jete seni kutıp bolǵan bolaman.

Bu gáp tabiǵi emes, çünki “kutw” dawam etip jatqan is.

To‘g‘ri:

I will wait for you until 5 o’clock.
Men seni soat 5 ge jete kutamın.

Yana bir to‘g‘ri mısal:

I will have finished the work by 5 o’clock.
Men soat 5 ge jete isni tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.

3-xato: By the time bilan noto‘g‘ri zamon qollanw

Noto‘g‘ri:

By the time you will arrive, I will have finished the work.
Sen kelgen bolǵanda men isni tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.

To‘g‘ri:

By the time you arrive, I will have finished the work.
Sen kelgénşe men isni tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.

Sabab:

By the time dan keyin keljek ma’nısında gápta odatda Present Simple qollanıladı.

4-xato: V3 şekilini unıtıw

Noto‘g‘ri:

She will have write the essay by Friday.
U juma künigáçá inshoni jazıp bolǵan boladı.

To‘g‘ri:

She will have written the essay by Friday.
U juma künigáçá inshoni jazıp bolǵan boladı.

Sabab:

Future Perfect da will have + V3 qollanıladı.

5-xato: Have orınına has qollanw

Noto‘g‘ri:

He will has finished the work by evening.
U kechke isni tugatıp bolǵan boladı.

To‘g‘ri:

He will have finished the work by evening.
U kechke isni tugatıp bolǵan boladı.

Sabab:

Will dan keyin her dawam fe’lniń oddı şekli kelip turadı. Sonlıqtan will have, will has emes.

6. Qısqa grammatik qaǵıyda

Future Perfect ni eslap qolıw ushın 4 ta sodda qaǵıyda:

1. Future Perfect = keljektegi waqıtta is tugap boladı.

2. Formula:
Subject + will have + V3

3. Future Perfect kóbinese by, by the time, before, by then bilan qollanıladı.

4. By the time hám before dan keyin keljek ma’nısı bolǵanda, odatda Present Simple qollanıladı:
By the time you arrive, I will have finished.
Sen kelgénşe men tugatıp bolǵan bolaman.
reading_passage:
In a short student interview, Eva explains what the class learned about goals students hope to complete before graduation in a career-planning workshop.

Students create a list of academic, professional and personal goals. By graduation Maya will have completed an internship, built an online portfolio and passed an advanced English exam.

Daniel will have taken part in at least two team projects and presented one of them publicly. The adviser asks students to choose goals that can be measured rather than vague wishes.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “By graduation, Eva will have completed five major projects.” Each student leaves with a list that includes clear deadlines.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Eva and Noah compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

title: Software engineer
topic: what motivates a software engineer
task_meta: Speaking: what is it like to be a software engineer?
grammar_rules:
1. Gerund nima?

Gerund — fe’lning V-ing shakli bo‘lib, gapda ko‘pincha ot vazifasida ishlatiladi.

Ya’ni shaklan fe’lga o‘xshaydi, lekin gapda “nima?” degan savolga javob beradi.

Masalan:

Reading is useful.
Kitob o‘qish foydali.

Bu gapda reading “o‘qish” degan ma’noda kelgan. U harakatni bildiradi, lekin gapda ega vazifasida turibdi.

Gerund shakli

Gerund quyidagicha yasaladi:

Verb + ing

Verb | Gerund
read | reading
write | writing
swim | swimming
study | studying
learn | learning
play | playing
speak | speaking

Gerund fe’lga o‘xshaydi, lekin ot vazifasida ishlaydi

I like reading.
Men o‘qishni yoqtiraman.

Bu yerda reading “o‘qish” degan otga o‘xshaydi.

O‘zbekchaga ko‘pincha quyidagicha tarjima qilinadi:

reading — o‘qish
writing — yozish
swimming — suzish
learning — o‘rganish
teaching — o‘qitish
travelling — sayohat qilish

Gerundga 10 ta misol

1. Reading books improves your vocabulary.
Kitob o‘qish so‘z boyligingizni oshiradi.

2. Swimming is good for health.
Suzish sog‘liq uchun foydali.

3. Learning English takes time.
Ingliz tilini o‘rganish vaqt talab qiladi.

4. Teaching children requires patience.
Bolalarga dars berish sabr talab qiladi.

5. Writing essays helps students think clearly.
Insho yozish talabalarga aniq fikrlashga yordam beradi.

6. Watching too many videos can waste time.
Juda ko‘p video ko‘rish vaqtni bekor ketkazishi mumkin.

7. Doing homework regularly improves results.
Uy vazifasini muntazam bajarish natijalarni yaxshilaydi.

8. Speaking English every day builds confidence.
Har kuni inglizcha gapirish ishonchni oshiradi.

9. Studying grammar is important for exams.
Grammatikani o‘rganish imtihonlar uchun muhim.

10. Helping others makes people kinder.
Boshqalarga yordam berish insonlarni mehribonroq qiladi.

2. Infinitive nima?

Infinitive — fe’lning asosiy shakli. Ingliz tilida infinitive ikki xil bo‘ladi:

1. To-infinitive

2. Bare infinitive

1. To-infinitive

To-infinitive quyidagicha yasaladi:

to + V1

Masalan:

to read — o‘qimoq
to write — yozmoq
to learn — o‘rganmoq
to speak — gapirmoq
to help — yordam bermoq

Misol:

I want to learn English.
Men ingliz tilini o‘rganmoqchiman.

Bu yerda to learn — infinitive.

2. Bare infinitive

Bare infinitive — tosiz keladigan fe’lning oddiy shakli.

Masalan:

go
read
write
study
help

Bare infinitive odatda modal fe’llardan keyin ishlatiladi:

I can swim.
Men suza olaman.

Bu yerda swim — bare infinitive. Chunki candan keyin to swim emas, swim keladi.

Infinitivega 10 ta misol

1. I want to study abroad.
Men chet elda o‘qimoqchiman.

2. She hopes to pass the exam.
U imtihondan o‘tishni umid qiladi.

3. They decided to start a new course.
Ular yangi kurs boshlashga qaror qilishdi.

4. We plan to visit Samarkand next month.
Biz kelasi oy Samarqandga borishni rejalashtiryapmiz.

5. He promised to help me.
U menga yordam berishga va’da berdi.

6. This topic is easy to understand.
Bu mavzuni tushunish oson.

7. I went to the library to read.
Men o‘qish uchun kutubxonaga bordim.

8. She learned to drive last year.
U o‘tgan yili mashina haydashni o‘rgandi.

9. Students need to practise every day.
O‘quvchilar har kuni mashq qilishlari kerak.

10. I don’t know what to do.
Men nima qilishni bilmayman.

3. Gerund ishlatiladigan asosiy holatlar

3.1. Gerund gapning egasi sifatida

Agar ish-harakat gapning boshida kelib, “nima?” degan savolga javob bersa, gerund ishlatiladi.

Formula:

V-ing + verb + ...

Misollar:

1. Swimming is useful.
Suzish foydali.

2. Reading helps students learn new words.
O‘qish o‘quvchilarga yangi so‘zlarni o‘rganishga yordam beradi.

3. Studying at night is difficult for some students.
Kechasi o‘qish ba’zi talabalar uchun qiyin.

4. Learning grammar improves writing.
Grammatikani o‘rganish yozuvni yaxshilaydi.

5. Speaking in public builds confidence.
Omma oldida gapirish ishonchni oshiradi.

3.2. Ayrim fe’llardan keyin gerund ishlatiladi

Ba’zi fe’llardan keyin har doim V-ing keladi.

Masalan:

enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, mind, keep, consider, admit, deny

Misollar:

1. I enjoy reading English books.
Men inglizcha kitob o‘qishni yoqtiraman.

2. She avoids eating fast food.
U fast food yeyishdan qochadi.

3. They finished writing the test.
Ular test yozishni tugatishdi.

4. The teacher suggested revising the topic.
Ustoz mavzuni takrorlashni taklif qildi.

5. Do you mind opening the window?
Derazani ochsangiz qarshi emasmisiz?

6. He keeps making the same mistake.
U bir xil xatoni takrorlayveradi.

7. We are considering moving to another city.
Biz boshqa shaharga ko‘chishni o‘ylayapmiz.

8. She admitted breaking the glass.
U stakanni sindirganini tan oldi.

9. He denied taking the money.
U pulni olganini inkor qildi.

3.3. Predloglardan keyin gerund ishlatiladi

Ingliz tilida predlogdan keyin fe’l kelsa, odatda V-ing shaklida keladi.

Ko‘p uchraydigan predlogli birikmalar:

interested in — qiziqmoq
good at — yaxshi uddalamoq
afraid of — qo‘rqmoq
before — oldin
after — keyin
without — -masdan
instead of — o‘rniga
about — haqida
for — uchun
of — -dan

Misollar:

1. She is interested in learning English.
U ingliz tilini o‘rganishga qiziqadi.

2. He is good at solving problems.
U masalalar yechishda yaxshi.

3. I am afraid of making mistakes.
Men xato qilishdan qo‘rqaman.

4. Before going to bed, I read a book.
Uxlashdan oldin men kitob o‘qiyman.

5. After finishing the lesson, we discussed the test.
Darsni tugatgandan keyin biz testni muhokama qildik.

6. She left without saying goodbye.
U xayrlashmasdan ketdi.

7. Instead of watching TV, he studied English.
Televizor ko‘rish o‘rniga u ingliz tili o‘qidi.

8. We talked about studying abroad.
Biz chet elda o‘qish haqida gaplashdik.

9. Thank you for helping me.
Menga yordam berganingiz uchun rahmat.

10. He is tired of waiting.
U kutishdan charchagan.

3.4. Maxsus birikmalardan keyin gerund ishlatiladi

Ba’zi maxsus iboralardan keyin ham V-ing ishlatiladi.

It’s no use + V-ing

Ma’nosi: foydasi yo‘q.

It’s no use crying.
Yig‘lashdan foyda yo‘q.

It’s no use arguing with him.
U bilan tortishishdan foyda yo‘q.

It’s worth + V-ing

Ma’nosi: arziydi.

This book is worth reading.
Bu kitob o‘qishga arziydi.

This film is worth watching.
Bu film ko‘rishga arziydi.

Can’t help + V-ing

Ma’nosi: o‘zini tiyolmaslik.

I can’t help laughing.
Men kulmasdan turolmayman.

She couldn’t help crying.
U yig‘lamasdan turolmadi.

Look forward to + V-ing

Ma’nosi: intizorlik bilan kutmoq.

I look forward to meeting you.
Siz bilan uchrashishni intizorlik bilan kutyapman.

We are looking forward to seeing the results.
Biz natijalarni ko‘rishni intizorlik bilan kutyapmiz.

E’tibor bering: bu yerda to predlog, shuning uchun undan keyin V-ing keladi.

Be used to + V-ing

Ma’nosi: ko‘nikkan bo‘lmoq.

I am used to waking up early.
Men erta uyg‘onishga ko‘nikkanman.

She is used to studying at night.
U kechasi o‘qishga ko‘nikkan.

Get used to + V-ing

Ma’nosi: ko‘nikib bormoq.

I am getting used to living in a new city.
Men yangi shaharda yashashga ko‘nikib boryapman.

Students got used to using online platforms.
Talabalar onlayn platformalardan foydalanishga ko‘nikishdi.

4. Infinitive ishlatiladigan asosiy holatlar

4.1. Maqsad bildirish uchun

Infinitive ko‘pincha “nima uchun?” degan savolga javob beradi.

Formula:

to + V1

Misollar:

1. I went to the library to study.
Men o‘qish uchun kutubxonaga bordim.

2. She called me to ask a question.
U savol so‘rash uchun menga qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.

3. They came here to meet the teacher.
Ular ustoz bilan uchrashish uchun bu yerga kelishdi.

4. We use dictionaries to learn new words.
Biz yangi so‘zlarni o‘rganish uchun lug‘atlardan foydalanamiz.

5. He works hard to support his family.
U oilasini qo‘llab-quvvatlash uchun qattiq ishlaydi.

4.2. Ayrim fe’llardan keyin infinitive ishlatiladi

Ba’zi fe’llardan keyin odatda to + V1 keladi.

Masalan:

want, hope, decide, agree, promise, plan, refuse, offer, manage, learn

Misollar:

1. I want to improve my English.
Men ingliz tilimni yaxshilamoqchiman.

2. She hopes to enter university.
U universitetga kirishni umid qiladi.

3. They decided to take the exam.
Ular imtihon topshirishga qaror qilishdi.

4. He agreed to help us.
U bizga yordam berishga rozi bo‘ldi.

5. I promise to call you tomorrow.
Men ertaga sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilishga va’da beraman.

6. We plan to start a new project.
Biz yangi loyiha boshlashni rejalashtiryapmiz.

7. She refused to answer the question.
U savolga javob berishdan bosh tortdi.

8. He offered to carry my bag.
U sumkamni ko‘tarib berishni taklif qildi.

9. They managed to finish the work on time.
Ular ishni vaqtida tugatishga muvaffaq bo‘lishdi.

10. I learned to drive last year.
Men o‘tgan yili mashina haydashni o‘rgandim.

4.3. Sifatdan keyin infinitive ishlatiladi

Ba’zi sifatlar infinitive bilan ishlatiladi.

Formula:

adjective + to + V1

Misollar:

1. I am happy to help you.
Men sizga yordam berishdan xursandman.

2. This rule is easy to understand.
Bu qoidani tushunish oson.

3. This problem is difficult to solve.
Bu masalani yechish qiyin.

4. She was surprised to see me.
U meni ko‘rib hayron bo‘ldi.

5. Students are ready to start the lesson.
O‘quvchilar darsni boshlashga tayyor.

6. It is important to practise every day.
Har kuni mashq qilish muhim.

7. It is necessary to follow the rules.
Qoidalarga amal qilish zarur.

4.4. Too / enough bilan infinitive ishlatiladi

Too + adjective + to + V1

Ma’nosi: juda ... bo‘lgani uchun qila olmaydi.

He is too tired to study.
U o‘qish uchun juda charchagan.

This text is too difficult to translate.
Bu matn tarjima qilish uchun juda qiyin.

She is too young to drive.
U mashina haydash uchun juda yosh.

Adjective + enough + to + V1

Ma’nosi: biror ish qilish uchun yetarlicha ...

He is old enough to drive.
U mashina haydash uchun yetarlicha katta.

She is smart enough to solve this problem.
U bu masalani yechish uchun yetarlicha aqlli.

The room is large enough to hold 50 students.
Xona 50 ta o‘quvchini sig‘dirish uchun yetarlicha katta.

4.5. So‘roq so‘zlardan keyin infinitive ishlatiladi

Quyidagi so‘zlardan keyin to + V1 kelishi mumkin:

what to do — nima qilishni
how to solve — qanday yechishni
where to go — qayerga borishni
when to start — qachon boshlashni
which book to choose — qaysi kitobni tanlashni

Misollar:

1. I don’t know what to do.
Men nima qilishni bilmayman.

2. She knows how to solve this problem.
U bu masalani qanday yechishni biladi.

3. We haven’t decided where to go.
Biz qayerga borishni hal qilganimiz yo‘q.

4. Tell me when to start.
Qachon boshlashni menga ayting.

5. Students asked which topic to revise.
O‘quvchilar qaysi mavzuni takrorlashni so‘rashdi.

5. Faqat Gerund talab qiladigan fe’llar

Quyidagi fe’llardan keyin odatda V-ing ishlatiladi.

Fe’l | Ma’nosi | Misol
enjoy | yoqtirmoq | I enjoy reading novels. — Men roman o‘qishni yoqtiraman.
avoid | qochmoq | He avoids making mistakes. — U xato qilishdan qochadi.
finish | tugatmoq | She finished writing the report. — U hisobot yozishni tugatdi.
suggest | taklif qilmoq | They suggested going by train. — Ular poyezdda borishni taklif qilishdi.
mind | qarshi bo‘lmoq | Do you mind closing the door? — Eshikni yopishga qarshi emasmisiz?
keep | davom etmoq | He kept talking during the lesson. — U dars davomida gapirishda davom etdi.
consider | o‘ylab ko‘rmoq | We are considering opening a new group. — Biz yangi guruh ochishni o‘ylayapmiz.
admit | tan olmoq | She admitted cheating in the test. — U testda ko‘chirganini tan oldi.
deny | inkor qilmoq | He denied breaking the window. — U oynani sindirganini inkor qildi.
postpone | kechiktirmoq | They postponed holding the meeting. — Ular uchrashuv o‘tkazishni kechiktirishdi.
practise | mashq qilmoq | Students practise speaking English every day. — O‘quvchilar har kuni inglizcha gapirishni mashq qilishadi.
risk | tavakkal qilmoq | You risk losing marks. — Sen ball yo‘qotish xavfiga borasan.
miss | sog‘inmoq / yo‘qligini his qilmoq | I miss studying with my old classmates. — Men eski sinfdoshlarim bilan o‘qishni sog‘indim.
imagine | tasavvur qilmoq | Imagine living in London. — Londonda yashashni tasavvur qiling.

6. Faqat Infinitive talab qiladigan fe’llar

Quyidagi fe’llardan keyin odatda to + V1 ishlatiladi.

Fe’l | Ma’nosi | Misol
want | xohlamoq | I want to learn English. — Men ingliz tilini o‘rganmoqchiman.
hope | umid qilmoq | She hopes to pass the exam. — U imtihondan o‘tishni umid qiladi.
decide | qaror qilmoq | They decided to study abroad. — Ular chet elda o‘qishga qaror qilishdi.
agree | rozi bo‘lmoq | He agreed to help us. — U bizga yordam berishga rozi bo‘ldi.
promise | va’da bermoq | I promise to be on time. — Men vaqtida bo‘lishga va’da beraman.
plan | rejalashtirmoq | We plan to open a new course. — Biz yangi kurs ochishni rejalashtiryapmiz.
refuse | bosh tortmoq | She refused to answer. — U javob berishdan bosh tortdi.
offer | taklif qilmoq | He offered to explain the rule. — U qoidani tushuntirib berishni taklif qildi.
manage | uddalamoq | They managed to finish the task. — Ular topshiriqni tugatishga muvaffaq bo‘lishdi.
learn | o‘rganmoq | I learned to swim when I was ten. — Men o‘n yoshimda suzishni o‘rgandim.
expect | kutmoq | We expect to get good results. — Biz yaxshi natijalar olishni kutyapmiz.
afford | qurbi yetmoq | I can’t afford to buy a new laptop. — Men yangi noutbuk sotib olishga qurbi yetmaydi.
choose | tanlamoq | She chose to study biology. — U biologiyani o‘qishni tanladi.
prepare | tayyorlanmoq | Students prepared to take the test. — O‘quvchilar test topshirishga tayyorlanishdi.

7. Gerund ham, Infinitive ham kela oladigan fe’llar

Ba’zi fe’llardan keyin ham gerund, ham infinitive kelishi mumkin. Ko‘p hollarda ma’no deyarli o‘zgarmaydi.

Like

I like reading books.
Men kitob o‘qishni yoqtiraman.

I like to read books.
Men kitob o‘qishni yoqtiraman.

Farq juda katta emas. Kundalik gapda ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi.

Love

She loves dancing.
U raqsga tushishni juda yaxshi ko‘radi.

She loves to dance.
U raqsga tushishni juda yaxshi ko‘radi.

Hate

He hates waiting.
U kutishni yomon ko‘radi.

He hates to wait.
U kutishni yomon ko‘radi.

Prefer

I prefer studying in the morning.
Men ertalab o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman.

I prefer to study in the morning.
Men ertalab o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman.

Start

It started raining.
Yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.

It started to rain.
Yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.

Begin

She began crying.
U yig‘lay boshladi.

She began to cry.
U yig‘lay boshladi.

Continue

They continued working.
Ular ishlashda davom etishdi.

They continued to work.
Ular ishlashda davom etishdi.

8. Gerund va Infinitive kelganda ma’nosi o‘zgaradigan fe’llar

Ba’zi fe’llardan keyin gerund yoki infinitive kelishiga qarab ma’no o‘zgaradi. Bu abituriyentlar va talabalar uchun juda muhim.

Fe’l | Gerund bilan ma’nosi | Infinitive bilan ma’nosi | Inglizcha misol | Tarjima
remember | O‘tmishda qilgan ishni eslamoq | Kelajakda qilish kerakligini eslamoq | I remember meeting him. | Men u bilan uchrashganimni eslayman.
remember | Remember to call me. | Menga qo‘ng‘iroq qilishni unutma.
forget | O‘tmishda qilgan ishni unutmoq | Kelajakda qilish kerak bo‘lgan ishni unutmoq | I forgot meeting her before. | Men u bilan oldin uchrashganimni unutibman.
forget | Don’t forget to do your homework. | Uy vazifangni qilishni unutma.
stop | Bir ishni to‘xtatmoq | Boshqa ish qilish uchun to‘xtamoq | He stopped smoking. | U chekishni tashladi.
stop | He stopped to smoke. | U chekish uchun to‘xtadi.
try | Biror usulni sinab ko‘rmoq | Harakat qilmoq, urinmoq | Try drinking warm water. | Iliq suv ichib ko‘r.
try | Try to solve this problem. | Bu masalani yechishga harakat qil.
regret | O‘tmishda qilgan ishidan afsuslanmoq | Yomon xabarni aytishdan afsuslanmoq | I regret wasting my time. | Men vaqtimni bekor sarflaganimdan afsuslanaman.
regret | I regret to inform you that you failed. | Sizga afsus bilan shuni ma’lum qilamanki, siz o‘ta olmadingiz.
go on | Bir ishni davom ettirmoq | Keyin boshqa ishga o‘tmoq | He went on speaking. | U gapirishda davom etdi.
go on | He went on to explain the next rule. | U keyingi qoidani tushuntirishga o‘tdi.

9. Bare infinitive ishlatiladigan holatlar

Bare infinitive — tosiz V1 shakli.

9.1. Modal fe’llardan keyin

Modal fe’llar:

can, could, may, might, must, should, would

Ulardan keyin to ishlatilmaydi.

Misollar:

1. I can swim.
Men suza olaman.

2. She could read when she was five.
U besh yoshida o‘qiy olardi.

3. You may leave now.
Siz hozir ketishingiz mumkin.

4. It might rain tomorrow.
Ertaga yomg‘ir yog‘ishi mumkin.

5. Students must follow the rules.
O‘quvchilar qoidalarga amal qilishlari shart.

6. You should study every day.
Sen har kuni o‘qishing kerak.

7. I would help you if I had time.
Vaqtim bo‘lganida, senga yordam bergan bo‘lardim.

9.2. Let, make, help fe’llaridan keyin

Let + object + V1

My parents let me go out.
Ota-onam menga tashqariga chiqishga ruxsat berishdi.

Let him speak.
Unga gapirishga ruxsat bering.

Make + object + V1

The teacher made us rewrite the test.
Ustoz bizga testni qayta yozdirdi.

This film made me cry.
Bu film meni yig‘latdi.

Help + object + V1 / to V1

Helpdan keyin ikkala shakl ham mumkin:

She helped me solve the problem.
U menga masalani yechishga yordam berdi.

She helped me to solve the problem.
U menga masalani yechishga yordam berdi.

9.3. Had better va would rather dan keyin

Had better + V1

Ma’nosi: yaxshisi ... qilgan ma’qul.

You had better study tonight.
Yaxshisi, bugun kechqurun o‘qiganing ma’qul.

We had better leave early.
Yaxshisi, erta chiqqanimiz ma’qul.

Would rather + V1

Ma’nosi: afzal ko‘rmoq.

I would rather stay at home.
Men uyda qolishni afzal ko‘raman.

She would rather study alone.
U yolg‘iz o‘qishni afzal ko‘radi.

10. Gerund / Infinitive mavzusida ko‘p qilinadigan xatolar

1-xato: enjoy to do

Noto‘g‘ri:

I enjoy to read books.

To‘g‘ri:

I enjoy reading books.
Men kitob o‘qishni yoqtiraman.

Sabab: enjoydan keyin gerund keladi.

2-xato: want doing

Noto‘g‘ri:

I want learning English.

To‘g‘ri:

I want to learn English.
Men ingliz tilini o‘rganmoqchiman.

Sabab: wantdan keyin infinitive keladi.

3-xato: preposition + to V1

Noto‘g‘ri:

She is good at to solve problems.

To‘g‘ri:

She is good at solving problems.
U masalalar yechishda yaxshi.

Sabab: predlogdan keyin gerund keladi.

4-xato: look forward to do

Noto‘g‘ri:

I look forward to meet you.

To‘g‘ri:

I look forward to meeting you.
Siz bilan uchrashishni intizorlik bilan kutyapman.

Sabab: look forward to birikmasidagi to predlog, shuning uchun undan keyin V-ing keladi.

5-xato: stop to do / stop doing ma’nolarini adashtirish

Noto‘g‘ri fikr:

He stopped to smoke = U chekishni tashladi.

To‘g‘ri:

He stopped smoking.
U chekishni tashladi.

He stopped to smoke.
U chekish uchun to‘xtadi.

6-xato: remember to do / remember doing farqini tushunmaslik

I remember locking the door.
Men eshikni qulflaganimni eslayman.

Remember to lock the door.
Eshikni qulflashni unutma.

Farq:

remember doing — qilgan ishni eslamoq
remember to do — qilish kerakligini eslamoq

11. Gerund va Infinitive farqi

Holat | Gerund ishlatilishi | Infinitive ishlatilishi | Misol | Tarjima
Gapning egasi | Ha | Kamroq ishlatiladi | Reading is useful. | O‘qish foydali.
Maqsad bildirish | Yo‘q | Ha | I went there to study. | Men u yerga o‘qish uchun bordim.
Predlogdan keyin | Ha | Yo‘q | She is good at speaking. | U gapirishda yaxshi.
Ba’zi fe’llardan keyin | enjoy, avoid, finish | want, hope, decide | I enjoy reading. / I want to read. | Men o‘qishni yoqtiraman. / Men o‘qimoqchiman.
Sifatdan keyin | Kamroq | Ha | This book is easy to read. | Bu kitobni o‘qish oson.
Too/enough bilan | Yo‘q | Ha | He is too tired to work. | U ishlash uchun juda charchagan.
Ma’nosi o‘zgaradigan fe’llar | O‘tmishdagi ish / jarayon | Kelajakdagi vazifa / maqsad | I remember meeting him. / Remember to meet him. | Men u bilan uchrashganimni eslayman. / U bilan uchrashishni unutma.

12. Qisqa grammatik qoida

Gerund / Infinitive mavzusini eslab qolish uchun 7 ta sodda qoida:

1. Gerund = V-ing
Masalan: reading, writing, learning

2. Infinitive = to + V1
Masalan: to read, to write, to learn

3. Predlogdan keyin odatda gerund keladi:
good at speaking, interested in learning

4. Maqsad bildirganda infinitive ishlatiladi:
I went there to study.

5. Enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, mind kabi fe’llardan keyin gerund keladi.

6. Want, hope, decide, agree, promise, plan kabi fe’llardan keyin infinitive keladi.

7. Ba’zi fe’llarda shakl o‘zgarsa, ma’no ham o‘zgaradi:
stop smoking — chekishni tashlamoq
stop to smoke — chekish uchun to‘xtamoq
grammar_rules_en:
1. What is a gerund?

A gerund is the V-ing form of a verb that usually works as a noun in a sentence.

That means it looks like a verb, but in the sentence it answers the question “what?”.

For example:

Reading is useful.
Reading is useful.

In this sentence reading means “the activity of reading”. It names an action, but in the sentence it is the subject.

Gerund form

A gerund is formed like this:

Verb + ing

Verb | Gerund
read | reading
write | writing
swim | swimming
study | studying
learn | learning
play | playing
speak | speaking

A gerund looks like a verb, but works as a noun.

I like reading.
I like reading.

Here, reading resembles a noun meaning “reading”.

In Uzbek, it is often translated as:

reading — o‘qish
writing — yozish
swimming — suzish
learning — o‘rganish
teaching — o‘qitish
travelling — sayohat qilish

10 examples of gerund

1. Reading books improves your vocabulary.
Reading books improves your vocabulary.

2. Swimming is good for health.
Swimming is good for health.

3. Learning English takes time.
Learning English takes time.

4. Teaching children requires patience.
Teaching children requires patience.

5. Writing essays helps students think clearly.
Writing essays helps students think clearly.

6. Watching too many videos can waste time.
Watching too many videos can waste time.

7. Doing homework regularly improves results.
Doing homework regularly improves results.

8. Speaking English every day builds confidence.
Speaking English every day builds confidence.

9. Studying grammar is important for exams.
Studying grammar is important for exams.

10. Helping others makes people kinder.
Helping others makes people kinder.

2. What is an infinitive?

An infinitive is the base form of a verb. In English, there are two types of infinitives:

1. To-infinitive

2. Bare infinitive

1. To-infinitive

To-infinitive is formed like this:

to + V1

For example:

to read — o‘qimoq
to write — yozmoq
to learn — o‘rganmoq
to speak — gapirmoq
to help — yordam bermoq

Example:

I want to learn English.
I want to learn English.

Here, to learn is an infinitive.

2. Bare infinitive

Bare infinitive is the simple form of the verb without 'to'.

For example:

go
read
write
study
help

Bare infinitive is usually used after modal verbs:

I can swim.
I can swim.

Here, swim is a bare infinitive. Because after can, it is swim, not to swim.

10 examples of infinitive

1. I want to study abroad.
I want to study abroad.

2. She hopes to pass the exam.
She hopes to pass the exam.

3. They decided to start a new course.
They decided to start a new course.

4. We plan to visit Samarkand next month.
We plan to visit Samarkand next month.

5. He promised to help me.
He promised to help me.

6. This topic is easy to understand.
This topic is easy to understand.

7. I went to the library to read.
I went to the library to read.

8. She learned to drive last year.
She learned to drive last year.

9. Students need to practise every day.
Students need to practise every day.

10. I don’t know what to do.
I don’t know what to do.

3. Main cases where gerund is used

3.1. Gerund as the subject of the sentence

If the action comes at the beginning of the sentence and answers the question “what?”, gerund is used.

Formula:

V-ing + verb + ...

Examples:

1. Swimming is useful.
Swimming is useful.

2. Reading helps students learn new words.
Reading helps students learn new words.

3. Studying at night is difficult for some students.
Studying at night is difficult for some students.

4. Learning grammar improves writing.
Learning grammar improves writing.

5. Speaking in public builds confidence.
Speaking in public builds confidence.

3.2. Gerund is used after certain verbs

After some verbs, V-ing always follows.

For example:

enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, mind, keep, consider, admit, deny

Examples:

1. I enjoy reading English books.
I enjoy reading English books.

2. She avoids eating fast food.
She avoids eating fast food.

3. They finished writing the test.
They finished writing the test.

4. The teacher suggested revising the topic.
The teacher suggested revising the topic.

5. Do you mind opening the window?
Do you mind opening the window?

6. He keeps making the same mistake.
He keeps making the same mistake.

7. We are considering moving to another city.
We are considering moving to another city.

8. She admitted breaking the glass.
She admitted breaking the glass.

9. He denied taking the money.
He denied taking the money.

3.3. Gerund is used after prepositions

In English, when a verb follows a preposition, it usually comes in the V-ing form.

Common prepositional phrases:

interested in — to be curious about
good at — to be skilled at
afraid of — to be afraid of
before — prior to
after — following
without
instead of — in place of
about — concerning
for
of

Examples:

1. She is interested in learning English.
