She is curious about learning English.

2. He is good at solving problems.
He is skilled at solving problems.

3. I am afraid of making mistakes.
I am afraid of making mistakes.

4. Before going to bed, I read a book.
Prior to going to bed, I read a book.

5. After finishing the lesson, we discussed the test.
Following the completion of the lesson, we discussed the test.

6. She left without saying goodbye.
She left without saying goodbye.

7. Instead of watching TV, he studied English.
In place of watching TV, he studied English.

8. We talked about studying abroad.
We talked concerning studying abroad.

9. Thank you for helping me.
Thank you for helping me.

10. He is tired of waiting.
He is tired of waiting.

3.4. Gerunds are used after certain phrases

Certain phrases also use the V-ing form.

It’s no use + V-ing

Meaning: there is no benefit.

It’s no use crying.
There is no benefit in crying.

It’s no use arguing with him.
There is no benefit in arguing with him.

It’s worth + V-ing

Meaning: it is worth it.

This book is worth reading.
This book is worth reading.

This film is worth watching.
This film is worth watching.

Can’t help + V-ing

Meaning: cannot restrain oneself.

I can’t help laughing.
I cannot restrain myself from laughing.

She couldn’t help crying.
She could not restrain herself from crying.

Look forward to + V-ing

Meaning: to eagerly await.

I look forward to meeting you.
I eagerly await meeting you.

We are looking forward to seeing the results.
We are eagerly awaiting seeing the results.

Note: here it is a preposition, so V-ing follows it.

Be used to + V-ing

Meaning: to be accustomed to.

I am used to waking up early.
I am accustomed to waking up early.

She is used to studying at night.
She is accustomed to studying at night.

Get used to + V-ing

Meaning: to become accustomed to.

I am getting used to living in a new city.
I am becoming accustomed to living in a new city.

Students got used to using online platforms.
Students became accustomed to using online platforms.

4. Main situations where the infinitive is used

4.1. To express purpose

The infinitive often answers the question “why?”.

Formula:

to + V1

Examples:

1. I went to the library to study.
I went to the library for the purpose of studying.

2. She called me to ask a question.
She called me for the purpose of asking a question.

3. They came here to meet the teacher.
They came here for the purpose of meeting the teacher.

4. We use dictionaries to learn new words.
We use dictionaries for the purpose of learning new words.

5. He works hard to support his family.
He works hard for the purpose of supporting his family.

4.2. The infinitive is used after certain verbs

After some verbs, to + V1 is usually used.

For example:

want, hope, decide, agree, promise, plan, refuse, offer, manage, learn

Examples:

1. I want to improve my English.
I want to improve my English.

2. She hopes to enter university.
She hopes to enter university.

3. They decided to take the exam.
They decided to take the exam.

4. He agreed to help us.
He agreed to help us.

5. I promise to call you tomorrow.
I promise to call you tomorrow.

6. We plan to start a new project.
We plan to start a new project.

7. She refused to answer the question.
She refused to answer the question.

8. He offered to carry my bag.
He offered to carry my bag.

9. They managed to finish the work on time.
They managed to finish the work on time.

10. I learned to drive last year.
I learned to drive last year.

4.3. The infinitive is used after adjectives

Some adjectives are used with the infinitive.

Formula:

adjective + to + V1

Examples:

1. I am happy to help you.
I am happy to help you.

2. This rule is easy to understand.
This rule is easy to understand.

3. This problem is difficult to solve.
This problem is difficult to solve.

4. She was surprised to see me.
She was surprised to see me.

5. Students are ready to start the lesson.
Students are ready to start the lesson.

6. It is important to practise every day.
It is important to practise every day.

7. It is necessary to follow the rules.
It is necessary to follow the rules.

4.4. The infinitive is used with too / enough

Too + adjective + to + V1

Meaning: too ... to be able to do something.

He is too tired to study.
He is too tired to study.

This text is too difficult to translate.
This text is too difficult to translate.

She is too young to drive.
She is too young to drive.

Adjective + enough + to + V1

Meaning: enough ... to do something.

He is old enough to drive.
He is old enough to drive.

She is smart enough to solve this problem.

The room is large enough to hold 50 students.

4.5. After question words, the infinitive is used.

The following words can be followed by to + V1:

what to do
how to solve
where to go
when to start
which book to choose

Examples:

1. I don’t know what to do.

2. She knows how to solve this problem.

3. We haven’t decided where to go.

4. Tell me when to start.

5. Students asked which topic to revise.

5. Verbs that require only a gerund

The following verbs are usually followed by V-ing.

Verb | Meaning | Example
enjoy | to like | I enjoy reading novels. — I like reading novels.
avoid | to avoid | He avoids making mistakes. — He avoids making mistakes.
finish | to finish | She finished writing the report. — She finished writing the report.
suggest | to suggest | They suggested going by train. — They suggested going by train.
mind | to mind | Do you mind closing the door? — Do you mind closing the door?
keep | to keep | He kept talking during the lesson. — He kept talking during the lesson.
consider | to consider | We are considering opening a new group. — We are considering opening a new group.
admit | to admit | She admitted cheating in the test. — She admitted cheating in the test.
deny | to deny | He denied breaking the window. — He denied breaking the window.
postpone | to postpone | They postponed holding the meeting. — They postponed holding the meeting.
practise | to practise | Students practise speaking English every day. — Students practise speaking English every day.
risk | to risk | You risk losing marks. — You risk losing marks.
miss | to miss | I miss studying with my old classmates. — I miss studying with my old classmates.
imagine | to imagine | Imagine living in London. — Imagine living in London.

6. Verbs that require only the infinitive

The following verbs are usually followed by to + V1.

Verb | Meaning | Example
want | to want | I want to learn English. — I want to learn English.
hope | to hope | She hopes to pass the exam. — She hopes to pass the exam.
decide | to decide | They decided to study abroad. — They decided to study abroad.
agree | to agree | He agreed to help us. — He agreed to help us.
promise | to promise | I promise to be on time. — I promise to be on time.
plan | to plan | We plan to open a new course. — We plan to open a new course.
refuse | to refuse | She refused to answer. — She refused to answer.
offer | to offer | He offered to explain the rule. — He offered to explain the rule.
manage | to manage | They managed to finish the task. — They managed to finish the task.
learn | to learn | I learned to swim when I was ten. — I learned to swim when I was ten.
expect | to expect | We expect to get good results. — We expect to get good results.
afford | to afford | I can’t afford to buy a new laptop. — I can’t afford to buy a new laptop.
choose | to choose | She chose to study biology. — She chose to study biology.
prepare | to prepare | Students prepared to take the test. — Students prepared to take the test.

7. Verbs that can take both gerund and infinitive

Some verbs can be followed by either a gerund or an infinitive. In many cases, the meaning does not change significantly.

Like

I like reading books.

I like to read books.

The difference is not very big. Both are used in everyday speech.

Love

She loves dancing.

She loves to dance.

Hate

He hates waiting.

He hates to wait.

Prefer

I prefer studying in the morning.

I prefer to study in the morning.

Start

It started raining.

It started to rain.

Begin

She began crying.

She began to cry.

Continue

They continued working.

They continued to work.

8. Verbs that change meaning depending on gerund or infinitive

Some verbs change meaning depending on whether they are followed by a gerund or an infinitive. This is very important for applicants and students.

Verb | Meaning with Gerund | Meaning with Infinitive | English Example | Translation
remember | to remember something done in the past | to remember something that needs to be done in the future | I remember meeting him. | I remember meeting him.
remember | Remember to call me. | Don't forget to call me.
forget | to forget something done in the past | to forget something that needs to be done in the future | I forgot meeting her before. | I forgot meeting her before.
forget | Don’t forget to do your homework. | Don't forget to do your homework.
stop | to stop doing something | to stop in order to do something else | He stopped smoking. | He quit smoking.
stop | He stopped to smoke. | He stopped to smoke.
try | to try a method | to make an effort, to attempt | Try drinking warm water. | Try drinking warm water.
try | Try to solve this problem. | Try to solve this problem.
regret | to regret something done in the past | to regret telling bad news | I regret wasting my time. | I regret wasting my time.
regret | I regret to inform you that you failed. | I regret to inform you that you failed.
 go on | to continue doing something | to move on to another task | He went on speaking. | He continued speaking.
go on | He went on to explain the next rule. | He moved on to explain the next rule.

Bare infinitive is the base form V1.

9.1. After modal verbs

Modal verbs:

can, could, may, might, must, should, would

They are not followed by to.

Examples:

1. I can swim.
I can swim.

2. She could read when she was five.
She could read when she was five.

3. You may leave now.
You may leave now.

4. It might rain tomorrow.
It might rain tomorrow.

5. Students must follow the rules.
Students must follow the rules.

6. You should study every day.
You should study every day.

7. I would help you if I had time.
I would help you if I had time.

9.2. After let, make, help verbs

Let + object + V1

My parents let me go out.
My parents let me go out.

Let him speak.
Let him speak.

Make + object + V1

The teacher made us rewrite the test.
The teacher made us rewrite the test.

This film made me cry.
This film made me cry.

Help + object + V1 / to V1

Both forms are possible after help:

She helped me solve the problem.
She helped me solve the problem.

She helped me to solve the problem.
She helped me to solve the problem.

9.3. After had better and would rather

Had better + V1

Meaning: it is better to do...

You had better study tonight.
You had better study tonight.

We had better leave early.
We had better leave early.

Would rather + V1

Meaning: to prefer.

I would rather stay at home.
I would rather stay at home.

She would rather study alone.
She would rather study alone.

10. Common mistakes with Gerund / Infinitive

Mistake 1: enjoy to do

Incorrect:

I enjoy to read books.

Correct:

I enjoy reading books.
I enjoy reading books.

Reason: gerund follows enjoy.

Mistake 2: want doing

Incorrect:

I want learning English.

Correct:

I want to learn English.
I want to learn English.

Reason: infinitive follows want.

Mistake 3: preposition + to V1

Incorrect:

She is good at to solve problems.

Correct:

She is good at solving problems.
She is good at solving problems.

Reason: gerund follows prepositions.

Mistake 4: look forward to do

Incorrect:

I look forward to meet you.

Correct:

I look forward to meeting you.
I look forward to meeting you.

Reason: the to in look forward to is a preposition, so it is followed by V-ing.

Mistake 5: confusing stop to do / stop doing meanings

Incorrect thought:

He stopped to smoke = He quit smoking.

Correct:

He stopped smoking.
He quit smoking.

He stopped to smoke.
He stopped to smoke.

Mistake 6: misunderstanding the difference between remember to do / remember doing

I remember locking the door.
I remember locking the door.

Remember to lock the door.
Don't forget to lock the door.

Difference:

remember doing — to remember something done
remember to do — to remember something that needs to be done

11. Difference between Gerund and Infinitive

Situation | Use of Gerund | Use of Infinitive | Example | Translation
Subject of the sentence | Yes | Less commonly used | Reading is useful. | Reading is useful.
To express purpose | No | Yes | I went there to study. | I went there to study.
After a preposition | Yes | No | She is good at speaking. | She is good at speaking.
After certain verbs | enjoy, avoid, finish | want, hope, decide | I enjoy reading. / I want to read. | I enjoy reading. / I want to read.
After an adjective | Less common | Yes | This book is easy to read. | This book is easy to read.
With too/enough | No | Yes | He is too tired to work. | He is too tired to work.
Verbs that change meaning | Past action / process | Future task / purpose | I remember meeting him. / Remember to meet him. | I remember meeting him. / Remember to meet him.

12. Short grammar rule

7 simple rules to remember the topic of Gerund / Infinitive:

1. Gerund = V-ing
For example: reading, writing, learning

2. Infinitive = to + V1
For example: to read, to write, to learn

3. After a preposition, gerund usually comes:
good at speaking, interested in learning

4. Infinitive is used to express purpose:
I went there to study.

5. After verbs like enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, mind, gerund comes.

6. After verbs like want, hope, decide, agree, promise, plan, infinitive comes.

7. In some verbs, if the form changes, the meaning also changes:
stop smoking — to quit smoking
stop to smoke — to stop in order to smoke
grammar_rules_ru:
1. Что такое Gerund?

Gerund — форма глагола V-ing, которая в предложении чаще всего выступает в роли существительного.

То есть по форме это глагол, но в предложении он отвечает на вопрос «что?».

Например:

Reading is useful.
Чтение полезно.

В этом предложении reading означает «чтение». Он обозначает действие, но в предложении выступает подлежащим.

Форма Gerund

Gerund образуется так:

Глагол + ing

Глагол | Gerund
read | reading
write | writing
swim | swimming
study | studying
learn | learning
play | playing
speak | speaking

Gerund похож на глагол, но выполняет роль существительного

I like reading.
Мне нравится читать.

Здесь reading похоже на существительное «чтение».

На узбекском языке это часто переводится так:

reading — o‘qish
writing — yozish
swimming — suzish
learning — o‘rganish
teaching — o‘qitish
travelling — sayohat qilish

10 примеров с Gerund

1. Reading books improves your vocabulary.
Чтение книг улучшает ваш словарный запас.

2. Swimming is good for health.
Плавание полезно для здоровья.

3. Learning English takes time.
Изучение английского требует времени.

4. Teaching children requires patience.
Обучение детей требует терпения.

5. Writing essays helps students think clearly.
Написание эссе помогает студентам ясно мыслить.

6. Watching too many videos can waste time.
Слишком много просмотра видео может потратить время впустую.

7. Doing homework regularly improves results.
Регулярное выполнение домашнего задания улучшает результаты.

8. Speaking English every day builds confidence.
Говорить по-английски каждый день повышает уверенность.

9. Studying grammar is important for exams.
Изучение грамматики важно для экзаменов.

10. Helping others makes people kinder.
Помощь другим делает людей добрее.

2. Что такое Infinitive?

Infinitive — основная форма глагола. В английском языке инфинитив бывает двух видов:

1. To-infinitive

2. Bare infinitive

1. To-infinitive

To-infinitive образуется так:

to + V1

Например:

to read — o‘qimoq
to write — yozmoq
to learn — o‘rganmoq
to speak — gapirmoq
to help — yordam bermoq

Пример:

I want to learn English.
Я хочу изучать английский.

Здесь to learn — инфинитив.

2. Bare infinitive

Bare infinitive — простая форма глагола без частицы to.

Например:

go
read
write
study
help

Bare infinitive обычно используется после модальных глаголов:

I can swim.
Я умею плавать.

Здесь swim — bare infinitive. Потому что после can идет именно swim, а не to swim.

10 примеров с Infinitive

1. I want to study abroad.
Я хочу учиться за границей.

2. She hopes to pass the exam.
Она надеется сдать экзамен.

3. They decided to start a new course.
Они решили начать новый курс.

4. We plan to visit Samarkand next month.
Мы планируем посетить Самарканд в следующем месяце.

5. He promised to help me.
Он пообещал помочь мне.

6. This topic is easy to understand.
Эта тема легка для понимания.

7. I went to the library to read.
Я пошел в библиотеку, чтобы читать.

8. She learned to drive last year.
Она научилась водить машину в прошлом году.

9. Students need to practise every day.
Студентам нужно практиковаться каждый день.

10. I don’t know what to do.
Я не знаю, что делать.

3. Основные случаи использования Gerund

3.1. Gerund в роли подлежащего

Если действие в предложении стоит в начале и отвечает на вопрос «что?», используется gerund.

Формула:

V-ing + глагол + ...

Примеры:

1. Swimming is useful.
Плавание полезно.

2. Reading helps students learn new words.
Чтение помогает студентам изучать новые слова.

3. Studying at night is difficult for some students.
Учеба ночью трудна для некоторых студентов.

4. Learning grammar improves writing.
Изучение грамматики улучшает письмо.

5. Speaking in public builds confidence.
Говорить на публике повышает уверенность.

3.2. Gerund используется после некоторых глаголов

После некоторых глаголов всегда следует V-ing.

Например:

enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, mind, keep, consider, admit, deny

Примеры:

1. I enjoy reading English books.
Мне нравится читать английские книги.

2. She avoids eating fast food.
Она избегает есть фастфуд.

3. They finished writing the test.
Они закончили писать тест.

4. The teacher suggested revising the topic.
Учитель предложил повторить тему.

5. Do you mind opening the window?
Вы не против открыть окно?

6. He keeps making the same mistake.
Он продолжает делать одну и ту же ошибку.

7. We are considering moving to another city.
Мы рассматриваем возможность переезда в другой город.

8. She admitted breaking the glass.
Она признала, что разбила стакан.

9. He denied taking the money.
Он отрицал, что взял деньги.

3.3. Gerund используется после предлогов

В английском языке, если после предлога стоит глагол, он обычно используется в форме V-ing.

Часто встречающиеся предлоговые конструкции:

interested in — интересоваться
good at — хорошо справляться
afraid of — бояться
before — перед
after — после
without — без
instead of — вместо
about — о
for — для
of — от

Примеры:

1. She is interested in learning English.
Она интересуется изучением английского.

2. He is good at solving problems.
Он хорошо справляется с решением задач.

3. I am afraid of making mistakes.
Я боюсь делать ошибки.

4. Before going to bed, I read a book.
Перед сном я читаю книгу.

5. After finishing the lesson, we discussed the test.
После завершения урока мы обсудили тест.

6. She left without saying goodbye.
Она ушла, не попрощавшись.

7. Instead of watching TV, he studied English.
Вместо того чтобы смотреть телевизор, он изучал английский.

8. We talked about studying abroad.
Мы говорили о учебе за границей.

9. Thank you for helping me.
Спасибо за вашу помощь.

10. He is tired of waiting.
Он устал ждать.

3.4. После специальных выражений используется герундий

После некоторых специальных выражений также используется V-ing.

It’s no use + V-ing

Значение: нет смысла.

It’s no use crying.
Нет смысла плакать.

It’s no use arguing with him.
Нет смысла спорить с ним.

It’s worth + V-ing

Значение: стоит.

This book is worth reading.
Эта книга стоит прочтения.

This film is worth watching.
Этот фильм стоит просмотра.

Can’t help + V-ing

Значение: не могу удержаться.

I can’t help laughing.
Я не могу удержаться от смеха.

She couldn’t help crying.
Она не могла удержаться от слез.

Look forward to + V-ing

Значение: с нетерпением ждать.

I look forward to meeting you.
Я с нетерпением жду встречи с вами.

We are looking forward to seeing the results.
Мы с нетерпением ждем результатов.

Обратите внимание: здесь предлог, поэтому после него идет V-ing.

Be used to + V-ing

Значение: привыкнуть.

I am used to waking up early.
Я привык вставать рано.

She is used to studying at night.
Она привыкла учиться ночью.

Get used to + V-ing

Значение: привыкать.

I am getting used to living in a new city.
Я привыкаю к жизни в новом городе.

Students got used to using online platforms.
Студенты привыкли использовать онлайн-платформы.

4. Основные случаи использования инфинитива

4.1. Для обозначения цели

Инфинитив часто отвечает на вопрос «зачем?»

Формула:

to + V1

Примеры:

1. I went to the library to study.
Я пошел в библиотеку, чтобы учиться.

2. She called me to ask a question.
Она позвонила мне, чтобы задать вопрос.

3. They came here to meet the teacher.
Они пришли сюда, чтобы встретиться с учителем.

4. We use dictionaries to learn new words.
Мы используем словари, чтобы учить новые слова.

5. He works hard to support his family.
Он усердно работает, чтобы поддерживать свою семью.

4.2. После некоторых глаголов используется инфинитив

После некоторых глаголов обычно следует to + V1.

Например:

want, hope, decide, agree, promise, plan, refuse, offer, manage, learn

Примеры:

1. I want to improve my English.
Я хочу улучшить свой английский.

2. She hopes to enter university.
Она надеется поступить в университет.

3. They decided to take the exam.
Они решили сдать экзамен.

4. He agreed to help us.
Он согласился помочь нам.

5. I promise to call you tomorrow.
Я обещаю позвонить вам завтра.

6. We plan to start a new project.
Мы планируем начать новый проект.

7. She refused to answer the question.
Она отказалась отвечать на вопрос.

8. He offered to carry my bag.
Он предложил помочь мне с сумкой.

9. They managed to finish the work on time.
Им удалось закончить работу вовремя.

10. I learned to drive last year.
Я научился водить машину в прошлом году.

4.3. После прилагательных используется инфинитив

Некоторые прилагательные используются с инфинитивом.

Формула:

прилагательное + to + V1

Примеры:

1. I am happy to help you.
Я рад помочь вам.

2. This rule is easy to understand.
Это правило легко понять.

3. This problem is difficult to solve.
Эту проблему трудно решить.

4. She was surprised to see me.
Она была удивлена, увидев меня.

5. Students are ready to start the lesson.
Студенты готовы начать урок.

6. It is important to practise every day.
Важно практиковаться каждый день.

7. It is necessary to follow the rules.
Необходимо следовать правилам.

4.4. С инфинитивом используются too / enough

Too + прилагательное + to + V1

Значение: слишком ... чтобы не мог.

He is too tired to study.
Он слишком устал, чтобы учиться.

This text is too difficult to translate.
Этот текст слишком труден для перевода.

She is too young to drive.
Она слишком молода, чтобы водить машину.

Прилагательное + enough + to + V1

Значение: достаточно ... чтобы что-то сделать.

He is old enough to drive.
Он достаточно взрослый, чтобы водить машину.

Она достаточно умная, чтобы решить эту проблему.
U bu masalani yechish uchun yetarlicha aqlli.

Комната достаточно большая, чтобы вмещать 50 студентов.
Xona 50 ta o‘quvchini sig‘dirish uchun yetarlicha katta.

4.5. После вопросительных слов используется инфинитив

После следующих слов может следовать to + V1:

what to do — что делать
how to solve — как решить
where to go — куда идти
when to start — когда начать
which book to choose — какую книгу выбрать

Примеры:

1. Я не знаю, что делать.
Men nima qilishni bilmayman.

2. Она знает, как решить эту проблему.
U bu masalani qanday yechishni biladi.

3. Мы не решили, куда идти.
Biz qayerga borishni hal qilganimiz yo‘q.

4. Скажи мне, когда начинать.
Qachon boshlashni menga ayting.

5. Студенты спросили, какую тему повторять.
O‘quvchilar qaysi mavzuni takrorlashni so‘rashdi.

5. Глаголы, требующие только герундий

После следующих глаголов обычно используется V-ing.

Глагол | Значение | Пример
enjoy | нравиться | I enjoy reading novels. — Мне нравится читать романы.
avoid | избегать | He avoids making mistakes. — Он избегает делать ошибки.
finish | заканчивать | She finished writing the report. — Она закончила писать отчет.
suggest | предлагать | They suggested going by train. — Они предложили поехать на поезде.
mind | возражать | Do you mind closing the door? — Вы не против закрыть дверь?
keep | продолжать | He kept talking during the lesson. — Он продолжал говорить во время урока.
consider | рассматривать | We are considering opening a new group. — Мы рассматриваем возможность открытия новой группы.
admit | признавать | She admitted cheating in the test. — Она признала, что списывала на тесте.
deny | отрицать | He denied breaking the window. — Он отрицал, что разбил окно.
postpone | откладывать | They postponed holding the meeting. — Они отложили проведение встречи.
practise | практиковать | Students practise speaking English every day. — Студенты практикуют разговорный английский каждый день.
risk | рисковать | You risk losing marks. — Вы рискуете потерять баллы.
miss | скучать / чувствовать отсутствие | I miss studying with my old classmates. — Я скучаю по учебе с моими старыми одноклассниками.
imagine | представлять | Imagine living in London. — Представьте, что вы живете в Лондоне.

6. Глаголы, требующие только инфинитив

После следующих глаголов обычно используется to + V1.

Глагол | Значение | Пример
want | хотеть | I want to learn English. — Я хочу учить английский.
hope | надеяться | She hopes to pass the exam. — Она надеется сдать экзамен.
decide | решать | They decided to study abroad. — Они решили учиться за границей.
agree | соглашаться | He agreed to help us. — Он согласился помочь нам.
promise | обещать | I promise to be on time. — Я обещаю быть вовремя.
plan | планировать | We plan to open a new course. — Мы планируем открыть новый курс.
refuse | отказываться | She refused to answer. — Она отказалась отвечать.
offer | предлагать | He offered to explain the rule. — Он предложил объяснить правило.
manage | справляться | They managed to finish the task. — Им удалось закончить задание.
learn | учить | I learned to swim when I was ten. — Я научился плавать, когда мне было десять.
expect | ожидать | We expect to get good results. — Мы ожидаем получить хорошие результаты.
afford | позволять себе | I can’t afford to buy a new laptop. — Я не могу позволить себе купить новый ноутбук.
choose | выбирать | She chose to study biology. — Она выбрала изучать биологию.
prepare | готовиться | Students prepared to take the test. — Студенты готовились к тесту.

7. Глаголы, после которых могут быть и герундий, и инфинитив

После некоторых глаголов могут использоваться как герундий, так и инфинитив. В большинстве случаев значение почти не меняется.

Like

I like reading books.
Men kitob o‘qishni yoqtiraman.

I like to read books.
Men kitob o‘qishni yoqtiraman.

Разница незначительна. В повседневной речи оба используются.

Love

She loves dancing.
U raqsga tushishni juda yaxshi ko‘radi.

She loves to dance.
U raqsga tushishni juda yaxshi ko‘radi.

Hate

He hates waiting.
U kutishni yomon ko‘radi.

He hates to wait.
U kutishni yomon ko‘radi.

Prefer

I prefer studying in the morning.
Men ertalab o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman.

I prefer to study in the morning.
Men ertalab o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman.

Start

It started raining.
Yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.

It started to rain.
Yomg‘ir yog‘a boshladi.

Begin

She began crying.
U yig‘lay boshladi.

She began to cry.
U yig‘lay boshladi.

Continue

They continued working.
Ular ishlashda davom etishdi.

They continued to work.
Ular ishlashda davom etishdi.

8. Глаголы, после которых значение меняется в зависимости от герундия или инфинитива

После некоторых глаголов значение меняется в зависимости от того, используется ли герундий или инфинитив. Это очень важно для абитуриентов и студентов.

Fe’l | Gerund и его значение | Infinitive и его значение | Пример на английском | Перевод
remember | Вспоминать о том, что было сделано в прошлом | Вспоминать о том, что нужно сделать в будущем | I remember meeting him. | Я помню, что встречался с ним.
remember | Remember to call me. | Не забудь позвонить мне.
forget | Забывать о том, что было сделано в прошлом | Забывать о том, что нужно сделать в будущем | I forgot meeting her before. | Я забыл, что встречался с ней раньше.
forget | Don’t forget to do your homework. | Не забудь сделать домашнее задание.
stop | Останавливать какое-либо действие | Останавливать, чтобы сделать что-то другое | He stopped smoking. | Он бросил курить.
stop | He stopped to smoke. | Он остановился, чтобы покурить.
try | Пробовать какой-либо способ | Пытаться, стараться | Try drinking warm water. | Попробуй выпить теплую воду.
try | Try to solve this problem. | Попробуй решить эту проблему.
regret | Сожалеть о том, что было сделано в прошлом | Сожалеть о том, что нужно сказать плохую новость | I regret wasting my time. | Я сожалею, что потратил свое время.
regret | I regret to inform you that you failed. | С сожалением сообщаю вам, что вы не сдали.
go on | Продолжать делать что-то | Переходить к другому делу | He went on speaking. | Он продолжал говорить.
 go on | He went on to explain the next rule. | Он перешел к объяснению следующего правила.

9. Bare infinitive используется в следующих случаях

Bare infinitive — это форма глагола V1 без частицы to.

9.1. После модальных глаголов

Модальные глаголы:

can, could, may, might, must, should, would

После них не используется to.

Примеры:

1. I can swim.
Я умею плавать.

2. She could read when she was five.
Она могла читать, когда ей было пять.

3. You may leave now.
Вы можете уходить сейчас.

4. It might rain tomorrow.
Завтра может пойти дождь.

5. Students must follow the rules.
Студенты должны следовать правилам.

6. You should study every day.
Тебе следует учиться каждый день.

7. I would help you if I had time.
Я бы помог тебе, если бы у меня было время.

9.2. После глаголов let, make, help

Let + object + V1

My parents let me go out.
Мои родители разрешили мне выйти на улицу.

Let him speak.
Позвольте ему говорить.

Make + object + V1

The teacher made us rewrite the test.
Учитель заставил нас переписать тест.

This film made me cry.
Этот фильм заставил меня плакать.

Help + object + V1 / to V1

После help возможны обе формы:

She helped me solve the problem.
Она помогла мне решить проблему.

She helped me to solve the problem.
Она помогла мне решить проблему.

9.3. После had better и would rather

Had better + V1

Значение: лучше бы ... сделать.

You had better study tonight.
Лучше бы тебе поучиться сегодня вечером.

We had better leave early.
Лучше бы нам уйти пораньше.

Would rather + V1

Значение: предпочитать.

I would rather stay at home.
Я предпочитаю остаться дома.

She would rather study alone.
Она предпочитает учиться одна.

10. Частые ошибки по теме Gerund / Infinitive

1-я ошибка: enjoy to do

Неправильно:

I enjoy to read books.

Правильно:

I enjoy reading books.
Мне нравится читать книги.

Причина: после enjoy следует использовать gerund.

2-я ошибка: want doing

Неправильно:

I want learning English.

Правильно:

I want to learn English.
Я хочу учить английский.

Причина: после want следует использовать infinitive.

3-я ошибка: предлог + to V1

Неправильно:

She is good at to solve problems.

Правильно:

She is good at solving problems.
Она хороша в решении задач.

Причина: после предлога следует использовать gerund.

4-я ошибка: look forward to do

Неправильно:

I look forward to meet you.

Правильно:

I look forward to meeting you.
Я с нетерпением жду встречи с вами.

Причина: в выражении look forward to предлог to, поэтому после него следует использовать V-ing.

5-я ошибка: путаница между stop to do / stop doing

Неправильное утверждение:

He stopped to smoke = Он бросил курить.

Правильно:

He stopped smoking.
Он бросил курить.

He stopped to smoke.
Он остановился, чтобы покурить.

6-я ошибка: непонимание разницы между remember to do / remember doing

I remember locking the door.
Я помню, что закрыл дверь.

Remember to lock the door.
Не забудь закрыть дверь.

Разница:

remember doing — вспоминать о том, что было сделано
remember to do — вспоминать о том, что нужно сделать

11. Разница между Gerund и Infinitive

Состояние | Использование Gerund | Использование Infinitive | Пример | Перевод
Субъект предложения | Да | Реже используется | Reading is useful. | Чтение полезно.
Выражение цели | Нет | Да | I went there to study. | Я пошёл туда, чтобы учиться.
После предлога | Да | Нет | She is good at speaking. | Она хороша в разговоре.
После некоторых глаголов | enjoy, avoid, finish | want, hope, decide | I enjoy reading. / I want to read. | Мне нравится читать. / Я хочу читать.
После прилагательного | Реже | Да | This book is easy to read. | Эта книга легка для чтения.
С too/enough | Нет | Да | He is too tired to work. | Он слишком устал, чтобы работать.
Глаголы с изменением смысла | Прошедшее действие / процесс | Будущая задача / цель | I remember meeting him. / Remember to meet him. | Я помню, что встречался с ним. / Не забудь встретиться с ним.

12. Краткое грамматическое правило

7 простых правил для запоминания темы Gerund / Infinitive:

1. Gerund = V-ing
Например: reading, writing, learning

2. Infinitive = to + V1
Например: to read, to write, to learn

3. Обычно после предлога следует gerund:
good at speaking, interested in learning

4. При выражении цели используется infinitive:
I went there to study.

5. После глаголов, таких как enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, mind, следует gerund.

6. После глаголов, таких как want, hope, decide, agree, promise, plan, следует infinitive.

7. У некоторых глаголов изменение формы меняет и смысл:
stop smoking — бросить курить
stop to smoke — остановиться, чтобы покурить
grammar_rules_kk:
1. Gerund degen ne?

Gerund — feyildiń V-ing forması bolıp, gápte kóbinese atlıq xızmetinde qollanıladı.

Yaǵnıy shaklan feyilge uqsaydı, biraq gápte «ne?» degen sorawǵa juwap beredi.

Mısalı:

Reading is useful.
Kitap oqıw paydalı.

Bul gápte reading «oqıw» degen mániste kelgen. Ol háreketti bildiredi, biraq gápte baslawısh xızmetinde turıp.

Gerund forması

Gerund tómendegishe jasaladı:

Verb + ing

Verb | Gerund
read | reading
write | writing
swim | swimming
study | studying
learn | learning
play | playing
speak | speaking

Gerund fe’lga o‘xshaydı, lekin ot vazifasida ishlaydi

I like reading.
Men oqıwı yoqtıraman.

Bu yerda reading «oqıw» degan otqa o‘xshaydı.

Ózbekchaga ko‘pincha quyidagicha tarjima qilinadi:

reading — oqıw
writing — yozıw
swimming — suzıw
learning — órgeniw
teaching — oqıtıw
travelling — sayahat qılıw

Gerundqa 10 ta mısal

1. Reading books improves your vocabulary.
Kitap oqıw so‘z boylıgıñızdı oshıradı.

2. Swimming is good for health.
Suzıw sog‘lıq ushın paydalı.

3. Learning English takes time.
Ingliz tilin órgeniw waqıt talab etedi.

4. Teaching children requires patience.
Bolalarga dars beriw sabr talab etedi.

5. Writing essays helps students think clearly.
Insho yozıw talabalara anıq fikirlawğa yardım etedi.

6. Watching too many videos can waste time.
Juda kóp video kórüw waqıtıñızdı bekor ketkizwi mümkin.

7. Doing homework regularly improves results.
Uy vazıfasın muntazam bajarıw natijalarǵa jaqsı etkiledi.

8. Speaking English every day builds confidence.
Har kúni inglizche gapırıw ishonçnı oshıradı.

9. Studying grammar is important for exams.
Grammatikanı órgeniw imtihonlar ushın muhim.

10. Helping others makes people kinder.
Boshqalara yardım beriw adamnıñ mehribon boluwına sebep boladı.

2. Infinitive nima?

Infinitive — feyldiń asası shaklı. Inglis tilinde infinitive eki xil boladı:

1. To-infinitive

2. Bare infinitive

1. To-infinitive

To-infinitive quyidagicha yasaladı:

to + V1

Mısalı:

to read — oqıw
 to write — yozıw
 to learn — órgeniw
 to speak — gapırıw
 to help — yardım beriw

Mısal:

I want to learn English.
Men ingliz tilin órgeniwdi xoxlayman.

Bul yerda to learn — infinitive.

2. Bare infinitive

Bare infinitive — tosız kelgen feyldiń oddı shaklı.

Mısalı:

go
read
write
study
help

Bare infinitive odatda modal feyllerden keyin qollanıladı:

I can swim.
Men suza alaman.

Bul yerda swim — bare infinitive. Chunki candan keyin to swim emes, swim keladi.

Infinitivega 10 ta mısal

1. I want to study abroad.
Men chet elde oqıwı xoxlayman.

2. She hopes to pass the exam.
U imtihondan ótwi umid etedi.

3. They decided to start a new course.
Ular jańa kurs bastawğa qaror qıldı.

4. We plan to visit Samarkand next month.
Biz kelasi ay Samarqandqa barwı rejalashtırıp jatırmız.

5. He promised to help me.
U menga yardım beriwge wa'da berdi.

6. This topic is easy to understand.
Bul mavzuni túsinwi oson.

7. I went to the library to read.
Men oqıw ushın kutubxonaga bardım.

8. She learned to drive last year.
U ótken jılda mashina haydashnı órgendı.

9. Students need to practise every day.
Oqıwshılar har kúni mashq qılıwı kerek.

10. I don’t know what to do.
Men ne qılıwı bilmeyman.

3. Gerund ishlitiladigan asası holatlar

3.1. Gerund gápniń egası sifatında

Agar ish-harakat gápniń boshında kelip, «ne?» degen sorawǵa juwap bersa, gerund ishlitiladi.

Formula:

V-ing + verb + ...

Mısallar:

1. Swimming is useful.
Suzıw paydalı.

2. Reading helps students learn new words.
Oqıw oqıwshılara jańa so'zlerdi órgeniwge yardım etedi.

3. Studying at night is difficult for some students.
Kechesi oqıw ba'zı studentler ushın qiyin.

4. Learning grammar improves writing.
Grammatikanı órgeniw yozuwnı jaqsılaydı.

5. Speaking in public builds confidence.
Omma aldında gapırıw ishonçnı oshıradı.

3.2. Ayrım fey'llardan keyin gerund ishlitiladi

Ba'zı fey'llardan keyin har doım V-ing keladi.

Mısalı:

enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, mind, keep, consider, admit, deny

Mısallar:

1. I enjoy reading English books.
Men inglizche kitob oqıwı yoqtıraman.

2. She avoids eating fast food.
U fast food yeyiwden qochadı.

3. They finished writing the test.
Ular test yozıwı tugatdı.

4. The teacher suggested revising the topic.
Ustoz mavzuni takrorlawdı taklif etdi.

5. Do you mind opening the window?
Derazanı ochsangiz qarshi emesizmi?

6. He keeps making the same mistake.
U bir xil xatoni takrorlay beredi.

7. We are considering moving to another city.
Biz başka qalağa köchuwdi oylayapmız.

8. She admitted breaking the glass.
U stakanni sindırğanını tan aldı.

9. He denied taking the money.
U pulnı alğanını inkor qıldı.

3.3. Predloglardan keyin gerund ishlitiladi

Ingliz tilinde predlogdan keyin feyl kelsa, odatda V-ing shaklında keladi.

Kóp uchraydıqan predloglı birikmeler:

interested in — qızıqtıru
good at — jaqsı qoldıru
afraid of — qorqıru
before — aldın
after — keyin
without — -masdan
instead of — orınına
about — turalı
for — ushın
of — -dan

Mısallar:

1. She is interested in learning English.
U ingliz tilin o‘rganıwğa qızıqtı.

2. He is good at solving problems.
U masalalardı şeşiwde jaqsı.

3. I am afraid of making mistakes.
Men xato jasawdan qorqamın.

4. Before going to bed, I read a book.
Uxlawdan aldın men kitap oqıymın.

5. After finishing the lesson, we discussed the test.
Darsnı tugatqandan keyin biz testti talqıladıq.

6. She left without saying goodbye.
U xayrlasmasdan ketti.

7. Instead of watching TV, he studied English.
Televizor körüw orınına u ingliz tilin oqıdı.

8. We talked about studying abroad.
Biz şet elde oqıw turalı söylesdik.

9. Thank you for helping me.
Menga yardım bergeniñiz ushın raxmet.

10. He is tired of waiting.
U kutıwdan şarşadı.

3.4. Maxsus birikmalardan keyin gerund qollanıladı

Ba’si maxsus ibiralardan keyin de V-ing qollanıladı.

It’s no use + V-ing

Ma’nısı: foydası joq.

It’s no use crying.
Yıglawdan foyda joq.

It’s no use arguing with him.
Umen talaswdan foyda joq.

It’s worth + V-ing

Ma’nısı: arziydi.

This book is worth reading.
Bul kitap oqıwğa arziydi.

This film is worth watching.
Bul film körüwge arziydi.

Can’t help + V-ing

Ma’nısı: özin toqtata almaydı.

I can’t help laughing.
Men külmesden turolmaymın.

She couldn’t help crying.
U yıglamasdan turolmadı.

Look forward to + V-ing

Ma’nısı: intizarlıqpen kütüw.

I look forward to meeting you.
Sizben uchraşwğa intizarlıqpen kütüwdeyim.

We are looking forward to seeing the results.
Biz natijalarğa körüwge intizarlıqpen kütüwdeyimiz.

E’tibor bering: bul jerde to predlog, sonlıqtan undan keyin V-ing keladi.

Be used to + V-ing

Ma’nısı: köniqkan bolmaq.

I am used to waking up early.
Men erta uyğonıwğa köniqqanım.

She is used to studying at night.
U keşesi oqıwğa köniqqan.

Get used to + V-ing

Ma’nısı: köniqip barmaq.

I am getting used to living in a new city.
Men jańa qala da yashawğa köniqıp barıwdayım.

Students got used to using online platforms.
Studentler onlayn platformalardı qollanıwğa köniqti.

4. Infinitive qollanılatın asası holatlar

4.1. Maqsat bildiriw ushın

Infinitive köpinşe “ne ushın?” degen sorawğa juwap beredi.

Formula:

to + V1

Mısallar:

1. I went to the library to study.
Men oqıw ushın kutubxanğa bardım.

2. She called me to ask a question.
U savol soraw ushın menga qoñğıraq qıldı.

3. They came here to meet the teacher.
Ular ustazmen uchraşw ushın bul jerge keldi.

4. We use dictionaries to learn new words.
Biz jańa so‘zlerdi oqıw ushın lug‘atlardı qollanamız.

5. He works hard to support his family.
U oylasın qo‘llaw ushın qattı jumıs isteydi.

4.2. Ayrım feylardın keyin infinitive qollanıladı

Ba’si feylardın keyin odatda to + V1 keladi.

Mısalı:

want, hope, decide, agree, promise, plan, refuse, offer, manage, learn

Mısallar:

1. I want to improve my English.
Men ingliz tilimni jaqsılaştıruwıñı xoxlaymın.

2. She hopes to enter university.
U universitetke kirwdi umıt etedi.

3. They decided to take the exam.
Ular imtihon alwğa qarar aldı.

4. He agreed to help us.
U bizge yardım beriwge razı boldu.

5. I promise to call you tomorrow.
Men erten sizge qoñğıraq etiwge wa’dı beremin.

6. We plan to start a new project.
Biz jańa proyekt başlawdı rejalastıramız.

7. She refused to answer the question.
U savolğa juwap beriwden bas tarttı.

8. He offered to carry my bag.
U sumkamnı köteriwdi taklif qıldı.

9. They managed to finish the work on time.
Ular jumıstı waqıtında tugatwğa muvafaq bolğan.

10. I learned to drive last year.
Men ötkən jılda mashina haydawdı úyrenip aldım.

4.3. Sıfatdan keyin infinitive qollanıladı

Ba’si sıfatlar infinitive men qollanıladı.

Formula:

adjective + to + V1

Mısallar:

1. I am happy to help you.
Men sizge yardım beriwden xursandım.

2. This rule is easy to understand.
Bul qaida túsinwge osan.

3. This problem is difficult to solve.
Bul masala şeşiwge qıyın.

4. She was surprised to see me.
U meni körip hayran bolğan.

5. Students are ready to start the lesson.
Oqıwshılar darsnı başlawğa tayyar.

6. It is important to practise every day.
Hár kúni mashq etiw muhim.

7. It is necessary to follow the rules.
Qaidağa amal etiw zarur.

4.4. Too / enough men infinitive qollanıladı

Too + adjective + to + V1

Ma’nısı: juda ... bolğandıqdan qıla almaydı.

He is too tired to study.
U oqıw ushın juda şarşagan.

This text is too difficult to translate.
Bul matn tarjıma etiw ushın juda qıyın.

She is too young to drive.
U mashina haydaw ushın juda josh.

Adjective + enough + to + V1

Ma’nısı: biror işti qıluw ushın jetarlicha ...

He is old enough to drive.
U mashina haydaw ushın jetarlicha ulken.

U aqıllı bolıp, bul masalani yechip aladı.
U bu masalani yechish uchun yetarlicha aqlli.

Xona 50 studentti sig‘dırıp aluw ushın yetarlicha úlken.
Xona 50 ta o‘quvchini sig‘dirish uchun yetarlicha katta.

4.5. Soraw so‘zlardan keyin infinitive qollanıladı

Tómendegı so‘zlardan keyin to + V1 kelwi mümkin:

what to do — ne qılıw
how to solve — qanday yechiw
where to go — qay jerge barw
when to start — qashan bastaw
which book to choose — qaysı kitapnı tanlaw

Mısallar:

1. Men ne qılıwımnı bilmeymin.
Men nima qilishni bilmayman.

2. U bul masalani qanday yechiwni bilip aladı.
U bu masalani qanday yechishni biladi.

3. Biz qay jerge barwımızdı hal etkenimiz joq.
Biz qayerga borishni hal qilganimiz yo‘q.

4. Qashan bastawımnı menga ayt.
Qachon boshlashni menga ayting.

5. O‘quvshılar qaysı mavzunı takrorlawdı soradı.
O‘quvchilar qaysi mavzuni takrorlashni so‘rashdi.

5. Faqat Gerund talab etiwshi feyllar

Tómendegı feyllardan keyin odatda V-ing qollanıladı.

Feyl | Ma’nısı | Mısal
enjoy | jaqsı körüw | I enjoy reading novels. — Men roman o‘qishni yoqtiraman.
avoid | qochiw | He avoids making mistakes. — U xato qilishdan qochadı.
finish | tugatw | She finished writing the report. — U hisobot yozuwdı tugatdı.
suggest | taklif etiw | They suggested going by train. — Ular poyezdda barwı taklif etti.
mind | qarşı boliw | Do you mind closing the door? — Eshikni yopwğa qarşı emesizmi?
keep | dawam etiw | He kept talking during the lesson. — U dars davomında gapırwda dawam etti.
consider | oylap körüw | We are considering opening a new group. — Biz jańa gurup açwı oylap turamız.
admit | tanıw | She admitted cheating in the test. — U testte ko‘chirgenin tanıdı.
deny | inkor etiw | He denied breaking the window. — U oynanı sindirgenin inkor etdi.
postpone | kechiktiriw | They postponed holding the meeting. — Ular uchraşuwdı kechiktirdi.
practise | mashq etiw | O‘quvshılar har kúni ingliz tilinde gapırwı mashq etedi. — O‘quvchilar har kuni inglizcha gapirishni mashq qilishadi.
risk | tavakkal etiw | You risk losing marks. — Sen ball yo‘qotw xavfına barasan.
miss | sog‘ınw / yoq bolwın his etiw | I miss studying with my old classmates. — Men eski sinfdoshlarım menen oqıwı sog‘ındım.
imagine | kóz aldıńızǵa keltiriw | Imagine living in London. — Londonda yashawdı kóz aldıńızǵa keltiriń.

6. Faqat Infinitive talab etiwshi feyllar

Tómendegı feyllardan keyin odatda to + V1 qollanıladı.

Feyl | Ma’nısı | Mısal
want | xohlaw | I want to learn English. — Men ingliz tilin o‘rganwı xohlayman.
hope | umid etiw | She hopes to pass the exam. — U imtihondan o‘tuwı umid etedi.
decide | qarar etiw | They decided to study abroad. — Ular chet elde oqıwğa qarar etti.
agree | rozi boliw | He agreed to help us. — U bizge yardım etiwge rozi bolğan.
promise | wa’da beriw | I promise to be on time. — Men waqıtında bolwğa wa’da beremin.
plan | rejalashtırw | We plan to open a new course. — Biz jańa kurs açwı rejalashtıramız.
refuse | bosh tortw | She refused to answer. — U javob beriwden bosh torttı.
offer | taklif etiw | He offered to explain the rule. — U qoidanı túsindiriwni taklif etdi.
manage | uddalaw | They managed to finish the task. — Ular topshırıwı tugatwğa muvaffaq bolğan.
learn | o‘rganw | I learned to swim when I was ten. — Men o‘n yoshımda suzuwı o‘rgendim.
expect | kutw | We expect to get good results. — Biz jaqsı natijalar alwı kutamız.
afford | qurbi yetiw | I can’t afford to buy a new laptop. — Men jańa noutbuk satıp alwğa qurbi yetpeydi.
choose | tanlaw | She chose to study biology. — U biologiyani o‘qıwı tanladı.
prepare | tayyorlanw | O‘quvshılar test topshirwğa tayyorlanwda.
O‘quvchilar test topshirishga tayyorlanishdi.

7. Gerund hám, Infinitive hám kelwi mümkin feyllar

Baǵı feyllardan keyin hám gerund, hám infinitive kelwi mümkin. Kóbinese ma‘no deyarli ózgermeydi.

Like

I like reading books.
Men kitob o‘qıwı jaqsı körimen.

I like to read books.
Men kitob o‘qıwı jaqsı körimen.

Farq juda katta emes. Kúnlik gápte ikkalası hám qollanıladı.

Love

She loves dancing.
U raqsqa túswı juda jaqsı köradi.

She loves to dance.
U raqsqa túswı juda jaqsı köradi.

Hate

He hates waiting.
U kutwı yaman köradi.

He hates to wait.
U kutwı yaman köradi.

Prefer

I prefer studying in the morning.
Men erteláb o‘qıwı afzal körimen.

I prefer to study in the morning.
Men erteláb o‘qıwı afzal körimen.

Start

It started raining.
Yomğır yağıp bastadı.

It started to rain.
Yomğır yağıp bastadı.

Begin

She began crying.
U yıglawı bastadı.

She began to cry.
U yıglawı bastadı.

Continue

They continued working.
Ular ishlawda dawam etiwde.

They continued to work.
Ular ishlawda dawam etiwde.

8. Gerund hám Infinitive kelgende ma‘nısı ózgere aladı feyllar

Baǵı feyllardan keyin gerund yaki infinitive kelwi arqalı ma‘no ózgere aladı. Bul abituriyentler hám talabalar ushın juda muhim.

Fe’l | Gerund bilan ma’nosi | Infinitive bilan ma’nosi | Inglizcha misol | Tarjima
remember | Ötkende qilğan işni eslemek | Keljekte qılış kerekligini eslemek | I remember meeting him. | Men u bilen uchraşqanımnı esleyimen.
remember | Remember to call me. | Menga qońğıroq qılışnı unutma.
forget | Ötkende qilğan işni unutmaq | Keljekte qılış kerek bolğan işni unutmaq | I forgot meeting her before. | Men u bilen aldin uchraşqanımnı unutıpman.
forget | Don’t forget to do your homework. | Uy vazifangnı qılışnı unutma.
stop | Bir işni toxtatmaq | Başqa iş qılış üşin toxtamaq | He stopped smoking. | U çekişnı taşladı.
stop | He stopped to smoke. | U çekiş üşin toxtadı.
try | Biror usulnı sinap körmek | Háreket qılış, urinmaq | Try drinking warm water. | Iliq suv içip kör.
try | Try to solve this problem. | Bu masalnı yeçişke háreket qıl.
regret | Ötkende qilğan işinen afsuslanmaq | Yaman habar berişten afsuslanmaq | I regret wasting my time. | Men vaqtımnı bekár sarflap alğanımdan afsuslanımen.
regret | I regret to inform you that you failed. | Sizge afsus bilen şunı ma’lum qilamanki, siz öta almadıñız.
go on | Bir işni davam ettirmek | Keyin başka işke ötmek | He went on speaking. | U gapırışta davam etdi.
go on | He went on to explain the next rule. | U keyingi qaǵıdani túsindirişke ötüdi.

9. Bare infinitive ishlatiladigan holatlar

Bare infinitive — tosız V1 şekli.

9.1. Modal fe’llardan keyin

Modal fe’llar:

can, could, may, might, must, should, would

Ularñan keyin to ishlatilmaydı.

Mısallar:

1. I can swim.
Men suza alaman.

2. She could read when she was five.
U besh yaşında oqıy alardı.

3. You may leave now.
Siz hozir ketip bolasız.

4. It might rain tomorrow.
Ertaga yomğır yağışı mümkin.

5. Students must follow the rules.
Oqıwshılar qaǵıdalarga amal qılışları şart.

6. You should study every day.
Sen hár kúni oqıwıñ kerek.

7. I would help you if I had time.
Vaqtım bolğanında, sana yardım bergan bolardım.

9.2. Let, make, help fe’llarından keyin

Let + object + V1

My parents let me go out.
Ata-anam menga taşqarıga çıxışqa ruxsat berdiler.

Let him speak.
Ona gapırışqa ruxsat beriñiz.

Make + object + V1

The teacher made us rewrite the test.
Ustaz bizge testni qayta yazdırdı.

This film made me cry.
Bu film meni yıqlattı.

Help + object + V1 / to V1

Helpdan keyin ikkisi de mümkin:

She helped me solve the problem.
U menga masalani yeçişke yardım berdi.

She helped me to solve the problem.
U menga masalani yeçişke yardım berdi.

9.3. Had better va would rather dan keyin

Had better + V1

Ma’nısı: yaxşısı ... qilğan ma’qul.

You had better study tonight.
Yaxşısı, búgin kechqurun oqıwıñ ma’qul.

We had better leave early.
Yaxşısı, erta chiqqanımız ma’qul.

Would rather + V1

Ma’nısı: afzal qılmaq.

I would rather stay at home.
Men uyda qolışnı afzal qılaman.

She would rather study alone.
U yolğız oqıwı afzal qılaydı.

10. Gerund / Infinitive mavzusida kóp qilınadıqan xatolar

1-xato: enjoy to do

Notoğrı:

I enjoy to read books.

Toğrı:

I enjoy reading books.
Men kitap oqıwı yoqtıraman.

Sebab: enjoydan keyin gerund keladi.

2-xato: want doing

Notoğrı:

I want learning English.

Toğrı:

I want to learn English.
Men ingilis tilin oǵrenmekçi bolaman.

Sebab: wantdan keyin infinitive keladi.

3-xato: preposition + to V1

Notoğrı:

She is good at to solve problems.

Toğrı:

She is good at solving problems.
U masalalar yeçişte jaqsı.

Sebab: predlogdan keyin gerund keladi.

4-xato: look forward to do

Notoğrı:

I look forward to meet you.

Toğrı:

I look forward to meeting you.
Siz bilen uchraşışnı intizorlıq bilen kutıypman.

Sebab: look forward to birikmesindegi to predlog, sonlıqtan undan keyin V-ing keladi.

5-xato: stop to do / stop doing ma’nolarını adashtırmaq

Notoğrı fikr:

He stopped to smoke = U çekişni taşladı.

Toğrı:

He stopped smoking.
U çekişni taşladı.

He stopped to smoke.
U çekiş üşin toxtadı.

6-xato: remember to do / remember doing farqını túsinmeslik

I remember locking the door.
Men esikni qulflaganımnı esleyimen.

Remember to lock the door.
Eşikni qulflashnı unutma.

Farq:

remember doing — qilğan işni eslemek
remember to do — qılış kerekligini eslemek

11. Gerund va Infinitive farqi

Holat | Gerund qollanılışı | Infinitive qollanılışı | Mısal | Tarjima
Gápniń egası | Ha | Kamraq qollanıladı | Reading is useful. | Oqıw paydalı.
Maqsad bildiriw | Yoq | Ha | I went there to study. | Men u yerge oqıw ushın bordım.
Predlogdan keyin | Ha | Yoq | She is good at speaking. | U gapırwda jaqsı.
Baǵı fe'llardan keyin | enjoy, avoid, finish | want, hope, decide | I enjoy reading. / I want to read. | Men oqıwı yoqtıraman. / Men oqıwı qılaman.
Kelbetlikten keyin | Kamraq | Ha | This book is easy to read. | Bul kitapnı oqıw oson.
Too/enough bilen | Yoq | Ha | He is too tired to work. | U jumıs istew ushın juda charchap qaldı.
Ma'nısı özgeriwshi fe'llar | O'tmıstaǵı ish / jarayón | Kelěşektegi vazıfa / maqsat | I remember meeting him. / Remember to meet him. | Men u bilán uchraşqanımnı eslayman. / U bilán uchraşwı unutma.

12. Qısqa grammatik qaǵıda

Gerund / Infinitive mavzusın eslep qalıw ushın 7 ta sodda qaǵıda:

1. Gerund = V-ing
Mısalı: reading, writing, learning

2. Infinitive = to + V1
Mısalı: to read, to write, to learn

3. Predlogdan keyin odatda gerund keladi:
good at speaking, interested in learning

4. Maqsad bildirgende infinitive qollanıladı:
I went there to study.

5. Enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, mind kabi fe'llardan keyin gerund keladi.

6. Want, hope, decide, agree, promise, plan kabi fe'llardan keyin infinitive keladi.

7. Baǵı fe'llarda şekil özgerse, ma'no ham özgeredi:
stop smoking — chekişni toqtatmaq
stop to smoke — chekiş ushın toqtamaq
reading_passage:
The student magazine has a new feature on what motivates a software engineer. It begins with a situation from a technology careers podcast.

A software engineer describes enjoying difficult problems more than repeating simple tasks. She likes working with users because their feedback helps her understand real needs.

She decided to study programming after learning to build a small website at school. She now wants to lead a team but continues to enjoy writing code herself.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Lena enjoys solving problems and wants to become a software engineer.” The interview shows that a technology career can involve both technical and communication skills.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Lena and Sam compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.
