grammar_rules:
Ingliz tilida kelajak haqida gapirishning bir nechta yo‘li bor. O‘zbek tilida ko‘pincha “boraman”, “qilaman”, “bo‘ladi” kabi shakllar ishlatiladi. Ingliz tilida esa vaziyatga qarab turli grammatik shakllar tanlanadi.

Kelajakni ifodalashda eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan 3 ta shakl:

1. Will

2. Be going to

3. Present Continuous for future

Ularning hammasi kelajak haqida gapiradi, lekin ma’nosi va ishlatilish holati bir xil emas.

Qisqa farq

Shakl | Asosiy ma’no | Misol | Tarjima
Will | Hozir qaror qilingan ish, va’da, taxmin | I will help you. | Men senga yordam beraman.
Be going to | Oldindan reja yoki dalilga asoslangan taxmin | I am going to study medicine. | Men tibbiyotda o‘qimoqchiman.
Present Continuous | Vaqti yoki joyi aniq kelishilgan kelajakdagi reja | I am meeting my teacher tomorrow. | Men ertaga ustozim bilan uchrashyapman.

Juda sodda tushuncha

Will — hozir qaror qilsang yoki shunchaki taxmin qilsang ishlatiladi.
Be going to — oldindan niyating yoki rejang bo‘lsa ishlatiladi.
Present Continuous — kelajakdagi aniq kelishilgan reja bo‘lsa ishlatiladi.

2. “Will” nima va qachon ishlatiladi?

“Will” nima?

Will kelajak haqida gapirish uchun ishlatiladigan yordamchi fe’ldir. Undan keyin fe’lning oddiy shakli, ya’ni V1 keladi.

Formula:

Subject + will + V1

Misol:

I will study.
Men o‘qiyman.

Bu yerda:

• I — ega

• will — kelajak yordamchi fe’li

• study — asosiy fe’l

a) Gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilingan qaror

Agar qaror aynan gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilinsa, will ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. I am tired. I will take a short break.
Men charchadim. Men qisqa tanaffus qilaman.

2. The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
Telefon jiringlayapti. Men unga javob beraman.

3. I forgot my pen. I will borrow one from my friend.
Men ruchkamni unutibman. Men do‘stimdan bittasini olaman.

b) Va’da berish

Va’da berganda will ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. I will always support you.
Men seni doim qo‘llab-quvvatlayman.

2. I will finish the homework today.
Men uy vazifasini bugun tugataman.

3. I will not be late again.
Men boshqa kechikmayman.

c) Taklif qilish

Biror ishni qilishni taklif qilganda yoki kimnidir biror narsaga taklif qilganda will ishlatilishi mumkin.

Misollar:

1. Will you join us for dinner?
Kechki ovqatda bizga qo‘shilasizmi?

2. Will you come to the meeting tomorrow?
Ertaga yig‘ilishga kelasizmi?

3. Will you have some tea?
Choy ichasizmi?

d) Yordam taklif qilish

Kimgadir yordam berishni taklif qilganda ham will ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. I will help you with your English.
Men senga ingliz tilidan yordam beraman.

2. I will carry your bag.
Men sumkangni ko‘tarib beraman.

3. I will explain this grammar rule again.
Men bu grammatik qoidani yana tushuntirib beraman.

e) Taxmin qilish

Agar dalil bo‘lmasa, shunchaki o‘ylab taxmin qilsak, will ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. I think he will pass the exam.
Menimcha, u imtihondan o‘tadi.

2. She will probably come late.
U ehtimol kech keladi.

3. It will be difficult, but we can do it.
Bu qiyin bo‘ladi, lekin biz buni qila olamiz.

f) Kelajak haqidagi umumiy fikr

Kelajak haqida umumiy fikr bildirganda will ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. People will use more technology in education.
Odamlar ta’limda ko‘proq texnologiyadan foydalanadi.

2. English will be important in the future.
Ingliz tili kelajakda muhim bo‘ladi.

3. Many students will study online.
Ko‘p talabalar onlayn o‘qiydi.

“Be going to” nima va qachon ishlatiladi?

“Be going to” nima?

Be going to kelajakdagi reja, niyat yoki dalilga asoslangan taxminni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

Bu shaklda be fe’li ega bilan moslashadi:

• I am going to

• He / She / It is going to

• You / We / They are going to

Misol:

I am going to learn English.
Men ingliz tilini o‘rganmoqchiman.

Bu gapda odam oldindan niyat qilgan.

a) Oldindan rejalashtirilgan niyat

Agar biror ishni oldindan reja qilgan bo‘lsak, be going to ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. I am going to prepare for IELTS.
Men IELTSga tayyorlanmoqchiman.

2. She is going to study medicine.
U tibbiyotda o‘qimoqchi.

3. We are going to open a new English group.
Biz yangi ingliz tili guruhi ochmoqchimiz.

b) Aniq belgi yoki dalilga asoslangan taxmin

Agar ko‘zimiz bilan dalilni ko‘rsak yoki vaziyatdan natija aniq ko‘rinsa, be going to ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
Bulutlarga qarang. Yomg‘ir yog‘moqchi.

2. He is driving very fast. He is going to have an accident.
U juda tez haydayapti. U avariya qilmoqchi.

3. The student didn’t study. He is going to fail the test.
O‘quvchi o‘qimadi. U testdan yiqilmoqchi.

c) Yaqin kelajakda sodir bo‘lishi aniq ko‘rinayotgan ish-harakat

Agar biror narsa juda yaqin va deyarli aniq bo‘lsa, be going to ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. The glass is on the edge. It is going to fall.
Stakan chekkada turibdi. U tushib ketmoqchi.

2. The baby is very sleepy. He is going to sleep soon.
Chaqaloq juda uyquchan. U tez orada uxlamoqchi.

3. The teacher is already in the classroom. The lesson is going to start.
O‘qituvchi allaqachon sinfda. Dars boshlanmoqchi.

Present Continuous kelajak ma’nosida

Present Continuous nima?

Present Continuous odatda hozir davom etayotgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Misol:

I am studying now.
Men hozir o‘qiyapman.

Lekin Present Continuous kelajakdagi aniq kelishilgan reja uchun ham ishlatiladi.

Bu ayniqsa quyidagi holatlarda ko‘p ishlatiladi:

• uchrashuv

• sayohat

• dars

• imtihon

• meeting

• appointment

• interview

• rejalashtirilgan tadbir

• oldindan belgilangan vaqt va joy

Muhim fikr

Present Continuous kelajak uchun ishlatilganda, odatda vaqt ko‘rsatkichi bo‘ladi:

• tomorrow

• tonight

• next week

• on Monday

• at 5 o’clock

• this evening

Misollar:

1. I am meeting my teacher tomorrow.
Men ertaga ustozim bilan uchrashyapman.

2. She is taking an exam next week.
U kelasi hafta imtihon topshiryapti.

3. We are flying to Istanbul on Friday.
Biz juma kuni Istanbulga uchyapmiz.

4. They are having a meeting at 3 o’clock.
Ular soat 3 da yig‘ilish o‘tkazyapti.

5. He is visiting his doctor this evening.
U bugun kechqurun shifokoriga boryapti.

6. I am starting a new course next month.
Men kelasi oy yangi kurs boshlayapman.

7. We are watching a film with our group tonight.
Biz bugun kechqurun guruhimiz bilan film ko‘ryapmiz.

8. My parents are coming to Urgench tomorrow.
Ota-onam ertaga Urganchga kelishyapti.

9. The students are presenting their projects on Monday.
Talabalar dushanba kuni loyihalarini taqdim qilishyapti.

10. I am having an interview next Tuesday.
Men kelasi seshanba kuni suhbatdan o‘tyapman.

Will / Be going to / Present Continuous farqi

Shakl | Tuzilma | Asosiy ma’no | Qachon ishlatiladi? | Misol | Tarjima
Will | Subject + will + V1 | Hozirgi qaror, va’da, taxmin | Gapirayotgan paytda qaror qilinsa yoki dalilsiz taxmin bo‘lsa | I will call you later. | Men senga keyinroq qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.
Be going to | Subject + am/is/are + going to + V1 | Oldindan reja yoki dalilli taxmin | Oldindan niyat bo‘lsa yoki dalil ko‘rinib tursa | I am going to buy a new book. | Men yangi kitob sotib olmoqchiman.
Present Continuous | Subject + am/is/are + V-ing | Aniq kelishilgan reja | Vaqt, joy yoki kelishuv aniq bo‘lsa | I am meeting my teacher at 5. | Men soat 5 da ustozim bilan uchrashyapman.

9. Eng muhim farqlar

1) Spontaneous decision — Will

Ya’ni qaror hozir, gapirayotgan paytda qabul qilinadi.

Misollar:

1. I am hungry. I will make a sandwich.
Men och qoldim. Men sendvich tayyorlayman.

2. This exercise is difficult. I will ask my teacher.
Bu mashq qiyin. Men ustozimdan so‘rayman.

3. It is cold here. I will close the window.
Bu yer sovuq. Men derazani yopaman.

2) Prior plan / intention — Be going to

Oldindan niyat yoki reja bo‘lsa, be going to ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. I am going to learn Korean next year.
Men kelasi yili koreys tilini o‘rganmoqchiman.

2. She is going to apply to medical university.
U tibbiyot universitetiga hujjat topshirmoqchi.

3. We are going to organize a seminar.
Biz seminar tashkil qilmoqchimiz.

3) Fixed arrangement — Present Continuous

Vaqt, joy yoki kelishuv aniq bo‘lsa, Present Continuous ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. I am meeting my tutor at 4 o’clock.
Men soat 4 da repetitorim bilan uchrashyapman.

2. They are leaving for Samarkand tomorrow morning.
Ular ertaga ertalab Samarqandga ketishyapti.

3. We are having a speaking club on Saturday.
Biz shanba kuni speaking club o‘tkazyapmiz.
grammar_rules_en:
There are several ways to talk about the future in English. In Uzbek, forms like “boraman”, “qilaman”, “bo‘ladi” are usually enough. In English, though, different grammatical forms are chosen depending on the situation.

The 3 most common forms for the future:

1. Will

2. Be going to

3. Present Continuous for future

All of them talk about the future, but their meaning and use are not the same.

A quick difference

Form | Main meaning | Example | Translation
Will | A decision made at the moment, promise, assumption | I will help you. | Men senga yordam beraman.
Be going to | An assumption based on a prior plan or evidence | I am going to study medicine. | Men tibbiyotda o‘qimoqchiman.
Present Continuous | A planned future event with a specific time or place | I am meeting my teacher tomorrow. | Men ertaga ustozim bilan uchrashyapman.

A very simple idea

Will is used when you make a decision at the moment or just assume something.
Be going to is used when you have a prior intention or plan.
Present Continuous is used for a specific planned event in the future.

2. What is “Will” and when is it used?

What is “Will”?

Will is an auxiliary verb used to talk about the future. It is followed by the base form of the verb, that is V1.

Formula:

Subject + will + V1

Example:

I will study.
Men o‘qiyman.

Here:

• I — subject

• will — future auxiliary verb

• study — main verb

a) A decision made while speaking

If a decision is made exactly at the moment of speaking, will is used.

Examples:

1. I am tired. I will take a short break.
Men charchadim. Men qisqa tanaffus qilaman.

2. The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
Telefon jiringlayapti. Men unga javob beraman.

3. I forgot my pen. I will borrow one from my friend.
Men ruchkamni unutibman. Men do‘stimdan bittasini olaman.

b) Making a promise

Will is used when making a promise.

Examples:

1. I will always support you.
Men seni doim qo‘llab-quvvatlayman.

2. I will finish the homework today.
Men uy vazifasini bugun tugataman.

3. I will not be late again.
Men boshqa kechikmayman.

c) Making an offer

Will can be used when offering to do something or inviting someone to do something.

Examples:

1. Will you join us for dinner?
Kechki ovqatda bizga qo‘shilasizmi?

2. Will you come to the meeting tomorrow?
Ertaga yig‘ilishga kelasizmi?

3. Will you have some tea?
Choy ichasizmi?

d) Offering help

Will is also used when offering help to someone.

Examples:

1. I will help you with your English.
Men senga ingliz tilidan yordam beraman.

2. I will carry your bag.
Men sumkangni ko‘tarib beraman.

3. I will explain this grammar rule again.
Men bu grammatik qoidani yana tushuntirib beraman.

e) Making an assumption

If there is no evidence, will is used when we just think or assume something.

Examples:

1. I think he will pass the exam.
Menimcha, u imtihondan o‘tadi.

2. She will probably come late.
U ehtimol kech keladi.

3. It will be difficult, but we can do it.
Bu qiyin bo‘ladi, lekin biz buni qila olamiz.

f) General thoughts about the future

Will is used when expressing a general thought about the future.

Examples:

1. People will use more technology in education.
Odamlar ta’limda ko‘proq texnologiyadan foydalanadi.

2. English will be important in the future.
Ingliz tili kelajakda muhim bo‘ladi.

3. Many students will study online.
Ko‘p talabalar onlayn o‘qiydi.

What is “Be going to” and when is it used?

What is “Be going to”?

Be going to is used to express a plan, intention, or assumption based on evidence in the future.

In this form, the verb be agrees with the subject:

• I am going to

• He / She / It is going to

• You / We / They are going to

Example:

I am going to learn English.
Men ingliz tilini o‘rganmoqchiman.

In this sentence, the person has made a prior intention.

a) A prior planned intention

If we have planned to do something in advance, be going to is used.

Examples:

1. I am going to prepare for IELTS.
Men IELTSga tayyorlanmoqchiman.

2. She is going to study medicine.
U tibbiyotda o‘qimoqchi.

3. We are going to open a new English group.
Biz yangi ingliz tili guruhi ochmoqchimiz.

b) An assumption based on a clear sign or evidence

If we see evidence with our own eyes or the result is clear from the situation, be going to is used.

Examples:

1. Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
Bulutlarga qarang. Yomg‘ir yog‘moqchi.

2. He is driving very fast. He is going to have an accident.
U juda tez haydayapti. U avariya qilmoqchi.

3. The student didn’t study. He is going to fail the test.
O‘quvchi o‘qimadi. U testdan yiqilmoqchi.

c) An action that is clearly going to happen in the near future

If something is very close and almost certain, be going to is used.

Examples:

1. The glass is on the edge. It is going to fall.
Stakan chekkada turibdi. U tushib ketmoqchi.

2. The baby is very sleepy. He is going to sleep soon.
Chaqaloq juda uyquchan. U tez orada uxlamoqchi.

3. The teacher is already in the classroom. The lesson is going to start.
The teacher is already in the classroom. The lesson is going to start.

Present Continuous in the future meaning

What is Present Continuous?

Present Continuous usually indicates an action that is currently ongoing.

Example:

I am studying now.
I am studying now.

However, Present Continuous is also used for a specific planned arrangement in the future.

This is especially common in the following situations:

• meeting

• travel

• lesson

• exam

• meeting

• appointment

• interview

• planned event

• predetermined time and place

Important point

When Present Continuous is used for the future, there is usually a time indicator:

• tomorrow

• tonight

• next week

• on Monday

• at 5 o’clock

• this evening

Examples:

1. I am meeting my teacher tomorrow.
I am meeting my teacher tomorrow.

2. She is taking an exam next week.
She is taking an exam next week.

3. We are flying to Istanbul on Friday.
We are flying to Istanbul on Friday.

4. They are having a meeting at 3 o’clock.
They are having a meeting at 3 o’clock.

5. He is visiting his doctor this evening.
He is visiting his doctor this evening.

6. I am starting a new course next month.
I am starting a new course next month.

7. We are watching a film with our group tonight.
We are watching a film with our group tonight.

8. My parents are coming to Urgench tomorrow.
My parents are coming to Urgench tomorrow.

9. The students are presenting their projects on Monday.
The students are presenting their projects on Monday.

10. I am having an interview next Tuesday.
I am having an interview next Tuesday.

Difference between Will / Be going to / Present Continuous

Form | Structure | Main meaning | When is it used? | Example | Translation
Will | Subject + will + V1 | Current decision, promise, assumption | If the decision is made while speaking or if it is an assumption without evidence | I will call you later. | I will call you later.
Be going to | Subject + am/is/are + going to + V1 | Pre-planned intention or evidence-based assumption | If there is a prior intention or evidence is visible | I am going to buy a new book. | I am going to buy a new book.
Present Continuous | Subject + am/is/are + V-ing | Specific planned arrangement | If the time, place, or agreement is clear | I am meeting my teacher at 5. | I am meeting my teacher at 5.

9. The most important differences

1) Spontaneous decision — Will

That is, the decision is made now, while speaking.

Examples:

1. I am hungry. I will make a sandwich.
I am hungry. I will make a sandwich.

2. This exercise is difficult. I will ask my teacher.
This exercise is difficult. I will ask my teacher.

3. It is cold here. I will close the window.
It is cold here. I will close the window.

2) Prior plan / intention — Be going to

If there is a prior intention or plan, be going to is used.

Examples:

1. I am going to learn Korean next year.
I am going to learn Korean next year.

2. She is going to apply to medical university.
She is going to apply to medical university.

3. We are going to organize a seminar.
We are going to organize a seminar.

3) Fixed arrangement — Present Continuous

If the time, place, or agreement is clear, Present Continuous is used.

Examples:

1. I am meeting my tutor at 4 o’clock.
I am meeting my tutor at 4 o’clock.

2. They are leaving for Samarkand tomorrow morning.
They are leaving for Samarkand tomorrow morning.

3. We are having a speaking club on Saturday.
We are having a speaking club on Saturday.
grammar_rules_ru:
В английском языке есть несколько способов говорить о будущем. В узбекском языке обычно используются формы вроде «бораман», «қиламан», «бўлади». В английском же в зависимости от ситуации выбираются разные грамматические формы.

Три наиболее часто используемые формы для выражения будущего:

1. Will

2. Be going to

3. Present Continuous for future

Все они говорят о будущем, но их значение и случаи употребления не одинаковы.

Коротко о разнице

Форма | Основное значение | Пример | Перевод
Will | Решение принятое в данный момент, обещание, предположение | I will help you. | Я помогу тебе.
Be going to | Предположение основанное на заранее запланированном намерении или доказательстве | I am going to study medicine. | Я собираюсь учиться на врача.
Present Continuous | Конкретный запланированный будущий план | I am meeting my teacher tomorrow. | Я встречаюсь с учителем завтра.

Совсем просто

Will — используется, когда решение принимается в данный момент или просто предполагается.
Be going to — используется, когда есть заранее запланированное намерение или план.
Present Continuous — используется, когда есть конкретный запланированный будущий план.

2. Что такое “Will” и когда он используется?

Что такое “Will”?

Will — это вспомогательный глагол, используемый для выражения будущего. После него следует основной глагол в простой форме, то есть V1.

Формула:

Подлежащее + will + V1

Пример:

I will study.
Я буду учиться.

Здесь:

• I — подлежащее

• will — вспомогательный глагол будущего времени

• study — основной глагол

a) Решение принятое в момент разговора

Если решение принимается именно в момент разговора, используется will.

Примеры:

1. I am tired. I will take a short break.
Я устал. Я сделаю короткий перерыв.

2. The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
Телефон звонит. Я отвечу на него.

3. I forgot my pen. I will borrow one from my friend.
Я забыл свою ручку. Я одолжу одну у друга.

b) Обещание

При даче обещания используется will.

Примеры:

1. I will always support you.
Я всегда буду тебя поддерживать.

2. I will finish the homework today.
Я закончу домашнее задание сегодня.

3. I will not be late again.
Я больше не опоздаю.

c) Предложение

При предложении сделать что-то или пригласить кого-то на что-то также может использоваться will.

Примеры:

1. Will you join us for dinner?
Вы присоединитесь к нам на ужин?

2. Will you come to the meeting tomorrow?
Вы придете на встречу завтра?

3. Will you have some tea?
Вы выпьете чаю?

d) Предложение помощи

При предложении помочь кому-то также используется will.

Примеры:

1. I will help you with your English.
Я помогу тебе с английским.

2. I will carry your bag.
Я понесу твою сумку.

3. I will explain this grammar rule again.
Я объясню это грамматическое правило снова.

e) Предположение

Если нет доказательства, просто предполагаем, используется will.

Примеры:

1. I think he will pass the exam.
Я думаю, он сдаст экзамен.

2. She will probably come late.
Она, вероятно, придет поздно.

3. It will be difficult, but we can do it.
Это будет сложно, но мы сможем это сделать.

f) Общее мнение о будущем

При выражении общего мнения о будущем используется will.

Примеры:

1. People will use more technology in education.
Люди будут использовать больше технологий в образовании.

2. English will be important in the future.
Английский язык будет важен в будущем.

3. Many students will study online.
Многие студенты будут учиться онлайн.

Что такое “Be going to” и когда он используется?

Что такое “Be going to”?

Be going to используется для выражения будущего плана, намерения или предположения, основанного на доказательствах.

В этой форме глагол be согласуется с подлежащим:

• I am going to

• He / She / It is going to

• You / We / They are going to

Пример:

I am going to learn English.
Я собираюсь учить английский.

В этом предложении человек заранее намеревался.

a) Заранее запланированное намерение

Если мы заранее запланировали что-то, используется be going to.

Примеры:

1. I am going to prepare for IELTS.
Я собираюсь готовиться к IELTS.

2. She is going to study medicine.
Она собирается учиться на врача.

3. We are going to open a new English group.
Мы собираемся открыть новую группу по английскому языку.

b) Предположение, основанное на конкретном признаке или доказательстве

Если мы видим доказательство или результат ситуации очевиден, используется be going to.

Примеры:

1. Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
Посмотрите на облака. Скоро пойдет дождь.

2. He is driving very fast. He is going to have an accident.
Он едет очень быстро. Он собирается попасть в аварию.

3. The student didn’t study. He is going to fail the test.
Студент не учился. Он провалит тест.

c) Действие, которое явно произойдет в ближайшем будущем

Если что-то очень близко и почти очевидно, используется be going to.

Примеры:

1. The glass is on the edge. It is going to fall.
Стакан стоит на краю. Он собирается упасть.

2. The baby is very sleepy. He is going to sleep soon.
Младенец очень сонный. Он скоро уснет.

3. Учитель уже в классе. Урок собирается начаться.
O‘qituvchi allaqachon sinfda. Dars boshlanmoqchi.

Present Continuous в значении будущего

Что такое Present Continuous?

Present Continuous обычно обозначает действие, которое происходит сейчас.

Пример:

I am studying now.
Men hozir o‘qiyapman.

Но Present Continuous также используется для обозначения четко запланированного события в будущем.

Это особенно часто используется в следующих случаях:

• встреча

• поездка

• урок

• экзамен

• meeting

• appointment

• interview

• запланированное мероприятие

• заранее установленное время и место

Важная мысль

Когда Present Continuous используется для будущего, обычно присутствует указатель времени:

• tomorrow

• tonight

• next week

• on Monday

• at 5 o’clock

• this evening

Примеры:

1. I am meeting my teacher tomorrow.
Men ertaga ustozim bilan uchrashyapman.

2. She is taking an exam next week.
U kelasi hafta imtihon topshiryapti.

3. We are flying to Istanbul on Friday.
Biz juma kuni Istanbulga uchyapmiz.

4. They are having a meeting at 3 o’clock.
Ular soat 3 da yig‘ilish o‘tkazyapti.

5. He is visiting his doctor this evening.
U bugun kechqurun shifokoriga boryapti.

6. I am starting a new course next month.
Men kelasi oy yangi kurs boshlayapman.

7. We are watching a film with our group tonight.
Biz bugun kechqurun guruhimiz bilan film ko‘ryapmiz.

8. My parents are coming to Urgench tomorrow.
Ota-onam ertaga Urganchga kelishyapti.

9. The students are presenting their projects on Monday.
Talabalar dushanba kuni loyihalarini taqdim qilishyapti.

10. I am having an interview next Tuesday.
Men kelasi seshanba kuni suhbatdan o‘tyapman.

Разница между Will / Be going to / Present Continuous

Форма | Структура | Основное значение | Когда используется? | Пример | Перевод
Will | Subject + will + V1 | Настоящее решение, обещание, предположение | Если решение принимается в момент речи или это предположение без доказательств | I will call you later. | Men senga keyinroq qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.
Be going to | Subject + am/is/are + going to + V1 | Заранее запланированное действие или обоснованное предположение | Если есть намерение заранее или есть видимые доказательства | I am going to buy a new book. | Men yangi kitob sotib olmoqchiman.
Present Continuous | Subject + am/is/are + V-ing | Четко запланированное действие | Если время, место или договоренность ясны | I am meeting my teacher at 5. | Men soat 5 da ustozim bilan uchrashyapman.

9. Самые важные различия

1) Спонтанное решение — Will

То есть решение принимается сейчас, в момент речи.

Примеры:

1. I am hungry. I will make a sandwich.
Men och qoldim. Men sendvich tayyorlayman.

2. This exercise is difficult. I will ask my teacher.
Bu mashq qiyin. Men ustozimdan so‘rayman.

3. It is cold here. I will close the window.
Bu yer sovuq. Men derazani yopaman.

2) Предварительный план / намерение — Be going to

Если есть заранее запланированное намерение или план, используется be going to.

Примеры:

1. I am going to learn Korean next year.
Men kelasi yili koreys tilini o‘rganmoqchiman.

2. She is going to apply to medical university.
U tibbiyot universitetiga hujjat topshirmoqchi.

3. We are going to organize a seminar.
Biz seminar tashkil qilmoqchimiz.

3) Фиксированное соглашение — Present Continuous

Если время, место или договоренность ясны, используется Present Continuous.

Примеры:

1. I am meeting my tutor at 4 o’clock.
Men soat 4 da repetitorim bilan uchrashyapman.

2. They are leaving for Samarkand tomorrow morning.
Ular ertaga ertalab Samarqandga ketishyapti.

3. We are having a speaking club on Saturday.
Biz shanba kuni speaking club o‘tkazyapmiz.
grammar_rules_kk:
Inglis tilinde kelajak haqqında gápiriwdiń bir neshe jolı bar. Ózbek tilinde kóbinese "baraman", "qılaman", "boladı" sıyaqlı şekilder qollanıladı. Inglis tilinde esa vaziyatqa qarap turli grammatik şekilder tańlanadı.

Kelajakni ifodalawda eń kóp qollanılatuǵın 3 ta şekil:

1. Will

2. Be going to

3. Present Continuous for future

Olardıń hámmesi kelajak haqqında gápiradı, biraq mánisi hám qollanılıw jaǵdayı birdey emes.

Qısqasha ayırması

Shakl | Asosiy mánisi | Mısal | Tarjima
Will | Hozır qaror qılınǵan iş, va’da, taxmin | I will help you. | Men senga yordam beraman.
Be going to | Oldınǵan reja yaki dalilge asáslanǵan taxmin | I am going to study medicine. | Men tibbiyotda o‘qimoqchiman.
Present Continuous | Vaqtı yaki joyı anıq kelishilǵan kelajaktaǵı reja | I am meeting my teacher tomorrow. | Men ertaga ustozim bilen uchrashyapman.

Júdá sodda túsiníw

Will — hozir qaror qılsañ yaki shunchaki taxmin qılsañ qollanıladı.
Be going to — oldınǵan niyeting yaki rejang bolǵanda qollanıladı.
Present Continuous — kelajaktaǵı anıq kelishilǵan reja bolǵanda qollanıladı.

2. “Will” nima hám qachon qollanıladı?

“Will” nima?

Will kelajak haqqında gápiriw üşin qollanıladıǵan yordamçı feyildir. Undan keyin feyilniń oddiy şekli, yaǵnıy V1 keladi.

Formula:

Subject + will + V1

Mısal:

I will study.
Men o‘qiyman.

Bu yerda:

• I — ega

• will — kelajak yordamçı feyli

• study — asosiy feyil

a) Gapirıp otırǵanda qabul qılınǵan qaror

Agar qaror aynan gapirıp otırǵanda qabul qılınsa, will qollanıladı.

Mısallar:

1. I am tired. I will take a short break.
Men charchadım. Men qisqa tanaffus qilaman.

2. The phone is ringing. I will answer it.
Telefon jiringlayapti. Men unga javob beraman.

3. I forgot my pen. I will borrow one from my friend.
Men ruchkamni unutıpman. Men do‘stimdan bittasın alaman.

b) Va’da beriw

Va’da bergende will qollanıladı.

Mısallar:

1. I will always support you.
Men seni doim qo‘llap-quvvatlayman.

2. I will finish the homework today.
Men uy vazifasın bugun tugataman.

3. I will not be late again.
Men başqa kechikmeyman.

c) Taklif qılıw

Biror işni qılıwı taklif qılǵanda yaki kimnidir biror narsaga taklif qılǵanda will qollanıwı mümkin.

Mısallar:

1. Will you join us for dinner?
Kechki ovqatta bizge qo‘shilasız mı?

2. Will you come to the meeting tomorrow?
Ertaga yig‘ilışqa kelasız mı?

3. Will you have some tea?
Choy içesiz mı?

d) Yordam taklif qılıw

Kimgadir yordam beriwni taklif qılǵanda ham will qollanıladı.

Mısallar:

1. I will help you with your English.
Men senga ingliz tilından yordam beraman.

2. I will carry your bag.
Men sumkangnı ko‘tarıp beraman.

3. I will explain this grammar rule again.
Men bu grammatik qoidanı yana túsindiriw beraman.

e) Taxmin qılıw

Agar dalil bolmasa, shunchaki o‘ylaǵan taxmin qılsaq, will qollanıladı.

Mısallar:

1. I think he will pass the exam.
Menimşe, u imtihondan o‘tedi.

2. She will probably come late.
U ehtimol kech keladi.

3. It will be difficult, but we can do it.
Bu qiyin boladı, biraq biz buni qıla alamız.

f) Kelajak haqqında umumı fikr

Kelajak haqqında umumı fikr bildirǵende will qollanıladı.

Mısallar:

1. People will use more technology in education.
Odamlar ta’limde kóp texnologiyadan qollanadı.

2. English will be important in the future.
Ingliz tili kelajakta muhim boladı.

3. Many students will study online.
Kóp talabalar onlayn o‘qıydu.

“Be going to” nima hám qachon qollanıladı?

“Be going to” nima?

Be going to kelajaktaǵı reja, niyat yaki dalilge asáslanǵan taxminni ifodalaw üşin qollanıladı.

Bu şekilde be feyli ega bilen moslaşadı:

• I am going to

• He / She / It is going to

• You / We / They are going to

Mısal:

I am going to learn English.
Men ingliz tilin o‘rganmoqchiman.

Bu gápda adam oldınǵan niyat qılǵan.

a) Oldınǵan rejalashtırılǵan niyat

Agar biror işni oldınǵan reja qılǵan bolsaq, be going to qollanıladı.

Mısallar:

1. I am going to prepare for IELTS.
Men IELTSqa tayyorlanmoqchiman.

2. She is going to study medicine.
U tibbiyotda o‘qimoqçı.

3. We are going to open a new English group.
Biz jańa ingliz tili guruhı açmoqçımız.

b) Anıq belgi yaki dalilge asáslanǵan taxmin

Agar kózimiz bilen dalilni kórsek yaki vaziyatdan natija anıq kórinse, be going to qollanıladı.

Mısallar:

1. Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
Bulutlarğa qarang. Yomğır yog‘moqçı.

2. He is driving very fast. He is going to have an accident.
U juda tez haydayapti. U avariya qilmoqçı.

3. The student didn’t study. He is going to fail the test.
O‘quwshı o‘qimadı. U testdan yiqılmoqçı.

c) Yaqın kelajakta sodir bolıwı anıq kórinǵan iş-hárekət

Agar biror narsa juda yaqın hám deyarli anıq bolǵanda, be going to qollanıladı.

Mısallar:

1. The glass is on the edge. It is going to fall.
Stakan chekkede turıp. U tushıp ketmoqçı.

2. The baby is very sleepy. He is going to sleep soon.
Chaqaloq juda uyquchan. U tez orada uxlamoqçı.

3. Oqıtıwshı allaqachon sinfda. Dars bastalawıshı kerek.
O‘qituvchi allaqachon sinfda. Dars boshlanmoqchi.

Present Continuous keljek ma’nosında

Present Continuous ne?

Present Continuous ádette hozir dawam etiwatqan ish-háreketni bildiradi.

Mısal:

I am studying now.
Men hozir o‘qiyapman.

Biraq Present Continuous keljektegi anıq kelishilgen reja ushın da qollanıladı.

Bul aynıqsı quyıdakı holatlarda kóbinese qollanıladı:

• uchrasyw

• sayahat

• dars

• imtihon

• meeting

• appointment

• interview

• rejalashtırılğan tadbir

• oldınan belgilengen waqıt hám orın

Múhim fikr

Present Continuous keljek ushın qollanılğanda, ádette waqıt körsätkıshı boladı:

• tomorrow

• tonight

• next week

• on Monday

• at 5 o’clock

• this evening

Mısallar:

1. I am meeting my teacher tomorrow.
Men ertaga ustozım menen uchrashyapman.

2. She is taking an exam next week.
U kelasi hafta imtihon topshiryapti.

3. We are flying to Istanbul on Friday.
Biz juma kúni Istanbulğa uchyapmiz.

4. They are having a meeting at 3 o’clock.
Ular soat 3 te yig‘ilish o‘tkazyapti.

5. He is visiting his doctor this evening.
U búgin kechqurun shifokorına boryapti.

6. I am starting a new course next month.
Men kelasi oy jańa kurs bastalayapman.

7. We are watching a film with our group tonight.
Biz búgin kechqurun guruhımız menen film ko‘ryapmiz.

8. My parents are coming to Urgench tomorrow.
Ota-onam ertaga Urganchqa kelishyapti.

9. The students are presenting their projects on Monday.
Talabalar dushanba kúni loyihaların taqdim etiwatadı.

10. I am having an interview next Tuesday.
Men kelasi seshanba kúni suhbatdan o‘tyapman.

Will / Be going to / Present Continuous farqı

Shakl | Tuzılma | Asasiy ma’no | Qachon qollanıladı? | Mısal | Tarjima
Will | Subject + will + V1 | Hozırgi qaror, va’da, taxmin | Gapirıp turğanda qaror qılınsa yaki dalilsiz taxmin bolğanda | I will call you later. | Men senga keyinroq qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.
Be going to | Subject + am/is/are + going to + V1 | Oldınan reja yaki dalilli taxmin | Oldınan niyat bolğanda yaki dalil körinip turğanda | I am going to buy a new book. | Men jańa kitap sotıp almoqçı bolıp turamın.
Present Continuous | Subject + am/is/are + V-ing | Anıq kelishilgan reja | Waqıt, orın yaki kelishiw anıq bolğanda | I am meeting my teacher at 5. | Men soat 5 te ustozım menen uchrashyapman.

9. Eng muhim farqlar

1) Spontan qaror — Will

Ya’ni qaror hozir, gapirıp turğanda qabıl qılınadı.

Mısallar:

1. I am hungry. I will make a sandwich.
Men och qoldım. Men sendvich tayyorlayman.

2. This exercise is difficult. I will ask my teacher.
Bu mashq qiyin. Men ustozımdan so‘rayman.

3. It is cold here. I will close the window.
Bu yer sovuq. Men derazanı yopaman.

2) Oldınan niyat / reja — Be going to

Oldınan niyat yaki reja bolğanda, be going to qollanıladı.

Mısallar:

1. I am going to learn Korean next year.
Men kelasi jılda koreys tilin o‘rganmoqçı bolıp turamın.

2. She is going to apply to medical university.
U tibbiyot universitetine hujjat topshirmoqçı.

3. We are going to organize a seminar.
Biz seminar tashkil qilmoqçımız.

3) Anıq kelishiw — Present Continuous

Waqıt, orın yaki kelishiw anıq bolğanda, Present Continuous qollanıladı.

Mısallar:

1. I am meeting my tutor at 4 o’clock.
Men soat 4 te repetitorım menen uchrashyapman.

2. They are leaving for Samarkand tomorrow morning.
Ular ertaga erteláb Samarqandqa ketip baradı.

3. We are having a speaking club on Saturday.
Biz shanba kúni speaking club o‘tkazyapmiz.
reading_passage:
Maya is taking part in a lesson about planning a journey inspired by Marco Polo. The activity is set in a travel-history seminar.

A student team is planning a modern route that follows part of the Silk Road. They are meeting a historian tomorrow to check which cities are realistic to visit.

The group is going to travel by train whenever possible because they want to observe changes between regions. They will keep a digital diary and share short reports with classmates during the journey.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Maya is studying while Daniel is talking on the phone.” The plan connects historical curiosity with modern travel decisions.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Maya and Daniel compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

grammar_rules:
Future Perfect Continuous — kelajakdagi ma’lum bir vaqtgacha davom etib turgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Bu zamonning asosiy ma’nosi:

Kelajakdagi bir vaqtga kelib, ish-harakat qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotgan bo‘ladi.

Masalan:

By 6 o’clock, I will have been studying for three hours.
Soat 6 ga kelib, men 3 soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan bo‘laman.

Bu gapda asosiy e’tibor ishning tugaganiga emas, balki qancha vaqt davom etganiga qaratilgan.

Juda sodda tushuncha

Future Perfect Continuous quyidagi savolga javob beradi:

Kelajakdagi bir vaqtga kelib, bu ish qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotgan bo‘ladi?

Masalan:

By next year, she will have been learning English for five years.
Kelasi yilga kelib, u 5 yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan bo‘ladi.

Bu gapda “u ingliz tilini tugatadi” deyilmayapti. Asosiy ma’no — o‘rganish jarayoni 5 yil davom etgan bo‘ladi.

Future Perfect Continuous nimani ta’kidlaydi?

Bu zamon ko‘pincha quyidagilarni ta’kidlaydi:

1. Davomiylik — ish davom etadi.

2. Muddat — ish qancha vaqt davom etgan bo‘ladi.

3. Jarayon — ishning o‘zi jarayon sifatida ko‘rsatiladi.

4. Kelajakdagi vaqt nuqtasi — “by next year”, “by 2030”, “by the time...” kabi vaqtlar bilan ishlatiladi.

Misol orqali tushunamiz

By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for two hours.
Sen yetib kelguningcha, men 2 soatdan beri kutayotgan bo‘laman.

Bu yerda:

• you arrive — kelajakdagi vaqt nuqtasi

• I will have been waiting — shu vaqtgacha davom etib turgan ish

• for two hours — qancha vaqt davom etgani

2. Formula

1) Darak gap

Formula:

Subject + will have been + V-ing

Misollar:

1. I will have been studying for three hours by 8 o’clock.
Soat 8 ga kelib, men 3 soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan bo‘laman.

2. She will have been working at this school for five years by next month.
Kelasi oyga kelib, u bu maktabda 5 yildan beri ishlayotgan bo‘ladi.

3. They will have been waiting for us for an hour by the time we arrive.
Biz yetib borgunimizcha, ular bizni bir soatdan beri kutayotgan bo‘lishadi.

4. We will have been learning English for two years by June.
Iyun oyiga kelib, biz 2 yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan bo‘lamiz.

5. He will have been living in Tashkent for ten years by 2030.
2030-yilga kelib, u Toshkentda 10 yildan beri yashayotgan bo‘ladi.

2) Inkor gap

Formula:

Subject + will not have been + V-ing

Qisqa shakli:

will not = won’t

Misollar:

1. I will not have been studying for long by then.
O‘sha vaqtga kelib, men uzoq vaqt o‘qiyotgan bo‘lmayman.

2. She won’t have been working here for a year by May.
May oyiga kelib, u bu yerda bir yildan beri ishlayotgan bo‘lmaydi.

3. They will not have been waiting for us for two hours.
Ular bizni 2 soatdan beri kutayotgan bo‘lmaydi.

4. We won’t have been living in this city for long by next summer.
Kelasi yozga kelib, biz bu shaharda uzoq vaqt yashayotgan bo‘lmaymiz.

5. He will not have been practicing English for enough time by the exam.
Imtihonga kelib, u ingliz tilini yetarlicha vaqt mashq qilayotgan bo‘lmaydi.

3) So‘roq gap

Formula:

Will + subject + have been + V-ing?

Misollar:

1. Will you have been studying for three hours by 9 o’clock?
Soat 9 ga kelib, sen 3 soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan bo‘lasanmi?

2. Will she have been working at the university for five years by next year?
Kelasi yilga kelib, u universitetda 5 yildan beri ishlayotgan bo‘ladimi?

3. Will they have been waiting for us for a long time by then?
O‘sha vaqtga kelib, ular bizni uzoq vaqtdan beri kutayotgan bo‘lishadimi?

4. Will we have been learning this topic for two lessons by Friday?
Juma kuniga kelib, biz bu mavzuni 2 darsdan beri o‘rganayotgan bo‘lamizmi?

5. Will he have been living abroad for ten years by 2030?
2030-yilga kelib, u chet elda 10 yildan beri yashayotgan bo‘ladimi?

3. Future Perfect Continuous qachon ishlatiladi?

a) Kelajakdagi ma’lum vaqtgacha davom etgan ish-harakat

Agar biror ish kelajakdagi ma’lum vaqtgacha davom etib kelgan bo‘lsa, Future Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. By 10 p.m., I will have been reading for four hours.
Kechki soat 10 ga kelib, men 4 soatdan beri kitob o‘qiyotgan bo‘laman.

2. By next week, they will have been preparing for the exam for two months.
Kelasi haftaga kelib, ular 2 oydan beri imtihonga tayyorlanayotgan bo‘lishadi.

3. By the end of this year, we will have been studying English for three years.
Bu yil oxiriga kelib, biz 3 yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan bo‘lamiz.

b) Kelajakda biror natijaga sabab bo‘ladigan davomiy jarayon

Agar kelajakdagi biror holatning sababi oldin davom etgan jarayon bo‘lsa, Future Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. He will be tired because he will have been working all day.
U charchagan bo‘ladi, chunki u kun bo‘yi ishlayotgan bo‘ladi.

2. She will speak English better because she will have been practicing every day.
U ingliz tilida yaxshiroq gapiradi, chunki u har kuni mashq qilib kelayotgan bo‘ladi.

3. The students will be confident because they will have been preparing for weeks.
Talabalar o‘ziga ishongan bo‘ladi, chunki ular haftalardan beri tayyorlanayotgan bo‘lishadi.

c) “For” va “since” bilan davomiylikni ifodalash

Future Perfect Continuous ko‘pincha for va since bilan ishlatiladi.

For — muddatni bildiradi.
Since — boshlanish vaqtini bildiradi.

Misollar:

1. By July, I will have been working here for six months.
Iyulga kelib, men bu yerda 6 oydan beri ishlayotgan bo‘laman.

2. By next year, she will have been learning English since 2022.
Kelasi yilga kelib, u 2022-yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan bo‘ladi.

3. By evening, they will have been traveling for twelve hours.
Kechga kelib, ular 12 soatdan beri sayohat qilayotgan bo‘lishadi.

d) “By the time” bilan ishlatilishi

By the time — “... vaqtga kelib”, “...guncha” degan ma’noni beradi.

Future Perfect Continuous ko‘pincha by the time + Present Simple bilan ishlatiladi.

Formula:

By the time + subject + V1, subject + will have been + V-ing

Misollar:

1. By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for an hour.
Sen yetib kelguningcha, men bir soatdan beri kutayotgan bo‘laman.

2. By the time the exam starts, we will have been revising for three weeks.
Imtihon boshlanguncha, biz 3 haftadan beri takrorlayotgan bo‘lamiz.

3. By the time he graduates, he will have been studying medicine for six years.
U bitirguniga kelib, 6 yildan beri tibbiyotda o‘qiyotgan bo‘ladi.

e) Kelajakdagi vaqt nuqtasigacha qancha vaqt davom etganini ko‘rsatish

Bu zamon aynan “qancha vaqtdan beri?” degan ma’noni beradi.

Misollar:

1. By 2030, scientists will have been researching this problem for many years.
2030-yilga kelib, olimlar bu muammoni ko‘p yillardan beri tadqiq qilayotgan bo‘lishadi.

2. By tomorrow morning, I will have been working on this project for ten hours.
Ertaga ertalabga kelib, men bu loyiha ustida 10 soatdan beri ishlayotgan bo‘laman.

3. By the end of the semester, students will have been studying this subject for four months.
Semestr oxiriga kelib, talabalar bu fanni 4 oydan beri o‘rganayotgan bo‘lishadi.

4. Asosiy vaqt ko‘rsatkichlari

1) By next year — kelasi yilga kelib

By next year, I will have been learning English for four years.
Kelasi yilga kelib, men 4 yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan bo‘laman.

Izoh: Kelasi yil — vaqt nuqtasi. Shu vaqtga kelib ingliz tilini o‘rganish jarayoni 4 yil davom etgan bo‘ladi.

2) By 2030 — 2030-yilga kelib

By 2030, many teachers will have been using AI tools for several years.
2030-yilga kelib, ko‘p o‘qituvchilar bir necha yildan beri AI vositalaridan foydalanayotgan bo‘lishadi.

Izoh: Bu gapda o‘qituvchilarning AI dan foydalanish jarayoni davomiylik sifatida ko‘rsatilgan.

3) By the time — ... vaqtga kelib / ...guncha

By the time you finish school, you will have been studying English for eleven years.
Maktabni tugatguningcha, sen 11 yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan bo‘lasan.

Izoh: “By the time you finish school” — kelajakdagi vaqt nuqtasi.

4) By then — o‘sha vaqtga kelib

By then, we will have been working on this research for two years.
O‘sha vaqtga kelib, biz bu tadqiqot ustida 2 yildan beri ishlayotgan bo‘lamiz.

Izoh: “By then” avval aytilgan kelajakdagi vaqtga ishora qiladi.

5) For two hours — ikki soatdan beri

By 7 o’clock, she will have been studying for two hours.
Soat 7 ga kelib, u 2 soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan bo‘ladi.

Izoh: “For two hours” ishning davom etish muddatini bildiradi.

6) For five years — besh yildan beri

By next month, he will have been teaching English for five years.
Kelasi oyga kelib, u 5 yildan beri ingliz tilidan dars berayotgan bo‘ladi.

Izoh: Bu gapda asosiy e’tibor dars berish jarayonining 5 yil davom etganiga qaratilgan.

7) Since morning — ertalabdan beri

By lunchtime, I will have been working since morning.
Tushlik vaqtiga kelib, men ertalabdan beri ishlayotgan bo‘laman.

Izoh: “Since morning” ish qachondan boshlanganini bildiradi.

8) Since 2020 — 2020-yildan beri

By 2027, they will have been living in this city since 2020.
2027-yilga kelib, ular bu shaharda 2020-yildan beri yashayotgan bo‘lishadi.

Izoh: “Since 2020” boshlanish nuqtasini bildiradi.

9) Before — ...dan oldin

Before the conference starts, we will have been preparing for two months.
Konferensiya boshlanishidan oldin, biz 2 oydan beri tayyorlanayotgan bo‘lamiz.

Izoh: Konferensiya boshlanishi — kelajakdagi vaqt nuqtasi.

10) When — qachonki / ...ganda

When you arrive tomorrow, I will have been waiting for thirty minutes.
Ertaga sen yetib kelganingda, men 30 daqiqadan beri kutayotgan bo‘laman.

Izoh: “When you arrive” kelajakdagi vaqtni bildiradi, lekin ingliz tilida bu qismda odatda Present Simple ishlatiladi: when you arrive, will arrive emas.

5. “For” va “since” farqi

So‘z | Ma’nosi | Nimani bildiradi? | Misol | Tarjima
For | ... davomida / ...dan beri | Muddat | for two hours | ikki soatdan beri
Since | ...dan beri | Boshlanish nuqtasi | since 2020 | 2020-yildan beri

“For” bilan 8 ta misol

1. By 8 o’clock, I will have been studying for three hours.
Soat 8 ga kelib, men 3 soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan bo‘laman.

2. By next week, she will have been working on the project for two months.
Kelasi haftaga kelib, u loyiha ustida 2 oydan beri ishlayotgan bo‘ladi.

3. By tomorrow, they will have been traveling for five days.
Ertaga kelib, ular 5 kundan beri sayohat qilayotgan bo‘lishadi.

4. By June, we will have been learning grammar for six months.
Iyun oyiga kelib, biz 6 oydan beri grammatika o‘rganayotgan bo‘lamiz.

5. By the end of the lesson, he will have been writing for forty minutes.
Dars oxiriga kelib, u 40 daqiqadan beri yozayotgan bo‘ladi.

6. By next year, my brother will have been training for three years.

7. By the time the teacher comes, we will have been waiting for ten minutes.
O‘qituvchi kelgunicha, biz 10 daqiqadan beri kutayotgan bo‘lamiz.

8. By midnight, I will have been reading this article for two hours.

“Since” bilan 8 ta misol

1. By noon, I will have been working since morning.
Tushga kelib, men ertalabdan beri ishlayotgan bo‘laman.

2. By 2028, she will have been studying English since 2020.
2028-yilga kelib, u 2020-yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan bo‘ladi.

3. By Friday, they will have been preparing since Monday.
Juma kuniga kelib, ular dushanbadan beri tayyorlanayotgan bo‘lishadi.

4. By next month, we will have been living here since September.
Kelasi oyga kelib, biz bu yerda sentabrdan beri yashayotgan bo‘lamiz.

5. By 6 o’clock, he will have been waiting since 4 o’clock.
Soat 6 ga kelib, u soat 4 dan beri kutayotgan bo‘ladi.

6. By the end of this year, I will have been learning programming since last year.
Bu yil oxiriga kelib, men o‘tgan yildan beri dasturlashni o‘rganayotgan bo‘laman.

7. By the time she graduates, she will have been researching this topic since her second year.
U bitirguniga kelib, ikkinchi kursidan beri bu mavzuni tadqiq qilayotgan bo‘ladi.

8. By next summer, we will have been communicating in English since we joined the course.
Kelasi yozga kelib, biz kursga qo‘shilganimizdan beri ingliz tilida muloqot qilayotgan bo‘lamiz.

Future Perfect Continuous ishlatilmaydigan yoki kam ishlatiladigan holatlar

Future Perfect Continuous odatda harakat bildiruvchi fe’llar bilan ishlatiladi:

• study

• work

• wait

• read

• write

• travel

• teach

• prepare

• practice

• research

Lekin ayrim fe’llar odatda davom shaklida ishlatilmaydi. Bular state verbs, ya’ni holat bildiruvchi fe’llar.

State verbs

Fe’l | Tarjima

love | sevmoq
hate | yomon ko‘rmoq
want | xohlamoq
