own | egalik qilmoq
belong | tegishli bo‘lmoq

Bu fe’llar bilan odatda Future Perfect Continuous emas, Future Perfect ishlatiladi.
grammar_rules_en:
Future Perfect Continuous — indicates an action that will have been continuing up to a certain time in the future.

The main meaning of this tense:

By a certain time in the future, the action will have been continuing for some time.

For example:

By 6 o’clock, I will have been studying for three hours.
By 6 o’clock, I will have been studying for three hours.

The focus here is not on the action being finished, but on how long it has lasted.

A very simple idea

The Future Perfect Continuous answers this question:

By a certain time in the future, how long will this action have been continuing?

For example:

By next year, she will have been learning English for five years.
By next year, she will have been learning English for five years.

This sentence does not say 'she finishes learning English'. The main meaning is that the process of learning will have lasted for 5 years.

What does the Future Perfect Continuous emphasize?

This tense often emphasizes the following:

1. Continuity — the action continues.

2. Duration — how long the action will have lasted.

3. Process — the action itself is shown as a process.

4. Future time point — used with time expressions like 'by next year', 'by 2030', 'by the time...'.

Understanding through examples

By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for two hours.
By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for two hours.

Here:

• you arrive — future time point

• I will have been waiting — the action that has been continuing up to that time

• for two hours — how long it has lasted

2. Formula

1) Affirmative sentence

Formula:

Subject + will have been + V-ing

Examples:

1. I will have been studying for three hours by 8 o’clock.
By 8 o’clock, I will have been studying for three hours.

2. She will have been working at this school for five years by next month.
By next month, she will have been working at this school for five years.

3. They will have been waiting for us for an hour by the time we arrive.
By the time we arrive, they will have been waiting for us for an hour.

4. We will have been learning English for two years by June.
By June, we will have been learning English for two years.

5. He will have been living in Tashkent for ten years by 2030.
By 2030, he will have been living in Tashkent for ten years.

2) Negative sentence

Formula:

Subject + will not have been + V-ing

Short form:

will not = won’t

Examples:

1. I will not have been studying for long by then.
By then, I will not have been studying for long.

2. She won’t have been working here for a year by May.
By May, she won’t have been working here for a year.

3. They will not have been waiting for us for two hours.
They will not have been waiting for us for two hours.

4. We won’t have been living in this city for long by next summer.
By next summer, we won’t have been living in this city for long.

5. He will not have been practicing English for enough time by the exam.
By the exam, he will not have been practicing English for enough time.

3) Interrogative sentence

Formula:

Will + subject + have been + V-ing?

Examples:

1. Will you have been studying for three hours by 9 o’clock?
Will you have been studying for three hours by 9 o’clock?

2. Will she have been working at the university for five years by next year?
Will she have been working at the university for five years by next year?

3. Will they have been waiting for us for a long time by then?
Will they have been waiting for us for a long time by then?

4. Will we have been learning this topic for two lessons by Friday?
Will we have been learning this topic for two lessons by Friday?

5. Will he have been living abroad for ten years by 2030?
Will he have been living abroad for ten years by 2030?

3. When is the Future Perfect Continuous used?

a) An action that has been continuing up to a certain time in the future

If an action has been continuing up to a certain time in the future, the Future Perfect Continuous is used.

Examples:

1. By 10 p.m., I will have been reading for four hours.
By 10 p.m., I will have been reading for four hours.

2. By next week, they will have been preparing for the exam for two months.
By next week, they will have been preparing for the exam for two months.

3. By the end of this year, we will have been studying English for three years.
By the end of this year, we will have been studying English for three years.

b) A continuous process that will cause a result in the future

If the cause of a future situation is a process that has been continuing before, the Future Perfect Continuous is used.

Examples:

1. He will be tired because he will have been working all day.
He will be tired because he will have been working all day.

2. She will speak English better because she will have been practicing every day.
She will speak English better because she will have been practicing every day.

3. The students will be confident because they will have been preparing for weeks.

c) Expressing duration with “for” and “since”

The Future Perfect Continuous is often used with for and since.

For indicates a duration.
Since indicates a starting point.

Examples:

1. By July, I will have been working here for six months.
By July, I will have been working here for six months.

2. By next year, she will have been learning English since 2022.
By next year, she will have been learning English since 2022.

3. By evening, they will have been traveling for twelve hours.
By evening, they will have been traveling for twelve hours.

d) Usage with “by the time”

By the time means “by the time of...” or “until...”.

The Future Perfect Continuous is often used with by the time + Present Simple.

Formula:

By the time + subject + V1, subject + will have been + V-ing

Examples:

1. By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for an hour.
By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for an hour.

2. By the time the exam starts, we will have been revising for three weeks.
By the time the exam starts, we will have been revising for three weeks.

3. By the time he graduates, he will have been studying medicine for six years.
By the time he graduates, he will have been studying medicine for six years.

e) Indicating how long an action has been ongoing until a future point

This tense specifically answers the question “how long?”

Examples:

1. By 2030, scientists will have been researching this problem for many years.
By 2030, scientists will have been researching this problem for many years.

2. By tomorrow morning, I will have been working on this project for ten hours.
By tomorrow morning, I will have been working on this project for ten hours.

3. By the end of the semester, students will have been studying this subject for four months.
By the end of the semester, students will have been studying this subject for four months.

4. Main time indicators

1) By next year — by next year

By next year, I will have been learning English for four years.
By next year, I will have been learning English for four years.

Note: By next year is a point in time. By this time, the process of learning English will have lasted for 4 years.

2) By 2030 — by 2030

By 2030, many teachers will have been using AI tools for several years.
By 2030, many teachers will have been using AI tools for several years.

Note: In this sentence, the process of teachers using AI is shown as a duration.

3) By the time — by the time of... / until...

By the time you finish school, you will have been studying English for eleven years.
By the time you finish school, you will have been studying English for eleven years.

Note: “By the time you finish school” indicates a future point in time.

4) By then — by that time

By then, we will have been working on this research for two years.
By then, we will have been working on this research for two years.

Note: “By then” refers to a previously mentioned future time.

5) For two hours — for two hours

By 7 o’clock, she will have been studying for two hours.
By 7 o’clock, she will have been studying for two hours.

Note: “For two hours” indicates the duration of the action.

6) For five years — for five years

By next month, he will have been teaching English for five years.
By next month, he will have been teaching English for five years.

Note: In this sentence, the main focus is on the process of teaching lasting for 5 years.

7) Since morning — since morning

By lunchtime, I will have been working since morning.
By lunchtime, I will have been working since morning.

Note: “Since morning” indicates when the work started.

8) Since 2020 — since 2020

By 2027, they will have been living in this city since 2020.
By 2027, they will have been living in this city since 2020.

Note: “Since 2020” indicates the starting point.

9) Before — before...

Before the conference starts, we will have been preparing for two months.
Before the conference starts, we will have been preparing for two months.

Note: The start of the conference is a future point in time.

10) When — when...

When you arrive tomorrow, I will have been waiting for thirty minutes.
When you arrive tomorrow, I will have been waiting for thirty minutes.

Note: “When you arrive” indicates a future time, but in English, Present Simple is usually used in this part: when you arrive, not will arrive.

5. The difference between “for” and “since”

Word | Meaning | What does it indicate? | Example | Translation
For | during / since | Duration | for two hours | for two hours
Since | since | Starting point | since 2020 | since 2020

Expressions used with 'For'

For | Translation
for two minutes | for two minutes
for three hours | for three hours
for five days | for five days
for two weeks | for two weeks
for six months | for six months
for ten years | for ten years
for a long time | for a long time
for several years | for several years

8 examples with 'For'

1. By 8 o’clock, I will have been studying for three hours.
By 8 o’clock, I will have been studying for three hours.

2. By next week, she will have been working on the project for two months.
By next week, she will have been working on the project for two months.

3. By tomorrow, they will have been traveling for five days.
By tomorrow, they will have been traveling for five days.

4. By June, we will have been learning grammar for six months.
By June, we will have been learning grammar for six months.

5. By the end of the lesson, he will have been writing for forty minutes.
By the end of the lesson, he will have been writing for forty minutes.

6. By next year, my brother will have been training for three years.
By next year, my brother will have been training for three years.

7. By the time the teacher comes, we will have been waiting for ten minutes.
By the time the teacher comes, we will have been waiting for ten minutes.

8. By midnight, I will have been reading this article for two hours.
By midnight, I will have been reading this article for two hours.

Expressions used with 'Since'

Since | Translation
since morning | since morning
since 2020 | since 2020
since Monday | since Monday
since childhood | since childhood
since last year | since last year
since 8 o’clock | since 8 o’clock
since September | since September
since we met | since we met

8 examples with 'Since'

1. By noon, I will have been working since morning.
By noon, I will have been working since morning.

2. By 2028, she will have been studying English since 2020.
By 2028, she will have been studying English since 2020.

3. By Friday, they will have been preparing since Monday.
By Friday, they will have been preparing since Monday.

4. By next month, we will have been living here since September.
By next month, we will have been living here since September.

5. By 6 o’clock, he will have been waiting since 4 o’clock.
By 6 o’clock, he will have been waiting since 4 o’clock.

6. By the end of this year, I will have been learning programming since last year.
By the end of this year, I will have been learning programming since last year.

7. By the time she graduates, she will have been researching this topic since her second year.
By the time she graduates, she will have been researching this topic since her second year.

8. By next summer, we will have been communicating in English since we joined the course.
By next summer, we will have been communicating in English since we joined the course.

Situations where Future Perfect Continuous is not used or is rarely used

Future Perfect Continuous is usually used with action verbs:

• study

• work

• wait

• read

• write

• travel

• teach

• prepare

• practice

• research

However, some verbs are not usually used in the continuous form. These are state verbs.

State verbs

Verb | Translation
know | to know
believe | to believe
understand | to understand
love | to love
hate | to hate
want | to want
need | to need
own | to own
belong | to belong

With these verbs, Future Perfect Continuous is not usually used; Future Perfect is used instead.
grammar_rules_ru:
Future Perfect Continuous обозначает действие, которое будет длиться до определённого момента в будущем.

Основное значение этого времени:

К определённому моменту в будущем действие будет длиться уже какое-то время.

Например:

By 6 o’clock, I will have been studying for three hours.
К 6 часам я буду заниматься уже 3 часа.

В этом предложении главное внимание не на том, что действие закончилось, а на том, сколько оно длилось.

Совсем просто

Future Perfect Continuous отвечает на такой вопрос:

К определённому моменту в будущем, это действие сколько времени будет длиться?

Например:

By next year, she will have been learning English for five years.
К следующему году она будет учить английский уже 5 лет.

В этом предложении не говорится, что «она закончила учить английский». Основное значение — процесс обучения будет длиться 5 лет.

Что подчеркивает Future Perfect Continuous?

Это время часто подчеркивает следующее:

1. Продолжительность — действие продолжается.

2. Срок — сколько времени действие будет длиться.

3. Процесс — само действие представляется как процесс.

4. Точка времени в будущем — используется с такими временными выражениями, как «by next year», «by 2030», «by the time...».

Понимаем через пример

By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for two hours.
К моменту твоего приезда я буду ждать уже 2 часа.

Здесь:

• you arrive — точка времени в будущем

• I will have been waiting — действие, которое будет продолжаться до этого момента

• for two hours — сколько времени оно продолжалось

2. Формула

1) Утвердительное предложение

Формула:

Subject + will have been + V-ing

Примеры:

1. I will have been studying for three hours by 8 o’clock.
К 8 часам я буду заниматься уже 3 часа.

2. She will have been working at this school for five years by next month.
К следующему месяцу она будет работать в этой школе уже 5 лет.

3. They will have been waiting for us for an hour by the time we arrive.
К моменту нашего приезда они будут ждать нас уже 1 час.

4. We will have been learning English for two years by June.
К июню мы будем учить английский уже 2 года.

5. He will have been living in Tashkent for ten years by 2030.
К 2030 году он будет жить в Ташкенте уже 10 лет.

2) Отрицательное предложение

Формула:

Subject + will not have been + V-ing

Сокращённая форма:

will not = won’t

Примеры:

1. I will not have been studying for long by then.
К тому времени я не буду учиться долго.

2. She won’t have been working here for a year by May.
К маю она не будет работать здесь уже 1 год.

3. They will not have been waiting for us for two hours.
Они не будут ждать нас уже 2 часа.

4. We won’t have been living in this city for long by next summer.
К следующему лету мы не будем жить в этом городе долго.

5. He will not have been practicing English for enough time by the exam.
К экзамену он не будет достаточно долго практиковать английский.

3) Вопросительное предложение

Формула:

Will + subject + have been + V-ing?

Примеры:

1. Will you have been studying for three hours by 9 o’clock?
К 9 часам ты будешь учиться уже 3 часа?

2. Will she have been working at the university for five years by next year?
К следующему году она будет работать в университете уже 5 лет?

3. Will they have been waiting for us for a long time by then?
К тому времени они будут ждать нас уже долго?

4. Will we have been learning this topic for two lessons by Friday?
К пятнице мы будем изучать эту тему уже 2 урока?

5. Will he have been living abroad for ten years by 2030?
К 2030 году он будет жить за границей уже 10 лет?

3. Когда используется Future Perfect Continuous?

a) Действие, которое продолжалось до определённого времени в будущем

Если какое-либо действие продолжалось до определённого времени в будущем, используется Future Perfect Continuous.

Примеры:

1. By 10 p.m., I will have been reading for four hours.
К 10 часам вечера я буду читать уже 4 часа.

2. By next week, they will have been preparing for the exam for two months.
К следующей неделе они будут готовиться к экзамену уже 2 месяца.

3. By the end of this year, we will have been studying English for three years.
К концу этого года мы будем учить английский уже 3 года.

b) Продолжительный процесс, который станет причиной какого-либо результата в будущем

Если причиной какого-либо состояния в будущем является предшествующий процесс, используется Future Perfect Continuous.

Примеры:

1. He will be tired because he will have been working all day.
Он будет уставшим, потому что он будет работать весь день.

2. She will speak English better because she will have been practicing every day.
Она будет говорить по-английски лучше, потому что она будет практиковаться каждый день.

3. Студенты будут уверены в себе, потому что они будут готовиться в течение нескольких недель.
Talabalar o‘ziga ishongan bo‘ladi, chunki ular haftalardan beri tayyorlanayotgan bo‘lishadi.

c) Выражение продолжительности с помощью “for” и “since”

Future Perfect Continuous часто используется с for и since.

For — обозначает период времени.
Since — обозначает время начала.

Примеры:

1. By July, I will have been working here for six months.
Iyulga kelib, men bu yerda 6 oydan beri ishlayotgan bo‘laman.

2. By next year, she will have been learning English since 2022.
Kelasi yilga kelib, u 2022-yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan bo‘ladi.

3. By evening, they will have been traveling for twelve hours.
Kechga kelib, ular 12 soatdan beri sayohat qilayotgan bo‘lishadi.

d) Использование с “by the time”

By the time — означает “к моменту...” или “до...”

Future Perfect Continuous часто используется с by the time + Present Simple.

Формула:

By the time + subject + V1, subject + will have been + V-ing

Примеры:

1. By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for an hour.
Sen yetib kelguningcha, men bir soatdan beri kutayotgan bo‘laman.

2. By the time the exam starts, we will have been revising for three weeks.
Imtihon boshlanguncha, biz 3 haftadan beri takrorlayotgan bo‘lamiz.

3. By the time he graduates, he will have been studying medicine for six years.
U bitirguniga kelib, 6 yildan beri tibbiyotda o‘qiyotgan bo‘ladi.

e) Показать, сколько времени прошло к моменту в будущем

Это время отвечает на вопрос “как долго?”

Примеры:

1. By 2030, scientists will have been researching this problem for many years.
2030-yilga kelib, olimlar bu muammoni ko‘p yillardan beri tadqiq qilayotgan bo‘lishadi.

2. By tomorrow morning, I will have been working on this project for ten hours.
Ertaga ertalabga kelib, men bu loyiha ustida 10 soatdan beri ishlayotgan bo‘laman.

3. By the end of the semester, students will have been studying this subject for four months.
Semestr oxiriga kelib, talabalar bu fanni 4 oydan beri o‘rganayotgan bo‘lishadi.

4. Основные временные указатели

1) By next year — к следующему году

By next year, I will have been learning English for four years.
Kelasi yilga kelib, men 4 yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan bo‘laman.

Примечание: К следующему году — это временная точка. К этому времени процесс изучения английского языка будет длиться 4 года.

2) By 2030 — к 2030 году

By 2030, many teachers will have been using AI tools for several years.
2030-yilga kelib, ko‘p o‘qituvchilar bir necha yildan beri AI vositalaridan foydalanayotgan bo‘lishadi.

Примечание: В этом предложении процесс использования AI учителями показан как продолжительность.

3) By the time — к моменту / до того как

By the time you finish school, you will have been studying English for eleven years.
Maktabni tugatguningcha, sen 11 yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan bo‘lasan.

Примечание: “By the time you finish school” — это временная точка в будущем.

4) By then — к тому времени

By then, we will have been working on this research for two years.
O‘sha vaqtga kelib, biz bu tadqiqot ustida 2 yildan beri ishlayotgan bo‘lamiz.

Примечание: “By then” ссылается на ранее упомянутую временную точку в будущем.

5) For two hours — в течение двух часов

By 7 o’clock, she will have been studying for two hours.
Soat 7 ga kelib, u 2 soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan bo‘ladi.

Примечание: “For two hours” обозначает продолжительность действия.

6) For five years — в течение пяти лет

By next month, he will have been teaching English for five years.
Kelasi oyga kelib, u 5 yildan beri ingliz tilidan dars berayotgan bo‘ladi.

Примечание: В этом предложении основное внимание уделяется тому, что процесс преподавания длился 5 лет.

7) Since morning — с утра

By lunchtime, I will have been working since morning.
Tushlik vaqtiga kelib, men ertalabdan beri ishlayotgan bo‘laman.

Примечание: “Since morning” указывает, когда началась работа.

8) Since 2020 — с 2020 года

By 2027, they will have been living in this city since 2020.
2027-yilga kelib, ular bu shaharda 2020-yildan beri yashayotgan bo‘lishadi.

Примечание: “Since 2020” указывает на начальную точку.

9) Before — до того как

Before the conference starts, we will have been preparing for two months.
Konferensiya boshlanishidan oldin, biz 2 oydan beri tayyorlanayotgan bo‘lamiz.

Примечание: Начало конференции — это временная точка в будущем.

10) When — когда / в то время как

When you arrive tomorrow, I will have been waiting for thirty minutes.
Ertaga sen yetib kelganingda, men 30 daqiqadan beri kutayotgan bo‘laman.

Примечание: “When you arrive” указывает на будущее время, но в английском языке в этой части обычно используется Present Simple: when you arrive, а не will arrive.

5. Разница между “for” и “since”

Слово | Значение | Что обозначает? | Пример | Перевод
For | ... в течение / ... с | Период времени | for two hours | ikki soatdan beri
Since | ... с | Начальная точка | since 2020 | 2020-yildan beri

Выражения с "for"

For | Перевод
for two minutes | уже две минуты
for three hours | уже три часа
for five days | уже пять дней
for two weeks | уже две недели
for six months | уже шесть месяцев
for ten years | уже десять лет
for a long time | уже долгое время
for several years | уже несколько лет

8 примеров с "for"

1. By 8 o’clock, I will have been studying for three hours.
К 8 часам я буду заниматься уже 3 часа.

2. By next week, she will have been working on the project for two months.
К следующей неделе она будет работать над проектом уже 2 месяца.

3. By tomorrow, they will have been traveling for five days.
К завтрашнему дню они будут путешествовать уже 5 дней.

4. By June, we will have been learning grammar for six months.
К июню мы будем изучать грамматику уже 6 месяцев.

5. By the end of the lesson, he will have been writing for forty minutes.
К концу урока он будет писать уже 40 минут.

6. By next year, my brother will have been training for three years.
К следующему году мой брат будет тренироваться уже 3 года.

7. By the time the teacher comes, we will have been waiting for ten minutes.
К приходу учителя мы будем ждать уже 10 минут.

8. By midnight, I will have been reading this article for two hours.
К полуночи я буду читать эту статью уже 2 часа.

Выражения с "since"

Since | Перевод
since morning | с утра
since 2020 | с 2020 года
since Monday | с понедельника
since childhood | с детства
since last year | с прошлого года
since 8 o’clock | с 8 часов
since September | с сентября
since we met | с тех пор, как мы встретились

8 примеров с "since"

1. By noon, I will have been working since morning.
К полудню я буду работать с утра.

2. By 2028, she will have been studying English since 2020.
К 2028 году она будет изучать английский с 2020 года.

3. By Friday, they will have been preparing since Monday.
К пятнице они будут готовиться с понедельника.

4. By next month, we will have been living here since September.
К следующему месяцу мы будем жить здесь с сентября.

5. By 6 o’clock, he will have been waiting since 4 o’clock.
К 6 часам он будет ждать с 4 часов.

6. By the end of this year, I will have been learning programming since last year.
К концу этого года я буду изучать программирование с прошлого года.

7. By the time she graduates, she will have been researching this topic since her second year.
К моменту, когда она окончит, она будет исследовать эту тему со второго курса.

8. By next summer, we will have been communicating in English since we joined the course.
К следующему лету мы будем общаться на английском с тех пор, как присоединились к курсу.

Ситуации, в которых Future Perfect Continuous не используется или используется редко

Future Perfect Continuous обычно используется с глаголами, обозначающими действия:

• study

• work

• wait

• read

• write

• travel

• teach

• prepare

• practice

• research

Но некоторые глаголы обычно не используются в форме продолженного времени. Это state verbs, то есть глаголы состояния.

State verbs

Глагол | Перевод
know | знать
believe | верить
understand | понимать
love | любить
hate | ненавидеть
want | хотеть
need | нуждаться
own | владеть
belong | принадлежать

С этими глаголами обычно используется Future Perfect, а не Future Perfect Continuous.
grammar_rules_kk:
Future Perfect Continuous — keljektegi belgili bir waqıtqa shekem dawam etip turǵan is-háreketti bildiredi.

Bul zamannıń asası mánisi:

Keljektegi bir waqıtqa kelip, is-háreket qansha waqıttan beri dawam etip atırǵan boladı.

Mısalı:

By 6 o’clock, I will have been studying for three hours.
Saat 6 ǵa kelip, men 3 saattan beri oqıp atırǵan bolaman.

Bul gápte tiykarǵı itibar isniń tamamlanǵanına emes, al qansha waqıt dawam etkenine qaratılǵan.

Júdá ápiwayı túsinik

Future Perfect Continuous tómendegi sorawǵa juwap beredi:

Keljektegi bir waqıtqa kelip, bul is qanşa waqtdan beri dawam etip atırǵan boladı?

Mısalı:

By next year, she will have been learning English for five years.
Kelasi yilga kelip, u 5 yıldan beri inglis tilin o‘rganıp atırǵan boladı.

Bul gápte “u inglis tilin tugatadı” deyilmaydı. Asası mánı — o‘rganıw jarayony 5 jıldan beri dawam etip atırǵan boladı.

Future Perfect Continuous nimeni ta’kidlaydı?

Bul zamon kóbinese quyıdıqılarni ta’kidlaydı:

1. Davamiylik — is dawam etedi.

2. Muddat — is qanşa waqıt dawam etip atırǵan boladı.

3. Jarayon — isniń ózi jarayon sifatında körsetiledi.

4. Keljektegi waqıt nuqtası — “by next year”, “by 2030”, “by the time...” kabi waqıtlar menen qollanıladı.

Misol arqılı túsinimiz

By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for two hours.
Sen yetip kelguningcha, men 2 saattan beri kutıp atırǵan bolaman.

Bul yerda:

• you arrive — keljektegi waqıt nuqtası

• I will have been waiting — shu waqıtqa dawam etip turǵan is

• for two hours — qanşa waqıt dawam etip atırǵanı

2. Formula

1) Darak gáp

Formula:

Subject + will have been + V-ing

Mısallar:

1. I will have been studying for three hours by 8 o’clock.
Saat 8 ǵa kelip, men 3 saattan beri oqıp atırǵan bolaman.

2. She will have been working at this school for five years by next month.
Kelasi oyga kelip, u bul mektepte 5 yıldan beri jumıs atırǵan boladı.

3. They will have been waiting for us for an hour by the time we arrive.
Biz yetip borgunımızcha, olar bizni bir saattan beri kutıp atırǵan boladı.

4. We will have been learning English for two years by June.
Iyun oyına kelip, biz 2 yıldan beri inglis tilin o‘rganıp atırǵan bolamız.

5. He will have been living in Tashkent for ten years by 2030.
2030-jılğa kelip, u Taşkentte 10 yıldan beri yashap atırǵan boladı.

2) Inkor gáp

Formula:

Subject + will not have been + V-ing

Qısqa şekli:

will not = won’t

Mısallar:

1. I will not have been studying for long by then.
O‘sha waqıtqa kelip, men uzoq waqıt oqıp atırǵan bolmayman.

2. She won’t have been working here for a year by May.
May oyına kelip, u bul yerda bir yıldan beri jumıs atırǵan bolmaydı.

3. They will not have been waiting for us for two hours.
Olar bizni 2 saattan beri kutıp atırǵan bolmaydı.

4. We won’t have been living in this city for long by next summer.
Kelasi yozğa kelip, biz bul qala da uzoq waqıt yashap atırǵan bolmaymiz.

5. He will not have been practicing English for enough time by the exam.
Imtihonga kelip, u inglis tilin yetarlicha waqıt mashq etip atırǵan bolmaydı.

3) So‘roq gáp

Formula:

Will + subject + have been + V-ing?

Mısallar:

1. Will you have been studying for three hours by 9 o’clock?
Saat 9 ǵa kelip, sen 3 saattan beri oqıp atırǵan bolasan mı?

2. Will she have been working at the university for five years by next year?
Kelasi yilga kelip, u universitette 5 yıldan beri jumıs atırǵan boladı mı?

3. Will they have been waiting for us for a long time by then?
O‘sha waqıtqa kelip, olar bizni uzoq waqıttan beri kutıp atırǵan boladı mı?

4. Will we have been learning this topic for two lessons by Friday?
Juma kúnige kelip, biz bul mavzuni 2 darsdan beri o‘rganıp atırǵan bolamız mı?

5. Will he have been living abroad for ten years by 2030?
2030-jılğa kelip, u chet elde 10 yıldan beri yashap atırǵan boladı mı?

3. Future Perfect Continuous qachon ishlitiladi?

a) Keljektegi ma’lum waqıtqa dawam etip kelgen is-háreket

Agar biror is keljektegi ma’lum waqıtqa dawam etip kelgen bolsa, Future Perfect Continuous ishlitiladi.

Mısallar:

1. By 10 p.m., I will have been reading for four hours.
Kechki saat 10 ǵa kelip, men 4 saattan beri kitap oqıp atırǵan bolaman.

2. By next week, they will have been preparing for the exam for two months.
Kelasi haftaga kelip, olar 2 aydan beri imtihonga tayyorlanıp atırǵan boladı.

3. By the end of this year, we will have been studying English for three years.
Bul jıl oxırına kelip, biz 3 yıldan beri inglis tilin o‘rganıp atırǵan bolamız.

b) Keljekte biror natijaga sabab bolǵan davamiy jarayon

Agar keljektegi biror holatnıń sababı oldın dawam etip kelgen jarayon bolǵan bolsa, Future Perfect Continuous ishlitiladi.

Mısallar:

1. He will be tired because he will have been working all day.
U charchap atırǵan boladı, çünki u kún boyı jumıs atırǵan boladı.

2. She will speak English better because she will have been practicing every day.
U inglis tilinde jaqsıraq gapirip atırǵan boladı, çünki u har kún mashq etip kelip atırǵan boladı.

3. Studentler özine ishongan boladı, çünki olar haftalardan beri tayyorlanıp atır boladı.
Talabalar o‘ziga ishongan bo‘ladi, chunki ular haftalardan beri tayyorlanayotgan bo‘lishadi.

c) “For” hám “since” menen dawamlılıqtı bildirw

Future Perfect Continuous köpinşe for hám since menen qollanıladı.

For — muddatnı bildiradı.
Since — baslawısh waqıtın bildiradı.

Mısallar:

1. By July, I will have been working here for six months.
Iyulğa kelip, men bu yerde 6 oydan beri ishlap atır bolaman.

2. By next year, she will have been learning English since 2022.
Kelasi jılğa kelip, u 2022-jıldan beri ingliz tilin úyrenip atır boladı.

3. By evening, they will have been traveling for twelve hours.
Kechke kelip, olar 12 soqtan beri sayahat qılıp atır boladı.

d) “By the time” menen qollanılıwı

By the time — “... waqıtqa kelip”, “...ǵa kelip” degan mánini beradi.

Future Perfect Continuous köpinşe by the time + Present Simple menen qollanıladı.

Formula:

By the time + subject + V1, subject + will have been + V-ing

Mısallar:

1. By the time you arrive, I will have been waiting for an hour.
Sen yetip kelginingsha, men bir soatdan beri kutıp atırǵan bolaman.

2. By the time the exam starts, we will have been revising for three weeks.
Imtihon bastalǵanǵa kelip, biz 3 haftadan beri takrorlayıp atırǵan bolamız.

3. By the time he graduates, he will have been studying medicine for six years.
Ol bitirǵenǵe kelip, 6 yıldan beri tibbiýatta oqıp atırǵan boladı.

e) Keljektegi waqıt nuqtasına deýin qanşa waqıt dawam etkenin kórsetiw

Bul zamon aynan “qanşa waqıttan beri?” degan mánini beredi.

Mısallar:

1. By 2030, scientists will have been researching this problem for many years.
2030-jılǵa kelip, olımlar bul muammanı kóp yillardan beri tadqıqlap atırǵan boladı.

2. By tomorrow morning, I will have been working on this project for ten hours.
Ertengi ertalapǵa kelip, men bul loyiha ústinde 10 soatdan beri ishlap atırǵan bolaman.

3. By the end of the semester, students will have been studying this subject for four months.
Semestr axırǵa kelip, studentler bul fanni 4 oydan beri óyranıp atırǵan boladı.

4. Asosı waqıt kórsetkişleri

1) By next year — kelasi jılǵa kelip

By next year, I will have been learning English for four years.
Kelasi jılǵa kelip, men 4 yıldan beri inglis tilin óyranıp atırǵan bolaman.

Izoh: Kelasi jıl — waqıt nuqtası. Shu waqıtta inglis tilin óyranıw jarayony 4 jıl dawam etken boladı.

2) By 2030 — 2030-jılǵa kelip

2030-yılğa kelip, köp oqıtuvchilar bir neçe jıldan beri AI vosıtalarınan qollanıp atır boladı.
2030-yilga kelip, ko‘p o‘qituvchilar bir necha yildan beri AI vositalaridan foydalanayotgan bo‘lishadi.

Túsindirme: Bul gápte oqıtuvşılarǵa AI-dan qollanılıw jarayını dawamlılıq sifatında körsetilgen.

3) By the time — ... waqıtqa kelip / ...gunǵa

By the time you finish school, you will have been studying English for eleven years.
Mektepni tugatǵanǵa kelip, sen 11 jıldan beri inglis tilin úyrenip atırsıñ.

Túsindirme: “By the time you finish school” — kelǵektegi waqıt nuqtası.

4) By then — osha waqıtqa kelip

By then, we will have been working on this research for two years.
Osha waqıtqa kelip, biz bul tadqıqat ustında 2 jıldan beri jumıs atır bolamız.

Túsindirme: “By then” avval aytılǵan kelǵektegi waqıtqa isharalaydı.

5) For two hours — ikki soatdan beri

By 7 o’clock, she will have been studying for two hours.
Soat 7-ge kelip, u 2 soatdan beri oqıp atır boladı.

Túsindirme: “For two hours” is-hárekettiń dawam etiw muddatın bildirip tur.

6) For five years — besh yildan beri

By next month, he will have been teaching English for five years.
Kelasi ayğa kelip, u 5 jıldan beri inglis tilınan dars berip atır boladı.

Túsindirme: Bul gápte asasıy e’tibar dars beriw jarayınıń 5 jıl dawam etkenine qaratılǵan.

7) Since morning — ertalapdan beri

By lunchtime, I will have been working since morning.
Tushlıq waqıtına kelip, men ertalapdan beri jumıs atır bolaman.

Túsindirme: “Since morning” is-háreket qachandan bastalǵanın bildirip tur.

8) Since 2020 — 2020-yıldan beri

By 2027, they will have been living in this city since 2020.
2027-yılğa kelip, olar bul shaharda 2020-yıldan beri jásap atır boladı.

Túsindirme: “Since 2020” bastalǵan nuqtanı bildirip tur.

9) Before — ...dan oldın

Before the conference starts, we will have been preparing for two months.
Konferensiya bastalǵanǵa oldın, biz 2 aydan beri tayyorlanıp atır bolamız.

Túsindirme: Konferensiya bastalwı — kelǵektegi waqıt nuqtası.

10) When — qashanǵa / ...ganda

When you arrive tomorrow, I will have been waiting for thirty minutes.
Ertaga sen jetip kelǵanǵa, men 30 daqıǵadan beri kutıp atır bolaman.

Túsindirme: “When you arrive” kelǵektegi waqıtı bildirip tur, biraq inglis tilinde bul qısmında odatda Present Simple qollanıladı: when you arrive, will arrive emes.

5. “For” hám “since” farqı

Soz | Ma’nısı | Nimeni bildirip tur? | Mısal | Tarjima
For | ... dawamında / ...dan beri | Muddat | for two hours | ikki soatdan beri
Since | ...dan beri | Bastalwı nuqtası | since 2020 | 2020-yıldan beri

“Since” bilan ishlatiladigan ifodalar

Since | Tarjima
since morning | ertalapdan beri
since 2020 | 2020-jıldan beri

since last year | ótken jıldan beri

since September | sentabrdan beri
since we met | uchraşqanımızdan beri

“Since” bilan 8 ta misol

1. By noon, I will have been working since morning.
Tushqa kelip, men ertalapdan beri ishlap atırǵan bolaman.

2. By 2028, she will have been studying English since 2020.
2028-jılğa kelip, u 2020-jıldan beri ingliz tilin úyrenip atırǵan boladı.

3. By Friday, they will have been preparing since Monday.
Juma künige kelip, olar dushanbadan beri tayyarlanıp atırǵan boladı.

4. By next month, we will have been living here since September.
Kelasi ayğa kelip, biz bu jerde sentabrdan beri yashap atırǵan bolamız.

5. By 6 o’clock, he will have been waiting since 4 o’clock.
Soat 6-ge kelip, u soat 4-den beri kutıp atırǵan boladı.

6. By the end of this year, I will have been learning programming since last year.
Bu jıl oxırına kelip, men ótken jıldan beri dasturlawdı úyrenip atırǵan bolaman.

7. By the time she graduates, she will have been researching this topic since her second year.
U bitirip atırǵanda, ikkinshi kursınan beri bu mavzuda tadqıw etip atırǵan boladı.

8. By next summer, we will have been communicating in English since we joined the course.
Kelasi yozğa kelip, biz kursqa qoşılǵanımızdan beri ingliz tilinde muloqot etip atırǵan bolamız.

Future Perfect Continuous ishlatilmaydigan yoki kam ishlatiladigan holatlar

Future Perfect Continuous odatda háreket bildirǵi feyllar menen ishlitiladı:

• study

• work

• wait

• read

• write

• travel

• teach

• prepare

• practice

• research

Biraq ayrım feyllar odatda dawam şeklinde ishlitilmeýdi. Bular state verbs, yaǵnıy holat bildirǵi feyllar.

State verbs

Feyl | Tarjima
know | bilip atırǵan
believe | ishanıp atırǵan
understand | túsinip atırǵan
love | sevip atırǵan
hate | yomon körip atırǵan
want | xohlayıp atırǵan
need | muhtaj bolıp atırǵan / kerek bolıp atırǵan
own | egalik etip atırǵan
belong | tegishli bolıp atırǵan

Bu feyllar menen odatda Future Perfect Continuous emes, Future Perfect ishlitiladı.
reading_passage:
A university English class is exploring a playful prediction about the future through a short article set in a student radio show.

The presenter invites guests to choose cards that represent study, travel and career plans. One student jokes that by next year she will have been studying English for a decade.

Another says that by graduation he will have been working part-time for three years. The host reminds listeners that the cards are entertainment, not reliable predictions.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “By June, Sara will have been studying data science for two years.” The programme uses future-time language while keeping the tone light and humorous.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Sara and Leo compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

grammar_rules:
Present Perfect Continuous — bu ingliz tilidagi zamon bo‘lib, o‘tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Bu zamonning asosiy ma’nosi:

“Qancha vaqtdan beri davom etmoqda?”

Masalan:

I have been studying English for two years.
Men ikki yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganib kelyapman.

Bu gapda ish-harakat o‘tmishda boshlangan: two years ago — ikki yil oldin.
Va hozir ham davom etmoqda: men hali ham ingliz tilini o‘rganyapman.

Present Perfect Continuous odatda 3 narsani ta’kidlaydi:

1. Davomiylik — ish qancha vaqt davom etganini bildiradi.

2. Jarayon — ishning o‘zi, bajarilish jarayoni muhim bo‘ladi.

3. Natija — hozir ko‘rinib turgan holatning sababini tushuntiradi.

Masalan:

She is tired because she has been working all day.
U charchagan, chunki u kun bo‘yi ishlayapti / ishlab kelmoqda.

Bu yerda asosiy e’tibor ishning tugagan-tugamaganida emas, balki jarayon uzoq davom etgani va uning natijasi hozir ko‘rinib turganida.

2. Formula

2.1. Darak gap

Formula:

Subject + have/has + been + V-ing

Ya’ni:

Ega + have/has + been + fe’l-ing

Misollar:

1. I have been learning English for three years.
Men uch yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganib kelyapman.

2. She has been reading this book since morning.
U ertalabdan beri bu kitobni o‘qiyapti.

3. They have been playing football for two hours.
Ular ikki soatdan beri futbol o‘ynashyapti.

4. My brother has been preparing for the exam all week.
Mening akam / ukam butun hafta davomida imtihonga tayyorlanyapti.

5. We have been discussing this topic for a long time.
Biz bu mavzuni anchadan beri muhokama qilyapmiz.

2.2. Inkor gap

Formula:

Subject + have/has + not + been + V-ing

Qisqartma shakllar:

have not = haven’t
has not = hasn’t

Misollar:

1. I have not been sleeping well lately.
Men oxirgi paytlarda yaxshi uxlamayapman.

2. He has not been attending classes regularly.
U darslarga muntazam qatnashmayapti.

3. They have not been studying seriously this month.
Ular bu oy jiddiy o‘qimayapti.

4. She has not been feeling well recently.
U yaqinda o‘zini yaxshi his qilmayapti.

5. We have not been using this application for a long time.
Biz bu ilovadan anchadan beri foydalanmayapmiz.

2.3. So‘roq gap

Formula:

Have/Has + subject + been + V-ing?

Ya’ni:

Have/Has + ega + been + fe’l-ing?

Misollar:

1. Have you been studying English for a long time?
Siz anchadan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganyapsizmi?

2. Has she been working here since 2020?
U 2020-yildan beri shu yerda ishlayaptimi?

3. Have they been waiting for us for an hour?
Ular bizni bir soatdan beri kutishyaptimi?

4. Has your brother been preparing for the test?
Akang / ukang testga tayyorlanyaptimi?

5. Have we been doing this exercise correctly?
Biz bu mashqni to‘g‘ri bajaryapmizmi?

3. Have va Has ishlatilishi

Present Perfect Continuous zamonida have yoki has ega bilan mos ishlatiladi.

Ega | Yordamchi fe’l | Misol
I | have | I have been studying.
You | have | You have been working.
We | have | We have been learning.
They | have | They have been playing.
He | has | He has been reading.
She | has | She has been writing.
It | has | It has been raining.

Muhim qoida

I / you / we / they bilan have ishlatiladi.

He / she / it bilan has ishlatiladi.

10 ta misol

1. I have been reading grammar rules.
Men grammatika qoidalarini o‘qiyapman / o‘qib kelyapman.

2. You have been asking good questions.
Siz yaxshi savollar berib kelyapsiz.

3. We have been learning new words.
Biz yangi so‘zlarni o‘rganib kelyapmiz.

4. They have been practicing speaking.
Ular gapirishni mashq qilib kelishyapti.

5. He has been solving chemistry problems.
U kimyo masalalarini yechib kelyapti.

6. She has been writing an article.
U maqola yozib kelyapti.

7. It has been raining since morning.
Ertalabdan beri yomg‘ir yog‘yapti.

8. My parents have been living in this city for many years.
Ota-onam ko‘p yillardan beri bu shaharda yashab kelishyapti.

9. The teacher has been explaining the topic for twenty minutes.
O‘qituvchi yigirma daqiqadan beri mavzuni tushuntiryapti.

10. The students have been preparing for the entrance exam.
O‘quvchilar kirish imtihoniga tayyorlanib kelishyapti.

4. Present Perfect Continuous qachon ishlatiladi?

a) O‘tmishda boshlangan va hozirgacha davom etayotgan ish-harakat

Bu holatda ish-harakat oldin boshlangan va hozir ham davom etmoqda.

Misollar:

1. I have been studying English since 2021.
Men 2021-yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganib kelyapman.

2. She has been working at this school for five years.
U bu maktabda besh yildan beri ishlayapti.

3. They have been living in Tashkent since last year.
Ular o‘tgan yildan beri Toshkentda yashashyapti.

b) Hozir ko‘rinib turgan natijaga sabab bo‘lgan davomiy jarayon

Bu holatda ish-harakatning natijasi hozir ko‘rinib turadi.

Misollar:

1. You are wet. Have you been walking in the rain?
Siz ho‘lsiz. Yomg‘irda yurib keldingizmi?

2. She is tired because she has been studying all night.
U charchagan, chunki u tun bo‘yi o‘qigan / o‘qib chiqqan.

3. His hands are dirty because he has been repairing his bike.
Uning qo‘llari kir, chunki u velosipedini tuzatib yurgan.

c) “For” va “since” bilan davomiylikni ifodalash

For — muddatni bildiradi.
Since — boshlanish vaqtini bildiradi.

Misollar:

1. I have been waiting for you for thirty minutes.
Men sizni o‘ttiz daqiqadan beri kutyapman.

2. He has been learning Russian since January.
U yanvardan beri rus tilini o‘rganib kelyapti.

3. We have been working on this project for two weeks.
Biz bu loyiha ustida ikki haftadan beri ishlayapmiz.

d) Recently / lately bilan yaqin vaqtdan beri davom etayotgan ish-harakat

Recently va lately — “yaqinda”, “oxirgi paytlarda” degan ma’noni beradi.

Misollar:

1. I have been feeling tired lately.
Men oxirgi paytlarda charchoq his qilyapman.

2. She has been reading a lot recently.
U yaqinda juda ko‘p o‘qiyapti.

3. They have been practicing speaking lately.
Ular oxirgi paytlarda gapirishni mashq qilishyapti.

e) How long...? savollariga javob berishda

How long...? — “Qancha vaqtdan beri?” degani.

Misollar:

1. How long have you been learning English?
Siz qancha vaqtdan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganyapsiz?

2. How long has she been working here?
U qancha vaqtdan beri bu yerda ishlayapti?

3. How long have they been waiting?
Ular qancha vaqtdan beri kutishyapti?

5. Asosiy vaqt ko‘rsatkichlari

1. For two hours

For two hours — ikki soatdan beri.

I have been studying for two hours.
Men ikki soatdan beri o‘qiyapman.
Izoh: o‘qish jarayoni ikki soat davom etgan va ehtimol hozir ham davom etmoqda.

2. For three days

For three days — uch kundan beri.

She has been preparing for the interview for three days.
U uch kundan beri suhbatga tayyorlanyapti.
Izoh: tayyorgarlik uch kun oldin boshlangan.

3. For a long time

For a long time — anchadan beri.

We have been discussing this problem for a long time.
Biz bu muammoni anchadan beri muhokama qilyapmiz.
Izoh: jarayon uzoq vaqt davom etgan.

4. Since morning

Since morning — ertalabdan beri.

It has been raining since morning.
Ertalabdan beri yomg‘ir yog‘yapti.
Izoh: yomg‘ir ertalab boshlangan va hozir ham davom etmoqda.

5. Since 2020

Since 2020 — 2020-yildan beri.

He has been working as a teacher since 2020.
U 2020-yildan beri o‘qituvchi bo‘lib ishlayapti.
Izoh: ish faoliyati 2020-yilda boshlangan.

6. Since I was a child

Since I was a child — bolaligimdan beri.

I have been interested in science since I was a child.
Men bolaligimdan beri ilm-fanga qiziqib kelaman.
Izoh: qiziqish bolalikdan boshlangan.

7. Recently

Recently — yaqinda, oxirgi vaqtlarda.

They have been learning online recently.
Ular yaqinda onlayn o‘qishyapti.
Izoh: bu holat so‘nggi vaqtlarda davom etmoqda.

8. Lately

Lately — oxirgi paytlarda.

I have been sleeping late lately.
Men oxirgi paytlarda kech uxlayapman.
Izoh: bu odat so‘nggi kunlarda davom etmoqda.

9. All day

All day — kun bo‘yi.

She has been working all day.
U kun bo‘yi ishlayapti.
Izoh: ish uzoq davom etgani va charchoq natijasi bo‘lishi mumkinligi ta’kidlanadi.

10. All morning

All morning — butun ertalab.

We have been cleaning the classroom all morning.
Biz butun ertalab sinfxonani tozalayapmiz.
Izoh: jarayon ertalab davomida davom etgan.

11. How long

How long — qancha vaqtdan beri?

How long have you been using this app?
Siz bu ilovadan qancha vaqtdan beri foydalanayapsiz?
Izoh: savol ish-harakatning davomiyligini so‘rayapti.

6. “For” va “Since” farqi

So‘z | Ma’nosi | Nima bildiradi? | Misollar
For | davomida / -dan beri | Muddat | for two hours, for five years
Since | -dan beri | Boshlanish nuqtasi | since 2020, since morning

For ishlatiladigan holatlar

For + muddat

Masalan:

for two minutes — ikki daqiqa davomida
for ten years — o‘n yil davomida
for a week — bir hafta davomida

For bilan 8 ta misol

1. I have been waiting for ten minutes.
Men o‘n daqiqadan beri kutyapman.

2. She has been studying for three hours.
U uch soatdan beri o‘qiyapti.

3. They have been playing chess for an hour.
Ular bir soatdan beri shaxmat o‘ynashyapti.

4. We have been working for two weeks.
Biz ikki haftadan beri ishlayapmiz.

5. He has been learning English for five years.
U besh yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganib kelyapti.

6. My sister has been cooking for forty minutes.
Singlim / opam qirq daqiqadan beri ovqat pishiryapti.

7. The students have been writing the test for half an hour.
O‘quvchilar yarim soatdan beri test yozishyapti.

8. I have been thinking about this question for a long time.
Men bu savol haqida anchadan beri o‘ylayapman.

Since ishlatiladigan holatlar

Since + boshlanish vaqti

Masalan:

since morning — ertalabdan beri
since Monday — dushanbadan beri
since 2020 — 2020-yildan beri

Since bilan 8 ta misol

1. I have been studying since morning.
Men ertalabdan beri o‘qiyapman.

2. She has been working here since 2022.
U 2022-yildan beri bu yerda ishlayapti.

3. They have been living in this house since March.
Ular mart oyidan beri bu uyda yashashyapti.

4. We have been waiting since 8 o’clock.
Biz soat 8 dan beri kutyapmiz.

5. He has been learning biology since last year.
U o‘tgan yildan beri biologiyani o‘rganib kelyapti.

6. My brother has been using this laptop since September.
Ukam / akam sentabrdan beri bu noutbukdan foydalanayapti.

7. The teacher has been explaining the topic since the lesson started.
O‘qituvchi dars boshlanganidan beri mavzuni tushuntiryapti.

8. I have been interested in chemistry since I was a child.
Men bolaligimdan beri kimyoga qiziqib kelaman.

7. Present Perfect Continuous va Present Perfect farqi

Zamon | Asosiy e’tibor | Tuzilma | Misol
Present Perfect | Natija, tajriba, tugallangan ish | have/has + V3 | I have read this book.
Present Perfect Continuous | Jarayon, davomiylik, qancha vaqtdan beri | have/has + been + V-ing | I have been reading this book for two hours.

Asosiy farq

Present Perfect ishning natijasini ko‘rsatadi.
Present Perfect Continuous ishning jarayonini va davomiyligini ko‘rsatadi.

Qisqa grammatik qoida

Present Perfect Continuous mavzusini eslab qolish uchun 7 ta sodda qoida:

1. Ish o‘tmishda boshlangan va hozir ham davom etayotgan bo‘lsa — Present Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.

2. “Qancha vaqtdan beri?” degan savolga javob berilsa — have/has been + V-ing ishlatiladi.

3. Jarayon va davomiylik muhim bo‘lsa — Present Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.

4. Natija muhim bo‘lsa — ko‘pincha Present Perfect ishlatiladi.

5. For muddat bilan ishlatiladi: for two hours, for five years.

6. Since boshlanish nuqtasi bilan ishlatiladi: since morning, since 2020.

7. Know, believe, understand, love, want, own, belong kabi state verbs bilan odatda Present Perfect Continuous emas, Present Perfect ishlatiladi.
grammar_rules_en:
Present Perfect Continuous is an English tense that shows an action that started in the past and is still going on now.

The main meaning of this tense:

“How long has it been going on?”

For example:

I have been studying English for two years.

This sentence shows that the action started in the past: two years ago.
And it is still going on now: I am still learning English.

The Present Perfect Continuous usually emphasises 3 things:

1. Duration — it shows how long the action has lasted.

2. Process — the action itself, the process of doing it is important.

3. Result — explains the reason for the current state that is visible now.

For example:

She is tired because she has been working all day.
She is tired because she has been working all day.

Here, the main focus is not on whether the action has finished or not, but on the fact that the process has lasted a long time and its result is currently visible.

2. Formula

2.1. Affirmative sentence

Formula:

Subject + have/has + been + V-ing

That is:

Subject + have/has + been + verb-ing

Examples:

1. I have been learning English for three years.

2. She has been reading this book since morning.

3. They have been playing football for two hours.

4. My brother has been preparing for the exam all week.

5. We have been discussing this topic for a long time.

2.2. Negative sentence

Formula:

Subject + have/has + not + been + V-ing

Short forms:

have not = haven’t
has not = hasn’t

Examples:

1. I have not been sleeping well lately.

2. He has not been attending classes regularly.

3. They have not been studying seriously this month.

4. She has not been feeling well recently.

5. We have not been using this application for a long time.

2.3. Interrogative sentence

Formula:

Have/Has + subject + been + V-ing?

That is:

Have/Has + subject + been + verb-ing?

Examples:

1. Have you been studying English for a long time?

2. Has she been working here since 2020?

3. Have they been waiting for us for an hour?

4. Has your brother been preparing for the test?

5. Have we been doing this exercise correctly?

3. Usage of Have and Has

In the Present Perfect Continuous tense, have or has is used according to the subject.

Subject | Auxiliary verb | Example
I | have | I have been studying.
You | have | You have been working.
We | have | We have been learning.
They | have | They have been playing.
He | has | He has been reading.
She | has | She has been writing.
It | has | It has been raining.

Important rule

Use have with I / you / we / they.

Use has with He / she / it.

10 examples

1. I have been reading grammar rules.

2. You have been asking good questions.

3. We have been learning new words.

4. They have been practicing speaking.

5. He has been solving chemistry problems.

6. She has been writing an article.

7. It has been raining since morning.

8. My parents have been living in this city for many years.

9. The teacher has been explaining the topic for twenty minutes.

10. The students have been preparing for the entrance exam.

4. When is Present Perfect Continuous used?

a) An action that started in the past and is still going on now

In this case, the action started earlier and is still ongoing now.

Examples:

1. I have been studying English since 2021.

2. She has been working at this school for five years.

3. They have been living in Tashkent since last year.

b) A continuous process that has caused a result that is currently visible

In this case, the result of the action is currently visible.

Examples:

1. You are wet. Have you been walking in the rain?

2. She is tired because she has been studying all night.
She is tired because she has been studying all night.

3. His hands are dirty because he has been repairing his bike.
His hands are dirty because he has been repairing his bike.

c) Expressing duration with “for” and “since”

For indicates duration.
Since indicates the starting time.

Examples:

1. I have been waiting for you for thirty minutes.
I have been waiting for you for thirty minutes.
Note: The waiting process has lasted for thirty minutes and is likely still ongoing.

2. He has been learning Russian since January.
He has been learning Russian since January.
Note: The learning started in January.

3. We have been working on this project for two weeks.
We have been working on this project for two weeks.
Note: The work has lasted for two weeks.

d) Ongoing actions recently with recently / lately

Recently and lately mean “recently” or “in recent times.”

Examples:

1. I have been feeling tired lately.
I have been feeling tired lately.

2. She has been reading a lot recently.
She has been reading a lot recently.

3. They have been practicing speaking lately.
They have been practicing speaking lately.

e) Answering questions with How long...?

How long...? means “How long has it been?”

Examples:

1. How long have you been learning English?
How long have you been learning English?

2. How long has she been working here?
How long has she been working here?

3. How long have they been waiting?
How long have they been waiting?

5. Main time indicators

1. For two hours

For two hours means iki soatdan beri.

I have been studying for two hours.
I have been studying for two hours.
Note: The studying process has lasted for two hours and is likely still ongoing.

2. For three days

For three days means uch kundan beri.

She has been preparing for the interview for three days.
She has been preparing for the interview for three days.
Note: The preparation started three days ago.

3. For a long time

For a long time means anchadan beri.

We have been discussing this problem for a long time.
We have been discussing this problem for a long time.
Note: The process has lasted for a long time.

4. Since morning

Since morning means ertalabdan beri.

It has been raining since morning.
It has been raining since morning.
Note: The rain started in the morning and is still ongoing.

5. Since 2020

Since 2020 means 2020-yildan beri.

He has been working as a teacher since 2020.
He has been working as a teacher since 2020.
Note: The work activity started in 2020.

6. Since I was a child

Since I was a child means bolaligimdan beri.

I have been interested in science since I was a child.
I have been interested in science since I was a child.
Note: The interest started in childhood.

7. Recently

Recently means yaqinda, oxirgi vaqtlarda.

They have been learning online recently.
They have been learning online recently.
Note: This situation has been ongoing recently.

8. Lately

Lately means oxirgi paytlarda.

I have been sleeping late lately.
I have been sleeping late lately.
Note: This habit has been ongoing in recent days.

9. All day

All day means kun bo‘yi.

She has been working all day.
She has been working all day.
Note: The work has lasted a long time and may result in fatigue.

10. All morning

All morning means butun ertalab.

We have been cleaning the classroom all morning.
We have been cleaning the classroom all morning.
Note: The process has continued throughout the morning.

11. How long

How long means qancha vaqtdan beri?

How long have you been using this app?
How long have you been using this app?
Note: The question asks about the duration of the action.

6. The difference between “For” and “Since”

Word | Meaning | What it indicates? | Examples
For | during / since | Duration | for two hours, for five years
Since | since | Starting point | since 2020, since morning

Situations where For is used

For + duration

For example:

for two minutes
for ten years
for a week

Eight examples with For

1. I have been waiting for ten minutes.
I have been waiting for ten minutes.

2. She has been studying for three hours.
She has been studying for three hours.

3. They have been playing chess for an hour.
They have been playing chess for an hour.

4. We have been working for two weeks.
We have been working for two weeks.

5. He has been learning English for five years.
He has been learning English for five years.

6. My sister has been cooking for forty minutes.
My sister has been cooking for forty minutes.

7. The students have been writing the test for half an hour.
The students have been writing the test for half an hour.

8. I have been thinking about this question for a long time.
I have been thinking about this question for a long time.

Situations where Since is used

Since + starting time

For example:

since morning
since Monday
since 2020

Eight examples with Since

1. I have been studying since morning.
I have been studying since morning.

2. She has been working here since 2022.
She has been working here since 2022.

3. They have been living in this house since March.
They have been living in this house since March.

4. We have been waiting since 8 o’clock.
We have been waiting since 8 o’clock.

5. He has been learning biology since last year.
He has been learning biology since last year.

6. My brother has been using this laptop since September.
My brother has been using this laptop since September.

7. The teacher has been explaining the topic since the lesson started.
The teacher has been explaining the topic since the lesson started.

8. I have been interested in chemistry since I was a child.
I have been interested in chemistry since I was a child.

7. The difference between Present Perfect Continuous and Present Perfect

Tense | Main focus | Structure | Example
Present Perfect | Result, experience, completed action | have/has + V3 | I have read this book.
Present Perfect Continuous | Process, duration, how long | have/has + been + V-ing | I have been reading this book for two hours.

Main difference

Present Perfect shows the result of the action.
Present Perfect Continuous shows the process and duration of the action.

Short grammar rule

To remember the Present Perfect Continuous topic, here are 7 simple rules:

1. If the action started in the past and is still continuing now — Present Perfect Continuous is used.

2. If answering the question “How long?” — have/has been + V-ing is used.

3. If the process and duration are important — Present Perfect Continuous is used.

4. If the result is important — often Present Perfect is used.

5. For is used with duration: for two hours, for five years.

6. Since is used with a starting point: since morning, since 2020.

7. With state verbs like know, believe, understand, love, want, own, belong, usually Present Perfect is used, not Present Perfect Continuous.
grammar_rules_ru:
Present Perfect Continuous — это время английского языка, которое обозначает действие, начавшееся в прошлом и продолжающееся до сих пор.

Основное значение этого времени:

«Как долго это продолжается?»

Например:

I have been studying English for two years.
Я изучаю английский уже два года.

В этом предложении действие началось в прошлом: two years ago — два года назад.
И продолжается сейчас: я всё ещё изучаю английский.

Present Perfect Continuous обычно подчёркивает 3 вещи:

1. Длительность — показывает, сколько времени длилось действие.

2. Процесс — важен сам процесс выполнения действия.

3. Результат — объясняет причину текущего состояния.

Например:

She is tired because she has been working all day.
Она устала, потому что работала весь день.

Здесь основное внимание уделяется не тому, завершено действие или нет, а тому, что процесс длился долго и его результат сейчас виден.

2. Формула

2.1. Утвердительное предложение

Формула:

Subject + have/has + been + V-ing

То есть:

Подлежащее + have/has + been + глагол-ing

Примеры:

1. I have been learning English for three years.
Я изучаю английский уже три года.

2. She has been reading this book since morning.
Она читает эту книгу с утра.

3. They have been playing football for two hours.
Они играют в футбол уже два часа.

4. My brother has been preparing for the exam all week.
Мой брат готовится к экзамену всю неделю.

5. We have been discussing this topic for a long time.
Мы обсуждаем эту тему уже долго.

2.2. Отрицательное предложение

Формула:

Subject + have/has + not + been + V-ing

Сокращенные формы:

have not = haven’t
has not = hasn’t

Примеры:

1. I have not been sleeping well lately.
Я плохо сплю в последнее время.

2. He has not been attending classes regularly.
Он не посещает занятия регулярно.

3. They have not been studying seriously this month.
Они не учатся серьезно в этом месяце.

4. She has not been feeling well recently.
Она недавно плохо себя чувствовала.

5. We have not been using this application for a long time.
Мы не использовали это приложение уже долго.

2.3. Вопросительное предложение

Формула:

Have/Has + subject + been + V-ing?

То есть:

Have/Has + подлежащее + been + глагол-ing?

Примеры:

1. Have you been studying English for a long time?
Вы давно изучаете английский?

2. Has she been working here since 2020?
Она работает здесь с 2020 года?

3. Have they been waiting for us for an hour?
Они ждут нас уже час?

4. Has your brother been preparing for the test?
Твой брат готовится к тесту?

5. Have we been doing this exercise correctly?
Мы правильно выполняем это упражнение?

3. Использование have и has

В времени Present Perfect Continuous используется have или has в зависимости от подлежащего.

Подлежащее | Вспомогательный глагол | Пример
I | have | I have been studying.
You | have | You have been working.
We | have | We have been learning.
They | have | They have been playing.
He | has | He has been reading.
She | has | She has been writing.
It | has | It has been raining.

Важно помнить

С have используется с I / you / we / they.

С has используется с he / she / it.

10 примеров

1. I have been reading grammar rules.
Я читаю правила грамматики.

2. You have been asking good questions.
Вы задавали хорошие вопросы.

3. We have been learning new words.
Мы изучаем новые слова.

4. They have been practicing speaking.
Они практикуют разговорную речь.

5. He has been solving chemistry problems.
Он решает задачи по химии.

6. She has been writing an article.
Она пишет статью.

7. It has been raining since morning.
С утра идёт дождь.

8. My parents have been living in this city for many years.
Мои родители живут в этом городе уже много лет.

9. The teacher has been explaining the topic for twenty minutes.
Учитель объясняет тему уже двадцать минут.

10. The students have been preparing for the entrance exam.
Студенты готовятся к вступительному экзамену.

4. Когда используется Present Perfect Continuous?

a) Действие, начавшееся в прошлом и продолжающееся до сих пор

В этом случае действие началось раньше и продолжается сейчас.

Примеры:

1. I have been studying English since 2021.
Я изучаю английский с 2021 года.

2. She has been working at this school for five years.
Она работает в этой школе уже пять лет.

3. They have been living in Tashkent since last year.
Они живут в Ташкенте с прошлого года.

b) Длительный процесс, который стал причиной текущего результата

В этом случае результат действия виден сейчас.

Примеры:

1. You are wet. Have you been walking in the rain?
Вы мокрые. Вы гуляли под дождём?

2. Она устала, потому что училась всю ночь.
U charchagan, chunki u tun bo‘yi o‘qigan / o‘qib chiqqan.

3. Его руки грязные, потому что он ремонтировал свой велосипед.
Uning qo‘llari kir, chunki u velosipedini tuzatib yurgan.

c) Выражение продолжительности с помощью “for” и “since”

For — обозначает срок.
Since — обозначает время начала.

Примеры:

1. I have been waiting for you for thirty minutes.
Men sizni o‘ttiz daqiqadan beri kutyapman.

2. He has been learning Russian since January.
U yanvardan beri rus tilini o‘rganib kelyapti.

3. We have been working on this project for two weeks.
Biz bu loyiha ustida ikki haftadan beri ishlayapmiz.

d) Действия, продолжающиеся в последнее время с использованием Recently / lately

Recently и lately означают “недавно”, “в последнее время”.

Примеры:

1. I have been feeling tired lately.
Men oxirgi paytlarda charchoq his qilyapman.

2. She has been reading a lot recently.
U yaqinda juda ko‘p o‘qiyapti.

3. They have been practicing speaking lately.
Ular oxirgi paytlarda gapirishni mashq qilishyapti.

e) Ответы на вопросы How long...?

How long...? — означает “Сколько времени?”.

Примеры:

1. How long have you been learning English?
Siz qancha vaqtdan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganyapsiz?

2. How long has she been working here?
U qancha vaqtdan beri bu yerda ishlayapti?

3. How long have they been waiting?
Ular qancha vaqtdan beri kutishyapti?

5. Основные временные указатели

1. For two hours

For two hours — два часа.

I have been studying for two hours.
Men ikki soatdan beri o‘qiyapman.
Примечание: процесс обучения длился два часа и, возможно, продолжается сейчас.

2. For three days

For three days — три дня.

She has been preparing for the interview for three days.
U uch kundan beri suhbatga tayyorlanyapti.
Примечание: подготовка началась три дня назад.

3. For a long time

For a long time — долгое время.

We have been discussing this problem for a long time.
Biz bu muammoni anchadan beri muhokama qilyapmiz.
Примечание: процесс длился долго.

4. Since morning

Since morning — с утра.

It has been raining since morning.
Ertalabdan beri yomg‘ir yog‘yapti.
Примечание: дождь начался утром и продолжается сейчас.

5. Since 2020

Since 2020 — с 2020 года.

He has been working as a teacher since 2020.
U 2020-yildan beri o‘qituvchi bo‘lib ishlayapti.
Примечание: трудовая деятельность началась в 2020 году.

6. Since I was a child

Since I was a child — с детства.

I have been interested in science since I was a child.
Men bolaligimdan beri ilm-fanga qiziqib kelaman.
Примечание: интерес начался в детстве.

7. Recently

Recently — недавно, в последнее время.

They have been learning online recently.
Ular yaqinda onlayn o‘qishyapti.
Примечание: это состояние продолжается в последнее время.

8. Lately

Lately — в последнее время.

I have been sleeping late lately.
Men oxirgi paytlarda kech uxlayapman.
Примечание: эта привычка продолжается в последние дни.

9. All day

All day — весь день.

She has been working all day.
U kun bo‘yi ishlayapti.
Примечание: работа длилась долго и может быть причиной усталости.

10. All morning

All morning — все утро.

We have been cleaning the classroom all morning.
Biz butun ertalab sinfxonani tozalayapmiz.
Примечание: процесс продолжался все утро.

11. How long

How long — сколько времени?

How long have you been using this app?
Siz bu ilovadan qancha vaqtdan beri foydalanayapsiz?
Примечание: вопрос касается продолжительности действия.

6. Разница между “For” и “Since”

Слово | Значение | Что обозначает? | Примеры
For | в течение / с | Срок | for two hours, for five years
Since | с | Точка начала | since 2020, since morning

Случаи использования For

For + срок

Например:

for two minutes — в течение двух минут
for ten years — в течение десяти лет
for a week — в течение недели

8 примеров с For

1. I have been waiting for ten minutes.
Men o‘n daqiqadan beri kutyapman.

2. She has been studying for three hours.
U uch soatdan beri o‘qiyapti.

3. They have been playing chess for an hour.
Ular bir soatdan beri shaxmat o‘ynashyapti.

4. We have been working for two weeks.
Biz ikki haftadan beri ishlayapmiz.

5. He has been learning English for five years.
U besh yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganib kelyapti.

6. My sister has been cooking for forty minutes.
Singlim / opam qirq daqiqadan beri ovqat pishiryapti.

7. The students have been writing the test for half an hour.
O‘quvchilar yarim soatdan beri test yozishyapti.

8. I have been thinking about this question for a long time.
Men bu savol haqida anchadan beri o‘ylayapman.

Случаи использования Since

Since + время начала

Например:

since morning — с утра
since Monday — с понедельника
since 2020 — с 2020 года

8 примеров с Since

1. I have been studying since morning.
Men ertalabdan beri o‘qiyapman.

2. She has been working here since 2022.
U 2022-yildan beri bu yerda ishlayapti.

3. They have been living in this house since March.
Они живут в этом доме с марта.

4. We have been waiting since 8 o’clock.
Мы ждем с 8 часов.

5. He has been learning biology since last year.
Он изучает биологию с прошлого года.

6. My brother has been using this laptop since September.
Мой брат использует этот ноутбук с сентября.

7. The teacher has been explaining the topic since the lesson started.
Учитель объясняет тему с начала урока.

8. I have been interested in chemistry since I was a child.
Я интересуюсь химией с детства.

7. Разница между Present Perfect Continuous и Present Perfect

Время | Основное внимание | Структура | Пример
Present Perfect | Результат, опыт, завершённая работа | have/has + V3 | I have read this book.
Present Perfect Continuous | Процесс, продолжительность, как долго | have/has + been + V-ing | I have been reading this book for two hours.

Основное различие

Present Perfect показывает результат действия.
Present Perfect Continuous показывает процесс и продолжительность действия.

Краткое грамматическое правило

Чтобы запомнить тему Present Perfect Continuous, 7 простых правил:

1. Если действие началось в прошлом и продолжается сейчас — используется Present Perfect Continuous.

2. Если ответ на вопрос «Как долго?» — используется have/has been + V-ing.

3. Если важен процесс и продолжительность — используется Present Perfect Continuous.

4. Если важен результат — часто используется Present Perfect.

5. Используется с промежутком времени: for two hours, for five years.

6. Используется с начальной точкой: since morning, since 2020.

7. С глаголами состояния, такими как know, believe, understand, love, want, own, belong, обычно используется Present Perfect, а не Present Perfect Continuous.

Present Perfect Continuous — bul inglis tilindegi zamon bolıp, ótmishte baslanǵan hám házirge shekem dawam etip atırǵan is-háreketti bildiredi.

Bul zamonnyń asasıy mánisi:

“Qansha waqıttan beri dawam etip atır?”

Mısalı:

I have been studying English for two years.
Men eki jıldan beri inglis tilin úyrenip kiyatırman.

Bul gápte is-háreket ótmishte baslanǵan: two years ago — eki jıl burın.
Hám házir de dawam etip atır: men ele de inglis tilin úyrenip atırman.

Present Perfect Continuous ádette 3 nárseni atap kórsetedi:

1. Dawamlılıq — is qansha waqıt dawam etkenin bildiredi.

2. Jarayon — isniń ózi, bajarılıs jarayony mánilı boladı.

3. Natija — házir kórinip turǵan holatnyń sababın túsindiredi.

Mısalı:

She is tired because she has been working all day.
U charchagan, chunki u kun bo‘yı ishlayapti / ishlab kelmekte.

Bul yerda asasıy e’tibor isniń tugagan-tugamaganında emes, balki jarayon úlken dawam etkeni hám onıń natijası házir kórinip turǵanında.

2. Formula

2.1. Darak gáp

Formula:

Subject + have/has + been + V-ing

Ega + have/has + been + feyil-ing

Mısallar:

1. I have been learning English for three years.
Men uch jıldan beri inglis tilin úyrenip kiyatırman.

2. She has been reading this book since morning.
U ertalapdan beri bul kitapny o‘qiyapti.
