4. My brother has been preparing for the exam all week.
Mening akam / ukam butun hafta davomında imtihonga tayyorlanyapti.

5. We have been discussing this topic for a long time.
Biz bu mavzuni anchadan beri muhokama qilyapmiz.

2.2. Inkor gáp

Formula:

Subject + have/has + not + been + V-ing

Qisqartma shakllar:

have not = haven’t
has not = hasn’t

Mısallar:

1. I have not been sleeping well lately.
Men oxirǵı paytlarda jaqsı uxlamayapman.

2. He has not been attending classes regularly.
U darslarga muntazam qatnashmayapti.

3. They have not been studying seriously this month.
Ular bul oy jiddiy o‘qimayapti.

4. She has not been feeling well recently.
U yaqında ózini jaqsı his qilmayapti.

5. We have not been using this application for a long time.
Biz bul ilovadan anchadan beri qollanmayapmiz.

2.3. So‘roq gáp

Formula:

Have/Has + subject + been + V-ing?

Ya’ni:

Have/Has + ega + been + feyil-ing?

Mısallar:

1. Have you been studying English for a long time?
Siz anchadan beri inglis tilin úyrenip kiyatırmı?

2. Has she been working here since 2020?
U 2020-jıldan beri shu yerda ishlayaptımı?

3. Have they been waiting for us for an hour?
Ular bizni bir soatdan beri kutıp atırmı?

4. Has your brother been preparing for the test?
Akang / ukang testke tayyorlanyaptımı?

5. Have we been doing this exercise correctly?
Biz bul mashqny toǵrı bajarıp atırmı?

3. Have hám Has qollanılışı

Present Perfect Continuous zamonında have yaki has ega menen mos qollanıladı.

Ega | Yordamçı feyil | Mısal
I | have | I have been studying.
You | have | You have been working.
We | have | We have been learning.
They | have | They have been playing.
He | has | He has been reading.
She | has | She has been writing.
It | has | It has been raining.

Muhim qaǵıyda

I / you / we / they menen have qollanıladı.

He / she / it menen has qollanıladı.

10 ta mısal

1. I have been reading grammar rules.
Men grammatika qoidalarin o‘qıyp atırman / o‘qıp kiyatırman.

2. You have been asking good questions.
Siz jaqsı savollar berip kiyatırsız.

3. We have been learning new words.
Biz jańa so‘zlarni úyrenip kiyatırmız.

4. They have been practicing speaking.
Ular gapırwı mashq etip kiyatır.

5. He has been solving chemistry problems.
U kimyo masalalarin yeşip kiyatır.

6. She has been writing an article.
U maqala yozıp kiyatır.

7. It has been raining since morning.
Ertalapdan beri yomğır yağıp atır.

8. My parents have been living in this city for many years.
Ota-anam kóp jıldan beri bul qala da yashap kiyatır.

9. The teacher has been explaining the topic for twenty minutes.
O‘qıtıwshı yigirma daqiqa burın mavzuni túsindiriwde.

10. The students have been preparing for the entrance exam.
O‘quwshılar kirish imtihonına tayyorlanıp kiyatır.

4. Present Perfect Continuous qashan qollanıladı?

a) Ótmishda baslanǵan hám házirge shekem dawam etip atırǵan is-háreket

Bul holatda is-háreket oldın baslanǵan hám házir de dawam etip atır.

Mısallar:

1. I have been studying English since 2021.
Men 2021-jıldan beri inglis tilin úyrenip kiyatırman.

2. She has been working at this school for five years.
U bul mektepte besh jıldan beri ishlayapti.

3. They have been living in Tashkent since last year.
Ular ótkán jıldan beri Toshkentte yashap atır.

b) Házir kórinip turǵan natijaga sabab bolǵan dawamlı jarayon

Bul holatda is-háreketniń natijası házir kórinip turadı.

Mısallar:

1. You are wet. Have you been walking in the rain?
Siz ho‘lsiz. Yomğırda yurıp keldinizmi?

2. She is tired because she has been studying all night.
U charchagan, chunki u tun boyı oqıw atır.

3. His hands are dirty because he has been repairing his bike.
Uning qo'lları kir, chunki u velosipedinı tuzatıp yırğan.

c) “For” hám “since” bilən dawamlılıqnı ifodalaw

For — muddatnı bildiradı.
Since — baslaw waqıtın bildiradı.

Mısallar:

1. I have been waiting for you for thirty minutes.
Men sizni ottiź daqıqadan beri kutıp atırman.

2. He has been learning Russian since January.
U yanvardan beri rus tilin úyrenip atır.

3. We have been working on this project for two weeks.
Biz bu loyiha üstinde ikki haftadan beri jumıs atırmız.

d) Recently / lately bilän yaqın waqıttan beri dawam etip atırǵan is-háreket

Recently hám lately — “yaqında”, “oǵırǵı paytlarda” degan mánini bildiradı.

Mısallar:

1. I have been feeling tired lately.
Men oǵırǵı paytlarda charchap atırmın.

2. She has been reading a lot recently.
U yaqında juda kóp oqıp atır.

3. They have been practicing speaking lately.
Ular oǵırǵı paytlarda gapırwı mashq etip atır.

e) How long...? sorawlarına juwap beriwde

How long...? — “Qancha waqıttan beri?” degeni.

Mısallar:

1. How long have you been learning English?
Siz qancha waqıttan beri inglis tilin úyrenip atırsız?

2. How long has she been working here?
U qancha waqıttan beri bu yerde jumıs atır?

3. How long have they been waiting?
Ular qancha waqıttan beri kutıw atır?

5. Asosiy waqıt ko‘rsatkichları

1. For two hours

For two hours — ikki soatdan beri.

I have been studying for two hours.
Men ikki soatdan beri oqıw atırman.
Izah: oqıw jarayını ikki soat dawam etken hám ehtimol házir de dawam etip atır.

2. For three days

For three days — uch kundan beri.

She has been preparing for the interview for three days.
U uch kundan beri suhbatqa tayyarlanıw atır.
Izah: tayyorgarlıq uch kun burın baslanǵan.

3. For a long time

For a long time — anchadan beri.

We have been discussing this problem for a long time.
Biz bul muammanı anchadan beri muhokama qılıw atırmız.
Izah: jarayın uzáq waqıt dawam etken.

4. Since morning

Since morning — ertalapdan beri.

It has been raining since morning.
Ertalapdan beri yomğır yağıp atır.
Izah: yomğır ertalap baslanǵan hám házir de dawam etip atır.

5. Since 2020

Since 2020 — 2020-jıldan beri.

He has been working as a teacher since 2020.
U 2020-jıldan beri oqıtıwshı bolıp jumıs istey atır.
Izah: jumıs faoliyatı 2020-jılda baslanǵan.

6. Since I was a child

Since I was a child — bolalıqımdan beri.

I have been interested in science since I was a child.
Men bolalıǵımdan beri ilm-fanga qızıqtıǵım bar.
Izah: qızıqtıǵ bolalıqdan boslanǵan.

7. Recently

Recently — yaqında, oxırǵı waqıtlarda.

They have been learning online recently.
Ular yaqında onlayn oqıwshı bolıp atır.
Izah: bul holat sońǵı waqıtlarda dawam etip atır.

8. Lately

Lately — oxırǵı paytlarda.

I have been sleeping late lately.
Men oxırǵı paytlarda kech uxlayatırman.
Izah: bul odat sońǵı kúnlerde dawam etip atır.

9. All day

All day — kún boyı.

She has been working all day.
U kun bo‘yı ishlayapti.
Izoh: is háreket uzáq dawam etkeni hám charchaw natijası bolıwı mümkinligi ta’kidlanadı.

10. All morning

All morning — butun ertalab.

We have been cleaning the classroom all morning.
Biz butun ertalab sinfxonanı tozalayapmiz.
Izoh: jarayán ertalab dawam etip atır.

11. How long

How long — qancha waqıttan beri?

How long have you been using this app?
Siz bul ilovadan qancha waqıttan beri qollanıp atırsız?
Izoh: soraw is-háreketniń dawamlılığın so‘raydı.

6. “For” hám “Since” farqı

Sóz | Ma’nısı | Nima bildiradı? | Mısallar
For | dawamında / -dan beri | Muddat | for two hours, for five years
Since | -dan beri | Boshlanış nuqtası | since 2020, since morning

For qollanıladıǵan holatlar

For + muddat

Mısalı:

for two minutes — ikki daqiqa davomında
for ten years — o‘n yil davomında
for a week — bir hafta davomında

For bilen 8 ta mısal

1. I have been waiting for ten minutes.
Men o‘n daqiqa berin kutıp atırman.

2. She has been studying for three hours.
U uch soat berin oqıp atır.

3. They have been playing chess for an hour.
Ular bir soat berin shaxmat oýnıp atır.

4. We have been working for two weeks.
Biz ikki hafta berin jumıs atırmız.

5. He has been learning English for five years.
U besh jıldan berin inglis tilin úyrenip atır.

6. My sister has been cooking for forty minutes.
Singlim / opam qırq daqiqa berin tamak pışırıp atır.

7. The students have been writing the test for half an hour.
Oqıwshılar yarım soat berin test jazıp atır.

8. I have been thinking about this question for a long time.
Men bul soraw turalı kóp berin oýlap atırman.

Since qollanıladıǵan holatlar

Since + baslaw waqıt

Mısalı:

since morning — ertalap berin
since Monday — dushanba berin
since 2020 — 2020-jıldan berin

Since bilen 8 ta mısal

1. I have been studying since morning.
Men ertalap berin oqıp atırman.

2. She has been working here since 2022.
U 2022-jıldan berin bul jerde jumıs atır.

3. They have been living in this house since March.
Ular mart ayından beri bul uyda turıp atır.

4. We have been waiting since 8 o’clock.
Biz soat 8 den beri kütip atırmız.

5. He has been learning biology since last year.
Ol ötkən jıldan beri biologiyanı úyrenip atır.

6. My brother has been using this laptop since September.
Uqım / aqım sentábrdan beri bul noutbukdan paydalanıp atır.

7. The teacher has been explaining the topic since the lesson started.
Oqıtıwşı dars bastalǵanından beri mavzuni túsindiriw atır.

8. I have been interested in chemistry since I was a child.
Men balalıqımdan beri kimyaga qızıqtı bolıp atırmın.

7. Present Perfect Continuous hám Present Perfect farqı

Zamon | Asosiy e’tibor | Tuzılma | Mısal
Present Perfect | Natija, tajriba, tugallıǵan is | have/has + V3 | I have read this book.
Present Perfect Continuous | Jarayon, davomlılıq, qancha waqıttan beri | have/has + been + V-ing | I have been reading this book for two hours.

Asosiy farq

Present Perfect ishtin natijasın körsetedi.
Present Perfect Continuous ishtin jarayonın hám davomlılığın körsetedi.

Qısqa grammatik qaǵıda

Present Perfect Continuous mávzusın eslep qolıw ushın 7 ta sodda qaǵıda:

1. İş ötkende bastalǵan hám házir de dawam etip atır bolsa — Present Perfect Continuous qollanıladı.

2. “Qancha waqıttan beri?” degen sorawğa juwap berilse — have/has been + V-ing qollanıladı.

3. Jarayon hám davomlılıq máhim bolsa — Present Perfect Continuous qollanıladı.

4. Natija máhim bolsa — kóbinese Present Perfect qollanıladı.

5. For muddat bilán qollanıladı: for two hours, for five years.

6. Since bastalǵan nuqtası bilán qollanıladı: since morning, since 2020.

7. Know, believe, understand, love, want, own, belong kabi state verbs bilán odatda Present Perfect Continuous emes, Present Perfect qollanıladı.
reading_passage:
Hi Adam,

Today our English class worked on the long process of developing a computer game. The example came from an indie game studio.

A small team has been developing an educational adventure game for six months. The programmer has been fixing movement problems while the artist has been creating new characters.

Test players have been reporting confusing instructions and difficult levels. The team has been meeting every Friday to review feedback and decide what to change.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Nina has been developing the game for six months.” The game is not finished, but each version has become easier to play.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Nina and Adam compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

The final task asks readers to connect the topic with their own experience. They should explain one idea in their own words and then use the lesson grammar in a new sentence about the long process of developing a computer game.

grammar_rules:
Past Perfect Continuous — o‘tmishdagi biror vaqt yoki hodisadan oldin ma’lum muddat davom etgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Bu zamonning asosiy ma’nosi:

“O‘tmishdagi bir vaqtdan oldin ish-harakat qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotgan edi?”

Masalan:

When I arrived, he had been studying for two hours.
Men yetib kelganimda, u ikki soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan edi.

Bu gapda ikkita o‘tmishdagi holat bor:

1. He had been studying for two hours — u ikki soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan edi.

2. I arrived — men yetib keldim.

Demak, men yetib kelishimdan oldin u o‘qish jarayonini boshlagan va bu jarayon ikki soat davom etgan edi.

Juda sodda tushuncha

Past Perfect Continuous quyidagi savolga javob beradi:

O‘tmishdagi bir hodisadan oldin bu ish qancha vaqtdan beri davom etayotgan edi?

Masalan:

She was tired because she had been working all day.
U charchagan edi, chunki u kun bo‘yi ishlayotgan edi.

Bu gapda:

• u oldin ishlagan;

• bu ish uzoq davom etgan;

• natijada u charchagan.

Past Perfect Continuous nimani ta’kidlaydi?

Bu zamon asosan 3 narsani ta’kidlaydi:

1. Davomiylik — ish ma’lum vaqt davom etgan.

2. Jarayon — ishning o‘zi jarayon sifatida muhim.

3. Sabab-natija — o‘tmishdagi natijaning sababi oldingi davomiy ish bo‘lgan.

2. Formula

1) Darak gap

Formula:

Subject + had been + V-ing

Misollar:

1. I had been studying for three hours before my friend called.
Do‘stim qo‘ng‘iroq qilishidan oldin, men uch soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan edim.

2. She had been working since morning when I saw her.
Men uni ko‘rganimda, u ertalabdan beri ishlayotgan edi.

3. They had been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes before it arrived.
Avtobus kelishidan oldin, ular yigirma daqiqadan beri avtobus kutayotgan edi.

4. We had been preparing for the exam for two weeks before the teacher tested us.
O‘qituvchi bizni tekshirishidan oldin, biz ikki haftadan beri imtihonga tayyorlanayotgan edik.

5. He had been reading the article all morning before the lesson started.
Dars boshlanishidan oldin, u butun ertalab maqolani o‘qiyotgan edi.

2) Inkor gap

Formula:

Subject + had not / hadn’t been + V-ing

Misollar:

1. I had not been sleeping well before the exam.
Imtihondan oldin men yaxshi uxlamayotgan edim.

2. She hadn’t been studying regularly before she failed the test.
U testdan yiqilishidan oldin muntazam o‘qimayotgan edi.

3. They had not been working on the project for long before they stopped.
Ular to‘xtashidan oldin loyiha ustida uzoq vaqt ishlamayotgan edi.

4. We hadn’t been using this method before the new teacher came.
Yangi o‘qituvchi kelishidan oldin biz bu usuldan foydalanmayotgan edik.

5. He had not been attending the lessons before the final exam.
Yakuniy imtihondan oldin u darslarga qatnashmayotgan edi.

3) So‘roq gap

Formula:

Had + subject + been + V-ing?

Misollar:

1. Had you been studying for a long time before I called?
Men qo‘ng‘iroq qilishimdan oldin sen uzoq vaqtdan beri o‘qiyotganmiding?

2. Had she been working there for five years before she moved?
U ko‘chib ketishidan oldin u yerda besh yildan beri ishlayotganmidi?

3. Had they been waiting for us before we arrived?
Biz yetib borishimizdan oldin ular bizni kutayotganmidi?

4. Had we been preparing enough before the exam started?
Imtihon boshlanishidan oldin biz yetarlicha tayyorlanayotganmidik?

5. Had he been living in Tashkent for a long time before he returned to Urgench?
U Urganchga qaytishidan oldin Toshkentda uzoq vaqtdan beri yashayotganmidi?

3. Past Perfect Continuous qachon ishlatiladi?

a) O‘tmishdagi bir hodisadan oldin davom etgan ish-harakat

Agar bir ish o‘tmishda boshqa bir voqeadan oldin boshlanib, ma’lum muddat davom etgan bo‘lsa, Past Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. When the teacher entered the room, the students had been discussing the topic for ten minutes.
O‘qituvchi xonaga kirganida, talabalar mavzuni o‘n daqiqadan beri muhokama qilayotgan edi.

2. Before the rain started, we had been walking for an hour.
Yomg‘ir boshlanishidan oldin biz bir soatdan beri piyoda yurayotgan edik.

3. When I got home, my mother had been cooking for two hours.
Men uyga kelganimda, onam ikki soatdan beri ovqat pishirayotgan edi.

b) O‘tmishdagi natijaga sabab bo‘lgan davomiy jarayon

Agar o‘tmishdagi holatning sababi oldin davom etgan jarayon bo‘lsa, Past Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. He was tired because he had been working all day.
U charchagan edi, chunki u kun bo‘yi ishlayotgan edi.

2. Her eyes were red because she had been crying.
Uning ko‘zlari qizargan edi, chunki u yig‘layotgan edi.

3. The students were confident because they had been preparing for weeks.
Talabalar o‘ziga ishongan edi, chunki ular haftalardan beri tayyorlanayotgan edi.

c) “For” va “since” bilan o‘tmishdagi davomiylikni ifodalash

Past Perfect Continuous for va since bilan ko‘p ishlatiladi.

• For — muddatni bildiradi.

• Since — boshlanish nuqtasini bildiradi.

Misollar:

1. I had been studying for three hours before I took a break.
Tanaffus qilishimdan oldin men uch soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan edim.

2. She had been working since morning when I met her.
Men uni uchratganimda, u ertalabdan beri ishlayotgan edi.

3. They had been living in that city for ten years before they moved.
Ular ko‘chishidan oldin o‘sha shaharda o‘n yildan beri yashayotgan edi.

d) “Before”, “when”, “by the time” bilan ishlatilishi

Past Perfect Continuous ko‘pincha quyidagi bog‘lovchilar bilan ishlatiladi:

• before — ...dan oldin

• when — ...ganda

• by the time — ... vaqtga kelib / ...guncha

Misollar:

1. Before the exam began, we had been revising for two hours.
Imtihon boshlanishidan oldin biz ikki soatdan beri takrorlayotgan edik.

2. When I arrived, they had been waiting outside.
Men yetib kelganimda, ular tashqarida kutayotgan edi.

3. By the time the lesson started, the students had been sitting in the classroom for fifteen minutes.
Dars boshlanguncha, talabalar sinfda o‘n besh daqiqadan beri o‘tirgan edi.

e) O‘tmishda bir ish qancha vaqt davom etganini ta’kidlash

Agar asosiy e’tibor ishning natijasiga emas, balki qancha vaqt davom etganiga qaratilsa, Past Perfect Continuous ishlatiladi.

Misollar:

1. She had been learning English for five years before she entered university.
U universitetga kirishidan oldin besh yildan beri ingliz tilini o‘rganayotgan edi.

2. We had been working on the presentation for a week before we showed it to the teacher.
Taqdimotni o‘qituvchiga ko‘rsatishimizdan oldin biz uning ustida bir haftadan beri ishlayotgan edik.

3. He had been practicing pronunciation for months before he spoke confidently.
U ishonch bilan gapirishidan oldin oylar davomida talaffuz mashq qilayotgan edi.

4. Asosiy vaqt ko‘rsatkichlari

1) For two hours — ikki soatdan beri

I had been studying for two hours before dinner.
Kechki ovqatdan oldin men ikki soatdan beri o‘qiyotgan edim.

Izoh: Bu yerda o‘qish jarayoni kechki ovqatdan oldin ikki soat davom etgan.

2) For three days — uch kundan beri

They had been traveling for three days before they reached the city.
Ular shaharga yetib borishidan oldin uch kundan beri sayohat qilayotgan edi.

Izoh: Sayohat shaharga yetib borishdan oldin uch kun davom etgan.

3) For a long time — uzoq vaqtdan beri

She had been waiting for a long time before the doctor called her.
Shifokor uni chaqirishidan oldin u uzoq vaqtdan beri kutayotgan edi.

Izoh: Kutish jarayoni uzoq davom etgan.

4) Since morning — ertalabdan beri

He had been working since morning when I saw him.
Men uni ko‘rganimda, u ertalabdan beri ishlayotgan edi.

Izoh: Ish ertalab boshlangan va men uni ko‘rgan vaqtgacha davom etgan.

5) Since 2020 — 2020-yildan beri

They had been living in Tashkent since 2020 before they moved to Urgench.
Ular Urganchga ko‘chishidan oldin Toshkentda 2020-yildan beri yashayotgan edi.

Izoh: Yashash jarayoni 2020-yilda boshlangan.

6) Before — ...dan oldin

Before she passed the exam, she had been studying every day.
U imtihondan o‘tishidan oldin har kuni o‘qiyotgan edi.

Izoh: O‘qish imtihondan oldin davom etgan jarayon.

7) When — ...ganda

When I entered the room, they had been discussing the problem.
Men xonaga kirganimda, ular muammoni muhokama qilayotgan edi.

Izoh: Muhokama men kirishimdan oldin boshlangan.

8) By the time — ...guncha / ... vaqtga kelib

By the time the bus arrived, we had been waiting for thirty minutes.
Avtobus kelguncha, biz o‘ttiz daqiqadan beri kutayotgan edik.

Izoh: Kutish avtobus kelishidan oldin 30 daqiqa davom etgan.

9) All day — kun bo‘yi

He was exhausted because he had been working all day.
U holdan toygan edi, chunki u kun bo‘yi ishlayotgan edi.

Izoh: Ish jarayoni butun kun davom etgani natija — charchoqni keltirib chiqargan.

10) All morning — butun ertalab

My sister was sleepy because she had been studying all morning.
Singlim uyquchan edi, chunki u butun ertalab o‘qiyotgan edi.

Izoh: O‘qish jarayoni butun ertalab davom etgan.

11) Until then — o‘sha vaqtgacha

Until then, we had been using the old method.
O‘sha vaqtgacha biz eski usuldan foydalanib kelayotgan edik.

Izoh: Eski usuldan foydalanish o‘sha vaqtgacha davom etgan.

Past Perfect Continuous va Past Perfect farqi

Asosiy farq

Zamon | Tuzilma | Nimani ta’kidlaydi? | Misol | Tarjima
Past Perfect | had + V3 | O‘tmishda boshqa hodisadan oldin tugagan ish yoki natija | When I arrived, he had finished his homework. | Men yetib kelganimda, u uy vazifasini tugatib bo‘lgan edi.
Past Perfect Continuous | had been + V-ing | O‘tmishda boshqa hodisadan oldin davom etgan jarayon yoki muddat | When I arrived, he had been doing his homework for two hours. | Men yetib kelganimda, u ikki soatdan beri uy vazifasini qilayotgan edi.

Juda muhim farq

Past Perfect — ish tugagan, natija muhim.
Past Perfect Continuous — ish qancha vaqt davom etgan, jarayon muhim.

Past Perfect Continuous odatda harakat bildiruvchi fe’llar bilan ishlatiladi:

• study

• work

• wait

• read

• write

• travel

• teach

• prepare

• practice

• research

• cook

• discuss

Lekin ayrim fe’llar davom shaklida odatda ishlatilmaydi. Bular state verbs, ya’ni holat bildiruvchi fe’llar.

State verbs

Fe’l | Tarjima
know | bilmoq
believe | ishonmoq
understand | tushunmoq
love | sevmoq
hate | yomon ko‘rmoq
want | xohlamoq
need | kerak bo‘lmoq
own | egalik qilmoq
belong | tegishli bo‘lmoq

Bunday fe’llar bilan ko‘pincha Past Perfect ishlatiladi.

Noto‘g‘ri va to‘g‘ri misollar

1

❌ I had been knowing him for five years before we worked together.
Biz birga ishlashimizdan oldin men uni besh yildan beri bilayotgan edim.

✅ I had known him for five years before we worked together.
Biz birga ishlashimizdan oldin men uni besh yildan beri bilgan edim.

2

❌ She had been owning that house for ten years before she sold it.
U uyni sotishidan oldin unga o‘n yildan beri egalik qilayotgan edi.

✅ She had owned that house for ten years before she sold it.
U uyni sotishidan oldin unga o‘n yildan beri egalik qilgan edi.

3

❌ We had been understanding the topic before the test.
Testdan oldin biz mavzuni tushunayotgan edik.

✅ We had understood the topic before the test.
Testdan oldin biz mavzuni tushungan edik.

4

❌ He had been believing that idea for years before he changed his opinion.
U fikrini o‘zgartirishidan oldin yillardan beri o‘sha g‘oyaga ishonayotgan edi.

✅ He had believed that idea for years before he changed his opinion.
U fikrini o‘zgartirishidan oldin yillardan beri o‘sha g‘oyaga ishongan edi.

5

❌ They had been needing help before the teacher explained the rule.
O‘qituvchi qoidani tushuntirishidan oldin ular yordamga muhtoj bo‘layotgan edi.

✅ They had needed help before the teacher explained the rule.
O‘qituvchi qoidani tushuntirishidan oldin ular yordamga muhtoj bo‘lgan edi.
grammar_rules_en:
Past Perfect Continuous indicates an action that had been going on for a certain period before a moment or event in the past.

The main meaning of this tense:

“How long had the action been going on before a moment in the past?”

For example:

When I arrived, he had been studying for two hours.
When I arrived, he had been studying for two hours.

There are two past situations in this sentence:

1. He had been studying for two hours — he had been studying for two hours.

2. I arrived — I arrived.

Thus, before I arrived, he had started the studying process, and this process had lasted for two hours.

A very simple understanding

Past Perfect Continuous answers the following question:

How long had this action been going on before an event in the past?

For example:

She was tired because she had been working all day.
She was tired because she had been working all day.

In this sentence:

• she had worked before;

• this work had lasted a long time;

• as a result, she was tired.

What does Past Perfect Continuous emphasize?

This tense mainly emphasizes 3 things:

1. Duration — the action had lasted for a certain time.

2. Process — the action itself is important as a process.

3. Cause-effect — the reason for the past result was the previous ongoing action.

2. Formula

1) Affirmative sentence

Formula:

Subject + had been + V-ing

Examples:

1. I had been studying for three hours before my friend called.
I had been studying for three hours before my friend called.

2. She had been working since morning when I saw her.
She had been working since morning when I saw her.

3. They had been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes before it arrived.
They had been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes before it arrived.

4. We had been preparing for the exam for two weeks before the teacher tested us.
We had been preparing for the exam for two weeks before the teacher tested us.

5. He had been reading the article all morning before the lesson started.
He had been reading the article all morning before the lesson started.

2) Negative sentence

Formula:

Subject + had not / hadn’t been + V-ing

Examples:

1. I had not been sleeping well before the exam.
I had not been sleeping well before the exam.

2. She hadn’t been studying regularly before she failed the test.
She hadn’t been studying regularly before she failed the test.

3. They had not been working on the project for long before they stopped.
They had not been working on the project for long before they stopped.

4. We hadn’t been using this method before the new teacher came.
We hadn’t been using this method before the new teacher came.

5. He had not been attending the lessons before the final exam.
He had not been attending the lessons before the final exam.

3) Interrogative sentence

Formula:

Had + subject + been + V-ing?

Examples:

1. Had you been studying for a long time before I called?
Had you been studying for a long time before I called?

2. Had she been working there for five years before she moved?
Had she been working there for five years before she moved?

3. Had they been waiting for us before we arrived?
Had they been waiting for us before we arrived?

4. Had we been preparing enough before the exam started?
Had we been preparing enough before the exam started?

5. Had he been living in Tashkent for a long time before he returned to Urgench?
Had he been living in Tashkent for a long time before he returned to Urgench?

3. When is Past Perfect Continuous used?

a) An action that had been going on before an event in the past

If an action started in the past before another event and lasted for a certain period, Past Perfect Continuous is used.

Examples:

1. When the teacher entered the room, the students had been discussing the topic for ten minutes.
When the teacher entered the room, the students had been discussing the topic for ten minutes.

2. Before the rain started, we had been walking for an hour.
Before the rain started, we had been walking for an hour.

3. When I got home, my mother had been cooking for two hours.
When I got home, my mother had been cooking for two hours.

b) A continuous process that caused a result in the past

If the reason for a past situation was a process that had been ongoing, Past Perfect Continuous is used.

Examples:

1. He was tired because he had been working all day.
He was tired because he had been working all day.

2. Her eyes were red because she had been crying.
Her eyes were red because she had been crying.

3. The students were confident because they had been preparing for weeks.
The students were confident because they had been preparing for weeks.

c) Expressing past continuity with “for” and “since”

Past Perfect Continuous is often used with for and since.

• For — indicates duration.

• Since — indicates the starting point.

Examples:

1. I had been studying for three hours before I took a break.
Before taking a break, I had been studying for three hours.

2. She had been working since morning when I met her.
When I met her, she had been working since morning.

3. They had been living in that city for ten years before they moved.
They had been living in that city for ten years before they moved.

d) Usage with “before”, “when”, “by the time”

The Past Perfect Continuous is often used with the following conjunctions:

• before — before...

• when — when...

• by the time — by the time... / until...

Examples:

1. Before the exam began, we had been revising for two hours.
Before the exam started, we had been revising for two hours.

2. When I arrived, they had been waiting outside.
When I arrived, they had been waiting outside.

3. By the time the lesson started, the students had been sitting in the classroom for fifteen minutes.
By the time the lesson started, the students had been sitting in the classroom for fifteen minutes.

e) Emphasizing how long an action lasted in the past

If the main focus is on how long the action lasted rather than its result, the Past Perfect Continuous is used.

Examples:

1. She had been learning English for five years before she entered university.
She had been learning English for five years before she entered university.

2. We had been working on the presentation for a week before we showed it to the teacher.
We had been working on the presentation for a week before we showed it to the teacher.

3. He had been practicing pronunciation for months before he spoke confidently.
He had been practicing pronunciation for months before he spoke confidently.

4. Main time indicators

1) For two hours — for two hours

I had been studying for two hours before dinner.
I had been studying for two hours before dinner.

Note: Here, the studying process lasted for two hours before dinner.

2) For three days — for three days

They had been traveling for three days before they reached the city.
They had been traveling for three days before they reached the city.

Note: The traveling lasted for three days before reaching the city.

3) For a long time — for a long time

She had been waiting for a long time before the doctor called her.
She had been waiting for a long time before the doctor called her.

Note: The waiting process lasted for a long time.

4) Since morning — since morning

He had been working since morning when I saw him.
He had been working since morning when I saw him.

Note: The work started in the morning and continued until I saw him.

5) Since 2020 — since 2020

They had been living in Tashkent since 2020 before they moved to Urgench.
They had been living in Tashkent since 2020 before they moved to Urgench.

Note: The living process started in 2020.

6) Before — before...

Before she passed the exam, she had been studying every day.
Before she passed the exam, she had been studying every day.

Note: The studying process continued before passing the exam.

7) When — when...

When I entered the room, they had been discussing the problem.
When I entered the room, they had been discussing the problem.

Note: The discussion started before I entered.

8) By the time — by the time... / until...

By the time the bus arrived, we had been waiting for thirty minutes.
By the time the bus arrived, we had been waiting for thirty minutes.

Note: The waiting lasted for thirty minutes before the bus arrived.

9) All day — all day

He was exhausted because he had been working all day.
He was exhausted because he had been working all day.

Note: The working process lasted all day, resulting in exhaustion.

10) All morning — all morning

My sister was sleepy because she had been studying all morning.
My sister was sleepy because she had been studying all morning.

Note: The studying process lasted all morning.

11) Until then — until then

Until then, we had been using the old method.
Until then, we had been using the old method.

Note: The use of the old method continued until then.

Difference between Past Perfect Continuous and Past Perfect

Main difference

Tense | Structure | What it emphasizes? | Example | Translation
Past Perfect | had + V3 | An action or result that was completed before another event in the past | When I arrived, he had finished his homework. | When I arrived, he had finished his homework.
Past Perfect Continuous | had been + V-ing | A process or duration that was ongoing before another event in the past | When I arrived, he had been doing his homework for two hours. | When I arrived, he had been doing his homework for two hours.

Very important difference

Past Perfect — the action is completed, the result is important.
Past Perfect Continuous — how long the action lasted is important, the process is important.

Past Perfect Continuous is usually used with action verbs:

• study

• work

• wait

• read

• write

• travel

• teach

• prepare

• practice

• research

• cook

• discuss

However, some verbs are not usually used in the continuous form. These are state verbs.

State verbs

Verb | Translation
know | to know
believe | to believe
understand | to understand
love | to love
hate | to hate
want | to want
need | to need
own | to own
belong | to belong

Such verbs are often used with the Past Perfect.

Incorrect and correct examples

1

❌ I had been knowing him for five years before we worked together.
Before we worked together, I had been knowing him for five years.

✅ I had known him for five years before we worked together.
Before we worked together, I had known him for five years.

2

❌ She had been owning that house for ten years before she sold it.
Before she sold the house, she had been owning it for ten years.

✅ She had owned that house for ten years before she sold it.
Before she sold the house, she had owned it for ten years.

3

❌ We had been understanding the topic before the test.
Before the test, we had been understanding the topic.

✅ We had understood the topic before the test.
Before the test, we had understood the topic.

4

❌ He had been believing that idea for years before he changed his opinion.
Before he changed his opinion, he had been believing that idea for years.

✅ He had believed that idea for years before he changed his opinion.
Before he changed his opinion, he had believed that idea for years.

5

❌ They had been needing help before the teacher explained the rule.
Before the teacher explained the rule, they had been needing help.

✅ They had needed help before the teacher explained the rule.
Before the teacher explained the rule, they had needed help.
grammar_rules_ru:
Past Perfect Continuous обозначает действие, которое длилось какое-то время до определённого момента или события в прошлом.

Основное значение этого времени:

«Как долго длилось действие до какого-то момента в прошлом?»

Например:

When I arrived, he had been studying for two hours.
Когда я пришёл, он занимался уже два часа.

В этом предложении две ситуации в прошлом:

1. He had been studying for two hours — он занимался уже два часа.

2. I arrived — я пришёл.

Следовательно, до того как я пришёл, он начал учёбу, и этот процесс длился два часа.

Очень простое понимание

Past Perfect Continuous отвечает на следующий вопрос:

Сколько времени это действие продолжалось до какого-то события в прошлом?

Например:

She was tired because she had been working all day.
Она была уставшей, потому что работала весь день.

В этом предложении:

• она работала раньше;

• эта работа длилась долго;

• в результате она устала.

Что подчеркивает Past Perfect Continuous?

Это время в основном подчеркивает 3 вещи:

1. Продолжительность — действие длилось определённое время.

2. Процесс — само действие важно как процесс.

3. Причина-результат — причиной результата в прошлом было предшествующее длительное действие.

2. Формула

1) Утвердительное предложение

Формула:

Subject + had been + V-ing

Примеры:

1. I had been studying for three hours before my friend called.
Я занимался три часа, прежде чем мой друг позвонил.

2. She had been working since morning when I saw her.
Когда я её увидел, она работала с утра.

3. They had been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes before it arrived.
Они ждали автобус двадцать минут до его приезда.

4. We had been preparing for the exam for two weeks before the teacher tested us.
Мы готовились к экзамену две недели до того, как учитель нас проверил.

5. He had been reading the article all morning before the lesson started.
Он читал статью всё утро до начала урока.

2) Отрицательное предложение

Формула:

Subject + had not / hadn’t been + V-ing

Примеры:

1. I had not been sleeping well before the exam.
Я не спал хорошо перед экзаменом.

2. She hadn’t been studying regularly before she failed the test.
Она не училась регулярно перед тем, как провалила тест.

3. They had not been working on the project for long before they stopped.
Они не работали над проектом долго перед тем, как остановились.

4. We hadn’t been using this method before the new teacher came.
Мы не использовали этот метод до прихода нового учителя.

5. He had not been attending the lessons before the final exam.
Он не посещал занятия перед финальным экзаменом.

3) Вопросительное предложение

Формула:

Had + subject + been + V-ing?

Примеры:

1. Had you been studying for a long time before I called?
Ты долго учился до того, как я позвонил?

2. Had she been working there for five years before she moved?
Она работала там пять лет до того, как переехала?

3. Had they been waiting for us before we arrived?
Они ждали нас до нашего приезда?

4. Had we been preparing enough before the exam started?
Мы достаточно готовились до начала экзамена?

5. Had he been living in Tashkent for a long time before he returned to Urgench?
Он долго жил в Ташкенте до того, как вернулся в Ургенч?

3. Когда используется Past Perfect Continuous?

a) Действие, которое продолжалось до события в прошлом

Если действие началось в прошлом до другого события и длилось определённое время, используется Past Perfect Continuous.

Примеры:

1. When the teacher entered the room, the students had been discussing the topic for ten minutes.
Когда учитель вошёл в комнату, студенты обсуждали тему уже десять минут.

2. Before the rain started, we had been walking for an hour.
Перед тем, как начался дождь, мы шли пешком уже час.

3. When I got home, my mother had been cooking for two hours.
Когда я пришёл домой, мама готовила уже два часа.

b) Длительный процесс, который стал причиной результата в прошлом

Если причиной состояния в прошлом был длительный процесс, используется Past Perfect Continuous.

Примеры:

1. He was tired because he had been working all day.
Он был уставшим, потому что работал весь день.

2. Her eyes were red because she had been crying.
Её глаза были красными, потому что она плакала.

3. The students were confident because they had been preparing for weeks.
Студенты были уверены в себе, потому что готовились неделями.

c) Выражение длительности в прошлом с помощью “for” и “since”

Past Perfect Continuous часто используется с for и since.

• For — обозначает период времени.

• Since — обозначает начальную точку.

Примеры:

1. I had been studying for three hours before I took a break.
Перед тем как я сделал перерыв, я учился три часа.

2. She had been working since morning when I met her.
Когда я её встретил, она работала с утра.

3. They had been living in that city for ten years before they moved.
Перед тем как они переехали, они жили в этом городе десять лет.

d) Использование с “before”, “when”, “by the time”

Past Perfect Continuous часто используется с следующими союзами:

• before — ...до

• when — ...когда

• by the time — ...к тому времени / ...к моменту

Примеры:

1. Before the exam began, we had been revising for two hours.
Перед началом экзамена мы повторяли два часа.

2. When I arrived, they had been waiting outside.
Когда я пришёл, они ждали снаружи.

3. By the time the lesson started, the students had been sitting in the classroom for fifteen minutes.
К тому времени, как начался урок, студенты сидели в классе пятнадцать минут.

e) Подчёркивание того, как долго действие длилось в прошлом

Если основное внимание уделяется не результату действия, а тому, как долго оно длилось, используется Past Perfect Continuous.

Примеры:

1. She had been learning English for five years before she entered university.
Она учила английский язык пять лет перед тем, как поступила в университет.

2. We had been working on the presentation for a week before we showed it to the teacher.
Мы работали над презентацией неделю перед тем, как показали её учителю.

3. He had been practicing pronunciation for months before he spoke confidently.
Он практиковал произношение в течение месяцев перед тем, как заговорил уверенно.

4. Основные временные указатели

1) For two hours — в течение двух часов

I had been studying for two hours before dinner.
Перед ужином я учился в течение двух часов.

Примечание: Здесь процесс учёбы длился два часа до ужина.

2) For three days — в течение трёх дней

They had been traveling for three days before they reached the city.
Они путешествовали в течение трёх дней перед тем, как достигли города.

Примечание: Путешествие длилось три дня до достижения города.

3) For a long time — в течение долгого времени

She had been waiting for a long time before the doctor called her.
Она ждала долго, прежде чем врач её вызвал.

Примечание: Процесс ожидания длился долго.

4) Since morning — с утра

He had been working since morning when I saw him.
Когда я его увидел, он работал с утра.

Примечание: Работа началась с утра и продолжалась до момента, когда я его увидел.

5) Since 2020 — с 2020 года

They had been living in Tashkent since 2020 before they moved to Urgench.
Они жили в Ташкенте с 2020 года перед тем, как переехали в Ургенч.

Примечание: Процесс жизни начался в 2020 году.

6) Before — ...до

Before she passed the exam, she had been studying every day.
Перед тем как она сдала экзамен, она училась каждый день.

Примечание: Процесс учёбы продолжался до экзамена.

7) When — ...когда

When I entered the room, they had been discussing the problem.
Когда я вошёл в комнату, они обсуждали проблему.

Примечание: Обсуждение началось до моего входа.

8) By the time — ...к тому времени / ...к моменту

By the time the bus arrived, we had been waiting for thirty minutes.
К тому времени, как автобус приехал, мы ждали тридцать минут.

Примечание: Ожидание длилось тридцать минут до приезда автобуса.

9) All day — весь день

He was exhausted because he had been working all day.
Он был измотан, потому что работал весь день.

Примечание: Процесс работы длился весь день, что привело к усталости.

10) All morning — всё утро

My sister was sleepy because she had been studying all morning.
Моя сестра была сонной, потому что училась всё утро.

Примечание: Процесс учёбы длился всё утро.

11) Until then — до того времени

Until then, we had been using the old method.
До того времени мы использовали старый метод.

Примечание: Использование старого метода продолжалось до того времени.

Разница между Past Perfect Continuous и Past Perfect

Основное различие

Время | Структура | Что подчеркивает? | Пример | Перевод
Past Perfect | had + V3 | Действие или результат, завершившееся до другого события в прошлом | When I arrived, he had finished his homework. | Когда я пришёл, он закончил домашнее задание.
Past Perfect Continuous | had been + V-ing | Процесс или длительность, происходившие до другого события в прошлом | When I arrived, he had been doing his homework for two hours. | Когда я пришёл, он делал домашнее задание в течение двух часов.

Очень важное различие

Past Perfect — действие завершено, результат важен.
Past Perfect Continuous — важно, как долго длилось действие, процесс важен.

Past Perfect Continuous обычно используется с глаголами действия:

• study

• work

• wait

• read

• write

• путешествовать

• преподавать

• готовить

• практиковать

• исследовать

• готовить

• обсуждать

Однако некоторые глаголы в форме продолженного времени обычно не используются. Это state verbs, то есть глаголы состояния.

State verbs

Глагол | Перевод
know | знать
believe | верить
understand | понимать
love | любить
hate | ненавидеть
want | хотеть
need | нуждаться
own | владеть
belong | принадлежать

С такими глаголами часто используется Past Perfect.

Неправильные и правильные примеры

1

❌ I had been knowing him for five years before we worked together.
Я знал его пять лет до того, как мы начали работать вместе.

✅ I had known him for five years before we worked together.
Я знал его пять лет до того, как мы начали работать вместе.

2

❌ She had been owning that house for ten years before she sold it.
Она владела этим домом десять лет до того, как продала его.

✅ She had owned that house for ten years before she sold it.
Она владела этим домом десять лет до того, как продала его.

3

❌ We had been understanding the topic before the test.
Мы понимали тему до теста.

✅ We had understood the topic before the test.
Мы поняли тему до теста.

4

❌ He had been believing that idea for years before he changed his opinion.
Он верил в эту идею много лет до того, как изменил свое мнение.

✅ He had believed that idea for years before he changed his opinion.
Он верил в эту идею много лет до того, как изменил свое мнение.

5

❌ They had been needing help before the teacher explained the rule.
Им нужна была помощь до того, как учитель объяснил правило.

✅ They had needed help before the teacher explained the rule.
Им нужна была помощь до того, как учитель объяснил правило.
grammar_rules_kk:
Past Perfect Continuous — ótmishtaǵı biror waqıt yamasa hodisadan aldın belgili múddet dawam etken is-háreketti bildiredi.

Bul zamannıń asasıy mánisi:

“Ótmishtaǵı bir waqıttan aldın is-háreket qansha waqıttan beri dawam etip atır edi?”

Mısalı:

When I arrived, he had been studying for two hours.
Men jetip kelgenimde, ol eki saattan beri oqıp atır edi.

Bul gápte ikkita ótmishtaǵı holat bar:

1. He had been studying for two hours — ol eki saattan beri oqıp atır edi.

2. I arrived — men jetip keldim.

Demek, men jetip keluimden aldın ol oqıw jarayının bastalğan hám bul jarayın eki saqtan dawam etken edi.

Juda sodda túsinsha

Past Perfect Continuous quyıdıqı savolğa juwap beredi:

Ótmishtaǵı bir hodisadan aldın bul is qansha waqıttan beri dawam etip atır edi?

Mısalı:

She was tired because she had been working all day.
Ol charchap edi, chunki ol kun boyı ishlap atır edi.

Bul gápte:

• ol aldın ishlap atır;

• bul is uzın dawam etken;

• natijada ol charchap edi.

Past Perfect Continuous nimanı ta’kidlaydı?

Bul zamon asosan 3 narsanı ta’kidlaydı:

1. Davamiylik — is málum waqıt dawam etken.

2. Jarayon — isniń ózi jarayon sifatında muhim.

3. Sabab-natija — ótmishtaǵı natijanıń sababı aldınǵı davam etken is bolğan.

2. Formula

1) Darak gáp

Formula:

Subject + had been + V-ing

Mısallar:

1. I had been studying for three hours before my friend called.
Do‘stim qońğıraq qilishından aldın, men uch saattan beri oqıp atır edim.

2. She had been working since morning when I saw her.
Men onu kórgenimde, ol ertalapdan beri ishlap atır edi.

3. They had been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes before it arrived.
Avtobus kelishinden aldın, olar yigirma daqiqadan beri avtobus kutıp atır edi.

4. We had been preparing for the exam for two weeks before the teacher tested us.
Oqıtıwshı bizni tekşirip atırğanında, biz ikki haftadan beri imtihonga tayyorlanıp atır edik.

5. He had been reading the article all morning before the lesson started.
Dars bastalğanında, ol butun ertalap maqolanı oqıp atır edi.

2) Inkor gáp

Formula:

Subject + had not / hadn’t been + V-ing

Mısallar:

1. I had not been sleeping well before the exam.
Imtihondan aldın men jaqsı uxlamap edim.

2. She hadn’t been studying regularly before she failed the test.
Ol testdan yiqılıp atırğanında muntazam oqımay atır edi.

3. They had not been working on the project for long before they stopped.
Olar toxtap atırğanında loyiha ustında uzın waqıt ishlamay atır edi.

4. We hadn’t been using this method before the new teacher came.
Jańa oqıtıwshı kelip atırğanında biz bul usuldı qollanmay atır edik.

5. He had not been attending the lessons before the final exam.
Yaqın imtihondan aldın ol darslarğa qatnashmay atır edi.

3) So‘roq gáp

Formula:

Had + subject + been + V-ing?

Mısallar:

1. Had you been studying for a long time before I called?
Men qońğıraq qilishımdan aldın sen uzın waqıttan beri oqıp atırğanmı edin?

2. Had she been working there for five years before she moved?
Ol köchip ketip atırğanında ol yerda besh jıldan beri ishlap atırğanmı edi?

3. Had they been waiting for us before we arrived?
Biz jetip barğanımızdan aldın olar bizni kutıp atırğanmı edi?

4. Had we been preparing enough before the exam started?
Imtihon bastalğanından aldın biz yeterlikte tayyorlanıp atırğanmı edik?

5. Had he been living in Tashkent for a long time before he returned to Urgench?
Ol Urganchqa qaytıp atırğanında Toshkentte uzın waqıttan beri yashap atırğanmı edi?

3. Past Perfect Continuous qashan ishlitiledi?

a) Ótmishtaǵı bir hodisadan aldın dawam etken is-háreket

Agar bir is ótmishda basqa bir voqıeadan aldın bastalğan hám málum muddat dawam etken bolsa, Past Perfect Continuous ishlitiledi.

Mısallar:

1. When the teacher entered the room, the students had been discussing the topic for ten minutes.
Oqıtıwshı xonaga kirgeninde, talabalar mavzuni oń daqiqadan beri muhokama etip atır edi.

2. Before the rain started, we had been walking for an hour.
Yomğır bastalğanından aldın biz bir saqtan beri piyada yurip atır edik.

3. When I got home, my mother had been cooking for two hours.
Men uyğa kelgenimde, anam eki saattan beri ovqat pishirip atır edi.

b) Ótmishtaǵı natijaga sabab bolğan davam etken jarayon

Agar ótmishtaǵı holatnıń sababı aldın dawam etken jarayon bolsa, Past Perfect Continuous ishlitiledi.

Mısallar:

1. He was tired because he had been working all day.
Ol charchap edi, chunki ol kun boyı ishlap atır edi.

2. Her eyes were red because she had been crying.
Onıń közleri qızarğan edi, chunki ol yiglap atır edi.

3. The students were confident because they had been preparing for weeks.
Talabalar o‘zine ishongan edi, chunki olar haftalardan beri tayyorlanıp atır edi.

c) “For” hám “since” bilán ótmishtaǵı davamiylikti ifodalaw

Past Perfect Continuous for hám since bilán kóp ishlitiledi.

• For — muddatnı bildirip atır.

• Since — bastalaw nuqtasın bildirip atır.

Mısallar:

1. I had been studying for three hours before I took a break.
Tanaffus qilishımdan aldın men úch soatdan beri oqıp atır edim.

2. She had been working since morning when I met her.
Men uni úchratqanımda, u ertalabdan beri ishlap atır edi.

3. They had been living in that city for ten years before they moved.
Olar köchishidin aldın osha shaharda óń yildan beri yashap atır edi.

d) “Before”, “when”, “by the time” bilan ishlatilishi

Past Perfect Continuous kóbinese quyıdıqı bog‘lovçılar menen ishlitiledi:

• before — ...dan aldın

• when — ...ganda

• by the time — ... waqıtqa kelip / ...gunça

Mısallar:

1. Before the exam began, we had been revising for two hours.
Imtihon bastalğandan aldın biz ikki soatdan beri takrorlap atır edik.

2. When I arrived, they had been waiting outside.
Men yetip kelgenimde, olar tashqarıda kutıp atır edi.

3. By the time the lesson started, the students had been sitting in the classroom for fifteen minutes.
Dars bastalğanda, talabalar sinfda óń besh daqiqa berí otırıp atır edi.

e) Ótmışta bir iş qanşa waqıt dawam etkenin ta’kıdlaş

Agar asasıy e’tibar işniñ natijasına emes, balkı qanşa waqıt dawam etkenine qaratılsa, Past Perfect Continuous ishlitiledi.

Mısallar:

1. She had been learning English for five years before she entered university.
U universitetke kirishidin aldın besh yıldan beri inglis tilin úyrenip atır edi.

2. We had been working on the presentation for a week before we showed it to the teacher.
Taqdimotni oqıtuvchige körsetişimizdin aldın biz onıñ üstinde bir haftadan beri ishlip atır edik.

3. He had been practicing pronunciation for months before he spoke confidently.
U ishonç menen gapırışidin aldın oylar davomında talaffuz mashq qılıp atır edi.

4. Asasiy waqıt ko‘rsatqıçı

1) For two hours — ikki soatdan beri

I had been studying for two hours before dinner.
Kechki ovqatdan aldın men ikki soatdan beri oqıp atır edim.

Izoh: Bu yerde oqıw jarayını kechki ovqatdan aldın ikki soat dawam etken.

2) For three days — úch kundan beri

They had been traveling for three days before they reached the city.
Olar shaharga yetip borışidin aldın úch kundan beri sayahat qılıp atır edi.

Izoh: Sayahat shaharga yetip borışidin aldın úch kun dawam etken.

3) For a long time — uzoq waqıttan beri

She had been waiting for a long time before the doctor called her.
Shifokor uni chaqırışidin aldın u uzoq waqıttan beri kutıp atır edi.

Izoh: Kutıw jarayını uzoq dawam etken.

4) Since morning — ertalabdan beri

He had been working since morning when I saw him.
Men uni körgenimde, u ertalabdan beri ishlap atır edi.

Izoh: İş ertalab bastalğan hám men uni körgen waqıtqa dawam etken.

5) Since 2020 — 2020-yıldan beri

They had been living in Tashkent since 2020 before they moved to Urgench.
Olar Urganchqa köchishidin aldın Toshkentte 2020-yıldan beri yashap atır edi.

Izoh: Yashaw jarayını 2020-yılda bastalğan.

6) Before — ...dan aldın

Before she passed the exam, she had been studying every day.
U imtihondan ótishidin aldın har kúni oqıp atır edi.

Izoh: Oqıw imtihondan aldın dawam etken jarayını.

7) When — ...ganda

When I entered the room, they had been discussing the problem.
Men xonaga kirgenimde, olar muammonı muhokama qılıp atır edi.

Izoh: Muhokama men kirgenimdin aldın bastalğan.

8) By the time — ...gunça / ... waqıtqa kelip

By the time the bus arrived, we had been waiting for thirty minutes.
Avtobus kelgunça, biz óttız daqiqa berí kutıp atır edik.

Izoh: Kutıw avtobus kelishidin aldın 30 daqiqa dawam etken.

9) All day — kun bo‘yı

He was exhausted because he had been working all day.
U holdan toyğan edi, chunki u kun bo‘yı ishlap atır edi.

Izoh: İş jarayını butun kun dawam etkeni natija — charchawı keltirip chiqargan.

10) All morning — butun ertalab

My sister was sleepy because she had been studying all morning.
Singlim uyquchan edi, chunki u butun ertalab oqıp atır edi.

Izoh: Oqıw jarayını butun ertalab dawam etken.

11) Until then — o‘sha waqıtqa qadar

Until then, we had been using the old method.
O‘sha waqıtqa qadar biz eski usuldan paydalanıp kelip atır edik.

Izoh: Eski usuldan paydalanıw o‘sha waqıtqa qadar dawam etken.

Past Perfect Continuous hám Past Perfect farqı

Asasiy farq

Zamon | Tuzılma | Nimeni ta’kıdlaydı? | Mısal | Tarjima
Past Perfect | had + V3 | Ótmışta başqa hodisadan aldın tugatılğan iş yaki natija | When I arrived, he had finished his homework. | Men yetip kelgenimde, u uy vazifasın tugatıp bolğan edi.
Past Perfect Continuous | had been + V-ing | Ótmışta başqa hodisadan aldın dawam etken jarayın yaki muddat | When I arrived, he had been doing his homework for two hours. | Men yetip kelgenimde, u ikki soatdan beri uy vazifasın qılıp atır edi.

Juda muhim farq

Past Perfect — iş tugatılğan, natija muhim.
Past Perfect Continuous — iş qanşa waqıt dawam etken, jarayın muhim.

Past Perfect Continuous odatda háreket bildiriwshi feyllar menen ishlitiledi:

• study

• work

• wait

• read

• write

• sayahat

• óqıt

• dáyarlaw

• tájiribe

• izdew

• pishiruw

• talqıla

Biraq ayrım feyillar dawam şeklinde ádette qollanılmaydı. Bular state verbs, yaǵnıy holat bildirwshi feyillar.

State verbs

Feyil | Tarjima
know | bilmoq
believe | ishonmoq
understand | tushunmoq
love | sevmoq
hate | yomon ko‘rmoq
want | xohlamoq
need | kerak bo‘lmoq
own | egalik qilmoq
belong | tegishli bo‘lmoq

Bunday feyillar menen kóbinese Past Perfect qollanıladı.

Noto‘g‘ri hám to‘g‘ri mısallar

1

❌ I had been knowing him for five years before we worked together.
Biz birga ishlashımızdan aldın men uni besh jıldan beri bilip atır edim.

✅ I had known him for five years before we worked together.
Biz birga ishlashımızdan aldın men uni besh jıldan beri bilgen edim.

2

❌ She had been owning that house for ten years before she sold it.
U uyni sotıwıdan aldın unga oń jıldan beri egalıq qılıp atır edi.

✅ She had owned that house for ten years before she sold it.
U uyni sotıwıdan aldın unga oń jıldan beri egalıq qılğan edi.

3

❌ We had been understanding the topic before the test.
Testden aldın biz mavzuni túsinip atır edik.

✅ We had understood the topic before the test.
Testden aldın biz mavzuni túsingen edik.

4

❌ He had been believing that idea for years before he changed his opinion.
U fikrın oǵartıwıdan aldın yıldardan beri osha góiğa ishanıp atır edi.

✅ He had believed that idea for years before he changed his opinion.
U fikrın oǵartıwıdan aldın yıldardan beri osha góiğa ishangan edi.

5

❌ They had been needing help before the teacher explained the rule.
Oqıtıwşı qoidanı túsindiriwıdan aldın olar yardımğa muhtaç bolıp atır edi.

✅ They had needed help before the teacher explained the rule.
Oqıtıwşı qoidanı túsindiriwıdan aldın olar yardımğa muhtaç bolğan edi.
reading_passage:
This week I learned about adjusting to culture shock abroad. Our class used a realistic situation from an exchange-student reflection.

Before Lena began to feel comfortable, she had been living in another country for almost three months. She had been struggling with unfamiliar meal times and fast informal conversations.

Her host family had been inviting her to local events, which slowly made social situations easier. She also joined a language exchange after she had been avoiding large groups for several weeks.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Amina had been living abroad for three months before she began to feel at home.” Looking back, Lena sees culture shock as a process rather than one single difficult moment.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Amina and Tom compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

reading_vocabulary.definition: confusion caused by living in an unfamiliar culture
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “culture shock” in the context of adjusting to culture shock abroad.

reading_vocabulary.definition: not known or recognized
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “unfamiliar” in the context of adjusting to culture shock abroad.

reading_vocabulary.definition: to change in order to fit a new situation
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “adapt” in the context of adjusting to culture shock abroad.

reading_vocabulary.definition: a program in which students study in another place
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “exchange” in the context of adjusting to culture shock abroad.

reading_vocabulary.definition: slowly over time
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “gradually” in the context of adjusting to culture shock abroad.

reading_vocabulary.definition: careful thought about past experience
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “reflection” in the context of adjusting to culture shock abroad.

reading_questions.question: What is the text mainly about?
options: a noisy afternoon in a student residence
adjusting to culture shock abroad
protecting a national cultural treasure
describing products made in the United States
reading_questions.hint: Use the title and the first paragraph to identify the central topic.

reading_questions.question: Where is the main situation set?
options: an electronics shop near campus
an introductory computing lecture
an exchange-student reflection
a university food magazine
reading_questions.hint: Find the place named near the beginning of the text.

reading_questions.question: Which detail is stated in the text?
options: before Lena began to feel comfortable, she had been living in another country for almost three months
members create a list of places they hope to visit before graduation
new members answer simple questions about where they are from and which sport they like
shops in the neighbourhood close earlier on Sunday than on other days
reading_questions.hint: Return to the paragraph that introduces the first concrete fact.

reading_questions.question: What additional information does the text give?
options: users can study offline because downloaded lessons remain on the phone until they remove them
a label inside one bag shows the owner’s name
the family uses names, dates and possessive forms to label everyone in the picture
she had been struggling with unfamiliar meal times and fast informal conversations
reading_questions.hint: Look for the second supporting detail; do not choose an idea from another topic.

reading_questions.question: Which statement belongs to the later part of the text?
options: students can save documents on a laptop and also use an approved cloud service
her host family had been inviting her to local events, which slowly made social situations easier
written more than a century ago, the novel still attracts new readers because its central conflict feels familiar
books that are used every day are placed on the shelf above the desk
reading_questions.hint: Scan the later paragraph and match the exact meaning, not just a familiar word.

reading_questions.question: What happens or is explained after that?
options: students write one word that describes how they feel before important tests
students who eat breakfast often report better concentration during morning classes

grammar_rules:
Passive Voice — ingliz tilida ish-harakatni kim bajargani emas, balki ishning o‘zi, natijasi yoki kimga/nimaga ta’sir qilgani muhim bo‘lgan holatda ishlatiladigan grammatik shakl.

O‘zbek tilida Passive Voice ko‘pincha quyidagi ma’nolarni beradi:

• bajariladi

• bajarildi

• bajarilgan

• bajarilmoqda

• qilindi

• yozildi

• qurilgan

• ishlatiladi

• tekshirildi

Masalan:

Active Voice:
The teacher explains the rule.
O‘qituvchi qoidani tushuntiradi.

Bu gapda o‘qituvchi ishni bajaryapti. Ya’ni bajaruvchi muhim.

Passive Voice:
The rule is explained by the teacher.
Qoida o‘qituvchi tomonidan tushuntiriladi.

Bu gapda asosiy e’tibor qoidaga qaratilgan. Ya’ni ish-harakatni qabul qilgan narsa muhim.

Passive Voice’da asosiy fikr

Passive Voice’da gapning egasi ishni bajarmaydi. Aksincha, ish-harakat unga nisbatan bajariladi.

Masalan:

The window was broken.
Deraza sindirildi.

Bu yerda kim sindirgani aytilmagan. Muhimi — deraza singan.

10 ta sodda misol

1. The room is cleaned every day.
Xona har kuni tozalanadi.

2. English is spoken in many countries.
Ingliz tili ko‘p mamlakatlarda gapiriladi.

3. The book was written in 1949.
Kitob 1949-yilda yozilgan.

4. The car was repaired yesterday.
Mashina kecha ta’mirlandi.

5. The homework is checked by the teacher.
Uy vazifasi o‘qituvchi tomonidan tekshiriladi.

6. The windows are opened every morning.
Derazalar har kuni ertalab ochiladi.

7. The test will be written tomorrow.
Test ertaga yoziladi.

8. The experiment was conducted in the laboratory.
Tajriba laboratoriyada o‘tkazildi.

9. The data are analyzed carefully.
Ma’lumotlar diqqat bilan tahlil qilinadi.

10. The problem has been solved.
Muammo hal qilingan.

2. Active Voice va Passive Voice farqi

Active Voice

Active Voice’da gapning egasi ish-harakatni bajaradi.

Masalan:

The student reads the book.
O‘quvchi kitobni o‘qiydi.

Bu yerda student — bajaruvchi.

Passive Voice

Passive Voice’da gapning egasi ish-harakatni qabul qiladi.

Masalan:

The book is read by the student.
Kitob o‘quvchi tomonidan o‘qiladi.

Bu yerda book — ish-harakatni qabul qilgan narsa.

Active va Passive jadvali

Active gap | Passive gap | Tarjima | Farqi
The teacher explains the lesson. | The lesson is explained by the teacher. | Dars o‘qituvchi tomonidan tushuntiriladi. | Active’da teacher muhim, Passive’da lesson muhim.
My mother cooks dinner. | Dinner is cooked by my mother. | Kechki ovqat onam tomonidan pishiriladi. | Active’da bajaruvchi, Passive’da ovqat muhim.
Students write tests. | Tests are written by students. | Testlar o‘quvchilar tomonidan yoziladi. | Passive’da testlar gap boshiga chiqadi.
The company sells computers. | Computers are sold by the company. | Kompyuterlar kompaniya tomonidan sotiladi. | Mahsulot muhim.
The doctor examines the patient. | The patient is examined by the doctor. | Bemor shifokor tomonidan tekshiriladi. | Bemor e’tibor markazida.
The police caught the thief. | The thief was caught by the police. | O‘g‘ri politsiya tomonidan ushlandi. | Natija muhim: o‘g‘ri ushlandi.
Someone stole my phone. | My phone was stolen. | Telefonim o‘g‘irlandi. | Bajaruvchi noma’lum.
They built this school in 2020. | This school was built in 2020. | Bu maktab 2020-yilda qurilgan. | Qurilgan bino muhim.
Scientists discovered a new method. | A new method was discovered by scientists. | Yangi metod olimlar tomonidan kashf qilindi. | Keng ilmiy uslub.
People use English worldwide. | English is used worldwide. | Ingliz tili butun dunyoda ishlatiladi. | Bajaruvchi umumiy va muhim emas.

3. Passive Voice umumiy formulasi

Asosiy formula

Subject + be + V3

Ya’ni:

Ega + be fe’li + asosiy fe’lning 3-shakli

Masalan:

The door is opened.
Eshik ochiladi.

Bu yerda:

• The door — subject

• is — be fe’lining zamonga mos shakli

• opened — V3

“Be” fe’li zamonga qarab o‘zgaradi

Passive Voice’da eng muhim narsa: be fe’li zamonga qarab o‘zgaradi.

Zamon | Be shakli | Passive formula
Present Simple | am/is/are | am/is/are + V3
Past Simple | was/were | was/were + V3
Future Simple | will be | will be + V3
Present Continuous | am/is/are being | am/is/are being + V3
Past Continuous | was/were being | was/were being + V3
Present Perfect | have/has been | have/has been + V3
Past Perfect | had been | had been + V3
Future Perfect | will have been | will have been + V3

V3 doim asosiy fe’lning 3-shakli bo‘ladi

Passive Voice’da asosiy fe’l doim V3 bo‘ladi.

Regular verbs

Regular verbs odatda -ed qo‘shimchasi bilan V3 bo‘ladi.

V1 | V2 | V3 | Passive misol
clean | cleaned | cleaned | The room is cleaned.
open | opened | opened | The door was opened.
use | used | used | This method is used.
check | checked | checked | The tests are checked.
prepare | prepared | prepared | The report was prepared.

Misollar:

1. The classroom is cleaned every day.
Sinfxona har kuni tozalanadi.

2. The door was opened by the guard.
Eshik qorovul tomonidan ochildi.

3. This method is used in many schools.
Bu metod ko‘p maktablarda ishlatiladi.

Irregular verbs

Irregular verbs V3 shaklida o‘zgaradi.

V1 | V2 | V3 | Passive misol
write | wrote | written | The book was written.
build | built | built | The school was built.
speak | spoke | spoken | English is spoken.
take | took | taken | The photo was taken.
steal | stole | stolen | My phone was stolen.

Misollar:

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
Kitob Jorj Oruell tomonidan yozilgan.

2. This school was built in 2020.
Bu maktab 2020-yilda qurilgan.

3. English is spoken in many countries.
Ingliz tili ko‘p mamlakatlarda gapiriladi.

4. Passive Voice zamonlar bo‘yicha

4.1. Present Simple Passive

Formula

Subject + am/is/are + V3

Qachon ishlatiladi?

Present Simple Passive odatda quyidagi holatlarda ishlatiladi:

• doimiy ish-harakatlar

• odatlar

• umumiy haqiqatlar

• qoidalar

• muntazam bajariladigan ishlar

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. English is spoken in many countries.
Ingliz tili ko‘p mamlakatlarda gapiriladi.

2. The classroom is cleaned every day.
Sinfxona har kuni tozalanadi.

3. Tests are checked by the teacher.
Testlar o‘qituvchi tomonidan tekshiriladi.

4. This medicine is used for pain.
Bu dori og‘riq uchun ishlatiladi.

5. Students are given homework after the lesson.
O‘quvchilarga darsdan keyin uy vazifasi beriladi.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. This room is not used every day.
Bu xona har kuni ishlatilmaydi.

2. Phones are not allowed during the exam.
Imtihon paytida telefonlarga ruxsat berilmaydi.

3. The door is not opened after 10 p.m.
Kechki 10 dan keyin eshik ochilmaydi.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Is English spoken in your school?
Sizning maktabingizda ingliz tili gapiriladimi?

2. Are the tests checked every week?
Testlar har hafta tekshiriladimi?

3. Is this method used in universities?
Bu metod universitetlarda ishlatiladimi?

4.2. Past Simple Passive

Formula

Subject + was/were + V3

Qachon ishlatiladi?

Past Simple Passive o‘tmishda bajarilgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The school was built in 2020.
Maktab 2020-yilda qurilgan.

2. The car was repaired yesterday.
Mashina kecha ta’mirlandi.

3. The books were delivered last week.
Kitoblar o‘tgan hafta yetkazildi.

4. The lesson was explained clearly.
Dars aniq tushuntirildi.

5. The documents were signed by the director.
Hujjatlar direktor tomonidan imzolandi.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The window was not broken by me.
Deraza men tomonidan sindirilmadi.

2. The emails were not sent yesterday.
Email xatlar kecha yuborilmadi.

3. The task was not completed on time.
Topshiriq vaqtida bajarilmadi.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Was the book written in English?
Kitob ingliz tilida yozilganmi?

2. Were the students invited to the meeting?
Talabalar yig‘ilishga taklif qilindimi?

3. Was the experiment conducted yesterday?
Tajriba kecha o‘tkazildimi?

4.3. Future Simple Passive

Formula

Subject + will be + V3

Qachon ishlatiladi?

Future Simple Passive kelajakda bajariladigan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The results will be announced tomorrow.
Natijalar ertaga e’lon qilinadi.

2. The new school will be opened next year.
Yangi maktab kelasi yili ochiladi.

3. The documents will be checked soon.
Hujjatlar tez orada tekshiriladi.

4. The test will be written on Monday.
Test dushanba kuni yoziladi.

5. The project will be presented at the conference.
Loyiha konferensiyada taqdim etiladi.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The meeting will not be held today.
Yig‘ilish bugun o‘tkazilmaydi.

2. The exam will not be cancelled.
Imtihon bekor qilinmaydi.

3. The report will not be finished tonight.
Hisobot bugun kechqurun tugatilmaydi.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Will the results be announced today?
Natijalar bugun e’lon qilinadimi?

2. Will the classroom be cleaned before the lesson?
Sinfxona darsdan oldin tozalanadimi?

3. Will the project be accepted?
Loyiha qabul qilinadimi?

4.4. Present Continuous Passive

Formula

Subject + am/is/are being + V3

Qachon ishlatiladi?

Bu zamon ayni paytda bajarilayotgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Ma’nosi: hozir bajarilmoqda

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The room is being cleaned now.
Xona hozir tozalanmoqda.

2. The test papers are being checked.
Test varaqalari tekshirilmoqda.

3. The road is being repaired.
Yo‘l ta’mirlanmoqda.

4. The new rules are being discussed.
Yangi qoidalar muhokama qilinmoqda.

5. The experiment is being conducted in the lab.
Tajriba laboratoriyada o‘tkazilmoqda.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The computer is not being used now.
Kompyuter hozir ishlatilmayapti.

2. The documents are not being checked at the moment.
Hujjatlar ayni paytda tekshirilmayapti.

3. The room is not being painted today.
Xona bugun bo‘yalmayapti.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Is the lesson being recorded now?
Dars hozir yozib olinmoqdami?

2. Are the tests being checked?
Testlar tekshirilmoqdami?

3. Is the building being repaired?
Bino ta’mirlanmoqdami?

4.5. Past Continuous Passive

Formula

Subject + was/were being + V3

Qachon ishlatiladi?

Bu zamon o‘tmishda ayni bir vaqtda bajarilayotgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Ma’nosi: bajarilayotgan edi

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The room was being cleaned when I arrived.
Men kelganimda xona tozalanayotgan edi.

2. The tests were being checked at 5 p.m.
Soat 5 da testlar tekshirilayotgan edi.

3. The road was being repaired yesterday morning.
Kecha ertalab yo‘l ta’mirlanayotgan edi.

4. The documents were being prepared during the meeting.
Yig‘ilish paytida hujjatlar tayyorlanayotgan edi.

5. The patient was being examined when the doctor arrived.
Shifokor kelganida bemor tekshirilayotgan edi.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The room was not being cleaned at that time.
O‘sha paytda xona tozalanmayotgan edi.

2. The books were not being delivered yesterday.
Kitoblar kecha yetkazilmayotgan edi.

3. The project was not being discussed when I entered.
Men kirganimda loyiha muhokama qilinmayotgan edi.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Was the lesson being recorded at 10 a.m.?
Soat 10 da dars yozib olinayotgan edimi?

2. Were the students being tested when you came?
Siz kelganingizda o‘quvchilar test qilinayotgan edimi?

3. Was the car being repaired yesterday afternoon?
Kecha tushdan keyin mashina ta’mirlanayotgan edimi?

4.6. Present Perfect Passive

Formula

Subject + have/has been + V3

Qachon ishlatiladi?

Bu zamon hozirgacha bajarilgan va natijasi hozir muhim bo‘lgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Ma’nosi: bajarilgan / qilib bo‘lingan

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The homework has been checked.
Uy vazifasi tekshirilgan.

2. The results have been announced.
Natijalar e’lon qilingan.

3. The problem has been solved.
Muammo hal qilingan.

4. The documents have been signed.
Hujjatlar imzolangan.

5. The new method has been tested.
Yangi metod sinovdan o‘tkazilgan.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The work has not been finished yet.
Ish hali tugatilmagan.

2. The emails have not been sent.
Email xatlar yuborilmagan.

3. The results have not been published yet.
Natijalar hali chop etilmagan.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Has the task been completed?
Topshiriq bajarilganmi?

2. Have the students been informed?
Talabalar xabardor qilinganmi?

3. Has the article been published?
Maqola chop etilganmi?

4.7. Past Perfect Passive

Formula

Subject + had been + V3

Qachon ishlatiladi?

Bu zamon o‘tmishdagi bir voqeadan oldin bajarilgan ish-harakatni bildiradi.

Ma’nosi: oldin bajarilgan edi

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The room had been cleaned before the guests arrived.
Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin xona tozalangan edi.

2. The documents had been prepared before the meeting started.
Yig‘ilish boshlanishidan oldin hujjatlar tayyorlangan edi.

3. The project had been completed before the deadline.
Loyiha muddatdan oldin tugatilgan edi.

4. The results had been checked before they were announced.
Natijalar e’lon qilinishidan oldin tekshirilgan edi.

5. The report had been written before the professor asked for it.
Professor so‘rashidan oldin hisobot yozilgan edi.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The task had not been finished before noon.
Topshiriq tushgacha tugatilmagan edi.

2. The students had not been informed before the exam.
Imtihondan oldin talabalar xabardor qilinmagan edi.

3. The article had not been published before the conference.
Konferensiyadan oldin maqola chop etilmagan edi.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Had the room been cleaned before we arrived?
Biz kelishimizdan oldin xona tozalangan edimi?

2. Had the results been checked before publication?
Chop etilishidan oldin natijalar tekshirilgan edimi?

3. Had the report been written before the meeting?
Yig‘ilishdan oldin hisobot yozilgan edimi?

4.8. Future Perfect Passive

Formula

Subject + will have been + V3

Qachon ishlatiladi?

Bu zamon kelajakdagi ma’lum bir vaqtgacha ish-harakat tugallangan bo‘lishini bildiradi.

Ma’nosi: bajarilgan bo‘ladi

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The project will have been completed by Friday.
Loyiha jumagacha tugatilgan bo‘ladi.

2. The results will have been announced by tomorrow evening.
Natijalar ertaga kechgacha e’lon qilingan bo‘ladi.

3. The building will have been repaired by next month.
Bino kelasi oygacha ta’mirlangan bo‘ladi.

4. The report will have been written by the deadline.
Hisobot muddatgacha yozilgan bo‘ladi.

5. The exam papers will have been checked by Monday.
Imtihon varaqalari dushanbagacha tekshirilgan bo‘ladi.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The work will not have been finished by 6 p.m.
Ish soat 6 gacha tugatilgan bo‘lmaydi.

2. The documents will not have been signed by tomorrow.
Hujjatlar ertagacha imzolangan bo‘lmaydi.

3. The article will not have been published by next week.
Maqola kelasi haftagacha chop etilgan bo‘lmaydi.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Will the task have been completed by Friday?
Topshiriq jumagacha bajarilgan bo‘ladimi?

2. Will the results have been checked by tomorrow?
Natijalar ertagacha tekshirilgan bo‘ladimi?

3. Will the project have been presented by the end of the month?
Loyiha oy oxirigacha taqdim etilgan bo‘ladimi?

5. Modal fe’llar bilan Passive Voice

Modal passive formulasi:

Modal verb + be + V3

Masalan:

The task must be completed.
Topshiriq bajarilishi kerak.

Bu yerda:

• must — modal fe’l

• be — passive uchun kerak

• completed — V3

5.1. Can be + V3

Ma’nosi: qilinishi mumkin / bajarilishi mumkin

1. This problem can be solved easily.
Bu muammo oson hal qilinishi mumkin.

2. The room can be used for meetings.
Bu xona yig‘ilishlar uchun ishlatilishi mumkin.

3. English can be learned online.
Ingliz tilini onlayn o‘rganish mumkin.

5.2. Could be + V3

Ma’nosi: qilinishi mumkin edi / ehtimol qilinishi mumkin

1. The mistake could be corrected.
Xato tuzatilishi mumkin edi.

2. The old building could be repaired.
Eski bino ta’mirlanishi mumkin edi.

3. This idea could be used in education.
Bu g‘oya ta’limda ishlatilishi mumkin edi.

5.3. May be + V3

Ma’nosi: qilinishi mumkin / ehtimol qilinadi

1. The exam may be postponed.
Imtihon qoldirilishi mumkin.

2. The results may be announced today.
Natijalar bugun e’lon qilinishi mumkin.

3. The topic may be discussed tomorrow.
Mavzu ertaga muhokama qilinishi mumkin.

5.4. Might be + V3

Ma’nosi: ehtimol qilinishi mumkin

1. The meeting might be cancelled.
Yig‘ilish bekor qilinishi mumkin.

2. The report might be checked again.
Hisobot qayta tekshirilishi mumkin.

3. The problem might be solved later.
Muammo keyinroq hal qilinishi mumkin.

5.5. Must be + V3

Ma’nosi: qilinishi shart / kerak

1. The rules must be followed.
Qoidalarga amal qilinishi shart.

2. The homework must be submitted on time.
Uy vazifasi vaqtida topshirilishi kerak.

3. The door must be locked after the lesson.
Darsdan keyin eshik qulflanishi kerak.

5.6. Should be + V3

Ma’nosi: qilinishi kerak / ma’qul

1. The room should be cleaned before the guests arrive.
Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin xona tozalanishi kerak.

2. The information should be checked carefully.
Ma’lumot diqqat bilan tekshirilishi kerak.

3. Mistakes should be corrected before submission.
Topshirishdan oldin xatolar tuzatilishi kerak.

5.7. Have to be + V3

Ma’nosi: qilinishi kerak / majbur

1. The form has to be filled in.
Forma to‘ldirilishi kerak.

2. The documents have to be signed today.
Hujjatlar bugun imzolanishi kerak.

3. The project has to be finished by Monday.
Loyiha dushanbagacha tugatilishi kerak.

5.8. Need to be + V3

Ma’nosi: qilinishi kerak / zarur

1. The classroom needs to be cleaned.
Sinfxona tozalanishi kerak.

2. The article needs to be edited.
Maqola tahrir qilinishi kerak.

3. The data need to be analyzed.
Ma’lumotlar tahlil qilinishi kerak.

6. Active gapni Passive gapga aylantirish qoidasi

Active gapni Passive gapga aylantirish uchun 5 bosqich bor.

Misol:

Active:
The teacher checks the tests.
O‘qituvchi testlarni tekshiradi.

Passive:
The tests are checked by the teacher.
Testlar o‘qituvchi tomonidan tekshiriladi.

By Passive Voice’da ishni kim bajarganini ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.

Formula:

Passive sentence + by + doer

Masalan:

The book was written by George Orwell.
Kitob Jorj Oruell tomonidan yozilgan.

Qachon “by” kerak?

“By” bajaruvchi muhim, aniq yoki qiziqarli bo‘lsa ishlatiladi.

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
