Kitob Jorj Oruell tomonidan yozilgan.

2. The theory was developed by Einstein.
Nazariya Eynshteyn tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan.

3. The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
Mona Liza Leonardo da Vinchi tomonidan chizilgan.

Qachon “by” ishlatilmasa ham bo‘ladi?

Bajaruvchi noma’lum, umumiy yoki muhim bo‘lmasa, “by” ishlatilmaydi.

1. My phone was stolen.
Telefonim o‘g‘irlandi.

2. The window was broken.
Deraza sindirildi.

3. The road is being repaired.
Yo‘l ta’mirlanmoqda.

10 ta misol

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
Kitob Jorj Oruell tomonidan yozilgan.

2. My phone was stolen.
Telefonim o‘g‘irlandi.

3. The classroom is cleaned every morning.
Sinfxona har kuni ertalab tozalanadi.

4. The experiment was conducted by the researchers.
Tajriba tadqiqotchilar tomonidan o‘tkazildi.

5. The new building was designed by a famous architect.
Yangi bino mashhur arxitektor tomonidan loyihalashtirildi.

6. The results were announced yesterday.
Natijalar kecha e’lon qilindi.

7. The song was performed by young students.
Qo‘shiq yosh o‘quvchilar tomonidan ijro etildi.

8. The mistake was corrected by the teacher.
Xato o‘qituvchi tomonidan tuzatildi.

9. The documents were signed by the manager.
Hujjatlar menejer tomonidan imzolandi.

10. The car was repaired last week.
Mashina o‘tgan hafta ta’mirlandi.

8. Passive Voice ishlatiladigan asosiy holatlar

a) Bajaruvchi noma’lum bo‘lsa

Kim bajargani noma’lum bo‘lsa, Passive Voice ishlatiladi.

1. My bag was stolen.
Sumkam o‘g‘irlandi.

2. The window was broken last night.
Deraza kecha kechasi sindirildi.

3. The documents were lost.
Hujjatlar yo‘qotildi.

b) Bajaruvchi muhim bo‘lmasa

Kim bajargani muhim emas, ishning o‘zi muhim bo‘lsa.

1. The classroom is cleaned every day.
Sinfxona har kuni tozalanadi.

2. The roads are repaired every summer.
Yo‘llar har yozda ta’mirlanadi.

3. The forms are checked before submission.
Formalar topshirishdan oldin tekshiriladi.

c) Natija muhim bo‘lsa

Ishni kim qilgani emas, natija muhim bo‘ladi.

1. The problem has been solved.
Muammo hal qilingan.

2. The project has been completed.
Loyiha tugatilgan.

3. The room has been cleaned.
Xona tozalangan.

d) Rasmiy va ilmiy uslubda

Ilmiy va rasmiy yozuvlarda Passive Voice ko‘p ishlatiladi.

1. The experiment was conducted in a laboratory.
Tajriba laboratoriyada o‘tkazildi.

2. The data were analyzed carefully.
Ma’lumotlar diqqat bilan tahlil qilindi.

3. The results were compared with previous studies.
Natijalar oldingi tadqiqotlar bilan solishtirildi.

e) Yangiliklar, maqolalar va akademik yozuvlarda

Yangiliklarda ko‘pincha natija muhim bo‘ladi.

1. A new hospital was opened yesterday.
Kecha yangi shifoxona ochildi.

2. Several students were awarded at the ceremony.
Marosimda bir nechta o‘quvchi taqdirlandi.

3. The report was published online.
Hisobot onlayn chop etildi.

f) Qoidalar, e’lonlar va ko‘rsatmalarda

Qoidalarda bajaruvchi odatda muhim emas.

1. Phones are not allowed during the exam.
Imtihon paytida telefonlarga ruxsat berilmaydi.

2. The form must be filled in completely.
Forma to‘liq to‘ldirilishi kerak.

3. All questions should be answered clearly.
Barcha savollarga aniq javob berilishi kerak.

9. Passive Voice ishlatilmaydigan yoki ehtiyot bo‘lish kerak bo‘lgan holatlar

Ba’zi fe’llar object olmaydi. Bunday fe’llar bilan Passive Voice yasalmaydi.

Masalan:

• happen — sodir bo‘lmoq

• arrive — yetib kelmoq

• die — vafot etmoq

• sleep — uxlamoq

• go — bormoq

• come — kelmoq

Bu fe’llarda object bo‘lmagani uchun passive qilish noto‘g‘ri.

“Have”, “lack”, “belong”, “seem” kabi fe’llar

Bu fe’llar ham odatda Passive Voice’da ishlatilmaydi yoki juda ehtiyotkorlik bilan ishlatiladi.

• have — ega bo‘lmoq

• lack — yetishmaslik

• belong — tegishli bo‘lmoq

• seem — ko‘rinmoq
grammar_rules_en:
Passive Voice — a grammatical form used in English when what matters is not who did the action, but the action itself, its result, or whom/what it affected.

In Uzbek, the Passive Voice often conveys the following meanings:

• is done

• was done

• has been done

• is being done

• was made

• was written

• was built

• is used

• was checked

For example:

Active Voice:
The teacher explains the rule.
The teacher explains the rule.

In this sentence, the teacher is performing the action. That is, the doer is important.

Passive Voice:
The rule is explained by the teacher.
The rule is explained by the teacher.

In this sentence, the main focus is on the rule. That is, what receives the action is important.

Main idea in Passive Voice

In Passive Voice, the subject does not perform the action. Instead, the action is performed on it.

For example:

The window was broken.
The window was broken.

Here, it is not mentioned who broke it. The important thing is that the window is broken.

10 simple examples

1. The room is cleaned every day.
The room is cleaned every day.

2. English is spoken in many countries.
English is spoken in many countries.

3. The book was written in 1949.
The book was written in 1949.

4. The car was repaired yesterday.
The car was repaired yesterday.

5. The homework is checked by the teacher.
The homework is checked by the teacher.

6. The windows are opened every morning.
The windows are opened every morning.

7. The test will be written tomorrow.
The test will be written tomorrow.

8. The experiment was conducted in the laboratory.
The experiment was conducted in the laboratory.

9. The data are analyzed carefully.
The data are analyzed carefully.

10. The problem has been solved.
The problem has been solved.

2. Difference between Active Voice and Passive Voice

Active Voice

In Active Voice, the subject performs the action.

For example:

The student reads the book.
The student reads the book.

Here, the student is the doer.

Passive Voice

In Passive Voice, the subject receives the action.

For example:

The book is read by the student.
The book is read by the student.

Here, the book is what receives the action.

Active and Passive table

Active sentence | Passive sentence | Translation | Difference
The teacher explains the lesson. | The lesson is explained by the teacher. | The lesson is explained by the teacher. | In Active, the teacher is important; in Passive, the lesson is important.
My mother cooks dinner. | Dinner is cooked by my mother. | Dinner is cooked by my mother. | In Active, the doer is important; in Passive, the food is important.
Students write tests. | Tests are written by students. | Tests are written by students. | In Passive, tests come to the beginning of the sentence.
The company sells computers. | Computers are sold by the company. | Computers are sold by the company. | The product is important.
The doctor examines the patient. | The patient is examined by the doctor. | The patient is examined by the doctor. | The patient is the focus.
The police caught the thief. | The thief was caught by the police. | The thief was caught by the police. | The result is important: the thief was caught.
Someone stole my phone. | My phone was stolen. | My phone was stolen. | The doer is unknown.
They built this school in 2020. | This school was built in 2020. | This school was built in 2020. | The built building is important.
Scientists discovered a new method. | A new method was discovered by scientists. | A new method was discovered by scientists. | A broad scientific approach.
People use English worldwide. | English is used worldwide. | English is used worldwide. | The doer is general and not important.

3. General formula of Passive Voice

Main formula

Subject + be + V3

That is:

Subject + form of be + 3rd form of the main verb

For example:

The door is opened.
The door is opened.

Here:

• The door — subject

• is — form of be corresponding to the tense

• opened — V3

The form of 'be' changes according to the tense

In Passive Voice, the most important thing is: the form of 'be' changes according to the tense.

Tense | Form of Be | Passive formula
Present Simple | am/is/are | am/is/are + V3
Past Simple | was/were | was/were + V3
Future Simple | will be | will be + V3
Present Continuous | am/is/are being | am/is/are being + V3
Past Continuous | was/were being | was/were being + V3
Present Perfect | have/has been | have/has been + V3
Past Perfect | had been | had been + V3
Future Perfect | will have been | will have been + V3

V3 is always the 3rd form of the main verb

In Passive Voice, the main verb is always V3.

Regular verbs

Regular verbs usually become V3 with the -ed suffix.

V1 | V2 | V3 | Passive example
clean | cleaned | cleaned | The room is cleaned.
open | opened | opened | The door was opened.
use | used | used | This method is used.
check | checked | checked | The tests are checked.
prepare | prepared | prepared | The report was prepared.

Examples:

1. The classroom is cleaned every day.
The classroom is cleaned every day.

2. The door was opened by the guard.
The door was opened by the guard.

3. This method is used in many schools.
This method is used in many schools.

Irregular verbs

Irregular verbs change in V3 form.

V1 | V2 | V3 | Passive example
write | wrote | written | The book was written.
build | built | built | The school was built.
speak | spoke | spoken | English is spoken.
take | took | taken | The photo was taken.
steal | stole | stolen | My phone was stolen.

Examples:

1. The book was written by George Orwell.

2. This school was built in 2020.

3. English is spoken in many countries.

4. Passive Voice tenses

4.1. Present Simple Passive

Formula

Subject + am/is/are + V3

When is it used?

Present Simple Passive is usually used in the following situations:

• permanent actions

• habits

• general truths

• rules

• regularly performed tasks

Affirmative sentences — 5

1. English is spoken in many countries.

2. The classroom is cleaned every day.

3. Tests are checked by the teacher.

4. This medicine is used for pain.

5. Students are given homework after the lesson.

Negative sentences — 3

1. This room is not used every day.

2. Phones are not allowed during the exam.

3. The door is not opened after 10 p.m.

Interrogative sentences — 3

1. Is English spoken in your school?

2. Are the tests checked every week?

3. Is this method used in universities?

4.2. Past Simple Passive

Formula

Subject + was/were + V3

When is it used?

Past Simple Passive indicates an action that was done in the past.

Affirmative sentences — 5

1. The school was built in 2020.

2. The car was repaired yesterday.

3. The books were delivered last week.

4. The lesson was explained clearly.

5. The documents were signed by the director.

Negative sentences — 3

1. The window was not broken by me.

2. The emails were not sent yesterday.

3. The task was not completed on time.

Interrogative sentences — 3

1. Was the book written in English?

2. Were the students invited to the meeting?

3. Was the experiment conducted yesterday?

4.3. Future Simple Passive

Formula

Subject + will be + V3

When is it used?

Future Simple Passive indicates an action that will be done in the future.

Affirmative sentences — 5

1. The results will be announced tomorrow.

2. The new school will be opened next year.

3. The documents will be checked soon.

4. The test will be written on Monday.

5. The project will be presented at the conference.

Negative sentences — 3

1. The meeting will not be held today.

2. The exam will not be cancelled.

3. The report will not be finished tonight.

Interrogative sentences — 3

1. Will the results be announced today?

2. Will the classroom be cleaned before the lesson?

3. Will the project be accepted?

4.4. Present Continuous Passive

Formula

Subject + am/is/are being + V3

When is it used?

This tense indicates an action that is being done at the moment.

Meaning: currently being done

Affirmative sentences — 5

1. The room is being cleaned now.

2. The test papers are being checked.

3. The road is being repaired.

4. The new rules are being discussed.

5. The experiment is being conducted in the lab.

Negative sentences — 3

1. The computer is not being used now.

2. The documents are not being checked at the moment.

3. The room is not being painted today.

Interrogative sentences — 3

1. Is the lesson being recorded now?

2. Are the tests being checked?

3. Is the building being repaired?

4.5. Past Continuous Passive

Formula

Subject + was/were being + V3

When is it used?

This tense indicates an action that was being performed at the same time in the past.

Meaning: was being done

Affirmative sentences — 5 examples

1. The room was being cleaned when I arrived.
I arrived when the room was being cleaned.

2. The tests were being checked at 5 p.m.
The tests were being checked at 5 p.m.

3. The road was being repaired yesterday morning.
The road was being repaired yesterday morning.

4. The documents were being prepared during the meeting.
The documents were being prepared during the meeting.

5. The patient was being examined when the doctor arrived.
The patient was being examined when the doctor arrived.

Negative sentences — 3 examples

1. The room was not being cleaned at that time.
The room was not being cleaned at that time.

2. The books were not being delivered yesterday.
The books were not being delivered yesterday.

3. The project was not being discussed when I entered.
The project was not being discussed when I entered.

Interrogative sentences — 3 examples

1. Was the lesson being recorded at 10 a.m.?
Was the lesson being recorded at 10 a.m.?

2. Were the students being tested when you came?
Were the students being tested when you came?

3. Was the car being repaired yesterday afternoon?
Was the car being repaired yesterday afternoon?

4.6. Present Perfect Passive

Formula

Subject + have/has been + V3

When is it used?

This tense indicates an action that has been completed up to now and whose result is important at present.

Meaning: has been done

Affirmative sentences — 5 examples

1. The homework has been checked.
The homework has been checked.

2. The results have been announced.
The results have been announced.

3. The problem has been solved.
The problem has been solved.

4. The documents have been signed.
The documents have been signed.

5. The new method has been tested.
The new method has been tested.

Negative sentences — 3 examples

1. The work has not been finished yet.
The work has not been finished yet.

2. The emails have not been sent.
The emails have not been sent.

3. The results have not been published yet.
The results have not been published yet.

Interrogative sentences — 3 examples

1. Has the task been completed?
Has the task been completed?

2. Have the students been informed?
Have the students been informed?

3. Has the article been published?
Has the article been published?

4.7. Past Perfect Passive

Formula

Subject + had been + V3

When is it used?

This tense indicates an action that was completed before a certain event in the past.

Meaning: had been done before

Affirmative sentences — 5 examples

1. The room had been cleaned before the guests arrived.
The room had been cleaned before the guests arrived.

2. The documents had been prepared before the meeting started.
The documents had been prepared before the meeting started.

3. The project had been completed before the deadline.
The project had been completed before the deadline.

4. The results had been checked before they were announced.
The results had been checked before they were announced.

5. The report had been written before the professor asked for it.
The report had been written before the professor asked for it.

Negative sentences — 3 examples

1. The task had not been finished before noon.
The task had not been finished before noon.

2. The students had not been informed before the exam.
The students had not been informed before the exam.

3. The article had not been published before the conference.
The article had not been published before the conference.

Interrogative sentences — 3 examples

1. Had the room been cleaned before we arrived?
Had the room been cleaned before we arrived?

2. Had the results been checked before publication?
Had the results been checked before publication?

3. Had the report been written before the meeting?
Had the report been written before the meeting?

4.8. Future Perfect Passive

Formula

Subject + will have been + V3

When is it used?

This tense indicates that an action will be completed by a certain time in the future.

Meaning: will have been done

Affirmative sentences — 5 examples

1. The project will have been completed by Friday.
The project will have been completed by Friday.

2. The results will have been announced by tomorrow evening.
The results will have been announced by tomorrow evening.

3. The building will have been repaired by next month.
The building will have been repaired by next month.

4. The report will have been written by the deadline.
The report will have been written by the deadline.

5. The exam papers will have been checked by Monday.
The exam papers will have been checked by Monday.

Negative sentences — 3 examples

1. The work will not have been finished by 6 p.m.
The work will not have been finished by 6 p.m.

2. The documents will not have been signed by tomorrow.
The documents will not have been signed by tomorrow.

3. The article will not have been published by next week.
The article will not have been published by next week.

Interrogative sentences — 3 examples

1. Will the task have been completed by Friday?
Will the task have been completed by Friday?

2. Will the results have been checked by tomorrow?
Will the results have been checked by tomorrow?

3. Will the project have been presented by the end of the month?
Will the project have been presented by the end of the month?

5. Modal verbs with Passive Voice

Modal passive formula:

Modal verb + be + V3

For example:

The task must be completed.
The task must be completed.

Here:

• must — modal verb

• be — needed for passive

• completed — V3

5.1. Can be + V3

Meaning: can be done / can be performed

1. This problem can be solved easily.
This problem can be solved easily.

2. The room can be used for meetings.
The room can be used for meetings.

3. English can be learned online.
English can be learned online.

5.2. Could be + V3

Meaning: could be done / might be done

1. The mistake could be corrected.
The mistake could be corrected.

2. The old building could be repaired.
The old building could be repaired.

3. This idea could be used in education.
This idea could be used in education.

5.3. May be + V3

Meaning: may be done / might be done

1. The exam may be postponed.
The exam may be postponed.

2. The results may be announced today.
The results may be announced today.

3. The topic may be discussed tomorrow.
The topic may be discussed tomorrow.

5.4. Might be + V3

Meaning: might possibly be done

1. The meeting might be cancelled.
The meeting might be cancelled.

2. The report might be checked again.
The report might be checked again.

3. The problem might be solved later.
The problem might be solved later.

5.5. Must be + V3

Meaning: must be done / necessary

1. The rules must be followed.
The rules must be followed.

2. The homework must be submitted on time.
The homework must be submitted on time.

3. The door must be locked after the lesson.
The door must be locked after the lesson.

5.6. Should be + V3

Meaning: should be done / advisable

1. The room should be cleaned before the guests arrive.
The room should be cleaned before the guests arrive.

2. The information should be checked carefully.
The information should be checked carefully.

3. Mistakes should be corrected before submission.
Mistakes should be corrected before submission.

5.7. Have to be + V3

Meaning: has to be done / must

1. The form has to be filled in.
The form has to be filled in.

2. The documents have to be signed today.
The documents have to be signed today.

3. The project has to be finished by Monday.
The project has to be finished by Monday.

5.8. Need to be + V3

Meaning: needs to be done / necessary

1. The classroom needs to be cleaned.
The classroom needs to be cleaned.

2. The article needs to be edited.
The article needs to be edited.

3. The data need to be analyzed.
The data need to be analyzed.

6. The rule for converting an Active sentence to a Passive sentence

There are 5 steps to convert an Active sentence to a Passive sentence.

Example:

Active:
The teacher checks the tests.
The teacher checks the tests.

Passive:
The tests are checked by the teacher.
The tests are checked by the teacher.

‘By’ is used in Passive Voice to indicate who performed the action.

Formula:

Passive sentence + by + doer

For example:

The book was written by George Orwell.
The book was written by George Orwell.

When is ‘by’ needed?

‘By’ is used when the doer is important, specific, or interesting.

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
The book was written by George Orwell.

2. The theory was developed by Einstein.
The theory was developed by Einstein.

3. The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.

When can ‘by’ be omitted?

‘By’ is omitted when the doer is unknown, general, or not important.

1. My phone was stolen.
My phone was stolen.

2. The window was broken.
The window was broken.

3. The road is being repaired.
The road is being repaired.

10 examples

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
The book was written by George Orwell.

2. My phone was stolen.
My phone was stolen.

3. The classroom is cleaned every morning.
The classroom is cleaned every morning.

4. The experiment was conducted by the researchers.
The experiment was conducted by the researchers.

5. The new building was designed by a famous architect.
The new building was designed by a famous architect.

6. The results were announced yesterday.
The results were announced yesterday.

7. The song was performed by young students.
The song was performed by young students.

8. The mistake was corrected by the teacher.
The mistake was corrected by the teacher.

9. The documents were signed by the manager.
The documents were signed by the manager.

10. The car was repaired last week.
The car was repaired last week.

8. Main situations where Passive Voice is used

a) When the doer is unknown

Passive Voice is used when who performed the action is unknown.

1. My bag was stolen.
My bag was stolen.

2. The window was broken last night.
The window was broken last night.

3. The documents were lost.
The documents were lost.

b) When the doer is not important

Passive Voice is used when who performed the action is not important, but the action itself is important.

1. The classroom is cleaned every day.
The classroom is cleaned every day.

2. The roads are repaired every summer.
The roads are repaired every summer.

3. The forms are checked before submission.
The forms are checked before submission.

c) If the result is important

It is not who did the work that matters, but the result.

1. The problem has been solved.
The problem has been solved.

2. The project has been completed.
The project has been completed.

3. The room has been cleaned.
The room has been cleaned.

d) In formal and scientific style

The Passive Voice is often used in scientific and formal writing.

1. The experiment was conducted in a laboratory.
The experiment was conducted in a laboratory.

2. The data were analyzed carefully.
The data were analyzed carefully.

3. The results were compared with previous studies.
The results were compared with previous studies.

e) In news, articles, and academic writing

In news, the result is often important.

1. A new hospital was opened yesterday.
A new hospital was opened yesterday.

2. Several students were awarded at the ceremony.
Several students were awarded at the ceremony.

3. The report was published online.
The report was published online.

f) In rules, announcements, and instructions

In rules, the doer is usually not important.

1. Phones are not allowed during the exam.
Phones are not allowed during the exam.

2. The form must be filled in completely.
The form must be filled in completely.

3. All questions should be answered clearly.
All questions should be answered clearly.

9. Cases where Passive Voice is not used or should be used with caution

Some verbs do not take an object. Passive Voice cannot be formed with such verbs.

For example:

• happen

• arrive

• die

• sleep

• go

• come

Because these verbs do not have an object, it is incorrect to make them passive.

Verbs like “have”, “lack”, “belong”, “seem”

These verbs are also usually not used in Passive Voice or are used very cautiously.

• have

• lack

• belong

• seem
grammar_rules_ru:
Passive Voice — грамматическая форма английского языка, которая используется, когда важно не то, кто выполнил действие, а само действие, его результат или то, на кого/на что оно повлияло.

В узбекском языке Passive Voice чаще всего передаётся такими формами:

• выполняется

• было выполнено

• выполнен

• выполняется (сейчас)

• сделано

• написано

• построен

• используется

• проверено

Например:

Active Voice:
The teacher explains the rule.
Учитель объясняет правило.

В этом предложении учитель выполняет действие. То есть выполняющий важен.

Passive Voice:
The rule is explained by the teacher.
Правило объясняется учителем.

В этом предложении основное внимание уделяется правилу. То есть важно то, что действие было принято.

Основная идея в Passive Voice

В Passive Voice субъект не выполняет действие. Напротив, действие выполняется по отношению к нему.

Например:

The window was broken.
Окно было разбито.

Здесь не указано, кто разбил. Важно — окно разбито.

10 простых примеров

1. The room is cleaned every day.
Комната убирается каждый день.

2. English is spoken in many countries.
Английский язык говорят во многих странах.

3. The book was written in 1949.
Книга была написана в 1949 году.

4. The car was repaired yesterday.
Машина была отремонтирована вчера.

5. The homework is checked by the teacher.
Домашнее задание проверяется учителем.

6. The windows are opened every morning.
Окна открываются каждое утро.

7. The test will be written tomorrow.
Тест будет написан завтра.

8. The experiment was conducted in the laboratory.
Эксперимент был проведён в лаборатории.

9. The data are analyzed carefully.
Данные анализируются внимательно.

10. The problem has been solved.
Проблема была решена.

2. Разница между Active Voice и Passive Voice

Active Voice

В Active Voice субъект выполняет действие.

Например:

The student reads the book.
Студент читает книгу.

Здесь студент — выполняющий.

Passive Voice

В Passive Voice субъект принимает действие.

Например:

The book is read by the student.
Книга читается студентом.

Здесь книга — это то, что приняло действие.

Таблица Active и Passive

Active предложение | Passive предложение | Перевод | Разница
The teacher explains the lesson. | The lesson is explained by the teacher. | Урок объясняется учителем. | В Active важен teacher, в Passive важен lesson.
My mother cooks dinner. | Dinner is cooked by my mother. | Ужин готовится моей мамой. | В Active важен выполняющий, в Passive важен ужин.
Students write tests. | Tests are written by students. | Тесты пишутся студентами. | В Passive тесты выходят на первое место.
The company sells computers. | Computers are sold by the company. | Компьютеры продаются компанией. | Важен продукт.
The doctor examines the patient. | The patient is examined by the doctor. | Пациент проверяется врачом. | Пациент в центре внимания.
The police caught the thief. | The thief was caught by the police. | Вор был пойман полицией. | Важно: вор пойман.
Someone stole my phone. | My phone was stolen. | Мой телефон был украден. | Выполняющий неизвестен.
They built this school in 2020. | This school was built in 2020. | Эта школа была построена в 2020 году. | Важно, что здание построено.
Scientists discovered a new method. | A new method was discovered by scientists. | Новый метод был открыт учеными. | Широкий научный подход.
People use English worldwide. | English is used worldwide. | Английский язык используется по всему миру. | Выполняющий общий и не важен.

3. Общая формула Passive Voice

Основная формула

Subject + be + V3

То есть:

Субъект + форма глагола be + 3-я форма основного глагола

Например:

The door is opened.
Дверь открывается.

Здесь:

• The door — субъект

• is — форма глагола be, соответствующая времени

• opened — V3

Глагол “be” изменяется в зависимости от времени

В Passive Voice самое важное: глагол be изменяется в зависимости от времени.

Время | Форма be | Формула Passive
Present Simple | am/is/are | am/is/are + V3
Past Simple | was/were | was/were + V3
Future Simple | will be | will be + V3
Present Continuous | am/is/are being | am/is/are being + V3
Past Continuous | was/were being | was/were being + V3
Present Perfect | have/has been | have/has been + V3
Past Perfect | had been | had been + V3
Future Perfect | will have been | will have been + V3

V3 всегда будет 3-й формой основного глагола

В Passive Voice основной глагол всегда V3.

Регулярные глаголы

Регулярные глаголы обычно становятся V3 с добавлением суффикса -ed.

V1 | V2 | V3 | Пример Passive
clean | cleaned | cleaned | The room is cleaned.
open | opened | opened | The door was opened.
use | used | used | This method is used.
check | checked | checked | The tests are checked.
prepare | prepared | prepared | The report was prepared.

Примеры:

1. The classroom is cleaned every day.
Классная комната убирается каждый день.

2. The door was opened by the guard.
Дверь была открыта охранником.

3. This method is used in many schools.
Этот метод используется во многих школах.

Неправильные глаголы

Неправильные глаголы изменяются в форме V3.

V1 | V2 | V3 | Пример Passive
write | wrote | written | The book was written.
build | built | built | The school was built.
speak | spoke | spoken | English is spoken.
take | took | taken | The photo was taken.
steal | stole | stolen | My phone was stolen.

Примеры:

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
Книга была написана Джорджем Оруэллом.

2. This school was built in 2020.
Эта школа была построена в 2020 году.

3. English is spoken in many countries.
Английский язык говорят во многих странах.

4. Времена Passive Voice

4.1. Present Simple Passive

Формула

Subject + am/is/are + V3

Когда используется?

Present Simple Passive обычно используется в следующих случаях:

• постоянные действия

• привычки

• общие истины

• правила

• регулярно выполняемые действия

Утвердительные предложения — 5 штук

1. English is spoken in many countries.
Английский язык говорят во многих странах.

2. The classroom is cleaned every day.
Классная комната убирается каждый день.

3. Tests are checked by the teacher.
Тесты проверяются учителем.

4. This medicine is used for pain.
Это лекарство используется для облегчения боли.

5. Students are given homework after the lesson.
Студентам задают домашнее задание после урока.

Отрицательные предложения — 3 штуки

1. This room is not used every day.
Эта комната не используется каждый день.

2. Phones are not allowed during the exam.
Телефоны не разрешены во время экзамена.

3. The door is not opened after 10 p.m.
Дверь не открывается после 10 вечера.

Вопросительные предложения — 3 штуки

1. Is English spoken in your school?
В вашей школе говорят на английском?

2. Are the tests checked every week?
Тесты проверяются каждую неделю?

3. Is this method used in universities?
Этот метод используется в университетах?

4.2. Past Simple Passive

Формула

Subject + was/were + V3

Когда используется?

Past Simple Passive указывает на действие, выполненное в прошлом.

Утвердительные предложения — 5 штук

1. The school was built in 2020.
Школа была построена в 2020 году.

2. The car was repaired yesterday.
Машина была отремонтирована вчера.

3. The books were delivered last week.
Книги были доставлены на прошлой неделе.

4. The lesson was explained clearly.
Урок был объяснен ясно.

5. The documents were signed by the director.
Документы были подписаны директором.

Отрицательные предложения — 3 штуки

1. The window was not broken by me.
Окно не было разбито мной.

2. The emails were not sent yesterday.
Электронные письма не были отправлены вчера.

3. The task was not completed on time.
Задание не было выполнено вовремя.

Вопросительные предложения — 3 штуки

1. Was the book written in English?
Книга была написана на английском?

2. Were the students invited to the meeting?
Студенты были приглашены на встречу?

3. Was the experiment conducted yesterday?
Эксперимент проводился вчера?

4.3. Future Simple Passive

Формула

Subject + will be + V3

Когда используется?

Future Simple Passive указывает на действие, которое будет выполнено в будущем.

Утвердительные предложения — 5 штук

1. The results will be announced tomorrow.
Результаты будут объявлены завтра.

2. The new school will be opened next year.
Новая школа будет открыта в следующем году.

3. The documents will be checked soon.
Документы будут проверены скоро.

4. The test will be written on Monday.
Тест будет написан в понедельник.

5. The project will be presented at the conference.
Проект будет представлен на конференции.

Отрицательные предложения — 3 штуки

1. The meeting will not be held today.
Встреча не будет проведена сегодня.

2. The exam will not be cancelled.
Экзамен не будет отменен.

3. The report will not be finished tonight.
Отчет не будет завершен сегодня вечером.

Вопросительные предложения — 3 штуки

1. Will the results be announced today?
Результаты будут объявлены сегодня?

2. Will the classroom be cleaned before the lesson?
Классная комната будет убрана перед уроком?

3. Will the project be accepted?
Проект будет принят?

4.4. Present Continuous Passive

Формула

Subject + am/is/are being + V3

Когда используется?

Это время указывает на действие, выполняемое в данный момент.

Значение: сейчас выполняется

Утвердительные предложения — 5 штук

1. The room is being cleaned now.
Комната сейчас убирается.

2. The test papers are being checked.
Тестовые листы проверяются.

3. The road is being repaired.
Дорога ремонтируется.

4. The new rules are being discussed.
Новые правила обсуждаются.

5. The experiment is being conducted in the lab.
Эксперимент проводится в лаборатории.

Отрицательные предложения — 3 штуки

1. The computer is not being used now.
Компьютер сейчас не используется.

2. The documents are not being checked at the moment.
Документы в данный момент не проверяются.

3. The room is not being painted today.
Комната сегодня не красится.

Вопросительные предложения — 3 штуки

1. Is the lesson being recorded now?
Урок сейчас записывается?

2. Are the tests being checked?
Тесты проверяются?

3. Is the building being repaired?
Здание ремонтируется?

4.5. Past Continuous Passive

Формула

Subject + was/were being + V3

Когда используется?

Это время обозначает действие, которое выполняется в одно и то же время в прошлом.

Значение: выполнялось

Утвердительные предложения — 5 штук

1. The room was being cleaned when I arrived.
Комната убиралась, когда я пришёл.

2. The tests were being checked at 5 p.m.
Тесты проверялись в 5 часов вечера.

3. The road was being repaired yesterday morning.
Дорога ремонтировалась вчера утром.

4. The documents were being prepared during the meeting.
Документы готовились во время встречи.

5. The patient was being examined when the doctor arrived.
Пациент осматривался, когда пришёл врач.

Отрицательные предложения — 3 штуки

1. The room was not being cleaned at that time.
В это время комната не убиралась.

2. The books were not being delivered yesterday.
Книги не доставлялись вчера.

3. The project was not being discussed when I entered.
Проект не обсуждался, когда я вошёл.

Вопросительные предложения — 3 штуки

1. Was the lesson being recorded at 10 a.m.?
Урок записывался в 10 часов утра?

2. Were the students being tested when you came?
Студенты проходили тестирование, когда вы пришли?

3. Was the car being repaired yesterday afternoon?
Машина ремонтировалась вчера днём?

4.6. Present Perfect Passive

Формула

Subject + have/has been + V3

Когда используется?

Это время обозначает действие, которое было выполнено до настоящего момента, и его результат важен сейчас.

Значение: выполнено / сделано

Утвердительные предложения — 5 штук

1. The homework has been checked.
Домашнее задание проверено.

2. The results have been announced.
Результаты объявлены.

3. The problem has been solved.
Проблема решена.

4. The documents have been signed.
Документы подписаны.

5. The new method has been tested.
Новый метод протестирован.

Отрицательные предложения — 3 штуки

1. The work has not been finished yet.
Работа ещё не завершена.

2. The emails have not been sent.
Электронные письма не были отправлены.

3. The results have not been published yet.
Результаты ещё не опубликованы.

Вопросительные предложения — 3 штуки

1. Has the task been completed?
Задание выполнено?

2. Have the students been informed?
Студенты были проинформированы?

3. Has the article been published?
Статья опубликована?

4.7. Past Perfect Passive

Формула

Subject + had been + V3

Когда используется?

Это время обозначает действие, которое было выполнено до какого-либо события в прошлом.

Значение: было выполнено ранее

Утвердительные предложения — 5 штук

1. The room had been cleaned before the guests arrived.
Комната была убрана до прихода гостей.

2. The documents had been prepared before the meeting started.
Документы были подготовлены до начала встречи.

3. The project had been completed before the deadline.
Проект был завершён до срока.

4. The results had been checked before they were announced.
Результаты были проверены до их объявления.

5. The report had been written before the professor asked for it.
Отчёт был написан до того, как профессор его запросил.

Отрицательные предложения — 3 штуки

1. The task had not been finished before noon.
Задание не было завершено до полудня.

2. The students had not been informed before the exam.
Студенты не были проинформированы до экзамена.

3. The article had not been published before the conference.
Статья не была опубликована до конференции.

Вопросительные предложения — 3 штуки

1. Had the room been cleaned before we arrived?
Комната была убрана до нашего прихода?

2. Had the results been checked before publication?
Результаты были проверены до публикации?

3. Had the report been written before the meeting?
Отчёт был написан до встречи?

4.8. Future Perfect Passive

Формула

Subject + will have been + V3

Когда используется?

Это время обозначает, что действие будет завершено к определённому моменту в будущем.

Значение: будет выполнено

Утвердительные предложения — 5 штук

1. The project will have been completed by Friday.
Проект будет завершён к пятнице.

2. The results will have been announced by tomorrow evening.
Результаты будут объявлены к завтрашнему вечеру.

3. The building will have been repaired by next month.
Здание будет отремонтировано к следующему месяцу.

4. The report will have been written by the deadline.
Отчёт будет написан к сроку.

5. The exam papers will have been checked by Monday.
Экзаменационные работы будут проверены к понедельнику.

Отрицательные предложения — 3 штуки

1. The work will not have been finished by 6 p.m.
Работа не будет завершена к 6 часам вечера.

2. The documents will not have been signed by tomorrow.
Документы не будут подписаны к завтрашнему дню.

3. The article will not have been published by next week.
Статья не будет опубликована к следующей неделе.

Вопросительные предложения — 3 штуки

1. Will the task have been completed by Friday?
Задание будет выполнено к пятнице?

2. Will the results have been checked by tomorrow?
Результаты будут проверены к завтрашнему дню?

3. Will the project have been presented by the end of the month?
Проект будет представлен к концу месяца?

5. Модальные глаголы с Passive Voice

Формула модального пассива:

Модальный глагол + be + V3

Например:

The task must be completed.
Задание должно быть выполнено.

Здесь:

• must — модальный глагол

• be — необходимо для пассива

• completed — V3

5.1. Can be + V3

Значение: может быть сделано / может быть выполнено

1. This problem can be solved easily.
Эту проблему можно легко решить.

2. The room can be used for meetings.
Эта комната может быть использована для встреч.

3. English can be learned online.
Английский язык можно изучать онлайн.

5.2. Could be + V3

Значение: могло бы быть сделано / возможно, что будет сделано

1. The mistake could be corrected.
Ошибка могла бы быть исправлена.

2. The old building could be repaired.
Старое здание могло бы быть отремонтировано.

3. This idea could be used in education.
Эта идея могла бы быть использована в образовании.

5.3. May be + V3

Значение: может быть сделано / возможно, что будет сделано

1. The exam may be postponed.
Экзамен может быть отложен.

2. The results may be announced today.
Результаты могут быть объявлены сегодня.

3. The topic may be discussed tomorrow.
Тема может быть обсуждена завтра.

5.4. Might be + V3

Значение: возможно, что будет сделано

1. The meeting might be cancelled.
Встреча может быть отменена.

2. The report might be checked again.
Отчет может быть проверен снова.

3. The problem might be solved later.
Проблема может быть решена позже.

5.5. Must be + V3

Значение: должно быть сделано / необходимо

1. The rules must be followed.
Правила должны соблюдаться.

2. The homework must be submitted on time.
Домашнее задание должно быть сдано вовремя.

3. The door must be locked after the lesson.
Дверь должна быть заперта после урока.

5.6. Should be + V3

Значение: должно быть сделано / желательно

1. The room should be cleaned before the guests arrive.
Комната должна быть убрана перед приходом гостей.

2. The information should be checked carefully.
Информация должна быть проверена внимательно.

3. Mistakes should be corrected before submission.
Ошибки должны быть исправлены перед сдачей.

5.7. Have to be + V3

Значение: должно быть сделано / обязательно

1. The form has to be filled in.
Форма должна быть заполнена.

2. The documents have to be signed today.
Документы должны быть подписаны сегодня.

3. The project has to be finished by Monday.
Проект должен быть завершен к понедельнику.

5.8. Need to be + V3

Значение: должно быть сделано / необходимо

1. The classroom needs to be cleaned.
Классная комната должна быть убрана.

2. The article needs to be edited.
Статья должна быть отредактирована.

3. The data need to be analyzed.
Данные должны быть проанализированы.

6. Правило преобразования активного предложения в пассивное

Для преобразования активного предложения в пассивное существует 5 этапов.

Пример:

Active:
The teacher checks the tests.
Учитель проверяет тесты.

Passive:
The tests are checked by the teacher.
Тесты проверяются учителем.

В Passive Voice используется для указания на то, кто выполнил действие.

Формула:

Passive sentence + by + doer

Например:

The book was written by George Orwell.
Книга была написана Джорджем Оруэллом.

Когда нужно использовать “by”?

“By” используется, когда исполнитель важен, конкретен или интересен.

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
Книга была написана Джорджем Оруэллом.

2. The theory was developed by Einstein.
Теория была разработана Эйнштейном.

3. The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
Мона Лиза была написана Леонардо да Винчи.

Когда “by” можно не использовать?

“By” не используется, если исполнитель неизвестен, общий или не важен.

1. My phone was stolen.
Мой телефон был украден.

2. The window was broken.
Окно было разбито.

3. The road is being repaired.
Дорога ремонтируется.

10 примеров

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
Книга была написана Джорджем Оруэллом.

2. My phone was stolen.
Мой телефон был украден.

3. The classroom is cleaned every morning.
Классная комната убирается каждое утро.

4. The experiment was conducted by the researchers.
Эксперимент был проведен исследователями.

5. The new building was designed by a famous architect.
Новое здание было спроектировано известным архитектором.

6. The results were announced yesterday.
Результаты были объявлены вчера.

7. The song was performed by young students.
Песня была исполнена молодыми студентами.

8. The mistake was corrected by the teacher.
Ошибка была исправлена учителем.

9. The documents were signed by the manager.
Документы были подписаны менеджером.

10. The car was repaired last week.
Машина была отремонтирована на прошлой неделе.

8. Основные случаи использования Passive Voice

a) Если исполнитель неизвестен

Если неизвестно, кто выполнил действие, используется Passive Voice.

1. My bag was stolen.
Моя сумка была украдена.

2. The window was broken last night.
Окно было разбито прошлой ночью.

3. The documents were lost.
Документы были потеряны.

b) Если исполнитель не важен

Если не важно, кто выполнил действие, важно само действие.

1. The classroom is cleaned every day.
Классная комната убирается каждый день.

2. The roads are repaired every summer.
Дороги ремонтируются каждое лето.

3. The forms are checked before submission.
Формы проверяются перед подачей.

c) Если результат важен

Важно не то, кто выполнил действие, а результат.

1. The problem has been solved.
Проблема решена.

2. The project has been completed.
Проект завершён.

3. The room has been cleaned.
Комната убрана.

d) В официальном и научном стиле

В научных и официальных текстах Passive Voice часто используется.

1. The experiment was conducted in a laboratory.
Эксперимент проводился в лаборатории.

2. The data were analyzed carefully.
Данные были тщательно проанализированы.

3. The results were compared with previous studies.
Результаты были сопоставлены с предыдущими исследованиями.

e) В новостях, статьях и академических текстах

В новостях часто важен результат.

1. A new hospital was opened yesterday.
Вчера была открыта новая больница.

2. Several students were awarded at the ceremony.
На церемонии были награждены несколько студентов.

3. The report was published online.
Отчёт был опубликован онлайн.

f) В правилах, объявлениях и инструкциях

В правилах исполнители обычно не важны.

1. Phones are not allowed during the exam.
Телефоны не разрешены во время экзамена.

2. The form must be filled in completely.
Форма должна быть заполнена полностью.

3. All questions should be answered clearly.
На все вопросы следует ответить чётко.

9. Ситуации, в которых Passive Voice не используется или требует осторожности

Некоторые глаголы не имеют объекта. С такими глаголами Passive Voice не образуется.

Например:

• happen — происходить

• arrive — прибывать

• die — умирать

• sleep — спать

• go — идти

• come — приходить

Поскольку у этих глаголов нет объекта, образовать passive неправильно.

Глаголы, такие как “have”, “lack”, “belong”, “seem”

Эти глаголы также обычно не используются в Passive Voice или используются с большой осторожностью.

• have — иметь

• lack — не хватать

• belong — принадлежать

• seem — казаться
grammar_rules_kk:
Passive Voice — inglis tilinde is-háreketti kim orınlaǵanı emes, al istiń ózi, nátiyjesi yamasa kimge/nege tásir etkeni áhmiyetli bolǵan jaǵdayda qollanılatuǵın grammatikalıq forma.

ózbek tilinde Passive Voice kóbinese tómendegi mánislerdi beredi:

• orınlanadı

• orınlandı

• orınlanǵan

• orınlanbaqta

• islendi

• jazıldı

• qurıldı

• qollanıladı

• tekshirildi

Mısalı:

Active Voice:
The teacher explains the rule.
Oqıtıwshı qoidanı túsindiriw.

Bul gápda oqıtıwshı ishti bajarıp jatır. Yaǵnıy bajarıwşı muhim.

Passive Voice:
The rule is explained by the teacher.
Qoida oqıtıwshı taráfından túsindiriladı.

Bul gápda asası e’tibor qoidaǵa qaratılǵan. Yaǵnıy is-háreketti qabul etken zat muhim.

Passive Voice’da asası fikr

Passive Voice’da gápniń egasi ishti bajarmaydı. Aksinsha, is-háreket unga nisbattan orınlanadı.

Mısalı:

The window was broken.
Deraza sindirildi.

Bul yerde kim sindirǵanı aytılmaǵan. Muhimi — deraza singan.

10 ta sodda mısal

1. The room is cleaned every day.
Xona hár kúni tozalanadı.

2. English is spoken in many countries.
Ingliz tili kóp mamlakatlarda gapiriladı.

3. The book was written in 1949.
Kitap 1949-jılda jazılǵan.

4. The car was repaired yesterday.
Mashina keshe ta’mirlandı.

5. The homework is checked by the teacher.
Uy vazifası oqıtıwshı taráfından tekshiriladı.

6. The windows are opened every morning.
Derazalar hár kúni ertalap ochıladı.

7. The test will be written tomorrow.
Test ertaga jazıladı.

8. The experiment was conducted in the laboratory.
Tajriba laboratoriyada ótqazıldı.

9. The data are analyzed carefully.
Ma’lumotlar diqqat menen tahlil qilinadı.

10. The problem has been solved.
Muammo hal qılınǵan.

2. Active Voice va Passive Voice farqi

Active Voice

Active Voice’da gápniń egasi is-háreketti bajarıp jatır.

Mısalı:

The student reads the book.
Oqıwshı kitapnı oqıydu.

Bul yerde student — bajarıwşı.

Passive Voice

Passive Voice’da gápniń egasi is-háreketti qabul aladı.

Mısalı:

The book is read by the student.
Kitap oqıwshı taráfından oqıladı.

Bul yerde book — is-háreketti qabul etken zat.

Active va Passive jadvalı

Active gáp | Passive gáp | Tarjima | Farqi
The teacher explains the lesson. | The lesson is explained by the teacher. | Dars oqıtıwshı taráfından túsindiriladı. | Active’da teacher muhim, Passive’da lesson muhim.
My mother cooks dinner. | Dinner is cooked by my mother. | Kechki ovqat onam taráfından pishiriladı. | Active’da bajarıwşı, Passive’da ovqat muhim.
Students write tests. | Tests are written by students. | Testlar oqıwshılar taráfından jazıladı. | Passive’da testlar gáp boshına şıǵadı.
The company sells computers. | Computers are sold by the company. | Kompyuterlar kompaniya taráfından sotıladı. | Mahsulat muhim.
The doctor examines the patient. | The patient is examined by the doctor. | Bemor shifokor taráfından tekshiriladı. | Bemor e’tibor markazında.
The police caught the thief. | The thief was caught by the police. | Oǵrı politsiya taráfından ushlandı. | Natija muhim: oǵrı ushlandı.
Someone stole my phone. | My phone was stolen. | Telefonım oǵırlandı. | Bajarıwşı noma’lum.
They built this school in 2020. | This school was built in 2020. | Bul mektep 2020-jılda qurılǵan. | Qurılǵan bina muhim.
Scientists discovered a new method. | A new method was discovered by scientists. | Jańa metod olimlar taráfından kashf qilındı. | Keng ilmiy uslub.
People use English worldwide. | English is used worldwide. | Ingliz tili butun dúnýoda qollanıladı. | Bajarıwşı umumı menen muhim emes.

3. Passive Voice umumiy formulası

Asosiy formula

Subject + be + V3

Yaǵnıy:

Ega + be feyli + asası feylniń 3-shaklı

Mısalı:

The door is opened.
Eshik ochıladı.

Bul yerde:

• The door — subject

• is — be feyliń zamonga mos shaklı

• opened — V3

“Be” feyli zamonga qarap ózgeredi

Passive Voice’da eng muhim narsa: be feyli zamonga qarap ózgeredi.

Zamon | Be shaklı | Passive formula
Present Simple | am/is/are | am/is/are + V3
Past Simple | was/were | was/were + V3
Future Simple | will be | will be + V3
Present Continuous | am/is/are being | am/is/are being + V3
Past Continuous | was/were being | was/were being + V3
Present Perfect | have/has been | have/has been + V3
Past Perfect | had been | had been + V3
Future Perfect | will have been | will have been + V3

V3 doım asası feylniń 3-shaklı boladı

Passive Voice’da asası feyl doım V3 boladı.

Regular verbs

Regular verbs odatda -ed qosımçası menen V3 boladı.

V1 | V2 | V3 | Passive mısal
clean | cleaned | cleaned | The room is cleaned.
open | opened | opened | The door was opened.
use | used | used | This method is used.
check | checked | checked | The tests are checked.
prepare | prepared | prepared | The report was prepared.

Mısallar:

1. The classroom is cleaned every day.
Sinfxona hár kúni tozalanadı.

2. The door was opened by the guard.
Eshik qorovul taráfından ochıldı.

3. This method is used in many schools.
Bul metod kóp mekteplerde qollanıladı.

Qaytalanmaytın fe'ller

Qaytalanmaytın fe'ller V3 şeklinde özgeredi.

V1 | V2 | V3 | Passive mısal
write | wrote | written | The book was written.
build | built | built | The school was built.
speak | spoke | spoken | English is spoken.
take | took | taken | The photo was taken.
steal | stole | stolen | My phone was stolen.

Mısallar:

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
Kitap Jorj Oruell tomonidan yozılǵan.

2. This school was built in 2020.
Bul mektep 2020-jılda qurılǵan.

3. English is spoken in many countries.
Ingliz tili kóp mamlakatlarda gapırıladı.

4. Passive Voice zamandar boyınsha

4.1. Present Simple Passive

Formula

Subject + am/is/are + V3

Qashan qollanıladı?

Present Simple Passive ádette quyıdǵı holatlarda qollanıladı:

• doimiy iş-háreketler

• odatlar

• umumı haqıqatlar

• qaǵıdalar

• muntazam bajarılatın işlər

Darak gáplar — 5 ta

1. English is spoken in many countries.
Ingliz tili kóp mamlakatlarda gapırıladı.

2. The classroom is cleaned every day.
Sinfxona hár kúni tozalanadı.

3. Tests are checked by the teacher.
Testler oqıtıwshı tomonidan tekşiriladı.

4. This medicine is used for pain.
Bul dori ağrıǵ ushın qollanıladı.

5. Students are given homework after the lesson.
Oqıwshılardı darsdan keyin uy vazifası beriladı.

Inkor gáplar — 3 ta

1. This room is not used every day.
Bul xona hár kúni qollanılmaydı.

2. Phones are not allowed during the exam.
Imtihon paytında telefonlarğa ruxsat berilmeýdi.

3. The door is not opened after 10 p.m.
Kechki 10-dan keyin eshik açılmaydı.

So‘roq gáplar — 3 ta

1. Is English spoken in your school?
Sizdiń mektepıńızda ingliz tili gapırıladı mı?

2. Are the tests checked every week?
Testler hár hafta tekşiriladı mı?

3. Is this method used in universities?
Bul metod universitetlerde qollanıladı mı?

4.2. Past Simple Passive

Formula

Subject + was/were + V3

Qashan qollanıladı?

Past Simple Passive ótmısta bajarılan iş-háreketti bildiradı.

Darak gáplar — 5 ta

1. The school was built in 2020.
Mektep 2020-jılda qurılǵan.

2. The car was repaired yesterday.
Mashina keshe ta'mirlenǵen.

3. The books were delivered last week.
Kitaplar ótǵan hafta yetkizilǵen.

4. The lesson was explained clearly.
Dars anıq túsindirilǵen.

5. The documents were signed by the director.
Hujjatlar direktor tomonidan imzolandı.

Inkor gáplar — 3 ta

1. The window was not broken by me.
Deraza men tomonidan sindirilmedi.

2. The emails were not sent yesterday.
Email xatlar keshe yuborılmadı.

3. The task was not completed on time.
Topşırıq waqıtında bajarılmadi.

So‘roq gáplar — 3 ta

1. Was the book written in English?
Kitap ingliz tilinde yozılǵan mı?

2. Were the students invited to the meeting?
Talabalar yıǵılışqa taqıf qilındı mı?

3. Was the experiment conducted yesterday?
Tajriba keshe ótkazıldı mı?

4.3. Future Simple Passive

Formula

Subject + will be + V3

Qashan qollanıladı?

Future Simple Passive kelǵekte bajarılatın iş-háreketti bildiradı.

Darak gáplar — 5 ta

1. The results will be announced tomorrow.
Natijalar erteń e'lon qilınadı.

2. The new school will be opened next year.
Jańa mektep kelasi jılda açıladı.

3. The documents will be checked soon.
Hujjatlar tez orada tekşiriladı.

4. The test will be written on Monday.
Test dushánba kúni yozıladı.

5. The project will be presented at the conference.
Loyiha konferensiyada taqdim etilǵen.

Inkor gáplar — 3 ta

1. The meeting will not be held today.
Yıǵılış búgin ótkazılmaydı.

2. The exam will not be cancelled.
Imtihon bekor qilinmaydı.

3. The report will not be finished tonight.
Hisobot búgin kechqurun tugatılmaydı.

So‘roq gáplar — 3 ta

1. Will the results be announced today?
Natijalar búgin e'lon qilınadı mı?

2. Will the classroom be cleaned before the lesson?
Sinfxona darsdan aldın tozalanadı mı?

3. Will the project be accepted?
Loyiha qabul qilınadı mı?

4.4. Present Continuous Passive

Formula

Subject + am/is/are being + V3

Qashan qollanıladı?

Bu zamon ańı paytda bajarılatın iş-háreketti bildiradı.

Ma'nısı: hozir bajarılıp jatır

Darak gáplar — 5 ta

1. The room is being cleaned now.
Xona hozir tozalanıp jatır.

2. The test papers are being checked.
Test varaqları tekşirilip jatır.

3. The road is being repaired.
Yo'l ta'mirlanıp jatır.

4. The new rules are being discussed.
Jańa qaǵıdalar muhokama qilınıp jatır.

5. The experiment is being conducted in the lab.
Tajriba laboratoriyada ótkazılıp jatır.

Inkor gáplar — 3 ta

1. The computer is not being used now.
Kompyuter hozir qollanılmayapdı.

2. The documents are not being checked at the moment.
Hujjatlar ańı paytda tekşirilmeýapdı.

3. The room is not being painted today.
Xona búgin boyalmayapdı.

So‘roq gáplar — 3 ta

1. Is the lesson being recorded now?
Dars hozir yozılıp alınıp jatır mı?

2. Are the tests being checked?
Testler tekşirilip jatır mı?

3. Is the building being repaired?
Bino ta'mirlanıp jatır mı?

4.5. Past Continuous Passive

Formula

Subject + was/were being + V3

Qashan qollanıladı?

Bu zamon o‘tmishda ayni bir waqtta bajarılǵan is-háreketti bildiradi.

Ma’nosi: bajarılǵan edi

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The room was being cleaned when I arrived.
Men kelgenimde xona tozalanıp jatqan edi.

2. The tests were being checked at 5 p.m.
Soat 5 de testler tekshirilip jatqan edi.

3. The road was being repaired yesterday morning.
Keşe erteláb yo‘l ta’mirlanıp jatqan edi.

4. The documents were being prepared during the meeting.
Yig‘ilish paytında hujjatlar tayyorlanıp jatqan edi.

5. The patient was being examined when the doctor arrived.
Shifokor kelgeninde bemor tekshirilip jatqan edi.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The room was not being cleaned at that time.
O‘sha paytda xona tozalanıp jatqan emes edi.

2. The books were not being delivered yesterday.
Kitoblar keşe yetkizilip jatqan emes edi.

3. The project was not being discussed when I entered.
Men kirgenimde loyiha muhokama qilinıp jatqan emes edi.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Was the lesson being recorded at 10 a.m.?
Soat 10 da dars yozıp alınıp jatqan edi mi?

2. Were the students being tested when you came?
Siz kelgeningizde o‘quvshılar test qilınıp jatqan edi mi?

3. Was the car being repaired yesterday afternoon?
Keşe tushan keyin mashina ta’mirlanıp jatqan edi mi?

4.6. Present Perfect Passive

Formula

Subject + have/has been + V3

Qachon ishlatiladı?

Bu zamon hozirgacha bajarılǵan hám natijesi hozir muhim bolǵan is-háreketti bildiradi.

Ma’nosi: bajarılǵan / qılıp bolǵan

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The homework has been checked.
Uy vazifası tekshirilgen.

2. The results have been announced.
Natijalar e’lon qılınǵan.

3. The problem has been solved.
Muammo hal qılınǵan.

4. The documents have been signed.
Hujjatlar imzolangan.

5. The new method has been tested.
Jańa metod sinovdan ótqazılǵan.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The work has not been finished yet.
Ish hali tugatilǵan emes.

2. The emails have not been sent.
Email xatlar yuborılǵan emes.

3. The results have not been published yet.
Natijalar hali chop etilǵan emes.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Has the task been completed?
Topshiriq bajarılǵan mı?

2. Have the students been informed?
Talabalar xabardor qılınǵan mı?

3. Has the article been published?
Maqola chop etilǵan mı?

4.7. Past Perfect Passive

Formula

Subject + had been + V3

Qachon ishlatiladı?

Bu zamon o‘tmıştaǵı bir voqeadan oldın bajarılǵan is-háreketti bildiradi.

Ma’nosi: oldın bajarılǵan edi

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The room had been cleaned before the guests arrived.
Mehmonlar kelishinden oldın xona tozalangan edi.

2. The documents had been prepared before the meeting started.
Yig‘ilish bastalǵanǵa oldın hujjatlar tayyorlanǵan edi.

3. The project had been completed before the deadline.
Loyiha muddatdan oldın tugatilǵan edi.

4. The results had been checked before they were announced.
Natijalar e’lon qilınǵanǵa oldın tekshirilǵan edi.

5. The report had been written before the professor asked for it.
Professor so‘raǵanǵa oldın hisabot yozılǵan edi.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The task had not been finished before noon.
Topshiriq tushke tugatilǵan emes edi.

2. The students had not been informed before the exam.
Imtihondan oldın talabalar xabardor qılınǵan emes edi.

3. The article had not been published before the conference.
Konferensiyadan oldın maqola chop etilǵan emes edi.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Had the room been cleaned before we arrived?
Biz kelgenimizden oldın xona tozalangan edi mi?

2. Had the results been checked before publication?
Chop etilǵanǵa oldın natijalar tekshirilǵan edi mi?

3. Had the report been written before the meeting?
Yig‘ilishdan oldın hisabot yozılǵan edi mi?

4.8. Future Perfect Passive

Formula

Subject + will have been + V3

Qachon ishlatiladı?

Bu zamon kelǵektegi ma’lum bir waqıtqa is-háreket tugallangan bolǵanını bildiradi.

Ma’nosi: bajarılǵan boladı

Darak gaplar — 5 ta

1. The project will have been completed by Friday.
Loyiha jumagha tugatilǵan boladı.

2. The results will have been announced by tomorrow evening.
Natijalar ertága kechke e’lon qılınǵan boladı.

3. The building will have been repaired by next month.
Bino kelǵi oýda ta’mirlanǵan boladı.

4. The report will have been written by the deadline.
Hisabot muddatqa yozılǵan boladı.

5. The exam papers will have been checked by Monday.
Imtihon varaqaları dushanbaǵa tekshirilǵan boladı.

Inkor gaplar — 3 ta

1. The work will not have been finished by 6 p.m.
Ish soat 6ǵa tugatilǵan bolmaydı.

2. The documents will not have been signed by tomorrow.
Hujjatlar ertága imzolangan bolmaydı.

3. The article will not have been published by next week.
Maqola kelǵi háftada chop etilǵan bolmaydı.

So‘roq gaplar — 3 ta

1. Will the task have been completed by Friday?
Topshiriq jumagha bajarılǵan boladı mı?

2. Will the results have been checked by tomorrow?
Natijalar ertága tekshirilǵan boladı mı?

3. Will the project have been presented by the end of the month?
Loyiha oý axırına taqdim etilǵan boladı mı?

5. Modal feyllar bilen Passive Voice

Modal passive formulası:

Modal verb + be + V3

Mısalı:

The task must be completed.
Topshiriq bajarılışı kerek.

Bul yerde:

• must — modal feyl

• be — passive ushın kerek

• completed — V3

5.1. Can be + V3

Ma’nısı: qilinışı mümkin / bajarılışı mümkin

1. This problem can be solved easily.
Bul muammo osan hal qilinışı mümkin.

2. The room can be used for meetings.
Bul xona yig‘ilishlar ushın qollanılaşı mumkin.

3. English can be learned online.
Ingliz tilin onlayn úyreniw mümkin.

5.2. Could be + V3

Ma’nısı: qilinışı mümkin edi / ehtimal qilinışı mumkin

1. The mistake could be corrected.
Xato tuzatilışı mumkin edi.

2. The old building could be repaired.
Eski bino ta’mirlanışı mumkin edi.

3. This idea could be used in education.
Bul g‘oya ta’limde qollanılaşı mumkin edi.

5.3. May be + V3

Ma’nısı: qilinışı mümkin / ehtimal qilinadı

1. The exam may be postponed.
Imtihon qoldırılaşı mumkin.

2. The results may be announced today.
Natijalar búgin e’lon qilınışı mumkin.

3. The topic may be discussed tomorrow.
Mavzu erteń muhokama qilınışı mumkin.

5.4. Might be + V3

Ma’nısı: ehtimal qilinışı mumkin

1. The meeting might be cancelled.
Yig‘ilish bekor qilınışı mumkin.

2. The report might be checked again.
Hisobot qayta tekshirilışı mumkin.

3. The problem might be solved later.
Muammo keyinroq hal qilınışı mumkin.

5.5. Must be + V3

Ma’nısı: qilınışı şart / kerek

1. The rules must be followed.
Qoidalarga amal qilınışı şart.

2. The homework must be submitted on time.
Uy vazifası waqıtında topsırılaşı kerek.

3. The door must be locked after the lesson.
Darsdan keyin eshik qulflanılaşı kerek.

5.6. Should be + V3

Ma’nısı: qilınışı kerek / ma’qul

1. The room should be cleaned before the guests arrive.
Mehmonlar kelishidin oldın xona tozalanışı kerek.

2. The information should be checked carefully.
Ma’lumot diqqat bilen tekshirilışı kerek.

3. Mistakes should be corrected before submission.
Topşırıştan oldın xatolar tuzatilışı kerek.

5.7. Have to be + V3

Ma’nısı: qilınışı kerek / majbur

1. The form has to be filled in.
Forma to‘ldırılışı kerek.

2. The documents have to be signed today.
Hujjatlar búgin imzolınışı kerek.

3. The project has to be finished by Monday.
Loyiha dushanbagá tugatılışı kerek.

5.8. Need to be + V3

Ma’nısı: qilınışı kerek / zarur

1. The classroom needs to be cleaned.
Sinfxona tozalanışı kerek.

2. The article needs to be edited.
Maqola tahrir qilınışı kerek.

3. The data need to be analyzed.
Ma’lumotlar tahlil qilınışı kerek.

6. Active gápni Passive gápqa aylantırw qaǵıyda

Active gápni Passive gápqa aylantırw ushın 5 basqıç bar.

Mısal:

Active:
The teacher checks the tests.
Oqıtıwshı testlerdi tekşirip.

Passive:
The tests are checked by the teacher.
Testler oqıtıwshı tarafınan tekşirilip.

By Passive Voice’da işni kim bajarğanı kórsetiw ushın qollanıladı.

Formula:

Passive sentence + by + doer

Mısalı:

The book was written by George Orwell.
Kitob Jorj Oruell tarafınan yozılğan.

Qashan “by” kerek?

“By” bajaruşı muhim, anıq yamasa qızıqarli bolsa qollanıladı.

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
Kitob Jorj Oruell tarafınan yozılğan.

2. The theory was developed by Einstein.
Nazariya Eynshteyn tarafınan işläp chiqılğan.

3. The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci.
Mona Liza Leonardo da Vinchi tarafınan chızılğan.

Qashan “by” qollanılmasa ham boladı?

Bajaruşı noma’lum, umumiy yamasa muhim bolmasa, “by” qollanılmaydı.

1. My phone was stolen.
Telefonım o‘g‘irlandı.

2. The window was broken.
Deraza sindirildi.

3. The road is being repaired.
Yo‘l ta’mirlenip tur.

10 ta mısal

1. The book was written by George Orwell.
Kitob Jorj Oruell tarafınan yozılğan.

2. My phone was stolen.
Telefonım o‘g‘irlandı.

3. The classroom is cleaned every morning.
Sinfxona hár kúni erteláb tozalanadı.

4. The experiment was conducted by the researchers.
Tajriba tadqiqotchılar tarafınan o‘tkazıldı.

5. The new building was designed by a famous architect.
Jańa bino mashhur arxitektor tarafınan loyihalastırıldı.

6. The results were announced yesterday.
Natijalar keshe e’lon qilındı.

7. The song was performed by young students.
Qoşıq jańa oqıwshılar tarafınan ijro etildi.

8. The mistake was corrected by the teacher.
Xato oqıtıwshı tarafınan tuzatıldı.

9. The documents were signed by the manager.
Hujjatlar menejer tarafınan imzolandı.

10. The car was repaired last week.
Mashina o‘tken hafta ta’mirlandı.

8. Passive Voice qollanıladığan asası holatlar

a) Bajaruşı noma’lum bolsa

Kim bajarğanı noma’lum bolsa, Passive Voice qollanıladı.

1. My bag was stolen.
Sumkam o‘g‘irlandı.

2. The window was broken last night.
Deraza keshe kechasi sindirildi.

3. The documents were lost.
Hujjatlar yo‘qotıldı.

b) Bajaruşı muhim bolsa

Kim bajarğanı muhim emes, işniñ ózi muhim bolsa.

1. The classroom is cleaned every day.
Sinfxona hár kúni tozalanadı.

2. The roads are repaired every summer.
Yo‘llar har yozda ta’mirlanadı.

3. The forms are checked before submission.
Formalar topshirishdan oldın tekshiriladı.

c) Natija muhim bo‘lsa

Ishni kim qilǵanı emes, natija muhim boladı.

1. The problem has been solved.
Muammo hal qılınǵan.

2. The project has been completed.
Loyiha tugatılǵan.

3. The room has been cleaned.
Xona tozalanaǵan.

d) Rasmiy va ilmiy uslubda

Ilmiy hám rasmiy yozuvlarda Passive Voice kóbinese qollanıladı.

1. The experiment was conducted in a laboratory.
Tajriba laboratoriyada ótqazıldı.

2. The data were analyzed carefully.
Ma’lumotlar diqqat menen tahlil qılındı.

3. The results were compared with previous studies.
Natijalar oldǵı tadqiqotlar menen solıqtırıldı.

e) Yangiliklar, maqolalar va akademik yozuvlarda

Yangiliklarda kóbinese natija muhim boladı.

1. A new hospital was opened yesterday.
Kecha jańa shifoxona ochıldı.

2. Several students were awarded at the ceremony.
Marosımda bir neçta oqıwshı taqdırlandı.

3. The report was published online.
Hisobot onlayn chop etildi.

f) Qoidalar, e’lonlar va ko‘rsatmalarda

Qoidalarda bajarwısh odatda muhim emes.

1. Phones are not allowed during the exam.
Imtihon paytında telefonlardı ruxsat berilmeýdi.

2. The form must be filled in completely.
Forma tolıq toldırılwı kerek.

3. All questions should be answered clearly.
Barcha savollarga anıq juwap berilwı kerek.

9. Passive Voice ishlatilmaydigan yoki ehtiyot bo‘lish kerak bo‘lgan holatlar

Ba’zi feyllar object almaydı. Bunday feyllar menen Passive Voice yasalmaydı.

Mısalı:

• happen — sodır bolmaq

• arrive — yetip kelmaq

• die — vafot bolmaq

• sleep — uxlamıq

• go — bormaq

• come — kelmaq

Bu feyllarda object bolmaǵanı úşın passive qılıw notǵırı.

“Have”, “lack”, “belong”, “seem” kabi feyllar

Bu feyllar hám odatda Passive Voice’da qollanılmaydı yaki juda ehtiyotkorlıq menen qollanıladı.

• have — ega bolmaq

• lack — yetişmeslik

• belong — tegışli bolmaq

• seem — ko‘rinmaq
reading_passage:
In a short student interview, Eva explains what the class learned about a travel bucket list and how trips are organised in a student travel club.

Members create a list of places they hope to visit before graduation. Train tickets are booked online, hostel rooms are compared carefully and travel documents are checked before each trip.

Photos are shared in a private group after the journey, and practical advice is added to a common guide. New destinations are chosen by vote at the end of every semester.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “The tickets are booked online, the bags are checked at the station, and the route is shown on the app.” The club’s list grows, but each trip is planned with clear safety rules.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Eva and Noah compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.
