grammar_rules:
Indirect Question — bu savolni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri emas, balki muloyimroq, rasmiyroq yoki ehtiyotkorroq shaklda berish usuli.

Direct Question nima?

Direct question — oddiy, to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri savol.

Example:
Where is the bank?
Bank qayerda?

Indirect Question nima?

Indirect question — savol oldidan kirish iborasi keladi va gap muloyimroq bo‘ladi.

Example:
Could you tell me where the bank is?
Bank qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

Asosiy farq

Direct question’da odatda savol tartibi ishlatiladi:

Where is the bank?
Bank qayerda?

Indirect question’da esa darak gap tartibi ishlatiladi:

Could you tell me where the bank is?
Bank qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

Indirect Questions nima uchun kerak?

Indirect questions odatda quyidagi holatlarda ishlatiladi:

1. Muloyim savol berish uchun

2. Rasmiy vaziyatlarda savol berish uchun

3. Notanish odamdan ma’lumot so‘rash uchun

4. Email yoki ish yozishmalarida muloyim bo‘lish uchun

5. Biror narsani aniq bilmasligimizni bildirish uchun

10 ta sodda misol

1. Where is the station?
Bekat qayerda?

Could you tell me where the station is?
Bekat qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. What time is it?
Soat nechchi?

Do you know what time it is?
Soat nechchi ekanini bilasizmi?

3. Where does he live?
U qayerda yashaydi?

Do you know where he lives?
U qayerda yashashini bilasizmi?

4. When does the lesson start?
Dars qachon boshlanadi?

Could you tell me when the lesson starts?
Dars qachon boshlanishini aytib bera olasizmi?

5. Why is she upset?
U nega xafa?

I wonder why she is upset.
Men uning nega xafa ekanini bilmoqchiman.

6. How much does this book cost?
Bu kitob qancha turadi?

Could you tell me how much this book costs?
Bu kitob qancha turishini aytib bera olasizmi?

7. Is the library open?
Kutubxona ochiqmi?

Do you know if the library is open?
Kutubxona ochiqmi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

8. Can he speak English?
U inglizcha gapira oladimi?

I wonder if he can speak English.
Men u inglizcha gapira oladimi yoki yo‘qmi, bilmoqchiman.

9. Where did they go?
Ular qayerga ketishdi?

Do you know where they went?
Ular qayerga ketganini bilasizmi?

10. What should I do?
Men nima qilishim kerak?

Could you tell me what I should do?
Men nima qilishim kerakligini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Direct Question va Indirect Question farqi

Direct question | Indirect question | Tarjima | Farqi
Where is the hospital? | Could you tell me where the hospital is? | Kasalxona qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi? | “is” subjectdan keyin keldi.
What time does the train leave? | Do you know what time the train leaves? | Poyezd soat nechchida ketishini bilasizmi? | “does” tushdi, “leaves” ishlatildi.
Where does she study? | Could you tell me where she studies? | U qayerda o‘qishini aytib bera olasizmi? | “does” tushdi, “studies” keldi.
Why did he call you? | Do you know why he called you? | U nega sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilganini bilasizmi? | “did” tushdi, “called” ishlatildi.
When is the exam? | I’d like to know when the exam is. | Imtihon qachon ekanini bilmoqchiman. | Gap oxirida nuqta.
How much is this course? | Could you tell me how much this course is? | Bu kurs qancha turishini aytib bera olasizmi? | Darak gap tartibi.
Who is your teacher? | Do you know who your teacher is? | O‘qituvchingiz kimligini bilasizmi? | “is” oxirga yaqin keldi.
What did they discuss? | I wonder what they discussed. | Ular nimani muhokama qilganini bilmoqchiman. | “did” tushdi.
Is he ready? | Do you know if he is ready? | U tayyormi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi? | Yes/No savolda “if” ishlatildi.
Are they at school? | Could you tell me whether they are at school? | Ular maktabdami yoki yo‘qmi, aytib bera olasizmi? | “whether” ishlatildi.
Can she drive? | Do you know if she can drive? | U mashina hayday oladimi, bilasizmi? | Modal “can” subjectdan keyin keldi.
Where will you stay? | Could you tell me where you will stay? | Qayerda qolishingizni aytib bera olasizmi? | “will” subjectdan keyin keldi.
What are you doing? | I wonder what you are doing. | Nima qilayotganingizni bilmoqchiman. | “are” subjectdan keyin keldi.
Why has he left? | Do you know why he has left? | U nega ketganini bilasizmi? | “has” subjectdan keyin keldi.
Which book did you choose? | Could you tell me which book you chose? | Qaysi kitobni tanlaganingizni aytib bera olasizmi? | “did” tushdi, “chose” ishlatildi.

3. Indirect Questions ishlatiladigan asosiy kirish iboralari

1. Could you tell me…?

Bu ibora juda muloyim va rasmiy hisoblanadi. Notanish odam, o‘qituvchi, xodim yoki rasmiy shaxsdan savol so‘rashda ishlatiladi.

1. Could you tell me where the nearest bank is?
Eng yaqin bank qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Could you tell me when the meeting starts?
Uchrashuv qachon boshlanishini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Do you know…?

Bu ibora kundalik nutqda ko‘p ishlatiladi. “Bilasizmi?” degan ma’noni beradi.

1. Do you know where Ali lives?
Ali qayerda yashashini bilasizmi?

2. Do you know what time the class begins?
Dars soat nechchida boshlanishini bilasizmi?

3. I wonder…

Bu ibora “Qiziq, bilmadim...” yoki “Men bilmoqchiman...” degan ma’noda ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha gap oxirida nuqtaqo‘yiladi.

1. I wonder why she is late.
Qiziq, u nega kech qoldi ekan.

2. I wonder where they have gone.
Qiziq, ular qayerga ketishdi ekan.

4. I’d like to know…

Bu ibora “Men bilmoqchiman” degan rasmiyroq ifoda.

1. I’d like to know when the application deadline is.
Ariza topshirish muddati qachonligini bilmoqchiman.

2. I’d like to know how much the course costs.
Kurs qancha turishini bilmoqchiman.

5. Can you explain…?

Bu ibora “Tushuntirib bera olasizmi?” degan ma’noni beradi.

1. Can you explain why this answer is wrong?
Nega bu javob xato ekanini tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

2. Can you explain how this machine works?
Bu qurilma qanday ishlashini tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

6. Do you have any idea…?

Bu ibora “Sizda biror tasavvur bormi?” yoki “Bilasizmi?” ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

1. Do you have any idea where my notebook is?
Daftarim qayerdaligi haqida biror fikringiz bormi?

2. Do you have any idea why the lesson was cancelled?
Dars nega bekor qilinganini bilasizmi?

7. I’m not sure…

Bu ibora “Ishonchim komil emas” degan ma’noni bildiradi.

1. I’m not sure where he works.
Men uning qayerda ishlashiga ishonchim komil emas.

2. I’m not sure if they are ready.
Men ular tayyormi yoki yo‘qmi, aniq bilmayman.

8. Would you mind telling me…?

Bu juda muloyim va rasmiy ibora. “Aytib berishga qarshi emasmisiz?” degan ma’noda.

1. Would you mind telling me where the manager’s office is?
Menejerning xonasi qayerdaligini aytib berishga qarshi emasmisiz?

2. Would you mind telling me how I can register?
Qanday ro‘yxatdan o‘tishim mumkinligini aytib bera olasizmi?

9. Could you explain…?

Bu ham muloyim ibora. “Tushuntirib bera olasizmi?” degan ma’noni beradi.

1. Could you explain how this rule works?
Bu qoida qanday ishlashini tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

2. Could you explain why we use if here?
Bu yerda nega “if” ishlatishimizni tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

10. I want to know…

Bu ibora oddiyroq. Ba’zan rasmiy vaziyatda biroz keskin eshitilishi mumkin. Shuning uchun ko‘proq oddiy suhbatlarda ishlatiladi.

1. I want to know where my results are.
Men natijalarim qayerdaligini bilmoqchiman.

2. I want to know if I passed the exam.
Men imtihondan o‘tgan-o‘tmaganimni bilmoqchiman.

4. Eng muhim qoida: indirect question’da so‘z tartibi o‘zgaradi

Direct question’da savol tartibi ishlatiladi:

Where does he live?
U qayerda yashaydi?

Indirect question’da esa darak gap tartibi ishlatiladi:

Could you tell me where he lives?
U qayerda yashashini aytib bera olasizmi?

Asosiy formula

Question word + subject + verb

Ya’ni:

where + he + lives
u qayerda yashashi

what + she + wants
u nimani xohlashi

when + they + arrived
ular qachon kelgani

Xato va to‘g‘ri shakl

❌ Could you tell me where does he live?
Bu xato, chunki indirect question ichida “does he live” savol tartibi qolib ketgan.

✅ Could you tell me where he lives?
Bu to‘g‘ri, chunki “he lives” darak gap tartibida.

15 ta misol

1. Where does he live? → Could you tell me where he lives?
U qayerda yashashini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. What does she want? → Do you know what she wants?
U nimani xohlashini bilasizmi?

3. When did they arrive? → I wonder when they arrived.
Qiziq, ular qachon kelishdi ekan.

4. Why is he angry? → Do you know why he is angry?
U nega jahli chiqqanini bilasizmi?

5. Where are the students? → Could you tell me where the students are?
Talabalar qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

6. How does this app work? → Can you explain how this app works?
Bu ilova qanday ishlashini tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

7. What did the teacher say? → Do you know what the teacher said?
O‘qituvchi nima deganini bilasizmi?

8. When will the exam begin? → I’d like to know when the exam will begin.
Imtihon qachon boshlanishini bilmoqchiman.

9. Where can I buy tickets? → Could you tell me where I can buy tickets?
Qayerdan chipta sotib olishim mumkinligini aytib bera olasizmi?

10. Why did she leave early? → I wonder why she left early.
Qiziq, u nega erta ketdi ekan.

11. Who is responsible for this project? → Do you know who is responsible for this project?
Bu loyiha uchun kim mas’ul ekanini bilasizmi?

12. Which course should I choose? → Could you tell me which course I should choose?
Qaysi kursni tanlashim kerakligini aytib bera olasizmi?

13. How many students are absent? → Do you know how many students are absent?
Nechta o‘quvchi yo‘qligini bilasizmi?

14. How much does the ticket cost? → Could you tell me how much the ticket costs?
Chipta qancha turishini aytib bera olasizmi?

15. Whose bag is this? → Do you know whose bag this is?
Bu kimning sumkasi ekanini bilasizmi?

5. WH-questions bilan Indirect Questions

WH-question — savol so‘zi bilan boshlanadigan savol:

what, where, when, why, who, whose, which, how, how much, how many

Indirect question’da savol so‘zi saqlanadi, lekin undan keyin subject + verb keladi.

1. What

1. What does he need? → Do you know what he needs?
U nimaga muhtojligini bilasizmi?

2. What did she write? → Could you tell me what she wrote?
U nima yozganini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Where

1. Where is the classroom? → Could you tell me where the classroom is?
Sinfxona qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Where do they study? → Do you know where they study?
Ular qayerda o‘qishini bilasizmi?

3. When

1. When does the exam start? → Do you know when the exam starts?
Imtihon qachon boshlanishini bilasizmi?

2. When did he come back? → I wonder when he came back.
Qiziq, u qachon qaytib keldi ekan.

4. Why

1. Why is she crying? → Do you know why she is crying?
U nega yig‘layotganini bilasizmi?

2. Why did they cancel the meeting? → I wonder why they cancelled the meeting.
Qiziq, ular uchrashuvni nega bekor qilishdi ekan.

5. Who

1. Who is your English teacher? → Could you tell me who your English teacher is?
Ingliz tili o‘qituvchingiz kimligini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Who called you? → Do you know who called you?
Sizga kim qo‘ng‘iroq qilganini bilasizmi?

Eslatma: Agar who subject bo‘lsa, gap tartibi o‘zgarmaydi:
Who called you? → Do you know who called you?

6. Whose

1. Whose phone is this? → Do you know whose phone this is?
Bu kimning telefoni ekanini bilasizmi?

2. Whose car did they use? → Could you tell me whose car they used?
Ular kimning mashinasidan foydalanganini aytib bera olasizmi?

7. Which

1. Which answer is correct? → Do you know which answer is correct?
Qaysi javob to‘g‘ri ekanini bilasizmi?

2. Which university did she choose? → I wonder which university she chose.
Qiziq, u qaysi universitetni tanladi ekan.

8. How

1. How does this system work? → Can you explain how this system works?
Bu tizim qanday ishlashini tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

2. How did he solve the problem? → Do you know how he solved the problem?
U masalani qanday yechganini bilasizmi?

9. How much

1. How much is this jacket? → Could you tell me how much this jacket is?
Bu kurtka qancha turishini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. How much money did they spend? → Do you know how much money they spent?
Ular qancha pul sarflaganini bilasizmi?

10. How many

1. How many students are in your group? → Could you tell me how many students are in your group?
Guruhingizda nechta talaba borligini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. How many questions did you answer? → Do you know how many questions you answered?
Nechta savolga javob berganingizni bilasizmi?

6. Yes/No questions bilan Indirect Questions

Agar direct question yes/no question bo‘lsa, ya’ni “ha” yoki “yo‘q” deb javob beriladigan savol bo‘lsa, indirect question’da if yoki whether ishlatiladi.

Direct question

Is he at home?
U uydami?

Indirect question

Do you know if he is at home?
U uydami yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

If va whether farqi

If — kundalik nutqda ko‘p ishlatiladi.
Whether — biroz rasmiyroq va akademikroq.

Ko‘p holatda ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi:

Do you know if she is coming?
U keladimi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

Do you know whether she is coming?
U keladimi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

Whether ko‘proq mos keladigan holatlar

1. Rasmiy yozishmalarda

2. “or not” bilan

3. Ikki variant bor bo‘lsa

I don’t know whether he will agree or not.
U rozi bo‘ladimi yoki yo‘qmi, bilmayman.

15 ta misol

1. Is the shop open? → Do you know if the shop is open?
Do‘kon ochiqmi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

2. Are they ready? → Could you tell me whether they are ready?
Ular tayyormi yoki yo‘qmi, aytib bera olasizmi?

3. Does he speak English? → Do you know if he speaks English?
U inglizcha gapiradimi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

4. Did she pass the exam? → I wonder if she passed the exam.
Qiziq, u imtihondan o‘tdimi ekan.

5. Can you help me? → I’d like to know if you can help me.
Siz menga yordam bera olasizmi yoki yo‘qmi, bilmoqchiman.

6. Will they arrive today? → Do you know whether they will arrive today?
Ular bugun keladimi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

7. Has he finished the project? → I wonder if he has finished the project.
Qiziq, u loyihani tugatdimi ekan.

8. Is this seat free? → Could you tell me if this seat is free?
Bu joy bo‘shmi yoki yo‘qmi, aytib bera olasizmi?

9. Do we need a passport? → Do you know whether we need a passport?
Bizga pasport kerakmi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

10. Did they receive my email? → I wonder if they received my email.
Qiziq, ular mening emailimni olishdimi ekan.

11. Are there any tickets left? → Could you tell me if there are any tickets left?
Hali chiptalar qolganmi yoki yo‘qmi, aytib bera olasizmi?

12. Should I apply now? → I’d like to know whether I should apply now.
Hozir ariza topshirishim kerakmi yoki yo‘qmi, bilmoqchiman.

13. Is the teacher in the room? → Do you know if the teacher is in the room?
O‘qituvchi xonadami yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

14. Do they offer scholarships? → Could you tell me whether they offer scholarships?
Ular stipendiya taklif qiladimi yoki yo‘qmi, aytib bera olasizmi?

15. Was the lecture useful? → I wonder if the lecture was useful.
Qiziq, ma’ruza foydali bo‘ldimi ekan.

7. Indirect Questions formulalari

Formula 1

Could you tell me + question word + subject + verb?

1. Could you tell me where the library is?
Kutubxona qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Could you tell me when the bus leaves?
Avtobus qachon ketishini aytib bera olasizmi?

3. Could you tell me how this platform works?
Bu platforma qanday ishlashini aytib bera olasizmi?

Formula 2

Do you know + question word + subject + verb?

1. Do you know what he wants?
U nimani xohlashini bilasizmi?

2. Do you know where they live?
Ular qayerda yashashini bilasizmi?

3. Do you know why she left early?
U nega erta ketganini bilasizmi?

Formula 3

I wonder + question word + subject + verb.

1. I wonder what he is doing now.
Qiziq, u hozir nima qilyapti ekan.

2. I wonder where they went yesterday.
Qiziq, ular kecha qayerga borishdi ekan.

3. I wonder why the lesson was cancelled.
Qiziq, dars nega bekor qilindi ekan.

Formula 4

I’d like to know + question word + subject + verb.

1. I’d like to know when the course begins.
Kurs qachon boshlanishini bilmoqchiman.

2. I’d like to know how much the tuition fee is.
O‘qish to‘lovi qancha ekanini bilmoqchiman.

3. I’d like to know which documents I need.
Qaysi hujjatlar kerakligini bilmoqchiman.

Formula 5

Do you know + if/whether + subject + verb?

1. Do you know if he is at home?
U uydami yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

2. Do you know whether the office is open?
Ofis ochiqmi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

3. Do you know if they have arrived?
Ular yetib kelishdimi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

Formula 6

I wonder + if/whether + subject + verb.

1. I wonder if she likes this idea.
Qiziq, unga bu fikr yoqadimi ekan.

2. I wonder whether they will accept my application.
Qiziq, ular mening arizamni qabul qilishadimi ekan.

3. I wonder if the result is correct.
Qiziq, natija to‘g‘rimi ekan.

8. Tense va auxiliary verbs o‘zgarishi

Direct question’dan indirect question’ga o‘tganda do / does / did ko‘pincha tushib qoladi.

Nega?

Chunki indirect question ichida savol tartibi emas, darak gap tartibi ishlatiladi.

Present Simple

Where does she work?
U qayerda ishlaydi?

Do you know where she works?
U qayerda ishlashini bilasizmi?

Bu yerda does tushib qoldi, asosiy fe’l works bo‘ldi.

Past Simple

What did he say?
U nima dedi?

Could you tell me what he said?
U nima deganini aytib bera olasizmi?

Bu yerda did tushib qoldi, fe’l said bo‘ldi.

Present Simple plural

Why do they study English?
Ular nega ingliz tilini o‘rganadi?

I wonder why they study English.
Qiziq, ular nega ingliz tilini o‘rganishadi ekan.

Bu yerda do tushib qoldi.

15 ta misol

1. Where does he work? → Do you know where he works?
U qayerda ishlashini bilasizmi?

2. What does she need? → Could you tell me what she needs?
U nimaga muhtojligini aytib bera olasizmi?

3. Why do they come late? → I wonder why they come late.
Qiziq, ular nega kech kelishadi ekan.

4. When does the lesson finish? → Do you know when the lesson finishes?
Dars qachon tugashini bilasizmi?

5. How does this program work? → Can you explain how this program works?
Bu dastur qanday ishlashini tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

6. Where did he go? → Do you know where he went?
U qayerga ketganini bilasizmi?

7. What did she buy? → Could you tell me what she bought?
U nima sotib olganini aytib bera olasizmi?

8. Why did they argue? → I wonder why they argued.
Qiziq, ular nega bahslashishdi ekan.

9. When did you arrive? → Could you tell me when you arrived?
Siz qachon kelganingizni aytib bera olasizmi?

10. Which book did he choose? → Do you know which book he chose?
U qaysi kitobni tanlaganini bilasizmi?

11. Where is she studying? → Do you know where she is studying?
U qayerda o‘qiyotganini bilasizmi?

12. What are they doing? → I wonder what they are doing.
Qiziq, ular nima qilyapti ekan.

13. Why has he changed his plan? → Do you know why he has changed his plan?
U nega rejasini o‘zgartirganini bilasizmi?

14. When will they announce the results? → I’d like to know when they will announce the results.
Ular natijalarni qachon e’lon qilishini bilmoqchiman.

15. How can I contact the manager? → Could you tell me how I can contact the manager?
Menejer bilan qanday bog‘lanishim mumkinligini aytib bera olasizmi?

9. Indirect Questions’da punktuatsiya

Indirect question’da tinish belgisi gapning boshidagi iboraga bog‘liq.

1. Agar gap haqiqiy savol bo‘lsa, oxirida question mark qo‘yiladi.

Could you tell me where the station is?
Bekat qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

Bu savol, shuning uchun oxirida ? qo‘yiladi.

2. Agar gap darak gap bo‘lsa, oxirida nuqta qo‘yiladi.

I wonder where the station is.
Qiziq, bekat qayerda ekan.

Bu darak gap, shuning uchun oxirida . qo‘yiladi.

10 ta misol

1. Could you tell me where the office is?
Ofis qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Do you know when the test starts?
Test qachon boshlanishini bilasizmi?

3. Would you mind telling me how I can register?
Qanday ro‘yxatdan o‘tishim mumkinligini aytib berasizmi?

4. Can you explain why this rule is important?
Bu qoida nega muhimligini tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

5. Could you tell me if the manager is available?
Menejer bo‘shmi yoki yo‘qmi, aytib bera olasizmi?

6. I wonder where they are now.
Qiziq, ular hozir qayerda ekan.

7. I’d like to know when the interview will begin.
Suhbat qachon boshlanishini bilmoqchiman.

8. I’m not sure if this answer is correct.
Bu javob to‘g‘rimi yoki yo‘qmi, ishonchim komil emas.

9. I wonder why he refused the offer.
Qiziq, u taklifni nega rad etdi ekan.

10. I’d like to know whether I can change my schedule.
Jadvalimni o‘zgartira olamanmi yoki yo‘qmi, bilmoqchiman.

10. Indirect Questions va Reported Questions farqi

Indirect Question

Indirect question — muloyim savol yoki bilishni xohlash.

Could you tell me where he lives?
U qayerda yashashini aytib bera olasizmi?

Reported Question

Reported question — kimdir bergan savolni boshqa odamga aytish.

She asked where he lived.
U uning qayerda yashashini so‘radi.

Jadval

Direct question | Indirect question | Reported question | Tarjima
Where does he live? | Could you tell me where he lives? | She asked where he lived. | U qayerda yashashini so‘radi.
What is your name? | Could you tell me what your name is? | He asked what my name was. | U mening ismim nima ekanini so‘radi.
When does the class start? | Do you know when the class starts? | She asked when the class started. | U dars qachon boshlanishini so‘radi.
Why are you late? | Could you tell me why you are late? | The teacher asked why I was late. | O‘qituvchi nega kech qolganimni so‘radi.
Did you finish the task? | Do you know if he finished the task? | He asked if I had finished the task. | U vazifani tugatgan-tugatmaganimni so‘radi.
Is she at home? | Do you know if she is at home? | He asked if she was at home. | U uning uyda yoki uyda emasligini so‘radi.
Where did they go? | Do you know where they went? | She asked where they had gone. | U ular qayerga ketganini so‘radi.
Can you help me? | I’d like to know if you can help me. | He asked if I could help him. | U yordam bera olishimni so‘radi.
What are they doing? | I wonder what they are doing. | He asked what they were doing. | U ular nima qilayotganini so‘radi.
Will you come tomorrow? | Do you know whether he will come tomorrow? | She asked whether I would come the next day. | U ertasi kuni kelish-kelmasligimni so‘radi.

Muhim:
Indirect question’da zamon har doim ham o‘zgarmaydi. Reported question’da esa ko‘pincha zamon orqaga siljiydi:
is → was, do → did, will → would, can → could

11. Indirect Questions rasmiy va kundalik nutqda

1. Yo‘l so‘rash

1. Could you tell me where the nearest metro station is?
Eng yaqin metro bekati qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Do you know how I can get to the city center?
Shahar markaziga qanday borishim mumkinligini bilasizmi?

2. Ma’lumot so‘rash

1. Could you tell me when the office closes?
Ofis qachon yopilishini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Do you know if this service is free?
Bu xizmat bepulmi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

3. Universitetda savol berish

1. Could you explain how we should submit the assignment?
Topshiriqni qanday topshirishimiz kerakligini tushuntirib bera olasizmi?

2. I’d like to know whether we can choose our research topic.
Tadqiqot mavzusini o‘zimiz tanlay olamizmi yoki yo‘qmi, bilmoqchiman.

4. Mehmonxonada savol berish

1. Could you tell me what time breakfast is served?
Nonushta soat nechchida berilishini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Do you know if there is a gym in the hotel?
Mehmonxonada sport zali bormi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

5. Aeroportda savol berish

1. Could you tell me where gate 12 is?
12-darvoza qayerdaligini aytib bera olasizmi?

2. Do you know whether the flight has been delayed?
Reys kechiktirildimi yoki yo‘qmi, bilasizmi?

6. Ish intervyusida savol berish

1. I’d like to know what responsibilities this position includes.
Bu lavozim qanday vazifalarni o‘z ichiga olishini bilmoqchiman.

2. Could you tell me whether there is a training period?
Sinov yoki o‘quv davri bormi yoki yo‘qmi, aytib bera olasizmi?

7. Email yozishda savol berish

1. I’d like to know when the final decision will be made.
Yakuniy qaror qachon qabul qilinishini bilmoqchiman.

2. Could you please let me know whether my application has been received?
Arizam qabul qilingan-qilinmaganini menga ma’lum qila olasizmi?
grammar_rules_en:
Indirect Question — a way of asking a question not directly, but in a more polite, formal or careful way.

What is a direct question?

Direct question — a simple, straightforward question.

Example:
Where is the bank?

What is an indirect question?

In an indirect question, an introductory phrase comes before the question, and the sentence sounds more polite.

Example:
Could you tell me where the bank is?

The main difference

In a direct question, the question order is usually used:

Where is the bank?

In an indirect question, the statement order is used:

Could you tell me where the bank is?

Why are indirect questions needed?

Indirect questions are usually used in the following situations:

1. To ask a polite question

2. To ask a question in formal situations

3. To ask for information from an unfamiliar person

4. To be polite in emails or business correspondence

5. To indicate that we do not know something clearly

10 simple examples

1. Where is the station?
Where is the station?

Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where the station is?

2. What time is it?
What time is it?

Do you know what time it is?
Do you know what time it is?

3. Where does he live?
Where does he live?

Do you know where he lives?
Do you know where he lives?

4. When does the lesson start?
When does the lesson start?

Could you tell me when the lesson starts?
Could you tell me when the lesson starts?

5. Why is she upset?
Why is she upset?

I wonder why she is upset.
I wonder why she is upset.

6. How much does this book cost?
How much does this book cost?

Could you tell me how much this book costs?
Could you tell me how much this book costs?

7. Is the library open?
Is the library open?

Do you know if the library is open?
Do you know if the library is open?

8. Can he speak English?
Can he speak English?

I wonder if he can speak English.
I wonder if he can speak English.

9. Where did they go?
Where did they go?

Do you know where they went?
Do you know where they went?

10. What should I do?
What should I do?

Could you tell me what I should do?
Could you tell me what I should do?

2. The difference between Direct Question and Indirect Question

Direct question | Indirect question | Translation | Difference
Where is the hospital? | Could you tell me where the hospital is? | Could you tell me where the hospital is? | “is” comes after the subject.
What time does the train leave? | Do you know what time the train leaves? | Do you know what time the train leaves? | “does” is omitted, “leaves” is used.
Where does she study? | Could you tell me where she studies? | Could you tell me where she studies? | “does” is omitted, “studies” is used.
Why did he call you? | Do you know why he called you? | Do you know why he called you? | “did” is omitted, “called” is used.
When is the exam? | I’d like to know when the exam is. | I’d like to know when the exam is. | The sentence ends with a period.
How much is this course? | Could you tell me how much this course is? | Could you tell me how much this course is? | Statement order.
Who is your teacher? | Do you know who your teacher is? | Do you know who your teacher is? | “is” comes near the end.
What did they discuss? | I wonder what they discussed. | I wonder what they discussed. | “did” is omitted.
Is he ready? | Do you know if he is ready? | Do you know if he is ready? | “if” is used in Yes/No questions.
Are they at school? | Could you tell me whether they are at school? | Could you tell me whether they are at school? | “whether” is used.
Can she drive? | Do you know if she can drive? | Do you know if she can drive? | Modal “can” comes after the subject.
Where will you stay? | Could you tell me where you will stay? | Could you tell me where you will stay? | “will” comes after the subject.
What are you doing? | I wonder what you are doing. | I wonder what you are doing. | “are” comes after the subject.
Why has he left? | Do you know why he has left? | Do you know why he has left? | “has” comes after the subject.
Which book did you choose? | Could you tell me which book you chose? | Could you tell me which book you chose? | “did” is omitted, “chose” is used.

3. Main introductory phrases used in Indirect Questions

1. Could you tell me…?

This phrase is very polite and formal. It is used to ask a question from an unfamiliar person, teacher, staff, or official.

1. Could you tell me where the nearest bank is?
Could you tell me where the nearest bank is?

2. Could you tell me when the meeting starts?
Could you tell me when the meeting starts?

2. Do you know…?

This phrase is used frequently in everyday speech. It means “Do you know?”

1. Do you know where Ali lives?
Do you know where Ali lives?

2. Do you know what time the class begins?
Do you know what time the class begins?

3. I wonder…

This phrase is used in the sense of “I’m curious, I don’t know...” or “I want to know...”. It is often followed by a period at the end of the sentence.

1. I wonder why she is late.
I wonder why she is late.

2. I wonder where they have gone.
I wonder where they have gone.

4. I’d like to know…

This phrase is a more formal expression of “I want to know.”

1. I’d like to know when the application deadline is.
I’d like to know when the application deadline is.

2. I’d like to know how much the course costs.
I’d like to know how much the course costs.

5. Can you explain…?

This phrase means “Can you explain?”

1. Can you explain why this answer is wrong?
Can you explain why this answer is wrong?

2. Can you explain how this machine works?
Can you explain how this machine works?

6. Do you have any idea…?

This phrase is used in the sense of “Do you have any idea?” or “Do you know?”

1. Do you have any idea where my notebook is?
Do you have any idea where my notebook is?

2. Do you have any idea why the lesson was cancelled?
Do you have any idea why the lesson was cancelled?

7. I’m not sure…

This phrase means “I’m not sure.”

1. I’m not sure where he works.
I’m not sure where he works.

2. I’m not sure if they are ready.
I’m not sure if they are ready.

8. Would you mind telling me…?

This is a very polite and formal phrase. It means “Would you mind telling me?”

1. Would you mind telling me where the manager’s office is?
Would you mind telling me where the manager’s office is?

2. Would you mind telling me how I can register?
Would you mind telling me how I can register?

9. Could you explain…?

This is also a polite phrase. It means “Could you explain?”

1. Could you explain how this rule works?
Could you explain how this rule works?

2. Could you explain why we use if here?
Could you explain why we use if here?

10. I want to know…

This phrase is simpler. It can sometimes sound a bit harsh in formal situations. Therefore, it is used more in casual conversations.

1. I want to know where my results are.
I want to know where my results are.

2. I want to know if I passed the exam.
I want to know if I passed the exam.

4. The most important rule: in an indirect question, the word order changes

In a direct question, the question order is used:

Where does he live?
Where does he live?

In an indirect question, the statement order is used:

Could you tell me where he lives?
Could you tell me where he lives?

Basic formula

Question word + subject + verb

That is:

where + he + lives
where he lives

what + she + wants
what she wants

when + they + arrived
when they arrived

Incorrect and correct forms

❌ Could you tell me where does he live?
This is incorrect because the question order “does he live” remains in the indirect question.

✅ Could you tell me where he lives?
This is correct because “he lives” is in statement order.

15 examples

1. Where does he live? → Could you tell me where he lives?
Could you tell me where he lives?

2. What does she want? → Do you know what she wants?
Do you know what she wants?

3. When did they arrive? → I wonder when they arrived.
I wonder when they arrived.

4. Why is he angry? → Do you know why he is angry?
Do you know why he is angry?

5. Where are the students? → Could you tell me where the students are?
Could you tell me where the students are?

6. How does this app work? → Can you explain how this app works?
Can you explain how this app works?

7. What did the teacher say? → Do you know what the teacher said?
Do you know what the teacher said?

8. When will the exam begin? → I’d like to know when the exam will begin.
I’d like to know when the exam will begin.

9. Where can I buy tickets? → Could you tell me where I can buy tickets?
Could you tell me where I can buy tickets?

10. Why did she leave early? → I wonder why she left early.
I wonder why she left early.

11. Who is responsible for this project? → Do you know who is responsible for this project?
Do you know who is responsible for this project?

12. Which course should I choose? → Could you tell me which course I should choose?
Could you tell me which course I should choose?

13. How many students are absent? → Do you know how many students are absent?
Do you know how many students are absent?

14. How much does the ticket cost? → Could you tell me how much the ticket costs?
Could you tell me how much the ticket costs?

15. Whose bag is this? → Do you know whose bag this is?
Do you know whose bag this is?

5. WH-questions with Indirect Questions

WH-question — a question that starts with a question word:

what, where, when, why, who, whose, which, how, how much, how many

In an indirect question, the question word is retained, but it is followed by subject + verb.

1. What

1. What does he need? → Do you know what he needs?

2. What did she write? → Could you tell me what she wrote?

2. Where

1. Where is the classroom? → Could you tell me where the classroom is?

2. Where do they study? → Do you know where they study?

3. When

1. When does the exam start? → Do you know when the exam starts?

2. When did he come back? → I wonder when he came back.

4. Why

1. Why is she crying? → Do you know why she is crying?

2. Why did they cancel the meeting? → I wonder why they cancelled the meeting.

5. Who

1. Who is your English teacher? → Could you tell me who your English teacher is?

2. Who called you? → Do you know who called you?
Do you know who called you?

Note: If who is the subject, the word order does not change:
Who called you? → Do you know who called you?

6. Whose

1. Whose phone is this? → Do you know whose phone this is?
Do you know whose phone this is?

2. Whose car did they use? → Could you tell me whose car they used?
Could you tell me whose car they used?

7. Which

1. Which answer is correct? → Do you know which answer is correct?
Do you know which answer is correct?

2. Which university did she choose? → I wonder which university she chose.
I wonder which university she chose.

8. How

1. How does this system work? → Can you explain how this system works?
Can you explain how this system works?

2. How did he solve the problem? → Do you know how he solved the problem?
Do you know how he solved the problem?

9. How much

1. How much is this jacket? → Could you tell me how much this jacket is?
Could you tell me how much this jacket is?

2. How much money did they spend? → Do you know how much money they spent?
Do you know how much money they spent?

10. How many

1. How many students are in your group? → Could you tell me how many students are in your group?
Could you tell me how many students are in your group?

2. How many questions did you answer? → Do you know how many questions you answered?
Do you know how many questions you answered?

6. Yes/No questions and Indirect Questions

If the direct question is a yes/no question, meaning a question that can be answered with 'yes' or 'no', then 'if' or 'whether' is used in the indirect question.

Direct question

Is he at home?
Is he at home?

Indirect question

Do you know if he is at home?
Do you know if he is at home?

The difference between if and whether

If is used more in everyday speech.
Whether is a bit more formal and academic.

In many cases, both are used:

Do you know if she is coming?
Do you know if she is coming?

Do you know whether she is coming?
Do you know whether she is coming?

Situations where whether is more appropriate

1. In formal correspondence

2. With 'or not'

3. When there are two options

I don’t know whether he will agree or not.
I don’t know whether he will agree or not.

15 examples

1. Is the shop open? → Do you know if the shop is open?
Do you know if the shop is open?

2. Are they ready? → Could you tell me whether they are ready?
Could you tell me whether they are ready?

3. Does he speak English? → Do you know if he speaks English?
Do you know if he speaks English?

4. Did she pass the exam? → I wonder if she passed the exam.
I wonder if she passed the exam.

5. Can you help me? → I’d like to know if you can help me.
I’d like to know if you can help me.

6. Will they arrive today? → Do you know whether they will arrive today?
Do you know whether they will arrive today?

7. Has he finished the project? → I wonder if he has finished the project.
I wonder if he has finished the project.

8. Is this seat free? → Could you tell me if this seat is free?
Could you tell me if this seat is free?

9. Do we need a passport? → Do you know whether we need a passport?
Do you know whether we need a passport?

10. Did they receive my email? → I wonder if they received my email.
I wonder if they received my email.

11. Are there any tickets left? → Could you tell me if there are any tickets left?
Could you tell me if there are any tickets left?

12. Should I apply now? → I’d like to know whether I should apply now.
I’d like to know whether I should apply now.

13. Is the teacher in the room? → Do you know if the teacher is in the room?
Do you know if the teacher is in the room?

14. Do they offer scholarships? → Could you tell me whether they offer scholarships?
Could you tell me whether they offer scholarships?

15. Was the lecture useful? → I wonder if the lecture was useful.
I wonder if the lecture was useful.

7. Indirect Questions forms

Formula 1

Could you tell me + question word + subject + verb?

1. Could you tell me where the library is?
Could you tell me where the library is?

2. Could you tell me when the bus leaves?
Could you tell me when the bus leaves?

3. Could you tell me how this platform works?
Could you tell me how this platform works?

Formula 2

Do you know + question word + subject + verb?

1. Do you know what he wants?
Do you know what he wants?

2. Do you know where they live?
Do you know where they live?

3. Do you know why she left early?
Do you know why she left early?

Formula 3

I wonder + question word + subject + verb.

1. I wonder what he is doing now.
I wonder what he is doing now.

2. I wonder where they went yesterday.
I wonder where they went yesterday.

3. I wonder why the lesson was cancelled.
I wonder why the lesson was cancelled.

Formula 4

I’d like to know + question word + subject + verb.

1. I’d like to know when the course begins.
I’d like to know when the course begins.

2. I’d like to know how much the tuition fee is.
I’d like to know how much the tuition fee is.

3. I’d like to know which documents I need.
I’d like to know which documents I need.

Formula 5

Do you know + if/whether + subject + verb?

1. Do you know if he is at home?
Do you know if he is at home?

2. Do you know whether the office is open?
Do you know whether the office is open?

3. Do you know if they have arrived?
Do you know if they have arrived?

Formula 6

I wonder + if/whether + subject + verb.

1. I wonder if she likes this idea.
I wonder if she likes this idea.

2. I wonder whether they will accept my application.
I wonder whether they will accept my application.

3. I wonder if the result is correct.
I wonder if the result is correct.

8. Changes in tense and auxiliary verbs

When moving from a direct question to an indirect question, do / does / did often drop out.

Why?

Because in an indirect question, the order of the question is not used, but the statement order is used.

Present Simple

Where does she work?

Do you know where she works?

Here, does is omitted, and the main verb is works.

Past Simple

What did he say?

Could you tell me what he said?

Here, did is omitted, and the verb is said.

Present Simple plural

Why do they study English?

I wonder why they study English.

Here, do is omitted.

15 examples

1. Where does he work? → Do you know where he works?

2. What does she need? → Could you tell me what she needs?

3. Why do they come late? → I wonder why they come late.

4. When does the lesson finish? → Do you know when the lesson finishes?

5. How does this program work? → Can you explain how this program works?

6. Where did he go? → Do you know where he went?

7. What did she buy? → Could you tell me what she bought?

8. Why did they argue? → I wonder why they argued.

9. When did you arrive? → Could you tell me when you arrived?

10. Which book did he choose? → Do you know which book he chose?

11. Where is she studying? → Do you know where she is studying?

12. What are they doing? → I wonder what they are doing.

13. Why has he changed his plan? → Do you know why he has changed his plan?

14. When will they announce the results? → I’d like to know when they will announce the results.

15. How can I contact the manager? → Could you tell me how I can contact the manager?

9. Punctuation in Indirect Questions

In an indirect question, the punctuation depends on the introductory phrase.

1. If the sentence is a real question, a question mark is placed at the end.

Could you tell me where the station is?

This is a question, so a ? is placed at the end.

2. If the sentence is a statement, a period is placed at the end.

I wonder where the station is.

This is a statement, so a . is placed at the end.

10 examples

1. Could you tell me where the office is?

2. Do you know when the test starts?

3. Would you mind telling me how I can register?

4. Can you explain why this rule is important?

5. Could you tell me if the manager is available?

6. I wonder where they are now.

7. I’d like to know when the interview will begin.

8. I’m not sure if this answer is correct.

9. I wonder why he refused the offer.

10. I’d like to know whether I can change my schedule.

10. The difference between Indirect Questions and Reported Questions

Indirect Question

Indirect question — a polite way of asking a question or expressing a desire to know.

Could you tell me where he lives?

Reported Question

Reported question — telling someone else a question that someone asked.

She asked where he lived.

Table

Direct question | Indirect question | Reported question | Translation
Where does he live? | Could you tell me where he lives? | She asked where he lived. | U qayerda yashashini so‘radi.
What is your name? | Could you tell me what your name is? | He asked what my name was. | U mening ismim nima ekanini so‘radi.
When does the class start? | Do you know when the class starts? | She asked when the class started. | U dars qachon boshlanishini so‘radi.
Why are you late? | Could you tell me why you are late? | The teacher asked why I was late. | O‘qituvchi nega kech qolganimni so‘radi.
Did you finish the task? | Do you know if he finished the task? | He asked if I had finished the task. | U vazifani tugatgan-tugatmaganimni so‘radi.
Is she at home? | Do you know if she is at home? | He asked if she was at home. | U uning uyda yoki uyda emasligini so‘radi.
Where did they go? | Do you know where they went? | She asked where they had gone. | U ular qayerga ketganini so‘radi.
Can you help me? | I’d like to know if you can help me. | He asked if I could help him. | U yordam bera olishimni so‘radi.
What are they doing? | I wonder what they are doing. | He asked what they were doing. | U ular nima qilayotganini so‘radi.
Will you come tomorrow? | Do you know whether he will come tomorrow? | She asked whether I would come the next day. | U ertasi kuni kelish-kelmasligimni so‘radi.

Important:
In an indirect question, the tense does not always change. In a reported question, the tense often shifts back:
is → was, do → did, will → would, can → could

11. Indirect Questions in formal and everyday speech

1. Asking for directions

1. Could you tell me where the nearest metro station is?

2. Do you know how I can get to the city center?

2. Asking for information

1. Could you tell me when the office closes?

2. Do you know if this service is free?

3. Asking questions at the university

1. Could you explain how we should submit the assignment?

2. I’d like to know whether we can choose our research topic.

4. Asking questions at the hotel

1. Could you tell me what time breakfast is served?

2. Do you know if there is a gym in the hotel?

5. Asking questions at the airport

1. Could you tell me where gate 12 is?

2. Do you know whether the flight has been delayed?

6. Asking questions in a job interview

1. I’d like to know what responsibilities this position includes.

2. Could you tell me whether there is a training period?

7. Asking questions in an email

1. I’d like to know when the final decision will be made.

2. Could you please let me know whether my application has been received?
grammar_rules_ru:
Indirect Question — это способ задать вопрос не напрямую, а более вежливо, официально или осторожно.

Что такое Direct Question?

Direct question — обычный, прямой вопрос.

Example:
Where is the bank?
Где банк?

Что такое Indirect Question?

В indirect question перед вопросом идёт вводная фраза, и предложение звучит вежливее.

Example:
Could you tell me where the bank is?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится банк?

Главное различие

В Direct question обычно используется порядок слов вопроса:

Where is the bank?
Где банк?

В Indirect question используется порядок слов в утвердительном предложении:

Could you tell me where the bank is?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится банк?

Зачем нужны Indirect Questions?

Indirect questions обычно используются в следующих случаях:

1. Для вежливого задавания вопросов

2. Для задавания вопросов в официальных ситуациях

3. Для запроса информации у незнакомого человека

4. Для вежливости в email или деловой переписке

5. Для выражения неуверенности в чем-либо

10 простых примеров

1. Where is the station?
Где находится станция?

Could you tell me where the station is?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится станция?

2. What time is it?
Который час?

Do you know what time it is?
Вы знаете, который час?

3. Where does he live?
Где он живёт?

Do you know where he lives?
Вы знаете, где он живёт?

4. When does the lesson start?
Когда начинается урок?

Could you tell me when the lesson starts?
Не могли бы вы сказать, когда начинается урок?

5. Why is she upset?
Почему она расстроена?

I wonder why she is upset.
Мне интересно, почему она расстроена.

6. How much does this book cost?
Сколько стоит эта книга?

Could you tell me how much this book costs?
Не могли бы вы сказать, сколько стоит эта книга?

7. Is the library open?
Библиотека открыта?

Do you know if the library is open?
Вы знаете, открыта ли библиотека?

8. Can he speak English?
Он может говорить по-английски?

I wonder if he can speak English.
Мне интересно, может ли он говорить по-английски.

9. Where did they go?
Куда они ушли?

Do you know where they went?
Вы знаете, куда они ушли?

10. What should I do?
Что мне делать?

Could you tell me what I should do?
Не могли бы вы сказать, что мне делать?

2. Разница между Direct Question и Indirect Question

Direct question | Indirect question | Перевод | Разница
Where is the hospital? | Could you tell me where the hospital is? | Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится больница? | “is” пришло после подлежащего.
What time does the train leave? | Do you know what time the train leaves? | Вы знаете, в какое время уходит поезд? | “does” пропало, “leaves” использовано.
Where does she study? | Could you tell me where she studies? | Не могли бы вы сказать, где она учится? | “does” пропало, “studies” пришло.
Why did he call you? | Do you know why he called you? | Вы знаете, почему он вам позвонил? | “did” пропало, “called” использовано.
When is the exam? | I’d like to know when the exam is. | Мне интересно, когда экзамен. | В конце предложения точка.
How much is this course? | Could you tell me how much this course is? | Не могли бы вы сказать, сколько стоит этот курс? | Порядок слов в утвердительном предложении.
Who is your teacher? | Do you know who your teacher is? | Вы знаете, кто ваш учитель? | “is” пришло ближе к концу.
What did they discuss? | I wonder what they discussed. | Мне интересно, что они обсуждали. | “did” пропало.
Is he ready? | Do you know if he is ready? | Вы знаете, готов ли он? | В вопросах Yes/No используется “if”.
Are they at school? | Could you tell me whether they are at school? | Не могли бы вы сказать, в школе ли они? | Используется “whether”.
Can she drive? | Do you know if she can drive? | Вы знаете, может ли она водить машину? | Модальный “can” пришёл после подлежащего.
Where will you stay? | Could you tell me where you will stay? | Не могли бы вы сказать, где вы будете останавливаться? | “will” пришло после подлежащего.
What are you doing? | I wonder what you are doing. | Мне интересно, что вы делаете. | “are” пришло после подлежащего.
Why has he left? | Do you know why he has left? | Вы знаете, почему он ушёл? | “has” пришло после подлежащего.
Which book did you choose? | Could you tell me which book you chose? | Не могли бы вы сказать, какую книгу вы выбрали? | “did” пропало, “chose” использовано.

3. Основные вводные фразы для Indirect Questions

1. Could you tell me…?

Эта фраза считается очень вежливой и официальной. Используется для запроса у незнакомого человека, учителя, сотрудника или официального лица.

1. Could you tell me where the nearest bank is?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится ближайший банк?

2. Could you tell me when the meeting starts?
Не могли бы вы сказать, когда начинается встреча?

2. Do you know…?

Эта фраза часто используется в повседневной речи. Она означает “Вы знаете?”

1. Do you know where Ali lives?
Вы знаете, где живёт Али?

2. Do you know what time the class begins?
Вы знаете, во сколько начинается занятие?

3. I wonder…

Эта фраза используется в значении «Интересно, не знаю...» или «Я хочу знать...». Обычно в конце предложения ставится многоточие.

1. I wonder why she is late.
Интересно, почему она опоздала.

2. I wonder where they have gone.
Интересно, куда они ушли.

4. I’d like to know…

Эта фраза является более официальным выражением «Я хочу знать».

1. I’d like to know when the application deadline is.
Я хочу знать, когда крайний срок подачи заявлений.

2. I’d like to know how much the course costs.
Я хочу знать, сколько стоит курс.

5. Can you explain…?

Эта фраза означает «Можете объяснить?».

1. Can you explain why this answer is wrong?
Можете объяснить, почему этот ответ неверный?

2. Can you explain how this machine works?
Можете объяснить, как работает этот механизм?

6. Do you have any idea…?

Эта фраза используется в значении «У вас есть какое-либо представление?» или «Знаете ли вы?»

1. Do you have any idea where my notebook is?
У вас есть какое-либо представление, где моя тетрадь?

2. Do you have any idea why the lesson was cancelled?
Знаете ли вы, почему урок был отменён?

7. I’m not sure…

Эта фраза означает «Я не уверен».

1. I’m not sure where he works.
Я не уверен, где он работает.

2. I’m not sure if they are ready.
Я не уверен, готовы ли они.

8. Would you mind telling me…?

Это очень вежливая и официальная фраза. В значении «Не могли бы вы сказать...?».

1. Would you mind telling me where the manager’s office is?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится офис менеджера?

2. Would you mind telling me how I can register?
Не могли бы вы сказать, как я могу зарегистрироваться?

9. Could you explain…?

Это тоже вежливая фраза. В значении «Можете объяснить?».

1. Could you explain how this rule works?
Можете объяснить, как работает это правило?

2. Could you explain why we use if here?
Можете объяснить, почему мы используем if здесь?

10. I want to know…

Эта фраза более простая. Иногда в официальной ситуации может звучать немного резко. Поэтому используется больше в обычных разговорах.

1. I want to know where my results are.
Я хочу знать, где мои результаты.

2. I want to know if I passed the exam.
Я хочу знать, сдал ли я экзамен.

4. Главное правило: в indirect question порядок слов меняется

В direct question используется порядок слов вопроса:

Where does he live?
Где он живёт?

В indirect question используется порядок слов утвердительного предложения:

Could you tell me where he lives?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где он живёт?

Основная формула

Question word + subject + verb

То есть:

where + he + lives
где + он + живёт

what + she + wants
что + она + хочет

when + they + arrived
когда + они + прибыли

Ошибочный и правильный вариант

❌ Could you tell me where does he live?
Это ошибка, потому что в indirect question остался порядок слов вопроса «does he live».

✅ Could you tell me where he lives?
Это правильно, потому что «he lives» в порядке слов утвердительного предложения.

15 примеров

1. Where does he live? → Could you tell me where he lives?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где он живёт?

2. What does she want? → Do you know what she wants?
Вы знаете, что она хочет?

3. When did they arrive? → I wonder when they arrived.
Интересно, когда они прибыли.

4. Why is he angry? → Do you know why he is angry?
Вы знаете, почему он сердится?

5. Where are the students? → Could you tell me where the students are?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где студенты?

6. How does this app work? → Can you explain how this app works?
Можете объяснить, как работает это приложение?

7. What did the teacher say? → Do you know what the teacher said?
Вы знаете, что сказал учитель?

8. When will the exam begin? → I’d like to know when the exam will begin.
Я хочу знать, когда начнётся экзамен.

9. Where can I buy tickets? → Could you tell me where I can buy tickets?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где я могу купить билеты?

10. Why did she leave early? → I wonder why she left early.
Интересно, почему она ушла рано.

11. Who is responsible for this project? → Do you know who is responsible for this project?
Вы знаете, кто отвечает за этот проект?

12. Which course should I choose? → Could you tell me which course I should choose?
Не могли бы вы сказать, какой курс мне выбрать?

13. How many students are absent? → Do you know how many students are absent?
Вы знаете, сколько студентов отсутствует?

14. How much does the ticket cost? → Could you tell me how much the ticket costs?
Не могли бы вы сказать, сколько стоит билет?

15. Whose bag is this? → Do you know whose bag this is?
Вы знаете, чья это сумка?

5. WH-вопросы с Indirect Questions

WH-question — вопрос, начинающийся с вопросительного слова:

what, where, when, why, who, whose, which, how, how much, how many

В indirect question сохраняется слово вопроса, но после него идет subject + verb.

1. What

1. What does he need? → Do you know what he needs?
Вы знаете, в чем он нуждается?

2. What did she write? → Could you tell me what she wrote?
Вы можете сказать, что она написала?

2. Where

1. Where is the classroom? → Could you tell me where the classroom is?
Вы можете сказать, где находится класс?

2. Where do they study? → Do you know where they study?
Вы знаете, где они учатся?

3. When

1. When does the exam start? → Do you know when the exam starts?
Вы знаете, когда начинается экзамен?

2. When did he come back? → I wonder when he came back.
Интересно, когда он вернулся.

4. Why

1. Why is she crying? → Do you know why she is crying?
Вы знаете, почему она плачет?

2. Why did they cancel the meeting? → I wonder why they cancelled the meeting.
Интересно, почему они отменили встречу.

5. Who

1. Who is your English teacher? → Could you tell me who your English teacher is?
Вы можете сказать, кто ваш учитель английского?

2. Who called you? → Do you know who called you?
Вы знаете, кто вам позвонил?

Примечание: Если who является subject, порядок слов не меняется:
Who called you? → Do you know who called you?

6. Whose

1. Whose phone is this? → Do you know whose phone this is?
Вы знаете, чей это телефон?

2. Whose car did they use? → Could you tell me whose car they used?
Вы можете сказать, чью машину они использовали?

7. Which

1. Which answer is correct? → Do you know which answer is correct?
Вы знаете, какой ответ правильный?

2. Which university did she choose? → I wonder which university she chose.
Интересно, какой университет она выбрала.

8. How

1. How does this system work? → Can you explain how this system works?
Вы можете объяснить, как работает эта система?

2. How did he solve the problem? → Do you know how he solved the problem?
Вы знаете, как он решил проблему?

9. How much

1. How much is this jacket? → Could you tell me how much this jacket is?
Вы можете сказать, сколько стоит эта куртка?

2. How much money did they spend? → Do you know how much money they spent?
Вы знаете, сколько денег они потратили?

10. How many

1. How many students are in your group? → Could you tell me how many students are in your group?
Вы можете сказать, сколько студентов в вашей группе?

2. How many questions did you answer? → Do you know how many questions you answered?
Вы знаете, на сколько вопросов вы ответили?

6. Yes/No questions с Indirect Questions

Если прямой вопрос является yes/no вопросом, то в indirect question используется if или whether.

Прямой вопрос

Is he at home?
Он дома?

Косвенный вопрос

Do you know if he is at home?
Вы знаете, он дома или нет?

Разница между if и whether

If — чаще используется в повседневной речи.
Whether — немного более формально и академично.

Во многих случаях оба используются:

Do you know if she is coming?
Вы знаете, она придет или нет?

Do you know whether she is coming?
Вы знаете, она придет или нет?

Ситуации, когда лучше использовать whether

1. В официальной переписке

2. С “or not”

3. Если есть два варианта

I don’t know whether he will agree or not.
Я не знаю, согласится ли он или нет.

15 примеров

1. Is the shop open? → Do you know if the shop is open?
Вы знаете, магазин открыт или нет?

2. Are they ready? → Could you tell me whether they are ready?
Вы можете сказать, они готовы или нет?

3. Does he speak English? → Do you know if he speaks English?
Вы знаете, он говорит по-английски или нет?

4. Did she pass the exam? → I wonder if she passed the exam.
Интересно, она сдала экзамен?

5. Can you help me? → I’d like to know if you can help me.
Я хотел бы знать, можете ли вы мне помочь?

6. Will they arrive today? → Do you know whether they will arrive today?
Вы знаете, они приедут сегодня или нет?

7. Has he finished the project? → I wonder if he has finished the project.
Интересно, он закончил проект?

8. Is this seat free? → Could you tell me if this seat is free?
Вы можете сказать, это место свободно или нет?

9. Do we need a passport? → Do you know whether we need a passport?
Вы знаете, нам нужен паспорт или нет?

10. Did they receive my email? → I wonder if they received my email.
Интересно, они получили мое письмо?

11. Are there any tickets left? → Could you tell me if there are any tickets left?
Вы можете сказать, остались ли билеты?

12. Should I apply now? → I’d like to know whether I should apply now.
Я хотел бы знать, нужно ли мне подавать заявку сейчас?

13. Is the teacher in the room? → Do you know if the teacher is in the room?
Вы знаете, учитель в комнате или нет?

14. Do they offer scholarships? → Could you tell me whether they offer scholarships?
Не могли бы вы сказать, предлагают ли они стипендии?

15. Was the lecture useful? → I wonder if the lecture was useful.
Интересно, была ли лекция полезной.

7. Формулы Indirect Questions

Формула 1

Could you tell me + question word + subject + verb?

1. Could you tell me where the library is?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится библиотека?

2. Could you tell me when the bus leaves?
Не могли бы вы сказать, когда уходит автобус?

3. Could you tell me how this platform works?
Не могли бы вы сказать, как работает эта платформа?

Формула 2

Do you know + question word + subject + verb?

1. Do you know what he wants?
Вы знаете, чего он хочет?

2. Do you know where they live?
Вы знаете, где они живут?

3. Do you know why she left early?
Вы знаете, почему она ушла рано?

Формула 3

I wonder + question word + subject + verb.

1. I wonder what he is doing now.
Интересно, что он сейчас делает.

2. I wonder where they went yesterday.
Интересно, куда они пошли вчера.

3. I wonder why the lesson was cancelled.
Интересно, почему урок был отменён.

Формула 4

I’d like to know + question word + subject + verb.

1. I’d like to know when the course begins.
Я хотел бы знать, когда начинается курс.

2. I’d like to know how much the tuition fee is.
Я хотел бы знать, сколько стоит обучение.

3. I’d like to know which documents I need.
Я хотел бы знать, какие документы мне нужны.

Формула 5

Do you know + if/whether + subject + verb?

1. Do you know if he is at home?
Вы знаете, дома ли он?

2. Do you know whether the office is open?
Вы знаете, открыт ли офис?

3. Do you know if they have arrived?
Вы знаете, прибыли ли они?

Формула 6

I wonder + if/whether + subject + verb.

1. I wonder if she likes this idea.
Интересно, нравится ли ей эта идея.

2. I wonder whether they will accept my application.
Интересно, примут ли они мою заявку.

3. I wonder if the result is correct.
Интересно, правильный ли результат.

8. Изменения в времени и вспомогательных глаголах

При переходе от прямого вопроса к косвенному вопросу do / does / did часто опускаются.

Почему?

Потому что в косвенном вопросе используется порядок слов утвердительного предложения, а не вопросительного.

Present Simple

Where does she work?
Где она работает?

Do you know where she works?
Вы знаете, где она работает?

Здесь does опущено, основной глагол — works.

Past Simple

What did he say?
Что он сказал?

Could you tell me what he said?
Не могли бы вы сказать, что он сказал?

Здесь did опущено, глагол — said.

Present Simple plural

Why do they study English?
Почему они изучают английский?

I wonder why they study English.
Интересно, почему они изучают английский.

Здесь do опущено.

15 примеров

1. Where does he work? → Do you know where he works?
Вы знаете, где он работает?

2. What does she need? → Could you tell me what she needs?
Не могли бы вы сказать, в чем она нуждается?

3. Why do they come late? → I wonder why they come late.
Интересно, почему они приходят поздно.

4. When does the lesson finish? → Do you know when the lesson finishes?
Вы знаете, когда заканчивается урок?

5. How does this program work? → Can you explain how this program works?
Не могли бы вы объяснить, как работает эта программа?

6. Where did he go? → Do you know where he went?
Вы знаете, куда он пошел?

7. What did she buy? → Could you tell me what she bought?
Не могли бы вы сказать, что она купила?

8. Why did they argue? → I wonder why they argued.
Интересно, почему они спорили.

9. When did you arrive? → Could you tell me when you arrived?
Не могли бы вы сказать, когда вы прибыли?

10. Which book did he choose? → Do you know which book he chose?
Вы знаете, какую книгу он выбрал?

11. Where is she studying? → Do you know where she is studying?
Вы знаете, где она учится?

12. What are they doing? → I wonder what they are doing.
Интересно, что они делают.

13. Why has he changed his plan? → Do you know why he has changed his plan?
Вы знаете, почему он изменил свой план?

14. When will they announce the results? → I’d like to know when they will announce the results.
Я хотел бы знать, когда они объявят результаты.

15. How can I contact the manager? → Could you tell me how I can contact the manager?
Не могли бы вы сказать, как я могу связаться с менеджером?

9. Пунктуация в Indirect Questions

В косвенном вопросе пунктуация зависит от вводной фразы в начале предложения.

1. Если предложение является настоящим вопросом, в конце ставится вопросительный знак.

Could you tell me where the station is?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится станция?

Это вопрос, поэтому в конце ставится ?.

2. Если предложение является утвердительным, в конце ставится точка.

I wonder where the station is.
Интересно, где находится станция.

Это утвердительное предложение, поэтому в конце ставится .

10 примеров

1. Could you tell me where the office is?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится офис?

2. Do you know when the test starts?
Вы знаете, когда начинается тест?

3. Would you mind telling me how I can register?
Не могли бы вы сказать, как я могу зарегистрироваться?

4. Can you explain why this rule is important?
Можете объяснить, почему это правило важно?

5. Could you tell me if the manager is available?
Не могли бы вы сказать, доступен ли менеджер?

6. I wonder where they are now.
Интересно, где они сейчас.

7. I’d like to know when the interview will begin.
Я хотел бы знать, когда начнется собеседование.

8. I’m not sure if this answer is correct.
Я не уверен, правильный ли этот ответ.

9. I wonder why he refused the offer.
Интересно, почему он отказался от предложения.

10. I’d like to know whether I can change my schedule.
Я хотел бы знать, могу ли я изменить свое расписание.

10. Разница между Indirect Questions и Reported Questions

Indirect Question

Indirect question — вежливый вопрос или желание узнать.

Could you tell me where he lives?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где он живет?

Reported Question

Reported question — передача вопроса, заданного кем-то другому человеку.

She asked where he lived.
Она спросила, где он живет.

Таблица

Direct question | Indirect question | Reported question | Перевод
Where does he live? | Could you tell me where he lives? | She asked where he lived. | Она спросила, где он живет.
What is your name? | Could you tell me what your name is? | He asked what my name was. | Он спросил, как меня зовут.
When does the class start? | Do you know when the class starts? | She asked when the class started. | Она спросила, когда начинается урок.
Why are you late? | Could you tell me why you are late? | The teacher asked why I was late. | Учитель спросил, почему я опоздал.
Did you finish the task? | Do you know if he finished the task? | He asked if I had finished the task. | Он спросил, закончил ли я задание.
Is she at home? | Do you know if she is at home? | He asked if she was at home. | Он спросил, дома ли она.
Where did they go? | Do you know where they went? | She asked where they had gone. | Она спросила, куда они ушли.
Can you help me? | I’d like to know if you can help me. | He asked if I could help him. | Он спросил, могу ли я ему помочь.
What are they doing? | I wonder what they are doing. | He asked what they were doing. | Он спросил, что они делают.
Will you come tomorrow? | Do you know whether he will come tomorrow? | She asked whether I would come the next day. | Она спросила, приду ли я на следующий день.

Важно:
В indirect question время не всегда меняется. В reported question время часто сдвигается назад:
is → was, do → did, will → would, can → could

11. Indirect Questions в официальной и повседневной речи

1. Спросить дорогу

1. Could you tell me where the nearest metro station is?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится ближайшая станция метро?

2. Do you know how I can get to the city center?
Вы знаете, как я могу добраться до центра города?

2. Спросить информацию

1. Could you tell me when the office closes?
Не могли бы вы сказать, когда закрывается офис?

2. Do you know if this service is free?
Вы знаете, бесплатна ли эта услуга?

3. Задать вопрос в университете

1. Could you explain how we should submit the assignment?
Не могли бы вы объяснить, как нам следует сдать задание?

2. I’d like to know whether we can choose our research topic.
Я хотел бы знать, можем ли мы выбрать тему нашего исследования.

4. Задать вопрос в гостинице

1. Could you tell me what time breakfast is served?
Не могли бы вы сказать, в какое время подают завтрак?

2. Do you know if there is a gym in the hotel?
Вы знаете, есть ли в гостинице спортзал?

5. Задать вопрос в аэропорту

1. Could you tell me where gate 12 is?
Не могли бы вы сказать, где находится выход 12?

2. Do you know whether the flight has been delayed?
Вы знаете, задержан ли рейс?

6. Задать вопрос на собеседовании

1. I’d like to know what responsibilities this position includes.
Я хотел бы знать, какие обязанности включает эта должность.

2. Could you tell me whether there is a training period?
Не могли бы вы сказать, есть ли испытательный срок?

7. Задать вопрос в письме

1. I’d like to know when the final decision will be made.
Я хотел бы знать, когда будет принято окончательное решение.

2. Could you please let me know whether my application has been received?
Не могли бы вы сообщить мне, была ли получена моя заявка?
grammar_rules_kk:
Indirect Question — bul savolni toğridan-toğri emes, biraq muloyimroq, rásmiyroq yamasa ehtiyotkorroq şekilde beriw usılı.

Direct Question nima?

Direct question — ápiwayı, toğridan-toğri savol.

Example:
Where is the bank?
Bank qay jerde?

Indirect Question nima?

Indirect question — savol aldınan kirisiw iborası kelip, hám gáp muloyimroq boladı.

Example:
Could you tell me where the bank is?
Banktiń qay jerde ekenin aytıp bere alasız ba?

Asosiy farq

Direct question’da odatda savol tartibi ishlatiladı:

Where is the bank?
Bank qay jerde?

Indirect question’da esa darak gáp tartibi ishlatiladı:

Could you tell me where the bank is?
Banktiń qay jerde ekenin aytıp bere alasız ba?

Indirect Questions nima üşin kerek?

Indirect questions odatda quyıdakı holatlarda ishlatiladı:

1. Muloyim savol beriw üşin

2. Rásmiy vaziyatlarda savol beriw üşin

3. Notanish odamdan ma’lumot so‘raw üşin

4. Email yamasa jumıs yozıwshılarda muloyim boliw üşin

5. Biror narsanı anıq bilmaslıgımızdı bildiriw üşin

10 ta sodda mısal

1. Where is the station?
Bekat qay jerde?

Could you tell me where the station is?
Bekat qayerdaligini aytıp bere alasız ba?

2. What time is it?
Soat neçchi?

Do you know what time it is?
Soat neçchi ekenin bilasız mı?

3. Where does he live?
U qay jerde yashaydı?

Do you know where he lives?
U qay jerde yashawıdı bilasız mı?

4. When does the lesson start?
Dars qashan başlanadı?

Could you tell me when the lesson starts?
Dars qashan başlanatın aytıp bere alasız mı?

5. Why is she upset?
U nege xafa?

I wonder why she is upset.
Men uning nege xafa ekenin bilmoqçiman.

6. How much does this book cost?
Bu kitap qancha turadı?

Could you tell me how much this book costs?
Bu kitap qancha turatın aytıp bere alasız mı?

7. Is the library open?
Kutubxona açıq mı?

Do you know if the library is open?
Kutubxona açıq mı yamasa yoq mı, bilasız mı?

8. Can he speak English?
U inglizçe gapira aladı mı?

I wonder if he can speak English.
Men u inglizçe gapira aladı mı yamasa yoq mı, bilmoqçiman.

9. Where did they go?
Ular qay jerge ketti?

Do you know where they went?
Ular qay jerge ketkenin bilasız mı?

10. What should I do?
Men nima qilishım kerek?

Could you tell me what I should do?
Men nima qilishım kerekligini aytıp bere alasız mı?

2. Direct Question va Indirect Question farqi

Direct question | Indirect question | Tarjima | Farqi
Where is the hospital? | Could you tell me where the hospital is? | Kasalxona qay jerde ekenin aytıp bere alasız mı? | “is” subjectdan keyin keldi.
What time does the train leave? | Do you know what time the train leaves? | Poyezd soat neçchide ketetin bilasız mı? | “does” tushdi, “leaves” ishlatıldı.
Where does she study? | Could you tell me where she studies? | U qay jerde oqıwın aytıp bere alasız mı? | “does” tushdi, “studies” keldi.
Why did he call you? | Do you know why he called you? | U nege sizge qońıraqlı bolğanını bilasız mı? | “did” tushdi, “called” ishlatıldı.
When is the exam? | I’d like to know when the exam is. | Imtihon qashan ekenin bilmoqçiman. | Gáp oxırında nuqta.
How much is this course? | Could you tell me how much this course is? | Bu kurs qancha turatın aytıp bere alasız mı? | Darak gáp tartibi.
Who is your teacher? | Do you know who your teacher is? | Oqıtıwşıñız kimligini bilasız mı? | “is” oxırğa yaqın keldi.
What did they discuss? | I wonder what they discussed. | Ular nimeni muhokama qilğanını bilmoqçiman. | “did” tushdi.
Is he ready? | Do you know if he is ready? | U tayyarmı yamasa yoq mı, bilasız mı? | Yes/No savolda “if” ishlatıldı.
Are they at school? | Could you tell me whether they are at school? | Ular mektepde mi yamasa yoq mı, aytıp bere alasız mı? | “whether” işlendi.
Can she drive? | Do you know if she can drive? | U maşına hayday aladı mı, bilasız mı? | Modal “can” subjectdan keyin keldi.
Where will you stay? | Could you tell me where you will stay? | Qay jerde qolıwıñızdı aytıp bere alasız mı? | “will” subjectdan keyin keldi.
What are you doing? | I wonder what you are doing. | Nima qilıp jatqanın bilmoqçiman. | “are” subjectdan keyin keldi.
Why has he left? | Do you know why he has left? | U nege ketkenin bilasız mı? | “has” subjectdan keyin keldi.
Which book did you choose? | Could you tell me which book you chose? | Qaysı kitapnı tanlaganıñızdı aytıp bere alasız mı? | “did” tushdi, “chose” ishlatıldı.

3. Indirect Questions ishlatiladigan asosiy kirish iboralari

1. Could you tell me…?

Bul ibora juda muloyim hám rásmiy sanaladı. Notanish odam, oqıtıwşı, xodım yamasa rásmiy şahsdan savol so‘rağanda ishlatiladı.

1. Could you tell me where the nearest bank is?
Eng yaqin bank qay jerde ekenin aytıp bere alasız mı?

2. Could you tell me when the meeting starts?
Uchrashuv qashan başlanatın aytıp bere alasız mı?

2. Do you know…?

Bul ibora kundalık nutqda kóbinese ishlatiladı. “Bilasız mı?” degen ma’noni beredi.

1. Do you know where Ali lives?
Ali qay jerde yashaydı bilasız mı?

2. Siz dars soat nechchida boshlanadi dep bilesizmi?
Dars soat nechchida boshlanadı dep bilesizmi?

3. Men qızıqtıram...

Bu ibora “Qızıqtı, bilmedim...” yamasa “Men bilmekçi bolam...” degan ma’noda qollanıladı. Kóbinese gáp axırında nuqta qoyıladı.

1. Men qızıqtıram, u nege kech qaldı?
Qızıqtı, u nege kech qoldı ekan.

2. Men qızıqtıram, ular qayerge ketti?
Qızıqtı, ular qayerga ketishdi ekan.

4. Men bilmekçi bolam...

Bu ibora “Men bilmekçi bolam” degan rásmiyroq ifoda.

1. Men bilmekçi bolam, ariza tapsırış muddatı qachon?
Ariza topshirish muddati qachonligini bilmoqchiman.

2. Men bilmekçi bolam, kurs qancha turadı?
Kurs qancha turishini bilmoqchiman.

5. Siz tushuntıra alasız mı...?

Bu ibora “Túsindiriwge boladı mı?” degan ma’noni beredi.

1. Siz nege bu javob xato dep tushuntıra alasız mı?
Nega bu javob xato ekanini tushuntirib bera olasız mı?

2. Siz bu qurılma qanday ishlaydı dep tushuntıra alasız mı?
Bu qurilma qanday ishlashini tushuntirib bera olasız mı?

6. Sizde biror kóz aldıńızǵa keltiriń...

Bu ibora “Sizde biror tasavvur barmi?” yamasa “Bilasız mı?” ma’nosında qollanıladı.

1. Sizde daftarım qayerde dep biror fikriniz barmi?
Daftarim qayerdaligi haqida biror fikringiz bormi?

2. Sizde dars nege bekor qılındı dep bilasız mı?
Dars nega bekor qilinganini bilasizmi?

7. Men ishonchim komil emes...

Bu ibora “Ishonchim komil emes” degan ma’noni bildiradi.

1. Men uning qayerde ishlaydı dep ishonchim komil emes.
Men uning qayerda ishlashına ishonchim komil emas.

2. Men ular tayyarmı yamasa yoq mı, anıq bilmeymin.
Men ular tayyormi yoki yo‘qmi, anıq bilmayman.

8. Sizge aytıp beriwge qarşı emespe...?

Bu juda muloyim hám rásmiy ibora. “Aytıp beriwge qarşı emespe?” degan ma’noda.

1. Siz menejerning xonası qayerde dep aytıp beriwge qarşı emespe?
Menejerning xonasi qayerdaligini aytib berishga qarshi emasmisiz?

2. Siz qanday ro‘yxatdan o‘tüwüm mümkin dep aytıp beriwge boladı mı?
Qanday ro‘yxatdan o‘tishim mumkinligini aytib bera olasız mı?

9. Siz tushuntıra alasız mı...?

Bu ham muloyim ibora. “Túsindiriwge boladı mı?” degan ma’noni beredi.

1. Siz bu qoida qanday ishlaydı dep tushuntıra alasız mı?
Bu qoida qanday ishlashini tushuntirib bera olasız mı?

2. Siz bu yerde nege “if” qollanadı dep tushuntıra alasız mı?
Bu yerda nega “if” ishlatishimizni tushuntirib bera olasız mı?

10. Men bilmekçi bolam...

Bu ibora ápiwayıraq. Ba’zan rásmiy vaziyatta bir az keskin eshitilidi. Sonlıqtan kóbinese ápiwayı suhbatlarda qollanıladı.

1. Men natijalarım qayerde dep bilmekçi bolam.
Men natijalarim qayerdaligini bilmoqchiman.

2. Men imtihondan o‘tkenimni bilmekçi bolam.
Men imtihondan o‘tgan-o‘tmaganimni bilmoqchiman.

4. Eng muhim qaǵıyda: indirect question’da so‘z tartibi özgeredi

Direct question’da savol tartibi qollanıladı:

U qayerde yashaydı?
U qayerda yashaydi?

Indirect question’da esa darak gáp tartibi qollanıladı:

Siz u qayerde yashaydı dep aytıp beriwge boladı mı?
U qayerda yashashını aytib bera olasız mı?

Asosiy formula

Savol sozi + subject + verb

Yaǵnıy:

where + he + lives
u qayerda yashashi

what + she + wants
u nimani xohlashi

when + they + arrived
ular qachon kelgani

Xato hám to‘g‘ri şekil

❌ Siz u qayerde yashaydı dep aytıp beriwge boladı mı?
Bu xato, çünki indirect question içinde “does he live” savol tartibi qolıp ketken.

✅ Siz u qayerde yashaydı dep aytıp beriwge boladı mı?
Bu to‘g‘ri, çünki “he lives” darak gáp tartibinde.

15 ta mısal

1. U qayerde yashaydı? → Siz u qayerde yashaydı dep aytıp beriwge boladı mı?
U qayerda yashashını aytib bera olasız mı?

2. U nimani xohlasa? → Siz u nimani xohlashını bilasız mı?
U nimani xohlashini bilasızmi?

3. Ular qachon kelipti? → Men qızıqtıram, ular qachon kelipti.
Qızıqtı, ular qachon kelishdi ekan.

4. U nege jahli chiqqan? → Siz u nega jahli chiqqanını bilasız mı?
U nega jahli chiqqanini bilasizmi?

5. Talabalar qayerde? → Siz talabalar qayerde dep aytıp beriwge boladı mı?
Talabalar qayerdaligini aytib bera olasız mı?

6. Bu ilova qanday ishlaydı? → Siz bu ilova qanday ishlaydı dep tushuntıra alasız mı?
Bu ilova qanday ishlashini tushuntirib bera olasız mı?

7. Oqıtıwshı nima dep aytqan? → Siz oqıtıwshı nima dep aytqanını bilasız mı?
O‘qituvchi nima deganini bilasizmi?

8. Imtihon qachon boshlanadı? → Men bilmekçi bolam, imtihon qachon boshlanadı.
Imtihon qachon boshlanishini bilmoqchiman.

9. Qayerden chipta satıp alıwım mümkin? → Siz qayerden chipta satıp alıwım mümkin dep aytıp beriwge boladı mı?
