grammar_rules:
1. Complex Clause nima?

Complex clause / complex sentence — bitta asosiy gap va bitta yoki undan ortiq qo‘shimcha gapdan tashkil topgan murakkab gap.

Masalan:

I stayed at home because it was raining.
Men uyda qoldim, chunki yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan edi.

Bu gapda:

I stayed at home — main clause, ya’ni asosiy gap.
because it was raining — subordinate clause, ya’ni qo‘shimcha gap.

Simple sentence, compound sentence va complex sentence farqi

Turi | Tuzilishi | Misol | Tarjima
Simple sentence | Bitta fikr | I study English. | Men ingliz tilini o‘rganaman.
Compound sentence | Ikkita teng fikr | I study English, and my brother studies Russian. | Men ingliz tilini o‘rganaman, akam esa rus tilini o‘rganadi.
Complex sentence | Asosiy gap + qo‘shimcha gap | I study English because I want to enter university. | Men universitetga kirishni xohlaganim uchun ingliz tilini o‘rganaman.

Main clause nima?

Main clause — mustaqil ma’no bera oladigan asosiy gap.

She passed the exam.
U imtihondan o‘tdi.

Bu gap yakka o‘zi ham to‘liq ma’no beradi.

Subordinate clause nima?

Subordinate clause — yakka o‘zi to‘liq ma’no bermaydigan qo‘shimcha gap. U odatda connector bilan boshlanadi.

because she studied hard
chunki u qattiq o‘qidi

Bu qism yakka o‘zi to‘liq gap emas. Unga asosiy gap kerak:

She passed the exam because she studied hard.
U qattiq o‘qigani uchun imtihondan o‘tdi.

10 ta misol

1. I stayed at home because I was tired.
Men charchagan edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim.

2. She smiled when she saw her result.
U natijasini ko‘rganda tabassum qildi.

3. Although the test was difficult, he passed it.
Test qiyin bo‘lsa ham, u undan o‘tdi.

4. If you work hard, you will succeed.
Agar qattiq ishlasangiz, muvaffaqiyatga erishasiz.

5. I will call you after I finish the lesson.
Darsni tugatganimdan keyin sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

6. She studies every day so that she can improve her English.
U ingliz tilini yaxshilashi uchun har kuni o‘qiydi.

7. He did not come to class because he was ill.
U kasal bo‘lgani uchun darsga kelmadi.

8. We waited until the teacher arrived.
Biz o‘qituvchi kelguncha kutdik.

9. Even though it was late, they continued studying.
Kech bo‘lsa ham, ular o‘qishda davom etishdi.

10. As soon as I get home, I will send you the file.
Uyga yetib borishim bilan sizga faylni yuboraman.

2. Connectors nima?

Connectors — gaplar, fikrlar yoki gap bo‘laklarini bog‘laydigan so‘zlar.

Ular fikrlar orasidagi munosabatni ko‘rsatadi:

Turi | Ma’nosi | Misol
Reason | Sabab | because, since, as
Result | Natija | so, therefore, as a result
Contrast | Qarama-qarshilik | although, but, however
Condition | Shart | if, unless, as long as
Time | Vaqt | when, before, after
Purpose | Maqsad | to, in order to, so that
Addition | Qo‘shimcha fikr | and, also, moreover
Conclusion | Xulosa | in conclusion, overall

3. Connectors turlari

A) Reason / Sabab connectors

1. Because

Ma’nosi: chunki, sababli
Formula:
Main clause + because + subject + verb

1. I went to bed early because I was tired.
Men charchaganim uchun erta uxladim.

2. She passed the exam because she studied hard.
U qattiq o‘qigani uchun imtihondan o‘tdi.

2. Since

Ma’nosi: chunki, sababli
Formula:
Since + subject + verb, main clause

1. Since it was raining, we stayed at home.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgani uchun biz uyda qoldik.

2. Since he knows English well, he can help us.
U ingliz tilini yaxshi bilgani uchun bizga yordam bera oladi.

3. As

Ma’nosi: chunki, sababli
Formula:
As + subject + verb, main clause

1. As I was busy, I could not call you.
Band bo‘lganim uchun sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qila olmadim.

2. As the test was difficult, many students made mistakes.
Test qiyin bo‘lgani uchun ko‘p o‘quvchilar xato qilishdi.

4. Because of

Ma’nosi: sababli, tufayli
Formula:
because of + noun / pronoun / V-ing

1. The match was cancelled because of the rain.
Yomg‘ir tufayli o‘yin bekor qilindi.

2. He was tired because of working all day.
U kun bo‘yi ishlagani tufayli charchagan edi.

5. Due to

Ma’nosi: sababli, tufayli
Formula:
due to + noun / pronoun / V-ing

1. The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
Yomon ob-havo tufayli reys kechiktirildi.

2. The lesson was cancelled due to the teacher’s illness.
O‘qituvchining kasalligi tufayli dars bekor qilindi.

B) Result / Natija connectors

1. So

Ma’nosi: shuning uchun
Formula:
Cause + so + result

1. It was cold, so I closed the window.
Havo sovuq edi, shuning uchun men derazani yopdim.

2. She studied hard, so she passed the exam.
U qattiq o‘qidi, shuning uchun imtihondan o‘tdi.

2. Therefore

Ma’nosi: shuning uchun, demak
Formula:
Sentence. Therefore, sentence.

1. He did not study. Therefore, he failed the test.
U o‘qimadi. Shuning uchun u testdan yiqildi.

2. The price is too high. Therefore, we cannot buy it.
Narx juda baland. Shuning uchun biz uni sotib ololmaymiz.

3. As a result

Ma’nosi: natijada
Formula:
Sentence. As a result, sentence.

1. He trained every day. As a result, he won the competition.
U har kuni mashq qildi. Natijada, musobaqada g‘olib bo‘ldi.

2. The students practised a lot. As a result, their speaking improved.
Talabalar ko‘p mashq qilishdi. Natijada, ularning gapirish ko‘nikmasi yaxshilandi.

4. That’s why

Ma’nosi: shuning uchun, ana shuning uchun
Formula:
Reason. That’s why + result.

1. I was ill. That’s why I missed the lesson.
Men kasal edim. Shuning uchun darsni qoldirdim.

2. He worked very hard. That’s why he succeeded.
U juda qattiq ishladi. Shuning uchun muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.

5. Consequently

Ma’nosi: natijada, oqibatda
Formula:
Sentence. Consequently, sentence.

1. The company lost money. Consequently, it reduced salaries.
Kompaniya pul yo‘qotdi. Natijada, u maoshlarni kamaytirdi.

2. Many students were absent. Consequently, the exam was postponed.
Ko‘p talabalar yo‘q edi. Natijada, imtihon qoldirildi.

C) Contrast / Qarama-qarshilik connectors

1. But

Ma’nosi: lekin
Formula:
Sentence + but + sentence

1. The test was difficult, but I passed it.
Test qiyin edi, lekin men undan o‘tdim.

2. She is young, but she is very responsible.
U yosh, lekin juda mas’uliyatli.

2. Although

Ma’nosi: garchi, -ga qaramay
Formula:
Although + subject + verb, main clause

1. Although it was raining, we went out.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan bo‘lsa ham, biz tashqariga chiqdik.

2. Although he was tired, he continued working.
U charchagan bo‘lsa ham, ishlashda davom etdi.

3. Though

Ma’nosi: garchi, bo‘lsa ham
Formula:
Though + subject + verb, main clause

1. Though the task was hard, she finished it.
Vazifa qiyin bo‘lsa ham, u uni tugatdi.

2. Though he was late, the teacher allowed him to enter.
U kech qolgan bo‘lsa ham, o‘qituvchi unga kirishga ruxsat berdi.

4. Even though

Ma’nosi: hatto ... bo‘lsa ham
Formula:
Even though + subject + verb, main clause

1. Even though he was ill, he came to the exam.
U kasal bo‘lsa ham, imtihonga keldi.

2. Even though the course was expensive, many students joined it.
Kurs qimmat bo‘lsa ham, ko‘p talabalar unga qo‘shildi.

5. However

Ma’nosi: biroq, ammo
Formula:
Sentence. However, sentence.

1. The task was difficult. However, we completed it.
Vazifa qiyin edi. Biroq, biz uni tugatdik.

2. He wanted to travel. However, he did not have enough money.
U sayohat qilishni xohladi. Biroq, unda yetarli pul yo‘q edi.

6. Nevertheless

Ma’nosi: shunga qaramay
Formula:
Sentence. Nevertheless, sentence.

1. The weather was bad. Nevertheless, they continued the game.
Ob-havo yomon edi. Shunga qaramay, ular o‘yinni davom ettirishdi.

2. The project was challenging. Nevertheless, the team finished it on time.
Loyiha qiyin edi. Shunga qaramay, jamoa uni vaqtida tugatdi.

7. Despite

Ma’nosi: -ga qaramay
Formula:
despite + noun / V-ing

1. Despite the rain, we went out.
Yomg‘irga qaramay, biz tashqariga chiqdik.

2. Despite being tired, he continued studying.
Charchaganiga qaramay, u o‘qishda davom etdi.

8. In spite of

Ma’nosi: -ga qaramay
Formula:
in spite of + noun / V-ing

1. In spite of the noise, I could concentrate.
Shovqinga qaramay, men diqqatimni jamlay oldim.

2. In spite of having little time, she finished the essay.
Vaqti kam bo‘lishiga qaramay, u esseni tugatdi.

D) Condition / Shart connectors

1. If

Ma’nosi: agar
Formula:
If + subject + verb, main clause

1. If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
Agar qattiq o‘qisangiz, imtihondan o‘tasiz.

2. If it rains, we will stay at home.
Agar yomg‘ir yog‘sa, biz uyda qolamiz.

2. Unless

Ma’nosi: agar ... bo‘lmasa
Formula:
Unless + subject + verb, main clause

1. Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
Agar shoshilmasangiz, avtobusdan qolib ketasiz.

2. Unless he studies, he will fail the test.
Agar u o‘qimasa, testdan yiqiladi.

3. Provided that

Ma’nosi: sharti bilan, agar
Formula:
Provided that + subject + verb, main clause

1. You can join the course provided that you register today.
Bugun ro‘yxatdan o‘tsangiz, kursga qo‘shila olasiz.

2. We will accept your application provided that all documents are complete.
Barcha hujjatlar to‘liq bo‘lsa, arizangizni qabul qilamiz.

4. As long as

Ma’nosi: modomiki, sharti bilan
Formula:
As long as + subject + verb, main clause

1. You can use my laptop as long as you return it today.
Bugun qaytarib bersangiz, noutbukimdan foydalanishingiz mumkin.

2. You will improve as long as you practise every day.
Har kuni mashq qilsangiz, rivojlanasiz.

E) Time / Vaqt connectors

1. When

Ma’nosi: qachonki, -ganda
Formula:
When + subject + verb, main clause

1. When I arrived, the lesson had already started.
Men kelganimda, dars allaqachon boshlangan edi.

2. Call me when you get home.
Uyga yetib borganingizda menga qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.

2. While

Ma’nosi: paytida, davomida
Formula:
While + subject + verb, main clause

1. While I was reading, my brother was watching TV.
Men o‘qiyotganimda, ukam televizor ko‘rayotgan edi.

2. She listened to music while she was doing homework.
U uy vazifasini qilayotganida musiqa tingladi.

3. Before

Ma’nosi: oldin
Formula:
Before + subject + verb, main clause

1. Before you answer, read the question carefully.
Javob berishdan oldin savolni diqqat bilan o‘qing.

2. I checked my essay before I submitted it.
Men esseni topshirishdan oldin uni tekshirdim.

4. After

Ma’nosi: keyin
Formula:
After + subject + verb, main clause

1. After the lesson ended, we discussed the homework.
Dars tugagandan keyin biz uy vazifasini muhokama qildik.

2. I felt better after I drank some water.
Suv ichganimdan keyin o‘zimni yaxshi his qildim.

5. As soon as

Ma’nosi: bilanoq
Formula:
As soon as + subject + verb, main clause

1. As soon as I finish the task, I will send it to you.
Vazifani tugatishim bilan uni sizga yuboraman.

2. As soon as he arrived, the meeting started.
U kelishi bilan uchrashuv boshlandi.

6. Until

Ma’nosi: -gacha
Formula:
Main clause + until + subject + verb

1. We waited until the teacher came.
Biz o‘qituvchi kelguncha kutdik.

2. Do not leave until I call you.
Men qo‘ng‘iroq qilmagunimcha ketmang.

7. By the time

Ma’nosi: -gunga qadar, -gan paytga kelib
Formula:
By the time + subject + verb, main clause

1. By the time we arrived, the film had started.
Biz yetib kelgunimizcha film boshlangan edi.

2. By the time he finishes school, he will know English well.
U maktabni tugatguniga qadar ingliz tilini yaxshi biladi.

F) Purpose / Maqsad connectors

1. To

Ma’nosi: uchun
Formula:
to + verb

1. I study English to enter university.
Men universitetga kirish uchun ingliz tilini o‘rganaman.

2. She went to the library to borrow a book.
U kitob olish uchun kutubxonaga bordi.

2. In order to

Ma’nosi: maqsadida, uchun
Formula:
in order to + verb

1. He studies every day in order to pass the exam.
U imtihondan o‘tish uchun har kuni o‘qiydi.

2. We arrived early in order to get good seats.
Yaxshi joy olish uchun biz erta keldik.

3. So as to

Ma’nosi: maqsadida, uchun
Formula:
so as to + verb

1. She spoke quietly so as not to wake the baby.
U chaqaloqni uyg‘otmaslik uchun sekin gapirdi.

2. He saved money so as to buy a new laptop.
U yangi noutbuk sotib olish uchun pul yig‘di.

4. So that

Ma’nosi: shunday qilsinki, uchun
Formula:
so that + subject + can/could/will/would + verb

1. I wrote the instructions clearly so that everyone could understand them.
Hamma tushunishi uchun men ko‘rsatmalarni aniq yozdim.

2. She studies hard so that she can get a scholarship.
U stipendiya olishi uchun qattiq o‘qiydi.

G) Addition / Qo‘shimcha fikr connectors

1. And

Ma’nosi: va
Formula:
word/sentence + and + word/sentence

1. I study English and my sister studies biology.
Men ingliz tilini o‘rganaman va singlim biologiyani o‘rganadi.

2. He opened the book and started reading.
U kitobni ochdi va o‘qishni boshladi.

2. Also

Ma’nosi: ham, shuningdek
Formula:
subject + also + verb

1. She speaks English. She also speaks Russian.
U ingliz tilida gapiradi. U rus tilida ham gapiradi.

2. This course teaches grammar. It also improves speaking skills.
Bu kurs grammatika o‘rgatadi. U gapirish ko‘nikmasini ham yaxshilaydi.

3. Moreover

Ma’nosi: bundan tashqari
Formula:
Sentence. Moreover, sentence.

1. The course is useful. Moreover, it is affordable.
Kurs foydali. Bundan tashqari, u arzon.

2. He is talented. Moreover, he works very hard.
U iqtidorli. Bundan tashqari, u juda qattiq ishlaydi.

4. Furthermore

Ma’nosi: bundan tashqari, yana
Formula:
Sentence. Furthermore, sentence.

1. The method is simple. Furthermore, it is effective.
Metod sodda. Bundan tashqari, u samarali.

2. The school has modern classrooms. Furthermore, it has experienced teachers.
Maktabda zamonaviy sinfxonalar bor. Bundan tashqari, unda tajribali o‘qituvchilar bor.

5. In addition

Ma’nosi: qo‘shimcha ravishda
Formula:
Sentence. In addition, sentence.

1. The hotel is clean. In addition, it is close to the airport.
Mehmonxona toza. Qo‘shimcha ravishda, u aeroportga yaqin.

2. The book explains grammar. In addition, it gives useful exercises.
Kitob grammatikani tushuntiradi. Qo‘shimcha ravishda, foydali mashqlar beradi.

H) Conclusion / Xulosa connectors

1. In conclusion

Ma’nosi: xulosa qilib aytganda
Formula:
In conclusion, sentence.

1. In conclusion, connectors make our speech clearer.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, connectorlar nutqimizni aniqroq qiladi.

2. In conclusion, regular practice is necessary for success.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, muvaffaqiyat uchun muntazam mashq zarur.

2. To sum up

Ma’nosi: qisqacha aytganda
Formula:
To sum up, sentence.

1. To sum up, complex sentences help us express ideas better.
Qisqacha aytganda, murakkab gaplar fikrlarni yaxshiroq ifodalashga yordam beradi.

2. To sum up, both grammar and vocabulary are important.
Qisqacha aytganda, grammatika ham, lug‘at ham muhim.

3. Overall

Ma’nosi: umuman olganda
Formula:
Overall, sentence.

1. Overall, the lesson was useful.
Umuman olganda, dars foydali bo‘ldi.

2. Overall, students made good progress.
Umuman olganda, talabalar yaxshi rivojlanishdi.

4. In short

Ma’nosi: qisqasi
Formula:
In short, sentence.

1. In short, connectors connect ideas.
Qisqasi, connectorlar fikrlarni bog‘laydi.

2. In short, practice makes grammar easier.
Qisqasi, mashq grammatikani osonlashtiradi.

4. Eng muhim farqlar

Because vs Because of

Connector | Keyin nima keladi? | Misol | Tarjima
because | subject + verb | I stayed home because I was ill. | Men kasal bo‘lganim uchun uyda qoldim.
because of | noun / V-ing | I stayed home because of my illness. | Kasalligim sababli uyda qoldim.

Although vs However

Connector | Joylashuvi | Misol | Tarjima
although | Bitta gap ichida | Although it was late, we continued. | Kech bo‘lsa ham, davom etdik.
however | Odatda yangi gap boshida | It was late. However, we continued. | Kech edi. Biroq, davom etdik.

Despite vs Although

Connector | Keyin nima keladi? | Misol | Tarjima
although | subject + verb | Although he was tired, he studied. | U charchagan bo‘lsa ham, o‘qidi.
despite | noun / V-ing | Despite being tired, he studied. | Charchaganiga qaramay, u o‘qidi.

So vs Because

Connector | Vazifasi | Misol | Tarjima
because | sababni bildiradi | I stayed home because I was ill. | Men kasal bo‘lganim uchun uyda qoldim.
so | natijani bildiradi | I was ill, so I stayed home. | Men kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim.

Until vs By the time

Connector | Ma’nosi | Misol | Tarjima
until | bir vaqtgacha davom etish | We waited until he came. | U kelguncha kutdik.
by the time | ma’lum vaqtga kelib ish tugagan bo‘ladi | By the time he came, we had finished. | U kelguniga qadar biz tugatgan edik.

If vs Unless

Connector | Ma’nosi | Misol | Tarjima
if | agar | If you study, you will pass. | Agar o‘qisangiz, o‘tasiz.
unless | agar ... bo‘lmasa | Unless you study, you will fail. | Agar o‘qimasangiz, yiqilasiz.

5. Complex sentence tuzish qoidalari

1-qoida

Main clause + connector + subordinate clause

Bu holatda odatda vergul qo‘yilmaydi.

I stayed at home because I was tired.
Men charchaganim uchun uyda qoldim.

2-qoida

Connector + subordinate clause, main clause

Connector gap boshida kelsa, subordinate clause’dan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi.

Because I was tired, I stayed at home.
Charchaganim uchun men uyda qoldim.

10 ta misol

1. I passed the exam because I studied hard.
Men qattiq o‘qiganim uchun imtihondan o‘tdim.

2. Because I studied hard, I passed the exam.
Qattiq o‘qiganim uchun imtihondan o‘tdim.

3. She went out although it was raining.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan bo‘lsa ham, u tashqariga chiqdi.

4. Although it was raining, she went out.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan bo‘lsa ham, u tashqariga chiqdi.

5. You will succeed if you practise every day.
Har kuni mashq qilsangiz, muvaffaqiyatga erishasiz.

6. If you practise every day, you will succeed.
Agar har kuni mashq qilsangiz, muvaffaqiyatga erishasiz.

7. I will call you when I arrive.
Yetib borganimda sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

8. When I arrive, I will call you.
Men yetib borganimda, sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

9. He saved money so that he could buy a laptop.
U noutbuk sotib olishi uchun pul yig‘di.

10. After the lesson finished, we went home.
Dars tugagandan keyin biz uyga ketdik.
grammar_rules_en:
1. What is a complex clause?

A complex clause / complex sentence is a sentence made of one main clause and one or more subordinate clauses.

For example:

I stayed at home because it was raining.
I stayed at home, because it was raining.

In this sentence:

I stayed at home — the main clause, that is, the main clause.
because it was raining — the subordinate clause, that is, the subordinate clause.

The difference between simple sentence, compound sentence and complex sentence

Type | Structure | Example | Translation
Simple sentence | One idea | I study English. | I study English.
Compound sentence | Two equal ideas | I study English, and my brother studies Russian. | I study English, and my brother studies Russian.
Complex sentence | Main clause + subordinate clause | I study English because I want to enter university. | I study English because I want to enter university.

What is a main clause?

A main clause is a clause that can stand alone and convey a complete meaning.

She passed the exam.
She passed the exam.

This sentence can stand alone and conveys a complete meaning.

What is a subordinate clause?

A subordinate clause is a clause that does not convey a complete meaning on its own. It usually starts with a connector.

because she studied hard
because she studied hard

This part does not form a complete sentence on its own. It needs a main clause:

She passed the exam because she studied hard.
She passed the exam because she studied hard.

10 examples

1. I stayed at home because I was tired.
I stayed at home because I was tired.

2. She smiled when she saw her result.
She smiled when she saw her result.

3. Although the test was difficult, he passed it.
Although the test was difficult, he passed it.

4. If you work hard, you will succeed.
If you work hard, you will succeed.

5. I will call you after I finish the lesson.
I will call you after I finish the lesson.

6. She studies every day so that she can improve her English.
She studies every day so that she can improve her English.

7. He did not come to class because he was ill.
He did not come to class because he was ill.

8. We waited until the teacher arrived.
We waited until the teacher arrived.

9. Even though it was late, they continued studying.
Even though it was late, they continued studying.

10. As soon as I get home, I will send you the file.
As soon as I get home, I will send you the file.

2. What are connectors?

Connectors are words that link sentences, ideas, or clauses.

They show the relationship between ideas:

Type | Meaning | Example
Reason | Cause | because, since, as
Result | Result | so, therefore, as a result
Contrast | Contrast | although, but, however
Condition | Condition | if, unless, as long as
Time | Time | when, before, after
Purpose | Purpose | to, in order to, so that
Addition | Additional idea | and, also, moreover
Conclusion | Conclusion | in conclusion, overall

3. Types of connectors

A) Reason connectors

1. Because

Meaning: because
Formula:
Main clause + because + subject + verb

1. I went to bed early because I was tired.
I went to bed early because I was tired.

2. She passed the exam because she studied hard.
She passed the exam because she studied hard.

2. Since

Meaning: because
Formula:
Since + subject + verb, main clause

1. Since it was raining, we stayed at home.
Since it was raining, we stayed at home.

2. Since he knows English well, he can help us.
Since he knows English well, he can help us.

3. As

Meaning: because
Formula:
As + subject + verb, main clause

1. As I was busy, I could not call you.
As I was busy, I could not call you.

2. As the test was difficult, many students made mistakes.
As the test was difficult, many students made mistakes.

4. Because of

Meaning: because of
Formula:
because of + noun / pronoun / V-ing

1. The match was cancelled because of the rain.
The match was cancelled because of the rain.

2. He was tired because of working all day.
He was tired because of working all day.

5. Due to

Meaning: due to
Formula:
due to + noun / pronoun / V-ing

1. The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
The flight was delayed due to bad weather.

2. The lesson was cancelled due to the teacher’s illness.
The lesson was cancelled due to the teacher’s illness.

B) Result connectors

1. So

Meaning: so
Formula:
Cause + so + result

1. It was cold, so I closed the window.
It was cold, so I closed the window.

2. She studied hard, so she passed the exam.
She studied hard, so she passed the exam.

2. Therefore

Meaning: therefore
Formula:
Sentence. Therefore, sentence.

1. He did not study. Therefore, he failed the test.
He did not study. Therefore, he failed the test.

2. The price is too high. Therefore, we cannot buy it.
The price is too high. Therefore, we cannot buy it.

3. As a result

Meaning: as a result
Formula:
Sentence. As a result, sentence.

1. He trained every day. As a result, he won the competition.
He trained every day — the main clause. As a result, he won the competition — the subordinate clause.

2. The students practised a lot. As a result, their speaking improved.
The students practised a lot — the main clause. As a result, their speaking improved — the subordinate clause.

4. That’s why

Meaning: that's why
Formula:
Reason. That’s why + result.

1. I was ill. That’s why I missed the lesson.
I was ill — the main clause. That’s why I missed the lesson — the subordinate clause.

2. He worked very hard. That’s why he succeeded.
He worked very hard — the main clause. That’s why he succeeded — the subordinate clause.

5. Consequently

Meaning: consequently, as a result
Formula:
Sentence. Consequently, sentence.

1. The company lost money. Consequently, it reduced salaries.
The company lost money — the main clause. Consequently, it reduced salaries — the subordinate clause.

2. Many students were absent. Consequently, the exam was postponed.
Many students were absent — the main clause. Consequently, the exam was postponed — the subordinate clause.

C) Contrast / Contrast connectors

1. But

Meaning: but
Formula:
Sentence + but + sentence

1. The test was difficult, but I passed it.
The test was difficult — the main clause. But I passed it — the subordinate clause.

2. She is young, but she is very responsible.
She is young — the main clause. But she is very responsible — the subordinate clause.

2. Although

Meaning: although, even though
Formula:
Although + subject + verb, main clause

1. Although it was raining, we went out.
Although it was raining — the subordinate clause. We went out — the main clause.

2. Although he was tired, he continued working.
Although he was tired — the subordinate clause. He continued working — the main clause.

3. Though

Meaning: although, even though
Formula:
Though + subject + verb, main clause

1. Though the task was hard, she finished it.
Though the task was hard — the subordinate clause. She finished it — the main clause.

2. Though he was late, the teacher allowed him to enter.
Though he was late — the subordinate clause. The teacher allowed him to enter — the main clause.

4. Even though

Meaning: even though
Formula:
Even though + subject + verb, main clause

1. Even though he was ill, he came to the exam.
Even though he was ill — the subordinate clause. He came to the exam — the main clause.

2. Even though the course was expensive, many students joined it.
Even though the course was expensive — the subordinate clause. Many students joined it — the main clause.

5. However

Meaning: however, but
Formula:
Sentence. However, sentence.

1. The task was difficult. However, we completed it.
The task was difficult — the main clause. However, we completed it — the subordinate clause.

2. He wanted to travel. However, he did not have enough money.
He wanted to travel — the main clause. However, he did not have enough money — the subordinate clause.

6. Nevertheless

Meaning: nevertheless
Formula:
Sentence. Nevertheless, sentence.

1. The weather was bad. Nevertheless, they continued the game.
The weather was bad — the main clause. Nevertheless, they continued the game — the subordinate clause.

2. The project was challenging. Nevertheless, the team finished it on time.
The project was challenging — the main clause. Nevertheless, the team finished it on time — the subordinate clause.

7. Despite

Meaning: despite
Formula:
despite + noun / V-ing

1. Despite the rain, we went out.
Despite the rain — the subordinate clause. We went out — the main clause.

2. Despite being tired, he continued studying.
Despite being tired — the subordinate clause. He continued studying — the main clause.

8. In spite of

Meaning: in spite of
Formula:
in spite of + noun / V-ing

1. In spite of the noise, I could concentrate.
In spite of the noise — the subordinate clause. I could concentrate — the main clause.

2. In spite of having little time, she finished the essay.
In spite of having little time — the subordinate clause. She finished the essay — the main clause.

D) Condition / Condition connectors

1. If

Meaning: if
Formula:
If + subject + verb, main clause

1. If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
If you study hard — the subordinate clause. You will pass the exam — the main clause.

2. If it rains, we will stay at home.
If it rains — the subordinate clause. We will stay at home — the main clause.

2. Unless

Meaning: unless
Formula:
Unless + subject + verb, main clause

1. Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
Unless you hurry — the subordinate clause. You will miss the bus — the main clause.

2. Unless he studies, he will fail the test.
Unless he studies — the subordinate clause. He will fail the test — the main clause.

3. Provided that

Meaning: provided that
Formula:
Provided that + subject + verb, main clause

1. You can join the course provided that you register today.
You can join the course — the main clause. Provided that you register today — the subordinate clause.

2. We will accept your application provided that all documents are complete.
We will accept your application — the main clause. Provided that all documents are complete — the subordinate clause.

4. As long as

Meaning: as long as
Formula:
As long as + subject + verb, main clause

1. You can use my laptop as long as you return it today.
You can use my laptop — the main clause. As long as you return it today — the subordinate clause.

2. You will improve as long as you practise every day.
You will improve — the main clause. As long as you practise every day — the subordinate clause.

E) Time / Time connectors

1. When

Meaning: when
Formula:
When + subject + verb, main clause

1. When I arrived, the lesson had already started.
When I arrived — the subordinate clause. The lesson had already started — the main clause.

2. Call me when you get home.
Call me — the main clause. When you get home — the subordinate clause.

2. While

Meaning: while
Formula:
While + subject + verb, main clause

1. While I was reading, my brother was watching TV.
While I was reading — the subordinate clause. My brother was watching TV — the main clause.

2. She listened to music while she was doing homework.
She listened to music — the main clause. while she was doing homework — the subordinate clause.

3. Before

Meaning: earlier
Formula:
Before + subject + verb, main clause

1. Before you answer, read the question carefully.
Before you answer — the subordinate clause. read the question carefully — the main clause.

2. I checked my essay before I submitted it.
I checked my essay — the main clause. before I submitted it — the subordinate clause.

4. After

Meaning: later
Formula:
After + subject + verb, main clause

1. After the lesson ended, we discussed the homework.
After the lesson ended — the subordinate clause. we discussed the homework — the main clause.

2. I felt better after I drank some water.
I felt better — the main clause. after I drank some water — the subordinate clause.

5. As soon as

Meaning: immediately
Formula:
As soon as + subject + verb, main clause

1. As soon as I finish the task, I will send it to you.
As soon as I finish the task — the subordinate clause. I will send it to you — the main clause.

2. As soon as he arrived, the meeting started.
As soon as he arrived — the subordinate clause. the meeting started — the main clause.

6. Until

Meaning: until
Formula:
Main clause + until + subject + verb

1. We waited until the teacher came.
We waited — the main clause. until the teacher came — the subordinate clause.

2. Do not leave until I call you.
Do not leave — the main clause. until I call you — the subordinate clause.

7. By the time

Meaning: by the time
Formula:
By the time + subject + verb, main clause

1. By the time we arrived, the film had started.
By the time we arrived — the subordinate clause. the film had started — the main clause.

2. By the time he finishes school, he will know English well.
By the time he finishes school — the subordinate clause. he will know English well — the main clause.

F) Purpose / Purpose connectors

1. To

Meaning: for
Formula:
to + verb

1. I study English to enter university.
I study English — the main clause. to enter university — the purpose clause.

2. She went to the library to borrow a book.
She went to the library — the main clause. to borrow a book — the purpose clause.

2. In order to

Meaning: in order to, for
Formula:
in order to + verb

1. He studies every day in order to pass the exam.
He studies every day — the main clause. in order to pass the exam — the purpose clause.

2. We arrived early in order to get good seats.
We arrived early — the main clause. in order to get good seats — the purpose clause.

3. So as to

Meaning: in order to, for
Formula:
so as to + verb

1. She spoke quietly so as not to wake the baby.
She spoke quietly — the main clause. so as not to wake the baby — the purpose clause.

2. He saved money so as to buy a new laptop.
He saved money — the main clause. so as to buy a new laptop — the purpose clause.

4. So that

Meaning: so that, for
Formula:
so that + subject + can/could/will/would + verb

1. I wrote the instructions clearly so that everyone could understand them.
I wrote the instructions clearly — the main clause. so that everyone could understand them — the purpose clause.

2. She studies hard so that she can get a scholarship.
She studies hard — the main clause. so that she can get a scholarship — the purpose clause.

G) Addition / Additional connectors

1. And

Meaning: and
Formula:
word/sentence + and + word/sentence

1. I study English and my sister studies biology.
I study English — the first clause. and my sister studies biology — the second clause.

2. He opened the book and started reading.
He opened the book — the first clause. and started reading — the second clause.

2. Also

Meaning: also, as well
Formula:
subject + also + verb

1. She speaks English. She also speaks Russian.
She speaks English — the first clause. She also speaks Russian — the second clause.

2. This course teaches grammar. It also improves speaking skills.
This course teaches grammar — the first clause. It also improves speaking skills — the second clause.

3. Moreover

Meaning: moreover
Formula:
Sentence. Moreover, sentence.

1. The course is useful. Moreover, it is affordable.
The course is useful — the first clause. Moreover, it is affordable — the second clause.

2. He is talented. Moreover, he works very hard.
He is talented — the first clause. Moreover, he works very hard — the second clause.

4. Furthermore

Meaning: furthermore, additionally
Formula:
Sentence. Furthermore, sentence.

1. The method is simple. Furthermore, it is effective.
The method is simple — the first clause. Furthermore, it is effective — the second clause.

2. The school has modern classrooms. Furthermore, it has experienced teachers.
The school has modern classrooms — the first clause. Furthermore, it has experienced teachers — the second clause.

5. In addition

Meaning: additionally
Formula:
Sentence. In addition, sentence.

1. The hotel is clean. In addition, it is close to the airport.
The hotel is clean — the first clause. In addition, it is close to the airport — the second clause.

2. The book explains grammar. In addition, it gives useful exercises.
The book explains grammar — the first clause. In addition, it gives useful exercises — the second clause.

H) Conclusion / Conclusion connectors

1. In conclusion

Meaning: in conclusion
Formula:
In conclusion, sentence.

1. In conclusion, connectors make our speech clearer.
In conclusion, connectors make our speech clearer — the main clause.

2. In conclusion, regular practice is necessary for success.
In conclusion, regular practice is necessary for success — the main clause.

2. To sum up

Meaning: to summarize
Formula:
To sum up, sentence.

1. To sum up, complex sentences help us express ideas better.
To sum up, complex sentences help us express ideas better — the main clause.

2. To sum up, both grammar and vocabulary are important.
To sum up, both grammar and vocabulary are important — the main clause.

3. Overall

Meaning: overall
Formula:
Overall, sentence.

1. Overall, the lesson was useful.
Overall, the lesson was useful — the main clause.

2. Overall, students made good progress.
Overall, students made good progress.

4. In short

Meaning: in summary
Formula:
In short, sentence.

1. In short, connectors connect ideas.
In short, connectors connect ideas.

2. In short, practice makes grammar easier.
In short, practice makes grammar easier.

4. The most important differences

Because vs Because of

Connector | What comes next? | Example | Translation
because | subject + verb | I stayed home because I was ill. | Men kasal bo‘lganim uchun uyda qoldim.
because of | noun / V-ing | I stayed home because of my illness. | Kasalligim sababli uyda qoldim.

Although vs However

Connector | Position | Example | Translation
although | In one sentence | Although it was late, we continued. | Kech bo‘lsa ham, davom etdik.
however | Usually at the beginning of a new sentence | It was late. However, we continued. | Kech edi. Biroq, davom etdik.

Despite vs Although

Connector | What comes next? | Example | Translation
although | subject + verb | Although he was tired, he studied. | U charchagan bo‘lsa ham, o‘qidi.
despite | noun / V-ing | Despite being tired, he studied. | Charchaganiga qaramay, u o‘qidi.

So vs Because

Connector | Function | Example | Translation
because | indicates reason | I stayed home because I was ill. | Men kasal bo‘lganim uchun uyda qoldim.
so | indicates result | I was ill, so I stayed home. | Men kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim.

Until vs By the time

Connector | Meaning | Example | Translation
until | continues until a certain time | We waited until he came. | U kelguncha kutdik.
by the time | will have finished by a certain time | By the time he came, we had finished. | U kelguniga qadar biz tugatgan edik.

If vs Unless

Connector | Meaning | Example | Translation
if | if | If you study, you will pass. | Agar o‘qisangiz, o‘tasiz.
unless | unless | Unless you study, you will fail. | Agar o‘qimasangiz, yiqilasiz.

5. Rules for constructing complex sentences

Rule 1

Main clause + connector + subordinate clause

In this case, a comma is usually not used.

I stayed at home because I was tired.
Men charchaganim uchun uyda qoldim.

Rule 2

Connector + subordinate clause, main clause

If the connector comes at the beginning of the sentence, a comma is placed after the subordinate clause.

Because I was tired, I stayed at home.
Charchaganim uchun men uyda qoldim.

10 examples

1. I passed the exam because I studied hard.
Men qattiq o‘qiganim uchun imtihondan o‘tdim.

2. Because I studied hard, I passed the exam.
Qattiq o‘qiganim uchun imtihondan o‘tdim.

3. She went out although it was raining.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan bo‘lsa ham, u tashqariga chiqdi.

4. Although it was raining, she went out.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan bo‘lsa ham, u tashqariga chiqdi.

5. You will succeed if you practise every day.
Har kuni mashq qilsangiz, muvaffaqiyatga erishasiz.

6. If you practise every day, you will succeed.
Agar har kuni mashq qilsangiz, muvaffaqiyatga erishasiz.

7. I will call you when I arrive.
Yetib borganimda sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

8. When I arrive, I will call you.
Men yetib borganimda, sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

9. He saved money so that he could buy a laptop.
U noutbuk sotib olishi uchun pul yig‘di.

10. After the lesson finished, we went home.
Dars tugagandan keyin biz uyga ketdik.
grammar_rules_ru:
1. Что такое Complex Clause?

Complex clause / complex sentence — сложное предложение, состоящее из одного главного предложения и одного или нескольких придаточных.

Например:

I stayed at home because it was raining.
Я остался дома, потому что шёл дождь.

В этом предложении:

I stayed at home — main clause, то есть главное предложение.
because it was raining — subordinate clause, то есть придаточное предложение.

Разница между simple sentence, compound sentence и complex sentence

Тип | Структура | Пример | Перевод
Simple sentence | Одно предложение | I study English. | Я изучаю английский.
Compound sentence | Два равноправных предложения | I study English, and my brother studies Russian. | Я изучаю английский, а мой брат изучает русский.
Complex sentence | Главное предложение + придаточное предложение | I study English because I want to enter university. | Я изучаю английский, потому что хочу поступить в университет.

Что такое main clause?

Main clause — главное предложение, которое может иметь самостоятельный смысл.

She passed the exam.
Она сдала экзамен.

Это предложение само по себе имеет полный смысл.

Что такое subordinate clause?

Subordinate clause — придаточное предложение, которое само по себе не имеет полного смысла. Обычно оно начинается с соединительного слова.

because she studied hard
потому что она усердно училась

Эта часть сама по себе не является полным предложением. Ей нужно главное предложение:

She passed the exam because she studied hard.
Она сдала экзамен, потому что усердно училась.

10 примеров

1. I stayed at home because I was tired.
Я остался дома, потому что был уставшим.

2. She smiled when she saw her result.
Она улыбнулась, когда увидела свой результат.

3. Although the test was difficult, he passed it.
Хотя тест был трудным, он его сдал.

4. If you work hard, you will succeed.
Если ты будешь усердно работать, ты добьёшься успеха.

5. I will call you after I finish the lesson.
Я позвоню тебе после того, как закончу урок.

6. She studies every day so that she can improve her English.
Она учится каждый день, чтобы улучшить свой английский.

7. He did not come to class because he was ill.
Он не пришёл на занятия, потому что был болен.

8. We waited until the teacher arrived.
Мы ждали, пока не пришёл учитель.

9. Even though it was late, they continued studying.
Хотя было поздно, они продолжали учёбу.

10. As soon as I get home, I will send you the file.
Как только я доберусь домой, я отправлю тебе файл.

2. Что такое Connectors?

Connectors — это слова, которые связывают предложения, мысли или части предложений.

Они показывают отношения между мыслями:

Тип | Значение | Пример
Причина | Причина | because, since, as
Результат | Результат | so, therefore, as a result
Контраст | Противоречие | although, but, however
Условие | Условие | if, unless, as long as
Время | Время | when, before, after
Цель | Цель | to, in order to, so that
Дополнение | Дополнительная мысль | and, also, moreover
Заключение | Заключение | in conclusion, overall

3. Виды Connectors

A) Причинные соединители

1. Because

Значение: потому что
Формула:
Главное предложение + because + подлежащее + глагол

1. I went to bed early because I was tired.
Я лег спать рано, потому что был уставшим.

2. She passed the exam because she studied hard.
Она сдала экзамен, потому что усердно училась.

2. Since

Значение: потому что
Формула:
Since + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. Since it was raining, we stayed at home.
Поскольку шёл дождь, мы остались дома.

2. Since he knows English well, he can help us.
Поскольку он хорошо знает английский, он может нам помочь.

3. As

Значение: потому что
Формула:
As + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. As I was busy, I could not call you.
Поскольку я был занят, я не мог тебе позвонить.

2. As the test was difficult, many students made mistakes.
Поскольку тест был трудным, многие студенты допустили ошибки.

4. Because of

Значение: из-за
Формула:
because of + существительное / местоимение / V-ing

1. The match was cancelled because of the rain.
Матч был отменён из-за дождя.

2. He was tired because of working all day.
Он был уставшим из-за работы весь день.

5. Due to

Значение: из-за
Формула:
due to + существительное / местоимение / V-ing

1. The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
Рейс был задержан из-за плохой погоды.

2. The lesson was cancelled due to the teacher’s illness.
Урок был отменён из-за болезни учителя.

B) Результативные соединители

1. So

Значение: поэтому
Формула:
Причина + so + результат

1. It was cold, so I closed the window.
Было холодно, поэтому я закрыл окно.

2. She studied hard, so she passed the exam.
Она усердно училась, поэтому сдала экзамен.

2. Therefore

Значение: следовательно
Формула:
Предложение. Therefore, предложение.

1. He did not study. Therefore, he failed the test.
Он не учился. Следовательно, он провалил тест.

2. The price is too high. Therefore, we cannot buy it.
Цена слишком высокая. Следовательно, мы не можем это купить.

3. As a result

Значение: в результате
Формула:
Предложение. As a result, предложение.

1. Он тренировался каждый день. В результате он выиграл соревнование.
U har kuni mashq qildi. Natijada, musobaqada g‘olib bo‘ldi.

2. Студенты много практиковались. В результате их разговорные навыки улучшились.
Talabalar ko‘p mashq qilishdi. Natijada, ularning gapirish ko‘nikmasi yaxshilandi.

4. Вот почему

Значение: поэтому, вот почему
Формула:
Причина. Вот почему + результат.

1. Я болел. Вот почему я пропустил урок.
Men kasal edim. Shuning uchun darsni qoldirdim.

2. Он очень усердно работал. Вот почему он добился успеха.
U juda qattiq ishladi. Shuning uchun muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.

5. Следовательно

Значение: в результате, следовательно
Формула:
Предложение. Следовательно, предложение.

1. Компания потеряла деньги. Следовательно, она сократила зарплаты.
Kompaniya pul yo‘qotdi. Natijada, u maoshlarni kamaytirdi.

2. Многие студенты отсутствовали. Следовательно, экзамен был отложен.
Ko‘p talabalar yo‘q edi. Natijada, imtihon qoldirildi.

C) Контраст / Противоположные соединители

1. Но

Значение: но
Формула:
Предложение + но + предложение

1. Тест был сложным, но я его сдал.
Test qiyin edi, lekin men undan o‘tdim.

2. Она молода, но очень ответственна.
U yosh, lekin juda mas’uliyatli.

2. Хотя

Значение: хотя, несмотря на
Формула:
Хотя + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. Хотя шёл дождь, мы вышли на улицу.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan bo‘lsa ham, biz tashqariga chiqdik.

2. Хотя он был уставшим, он продолжал работать.
U charchagan bo‘lsa ham, ishlashda davom etdi.

3. Хотя

Значение: хотя, несмотря на то что
Формула:
Хотя + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. Хотя задание было трудным, она его закончила.
Vazifa qiyin bo‘lsa ham, u uni tugatdi.

2. Хотя он опоздал, учитель разрешил ему войти.
U kech qolgan bo‘lsa ham, o‘qituvchi unga kirishga ruxsat berdi.

4. Даже если

Значение: даже если
Формула:
Даже если + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. Даже если он был болен, он пришёл на экзамен.
U kasal bo‘lsa ham, imtihonga keldi.

2. Даже если курс был дорогим, многие студенты записались на него.
Kurs qimmat bo‘lsa ham, ko‘p talabalar unga qo‘shildi.

5. Однако

Значение: однако, но
Формула:
Предложение. Однако, предложение.

1. Задание было сложным. Однако, мы его выполнили.
Vazifa qiyin edi. Biroq, biz uni tugatdik.

2. Он хотел путешествовать. Однако, у него не было достаточно денег.
U sayohat qilishni xohladi. Biroq, unda yetarli pul yo‘q edi.

6. Тем не менее

Значение: тем не менее
Формула:
Предложение. Тем не менее, предложение.

1. Погода была плохой. Тем не менее, они продолжили игру.
Ob-havo yomon edi. Shunga qaramay, ular o‘yinni davom ettirishdi.

2. Проект был сложным. Тем не менее, команда закончила его вовремя.
Loyiha qiyin edi. Shunga qaramay, jamoa uni vaqtida tugatdi.

7. Несмотря на

Значение: несмотря на
Формула:
despite + существительное / V-ing

1. Несмотря на дождь, мы вышли на улицу.
Yomg‘irga qaramay, biz tashqariga chiqdik.

2. Несмотря на усталость, он продолжал учиться.
Charchaganiga qaramay, u o‘qishda davom etdi.

8. Несмотря на

Значение: несмотря на
Формула:
in spite of + существительное / V-ing

1. Несмотря на шум, я смог сосредоточиться.
Shovqinga qaramay, men diqqatimni jamlay oldim.

2. Несмотря на то, что времени было мало, она закончила эссе.
Vaqti kam bo‘lishiga qaramay, u esseni tugatdi.

D) Условие / Условные соединители

1. Если

Значение: если
Формула:
Если + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. Если ты будешь усердно учиться, ты сдашь экзамен.
Agar qattiq o‘qisangiz, imtihondan o‘tasiz.

2. Если пойдёт дождь, мы останемся дома.
Agar yomg‘ir yog‘sa, biz uyda qolamiz.

2. Если не

Значение: если не
Формула:
Unless + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. Если ты не поторопишься, ты опоздаешь на автобус.
Agar shoshilmasangiz, avtobusdan qolib ketasiz.

2. Если он не будет учиться, он провалит тест.
Agar u o‘qimasa, testdan yiqiladi.

3. При условии, что

Значение: при условии, что
Формула:
При условии, что + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. Ты можешь присоединиться к курсу при условии, что зарегистрируешься сегодня.
Bugun ro‘yxatdan o‘tsangiz, kursga qo‘shila olasiz.

2. Мы примем твою заявку при условии, что все документы в порядке.
Barcha hujjatlar to‘liq bo‘lsa, arizangizni qabul qilamiz.

4. Пока

Значение: пока, при условии
Формула:
Пока + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. Ты можешь пользоваться моим ноутбуком, пока вернёшь его сегодня.
Bugun qaytarib bersangiz, noutbukimdan foydalanishingiz mumkin.

2. Ты будешь улучшаться, пока будешь практиковаться каждый день.
Har kuni mashq qilsangiz, rivojlanasiz.

E) Время / Временные соединители

1. Когда

Значение: когда
Формула:
Когда + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. Когда я пришёл, урок уже начался.
Men kelganimda, dars allaqachon boshlangan edi.

2. Позвони мне, когда доберёшься домой.
Uyga yetib borganingizda menga qo‘ng‘iroq qiling.

2. Пока

Значение: во время, в течение
Формула:
Пока + подлежащее + глагол, главное предложение

1. Пока я читал, мой брат смотрел телевизор.
Men o‘qiyotganimda, ukam televizor ko‘rayotgan edi.

2. Она слушала музыку, пока делала домашнее задание.
Она слушала музыку, пока делала домашнее задание.

3. Перед

Значение: раньше
Формула:
Before + subject + verb, main clause

1. Перед тем как ответить, внимательно прочитайте вопрос.
Перед тем как ответить, внимательно прочитайте вопрос.

2. Я проверил своё эссе перед тем, как сдал его.
Я проверил своё эссе перед тем, как сдал его.

4. После

Значение: потом
Формула:
After + subject + verb, main clause

1. После того как урок закончился, мы обсудили домашнее задание.
После того как урок закончился, мы обсудили домашнее задание.

2. Я почувствовал себя лучше после того, как выпил немного воды.
Я почувствовал себя лучше после того, как выпил немного воды.

5. Как только

Значение: сразу же
Формула:
As soon as + subject + verb, main clause

1. Как только я закончу задание, я отправлю его тебе.
Как только я закончу задание, я отправлю его тебе.

2. Как только он пришёл, встреча началась.
Как только он пришёл, встреча началась.

6. До тех пор

Значение: до
Формула:
Main clause + until + subject + verb

1. Мы ждали, пока не пришёл учитель.
Мы ждали, пока не пришёл учитель.

2. Не уходи, пока я не позову тебя.
Не уходи, пока я не позову тебя.

7. К тому времени

Значение: к тому времени, когда
Формула:
By the time + subject + verb, main clause

1. К тому времени, как мы прибыли, фильм уже начался.
К тому времени, как мы прибыли, фильм уже начался.

2. К тому времени, как он закончит школу, он будет хорошо знать английский.
К тому времени, как он закончит школу, он будет хорошо знать английский.

F) Целевые / Maqsad connectors

1. Чтобы

Значение: для
Формула:
to + verb

1. Я изучаю английский, чтобы поступить в университет.
Я изучаю английский, чтобы поступить в университет.

2. Она пошла в библиотеку, чтобы взять книгу.
Она пошла в библиотеку, чтобы взять книгу.

2. Для того чтобы

Значение: для того чтобы
Формула:
in order to + verb

1. Он учится каждый день, чтобы сдать экзамен.
Он учится каждый день, чтобы сдать экзамен.

2. Мы пришли рано, чтобы занять хорошие места.
Мы пришли рано, чтобы занять хорошие места.

3. Чтобы

Значение: для того чтобы
Формула:
so as to + verb

1. Она говорила тихо, чтобы не разбудить ребёнка.
Она говорила тихо, чтобы не разбудить ребёнка.

2. Он копил деньги, чтобы купить новый ноутбук.
Он копил деньги, чтобы купить новый ноутбук.

4. Чтобы

Значение: так, чтобы
Формула:
so that + subject + can/could/will/would + verb

1. Я написал инструкции ясно, чтобы все могли их понять.
Я написал инструкции ясно, чтобы все могли их понять.

2. Она усердно учится, чтобы получить стипендию.
Она усердно учится, чтобы получить стипендию.

G) Дополнение / Qo‘shimcha fikr connectors

1. И

Значение: и
Формула:
word/sentence + and + word/sentence

1. Я изучаю английский, и моя сестра изучает биологию.
Я изучаю английский, и моя сестра изучает биологию.

2. Он открыл книгу и начал читать.
Он открыл книгу и начал читать.

2. Также

Значение: также
Формула:
subject + also + verb

1. Она говорит по-английски. Она также говорит по-русски.
Она говорит по-английски. Она также говорит по-русски.

2. Этот курс учит грамматике. Он также улучшает разговорные навыки.
Этот курс учит грамматике. Он также улучшает разговорные навыки.

3. Более того

Значение: кроме того
Формула:
Sentence. Moreover, sentence.

1. Курс полезен. Более того, он доступен.
Курс полезен. Более того, он доступен.

2. Он талантлив. Более того, он очень усердно работает.
Он талантлив. Более того, он очень усердно работает.

4. Кроме того

Значение: кроме того
Формула:
Sentence. Furthermore, sentence.

1. Метод прост. Кроме того, он эффективен.
Метод прост. Кроме того, он эффективен.

2. В школе современные классы. Кроме того, там опытные учителя.
В школе современные классы. Кроме того, там опытные учителя.

5. В дополнение

Значение: в дополнение
Формула:
Sentence. In addition, sentence.

1. Отель чистый. В дополнение, он близко к аэропорту.
Отель чистый. В дополнение, он близко к аэропорту.

2. Книга объясняет грамматику. В дополнение, она даёт полезные упражнения.
Книга объясняет грамматику. В дополнение, она даёт полезные упражнения.

H) Заключение / Xulosa connectors

1. В заключение

Значение: в заключение
Формула:
In conclusion, sentence.

1. В заключение, соединители делают нашу речь яснее.
В заключение, соединители делают нашу речь яснее.

2. В заключение, регулярная практика необходима для успеха.
В заключение, регулярная практика необходима для успеха.

2. Подводя итог

Значение: подводя итог
Формула:
To sum up, sentence.

1. Подводя итог, сложные предложения помогают нам лучше выражать идеи.
Подводя итог, сложные предложения помогают нам лучше выражать идеи.

2. Подводя итог, как грамматика, так и словарный запас важны.
Подводя итог, как грамматика, так и словарный запас важны.

3. В целом

Значение: в целом
Формула:
Overall, sentence.

1. В целом, урок был полезным.
В целом, урок был полезным.

2. В целом, студенты добились хорошего прогресса.
Umuman olganda, talabalar yaxshi rivojlanishdi.

4. Короче говоря

Ma’nosi: qisqasi
Формула:
In short, sentence.

1. Короче говоря, соединители связывают идеи.
Qisqasi, connectorlar fikrlarni bog‘laydi.

2. Короче говоря, практика облегчает грамматику.
Qisqasi, mashq grammatikani osonlashtiradi.

4. Самые важные различия

Because vs Because of

Connector | Что дальше? | Пример | Перевод
because | subject + verb | I stayed home because I was ill. | Men kasal bo‘lganim uchun uyda qoldim.
because of | noun / V-ing | I stayed home because of my illness. | Kasalligim sababli uyda qoldim.

Although vs However

Connector | Положение | Пример | Перевод
although | В одном предложении | Although it was late, we continued. | Kech bo‘lsa ham, davom etdik.
however | Обычно в начале нового предложения | It was late. However, we continued. | Kech edi. Biroq, davom etdik.

Despite vs Although

Connector | Что дальше? | Пример | Перевод
although | subject + verb | Although he was tired, he studied. | U charchagan bo‘lsa ham, o‘qidi.
despite | noun / V-ing | Despite being tired, he studied. | Charchaganiga qaramay, u o‘qidi.

So vs Because

Connector | Функция | Пример | Перевод
because | указывает на причину | I stayed home because I was ill. | Men kasal bo‘lganim uchun uyda qoldim.
so | указывает на результат | I was ill, so I stayed home. | Men kasal edim, shuning uchun uyda qoldim.

Until vs By the time

Connector | Значение | Пример | Перевод
until | продолжается до определенного времени | We waited until he came. | U kelguncha kutdik.
by the time | к определенному времени работа будет завершена | By the time he came, we had finished. | U kelguniga qadar biz tugatgan edik.

If vs Unless

Connector | Значение | Пример | Перевод
if | если | If you study, you will pass. | Agar o‘qisangiz, o‘tasiz.
unless | если ... не | Unless you study, you will fail. | Agar o‘qimasangiz, yiqilasiz.

5. Правила составления сложного предложения

1-е правило

Главное предложение + соединитель + придаточное предложение

В этом случае обычно запятая не ставится.

I stayed at home because I was tired.
Men charchaganim uchun uyda qoldim.

2-е правило

Соединитель + придаточное предложение, главное предложение

Если соединитель стоит в начале предложения, то после придаточного предложения ставится запятая.

Because I was tired, I stayed at home.
Charchaganim uchun men uyda qoldim.

10 примеров

1. Я сдал экзамен, потому что усердно учился.
Men qattiq o‘qiganim uchun imtihondan o‘tdim.

2. Потому что я усердно учился, я сдал экзамен.
Qattiq o‘qiganim uchun imtihondan o‘tdim.

3. Она вышла на улицу, хотя шёл дождь.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan bo‘lsa ham, u tashqariga chiqdi.

4. Хотя шёл дождь, она вышла на улицу.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotgan bo‘lsa ham, u tashqariga chiqdi.

5. Вы добьётесь успеха, если будете практиковаться каждый день.
Har kuni mashq qilsangiz, muvaffaqiyatga erishasiz.

6. Если вы будете практиковаться каждый день, вы добьётесь успеха.
Agar har kuni mashq qilsangiz, muvaffaqiyatga erishasiz.

7. Я позвоню тебе, когда приеду.
Yetib borganimda sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

8. Когда я приеду, я позвоню тебе.
Men yetib borganimda, sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

9. Он сэкономил деньги, чтобы купить ноутбук.
U noutbuk sotib olishi uchun pul yig‘di.

10. После того как урок закончился, мы пошли домой.
Dars tugagandan keyin biz uyga ketdik.
grammar_rules_kk:
1. Complex Clause degen ne?

Complex clause / complex sentence — bitta asosiy gáp hám bitta yoki undan ortiq qosımsha gápten táskil topǵan murakkab gáp.

Mısalı:

I stayed at home because it was raining.
Men úyde qaldım, sebebi jawın jawıp atır edi.

Bul gápte:

I stayed at home — main clause, yaǵnıy tiykarǵı gáp.
because it was raining — subordinate clause, yaǵnıy baǵınıńqı gáp.

Simple sentence, compound sentence hám complex sentence ayırması

Turi | Tuzilishi | Mısal | Tarjima
Simple sentence | Bitta fikr | I study English. | Men ingliz tilini o‘rganaman.
Compound sentence | Ikkita teng fikr | I study English, and my brother studies Russian. | Men ingliz tilini o‘rganaman, akam esa rus tilini o‘rganadi.
Complex sentence | Asosiy gáp + qosımsha gáp | I study English because I want to enter university. | Men universitetke kirishni xohlaganim ushın ingliz tilini o‘rganaman.

Main clause nima?

Main clause — mustaqil ma’no bera oladigan asosiy gáp.

She passed the exam.
U imtihondan o‘tdi.

Bul gáp yakka o‘zi hám to‘liq ma’no beradi.

Subordinate clause nima?

Subordinate clause — yakka o‘zi to‘liq ma’no bermeydigan qosımsha gáp. U odatda connector menen bastaladı.

because she studied hard
chunki u qattiq o‘qidi

Bul qism yakka o‘zi to‘liq gáp emes. Unga asosiy gáp kerek:

She passed the exam because she studied hard.
U qattiq o‘qigani ushın imtihondan o‘tdi.

10 ta mısal

1. I stayed at home because I was tired.
Men charchagan edim, sonlıqtan úyde qaldım.

2. She smiled when she saw her result.
U natijasını ko‘rganda tabassum qıldı.

3. Although the test was difficult, he passed it.
Test qiyin bolǵanı hám, u undan o‘tdi.

4. If you work hard, you will succeed.
Agar qattiq ishleseńiz, muvaffaqiyatqa erishesiz.

5. I will call you after I finish the lesson.
Darsnı tugatqandan keyin sizge qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman.

6. She studies every day so that she can improve her English.
U ingliz tilinı yaxshılawı ushın hár kúni o‘qıydu.

7. He did not come to class because he was ill.
U kasal bolǵanı ushın darsqa kelmedi.

8. We waited until the teacher arrived.
Biz oqıtıwshı kelǵunça kuttıq.

9. Even though it was late, they continued studying.
Kech bolǵanı hám, ular o‘qıwda davam ettiler.

10. As soon as I get home, I will send you the file.
Uyǵa yetip barǵanım menen sizge faylnı yuboraman.

2. Connectors nima?

Connectors — gáptar, fikrler yaki gáp bolakların bog‘laydıqan so‘zlar.

Ular fikrler orasındakı munasabatnı kórsatadı:

Turi | Ma’nosi | Mısal
Reason | Sabab | because, since, as
Result | Natija | so, therefore, as a result
Contrast | Qarama-qarshilik | although, but, however
Condition | Shart | if, unless, as long as
Time | Vaqt | when, before, after
Purpose | Maqsad | to, in order to, so that
Addition | Qo‘shimça fikr | and, also, moreover
Conclusion | Xulosa | in conclusion, overall

3. Connectors turları

A) Reason / Sabab connectors

1. Because

Ma’nosi: chunki, sababli
Formula:
Main clause + because + subject + verb

1. I went to bed early because I was tired.
Men charchaganim ushın erta uxladım.

2. She passed the exam because she studied hard.
U qattiq o‘qigani ushın imtihondan o‘tdi.

2. Since

Ma’nosi: chunki, sababli
Formula:
Since + subject + verb, main clause

1. Since it was raining, we stayed at home.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ayotǵanı ushın biz úyde qaldıq.

2. Since he knows English well, he can help us.
U ingliz tilinı jaqsı bilgani ushın bizge yordam berip aladı.

3. As

Ma’nosi: chunki, sababli
Formula:
As + subject + verb, main clause

1. As I was busy, I could not call you.
Band bolǵanım ushın sizge qo‘ng‘iroq qıla almadım.

2. As the test was difficult, many students made mistakes.
Test qiyin bolǵanı ushın köp o‘quwshılar xato qıldı.

4. Because of

Ma’nosi: sababli, tufaylı
Formula:
because of + noun / pronoun / V-ing

1. The match was cancelled because of the rain.
Yomg‘ir tufaylı o‘yın bekor qılındı.

2. He was tired because of working all day.
U kun boyı ishlagani tufaylı charchap qaldı.

5. Due to

Ma’nosi: sababli, tufaylı
Formula:
due to + noun / pronoun / V-ing

1. The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
Yomon ob-havo tufaylı reys kechiktirildi.

2. The lesson was cancelled due to the teacher’s illness.
O‘qıtıwşınıñ kasallığı tufaylı dars bekor qılındı.

B) Result / Natija connectors

1. So

Ma’nosi: shuning uchun
Formula:
Cause + so + result

1. It was cold, so I closed the window.
Havo sovuq edi, shuning uchun men derazanı yopdım.

2. She studied hard, so she passed the exam.
U qattiq o‘qidi, shuning uchun imtihondan o‘tdi.

2. Therefore

Ma’nosi: shuning uchun, demak
Formula:
Sentence. Therefore, sentence.

1. He did not study. Therefore, he failed the test.
U o‘qimadı. Shuning uchun u testdan yiqıldı.

2. The price is too high. Therefore, we cannot buy it.
Narx juda baland. Shuning uchun biz uni sotıp alalmaymiz.

3. As a result

Ma’nosi: natijada
Formula:
Sentence. As a result, sentence.

1. He trained every day. As a result, he won the competition.
U har kuni mashq qıldı. Natijada, musobaqada g‘olib boldı.

2. The students practised a lot. As a result, their speaking improved.
Talabalar kóp mashq qıldı. Natijada, ularning gapırwı kónikması jaqsılandı.

4. That’s why

Ma’nısı: sonlıqtan, ana sonlıqtan
Formula:
Sebep. That’s why + natija.

1. I was ill. That’s why I missed the lesson.
Men kasal edim. Sonlıqtan darsnı qaldırdım.

2. He worked very hard. That’s why he succeeded.
U juda qattıq işledi. Sonlıqtan muvaffaqiyatqa erıştı.

5. Consequently

Ma’nısı: natijada, oqıbatda
Formula:
Gáp. Consequently, gáp.

1. The company lost money. Consequently, it reduced salaries.
Kompaniya pul yoqotdı. Natijada, u maoshlarını kamayttı.

2. Many students were absent. Consequently, the exam was postponed.
Kóp talabalar yoq edi. Natijada, imtihon qaldırıldı.

C) Contrast / Qarama-qarşılıq connectors

1. But

Ma’nısı: biraq
Formula:
Gáp + but + gáp

1. The test was difficult, but I passed it.
Test qiyin edi, biraq men undan ótdım.

2. She is young, but she is very responsible.
U yosh, biraq juda mas’uliyatlı.

2. Although

Ma’nısı: garchı, -ğa qaramay
Formula:
Although + subject + verb, main clause

1. Although it was raining, we went out.
Yomg‘ir yog‘atqan bolsa ham, biz tashqarıga çıqtıq.

2. Although he was tired, he continued working.
U charchagan bolsa ham, işlawda davam etdi.

3. Though

Ma’nısı: garchı, bolsa ham
Formula:
Though + subject + verb, main clause

1. Though the task was hard, she finished it.
Vazıfa qiyin bolsa ham, u uni tugattı.

2. Though he was late, the teacher allowed him to enter.
U kech qolğan bolsa ham, oqıtıwşı unga kirüwge ruxsat berdi.

4. Even though

Ma’nısı: hatto ... bolsa ham
Formula:
Even though + subject + verb, main clause

1. Even though he was ill, he came to the exam.
U kasal bolsa ham, imtihonga keldi.

2. Even though the course was expensive, many students joined it.
Kurs qımmat bolsa ham, kóp talabalar unga qoşıldı.

5. However

Ma’nısı: biraq, ammo
Formula:
Gáp. However, gáp.

1. The task was difficult. However, we completed it.
Vazıfa qiyin edi. Biraq, biz uni tugattıq.

2. He wanted to travel. However, he did not have enough money.
U sayohat qılışnı xohladı. Biraq, unda yetarli pul yoq edi.

6. Nevertheless

Ma’nısı: şunga qaramay
Formula:
Gáp. Nevertheless, gáp.

1. The weather was bad. Nevertheless, they continued the game.
Ob-havo yomon edi. Şunga qaramay, ular o‘yınnı davam ettirdi.

2. The project was challenging. Nevertheless, the team finished it on time.
Loyiha qiyin edi. Şunga qaramay, jamoa uni waqıtında tugattı.

7. Despite

Ma’nısı: -ğa qaramay
Formula:
despite + noun / V-ing

1. Despite the rain, we went out.
Yomg‘irğa qaramay, biz tashqarıga çıqtıq.

2. Despite being tired, he continued studying.
Charchaganıña qaramay, u oqıwda davam etdi.

8. In spite of

Ma’nısı: -ğa qaramay
Formula:
in spite of + noun / V-ing

1. In spite of the noise, I could concentrate.
Şovqınga qaramay, men diqqatımnı jamlay aldım.

2. In spite of having little time, she finished the essay.
Waqtı kam bolıwıña qaramay, u esseni tugattı.

D) Condition / Şart connectors

1. If

Ma’nısı: agar
Formula:
If + subject + verb, main clause

1. If you study hard, you will pass the exam.
Agar qattıq oqısańız, imtihondan ótásız.

2. If it rains, we will stay at home.
Agar yomg‘ir yog‘sa, biz uyda qolamız.

2. Unless

Ma’nısı: agar ... bolmasa
Formula:
Unless + subject + verb, main clause

1. Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
Agar shoshılmasanız, avtobusdan qolıp ketásız.

2. Unless he studies, he will fail the test.
Agar u oqımasa, testdan yiqıladı.

3. Provided that

Ma’nısı: şartı menen, agar
Formula:
Provided that + subject + verb, main clause

1. You can join the course provided that you register today.
Bugün ro‘yxatdan ótseńiz, kursqa qoşıla alasız.

2. We will accept your application provided that all documents are complete.
Barcha hujjatlar to‘lıq bolısa, arizañıznı qabul qilamız.

4. As long as

Ma’nısı: modomiki, şartı menen
Formula:
As long as + subject + verb, main clause

1. You can use my laptop as long as you return it today.
Bugün qaytarıp berseniz, noutbukımdan faydalanıwıñız mumkin.

2. You will improve as long as you practise every day.
Har kuni mashq qılsañız, rıvojlanasız.

E) Time / Waqıt connectors

1. When

Ma’nısı: qachonki, -ganda
Formula:
When + subject + verb, main clause

1. When I arrived, the lesson had already started.
Men kelgenimde, dars allaqachon bosılğan edi.

2. Call me when you get home.
Uyğa yetip borganıñızda menga qo‘ng‘iroq qılıñ.

2. While

Ma’nısı: paytında, davamında
Formula:
While + subject + verb, main clause

1. While I was reading, my brother was watching TV.
Men oqıyotqanda, ukam televizor qorayotqandı.

2. She listened to music while she was doing homework.
U uy vazifasini qilıp atırǵanda musiqa tingledi.

3. Before

Ma’nosi: oldın
Formula:
Before + subject + verb, main clause

1. Before you answer, read the question carefully.
Javob berişden oldın savolnı diqqat menen o‘qıñ.

2. I checked my essay before I submitted it.
Men esseni topshırışdan oldın uni tekşirdim.

4. After

Ma’nosi: keyin
Formula:
After + subject + verb, main clause

1. After the lesson ended, we discussed the homework.
Dars tugap qaldıktan keyin biz uy vazifasın muhokama qıldıq.

2. I felt better after I drank some water.
Suv içip alǵandan keyin o‘zimni jaqsı his qıldım.

5. As soon as

Ma’nosi: bilınaw
Formula:
As soon as + subject + verb, main clause

1. As soon as I finish the task, I will send it to you.
Vazifanı tugatıp alǵanım menen uni sizge yubaramın.

2. As soon as he arrived, the meeting started.
U kelip alǵanında uchraşuv bastaldı.

6. Until

Ma’nosi: -ğaça
Formula:
Main clause + until + subject + verb

1. We waited until the teacher came.
Biz o‘qıtwşı kelǵunşa kuttıq.

2. Do not leave until I call you.
Men qo‘ng‘iroq qilǵunımça ketpeñ.

7. By the time

Ma’nosi: -gunga qadar, -gan paytqa kelip
Formula:
By the time + subject + verb, main clause

1. By the time we arrived, the film had started.
Biz yetip kelǵunımızça film boshlanǵan edi.

2. By the time he finishes school, he will know English well.
U maktabnı tugatǵanına qadar ingliz tilin jaqsı bilip aladı.

F) Purpose / Maqsad connectors

1. To

Ma’nosi: üşin
Formula:
to + verb

1. I study English to enter university.
Men universitetke kirip üşin ingliz tilin úyrenemin.

2. She went to the library to borrow a book.
U kitap alıp üşin kutubxanaga bardı.

2. In order to

Ma’nosi: maqsadında, üşin
Formula:
in order to + verb

1. He studies every day in order to pass the exam.
U imtihondan o‘tıp üşin hár kúni o‘qıydu.

2. We arrived early in order to get good seats.
Jaqlı orın alıp üşin biz erta keldik.

3. So as to

Ma’nosi: maqsadında, üşin
Formula:
so as to + verb

1. She spoke quietly so as not to wake the baby.
U chaqaloqni uyǵotmaslıq üşin sekin gapırdı.

2. He saved money so as to buy a new laptop.
U jańa noutbuk satıp alıp üşin pul yıqtı.

4. So that

Ma’nosi: şunday qılsın ki, üşin
Formula:
so that + subject + can/could/will/would + verb

1. I wrote the instructions clearly so that everyone could understand them.
Hámma túsinip alıwı üşin men ko‘rsatmalarni anıq jazdım.

2. She studies hard so that she can get a scholarship.
U stipendiya alıwı üşin qattıq o‘qıydu.

G) Addition / Qo‘shimça fikr connectors

1. And

Ma’nosi: hám
Formula:
word/sentence + and + word/sentence

1. I study English and my sister studies biology.
Men ingliz tilin úyrenemin hám singlim biologiyani úyrenedi.

2. He opened the book and started reading.
U kitapnı açtı hám o‘qıwğa bastadı.

2. Also

Ma’nosi: hám, shuningdek
Formula:
subject + also + verb

1. She speaks English. She also speaks Russian.
U ingliz tilida gapıradı. U rus tilida hám gapıradı.

2. This course teaches grammar. It also improves speaking skills.
Bu kurs grammatika o‘rgatadı. U gapıw ko‘nikmasın hám jaqsılaydı.

3. Moreover

Ma’nosi: bundan taşqarı
Formula:
Sentence. Moreover, sentence.

1. The course is useful. Moreover, it is affordable.
Kurs foydali. Bundan taşqarı, u arzon.

2. He is talented. Moreover, he works very hard.
U iqtidorlı. Bundan taşqarı, u juda qattiq ishlaydi.

4. Furthermore

Ma’nosi: bundan taşqarı, yana
Formula:
Sentence. Furthermore, sentence.

1. The method is simple. Furthermore, it is effective.
Metod sodda. Bundan taşqarı, u samaralı.

2. The school has modern classrooms. Furthermore, it has experienced teachers.
Mektep zamonaviy sinfxonalarğa iye. Bundan taşqarı, onda tajribalı o‘qıtuvşılar bar.

5. In addition

Ma’nosi: qo‘shimça ravışında
Formula:
Sentence. In addition, sentence.

1. The hotel is clean. In addition, it is close to the airport.
Mehmonxona toza. Qo‘shimça ravışında, u aeroportqa yaqin.

2. The book explains grammar. In addition, it gives useful exercises.
Kitap grammatikanı túsindiredi. Qo‘shimça ravışında, foydali mashq beredi.

H) Conclusion / Xulosa connectors

1. In conclusion

Ma’nosi: xulosa qilib aytqanda
Formula:
In conclusion, sentence.

1. In conclusion, connectors make our speech clearer.
Xulosa qilib aytqanda, connectorlar nutqımıznı anıqraq etedi.

2. In conclusion, regular practice is necessary for success.
Xulosa qilib aytqanda, muvaffaqiyat üşin muntazam mashq zarur.

2. To sum up

Ma’nosi: qisqıca aytganda
Formula:
To sum up, sentence.

1. To sum up, complex sentences help us express ideas better.
Qisqıca aytganda, murakkab gaplar fikrlerdi jaqsıraq ifodalawğa yardım etedi.

2. To sum up, both grammar and vocabulary are important.
Qisqıca aytganda, grammatika hám lug‘at muhim.

3. Overall

Ma’nosi: umuman olǵanda
Formula:
Overall, sentence.

1. Overall, the lesson was useful.
Umuman olǵanda, dars foydali bolıp qaldı.

2. Umuman olganda, studentler jaqsı rıvojlanyşdı.
Umuman olganda, talabalar yaxshi rivojlanishdi.

4. Qısqası

Ma’nısı: qısqası
Formula:
In short, sentence.

1. Qısqası, connectorlar fikrlarni bog‘laydı.
Qısqası, connectorlar fikrlarni bog‘laydı.

2. Qısqası, mashq grammatikanı osonlaştıradı.
Qısqası, mashq grammatikani osonlashtiradi.

4. Eng muhim farqlar

Because vs Because of

Connector | Keyin nima keladi? | Mısal | Tarjima
because | subject + verb | I stayed home because I was ill. | Men kasal bo‘lganım úşın uyda qoldım.
because of | noun / V-ing | I stayed home because of my illness. | Kasalligim sabablı uyda qoldım.

Although vs However

Connector | Joylaşuwı | Mısal | Tarjima
although | Bitta gáp içide | Although it was late, we continued. | Kech bo‘lsa ham, davom etdik.
however | Odatda jańa gáp başında | It was late. However, we continued. | Kech edi. Biraq, davom etdik.

Despite vs Although

Connector | Keyin nima keladi? | Mısal | Tarjima
although | subject + verb | Although he was tired, he studied. | U charchagan bo‘lsa ham, o‘qidi.
despite | noun / V-ing | Despite being tired, he studied. | Charchaganına qaramay, u o‘qidi.

So vs Because

Connector | Vazifası | Mısal | Tarjima
because | sababnı bildiradı | I stayed home because I was ill. | Men kasal bo‘lganım úşın uyda qoldım.
so | natijanı bildiradı | I was ill, so I stayed home. | Men kasal edim, sonlıqtan uyda qoldım.

Until vs By the time

Connector | Ma’nısı | Mısal | Tarjima
until | bir waqıtğa davam etiş | We waited until he came. | U kelgunça kutdıq.
by the time | ma’lum waqıtqa kelip iş tugatılğan boladı | By the time he came, we had finished. | U kelgunıqa qadar biz tugatqan edik.

If vs Unless

Connector | Ma’nısı | Mısal | Tarjima
if | agar | If you study, you will pass. | Agar o‘qisangız, o‘tasız.
unless | agar ... bolmasa | Unless you study, you will fail. | Agar o‘qimasanız, yiqilasız.

5. Complex sentence tuzıw qaǵıydaları

1-qaǵıda

Main clause + connector + subordinate clause

Bu holatda ádette vergul qoyılmaydı.

I stayed at home because I was tired.
Men charchaganim úşın uyda qoldım.

2-qaǵıda

Connector + subordinate clause, main clause

Connector gáp başında kelsa, subordinate clause’dan keyin vergul qoyıladı.

Because I was tired, I stayed at home.
Charchaganim úşın men uyda qoldım.

10 ta mısal

1. I passed the exam because I studied hard.
Men qattıq o‘qıganym úşın imtihondan o‘tdım.

2. Because I studied hard, I passed the exam.
Qattıq o‘qıganym úşın imtihondan o‘tdım.

3. She went out although it was raining.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ıp atır bolsa ham, u tashqarıga şıqtı.

4. Although it was raining, she went out.
Yomg‘ir yog‘ıp atır bolsa ham, u tashqarıga şıqtı.

5. You will succeed if you practise every day.
Har kúni mashq qılsanız, muvaffaqiyatqa erişesiz.

6. If you practise every day, you will succeed.
Agar har kúni mashq qılsanız, muvaffaqiyatqa erişesiz.

7. I will call you when I arrive.
Yetip borganımda sizge qońğırıq qılamın.

8. When I arrive, I will call you.
Men yetip borganımda, sizge qońğırıq qılamın.

9. He saved money so that he could buy a laptop.
U noutbuk sotıp alıwı úşın pul yıqtı.

10. After the lesson finished, we went home.
Dars tugagandan keyin biz uyğa ketdik.
reading_passage:
Maya is taking part in a lesson about downloading and evaluating a new study app. The activity is set in a mobile-learning review.

Although the app is small, it includes flashcards, audio notes and a weekly progress chart. Users can study offline because downloaded lessons remain on the phone until they remove them.

The reviewer likes the simple layout, while she dislikes the fact that some notifications cannot be turned off. Because the privacy policy is easy to find, users can check what data is collected before creating an account.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Although the app is small, it works well because the developers removed features that users did not need.” The review recommends the app for students who want simple tools rather than a large social platform.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Maya and Daniel compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.
