grammar_rules:
Participle clause — gapni qisqartirish uchun ishlatiladigan grammatik shakl. U matnni ixchamroq, ravonroq va akademikroq qiladi.

Oddiy gap:

Because he felt tired, he went home.
U charchagani uchun uyga ketdi.

Qisqartirilgan gap:

Feeling tired, he went home.
Charchagan holda, u uyga ketdi.

Bu yerda because he felt tired qismi feeling tired shakliga qisqardi.

To‘liq gap va participle clause farqi

To‘liq gap | Participle clause | Tarjima
Because I was late, I took a taxi. | Being late, I took a taxi. | Kech qolganim uchun taksiga chiqdim.
When she saw the teacher, she stopped talking. | Seeing the teacher, she stopped talking. | O‘qituvchini ko‘rib, u gapirishni to‘xtatdi.
After he finished his homework, he went out. | Having finished his homework, he went out. | Uy vazifasini tugatib, u tashqariga chiqdi.
The book which was written by Orwell is famous. | Written by Orwell, the book is famous. | Orwell tomonidan yozilgan kitob mashhur.

8 ta misol

1. Feeling tired, I went to bed early.
Charchaganim uchun erta uxladim.

2. Seeing the police, the driver stopped.
Politsiyani ko‘rib, haydovchi to‘xtadi.

3. Having finished the test, the students left the room.
Testni tugatib, talabalar xonadan chiqishdi.

4. Written in simple language, the book is easy to understand.
Sodda tilda yozilgani uchun kitobni tushunish oson.

5. Not knowing the answer, he stayed silent.
Javobni bilmagani uchun u jim qoldi.

6. Built in 1990, the school is still modern.
1990-yilda qurilgan maktab hali ham zamonaviy.

7. Working hard, she improved her English.
Qattiq ishlab, u ingliz tilini yaxshiladi.

8. Having saved enough money, he bought a laptop.
Yetarli pul yig‘ib, u noutbuk sotib oldi.

2. Participle Clauses turlari

A) Present Participle Clause: V-ing

V-ing shakli ikki asosiy holatda ishlatiladi:

1. Ikki ish bir vaqtda sodir bo‘lsa

2. Sabab bildirsa

Misol

Because he felt tired, he went home.
U charchagani uchun uyga ketdi.

Feeling tired, he went home.
Charchagan holda, u uyga ketdi.

5 ta misol

1. Walking home, I met my friend.
Uyga ketayotganimda do‘stimni uchratdim.

2. Feeling nervous, she could not answer well.
Hayajonlangani uchun u yaxshi javob bera olmadi.

3. Knowing the rule, he solved the test quickly.
Qoidani bilgani uchun u testni tez yechdi.

4. Looking at the board, the students copied the sentence.
Doskaga qarab, talabalar gapni ko‘chirishdi.

5. Being busy, I could not call you.
Band bo‘lganim uchun sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qila olmadim.

B) Past Participle Clause: V3

V3 shakli odatda passive, ya’ni “qilingan”, “yozilgan”, “qurilgan”, “berilgan” ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

Misol

The book which was written by Orwell is famous.
Orwell tomonidan yozilgan kitob mashhur.

Written by Orwell, the book is famous.
Orwell tomonidan yozilgan kitob mashhur.

5 ta misol

1. Written in English, the article is useful for students.
Ingliz tilida yozilgan maqola talabalar uchun foydali.

2. Built many years ago, the bridge is still strong.
Ko‘p yillar oldin qurilgan ko‘prik hali ham mustahkam.

3. Designed by experts, the course is very effective.
Mutaxassislar tomonidan tuzilgan kurs juda samarali.

4. Given enough time, students can finish the task.
Yetarli vaqt berilsa, talabalar vazifani tugata oladi.

5. Translated into Uzbek, the text became easier to understand.
O‘zbek tiliga tarjima qilingach, matnni tushunish osonlashdi.

C) Perfect Participle Clause: Having + V3

Having + V3 bir ish ikkinchi ishdan oldin tugaganini bildiradi.

Misol

After she had finished her work, she left.
U ishini tugatgandan keyin ketdi.

Having finished her work, she left.
Ishini tugatib, u ketdi.

5 ta misol

1. Having finished the exam, he left the classroom.
Imtihonni tugatib, u sinfxonadan chiqdi.

2. Having read the article, she wrote a summary.
Maqolani o‘qib, u qisqa xulosa yozdi.

3. Having completed the project, they presented it.
Loyihani tugatib, ular uni taqdim qilishdi.

4. Having received the email, I replied immediately.
Emailni olib, men darhol javob berdim.

5. Having learned the rule, the students did the exercises.
Qoidani o‘rganib, talabalar mashqlarni bajarishdi.

3. Participle Clause qachon ishlatiladi?

Holat | Misol | Tarjima
Sabab | Feeling ill, he stayed at home. | Kasal bo‘lgani uchun u uyda qoldi.
Vaqt | Walking to school, I saw my teacher. | Maktabga ketayotganimda o‘qituvchimni ko‘rdim.
Natija | The fire spread quickly, destroying many houses. | Yong‘in tez tarqalib, ko‘p uylarni vayron qildi.
Qo‘shimcha ma’lumot | My brother, studying in London, speaks English well. | Londonda o‘qiyotgan akam ingliz tilida yaxshi gapiradi.
Passive ma’no | Written by a famous writer, the book is popular. | Mashhur yozuvchi tomonidan yozilgan kitob ommabop.

4. Muhim qoida: subject bir xil bo‘lishi kerak

Participle clause ishlatilganda, participle clause va asosiy gapdagi bajaruvchi bir xil bo‘lishi kerak.

To‘g‘ri

Feeling tired, I went home.
Charchaganim uchun men uyga ketdim.

Bu yerda charchagan ham I, uyga ketgan ham I.

Dangling participle xatosi

Dangling participle — participle clause’dagi subject asosiy gapdagi subject bilan mos kelmaganda yuzaga keladigan xato.

Noto‘g‘ri

❌ Walking to school, the rain started.
Maktabga ketayotganida yomg‘ir boshlandi.

Bu xato, chunki “rain” maktabga yurmaydi.

To‘g‘ri

✅ Walking to school, I saw that the rain started.
Maktabga ketayotganimda yomg‘ir boshlanganini ko‘rdim.

Yoki:

✅ While I was walking to school, the rain started.
Men maktabga ketayotganimda yomg‘ir boshlandi.

Yana misollar

❌ Feeling hungry, the food was cooked.
✅ Feeling hungry, I cooked some food.
Och qolganim uchun ovqat pishirdim.

❌ Reading the book, the phone rang.
✅ Reading the book, I heard the phone ring.
Kitob o‘qiyotganimda telefon jiringlaganini eshitdim.

5. Nominalisation nima?

Nominalisation — fe’l yoki sifatni otga aylantirish.

Bu usul akademik va rasmiy yozuvda gapni jiddiyroq, ixchamroq va ilmiyroq qiladi.

Oddiy misol

The students improved their English.
Talabalar ingliz tilini yaxshilashdi.

There was an improvement in the students’ English.
Talabalarning ingliz tilida yaxshilanish bo‘ldi.

Bu yerda:

improve — yaxshilamoq
improvement — yaxshilanish

8 ta sodda misol

1. decide → decision
qaror qilmoq → qaror

2. develop → development
rivojlanmoq → rivojlanish

3. improve → improvement
yaxshilamoq → yaxshilanish

4. explain → explanation
tushuntirmoq → tushuntirish

5. educate → education
ta’lim bermoq → ta’lim

6. succeed → success
muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq → muvaffaqiyat

7. fail → failure
muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoq → muvaffaqiyatsizlik

8. different → difference
farqli → farq

6. Nominalisation misollari

Verb / adjective | Noun | Gap | Tarjima
decide | decision | His decision was correct. | Uning qarori to‘g‘ri edi.
develop | development | The development of technology is fast. | Texnologiyaning rivojlanishi tez.
improve | improvement | There was an improvement in her writing. | Uning yozuvida yaxshilanish bo‘ldi.
investigate | investigation | The investigation took two months. | Tekshiruv ikki oy davom etdi.
analyze | analysis | The analysis of the data was useful. | Ma’lumotlar tahlili foydali bo‘ldi.
explain | explanation | His explanation was clear. | Uning tushuntirishi aniq edi.
educate | education | Education is important for society. | Ta’lim jamiyat uchun muhim.
succeed | success | Success requires hard work. | Muvaffaqiyat qattiq mehnatni talab qiladi.
fail | failure | Failure can teach important lessons. | Muvaffaqiyatsizlik muhim saboqlar berishi mumkin.
different | difference | There is a big difference between the two methods. | Ikki metod o‘rtasida katta farq bor.

7. Oddiy gapdan akademik gapga o‘tish

Oddiy gap | Akademikroq gap | Tarjima
The government decided to change the system. | The government’s decision to change the system was important. | Hukumatning tizimni o‘zgartirish qarori muhim edi.
The company developed a new app. | The development of a new app helped the company. | Yangi ilovaning ishlab chiqilishi kompaniyaga yordam berdi.
Students improved their speaking. | The improvement of students’ speaking was clear. | Talabalarning gapirishidagi yaxshilanish aniq edi.
Researchers investigated the problem. | The investigation of the problem took several months. | Muammoning tekshirilishi bir necha oy davom etdi.
They analyzed the results carefully. | The analysis of the results was careful. | Natijalarning tahlili ehtiyotkorlik bilan qilindi.
The teacher explained the rule. | The teacher’s explanation of the rule was clear. | O‘qituvchining qoidani tushuntirishi aniq edi.
The school educates young people. | The education of young people is important. | Yoshlarning ta’limi muhim.
He succeeded in the exam. | His success in the exam surprised everyone. | Uning imtihondagi muvaffaqiyati hammani hayratlantirdi.
The plan failed. | The failure of the plan caused problems. | Rejaning muvaffaqiyatsizligi muammolarga sabab bo‘ldi.
The two methods are different. | The difference between the two methods is clear. | Ikki metod o‘rtasidagi farq aniq.

8. Participle Clauses va Nominalisation farqi

Savol | Participle clause | Nominalisation
Nima qiladi? | Gapni qisqartiradi. | Fe’l yoki sifatni otga aylantiradi.
Qachon ishlatiladi? | Sabab, vaqt, passive yoki qo‘shimcha ma’lumot berishda. | Akademik va rasmiy yozuvda.
Shakli | V-ing, V3, Having + V3 | decision, development, analysis
Misol | Feeling tired, he went home. | His decision was important.
Tarjima | Charchagani uchun u uyga ketdi. | Uning qarori muhim edi.

9. Ko‘p qilinadigan xatolar

1. Subject bir xil bo‘lmaganda participle clause ishlatish

❌ Walking to school, the rain started.
✅ While I was walking to school, the rain started.
Men maktabga ketayotganimda yomg‘ir boshlandi.

Izoh: Yomg‘ir maktabga yurmaydi. Subject mos bo‘lishi kerak.

2. V-ing va V3 ni adashtirish

❌ Writing by Shakespeare, the play is famous.
✅ Written by Shakespeare, the play is famous.
Shakespeare tomonidan yozilgan pyesa mashhur.

Izoh: Passive ma’noda V3 kerak.

3. Having + V3 ni noto‘g‘ri ishlatish

❌ Having finish the task, he left.
✅ Having finished the task, he left.
Vazifani tugatib, u ketdi.

Izoh: Having’dan keyin V3 ishlatiladi.

4. Nominalisation’da noto‘g‘ri ot shaklini tanlash

❌ The improve of students was clear.
✅ The improvement of students was clear.
Talabalardagi yaxshilanish aniq edi.

Izoh: improve — fe’l, improvement — ot.

5. Juda ko‘p nominalisation ishlatish

❌ The implementation of the improvement of the development of education was necessary.
✅ It was necessary to improve and develop education.
Ta’limni yaxshilash va rivojlantirish zarur edi.

Izoh: Nominalisation foydali, lekin haddan tashqari ko‘p ishlatilsa gap og‘irlashadi.
grammar_rules_en:
A participle clause is a grammatical form used to shorten a sentence. It makes a text more compact, smoother and more academic.

Simple sentence:

Because he felt tired, he went home.

Shortened sentence:

Feeling tired, he went home.

Here the part because he felt tired was shortened to feeling tired.

The difference between a full clause and a participle clause

Full sentence | Participle clause | Translation
Because I was late, I took a taxi. | Being late, I took a taxi. | Kech qolganim uchun taksiga chiqdim.
When she saw the teacher, she stopped talking. | Seeing the teacher, she stopped talking. | O‘qituvchini ko‘rib, u gapirishni to‘xtatdi.
After he finished his homework, he went out. | Having finished his homework, he went out. | Uy vazifasini tugatib, u tashqariga chiqdi.
The book which was written by Orwell is famous. | Written by Orwell, the book is famous. | Orwell tomonidan yozilgan kitob mashhur.

8 examples

1. Feeling tired, I went to bed early.
Charchaganim uchun erta uxladim.

2. Seeing the police, the driver stopped.
Politsiyani ko‘rib, haydovchi to‘xtadi.

3. Having finished the test, the students left the room.
Testni tugatib, talabalar xonadan chiqishdi.

4. Written in simple language, the book is easy to understand.
Sodda tilda yozilgani uchun kitobni tushunish oson.

5. Not knowing the answer, he stayed silent.
Javobni bilmagani uchun u jim qoldi.

6. Built in 1990, the school is still modern.
1990-yilda qurilgan maktab hali ham zamonaviy.

7. Working hard, she improved her English.
Qattiq ishlab, u ingliz tilini yaxshiladi.

8. Having saved enough money, he bought a laptop.
Yetarli pul yig‘ib, u noutbuk sotib oldi.

2. Types of Participle Clauses

A) Present Participle Clause: V-ing

The V-ing form is used in two main cases:

1. When two actions occur at the same time

2. To indicate a reason

Example

Because he felt tired, he went home.

Feeling tired, he went home.

5 examples

1. Walking home, I met my friend.
Uyga ketayotganimda do‘stimni uchratdim.

2. Feeling nervous, she could not answer well.
Hayajonlangani uchun u yaxshi javob bera olmadi.

3. Knowing the rule, he solved the test quickly.
Qoidani bilgani uchun u testni tez yechdi.

4. Looking at the board, the students copied the sentence.
Doskaga qarab, talabalar gapni ko‘chirishdi.

5. Being busy, I could not call you.
Band bo‘lganim uchun sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qila olmadim.

B) Past Participle Clause: V3

The V3 form is usually used in a passive sense, meaning 'done', 'written', 'built', 'given'.

Example

The book which was written by Orwell is famous.

Written by Orwell, the book is famous.

5 examples

1. Written in English, the article is useful for students.
Ingliz tilida yozilgan maqola talabalar uchun foydali.

2. Built many years ago, the bridge is still strong.
Ko‘p yillar oldin qurilgan ko‘prik hali ham mustahkam.

3. Designed by experts, the course is very effective.
Mutaxassislar tomonidan tuzilgan kurs juda samarali.

4. Given enough time, students can finish the task.
Yetarli vaqt berilsa, talabalar vazifani tugata oladi.

5. Translated into Uzbek, the text became easier to understand.
O‘zbek tiliga tarjima qilingach, matnni tushunish osonlashdi.

C) Perfect Participle Clause: Having + V3

Having + V3 indicates that one action was completed before another action.

Example

After she had finished her work, she left.

Having finished her work, she left.

5 examples

1. Having finished the exam, he left the classroom.
Imtihonni tugatib, u sinfxonadan chiqdi.

2. Having read the article, she wrote a summary.
Maqolani o‘qib, u qisqa xulosa yozdi.

3. Having completed the project, they presented it.
Loyihani tugatib, ular uni taqdim qilishdi.

4. Having received the email, I replied immediately.
Emailni olib, men darhol javob berdim.

5. Having learned the rule, the students did the exercises.
Qoidani o‘rganib, talabalar mashqlarni bajarishdi.

3. When is a Participle Clause used?

Situation | Example | Translation
Reason | Feeling ill, he stayed at home. | Kasal bo‘lgani uchun u uyda qoldi.
Time | Walking to school, I saw my teacher. | Maktabga ketayotganimda o‘qituvchimni ko‘rdim.
Result | The fire spread quickly, destroying many houses. | Yong‘in tez tarqalib, ko‘p uylarni vayron qildi.
Additional information | My brother, studying in London, speaks English well. | Londonda o‘qiyotgan akam ingliz tilida yaxshi gapiradi.
Passive meaning | Written by a famous writer, the book is popular. | Mashhur yozuvchi tomonidan yozilgan kitob ommabop.

4. Important rule: the subject must be the same

When using a participle clause, the subject of the participle clause and the main clause must be the same.

Correct

Feeling tired, I went home.
Charchaganim uchun men uyga ketdim.

Here both feeling tired and going home refer to I.

Dangling participle error

Dangling participle — an error that occurs when the subject of the participle clause does not match the subject of the main clause.

Incorrect

❌ Walking to school, the rain started.
While I was walking to school, the rain started.

This is an error because 'rain' does not walk to school.

Correct

✅ Walking to school, I saw that the rain started.
While I was walking to school, I saw that the rain started.

Or:

✅ While I was walking to school, the rain started.
While I was walking to school, the rain started.

More examples

❌ Feeling hungry, the food was cooked.
✅ Feeling hungry, I cooked some food.
I cooked some food because I was feeling hungry.

❌ Reading the book, the phone rang.
✅ Reading the book, I heard the phone ring.
I heard the phone ring while I was reading the book.

5. What is nominalisation?

Nominalisation — turning a verb or adjective into a noun.

This method makes a sentence more serious, compact, and academic in formal writing.

Simple example

The students improved their English.
The students improved their English.

There was an improvement in the students’ English.
There was an improvement in the students’ English.

Here:

improve — to improve
improvement

8 examples

1. decide → decision
qaror qilmoq → decision

2. develop → development
rivojlanmoq → development

3. improve → improvement
yaxshilamoq → improvement

4. explain → explanation
tushuntirmoq → explanation

5. educate → education
ta’lim bermoq → education

6. succeed → success
muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq → success

7. fail → failure
muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoq → failure

8. different → difference
farqli → difference

6. Examples of Nominalisation

Verb / adjective | Noun | Sentence | Uzbek
decide | decision | His decision was correct. | Uning qarori to‘g‘ri edi.
develop | development | The development of technology is fast. | Texnologiyaning rivojlanishi tez.
improve | improvement | There was an improvement in her writing. | Uning yozuvida yaxshilanish bo‘ldi.
investigate | investigation | The investigation took two months. | Tekshiruv ikki oy davom etdi.
analyze | analysis | The analysis of the data was useful. | Ma’lumotlar tahlili foydali bo‘ldi.
explain | explanation | His explanation was clear. | Uning tushuntirishi aniq edi.
educate | education | Education is important for society. | Ta’lim jamiyat uchun muhim.
succeed | success | Success requires hard work. | Muvaffaqiyat qattiq mehnatni talab qiladi.
fail | failure | Failure can teach important lessons. | Muvaffaqiyatsizlik muhim saboqlar berishi mumkin.
different | difference | There is a big difference between the two methods. | Ikki metod o‘rtasida katta farq bor.

7. Transition from Simple Sentences to Academic Sentences

Simple sentence | More academic sentence | Translation
The government decided to change the system. | The government’s decision to change the system was important. | Hukumatning tizimni o‘zgartirish qarori muhim edi.
The company developed a new app. | The development of a new app helped the company. | Yangi ilovaning ishlab chiqilishi kompaniyaga yordam berdi.
Students improved their speaking. | The improvement of students’ speaking was clear. | Talabalarning gapirishidagi yaxshilanish aniq edi.
Researchers investigated the problem. | The investigation of the problem took several months. | Muammoning tekshirilishi bir necha oy davom etdi.
They analyzed the results carefully. | The analysis of the results was careful. | Natijalarning tahlili ehtiyotkorlik bilan qilindi.
The teacher explained the rule. | The teacher’s explanation of the rule was clear. | O‘qituvchining qoidani tushuntirishi aniq edi.
The school educates young people. | The education of young people is important. | Yoshlarning ta’limi muhim.
He succeeded in the exam. | His success in the exam surprised everyone. | Uning imtihondagi muvaffaqiyati hammani hayratlantirdi.
The plan failed. | The failure of the plan caused problems. | Rejaning muvaffaqiyatsizligi muammolarga sabab bo‘ldi.
The two methods are different. | The difference between the two methods is clear. | Ikki metod o‘rtasidagi farq aniq.

8. Difference between Participle Clauses and Nominalisation

Question | Participle clause | Nominalisation
What does it do? | Shortens a sentence. | Converts a verb or adjective into a noun.
When is it used? | To provide reason, time, passive or additional information. | In academic and formal writing.
Form | V-ing, V3, Having + V3 | decision, development, analysis
Example | Feeling tired, he went home. | His decision was important.
Translation | Charchagani uchun u uyga ketdi. | Uning qarori muhim edi.

9. Common Mistakes

1. Using a participle clause when the subjects are different

❌ Walking to school, the rain started.
✅ While I was walking to school, the rain started.
Men maktabga ketayotganimda yomg‘ir boshlandi.

Note: The rain does not walk to school. Subjects must match.

2. Confusing V-ing and V3

❌ Writing by Shakespeare, the play is famous.
✅ Written by Shakespeare, the play is famous.
Shakespeare tomonidan yozilgan pyesa mashhur.

Note: V3 is needed in the passive meaning.

3. Incorrect use of Having + V3

❌ Having finish the task, he left.
✅ Having finished the task, he left.
Having finished the task, he left.

Note: V3 is used after Having.

4. Incorrect noun form selection in nominalisation

❌ The improve of students was clear.
✅ The improvement of students was clear.
The improvement of students was clear.

Note: improve — verb, improvement — noun.

5. Overuse of nominalisation

❌ The implementation of the improvement of the development of education was necessary.
✅ It was necessary to improve and develop education.
It was necessary to improve and develop education.

Note: Nominalisation is useful, but if used excessively, the sentence becomes cumbersome.
grammar_rules_ru:
Participle clause — грамматическая форма, используемая для сокращения предложения. Она делает текст компактнее, плавнее и академичнее.

Обычное предложение:

Because he felt tired, he went home.
Он ушёл домой, потому что устал.

Сокращённое предложение:

Feeling tired, he went home.
Чувствуя усталость, он ушёл домой.

Здесь часть because he felt tired сократилась до feeling tired.

Разница между полным предложением и participle clause

Полное предложение | Participle clause | Перевод
Because I was late, I took a taxi. | Being late, I took a taxi. | Я взял такси, потому что опоздал.
When she saw the teacher, she stopped talking. | Seeing the teacher, she stopped talking. | Увидев учителя, она перестала говорить.
After he finished his homework, he went out. | Having finished his homework, he went out. | Закончив домашнее задание, он вышел на улицу.
The book which was written by Orwell is famous. | Written by Orwell, the book is famous. | Книга, написанная Оруэллом, известна.

8 примеров

1. Feeling tired, I went to bed early.
Чувствуя усталость, я лег спать пораньше.

2. Seeing the police, the driver stopped.
Увидев полицию, водитель остановился.

3. Having finished the test, the students left the room.
Закончив тест, студенты покинули комнату.

4. Written in simple language, the book is easy to understand.
Написанная простым языком, книга легко понимается.

5. Not knowing the answer, he stayed silent.
Не зная ответа, он молчал.

6. Built in 1990, the school is still modern.
Построенная в 1990 году, школа всё ещё современна.

7. Working hard, she improved her English.
Усердно работая, она улучшила свой английский.

8. Having saved enough money, he bought a laptop.
Накопив достаточно денег, он купил ноутбук.

2. Виды Participles Clauses

A) Present Participle Clause: V-ing

Форма V-ing используется в двух основных случаях:

1. Когда два действия происходят одновременно

2. Когда указывает на причину

Пример

Because he felt tired, he went home.
Он ушёл домой, потому что устал.

Feeling tired, he went home.
Чувствуя усталость, он ушёл домой.

5 примеров

1. Walking home, I met my friend.
Идя домой, я встретил своего друга.

2. Feeling nervous, she could not answer well.
Поскольку она нервничала, она не смогла ответить хорошо.

3. Knowing the rule, he solved the test quickly.
Зная правило, он быстро решил тест.

4. Looking at the board, the students copied the sentence.
Смотря на доску, студенты переписали предложение.

5. Being busy, I could not call you.
Будучи занятым, я не смог вам позвонить.

B) Past Participle Clause: V3

Форма V3 обычно используется в пассивном залоге, то есть в значении «сделанный», «написанный», «построенный», «данный».

Пример

The book which was written by Orwell is famous.
Книга, написанная Оруэллом, известна.

Written by Orwell, the book is famous.
Книга, написанная Оруэллом, известна.

5 примеров

1. Written in English, the article is useful for students.
Статья, написанная на английском, полезна для студентов.

2. Built many years ago, the bridge is still strong.
Мост, построенный много лет назад, всё ещё крепок.

3. Designed by experts, the course is very effective.
Курс, разработанный экспертами, очень эффективен.

4. Given enough time, students can finish the task.
Если дать достаточно времени, студенты могут закончить задание.

5. Translated into Uzbek, the text became easier to understand.
Переведённый на узбекский, текст стал легче для понимания.

C) Perfect Participle Clause: Having + V3

Having + V3 указывает на то, что одно действие завершилось до другого действия.

Пример

After she had finished her work, she left.
Она ушла, закончив свою работу.

Having finished her work, she left.
Закончив свою работу, она ушла.

5 примеров

1. Having finished the exam, he left the classroom.
Закончив экзамен, он вышел из класса.

2. Having read the article, she wrote a summary.
Прочитав статью, она написала краткое резюме.

3. Having completed the project, they presented it.
Завершив проект, они представили его.

4. Having received the email, I replied immediately.
Получив электронное письмо, я сразу ответил.

5. Having learned the rule, the students did the exercises.
Изучив правило, студенты выполнили упражнения.

3. Когда используется Participle Clause?

Состояние | Пример | Перевод
Причина | Feeling ill, he stayed at home. | Поскольку он был болен, он остался дома.
Время | Walking to school, I saw my teacher. | Идя в школу, я увидел своего учителя.
Результат | The fire spread quickly, destroying many houses. | Пожар быстро распространился, разрушив много домов.
Дополнительная информация | My brother, studying in London, speaks English well. | Мой брат, который учится в Лондоне, хорошо говорит по-английски.
Пассивное значение | Written by a famous writer, the book is popular. | Книга, написанная известным писателем, популярна.

4. Важное правило: подлежащее должно быть одинаковым

При использовании participle clause подлежащее participle clause и основного предложения должно быть одинаковым.

Правильно

Feeling tired, I went home.
Чувствуя усталость, я ушёл домой.

Здесь и усталость, и уход домой — это я.

Ошибки висячего причастия

Висячее причастие — ошибка, возникающая, когда подлежащее в причастном обороте не соответствует подлежащему в основном предложении.

Неправильно

❌ Walking to school, the rain started.
Мой дождь начался, когда я шёл в школу.

Эта ошибка, потому что «дождь» не ходит в школу.

Правильно

✅ Walking to school, I saw that the rain started.
Я увидел, что дождь начался, когда шёл в школу.

Или:

✅ While I was walking to school, the rain started.
Когда я шёл в школу, дождь начался.

Другие примеры

❌ Feeling hungry, the food was cooked.
✅ Feeling hungry, I cooked some food.
Я приготовил еду, потому что был голоден.

❌ Reading the book, the phone rang.
✅ Reading the book, I heard the phone ring.
Я услышал, как зазвонил телефон, когда читал книгу.

5. Что такое номинализация?

Номинализация — это превращение глагола или прилагательного в существительное.

Этот метод делает предложение более серьезным, компактным и научным в академическом и официальном письме.

Простой пример

The students improved their English.
Студенты улучшили свой английский.

There was an improvement in the students’ English.
В английском языке студентов произошло улучшение.

Здесь:

improve — улучшать
improvement — улучшение

8 простых примеров

1. decide → decision
решать → решение

2. develop → development
развивать → развитие

3. improve → improvement
улучшать → улучшение

4. explain → explanation
объяснять → объяснение

5. educate → education
обучать → образование

6. succeed → success
достигать успеха → успех

7. fail → failure
терпеть неудачу → неудача

8. different → difference
разный → разница

6. Примеры номинализации

Глагол / прилагательное | Существительное | Предложение | Перевод
decide | decision | His decision was correct. | Его решение было правильным.
develop | development | The development of technology is fast. | Развитие технологий быстрое.
improve | improvement | There was an improvement in her writing. | В её письме произошло улучшение.
investigate | investigation | The investigation took two months. | Расследование заняло два месяца.
analyze | analysis | The analysis of the data was useful. | Анализ данных был полезен.
explain | explanation | His explanation was clear. | Его объяснение было ясным.
educate | education | Education is important for society. | Образование важно для общества.
succeed | success | Success requires hard work. | Успех требует упорного труда.
fail | failure | Failure can teach important lessons. | Неудача может научить важным урокам.
different | difference | There is a big difference between the two methods. | Между двумя методами есть большая разница.

7. Переход от простого предложения к академическому

Простое предложение | Более академическое предложение | Перевод
The government decided to change the system. | The government’s decision to change the system was important. | Решение правительства изменить систему было важным.
The company developed a new app. | The development of a new app helped the company. | Разработка нового приложения помогла компании.
Students improved their speaking. | The improvement of students’ speaking was clear. | Улучшение речи студентов было очевидным.
Researchers investigated the problem. | The investigation of the problem took several months. | Исследование проблемы заняло несколько месяцев.
They analyzed the results carefully. | The analysis of the results was careful. | Анализ результатов был тщательным.
The teacher explained the rule. | The teacher’s explanation of the rule was clear. | Объяснение правила учителем было ясным.
The school educates young people. | The education of young people is important. | Образование молодежи важно.
He succeeded in the exam. | His success in the exam surprised everyone. | Его успех на экзамене удивил всех.
The plan failed. | The failure of the plan caused problems. | Неудача плана вызвала проблемы.
The two methods are different. | The difference between the two methods is clear. | Разница между двумя методами очевидна.

8. Разница между Participles Clauses и Номинализацией

Вопрос | Participles clause | Номинализация
Что делает? | Сокращает предложение. | Превращает глагол или прилагательное в существительное.
Когда используется? | Для указания причины, времени, пассивного или дополнительного значения. | В академическом и официальном письме.
Форма | V-ing, V3, Having + V3 | decision, development, analysis
Пример | Feeling tired, he went home. | His decision was important.
Перевод | Устав, он пошёл домой. | Его решение было важным.

9. Часто совершаемые ошибки

1. Использование participle clause, когда подлежащее не совпадает

❌ Walking to school, the rain started.
✅ While I was walking to school, the rain started.
Когда я шёл в школу, дождь начался.

Примечание: Дождь не ходит в школу. Подлежащее должно совпадать.

2. Путаница между V-ing и V3

❌ Writing by Shakespeare, the play is famous.
✅ Written by Shakespeare, the play is famous.
Пьеса, написанная Шекспиром, известна.

Примечание: Для пассивного значения требуется V3.

3. Неправильное использование Having + V3

❌ Having finish the task, he left.
✅ Having finished the task, he left.
Завершив задание, он ушёл.

Примечание: После Having используется V3.

4. Неправильный выбор формы существительного в номинализации

❌ The improve of students was clear.
✅ The improvement of students was clear.
Улучшение студентов было очевидно.

Примечание: improve — глагол, improvement — существительное.

5. Чрезмерное использование номинализации

❌ The implementation of the improvement of the development of education was necessary.
✅ It was necessary to improve and develop education.
Необходимо было улучшить и развивать образование.

Примечание: Номинализация полезна, но при чрезмерном использовании предложение становится громоздким.
grammar_rules_kk:
Participle clause — gápti qısqartıw ushın qollanılatuǵın grammatikalıq forma. Ol tekstti ıqshamıraq, rawanıraq hám akademiyalıqıraq etedi.

Ápiwayı gáp:

Because he felt tired, he went home.
Ol sharshaǵanı ushın úyge ketti.

Qısqartılǵan gáp:

Feeling tired, he went home.
Sharshap, ol úyge ketti.

Bul jerde because he felt tired bólimi feeling tired formasına qısqardı.

Tolıq gáp hám participle clause ayırması

Tolıq gáp | Participle clause | Tarjima
Because I was late, I took a taxi. | Being late, I took a taxi. | Kech qolğanım ushın taksige chiqdim.
When she saw the teacher, she stopped talking. | Seeing the teacher, she stopped talking. | O‘qituvchini ko‘rib, u gapirishni to‘xtatdı.
After he finished his homework, he went out. | Having finished his homework, he went out. | Uy vazifasın tugatıp, ol tashqarıga chiqtı.
The book which was written by Orwell is famous. | Written by Orwell, the book is famous. | Orwell tarafından yozılğan kitap mashhur.

8 ta mısal

1. Feeling tired, I went to bed early.
Sharshap, men erta uxladım.

2. Seeing the police, the driver stopped.
Politsiyani ko‘rib, haydovçı to‘xtadı.

3. Having finished the test, the students left the room.
Testni tugatıp, talabalar xonadan chiqıp ketti.

4. Written in simple language, the book is easy to understand.
Sodda tilda yozılğanı ushın kitapni túsinuw oson.

5. Not knowing the answer, he stayed silent.
Javobni bilmegeni ushın ol jim qaldı.

6. Built in 1990, the school is still modern.
1990-jılda qurılğan mektep hali ham zamonaviy.

7. Working hard, she improved her English.
Qattıq islep, u ingliz tilin jaqsılaydı.

8. Having saved enough money, he bought a laptop.
Yetarli pul jıgıp, ol noutbuk satıp aldı.

2. Participle Clauses turları

A) Present Participle Clause: V-ing

V-ing shaklı eki asası holatta qollanıladı:

1. Eki iş bir waqıtta sodır bolsa

2. Sabab bildirse

Mısal

Because he felt tired, he went home.
Ol sharshaǵanı ushın úyge ketti.

Feeling tired, he went home.
Sharshap, ol úyge ketti.

5 ta mısal

1. Walking home, I met my friend.
Uyğa ketip barıp, men do‘stimni uchratıp aldım.

2. Feeling nervous, she could not answer well.
Hayajonlanğanı ushın u jaqsı javob berip olmadı.

3. Knowing the rule, he solved the test quickly.
Qoidanı bilgeni ushın ol testni tez yechti.

4. Looking at the board, the students copied the sentence.
Doskaga qarap, talabalar gapni ko‘chirdi.

5. Being busy, I could not call you.
Band bolğanım ushın sizge qo‘ng‘iroq qıla almadım.

B) Past Participle Clause: V3

V3 shaklı odatda passive, yaǵnıy “qılınğan”, “yozılğan”, “qurılğan”, “berilğan” ma’nosında qollanıladı.

Mısal

The book which was written by Orwell is famous.
Orwell tarafından yozılğan kitap mashhur.

Written by Orwell, the book is famous.
Orwell tarafından yozılğan kitap mashhur.

5 ta mısal

1. Written in English, the article is useful for students.
Ingliz tilında yozılğan maqala talabalar ushın foydalı.

2. Built many years ago, the bridge is still strong.
Kóp jıldar aldın qurılğan köprü hali ham mustahkam.

3. Designed by experts, the course is very effective.
Mutaxassislar tarafından tuzılğan kurs juda samaralı.

4. Given enough time, students can finish the task.
Yetarli waqıt berilse, talabalar vazifanı tugata aladı.

5. Translated into Uzbek, the text became easier to understand.
Ózbek tiline tarjıma qılınğanda, matnni túsinuw osonlaştı.

C) Perfect Participle Clause: Having + V3

Having + V3 bir iş ikkinci işden aldın tugatılğanın bildiradi.

Mısal

After she had finished her work, she left.
U ishın tugatıp, ketti.

Having finished her work, she left.
Işın tugatıp, u ketti.

5 ta mısal

1. Having finished the exam, he left the classroom.
Imtihonni tugatıp, u sinfxonadan chiqıp ketti.

2. Having read the article, she wrote a summary.
Maqolani o‘qıp, u qisqa xulosa yozdı.

3. Having completed the project, they presented it.
Loyihani tugatıp, olar uni taqdim etdi.

4. Having received the email, I replied immediately.
Emailni alıp, men darhol javob berdim.

5. Having learned the rule, the students did the exercises.
Qoidanı úyrenip, talabalar mashqlarni bajardı.

3. Participle Clause qachon ishlatiladı?

Holat | Mısal | Tarjima
Sabab | Feeling ill, he stayed at home. | Kasal bolğanı ushın u uyda qaldı.
Vaqıt | Walking to school, I saw my teacher. | Maktabqa ketip barıp, o‘qituvchimni ko‘rdim.
Natija | The fire spread quickly, destroying many houses. | Yong‘ın tez tarqalıp, kóp uylarni vayron qıldı.
Qo‘shimça ma’lumot | My brother, studying in London, speaks English well. | Londonda o‘qiyotğan akam ingliz tilinde jaqsı gapiradı.
Passive ma’no | Written by a famous writer, the book is popular. | Mashhur yozuǵı tarafından yozılğan kitap ommabop.

4. Muhim qoida: subject bir xil boluwı kerek

Participle clause qollanılğanda, participle clause hám asası gápda bajarıwşı bir xil boluwı kerek.

To‘g‘ri

Feeling tired, I went home.
Sharshap, men úyge ketti.

Bul jerde sharshap hám men, úyge ketken hám men.

Dangling participle xatosı

Dangling participle — participle clause’dagi subject asası gápda subject menen mos kelmegende yuzaga kelgen xato.

Noto‘g‘ri

❌ Walking to school, the rain started.
Maktabga ketip barğanda yomg‘ir boshlandi.

Bu xato, çünki “rain” maktabga yurmaydı.

To‘g‘ri

✅ Walking to school, I saw that the rain started.
Maktabga ketip barğanda yomg‘ir boslanganın kördim.

Yoki:

✅ While I was walking to school, the rain started.
Men maktabga ketip barğanda yomg‘ir boshlandi.

Yana mısallar

❌ Feeling hungry, the food was cooked.
✅ Feeling hungry, I cooked some food.
Och qolğanın üşin ovqat pishirdim.

❌ Reading the book, the phone rang.
✅ Reading the book, I heard the phone ring.
Kitob o‘qıp otırğanda telefon jiringlaganın eshitdim.

5. Nominalisation nima?

Nominalisation — feyil yaki kelbetlikti atqa aylantıw.

Bu usul akademik hám rasmiy yozuwda gápni jiddiyraq, ıqshamıraq hám ilmiyraq etedi.

Ápiwayı mısal

The students improved their English.
Talabalar ingliz tilin yaxshıladı.

There was an improvement in the students’ English.
Talabalarnıñ ingliz tilindegi yaxshılaw boldı.

Bu yerde:

improve — yaxshılamaq
improvement — yaxshılaw

8 ta sodda mısal

1. decide → decision
qaror qilmaq → qaror

2. develop → development
rivojlanmaq → rivojlanıw

3. improve → improvement
yaxshılamaq → yaxshılaw

4. explain → explanation
túsindiriw → tushuntırıw

5. educate → education
ta’lim bermek → ta’lim

6. succeed → success
muvaffaqiyatqa erişiw → muvaffaqiyat

7. fail → failure
muvaffaqiyatsızlıqqa uçraiw → muvaffaqiyatsızlıq

8. different → difference
farqlı → farq

6. Nominalisation mısalları

Verb / adjective | Noun | Gáp | Tarjima
decide | decision | His decision was correct. | Unıñ qarorı to‘g‘ri edi.
develop | development | The development of technology is fast. | Texnologiyanıñ rivojlanıwı tez.
improve | improvement | There was an improvement in her writing. | Unıñ yozuında yaxshılaw boldı.
investigate | investigation | The investigation took two months. | Tekşiriw ikki ay davom etdi.
analyze | analysis | The analysis of the data was useful. | Ma’lumotlardıñ tahlili foydalı boldı.
explain | explanation | His explanation was clear. | Unıñ túsindiriwi anıq edi.
educate | education | Education is important for society. | Ta’lim jamiyat üşin muhim.
succeed | success | Success requires hard work. | Muvaffaqiyat qattiq jumıs talap etedi.
fail | failure | Failure can teach important lessons. | Muvaffaqiyatsızlıq muhim saboqlar beriwı mümkin.
different | difference | There is a big difference between the two methods. | Ikki metod arasında katta farq bar.

7. Oddı gápdan akademik gápqa ötüw

Oddı gáp | Akademikroq gáp | Tarjima
The government decided to change the system. | The government’s decision to change the system was important. | Hukumatnıñ tizimni özgertiw qarorı muhim edi.
The company developed a new app. | The development of a new app helped the company. | Jańa ilovanıñ işläp şıqarılıwı kompaniyaga yardım berdi.
Students improved their speaking. | The improvement of students’ speaking was clear. | Talabalarnıñ gapırwında yaxshılaw anıq edi.
Researchers investigated the problem. | The investigation of the problem took several months. | Muammanıñ tekşirilwi bir neşe ay davom etdi.
They analyzed the results carefully. | The analysis of the results was careful. | Natijalardıñ tahlili ehtiyotkorlıq menen qılındı.
The teacher explained the rule. | The teacher’s explanation of the rule was clear. | O‘qıtwşınıñ qoidanı túsindiriwi anıq edi.
The school educates young people. | The education of young people is important. | Jaşlarnıñ ta’limi muhim.
He succeeded in the exam. | His success in the exam surprised everyone. | Unıñ imtihondakı muvaffaqiyatı hammanı hayratlandırdı.
The plan failed. | The failure of the plan caused problems. | Rejanıñ muvaffaqiyatsızlığı muammolarga sebep boldı.
The two methods are different. | The difference between the two methods is clear. | Ikki metod arasındağı farq anıq.

8. Participle Clauses hám Nominalisation farqı

Savol | Participle clause | Nominalisation
Nima qiladi? | Gápni qısqartadı. | Feyil yaki kelbetlikti atqa aylantıradı.
Qachon ishlatiladı? | Sabab, waqıt, passive yaki qosımça ma’lumot beriwde. | Akademik hám rasmiy yozuwda.
Shaklı | V-ing, V3, Having + V3 | decision, development, analysis
Mısal | Feeling tired, he went home. | His decision was important.
Tarjima | Charchap, u uyğa ketti. | Unıñ qarorı muhim edi.

9. Kóp qılınatın xatolar

1. Subject bir xil bolmağanda participle clause qollanıladı

❌ Walking to school, the rain started.
✅ While I was walking to school, the rain started.
Men maktabga ketip barğanda yomg‘ir boshlandi.

Izah: Yomg‘ir maktabga yurmaydı. Subject mos bolwı kerek.

2. V-ing hám V3 ni adashtırw

❌ Writing by Shakespeare, the play is famous.
✅ Written by Shakespeare, the play is famous.
Shakespeare tarafından yozılğan pyesa mashhur.

Izah: Passive ma’noda V3 kerek.

3. Having + V3 ni noto‘g‘ri qollanılıwı

❌ Having finish the task, he left.
✅ Having finished the task, he left.
Vazifani tugatıp, u ketti.

Izah: Having’dan keyin V3 qollanıladı.

4. Nominalisation’da noto‘g‘ri atlıq şekilini tanlaw

❌ The improve of students was clear.
✅ The improvement of students was clear.
Talabalardagi yaxshılanıw anıq edi.

Izah: improve — feyil, improvement — atlıq.

5. Juda kóbinese nominalisation qollanılıwı

❌ The implementation of the improvement of the development of education was necessary.
✅ It was necessary to improve and develop education.
Ta’limni yaxshılań hám rivojlantıw zarur edi.

Izah: Nominalisation foydalı, biraq haddan tashqarı kóbinese qollanılğanda gáp og‘ırlawı mumkin.
reading_passage:
A university English class is exploring why a classic novel remains influential through a short article set in a literature seminar.

Written more than a century ago, the novel still attracts new readers because its central conflict feels familiar. Having finished the book, students compare the main character’s choices with modern social pressures.

The publication of the novel changed the author’s reputation and encouraged later writers to explore similar themes. Discussion of the book focuses on influence, interpretation and the transformation of private experience into public art.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Having finished the novel, the students discussed its influence; the publication of the book changed public debate.” The seminar shows how grammatical compression can support more formal academic discussion.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Sara and Leo compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.
