grammar_rules:
Inversion — ingliz tilida gapdagi odatiy so‘z tartibining o‘zgarishi.

Oddiy gapda tartib odatda shunday bo‘ladi:

Subject + auxiliary verb + main verb

Masalan:

I have never seen such a beautiful place.
Men hech qachon bunday chiroyli joyni ko‘rmaganman.

Inversion’da esa auxiliary verb subjectdan oldinga chiqadi:

Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
Men hech qachon bunday chiroyli joyni ko‘rmaganman.

Inversion odatda:

• rasmiy nutqda,

• akademik yozuvda,

• imtihon uslubidagi gaplarda,

• gapga kuchli urg‘u berishda ishlatiladi.

8 ta misol

1. Never have I heard such a strange story.
Men hech qachon bunday g‘alati hikoyani eshitmaganman.

2. Rarely do students ask such deep questions.
Talabalar kamdan-kam hollarda bunday chuqur savollar berishadi.

3. Seldom does he arrive late.
U juda kam hollarda kech keladi.

4. Hardly ever do we see such results.
Biz bunday natijalarni deyarli hech qachon ko‘rmaymiz.

5. Little did she know about the problem.
U muammo haqida deyarli hech narsa bilmas edi.

6. Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.
U nafaqat imtihondan o‘tdi, balki eng yuqori ball ham oldi.

7. No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.
Men yetib kelishim bilanoq yomg‘ir boshlandi.

8. Only after the lesson did I understand the topic.
Faqat darsdan keyin mavzuni tushundim.

2. Inversion formulasi

Asosiy formula

Negative adverbial + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb

Ya’ni:

Negative adverbial — never, rarely, seldom, no sooner, hardly, only after kabi iboralar.
Auxiliary verb — do, does, did, have, has, had, can, will, should va boshqalar.
Subject — I, he, she, they, students, teacher va hokazo.
Main verb — asosiy fe’l.

Misol

Oddiy gap:

I have never seen such a beautiful place.
Men hech qachon bunday chiroyli joyni ko‘rmaganman.

Inversion:

Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
Men hech qachon bunday chiroyli joyni ko‘rmaganman.

Bu yerda:

Never — negative adverbial
have — auxiliary verb
I — subject
seen — main verb

3. Inversion ishlatiladigan asosiy iboralar

1. Never

Ma’nosi: hech qachon

Never have I seen such a mistake.
Men hech qachon bunday xatoni ko‘rmaganman.

2. Rarely

Ma’nosi: kamdan-kam

Rarely does he speak in public.
U kamdan-kam hollarda omma oldida gapiradi.

3. Seldom

Ma’nosi: juda kam hollarda

Seldom do students finish this task quickly.
Talabalar bu vazifani juda kam hollarda tez tugatishadi.

4. Hardly ever

Ma’nosi: deyarli hech qachon

Hardly ever do we use this word in daily speech.
Biz bu so‘zni kundalik nutqda deyarli ishlatmaymiz.

5. Little

Ma’nosi: deyarli bilmaslik, kutmaslik

Little did he know that his life would change.
U hayoti o‘zgarishini umuman bilmas edi.

6. Not only

Ma’nosi: nafaqat

Not only did she win the competition, but she also broke the record.
U nafaqat musobaqada g‘olib bo‘ldi, balki rekord ham o‘rnatdi.

7. No sooner

Ma’nosi: ... bilanoq

No sooner had we started the lesson than the lights went off.
Darsni boshlashimiz bilanoq chiroqlar o‘chdi.

8. Hardly / Scarcely

Ma’nosi: endigina, zo‘rg‘a

Hardly had I opened the book when the phone rang.
Kitobni endigina ochgan edim, telefon jiringladi.

Scarcely had they arrived when the meeting began.
Ular endigina yetib kelgan edi, uchrashuv boshlandi.

9. Under no circumstances

Ma’nosi: hech qanday holatda

Under no circumstances should you share your password.
Hech qanday holatda parolingizni boshqalar bilan bo‘lishmasligingiz kerak.

10. On no account

Ma’nosi: aslo, hech qanday holatda

On no account must students use phones during the exam.
Imtihon paytida talabalar aslo telefondan foydalanmasligi kerak.

11. Only then

Ma’nosi: faqat shundan keyin

Only then did I realize my mistake.
Faqat shundan keyin xatoimni tushundim.

12. Only after

Ma’nosi: faqat ... dan keyin

Only after the test did I understand the topic.
Faqat testdan keyin mavzuni tushundim.

13. Only when

Ma’nosi: faqat ... qachonki

Only when I saw the result did I believe it.
Faqat natijani ko‘rganimda bunga ishondim.

14. Not until

Ma’nosi: faqat ... gacha emas / ... bo‘lgandagina

Not until the teacher explained it did I understand the rule.
O‘qituvchi tushuntirgandan keyingina qoidani tushundim.

4. Eng muhim inversion turlari

A) Negative adverbs bilan inversion

Negative adverbs gap boshiga chiqsa, inversion ishlatiladi.

1. Never

Never have I heard this story.
Men bu hikoyani hech qachon eshitmaganman.

2. Rarely

Rarely do people get such an opportunity.
Odamlar bunday imkoniyatni kamdan-kam olishadi.

3. Seldom

Seldom does she make grammar mistakes.
U juda kam hollarda grammatik xato qiladi.

B) Not only ... but also

Not only gap boshida kelsa, birinchi qismda inversion ishlatiladi.

Formula

Not only + auxiliary + subject + main verb, but subject also + verb

3 ta misol

1. Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.
U nafaqat imtihondan o‘tdi, balki eng yuqori ball ham oldi.

2. Not only does she speak English, but she also speaks French.
U nafaqat ingliz tilida, balki fransuz tilida ham gapiradi.

3. Not only was the lesson useful, but it was also interesting.
Dars nafaqat foydali, balki qiziqarli ham edi.

C) No sooner ... than

Bir ish bo‘lishi bilanoq ikkinchi ish sodir bo‘lsa ishlatiladi.

Formula

No sooner + had + subject + V3 + than + subject + past verb

3 ta misol

1. No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.
Men yetib kelishim bilanoq yomg‘ir boshlandi.

2. No sooner had she entered the room than everyone became silent.
U xonaga kirishi bilanoq hamma jim bo‘lib qoldi.

3. No sooner had the exam started than one student asked a question.
Imtihon boshlanishi bilanoq bir talaba savol berdi.

D) Hardly / Scarcely ... when

Bir ish endigina bo‘lgan paytda ikkinchi ish sodir bo‘lsa ishlatiladi.

Formula

Hardly / Scarcely + had + subject + V3 + when + subject + past verb

3 ta misol

1. Hardly had she left when the phone rang.
U endigina ketgan edi, telefon jiringladi.

2. Scarcely had we sat down when the teacher entered.
Biz endigina o‘tirgan edik, o‘qituvchi kirdi.

3. Hardly had I opened my notebook when the lesson began.
Daftarimni endigina ochgan edim, dars boshlandi.

E) Only after / only when / only then

Bu iboralar gap boshida kelsa, asosiy gapda inversion bo‘ladi.

3 ta misol

1. Only after the lesson did I understand the topic.
Faqat darsdan keyin mavzuni tushundim.

2. Only when I checked my answers did I notice the mistake.
Faqat javoblarimni tekshirganimda xatoni payqadim.

3. Only then did she realize the importance of grammar.
Faqat shundan keyin u grammatikaning muhimligini tushundi.

5. Oddiy gapni inversion gapga aylantirish

Oddiy gap | Inversion gap | Tarjima
I have never seen such a result. | Never have I seen such a result. | Men hech qachon bunday natijani ko‘rmaganman.
He rarely comes late. | Rarely does he come late. | U kamdan-kam hollarda kech keladi.
She seldom makes mistakes. | Seldom does she make mistakes. | U juda kam xato qiladi.
I hardly ever watch TV. | Hardly ever do I watch TV. | Men deyarli televizor ko‘rmayman.
He knew little about the problem. | Little did he know about the problem. | U muammo haqida deyarli bilmas edi.
He not only passed the exam, but also won a prize. | Not only did he pass the exam, but he also won a prize. | U nafaqat imtihondan o‘tdi, balki mukofot ham yutdi.
I had no sooner arrived than the lesson started. | No sooner had I arrived than the lesson started. | Men yetib kelishim bilanoq dars boshlandi.
She had hardly left when he called. | Hardly had she left when he called. | U endigina ketgan edi, u qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.
I understood the topic only after the teacher explained it. | Only after the teacher explained it did I understand the topic. | Faqat o‘qituvchi tushuntirgandan keyin mavzuni tushundim.
I realized my mistake only then. | Only then did I realize my mistake. | Faqat shundan keyin xatoimni tushundim.

6. Ko‘p qilinadigan xatolar

1. Auxiliary verbni unutish

❌ Never I have seen such a place.
✅ Never have I seen such a place.
Men hech qachon bunday joyni ko‘rmaganman.

Izoh: Never gap boshida kelsa, auxiliary subjectdan oldin keladi.

2. Subject va auxiliary joyini almashtirmaslik

❌ Rarely he comes late.
✅ Rarely does he come late.
U kamdan-kam hollarda kech keladi.

Izoh: Present Simple’da does/do yordamchi fe’li kerak.

3. No sooner bilan than ishlatmaslik

❌ No sooner had I arrived when it started raining.
✅ No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.
Men yetib kelishim bilanoq yomg‘ir boshlandi.

Izoh: No sooner doimo than bilan ishlatiladi.

4. Hardly / Scarcely bilan when ishlatmaslik

❌ Hardly had she left than the phone rang.
✅ Hardly had she left when the phone rang.
U endigina ketgan edi, telefon jiringladi.

Izoh: Hardly / Scarcely doimo when bilan ishlatiladi.

5. Not only gapida noto‘g‘ri tartib ishlatish

❌ Not only he passed the exam, but he also got a high score.
✅ Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got a high score.
U nafaqat imtihondan o‘tdi, balki yuqori ball ham oldi.

Izoh: Not only gap boshida kelsa, inversion kerak.

7. Qisqa qoida

1. Inversion — odatiy gap tartibining o‘zgarishi.

2. Negative ibora gap boshiga chiqsa, auxiliary subjectdan oldin keladi.

3. Formula: Negative adverbial + auxiliary + subject + main verb.

4. No sooner bilan than, Hardly/Scarcely bilan when ishlatiladi.

5. Inversion ko‘proq rasmiy, akademik va urg‘uli gaplarda ishlatiladi.
grammar_rules_en:
Inversion is a change in the normal word order of an English sentence.

In an ordinary sentence the order is usually:

Subject + auxiliary verb + main verb

For example:

I have never seen such a beautiful place.

In inversion, the auxiliary verb moves in front of the subject:

Never have I seen such a beautiful place.

Inversion is usually used:

• in formal speech,

• in academic writing,

• in exam-style sentences,

• to give strong emphasis to a sentence.

8 examples

1. Never have I heard such a strange story.

2. Rarely do students ask such deep questions.

3. Seldom does he arrive late.

4. Hardly ever do we see such results.

5. Little did she know about the problem.

6. Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.

7. No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.

8. Only after the lesson did I understand the topic.

2. Inversion formula

Main formula

Negative adverbial + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb

That is:

Negative adverbial — phrases like never, rarely, seldom, no sooner, hardly, only after.
Auxiliary verb — do, does, did, have, has, had, can, will, should, etc.
Subject — I, he, she, they, students, teacher, etc.
Main verb — the main verb.

Example

Ordinary sentence:

I have never seen such a beautiful place.

Inversion:

Never have I seen such a beautiful place.

Here:

Never — negative adverbial
have — auxiliary verb
I — subject
seen — main verb

3. Main phrases where inversion is used

1. Never

Meaning: never

Never have I seen such a mistake.

2. Rarely

Meaning: rarely

Rarely does he speak in public.

3. Seldom

Meaning: seldom

Seldom do students finish this task quickly.

4. Hardly ever

Meaning: hardly ever

Hardly ever do we use this word in daily speech.

5. Little

Meaning: hardly knowing, not expecting

Little did he know that his life would change.

6. Not only

Meaning: not only

Not only did she win the competition, but she also broke the record.

7. No sooner

Meaning: as soon as

No sooner had we started the lesson than the lights went off.

8. Hardly / Scarcely

Meaning: just now, barely

Hardly had I opened the book when the phone rang.

Scarcely had they arrived when the meeting began.

9. Under no circumstances

Meaning: in no circumstances

Under no circumstances should you share your password.

10. On no account

Meaning: never, in no circumstances

On no account must students use phones during the exam.

11. Only then

Meaning: only after that

Only then did I realize my mistake.

12. Only after

Meaning: only after...

Only after the test did I understand the topic.

13. Only when

Meaning: only when...

Only when I saw the result did I believe it.

14. Not until

Meaning: not until... / only when...

Not until the teacher explained it did I understand the rule.

4. The most important types of inversion

A) Inversion with negative adverbs

When negative adverbs come at the beginning of the sentence, inversion is used.

1. Never

Never have I heard this story.

2. Rarely

Rarely do people get such an opportunity.

3. Seldom

Seldom does she make grammar mistakes.

B) Not only ... but also

When not only comes at the beginning, inversion is used in the first part.

Formula

Not only + auxiliary + subject + main verb, but subject also + verb

3 examples

1. Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.

2. Not only does she speak English, but she also speaks French.

3. Not only was the lesson useful, but it was also interesting.

C) No sooner ... than

Used when one action occurs immediately after another.

Formula

No sooner + had + subject + V3 + than + subject + past verb

3 examples

1. No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.

2. No sooner had she entered the room than everyone became silent.

3. No sooner had the exam started than one student asked a question.

D) Hardly / Scarcely ... when

Used when one action has just happened and another action occurs.

Formula

Hardly / Scarcely + had + subject + V3 + when + subject + past verb

3 examples

1. Hardly had she left when the phone rang.

2. Scarcely had we sat down when the teacher entered.

3. Hardly had I opened my notebook when the lesson began.

E) Only after / only when / only then

When these phrases come at the beginning of a sentence, inversion occurs in the main clause.

3 examples

1. Only after the lesson did I understand the topic.

2. Only when I checked my answers did I notice the mistake.

3. Only then did she realize the importance of grammar.

5. Turning a simple sentence into an inversion sentence

Simple sentence | Inversion sentence | Translation
I have never seen such a result. | Never have I seen such a result. | Men hech qachon bunday natijani ko‘rmaganman.
He rarely comes late. | Rarely does he come late. | U kamdan-kam hollarda kech keladi.
She seldom makes mistakes. | Seldom does she make mistakes. | U juda kam xato qiladi.
I hardly ever watch TV. | Hardly ever do I watch TV. | Men deyarli televizor ko‘rmayman.
He knew little about the problem. | Little did he know about the problem. | U muammo haqida deyarli bilmas edi.
He not only passed the exam, but also won a prize. | Not only did he pass the exam, but he also won a prize. | U nafaqat imtihondan o‘tdi, balki mukofot ham yutdi.
I had no sooner arrived than the lesson started. | No sooner had I arrived than the lesson started. | Men yetib kelishim bilanoq dars boshlandi.
She had hardly left when he called. | Hardly had she left when he called. | U endigina ketgan edi, u qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.
I understood the topic only after the teacher explained it. | Only after the teacher explained it did I understand the topic. | Faqat o‘qituvchi tushuntirgandan keyin mavzuni tushundim.
I realized my mistake only then. | Only then did I realize my mistake. | Faqat shundan keyin xatoimni tushundim.

6. Common mistakes

1. Forgetting the auxiliary verb

❌ Never I have seen such a place.
✅ Never have I seen such a place.
Men hech qachon bunday joyni ko‘rmaganman.

Note: When 'never' is at the beginning of the sentence, the auxiliary comes before the subject.

2. Not switching the subject and auxiliary

❌ Rarely he comes late.
✅ Rarely does he come late.
U kamdan-kam hollarda kech keladi.

Note: The auxiliary verb 'does/do' is needed in Present Simple.

3. Not using 'than' with 'no sooner'

❌ No sooner had I arrived when it started raining.
✅ No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.
Men yetib kelishim bilanoq yomg‘ir boshlandi.

Note: 'No sooner' is always used with 'than'.

4. Not using 'when' with 'hardly / scarcely'

❌ Hardly had she left than the phone rang.
✅ Hardly had she left when the phone rang.
U endigina ketgan edi, telefon jiringladi.

Note: 'Hardly / Scarcely' is always used with 'when'.

5. Incorrect order in 'not only' sentences

❌ Not only he passed the exam, but he also got a high score.
✅ Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got a high score.
U nafaqat imtihondan o‘tdi, balki yuqori ball ham oldi.

Note: When 'not only' is at the beginning of the sentence, inversion is needed.

7. Brief rules

1. Inversion is a change in the normal word order.

2. If a negative phrase comes at the beginning of the sentence, the auxiliary comes before the subject.

3. Formula: Negative adverbial + auxiliary + subject + main verb.

4. 'No sooner' is used with 'than', 'hardly/scarcely' is used with 'when'.

5. Inversion is more commonly used in formal, academic, and emphatic sentences.
grammar_rules_ru:
Inversion — изменение обычного порядка слов в английском предложении.

В обычном предложении порядок, как правило, такой:

Subject + auxiliary verb + main verb

Например:

I have never seen such a beautiful place.
Я никогда не видел такого красивого места.

А при inversion вспомогательный глагол выходит перед подлежащим:

Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
Никогда я не видел такого красивого места.

Inversion обычно используется:

• в официальной речи,

• в академическом письме,

• в экзаменационных предложениях,

• для сильного акцента в предложении.

8 примеров

1. Never have I heard such a strange story.
Я никогда не слышал такой странной истории.

2. Rarely do students ask such deep questions.
Студенты редко задают такие глубокие вопросы.

3. Seldom does he arrive late.
Он очень редко приходит поздно.

4. Hardly ever do we see such results.
Мы почти никогда не видим таких результатов.

5. Little did she know about the problem.
Она почти ничего не знала о проблеме.

6. Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.
Он не только сдал экзамен, но и получил высший балл.

7. No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.
Я только что пришел, как начался дождь.

8. Only after the lesson did I understand the topic.
Только после урока я понял тему.

2. Формула инверсии

Основная формула

Negative adverbial + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb

То есть:

Negative adverbial — такие выражения, как never, rarely, seldom, no sooner, hardly, only after.
Auxiliary verb — do, does, did, have, has, had, can, will, should и другие.
Subject — I, he, she, they, students, teacher и так далее.
Main verb — основной глагол.

Пример

Обычное предложение:

I have never seen such a beautiful place.
Я никогда не видел такого красивого места.

Inversion:

Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
Никогда я не видел такого красивого места.

Здесь:

Never — negative adverbial
have — auxiliary verb
I — subject
seen — main verb

3. Основные выражения, в которых используется инверсия

1. Never

Значение: никогда

Never have I seen such a mistake.
Я никогда не видел такой ошибки.

2. Rarely

Значение: редко

Rarely does he speak in public.
Он редко говорит на публике.

3. Seldom

Значение: очень редко

Seldom do students finish this task quickly.
Студенты очень редко быстро заканчивают это задание.

4. Hardly ever

Значение: почти никогда

Hardly ever do we use this word in daily speech.
Мы почти никогда не используем это слово в повседневной речи.

5. Little

Значение: почти не знать, не ожидать

Little did he know that his life would change.
Он вообще не знал, что его жизнь изменится.

6. Not only

Значение: не только

Not only did she win the competition, but she also broke the record.
Она не только выиграла соревнование, но и установила рекорд.

7. No sooner

Значение: ... как только

No sooner had we started the lesson than the lights went off.
Как только мы начали урок, свет погас.

8. Hardly / Scarcely

Значение: только что, едва

Hardly had I opened the book when the phone rang.
Я только открыл книгу, как зазвонил телефон.

Scarcely had they arrived when the meeting began.
Они только что прибыли, как началась встреча.

9. Under no circumstances

Значение: ни при каких обстоятельствах

Under no circumstances should you share your password.
Ни при каких обстоятельствах вы не должны делиться своим паролем.

10. On no account

Значение: ни в коем случае

On no account must students use phones during the exam.
Ни в коем случае студенты не должны использовать телефоны во время экзамена.

11. Only then

Значение: только тогда

Only then did I realize my mistake.
Только тогда я понял свою ошибку.

12. Only after

Значение: только после ...

Only after the test did I understand the topic.
Только после теста я понял тему.

13. Only when

Значение: только когда ...

Only when I saw the result did I believe it.
Только когда я увидел результат, я в это поверил.

14. Not until

Значение: только до ... / ... только тогда

Not until the teacher explained it did I understand the rule.
Только после того, как учитель объяснил это, я понял правило.

4. Самые важные виды инверсии

A) Инверсия с отрицательными наречиями

Если отрицательные наречия стоят в начале предложения, используется инверсия.

1. Never

Never have I heard this story.
Я никогда не слышал эту историю.

2. Rarely

Rarely do people get such an opportunity.
Люди редко получают такую возможность.

3. Seldom

Seldom does she make grammar mistakes.
Она очень редко делает грамматические ошибки.

B) Not only ... but also

Если Not only стоит в начале предложения, в первой части используется инверсия.

Формула

Not only + auxiliary + subject + main verb, but subject also + verb

3 примера

1. Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.
Он не только сдал экзамен, но и получил высший балл.

2. Не только она говорит по-английски, но и по-французски.
U nafaqat ingliz tilida, balki fransuz tilida ham gapiradi.

3. Урок был не только полезным, но и интересным.
Dars nafaqat foydali, balki qiziqarli ham edi.

C) Едва ... как

Используется, когда одно действие происходит сразу после другого.

Формула

No sooner + had + subject + V3 + than + subject + past verb

3 примера

1. Едва я приехал, как начался дождь.
Men yetib kelishim bilanoq yomg‘ir boshlandi.

2. Едва она вошла в комнату, как все замолчали.
U xonaga kirishi bilanoq hamma jim bo‘lib qoldi.

3. Едва начался экзамен, как один студент задал вопрос.
Imtihon boshlanishi bilanoq bir talaba savol berdi.

D) Едва ли / Едва ... как

Используется, когда одно действие только что произошло, а второе действие происходит.

Формула

Hardly / Scarcely + had + subject + V3 + when + subject + past verb

3 примера

1. Едва она ушла, как зазвонил телефон.
U endigina ketgan edi, telefon jiringladi.

2. Едва мы сели, как вошел учитель.
Biz endigina o‘tirgan edik, o‘qituvchi kirdi.

3. Едва я открыл тетрадь, как начался урок.
Daftarimni endigina ochgan edim, dars boshlandi.

E) Только после / только когда / только тогда

Если эти выражения стоят в начале предложения, то в основном предложении используется инверсия.

3 примера

1. Только после урока я понял тему.
Faqat darsdan keyin mavzuni tushundim.

2. Только когда я проверил свои ответы, я заметил ошибку.
Faqat javoblarimni tekshirganimda xatoni payqadim.

3. Только тогда она поняла важность грамматики.
Faqat shundan keyin u grammatikaning muhimligini tushundi.

5. Преобразование простого предложения в инверсионное

Простое предложение | Инверсионное предложение | Перевод
I have never seen such a result. | Never have I seen such a result. | Men hech qachon bunday natijani ko‘rmaganman.
He rarely comes late. | Rarely does he come late. | U kamdan-kam hollarda kech keladi.
She seldom makes mistakes. | Seldom does she make mistakes. | U juda kam xato qiladi.
I hardly ever watch TV. | Hardly ever do I watch TV. | Men deyarli televizor ko‘rmayman.
He knew little about the problem. | Little did he know about the problem. | U muammo haqida deyarli bilmas edi.
He not only passed the exam, but also won a prize. | Not only did he pass the exam, but he also won a prize. | U nafaqat imtihondan o‘tdi, balki mukofot ham yutdi.
I had no sooner arrived than the lesson started. | No sooner had I arrived than the lesson started. | Men yetib kelishim bilanoq dars boshlandi.
She had hardly left when he called. | Hardly had she left when he called. | U endigina ketgan edi, u qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.
I understood the topic only after the teacher explained it. | Only after the teacher explained it did I understand the topic. | Faqat o‘qituvchi tushuntirgandan keyin mavzuni tushundim.
I realized my mistake only then. | Only then did I realize my mistake. | Faqat shundan keyin xatoimni tushundim.

6. Часто совершаемые ошибки

1. Забывание вспомогательного глагола

❌ Never I have seen such a place.
✅ Never have I seen such a place.
Men hech qachon bunday joyni ko‘rmaganman.

Примечание: Если never стоит в начале предложения, вспомогательный глагол идет перед подлежащим.

2. Не менять местами подлежащее и вспомогательный глагол

❌ Rarely he comes late.
✅ Rarely does he come late.
U kamdan-kam hollarda kech keladi.

Примечание: В Present Simple нужен вспомогательный глагол does/do.

3. Не использовать no sooner с than

❌ No sooner had I arrived when it started raining.
✅ No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.
Men yetib kelishim bilanoq yomg‘ir boshlandi.

Примечание: No sooner всегда используется с than.

4. Не использовать hardly / scarcely с when

❌ Hardly had she left than the phone rang.
✅ Hardly had she left when the phone rang.
U endigina ketgan edi, telefon jiringladi.

Примечание: Hardly / Scarcely всегда используется с when.

5. Неправильный порядок в предложении с not only

❌ Not only he passed the exam, but he also got a high score.
✅ Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got a high score.
U nafaqat imtihondan o‘tdi, balki yuqori ball ham oldi.

Примечание: Если not only стоит в начале предложения, нужна инверсия.

7. Краткое правило

1. Инверсия — это изменение обычного порядка слов в предложении.

2. Если отрицательное выражение стоит в начале предложения, вспомогательный глагол идет перед подлежащим.

3. Формула: Отрицательное наречие + вспомогательный + подлежащее + основной глагол.

4. No sooner используется с than, Hardly/Scarcely используется с when.

5. Инверсия чаще используется в официальных, академических и акцентированных предложениях.
grammar_rules_kk:
Inversion — ingliz tilida gáptegi ádettegi sóz tartibiniń ózgeriwi.

Ádette gápda tartib ádette bılay boladı:

Subject + auxiliary verb + main verb

Mısalı:

I have never seen such a beautiful place.
Men hesh qashan bunday ádemi orındı kórmegenmen.

Al Inversion’da auxiliary verb subjectten aldınǵa shıǵadı:

Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
Men hesh qashan bunday ádemi orındı kórmegenmen.

Inversion ádette:

• rasmiy nutqda,

• akademik yozuvda,

• imtihon uslubındaki gáplerde,

• gápke kuchli urg‘u beriwde qollanıladı.

8 ta mısal

1. Never have I heard such a strange story.
Men hesh qashan bunday g‘alati hikoyanı eshitmegenmen.

2. Rarely do students ask such deep questions.
Studentler kamdan-kam hollarda bunday chuqur savollar beredi.

3. Seldom does he arrive late.
Ol juda kam hollarda kech keladi.

4. Hardly ever do we see such results.
Biz bunday natijalarni deyarli hesh qashan kórmeymiz.

5. Little did she know about the problem.
Ol muammo haqqında deyarli hesh narsa bilmegen edi.

6. Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.
Ol nafaqat imtihondan o‘tdi, balki eng yuqori ball ham aldı.

7. No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.
Men yetip kelishim bilanoq yomg‘ir boshlandı.

8. Only after the lesson did I understand the topic.
Faqat darsdan keyin mavzuni túsindim.

2. Inversion formulası

Asasiy formula

Negative adverbial + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb

Ya’ni:

Negative adverbial — never, rarely, seldom, no sooner, hardly, only after kabi iboralar.
Auxiliary verb — do, does, did, have, has, had, can, will, should hám başqalar.
Subject — I, he, she, they, students, teacher hám hokazo.
Main verb — asasiy feyil.

Mısal

Ádette gáp:

I have never seen such a beautiful place.
Men hesh qashan bunday ádemi orındı kórmegenmen.

Inversion:

Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
Men hesh qashan bunday ádemi orındı kórmegenmen.

Bu yerda:

Never — negative adverbial
have — auxiliary verb
I — subject
seen — main verb

3. Inversion ishlatiladigan asasiy iboralar

1. Never

Ma’nosi: hesh qashan

Never have I seen such a mistake.
Men hesh qashan bunday xatoni kórmegenmen.

2. Rarely

Ma’nosi: kamdan-kam

Rarely does he speak in public.
Ol kamdan-kam hollarda omma oldında gapiradi.

3. Seldom

Ma’nosi: juda kam hollarda

Seldom do students finish this task quickly.
Studentler bu vazifani juda kam hollarda tez tugatadı.

4. Hardly ever

Ma’nosi: deyarli hesh qashan

Hardly ever do we use this word in daily speech.
Biz bu sózdi kundalık nutqda deyarli qollanmaymiz.

5. Little

Ma’nosi: deyarli bilmaslıq, kutmaslıq

Little did he know that his life would change.
Ol hayatı o‘zgeriwini umuman bilmegen edi.

6. Not only

Ma’nosi: nafaqat

Not only did she win the competition, but she also broke the record.
Ol nafaqat musobaqada g‘olib bolıp, balki rekord ham ornatdı.

7. No sooner

Ma’nosi: ... bilanoq

No sooner had we started the lesson than the lights went off.
Darsnı boshlawımız bilanoq chiroqlar o‘chdi.

8. Hardly / Scarcely

Ma’nosi: endigina, zo‘rg‘a

Hardly had I opened the book when the phone rang.
Kitobnı endigina ochqan edim, telefon jiringladi.

Scarcely had they arrived when the meeting began.
Olar endigina yetip kelgen edi, uchraşuw boshlandı.

9. Under no circumstances

Ma’nosi: hesh qanday holatda

Under no circumstances should you share your password.
Hesh qanday holatda parolingizni başqalar menen bo‘lishmaslıgınız kerek.

10. On no account

Ma’nosi: aslo, hesh qanday holatda

On no account must students use phones during the exam.
Imtihon paytında studentler aslo telefondan qollanmaslıgı kerek.

11. Only then

Ma’nosi: faqat shundan keyin

Only then did I realize my mistake.
Faqat shundan keyin xatoimni túsindim.

12. Only after

Ma’nosi: faqat ... dan keyin

Only after the test did I understand the topic.
Faqat testdan keyin mavzuni túsindim.

13. Only when

Ma’nosi: faqat ... qachonki

Only when I saw the result did I believe it.
Faqat natijani kórgenimde buna ishondım.

14. Not until

Ma’nosi: faqat ... gacha emes / ... bolǵandıqta

Not until the teacher explained it did I understand the rule.
Oqıtıwshı túsindirgandan keyin qoidanı túsindim.

4. Eng muhim inversion turları

A) Negative adverbs menen inversion

Negative adverbs gáp boshına chiqsa, inversion qollanıladı.

1. Never

Never have I heard this story.
Men bu hikoyanı hesh qashan eshitmegenmen.

2. Rarely

Rarely do people get such an opportunity.
Odamlar bunday mümkinşilikni kamdan-kam aladı.

3. Seldom

Seldom does she make grammar mistakes.
Ol juda kam hollarda grammatik xatolar qıladı.

B) Not only ... but also

Not only gáp boshında kelsa, birinshi qısımda inversion qollanıladı.

Formula

Not only + auxiliary + subject + main verb, but subject also + verb

3 ta mısal

1. Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.
Ol nafaqat imtihondan o‘tdi, balki eng yuqori ball ham aldı.

2. Nafaqat u ingliz tilinde gapiradi, balki fransuz tilinde ham gapiradi.
U nafaqat ingliz tilinde, balki fransuz tilinde ham gapiradi.

3. Nafaqat dars foydali edi, balki qiziqarli ham edi.
Dars nafaqat foydali, balki qiziqarli ham edi.

C) No sooner ... than

Bir ish bolǵanda ikkinshi ish sodir bolǵanda qollanıladı.

Formula

No sooner + had + subject + V3 + than + subject + past verb

3 ta mısal

1. No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.
Men yetip kelishim bolǵanda yomǵır bastaldı.

2. No sooner had she entered the room than everyone became silent.
U xonaga kirǵanda hamma jim bolǵan edi.

3. No sooner had the exam started than one student asked a question.
Imtihon bastalǵanda bir talaba savol berdi.

D) Hardly / Scarcely ... when

Bir ish endigina bolǵanda ikkinshi ish sodir bolǵanda qollanıladı.

Formula

Hardly / Scarcely + had + subject + V3 + when + subject + past verb

3 ta mısal

1. Hardly had she left when the phone rang.
U endigina ketǵan edi, telefon jiringladi.

2. Scarcely had we sat down when the teacher entered.
Biz endigina otırǵan edik, oqıtıwshı kirdi.

3. Hardly had I opened my notebook when the lesson began.
Daftarımnı endigina ochǵan edim, dars bastaldı.

E) Only after / only when / only then

Bu iboralar gáp boshında kelsa, asası gápda inversion bolǵadı.

3 ta mısal

1. Only after the lesson did I understand the topic.
Faqat darsdan keyin mavzuni túsindim.

2. Only when I checked my answers did I notice the mistake.
Faqat javoblarımnı tekshirǵanımda xatoni payqadım.

3. Only then did she realize the importance of grammar.
Faqat shundan keyin u grammatikanıń muhimligini túsindi.

5. Oddiy gápni inversion gápqa aylantırw

Oddiy gáp | Inversion gáp | Tarjima
I have never seen such a result. | Never have I seen such a result. | Men hech qachon bunday natijani kórmaganman.
He rarely comes late. | Rarely does he come late. | U kamdan-kam hollarda kech keladi.
She seldom makes mistakes. | Seldom does she make mistakes. | U juda kam xato qiladi.
I hardly ever watch TV. | Hardly ever do I watch TV. | Men deyarli televizor kórmayman.
He knew little about the problem. | Little did he know about the problem. | U muammo haqida deyarli bilmas edi.
He not only passed the exam, but also won a prize. | Not only did he pass the exam, but he also won a prize. | U nafaqat imtihondan ótdi, balki mukofot ham yutdı.
I had no sooner arrived than the lesson started. | No sooner had I arrived than the lesson started. | Men yetip kelishim bolǵanda dars bastaldı.
She had hardly left when he called. | Hardly had she left when he called. | U endigina ketǵan edi, u qońǵiroq qıldı.
I understood the topic only after the teacher explained it. | Only after the teacher explained it did I understand the topic. | Faqat oqıtıwshı túsuntırǵandan keyin mavzuni túsindim.
I realized my mistake only then. | Only then did I realize my mistake. | Faqat shundan keyin xatoımnı túsindim.

6. Kóp qılınǵan xatolar

1. Auxiliary verbni unıtıw

❌ Never I have seen such a place.
✅ Never have I seen such a place.
Men hech qachon bunday joynı kórmaganman.

Izoh: Never gáp boshında kelsa, auxiliary subjectten aldınǵa keladı.

2. Subject va auxiliary joyın almashtırmaslıq

❌ Rarely he comes late.
✅ Rarely does he come late.
U kamdan-kam hollarda kech keladi.

Izoh: Present Simple’da does/do yordamçı feyli kerek.

3. No sooner bilan than ishlatmaslıq

❌ No sooner had I arrived when it started raining.
✅ No sooner had I arrived than it started raining.
Men yetip kelishim bolǵanda yomǵır bastaldı.

Izoh: No sooner doımo than bilan ishlatıladı.

4. Hardly / Scarcely bilan when ishlatmaslıq

❌ Hardly had she left than the phone rang.
✅ Hardly had she left when the phone rang.
U endigina ketǵan edi, telefon jiringladi.

Izoh: Hardly / Scarcely doımo when bilan ishlatıladı.

5. Not only gápında notoǵrı tartıb ishlatış

❌ Not only he passed the exam, but he also got a high score.
✅ Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got a high score.
U nafaqat imtihondan ótdi, balki yuqori ball ham oldı.

Izoh: Not only gáp boshında kelsa, inversion kerek.

7. Qısqa qaǵıyda

1. Inversion — odatıy gáp tartıbınıń ózgeriwı.

2. Negative ibora gáp boshına şıǵsa, auxiliary subjectten aldınǵa keladı.

3. Formula: Negative adverbial + auxiliary + subject + main verb.

4. No sooner bilan than, Hardly/Scarcely bilan when ishlatıladı.

5. Inversion kóp rasmiy, akademik hám urgılı gápda qollanıladı.
reading_passage:
Hi Adam,

Today our English class worked on reviewing a special dinner at a restaurant. The example came from a university food magazine.

Rarely has the magazine reviewed a restaurant that serves such a short seasonal menu. Not only was the soup carefully prepared, but the staff also explained where the main ingredients came from.

Only after the main course arrived did the reviewer understand why the restaurant limits the number of tables. Never had the student writers seen the chef visit every table at the end of the evening.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “Rarely have we eaten at a restaurant with such careful service.” The review recommends the restaurant for special occasions rather than quick everyday meals.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Nina and Adam compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

grammar_rules:
Formal conclusion — essay, article, report, presentation yoki academic writing oxirida yoziladigan rasmiy yakuniy qism.

Conclusion’ning vazifasi:

• mavzuni yakunlash;

• asosiy fikrlarni qisqa eslatish;

• umumiy xulosa berish;

• o‘quvchida aniq yakuniy taassurot qoldirish.

Muhim: Conclusion’da yangi fikr yoki yangi argument kiritilmaydi. U oldin aytilgan asosiy fikrlarni umumlashtiradi.

6 ta sodda misol

1. In conclusion, education plays an important role in personal and social development.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, ta’lim shaxsiy va ijtimoiy rivojlanishda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.

2. To conclude, technology can be useful if it is used wisely.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, texnologiya oqilona ishlatilsa foydali bo‘lishi mumkin.

3. Overall, regular practice is necessary for academic success.
Umuman olganda, akademik muvaffaqiyat uchun muntazam mashq zarur.

4. It can be concluded that online learning offers both opportunities and challenges.
Online ta’lim imkoniyatlar va qiyinchiliklarni taqdim etadi, degan xulosa qilish mumkin.

5. For these reasons, students should develop both knowledge and practical skills.
Shu sabablarga ko‘ra, talabalar bilim va amaliy ko‘nikmalarni rivojlantirishlari kerak.

6. In light of the evidence, environmental protection should be a global priority.
Dalillarni hisobga olgan holda, atrof-muhitni himoya qilish global ustuvor vazifa bo‘lishi kerak.

2. Formal conclusion tuzilishi

Formal conclusion odatda 4 qismdan iborat bo‘ladi.

1. Topicni qayta umumlashtirish

Mavzuni boshqa so‘zlar bilan qisqa eslatadi.

Education is one of the most important factors in modern society.
Ta’lim zamonaviy jamiyatdagi eng muhim omillardan biridir.

2. Asosiy fikrlarni qisqa eslatish

Essay yoki report ichida aytilgan asosiy fikrlar umumlashtiriladi.

It improves knowledge, develops skills, and creates better opportunities.
U bilimni oshiradi, ko‘nikmalarni rivojlantiradi va yaxshi imkoniyatlar yaratadi.

3. Yakuniy xulosa yoki tavsiya berish

O‘quvchiga umumiy natija yoki tavsiya beriladi.

Therefore, governments should invest more in education.
Shuning uchun hukumatlar ta’limga ko‘proq sarmoya kiritishi kerak.

4. Kuchli final sentence yozish

Oxirgi gap aniq, kuchli va esda qolarli bo‘lishi kerak.

A strong education system is the foundation of a successful future.
Kuchli ta’lim tizimi muvaffaqiyatli kelajakning asosidir.

3. Formal conclusion uchun foydali iboralar

Phrase | Ma’nosi | Misol | Tarjima
In conclusion, ... | Xulosa qilib aytganda | In conclusion, education is essential for progress. | Xulosa qilib aytganda, ta’lim taraqqiyot uchun zarur.
To conclude, ... | Xulosa qilib | To conclude, technology should be used responsibly. | Xulosa qilib, texnologiyadan mas’uliyat bilan foydalanish kerak.
To sum up, ... | Qisqacha aytganda | To sum up, healthy habits improve quality of life. | Qisqacha aytganda, sog‘lom odatlar hayot sifatini yaxshilaydi.
Overall, ... | Umuman olganda | Overall, online learning is flexible and convenient. | Umuman olganda, online ta’lim moslashuvchan va qulay.
Taking everything into account, ... | Barchasini hisobga olganda | Taking everything into account, the benefits are greater than the drawbacks. | Barchasini hisobga olganda, foydalari kamchiliklaridan ko‘proq.
Based on the points discussed, ... | Muhokama qilingan fikrlarga asoslanib | Based on the points discussed, social media should be used carefully. | Muhokama qilingan fikrlarga asoslanib, ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan ehtiyotkorlik bilan foydalanish kerak.
It can be concluded that ... | Shunday xulosa qilish mumkinki | It can be concluded that practice is the key to success. | Muvaffaqiyat kaliti mashqdir, degan xulosa qilish mumkin.
Therefore, ... | Shuning uchun | Therefore, students should manage their time well. | Shuning uchun talabalar vaqtlarini yaxshi boshqarishlari kerak.
For these reasons, ... | Shu sabablarga ko‘ra | For these reasons, environmental education is necessary. | Shu sabablarga ko‘ra, ekologik ta’lim zarur.
In light of the evidence, ... | Dalillarni hisobga olgan holda | In light of the evidence, action must be taken immediately. | Dalillarni hisobga olgan holda, darhol chora ko‘rish kerak.

4. Formal va informal conclusion farqi

Formal conclusion | Informal conclusion | Qachon ishlatiladi? | Misol | Tarjima
Rasmiy, aniq va akademik | Oddiy, suhbatga xos | Essay, report, presentation | In conclusion, education is vital for future success. | Xulosa qilib aytganda, ta’lim kelajakdagi muvaffaqiyat uchun muhim.
“I think”, “Anyway” kabi iboralar yo‘q | “I think”, “Anyway”, “That’s all” bo‘lishi mumkin | Kundalik nutq | Anyway, that’s all about education. | Xullas, ta’lim haqida shular.
Asosiy fikrlarni umumlashtiradi | Ko‘pincha oddiy tugatadi | Academic writing | Overall, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages. | Umuman olganda, afzalliklar kamchiliklardan ustun.
Kuchli final sentence bo‘ladi | Final gap kuchsiz bo‘lishi mumkin | Imtihon, IELTS, CEFR, universitet ishlari | Therefore, effective planning is essential. | Shuning uchun samarali rejalashtirish zarur.
grammar_rules_en:
A formal conclusion is the formal closing part written at the end of an essay, article, report, presentation or piece of academic writing.

The job of a conclusion:

• to close the topic;

• to briefly recall the main ideas;

• to give an overall summary;

• to leave the reader with a clear final impression.

Important: a conclusion does not introduce new ideas or new arguments. It sums up the main ideas already given.

6 simple examples

1. In conclusion, education plays an important role in personal and social development.

2. To conclude, technology can be useful if it is used wisely.

3. Overall, regular practice is necessary for academic success.

4. It can be concluded that online learning offers both opportunities and challenges.

5. For these reasons, students should develop both knowledge and practical skills.

6. In light of the evidence, environmental protection should be a global priority.

2. Structure of a formal conclusion

A formal conclusion usually consists of 4 parts.

1. Restating the topic

It briefly reminds of the topic in other words.

Education is one of the most important factors in modern society.

2. Briefly recalling the main ideas

The main ideas stated in the essay or report are summarized.

It improves knowledge, develops skills, and creates better opportunities.

3. Giving a final conclusion or recommendation

A general result or recommendation is given to the reader.

Therefore, governments should invest more in education.

4. Writing a strong final sentence

The last sentence should be clear, strong, and memorable.

A strong education system is the foundation of a successful future.

3. Useful phrases for a formal conclusion

Phrase | Uzbek | Example | Translation
In conclusion, ... | Xulosa qilib aytganda | In conclusion, education is essential for progress. | Xulosa qilib aytganda, ta’lim taraqqiyot uchun zarur.
To conclude, ... | Xulosa qilib | To conclude, technology should be used responsibly. | Xulosa qilib, texnologiyadan mas’uliyat bilan foydalanish kerak.
To sum up, ... | Qisqacha aytganda | To sum up, healthy habits improve quality of life. | Qisqacha aytganda, sog‘lom odatlar hayot sifatini yaxshilaydi.
Overall, ... | Umuman olganda | Overall, online learning is flexible and convenient. | Umuman olganda, online ta’lim moslashuvchan va qulay.
Taking everything into account, ... | Barchasini hisobga olganda | Taking everything into account, the benefits are greater than the drawbacks. | Barchasini hisobga olganda, foydalari kamchiliklaridan ko‘proq.
Based on the points discussed, ... | Muhokama qilingan fikrlarga asoslanib | Based on the points discussed, social media should be used carefully. | Muhokama qilingan fikrlarga asoslanib, ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan ehtiyotkorlik bilan foydalanish kerak.
It can be concluded that ... | Shunday xulosa qilish mumkinki | It can be concluded that practice is the key to success. | Muvaffaqiyat kaliti mashqdir, degan xulosa qilish mumkin.
Therefore, ... | Shuning uchun | Therefore, students should manage their time well. | Shuning uchun talabalar vaqtlarini yaxshi boshqarishlari kerak.
For these reasons, ... | Shu sabablarga ko‘ra | For these reasons, environmental education is necessary. | Shu sabablarga ko‘ra, ekologik ta’lim zarur.
In light of the evidence, ... | Dalillarni hisobga olgan holda | In light of the evidence, action must be taken immediately. | Dalillarni hisobga olgan holda, darhol chora ko‘rish kerak.

4. The difference between formal and informal conclusions

Formal conclusion | Informal conclusion | When is it used? | Example | Translation
Formal, clear, and academic | Simple, conversational | Essay, report, presentation | In conclusion, education is vital for future success. | In conclusion, education is vital for future success.
No phrases like “I think”, “Anyway” | Can include “I think”, “Anyway”, “That’s all” | Everyday speech | Anyway, that’s all about education. | Anyway, that’s all about education.
Summarizes the main ideas | Often ends simply | Academic writing | Overall, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages. | Overall, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages.
Will have a strong final sentence | Final sentence can be weak | Exams, IELTS, CEFR, university work | Therefore, effective planning is essential. | Therefore, effective planning is essential.
grammar_rules_ru:
Официальная заключительная часть — это рутинная заключительная часть, которая пишется в конце эссе, статьи, отчёта, презентации или академической работы.

Задача conclusion:

• завершить тему;

• кратко напомнить основные мысли;

• сделать общий вывод;

• оставить у читателя ясное итоговое впечатление.

Важно: в conclusion не вводятся новые мысли или новые аргументы. Он обобщает основные мысли, высказанные ранее.

6 простых примеров

1. In conclusion, education plays an important role in personal and social development.
В заключение, образование играет важную роль в личном и социальном развитии.

2. To conclude, technology can be useful if it is used wisely.
В заключение, технологии могут быть полезными, если их использовать разумно.

3. Overall, regular practice is necessary for academic success.
В общем, регулярная практика необходима для академического успеха.

4. It can be concluded that online learning offers both opportunities and challenges.
Можно сделать вывод, что онлайн-обучение предлагает как возможности, так и вызовы.

5. For these reasons, students should develop both knowledge and practical skills.
По этим причинам студенты должны развивать как знания, так и практические навыки.

6. In light of the evidence, environmental protection should be a global priority.
С учетом доказательств, защита окружающей среды должна быть глобальным приоритетом.

2. Структура официального заключения

Официальное заключение обычно состоит из 4 частей.

1. Повторное обобщение темы

Кратко напоминает о теме другими словами.

Education is one of the most important factors in modern society.
Образование является одним из самых важных факторов в современном обществе.

2. Краткое напоминание основных мыслей

Обобщаются основные мысли, высказанные в эссе или отчёте.

It improves knowledge, develops skills, and creates better opportunities.
Это улучшает знания, развивает навыки и создает лучшие возможности.

3. Заключительный вывод или рекомендация

Читателю дается общий результат или рекомендация.

Therefore, governments should invest more in education.
Следовательно, правительствам следует больше инвестировать в образование.

4. Написание сильного финального предложения

Последнее предложение должно быть ясным, сильным и запоминающимся.

A strong education system is the foundation of a successful future.
Сильная образовательная система является основой успешного будущего.

3. Полезные фразы для официального заключения

Phrase | Значение | Пример | Перевод
In conclusion, ... | В заключение | In conclusion, education is essential for progress. | В заключение, образование необходимо для прогресса.
To conclude, ... | В заключение | To conclude, technology should be used responsibly. | В заключение, технологии должны использоваться ответственно.
To sum up, ... | Вкратце | To sum up, healthy habits improve quality of life. | Вкратце, здоровые привычки улучшают качество жизни.
Overall, ... | В общем | Overall, online learning is flexible and convenient. | В общем, онлайн-обучение гибкое и удобное.
Taking everything into account, ... | Учитывая всё | Taking everything into account, the benefits are greater than the drawbacks. | Учитывая всё, преимущества превышают недостатки.
Based on the points discussed, ... | Основываясь на обсужденных пунктах | Based on the points discussed, social media should be used carefully. | Основываясь на обсужденных пунктах, социальные сети следует использовать осторожно.
It can be concluded that ... | Можно сделать вывод, что | It can be concluded that practice is the key to success. | Можно сделать вывод, что практика — это ключ к успеху.
Therefore, ... | Следовательно | Therefore, students should manage their time well. | Следовательно, студентам следует хорошо управлять своим временем.
For these reasons, ... | По этим причинам | For these reasons, environmental education is necessary. | По этим причинам, экологическое образование необходимо.
In light of the evidence, ... | Учитывая доказательства | In light of the evidence, action must be taken immediately. | Учитывая доказательства, необходимо немедленно принять меры.

4. Разница между официальным и неофициальным заключением

Официальное заключение | Неофициальное заключение | Когда используется? | Пример | Перевод
Официальное, четкое и академическое | Простое, разговорное | Эссе, отчет, презентация | In conclusion, education is vital for future success. | В заключение, образование жизненно важно для будущего успеха.
Нет таких фраз, как “I think”, “Anyway” | Могут быть “I think”, “Anyway”, “That’s all” | Повседневная речь | Anyway, that’s all about education. | В общем, это всё о образовании.
Обобщает основные мысли | Часто завершает просто | Академическое письмо | Overall, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages. | В целом, преимущества перевешивают недостатки.
Будет сильное финальное предложение | Финальное предложение может быть слабым | Экзамены, IELTS, CEFR, университетские работы | Therefore, effective planning is essential. | Поэтому эффективное планирование необходимо.
grammar_rules_kk:
Rásmiy juwmaqlaw — essé, maqala, hisobot, prezentaciya yamasa academic writing aqırında jazılatuǵın rásmiy juwmaqlawshı bólim.

Conclusion’niń vazıypası:

• mavzuni juwmaqlaw;

• asosiy pikirlerdi qısqasha eske salıw;

• umumiy xulosa beriw;

• oqıwshıda anıq juwmaqlawshı tásir qaldırıw.

Muhim: Conclusion’da jańa pikir yamasa jańa argument kirgizilmeydi. Ol aldın aytılǵan asosiy pikirlerdi ulıwmalastıradı.

6 ta sodda mısal

1. In conclusion, education plays an important role in personal and social development.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, ta’lim shaxsiy hám ijtimoiy rivojlanishda muhim rol o‘ynaydı.

2. To conclude, technology can be useful if it is used wisely.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, texnologiya oqilona ishlatilsa foydali boladı.

3. Overall, regular practice is necessary for academic success.
Umuman olganda, akademik muvaffaqiyat ushın muntazam mashq zarur.

4. It can be concluded that online learning offers both opportunities and challenges.
Online ta’lim imkanlar hám qiyinchiliklerdi taqdim etedi, degan xulosa qilish mumkin.

5. For these reasons, students should develop both knowledge and practical skills.
Shu sabablarga ko‘ra, studentler bilim hám amalıy ko‘nikmalarni rivojlantırwı kerek.

6. In light of the evidence, environmental protection should be a global priority.
Dalillarni hisobqa alǵanda, atrof-muhitni himoya qilish global ustuvor vazifa bolwı kerek.

2. Rásmiy juwmaqlaw tuzilışı

Formal conclusion ádette 4 qismdan ibarat boladı.

1. Topicni qayta umumlashtıru

Mavzuni basqa so‘zler menen qisqa eske saladı.

Education is one of the most important factors in modern society.
Ta’lim zamonaviy jamiyatdaǵı eng muhim omillardan biridir.

2. Asosı fikrlerdi qisqa eske salıw

Essay yamasa report içinde aytılǵan asosı fikrler umumlashtırıladı.

It improves knowledge, develops skills, and creates better opportunities.
U bilimni oshıradı, kónikmalarni rivojlantıradı hám jaqsı mümkinşilikler yaratadı.

3. Yakunı xulosa yamasa tavsıya beriw

Oqıwshıǵa umumı natıja yamasa tavsıya beriladı.

Therefore, governments should invest more in education.
Sonlıqtan, hukumatlar ta’limge kóproq sarmoya kiritwi kerek.

4. Kúchli final sentence yozıw

Oxırǵı gáp anıq, kúchli hám esda qolarli bolıwı kerek.

A strong education system is the foundation of a successful future.
Kúchli ta’lim tizimi muvaffaqiyatlı kelǵekniń asasıdır.

3. Formal conclusion üşin foydali ibralar

Phrase | Ma’nısı | Misal | Tarjima
In conclusion, ... | Xulosa qilib aytganda | In conclusion, education is essential for progress. | Xulosa qilib aytganda, ta’lim taraqqiyot üşin zarur.
To conclude, ... | Xulosa qilib | To conclude, technology should be used responsibly. | Xulosa qilib, texnologiyadan mas’uliyat menen foydalanıw kerek.
To sum up, ... | Qısqasha aytganda | To sum up, healthy habits improve quality of life. | Qısqasha aytganda, sog‘lom odatlar hayot sifatın jaqsılaydı.
Overall, ... | Umuman olǵanda | Overall, online learning is flexible and convenient. | Umuman olǵanda, online ta’lim moslaşwlı hám qulay.
Taking everything into account, ... | Barchasın esapqa alǵanda | Taking everything into account, the benefits are greater than the drawbacks. | Barchasın esapqa alǵanda, foydalari kamçılıqtarınan kóproq.
Based on the points discussed, ... | Muhokama qılınǵan fikrlere asáslanıp | Based on the points discussed, social media should be used carefully. | Muhokama qılınǵan fikrlere asáslanıp, ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan ehtiyotkorlıq menen foydalanıw kerek.
It can be concluded that ... | Shunday xulosa qılıw mumkın | It can be concluded that practice is the key to success. | Muvaffaqiyat kaliti mashqdir, degan xulosa qılıw mumkın.
Therefore, ... | Shuning üşin | Therefore, students should manage their time well. | Shuning üşin, talabalardıń waqıtların jaqsı basqarwları kerek.
For these reasons, ... | Shu sabablara kóre | For these reasons, environmental education is necessary. | Shu sabablara kóre, ekologik ta’lim zarur.
In light of the evidence, ... | Dalıllar menen esapqa alǵanda | In light of the evidence, action must be taken immediately. | Dalıllar menen esapqa alǵanda, darǵıl chora qılınw kerek.

4. Formal hám informal conclusion farqı

Rásmiy juwmaqlaw | Ádette juwmaqlaw | Qashan qollanıladı? | Mısal | Tarjima
Rásmiy, anıq hám akademik | Oddiy, suhbatqa xos | Essay, report, presentation | In conclusion, education is vital for future success. | Xulosa qilib aytganda, ta’lim kelajaktaǵı muvaffaqiyat ushın muhim.
“I think”, “Anyway” kabi iboralar joq | “I think”, “Anyway”, “That’s all” bolıwı mümkin | Kundalık nutq | Anyway, that’s all about education. | Xullas, ta’lim toǵrısında shular.
Asasiy fikrlerdi umumlashtıradı | Kóbinese oddiy tugatadı | Academic writing | Overall, the advantages outweigh the disadvantages. | Umuman alğanda, afzallıqlar kamçılıqlardan ustun.
Kúchli final gap boladı | Final gap kúchsiz bolıwı mümkin | Imtihon, IELTS, CEFR, universitet jumıstarı | Therefore, effective planning is essential. | Sonlıqtan, samaralı rejalashtıru zarur.
reading_passage:
This week I learned about protecting a national cultural treasure. Our class used a realistic situation from a heritage-policy report.

The report examines a historic site that attracts thousands of visitors each year. Conservation teams have repaired damaged sections while trying to preserve original materials.

Local residents benefit from tourism, but heavy visitor numbers can place pressure on fragile areas. The report argues that education, careful planning and community participation are all necessary for long-term protection.

The target grammar appears naturally in the discussion: “In conclusion, protecting cultural heritage requires both public responsibility and long-term planning.” In conclusion, cultural heritage can remain meaningful only when preservation and public access are balanced responsibly.

Rather than treating the passage as a grammar list, the class reads for meaning first and then returns to the language that carries the meaning. Amina and Tom compare evidence from different parts of the text before answering the final comprehension questions.

reading_vocabulary.definition: history, traditions and important places passed down through generations
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “heritage” in the context of protecting a national cultural treasure.

reading_vocabulary.definition: protection of important natural or cultural things
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “conservation” in the context of protecting a national cultural treasure.

reading_vocabulary.definition: easily damaged
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “fragile” in the context of protecting a national cultural treasure.

reading_vocabulary.definition: the act of keeping something safe and unchanged
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “preservation” in the context of protecting a national cultural treasure.

reading_vocabulary.definition: taking part in an activity or decision
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “participation” in the context of protecting a national cultural treasure.

reading_vocabulary.definition: a suggestion about what should be done
reading_vocabulary.example: The lesson uses “recommendation” in the context of protecting a national cultural treasure.

reading_questions.question: What is the text mainly about?
options: choosing a computer for university work
deciding whether to adopt a dog
how a small student band prepares music
protecting a national cultural treasure
reading_questions.hint: Use the title and the first paragraph to identify the central topic.

reading_questions.question: Where is the main situation set?
options: a heritage-policy report
a quiet dormitory room
a technology review club
a cybersecurity workshop
reading_questions.hint: Find the place named near the beginning of the text.

reading_questions.question: Which detail is stated in the text?
options: the report examines a historic site that attracts thousands of visitors each year
Maya is from Urgench and studies information technology
many choose nervous, tired or worried, while a few choose confident
short walks between long study sessions can reduce tiredness
reading_questions.hint: Return to the paragraph that introduces the first concrete fact.

reading_questions.question: What additional information does the text give?
options: conservation teams have repaired damaged sections while trying to preserve original materials
Nina checks university messages on her phone every morning
shops in the neighbourhood close earlier on Sunday than on other days
the residence manager is asking students to keep the corridor quiet during study hours
reading_questions.hint: Look for the second supporting detail; do not choose an idea from another topic.

reading_questions.question: Which statement belongs to the later part of the text?
options: several notebooks, pens, headphones and water bottles are waiting for their owners
many young employees prefer hybrid work because it combines flexibility with face-to-face contact
the teacher is explaining how a web page is different from the wider internet
local residents benefit from tourism, but heavy visitor numbers can place pressure on fragile areas
reading_questions.hint: Scan the later paragraph and match the exact meaning, not just a familiar word.

reading_questions.question: What happens or is explained after that?
options: there are several lightweight models but only a little information about battery life on the display cards
Lena finds a black-and-white photograph in her grandmother’s album
this month she is staying with a cousin in Greenwich while her room is being repaired
the report argues that education, careful planning and community participation are all necessary for long-term protection
reading_questions.hint: The correct choice is explicitly supported by the final supporting detail.

reading_questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the grammar focus of this lesson?
options: In conclusion, protecting cultural heritage requires both public responsibility and long-term planning.
I am Amina, Tom is my classmate, and we are ready.
The new device is small, light and reliable.
A student adopted a dog. The dog now lives in an apartment near the university.
reading_questions.hint: Look for a sentence that matches: Formal conclusions.

reading_questions.question: In this text, what is the best meaning of “heritage”?
options: a person who refuses to study
a place used only for sport
a kind of examination result
history, traditions and important places passed down through generations
reading_questions.hint: Use the surrounding topic and the vocabulary panel; do not guess from spelling alone.

reading_questions.question: What is the outcome or conclusion of the reading?
options: Regular backups make it easier to recover work after a device problem.
The column suggests changing small habits rather than simply complaining about Mondays.
In conclusion, cultural heritage can remain meaningful only when preservation and public access are balanced responsibly.
The organised desk gives Eva more space and helps her find things quickly.
reading_questions.hint: Read the final topic sentence before the study-task paragraph.

reading_questions.question: Why is this text included in the lesson?
options: to copy a model answer without reading
to understand the topic and notice the target grammar in meaningful context
to memorise an unrelated word list
to translate every sentence word for word
reading_questions.hint: The lesson combines comprehension with grammar-in-context rather than isolated rules.

listening_transcript:
Amina: Tom, I was thinking about our lesson on protecting a national cultural treasure.
Tom: Me too. We have to present final recommendations for protecting a heritage site, so the details matter.
Amina: I wrote down the first point. Tell me if this is right.
Tom: Amina says visitor numbers should be controlled during the busiest months.
Amina: What did you write for the next point?
Tom: Tom recommends training local guides to explain why some areas are restricted.
Amina: I nearly missed another detail.
Tom: They agree that tourism income should support conservation work.
Amina: Yes, and there is one more fact we should not forget.
Tom: Amina concludes that protection will succeed only if residents are included in decisions.
Amina: Let’s check the grammar before we finish.
Tom: For example: In conclusion, protecting cultural heritage requires both public responsibility and long-term planning.
Amina: Great. What happened in the end?
Tom: Their final recommendation balances education, access and preservation.

options: retell a traditional story using object pronouns
present final recommendations for protecting a heritage site
identify who owns several classroom items
work out who owns objects shown in a family photo
listening_questions.hint: Listen to the purpose stated in the opening exchange.

listening_questions.question: What first detail does the second speaker mention?
options: Sara drinks water every day and almost never drinks energy drinks

listening_questions.question: Which sentence uses today’s target grammar?
